title: Self-Supervised Auxiliary Task Discovery for Stable Reinforcement Learning in Stock Trading
summary: Reinforcement learning has gained increasing attention as a data-driven approach for stock trading. However, learning a policy that is both profitable and stable remains challenging due to non-stationary market behaviour and noisy reward signals. Auxiliary tasks are often used to improve representation learning and stabilize training, yet they are usually designed manually and depend heavily on prior assumptions about targets and prediction horizons. Such fixed designs may not remain suitable across changing market regimes. In this work, we propose a self-supervised framework that automatically discovers auxiliary tasks to support reinforcement learning for stock trading. The auxiliary tasks are formulated as General Value Functions so that their predictions enrich the learned state representation and assist policy optimization. The framework consists of two networks. The main network learns the trading policy along with the auxiliary predictions, while the secondary network generates the definitions of auxiliary tasks through learned cumulants and discount factors. These tasks are updated using a meta gradient mechanism that accounts for their long-term impact on trading performance and improves training stability. We evaluate the proposed approach across four major equity indices: DJI, FTSE, Sensex, and TAIEX. The empirical results demonstrate that automatically discovered auxiliary tasks lead to more robust learning and improved trading performance compared to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自监督框架，通过自动发现辅助任务（以通用价值函数形式表达）来支持股票交易中的强化学习，利用元梯度机制优化任务定义，在四个股指上验证了其稳健性和交易性能优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 股票交易中强化学习面临市场非平稳和奖励信号嘈杂的挑战，传统辅助任务依赖人工设计，基于固定的目标假设和预测范围，难以适应市场机制的变化，缺乏自适应能力。
AI.method: 提出双网络自监督框架：主网络学习交易策略和辅助预测，辅助网络通过学习累积量与折扣因子自动生成辅助任务定义；辅助任务基于通用价值函数公式化，通过元梯度机制更新任务参数，考虑其对交易绩效的长期影响并提升训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在DJI、FTSE、Sensex和TAIEX四大股指上进行评估，实验结果表明自动发现的辅助任务相比现有基线产生了更稳健的学习过程和更优的交易表现。
AI.conclusion: 自动发现的辅助任务能有效改善股票交易强化学习的表示学习和策略优化，自适应任务设计比人工固定设计在不同市场环境下更具优势。

title: Is the medium the message? Social disclosure channels and firm risk
summary: Investors interpret social disclosures from a risk perspective, yet relevant information can reach them through channels that differ sharply in regulatory enforcement and materiality: SEC filings, sustainability reports, or financial reports. We analyse how social disclosure via each channel relates to idiosyncratic risk. Studying S&P 1,500 constituents, we distinguish between initiated and continued disclosure along the three disclosure channels. We find first-time disclosure of social issues via SEC filings is related to increased idiosyncratic firm risk, highlighting that unexpected information is published. Continuous disclosure of social issues is related to lower idiosyncratic risk for sustainability and financial reports, which is in line with the literature. The SEC filing effect is robust for downside idiosyncratic risk measures, the separation of social disclosure into human capital, product liabilities, and stakeholder engagement, and for propensity score matching. Our findings suggest that the risk impacts of sustainability disclosure depend on the newness of information and disclosure channels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究社会信息披露渠道（SEC文件、可持续发展报告和财务报告）与公司特质风险之间的关系，通过对S&P 1500成分股的分析，发现首次通过SEC文件披露社会问题会增加特质风险，而持续披露则会降低特质风险。
AI.motivation: 投资者从风险角度解读社会披露，但不同披露渠道在监管执行和重要性上存在显著差异，现有文献缺乏对不同渠道下社会披露与特质风险关系的系统性区分。
AI.method: 基于S&P 1500成分股样本，区分首次披露与持续披露，分别考察三条披露渠道（SEC文件、可持续发展报告、财务报告）与社会披露的关系，并采用下行特质风险测度、社会披露细分（人力资本、产品责任、利益相关者参与）以及倾向得分匹配等方法进行稳健性检验。
AI.result: 首次通过SEC文件披露社会问题与特质风险上升相关；持续通过可持续发展报告和财务报告披露社会问题与特质风险下降相关；SEC文件效应在下行特质风险、社会披露细分及倾向得分匹配下均保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 可持续发展披露的风险影响取决于信息的新颖程度和披露渠道，首次披露带来不确定性，持续披露则有助于降低风险。

title: Geometry Induced Contraction Degradation and Stabilization of Learning Enabled Observers
comment: IEEE CDC 2026 preprint (Accepted), Authors have equal contribution, 8 pages and 7 figures
summary: Learned perception models are increasingly used as measurement maps within nonlinear observers, mapping high dimensional sensory inputs to low dimensional quantities for state estimation. Unlike analytic measurement functions, learned models introduce state dependent Jacobians whose effect on observer stability is rarely characterized. We show that learned measurement geometry enters the observer error dynamics explicitly and rescales Euclidean contraction margins. Under fixed gains, increased measurement sensitivity reduces the certifiable contraction region and can eliminate exponential convergence guarantees. To address this effect, we introduce a representation aware gain normalization that compensates for geometry induced amplification using only local Jacobian information. The proposed approach treats the learned measurement model as a black box and requires no retraining or architectural modification. The normalization removes the dominant sensitivity dependence and restores a uniform Euclidean contraction bound while preserving a simple observer structure. Numerical and real data experiments validate the predicted sensitivity convergence relationship and demonstrate improved robustness and stability in learning enabled observer architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了学习型感知模型作为非线性观测器测量映射时，其状态相关雅可比矩阵对观测器稳定性的影响，并提出一种仅利用局部雅可比信息的表示感知增益归一化方法，以补偿几何放大效应并恢复均匀欧几里得收缩界。
AI.motivation: 学习型感知模型越来越多地被用作非线性观测器中的测量映射，将高维感官输入映射到低维状态估计量。与解析测量函数不同，学习模型引入的状态相关雅可比矩阵对观测器稳定性的影响很少被刻画，而固定增益下测量灵敏度的增加可能消除指数收敛保证。
AI.method: 首先证明学习测量几何显式进入观测器误差动力学并重新缩放欧几里得收缩边界；然后提出表示感知增益归一化方法，仅利用局部雅可比信息补偿几何引起的放大效应，将学习测量模型视为黑盒，无需重新训练或修改架构。
AI.result: 归一化方法消除了主导灵敏度依赖并恢复均匀欧几里得收缩界，同时保持简单观测器结构；数值与真实数据实验验证了预测的灵敏度-收敛关系，并展示了学习使能观测器架构在鲁棒性和稳定性上的提升。
AI.conclusion: 学习测量模型的几何特性对观测器稳定性有显著影响，所提出的增益归一化方法为现有学习使能观测器提供了一种轻量化、无需改架构的稳定性补偿策略。

title: Optimal Control Variates for Survey Sampling and Causal Inference
summary: We propose a family of control variate estimators for variance reduction in design-based survey sampling and causal inference, with and without interference. In these settings, inverse probability weighting (IPW) estimators are widely used, but may have large variance when sampling, treatment, or exposure probabilities are small. Building on the observation that several common estimators, including the Hajek, normalized, and augmented inverse probability weighting (AIPW) estimators, correct the Horvitz-Thompson estimator by canceling part of its randomness, we provide a unified interpretation of these estimators as special cases of a general control variate estimator. We then construct optimal control variates that can further reduce the finite sample variance compared to these common estimators. We parameterize the proposed control variates by their bases and characterize the optimal bases through a stochastic optimization formulation. In survey sampling and causal inference without interference, the optimal bases are characterized by leading eigenvectors of matrices that depend on both the design-based sampling structure and the model-based outcome uncertainty. In causal inference under network interference, the optimal bases solve a nonconvex quadratic optimization problem; we provide a $\frac{1}{2}$-approximate solution and an alternating local search heuristic. We apply the control variate estimators to the Swiss Environmental Panel survey data and the Chinese social network data, and conduct extensive simulations to show that the proposed control variate estimators can achieve substantial variance reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一族控制变量估计器，用于减少基于设计的抽样调查和因果推断中的方差。作者将Hajek、归一化及AIPW等常见估计器统一解释为一般控制变量估计器的特例，并构造了最优控制变量以进一步降低有限样本方差。最优基分别通过特征向量或非凸二次优化（提供1/2近似解）刻画，仿真和实证均显示显著方差缩减。
AI.motivation: 逆概率加权（IPW）估计器在抽样调查与因果推断中被广泛使用，但当抽样概率、处理概率或暴露概率较小时，其方差可能很大。现有修正方法（如Hajek、AIPW）虽能降低方差，但缺乏统一的解释框架，也难以系统性地构造更优估计器。
AI.method: 1) 将Hajek、归一化与AIPW估计器统一解释为Horvitz-Thompson估计器的控制变量修正特例；2) 提出一般化的控制变量估计器族，并参数化其基底；3) 通过随机优化刻画最优基底：无干扰情形下由依赖抽样结构与模型不确定性的矩阵的前导特征向量刻画，网络干扰下由非凸二次优化刻画（给出1/2近似解与交替局部搜索启发式）；4) 在瑞士环境面板与中囵社交网络数据上应用并进行广泛仿真验证。
AI.result: 在瑞士环境面板调查数据和中囵社交网络数据上，所提控制变量估计器相比常见估计器实现了可观（substantial）的方差缩减；仿真实验进一步验证了方法在不同设定下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为IPW类估计器的方差缩减提供了一个统一的理论框架，并通过最优控制变量的构造系统性地提升了估计精度，适用于有/无干扰下的抽样调查与因果推断场景。

title: Disclosed Human-Capital Disruption and Firm-Specific Risk
comment: 50 pages
summary: Human capital is a central organizational input, but standard financial data reveal little about firm-specific disruptions to workforce availability, cost, skills, and continuity. I construct a measure of disclosed human-capital disruption from earnings calls using author-defined coding criteria and a contextual language model. Within firms, a one-standard-deviation increase in the annual measure is associated with 0.55 percentage points higher idiosyncratic volatility, 0.58 percentage points higher downside deviation, and a 0.46 percentage point lower worst monthly return, with no corresponding relation to market beta. The results are stable across seven broader and narrower classification rules and remain after removing explicit labor-shortage passages and controlling for a recently published labor-shortage measure and transcript-wide negative and uncertain language. At the call level, human-capital disruption predicts approximately 0.50% higher idiosyncratic volatility over the following 42 trading days after conditioning on pre-call risk. Risk is elevated before the call as well, and the score predicts the continuation of that firm-specific risk state over the following 42 trading days. After telegraphing and succession passages are removed, the measure also predicts subsequent named-executive roster exits and the incumbent CEO's effective departure from office. Earnings calls therefore reveal disturbances to a key organizational input that are broader than labor shortages and informative about the distribution of firm outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于财报电话会议文本的人力资本中断度量指标，发现该指标与公司特质波动率、下行偏差等风险指标显著正相关，并能预测高管离职等事件，说明财报电话会议能揭示超出劳动力短缺范畴的组织关键投入扰动。
AI.motivation: 人力资本是组织的核心投入，但标准财务数据无法揭示公司特有的人力可用性、成本、技能和连续性中断。现有文献缺乏一个能够从公开信息中系统度量人力资本中断的指标。
AI.method: 作者使用作者定义编码标准和情境语言模型，从财报电话会议记录中构建人力资本中断披露指标。通过回归分析检验该指标与公司风险度量的关系，并进行多种稳健性检验（如多种分类规则、控制劳动力短缺指标和负面语言等），同时进行事件层面的预测测试。
AI.result: 公司内部，该指标每增加一个标准差，与特质波动率增加0.55个百分点、下行偏差增加0.58个百分点、最差月度回报率下降0.46个百分点相关，且与市场贝塔无关。在电话会议层面，该指标能预测随后42个交易日内约0.50%的特质波动率上升，并能预测高管名单变动和CEO离职。
AI.conclusion: 财报电话会议能揭示超出劳动力短缺范畴的人力资本中断信息，这些信息对公司风险分布具有预测力，说明人力资本中断是影响企业产出分布的重要组织投入扰动。

title: Pricing Temperature-Index Insurance under Long Memory and Stochastic Time Change
comment: 43 pages, 6 figures
summary: This paper develops a unit-consistent actuarial framework for pricing capped cumulative temperature-index insurance under long-range dependence and stochastic variability. Daily temperature anomalies are modeled as increments of fractional Brownian motion evaluated at an operational time generated by the integral of a stationary normalized Cox--Ingersoll--Ross process. We show that the stochastic time change preserves stationarity and the long-memory covariance decay of the increments while introducing additional variability through the random operational clock. The cumulative temperature index admits a conditionally Gaussian representation, which leads to an exact conditional exponential kernel for capped stop-loss contracts and ensures existence of the entropic premium for every positive risk-aversion parameter. Consequently, valuation reduces to an outer Monte Carlo expectation over the accumulated CIR time, avoiding fractional Brownian path simulation and covariance-matrix construction. We further establish monotonicity properties of the premium with respect to risk aversion and conditional volatility. An empirical illustration based on Chicago temperature data shows that both long memory and stochastic time change can materially affect insurance premiums relative to conventional Brownian and fractional Brownian benchmarks, with the Hurst parameter playing an important role in valuation uncertainty. The proposed framework therefore provides a tractable approach for incorporating persistent dependence, stochastic variability, and bounded insurance losses into climate-index pricing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个单位一致的精算框架，用于在长程依赖和随机波动性下对带上限的累积温度指数保险进行定价。温度异常被建模为分数布朗运动在由CIR过程积分生成的操作时间下的增量，利用条件高斯表示实现了精确的条件指数核定价，将估值简化为对累积CIR时间的外层蒙特卡洛期望。
AI.motivation: 传统温度指数保险定价模型通常基于标准布朗运动或分数布朗运动，但难以同时捕捉温度序列的长程依赖（长期记忆）和随机波动性，且计算上需要模拟分数布朗路径和构造协方差矩阵，效率低下且不够精确。
AI.method: 1) 将每日温度异常建模为分数布朗运动在操作随机时间（由标准化CIR过程积分生成）下的增量；2) 证明随机时间变换保持平稳性和长记忆协方差衰减，同时引入额外随机波动；3) 利用累积温度指数的条件高斯表示，推导带上限止损合约的精确条件指数核；4) 通过外层蒙特卡洛对CIR时间求期望来完成定价，避免分数布朗路径模拟与协方差矩阵构造。
AI.result: 证明了熵保费对任意正风险厌恶参数均存在，建立了保费对风险厌恶和条件波动率的单调性。基于芝加哥温度数据的实证表明，长记忆和随机时间变换相对传统布朗和分数布朗基准可实质影响保险保费，Hurst参数在估值不确定性中起重要作用。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种将持久依赖、随机变异和有界保险损失纳入气候指数定价的可处理方法，兼具理论完备性与计算可行性。

title: Behavioral Participating Insurance: Optimal Investment under Probability Distortion and Aspiration Constraints
comment: 38 pages, 9 figures
summary: We study optimal investment for insurers managing participating (profit-sharing) contracts under probability distortion and probability benchmark (aspiration) constraints. The problem combines three theoretical complexities: (i) nonconcave effective utilities induced by embedded guarantees and surplus-sharing rules, (ii) probability weighting capturing behavioral aspects of long-horizon decisions, and (iii) aspiration-type constraints formalizing solvency requirements. Using quantile formulations and concavification techniques, we derive explicit closed-form solutions for optimal terminal wealth and trading strategies in both complete and incomplete Black-Scholes markets. Our utility class accommodates the piecewise hyperbolic absolute risk aversion (PHARA) family and covers nonconcavities arising naturally in insurance contexts. The framework reveals how probability distortion weakens lock-in behavior and induces time inconsistency: under inverse S-shaped distortions, insurers overestimate upside probabilities and increase risky investment relative to undistorted benchmarks. Asymptotic analysis and numerical illustrations demonstrate regime switches in optimal policies driven by regulatory thresholds and capital constraints. Our results extend the hope-fear-aspirations framework of He and Zhou (2016) and provide practical insights for managing insurance balance sheets under behavioral preferences and solvency constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了保险公司在概率扭曲和概率基准（期望）约束下管理参与型（利润分享）合约的最优投资问题，通过分位数公式和凹化技术，在完整和不完整的Black-Scholes市场中推导出最优终期财富和交易策略的显式闭式解。
AI.motivation: 保险公司管理参与型合约时面临三个理论复杂性：(i)嵌入保证和盈余分享规则导致的非凹有效效用；(ii)反映长期决策行为特征的概率加权；(iii)形式化偿付能力要求的期望型约束。这些问题尚未在统一框架下得到系统解决。
AI.method: 采用分位数公式和凹化技术，在完整和不完整Black-Scholes市场中求解最优投资问题。效用类别涵盖分段双曲绝对风险厌恶（PHARA）族，并处理保险情境中自然出现的非凹性。结合渐近分析和数值模拟。
AI.result: 揭示了概率扭曲削弱锁定行为并引发时间不一致性：在逆S形扭曲下，保险公司高估上行概率并相对于无扭曲基准增加风险投资。渐近分析和数值示例表明最优策略存在由监管阈值和资本约束驱动的机制转换。
AI.conclusion: 本文扩展了He和Zhou（2016）的希望-恐惧-期望框架，为在行为偏好和偿付能力约束下管理保险公司资产负债表提供了实际见解。

title: ARISE: An adaptive residual-informed stability ensemble for feature selection in small-sample biomedical omics
comment: 30 pages, 6 figures
summary:
Objective: Small-sample molecular classification requires feature selectors that identify predictive, stable, and nonredundant subsets for binary and multiclass outcomes. We propose ARISE (Adaptive Residual-Informed Stability Ensemble), which integrates complementary relevance signals, class-balanced stability assessment, residual-informed redundancy control, and multiclass pairwise coverage.
  Methods: ARISE combines seven percentile-normalized relevance components through 15 predefined profiles, adaptively weighted by nested inner cross-validation. It was evaluated on five molecular datasets, eight feature-set sizes, three fixed classifiers (k-nearest neighbours, support vector machine, and random forest), and six filter comparators. Generalization was estimated by five-fold outer cross-validation repeated 50 times using balanced accuracy, macro-F1, and Cohen's kappa.
  Results: Across 210,000 held-out assessments, ARISE ranked first in all 15 dataset-metric combinations. Equal-dataset means were 0.793 for balanced accuracy, 0.776 for macro-F1, and 0.725 for kappa, exceeding the strongest aggregate comparator by 0.022, 0.023, and 0.028, respectively. Performance remained strong across compact feature sets, although the optimal budget differed by dataset.
  Conclusion: ARISE provides a transparent, adaptive framework that jointly addresses relevance, stability, redundancy, and multiclass discrimination. Its consistent results across datasets, classifiers, metrics, and feature-set sizes support further evaluation for small-sample molecular classification.

AI.tldr: 提出ARISE（自适应残差信息稳定性集成）特征选择框架，用于小样本分子分类，整合七种相关性信号、类别平衡稳定性评估、残差信息冗余控制和多类别成对覆盖，在21万次评估中全面超越六个对比滤波器方法。
AI.motivation: 小样本分子分类需要能够识别预测性强、稳定且非冗余特征子集的选择器，现有方法在二分类和多分类场景下难以同时满足相关性、稳定性和冗余控制的需求。
AI.method: ARISE通过15个预定义配置组合七种百分位数归一化的相关性组件，利用嵌套内部交叉验证自适应加权；结合类别平衡稳定性评估、残差信息驱动的冗余控制和多类别成对覆盖率；在五个分子数据集上使用三个固定分类器（KNN、SVM、随机森林）和六个滤波器基准方法进行比较，采用5折外层交叉验证重复50次评估泛化性能。
AI.result: 在21万次保留测试评估中，ARISE在全部15个数据集-指标组合中排名第一；平均平衡准确率0.793、宏F1为0.776、Cohen's kappa为0.725，分别超过最强聚合对比方法0.022、0.023和0.028；在紧凑特征集上仍保持强劲性能，但最优特征预算随数据集而异。
AI.conclusion: ARISE提供了一个透明、自适应的框架，联合解决相关性、稳定性、冗余性和多类别判别问题，在不同数据集、分类器、指标和特征集大小上表现一致，值得在小样本分子分类中进一步推广验证。

title: FLOPs vs Real Work: The Importance of Replication in AI Efficiency Assessment
summary:
AI efficiency has recently taken the spotlight in both academy and industry due to massive model scales, high energy demands, and environmental costs. While reporting Floating Point Operations (FLOPs) is a traditional approach for assessing computational costs, the relationship between FLOPs and execution time is not straightforward, as layers with the same number of FLOPs may not have the same execution time because some operations are more easily parallelized than others. This paper sets out to replicate the original experiments from a study that proposed the $α-FLOPs$ estimation formula to verify whether the results remain applicable on newer, more powerful hardware.
  During the replication process, we identify limitations in the replication materials provided by the original study, including a lack of specific dependency details and transparency regarding regression data. Our results validate the thesis that raw FLOPs alone are not an appropriate metric for execution time, as spatial dimensions remain more easily parallelized than kernel dimensions. However, fine-grained measurements reveal that the relationship is much less straightforward than previously shown, with newer hardware exhibiting instabilities and discontinuities in execution time, including jumps and oscillations, that the $α-FLOPs$ formula generally underestimates. Ultimately, this work validates the empirical findings from the original study but shows negative results when applying the $α-FLOPs$ estimation. We also highlight the critical need for complete and accurate replication packages for research on hardware-dependent efficiency assessment and provide a complete replication package for our implementation to facilitate further study.

AI.tldr: 本文复制了原始研究中提出的α-FLOPs估算公式实验，以验证其在新硬件上的适用性。结果显示原始研究的经验发现（原始FLOPs不适合衡量执行时间）依然成立，但α-FLOPs估算公式在新硬件上表现不佳，存在低估和不稳定性问题。同时指出原始研究复现材料的不足，并提供了完整的复现包。
AI.motivation: 传统上使用FLOPs评估计算成本，但FLOPs与执行时间之间并非简单的对应关系（某些操作更容易并行化）。本研究旨在复制原始研究中提出的α-FLOPs估算公式实验，验证其结果是否在更新、更强大的硬件上仍然适用。
AI.method: 复现原始α-FLOPs估算公式的实验，在更新的硬件上进行测试，并进行细粒度测量以观察执行时间的变化模式。同时评估原始研究的复现材料质量。
AI.result: 验证了原始FLOPs不适合作为执行时间指标的论点（空间维度比核维度更容易并行化）。但发现新硬件显示出执行时间的不稳定性和不连续性（跳跃和振荡），α-FLOPs公式普遍低估这些现象。应用α-FLOPs估算时得到负面结果。
AI.conclusion: 原始研究的经验发现得到验证，但α-FLOPs估算公式在新硬件上不适用。强调硬件依赖的效率评估研究需要完整、准确的复现包，并提供完整复现包以促进进一步研究。

title: Auxiliary uncertainty signals for LLM-assisted systematic review screening: a benchmark across eight Cohen drug-class reviews
comment: 27 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Code, prompts, and cached LLM responses at https://github.com/rahgoar/LR-Spectral-BERTGCN-Topological-Undecidability-in-Clinical-AI
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for title-abstract screening in systematic reviews, but their decisions lack calibrated uncertainty. We show that an auxiliary BERT+GCN classifier supplies a structured uncertainty signal that improves LLM screening efficiency, and we identify the prompt-delivery strategy that maximises the benefit-to-cost ratio.
  We evaluate five LLM prompt-delivery conditions on eight drug-class datasets from the Cohen (2006) benchmark using 3 seeds x 5-fold stratified cross-validation (600 fold-level results). A BERT+GCN model trained per fold classifies each test paper as INCLUDE, EXCLUDE, or MAYBE via two spectral tests (algebraic radical and categorical paradox). Conditions vary information content (none / label / full scores), selectivity (all papers vs. MAYBE only), and timing (proactive vs. reactive two-pass). A cross-model pilot against gpt-4.1-mini on three datasets tests cross-generation transfer.
  Three findings: (i) Full-context delivery yields significant gains in F1 (+0.011, paired Wilcoxon p=0.008) and WSS@95 (+0.050, p=0.039) at a 1.28x token-cost premium, while preserving recall. (ii) MAYBE-only routing is Pareto-optimal: highest mean recall (0.92) and AUC-ROC (0.54) at only 1.05x baseline cost -- one sixth of full-context overhead. (iii) The two-pass design escalates 22.2% +/- 8.8% of records yet never revises its decision (0% flip rate across all datasets and folds), giving decisive evidence that current instruction-tuned LLMs cannot self-triage. The cross-model pilot shows an identical +0.8% recall uplift for both LLM generations. A per-paper ablation across 20,796 observations shows the dual paradox test reduces empirically to a one-line logit-gap criterion. We release the full pipeline; the 600-run experiment replays in under one hour from cached LLM responses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了如何利用辅助BERT+GCN分类器为LLM的系统综述标题-摘要筛选提供结构化不确定性信号，以提高筛选效率。在Cohen (2006)基准的8个药物数据集上，通过600次交叉验证实验评估了五种提示交付策略，发现全上下文交付显著提升F1和WSS@95，MAYBE-only路由是帕累托最优方案，而两遍设计证明当前指令微调LLM无法自我分流。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地用于系统综述的标题-摘要筛选，但其决策缺乏校准的不确定性评估。传统LLM筛选方式要么过度筛选（高召回但低精确率），要么需要人工检查大量无关记录，效率低下。需要一个结构化的不确定性信号来引导LLM更高效地工作。
AI.method: 使用BERT+GCN辅助分类器对每篇测试论文分类为INCLUDE/EXCLUDE/MAYBE（通过两个谱测试：代数根测试和范畴悖论测试），然后将此信号通过五种提示交付条件提供给LLM：(1)无信息、(2)仅标签、(3)全分数、(4)仅MAYBE选择性路由、(5)两遍反应式设计。在3个种子x5折交叉验证下评估，并用gpt-4.1-mini进行跨模型迁移测试。
AI.result: (i)全上下文交付在1.28倍token成本下使F1提升0.011（p=0.008）、WSS@95提升0.050（p=0.039），同时保持召回率；(ii)MAYBE-only路由具有最优帕累托特性：最高平均召回率0.92和AUC-ROC 0.54，仅1.05倍基准成本（全上下文开销的六分之一）；(iii)两遍设计升级了22.2%±8.8%的记录却从未修改决策（0%翻转率），证明LLM无法自我分流。跨模型实验显示两种LLM代际均获得相同的+0.8%召回提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的不确定性信号（来自BERT+GCN）能显著提升LLM系统综述筛选效率，推荐使用MAYBE-only路由作为成本效益最佳的交付策略。当前指令微调LLM缺乏自我分流能力，需要外部辅助信号指导筛选。文章发布完整流程，600次实验可在1小时内从缓存的LLM响应中重放。

title: Resilience-Oriented Parametric Insurance Design for Power Systems Under Extreme Weather
summary: Extreme weather leaves power systems exposed to residual outage risk even after physical resilience investments. Parametric insurance can provide pre-agreed contingent liquidity, but its physical value depends on how trigger thresholds and payout levels are designed. This paper proposes a resilience oriented parametric insurance framework that couples a three tier wind-index contract with post-event network restoration. Insurance payout expands the budget available to activate emergency resources, so the contract changes the physical restoration feasible set rather than merely offsetting accounting losses. Trigger thresholds and payout levels are jointly designed to balance actuarial premium, expected post-event system cost, and the conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) of scenario energy not supplied (ENS). A response-library method precomputes the restoration mixed-integer linear program for each scenario-payout pair and then evaluates admissible contracts efficiently. On the IEEE RTS-24 with 80 extreme-wind scenarios, the optimized contract reduces expected EENS and CVaR0.90 of ENS by 21.1% and 21.4%, respectively, relative to no insurance, while requiring 48.8% less premium than a fixed parametric contract with comparable resilience. The results show that insurance design should target the nonlinear liquidity-to-resilience response rather than loss compensation alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向韧性的参数化保险框架，将三层风指数合同与灾后电网恢复相结合。保险赔付通过扩大应急资源预算，改变物理恢复可行集而非仅补偿经济损失。触发阈值和赔付水平被联合设计，以平衡精算保费、期望灾后系统成本及场景ENS的CVaR。在IEEE RTS-24系统上，优化合同相比无保险情景将期望EENS和CVaR0.90分别降低21.1%和21.4%，且比固定参数合同节省48.8%保费。
AI.motivation: 极端天气使电力系统即使在物理韧性投资后仍面临剩余停电风险。传统参数化保险虽能提供预先约定的应急流动性，但其物理价值高度依赖于触发阈值和赔付水平的设计，现有方法未充分考虑保险赔付对灾后恢复过程的物理支撑作用。
AI.method: 提出韧性导向的参数化保险框架，包含三层风指数合同，将保险赔付与灾后网络恢复耦合。采用响应库方法对每个场景-赔付组合预计算恢复混合整数线性规划，从而高效评估可行合同；联合优化触发阈值与赔付水平，权衡精算保费、期望灾后系统成本和场景ENS的CVaR。
AI.result: 在IEEE RTS-24系统上使用80个极端风场景验证，优化合同相比无保险情景将期望EENS降低21.1%，CVaR0.90的ENS降低21.4%；与具有可比韧性的固定参数合同相比，保费降低48.8%。
AI.conclusion: 保险设计应瞄准非线性的"流动性-韧性"响应关系，而非单纯的损失补偿。参数化保险的触发阈值与赔付设计可显著提升灾后系统恢复能力，为电力系统韧性风险管理提供了新的市场化工具。

title: Recommended Selves: Authenticity and Algorithmic Filtering
comment: 21 pages. Published in the Journal of the American Philosophical Association 12(1): 15-34 (2026). DOI: 10.1017/apa.2025.10009
summary: By allocating their attention to pieces of content, algorithmic filtering shapes the daily behavior of billions of users when they interact with a digital platform. Beyond conditioning what we do, can recommendation algorithms influence who we are? This article suggests that they do. Specifically, I contend that recommender systems affect users' capacity to be their authentic selves in both positive and negative ways. I start by offering an account of authenticity that builds on two central concepts: volitional alignment and self-understanding. I then explain how algorithmic filtering works and impacts authenticity. While recommender systems frustrate users' second-order desires by relying on uninformative behavioral signals, they also facilitate self-understanding by inciting users to question their identity. I end by discussing how controllable and explainable recommenders would best enable users to be authentic.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨推荐算法如何影响用户的真实性（authenticity），认为推荐系统既可能通过依赖无信息的行为信号挫败用户的二阶欲望，也可能通过激发用户质疑自身身份来促进自我理解，并最终提出可控和可解释的推荐系统最能帮助用户实现真实自我。
AI.motivation: 数以十亿计的用户每天与数字平台互动，算法过滤不仅塑造行为，还可能影响用户"是谁"（身份认同），但学术界尚未系统探讨推荐算法对用户真实性的影响。
AI.method: 本文采用概念分析方法，构建基于"意志对齐"（volitional alignment）和"自我理解"（self-understanding）两个核心概念的真实性理论框架，然后分析推荐系统的工作机制及其对真实性各维度的具体影响。
AI.result: 作者发现推荐系统对真实性具有双重影响：一方面，推荐系统依赖无信息的（uninformative）行为信号，可能挫败用户的二阶欲望；另一方面，推荐系统能激发用户反思和质疑自身身份，从而促进自我理解。
AI.conclusion: 可控（controllable）和可解释（explainable）的推荐系统最能帮助用户实现真实性，这为推荐系统的设计和治理提供了伦理层面的指导原则。

title: Learning Discrete Riemannian Metrics for Physical Fields with Cochain-Frame Equivarianc
summary: Physical fields on meshes require a separation between topology and geometry: conservation laws are topological and should be exact, while geometry, material response, and anisotropic coupling must be learned from data. Existing neural surrogates often mix these roles inside unconstrained message passing. We introduce Riemannian Hodge Message Passing (RHMP), which turns this separation into an architectural principle. RHMP fixes the cellular coboundaries ($d_k$) determined by oriented incidence and learns symmetric positive-definite cochain metrics ($H_k$) for geometry-dependent propagation. Treating $H_k$ as the learned metric motivates cochain-frame equivariance: physical propagation should be invariant to orthogonal changes of the hidden cochain feature basis. RHMP implements this principle with metric-weighted Hodge blocks ($d_k^\top H_{k+1}d_k$), yielding exact cochain-complex identities ($d_{k+1}d_k=0$), nonnegative Hodge energies, positive-semidefinite operators, and exact Abelian curvature invariance. Across seven physical benchmarks spanning fluids, electromagnetism, gauge fields, and variable-mesh CFD, RHMP achieves the best overall performance, with the largest gains when topology, learned geometry, and field structure interact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出黎曼Hodge消息传递（RHMP），将物理场模拟中拓扑与几何的分离作为架构原则：固定由定向关联决定的细胞上边界算子（拓扑，精确），学习对称正定余链度量（几何，数据驱动），从而在网格上实现物理传播的等变性和精确的守恒律。
AI.motivation: 现有神经代理模型常在无约束的消息传递中混淆拓扑与几何的角色，导致守恒律（拓扑性质）无法被精确保持，且几何、材料响应和各向异性耦合需要从数据中学习。
AI.method: RHMP固定细胞复形上的上边界算子d_k（由定向关联决定，保证精确的d_{k+1}d_k=0），并学习对称正定余链度量H_k用于几何相关的传播。通过度量加权Hodge块（d_k^T H_{k+1}d_k）实现余链框架等变性，即物理传播对隐藏余链特征基的正交变换保持不变。
AI.result: 在涵盖流体、电磁学、规范场和变网格CFD的七个物理基准上，RHMP取得最佳整体性能，尤其在拓扑、学习几何和场结构相互作用的场景中增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 将拓扑与几何的分离作为架构原则而非事后约束，可以同时获得精确的守恒律、非负Hodge能量、半正定算子以及精确的Abel曲率不变性，并在多个物理基准上取得最优性能。

title: Industrial Load Modeling and Optimization for Market-Based Interaction with Power Systems
comment: PhD thesis, Tsinghua University, June 2026, 178 pages
summary: Industrial loads account for more than 60% of electricity consumption in China and offer substantial flexibility for balancing variable power systems. Their market participation remains limited by complex production constraints, incomplete information, and the computational burden of coordinating large portfolios. This dissertation develops modeling and optimization methods for market-based interaction between industrial loads and power systems. First, unified formulations based on the Linearized State Task Network and continuous Resource Task Network represent discrete and continuous industrial processes for power-system optimization. In a representative steelmaking case, they reduce solution time from more than 24 hours to less than 30 minutes while preserving modeling accuracy. Second, a privacy-preserving identification method combines process knowledge with hourly smart-meter data to infer internal production parameters. Using 21 days of observations, it achieves errors of 5.2%-8.5% for cement and steel-powder production, more than halving the errors of conventional machine-learning baselines. Third, a data-driven method converts high-dimensional, nonconvex flexibility regions into compact linear representations. For a steelmaking process with more than 10,000 binary variables, the resulting models require only 24-48 continuous variables and incur errors of 3.6%-10.3%. Finally, a co-optimization framework combines dimension-reduced bidding with exact disaggregation, allocating power among tens of thousands of resources within milliseconds while maintaining device-level feasibility. In a representative comparison, it reduces interaction costs by 40% relative to a simplified strategy. Together, these methods provide a tractable pipeline from industrial process modeling and parameter identification to flexibility aggregation and power system interation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套从工业过程建模、参数辨识到灵活性聚合与电力系统交互的可扩展优化方法管线。针对中国工业负荷占电力消耗60%以上但市场参与受限的问题，开发了四种方法：基于线性化状态任务网络和连续资源任务网络的统一建模（将炼钢案例求解时间从24小时以上降至30分钟内）、结合过程知识与智能电表数据的隐私保护参数辨识（误差5.2%-8.5%）、数据驱动的灵活性区域紧凑线性化（仅需24-48个连续变量）、以及降维出清与精确分解的协同优化框架（毫秒级分配数万资源，交互成本降低40%）。
AI.motivation: 中国工业负荷占电力消耗超过60%，具备为可变电力系统提供灵活性调节的巨大潜力。然而，工业负荷参与电力市场受到复杂生产约束、信息不完整以及大规模组合协调的计算负担三重限制，亟需开发有效的建模与优化方法。
AI.method: 论文提出四阶段方法论管线：（1）基于线性化状态任务网络和连续资源任务网络的统一建模框架，统一表达离散和连续工业过程；（2）隐私保护辨识方法，结合过程知识与小时级智能电表数据推断内部生产参数；（3）数据驱动方法将高维非凸灵活性区域转换为紧凑线性表示；（4）协同优化框架，将降维投标与精确分解相结合，实现大规模资源的快速功率分配。
AI.result: （1）炼钢案例求解时间从24小时以上降至30分钟以内，保持建模精度；（2）基于21天观测数据，水泥和钢粉生产参数辨识误差为5.2%-8.5%，比传统机器学习基线误差降低一半以上；（3）对含10000+二进制变量的炼钢过程，紧凑模型仅需24-48个连续变量，误差3.6%-10.3%；（4）可在毫秒级为数万资源分配功率并维持设备级可行性，交互成本相对简化策略降低40%。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了从工业过程建模、参数辨识到灵活性聚合和电力系统交互的全流程是可计算的，为工业负荷大规模参与电力市场提供了实用化技术路径，兼具建模精度、隐私保护和计算效率。

title: Learning Sequential Mobility Choice: A Review of Route and Activity Choice through Inverse Reinforcement and Imitation Learning
summary: Route and activity choice are connected levels of a common sequential mobility decision problem: activity choice determines what people do, where, and when, while route choice governs how they move between activities. This review develops a unified framework connecting transportation choice modeling with inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) and imitation learning (IL). Under explicit assumptions, recursive logit, logit dynamic discrete choice, and maximum-entropy IRL share a soft Bellman representation, while trajectory occupancies and network flows satisfy related conservation laws. However, utility, reward, policy, occupancy, constraints, and observation errors remain different estimands with different behavioral and counterfactual interpretations. We review constrained and inverse-constrained learning, occupancy-ratio and DICE methods, incomplete and mixed-quality demonstrations, graph and sequence learning, transfer, data fusion, multi-agent choice, and large language models. Our central message is that machine learning adds the greatest value when embedded within a behaviorally disciplined framework: exact transitions enforce feasibility, structured rewards preserve interpretable trade-offs, observation models address heterogeneous data sources, and network or equilibrium solvers produce coherent system outcomes. Such hybrid models can improve scalability and prediction without sacrificing behavioral identification or policy relevance.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了出行选择建模与逆强化学习（IRL）和模仿学习（IL）的统一框架，指出递归logit、logit动态离散选择和最大熵IRL在软Bellman表示下共享结构，并强调机器学习应在行为约束框架内嵌入以保持可解释性和政策相关性。
AI.motivation: 出行中的活动选择和路径选择是同一序列决策问题的不同层面，但传统交通选择建模与机器学习方法（IRL/IL）之间缺乏统一的理论框架，导致两者难以有效结合并发挥各自优势。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法：建立统一框架连接交通选择建模与IRL/IL，明确各方法在软Bellman表示下的理论联系和差异（效用vs奖励、策略vs占用等），并系统回顾多类方法（约束学习、占用比/DICE、不完整示范、图与序列学习、迁移、数据融合、多主体、大语言模型）。
AI.result: 揭示了递归logit、logit动态离散选择和最大熵IRL共享软Bellman表示及守恒定律，但各方法的估测量（效用、奖励、策略、占用、约束、观测误差）在行为解释和反事实分析上存在本质区别；混合模型可提升可扩展性和预测力。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习只有在嵌入行为纪律框架内才能发挥最大价值——精确转移保证可行性、结构化奖励保持可解释的权衡、观测模型处理异构数据、网络/均衡求解器产生连贯系统结果，从而在不牺牲行为识别和政策相关性的前提下提升可扩展性和预测能力。

title: Rough Volatility Across Assets
summary: We measure volatility roughness across asset classes using a common data infrastructure and pipeline. Our data covers 3,926 United States equities, 34 CME futures roots, rates, FX, and commodities, and options on 44 underlyings over 2010-2025. Realized volatility is rough everywhere. The class-median Hurst estimate ranges from $0.05$ (livestock) through $0.07-0.10$ (rates, FX, agriculture, energy, metals) to $0.13$ (single stocks) and $0.20$ (equity indices). The option-implied measure identifies $H$ only where the leverage effect produces a clean skew term structure. For the equity indices, implied estimates of $0.21-0.28$ are just above realized volatility $H$, while for rates and FX the ATM skew regression fails with an R-squared near zero even though realized volatility remains rough. We also show a mean-reversion contamination formula for the second-moment estimator of the roughness for the stationary fractional Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. The local slope of the increment second moment deviates from $2H$ by $(1-H)Γ(2H+1)(κΔ)^{2-2H}$ for all $H\in(0,1)$. A correction framework for the second moment, when the log realized volatility measure has additive noise, raised the $H$ estimate slightly but nowhere near the Brownian diffusion framework. Finally, a failure taxonomy discusses where rough-volatility methods apply and where they fail, suggesting alternative paths to further explore the rough-volatility paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文使用统一的数据基础设施和流水线，对2010-2025年间美国股票、期货、利率、外汇、大宗商品及期权的已实现波动率粗糙度进行了系统性度量。研究发现已实现波动率在所有资产类别中均表现出粗糙性，Hurst估计中位数从牲畜（0.05）到股票指数（0.20）不等。期权隐含度量仅在杠杆效应产生干净偏度期限结构时才能识别H，且利率和外汇的ATM偏度回归失败。此外，论文对平稳分数阶Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程的粗糙度估计提出了均值回归污染公式，并讨论了粗糙波动率方法的适用与失效场景。
AI.motivation: 尽管粗糙波动率（rough volatility）范式在学术界引起广泛关注，但缺乏跨资产类别、使用统一数据基础设施的大规模系统性验证。现有研究多聚焦于单一资产或单一方法，未能在统一的框架下检验"波动率无处不在粗糙"这一核心主张，也未能明确区分已实现度量与期权隐含度量的适用边界。
AI.method: 论文构建了覆盖3926只美国股票、34个CME期货品种（涵盖利率、外汇、大宗商品）及44个标的期权的统一数据流水线（2010-2025）。采用两类度量方法：(1) 已实现波动率估计Hurst参数；(2) 期权隐含度量，通过ATM偏度期限结构识别H。同时推导了平稳分数阶Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程中二阶矩估计量的均值回归污染公式，并提出对数已实现波动率含加性噪声时的二阶矩校正框架。
AI.result: 已实现波动率在所有资产类别中均粗糙，类别中位数Hurst从牲畜的0.05、利率/外汇/农产品/能源/金属的0.07-0.10，到个股的0.13和股票指数的0.20。期权隐含估计仅在杠杆效应产生清晰偏度期限结构时才有效：股票指数的隐含H（0.21-0.28）略高于已实现估计，而利率和外汇的ATM偏度回归R²接近零，尽管其已实现波动率依然粗糙。均值回归污染公式显示增量二阶矩的局部斜率偏离2H的程度为(1-H)Γ(2H+1)(κΔ)^(2-2H)，噪声校正框架仅能略微提高H估计，远未达到Brownian扩散框架的水平。
AI.conclusion: 已实现波动率的粗糙性是跨资产类别的普适现象，但期权隐含方法对H的识别依赖杠杆效应产生的偏度结构，不适用于利率和外汇。二阶矩估计受均值回归污染的精确量化公式为后续修正提供了理论工具。论文最后提出失败分类学，界定了粗糙波动率方法的适用范围（股票类资产效果最佳），并指出对于杠杆效应缺失的资产类别需要探索替代路径来推进粗糙波动率范式。

title: A Deep Learning Model for Spatially Clustered Data via Differentiable Cluster Assignment
summary: We consider nonparametric regression when the association between a response and its covariates changes across an unknown partition of a spatial domain. The proposed estimator learns the partition and the cluster-specific regression functions jointly. A neural network depending only on location determines cluster membership, while separate neural networks describe the covariate--response relationship within the clusters. An annealed softmax relaxation permits gradient-based estimation of the otherwise discrete assignments. Graph-Laplacian and occupancy penalties are used to discourage fragmented regions and degenerate solutions. We establish identifiability up to label permutation, bound partition error under a margin condition, and decompose prediction risk into regression and assignment components. The resulting rate agrees with that of an oracle estimator when the partition is estimated sufficiently accurately. Simulations show that joint estimation is useful when regression surfaces change abruptly across spatial boundaries, including settings with nonlinear effects, unequal region sizes, preferential sampling, and spatially correlated errors. Finally, a real data analysis is provided to demonstrate the validity and effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于空间分区非参数回归的新方法，通过一个仅依赖位置的神经网络确定聚类成员，并用多个独立的神经网络描述各聚类内的协变量-响应关系。采用退火softmax松弛处理离散分配问题，并引入图拉普拉斯和占用惩罚以避免碎片化区域和退化解。作者建立了标签置换下的可识别性，证明了在边际条件下的分区误差上界，并将预测风险分解为回归和分配两个部分。实验表明该方法在回归面突然变化的场景中表现优越。
AI.motivation: 当响应与协变量之间的关联在空间域的未知分区上发生变化时，现有方法难以同时学习分区和簇特定的回归函数。特别是在回归曲面跨空间边界突然变化的情况下，联合估计比分别估计更有效，但离散分配带来的优化困难是主要挑战。
AI.method: 1) 使用仅依赖位置的神经网络确定聚类成员分配；2) 使用独立的神经网络描述各聚类内的协变量-响应关系；3) 采用退火softmax松弛实现基于梯度的估计；4) 引入图拉普拉斯惩罚减少碎片化区域，占用惩罚防止退化解。
AI.result: 建立了标签置换下的可识别性，在边际条件下给出了分区误差的上界，并将预测风险分解为回归和分配两部分。当分区估计足够准确时，所提出的方法达到了与预言估计器一致的速率。模拟实验表明，该方法在非线性效应、不等区域大小、偏好采样和空间相关误差等场景下均表现良好，真实数据分析也验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 联合估计空间分区和簇特定回归函数在回归曲面突然变化的场景下是有效的，所提出的神经网络方法在理论和实践两方面都展现出了良好的性能保证。

title: Large Language Models Show Metacognitive Sensitivity in Medical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated and used in medicine, but clinical usefulness depends on answer accuracy and whether confidence tracks evidence quality and uncertainty. We developed a controlled, psychophysics-inspired clinical benchmark to test diagnostic choice and confidence behavior in a medical LLM. The benchmark focused on probable Alzheimer-type neurocognitive disorder (AT-NCD) versus depression-related cognitive impairment (DRCI). We generated 45 synthetic vignettes varying evidence strength, conflicting evidence, and missing information. Each vignette was presented under three prompt variants, yielding 135 trials. In a pilot run with gpt-4.1-nano, all trials produced valid structured outputs. Across forced-choice trials, diagnostic accuracy was 93.5%, mean confidence was 78.4%, and AUROC2 was 0.876. Confidence increased with evidence distance from the diagnostic boundary, decreased when information was missing, and remained higher on correct than incorrect trials after adjustment for evidence strength and prompt format. These findings indicate partial metacognitive sensitivity rather than globally uninformative confidence. However, errors clustered in moderate, conflicting AT-NCD cases, where the model shifted toward DRCI and retained more confidence than empirical accuracy justified. Model comparison suggested that confidence quality should be measured directly rather than inferred from benchmark accuracy or model capability alone. This study establishes a reproducible framework for evaluating evidence sensitivity, metacognitive sensitivity, and localized calibration failure in medical LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受心理物理学启发的受控临床基准测试，用于评估医学大语言模型（LLM）的诊断选择能力和置信度校准行为。以阿尔茨海默型神经认知障碍（AT-NCD）与抑郁相关认知障碍（DRCI）的鉴别为场景，生成45个合成病例并施加三种提示变体共135次试验，发现模型诊断准确率93.5%、平均置信度78.4%，置信度对证据强度、信息缺失和正确性均表现出部分元认知敏感性，但错误集中在冲突证据的AT-NCD中度病例中，提示存在局部校准失败。
AI.motivation: 医学LLM的临床实用性不仅取决于答案准确性，还取决于置信度能否真实反映证据质量和不确定性。现有评估往往忽视置信度校准，需要一个受控框架来系统测试模型的诊断选择与置信度行为是否具有元认知敏感性。
AI.method: 构建心理物理学启发的受控临床基准：生成45个系统性变化证据强度、冲突证据和信息缺失的合成病例，每种病例配以三种提示变体共135次试验，用gpt-4.1-nano进行强制选择诊断并报告置信度，通过AUROC2和校准分析评估诊断准确性与元认知敏感性。
AI.result: 诊断准确率93.5%，平均置信度78.4%，AUROC2为0.876。置信度随与诊断边界的证据距离增加而上升、信息缺失时下降，且在调整证据强度和提示格式后，正确试验的置信度仍高于错误试验。但错误集中于中等冲突的AT-NCD病例，模型倾向于转向DRCI并对错误保留过高置信度。
AI.conclusion: 模型展现出部分元认知敏感性而非全局无信息置信度，但存在局部校准失败区域。置信度质量应直接测量而非从基准准确率或模型能力推断。该框架为医学LLM提供了可复现的证据敏感性、元认知敏感性和局部校准失败评估方法。

title: HarmProfile: Characterizing Harmful Distributions in Frontier LLMs
summary: Frontier large language models (LLMs) safety evaluation has largely treated harmful generation as an attack outcome rather than as an object of analysis. Consequently, little is known about the harmful outputs produced during model misbehavior, partly because large-scale, high-quality collections of frontier-LLM misbehavior are difficult to obtain. To address this gap, we introduce HarmProfile, a content-centric benchmark dataset that collects model misbehavior across diverse harm categories and model families, and defines the resulting harmful-output distribution as a model-level risk profile. The premise is that, just as linguistic behavior can be characterized from an utterance corpus, model risk can be characterized from the content, severity, and variation of its safety failures. HarmProfile contains over 80,000 validated artifacts from 23 frontier LLMs across 13 model families, organized into 15 harm categories and 57 subcategories. Using this corpus, we find that frontier LLMs reliably produce harmful content at scale, yet exhibit distinct risk profiles; both harmfulness and diversity grow with model capability, suggesting that frontier LLMs may appear safe yet harbor increasingly dangerous knowledge beneath the alignment surface. Our source code is available at https://github.com/fresh-ma/HarmProfile .

AI.tldr: 本文提出HarmProfile，一个以内容为中心的基准数据集，收集了来自23个前沿大语言模型（覆盖13个模型家族）的超过80,000个有害输出，跨15个危害类别和57个子类别，将模型误行为定义为模型级风险画像。研究发现前沿LLM大规模稳定产生有害内容且各模型呈现不同风险画像，危害性和多样性随模型能力增长而增加。
AI.motivation: 现有前沿LLM安全评估将有害生成视为攻击结果而非分析对象，导致对模型误行为期间产生的有害输出知之甚少，主要原因是大规模高质量的模型误行为数据集难以获取。
AI.method: 构建HarmProfile基准数据集，系统性收集23个前沿LLM（13个模型家族）的误行为，按15个危害类别和57个子类别组织，通过定义有害输出分布作为模型级风险画像，从内容、严重程度和变异性三个维度刻画模型安全失败特征。
AI.result: 前沿LLM能够大规模稳定产生有害内容，但各模型呈现显著不同的风险画像；且危害性和多样性均随模型能力提升而增长，表明越强的模型在对齐表面之下隐藏着越多危险知识。
AI.conclusion: 类似从语料库刻画语言行为，可从模型安全失败的内容、严重程度和变异来刻画模型风险。前沿LLM表面看似安全，但随着能力增长其潜在危险性也在增加，这对AI安全评估提出了新的视角和挑战。

title: Optimal Two-Step Stepsize Schedule for Stochastic Gradient Methods
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures
summary: Structured nonconstant large stepsizes can improve the convergence of gradient descent in the deterministic setting. However, in stochastic optimization, aggressive stepsizes can amplify oracle noise and hinder the convergence of stochastic gradient methods. We characterize the globally optimal two-step stepsize schedule for stochastic gradient methods applied to strongly convex and smooth functions, assuming access only to unbiased stochastic gradient estimates with finite support and bounded variance. The optimal schedule depends on the ratio of the initial optimality gap to the noise level and exhibits several distinct regimes. As the influence of stochastic noise diminishes, the optimal two-step stepsizes become larger, reflecting a balance between the benefits of faster iterate convergence and the perturbations induced by stochastic noise.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了随机梯度方法在强凸光滑函数上的最优两步步长调度。作者刻画了全局最优的两步步长策略，该策略取决于初始最优性差距与噪声水平的比值，并展现出多个不同的区间。随着随机噪声影响的减弱，最优两步步长会变大，体现了迭代收敛速度与噪声扰动之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 在确定性设置中，结构化非恒定的大步长可以改善梯度下降的收敛性。然而在随机优化中，激进的步长会放大随机噪声并阻碍随机梯度方法的收敛。作者希望理解在随机优化中如何设计最优的步长调度策略。
AI.method: 针对强凸光滑函数的随机梯度方法，假设只能获得具有有限支撑和有界方差的渐进无偏随机梯度估计，刻画了全局最优的两步步长调度。最优调度取决于初始最优性差距与噪声水平的比率，并展现出若干不同的区间特征。
AI.result: 找到了随机梯度方法的最优两步步长调度策略。该策略依赖于初始最优性差距与噪声水平的比值，并且表现出多种不同的区间。随着随机噪声影响的减小，最优两步步长会相应增大。
AI.conclusion: 随机优化中的最优步长调度需要在更快的迭代收敛与噪声扰动之间取得平衡。当噪声影响减弱时，可以采用更大的步长以获得更快的收敛速度，这表明步长策略应自适应地根据噪声水平进行调整。

title: Psychological Determinants of Academic Integrity in the Use of Generative AI in Higher Education
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Presented at the 11th International Academic Studies Congress, Tarsus, Mersin, Türkiye, April 28-30, 2026; published in the Book of Full Texts, pp. 750-759
summary: This paper examines the psychological determinants that shape academically honest and dishonest uses of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in higher education. Rather than treating academic misconduct as a purely technological problem, the study conceptualizes academic integrity as a psychologically mediated decision process influenced by moral reasoning, perceived social norms, policy clarity, academic self-efficacy, AI literacy, performance pressure, and beliefs about authorship. Methodologically, the paper adopts a focused narrative review and conceptual synthesis design. A purposive corpus of 16 core publications, including peer-reviewed studies and policy-oriented texts published between 2022 and March 2026, was assembled through targeted searches using combinations of the keywords generative AI, academic integrity, academic misconduct, moral disengagement, AI literacy, and higher education. The reviewed literature suggests that students do not interpret all forms of AI assistance as cheating. Integrity risk increases when institutional guidance is vague, peer use appears normalized, academic pressure is high, and AI tools are perceived as legitimate substitutes for difficult cognitive labor. By contrast, assignment-level guidance, explicit disclosure norms, ethics-oriented instruction, and authentic assessment design appear to reduce integrity risk more effectively than detection-centered responses alone. Based on these findings, the paper proposes an integrative conceptual model in which institutional context shapes psychological appraisal, and psychological appraisal in turn influences disclosed, borderline, or dishonest GenAI use. The paper concludes that effective responses to GenAI-related integrity problems should combine policy clarity, pedagogy, AI literacy, and student support rather than relying only on prohibition or software-based surveillance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过聚焦叙事综述和概念综合的方法，考察了影响高等教育中生成式AI学术诚实与不诚实使用的心理决定因素，并提出一个综合概念模型，主张通过政策清晰度、教学法、AI素养和学生支持相结合来应对学术诚信问题。
AI.motivation: 现有研究往往将学术不端视为纯技术问题，忽视了学术诚信作为心理中介决策过程的本质。本文旨在系统梳理影响学生GenAI使用行为（诚实或不诚实）的心理决定因素，以弥补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 采用聚焦叙事综述与概念综合设计，通过关键词组合检索，汇编了2022年至2026年3月间的16篇核心出版物（包括同行评审研究和政策导向文本），对道德推理、社会规范、政策清晰度、学术自我效能、AI素养、表现压力和作者身份信念等心理维度进行综合分析。
AI.result: 研究发现：学生并非将所有AI辅助都视为作弊；当机构指导模糊、同伴使用常态化、学业压力高、AI被视为困难认知劳动的合法替代品时，诚信风险增加；相反，作业级指导、明确披露规范、伦理导向教学和真实评估设计比仅靠检测手段更能有效降低诚信风险。
AI.conclusion: 提出一个综合概念模型（制度情境→心理评估→披露/边缘/不诚实使用），认为有效应对GenAI诚信问题应结合政策清晰度、教学法、AI素养和学生支持，而非仅依赖禁令或软件监控。

title: Forward Pass Domain Adaptation (Without Cross-Layer Backpropagation)
comment: 15 pages
summary: Forward-Pass-Only MLP training (FPO) adapts large language models without a backward pass through the model body, achieving 2.7--3.2x the throughput of standard fine-tuning at ~40% less peak training memory, while leaving off-domain benchmarks within seed-noise of baseline, a property that full-network fine-tuning does not reliably reproduce. FPO rests on a single empirical observation: at late layers of a transformer, the output-layer prediction error approximates the true gradient with cosine similarity 0.47--0.59 across six public models we survey. We introduce a two-minute diagnostic that quantifies this approximation per layer for any model, identifying where late-layer adaptation is viable. Informed by the diagnostic, FPO computes a single error signal at the output and applies it to each target layer. No signal is propagated between layers, and no autograd graph is constructed at any point. We evaluate FPO on three model families (OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-8B, Falcon3-7B). Across all three, FPO produces in-domain perplexity improvement and leaves MMLU, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, and Winogrande within seed-noise of baseline. Localizing SFT to FPO's target layers to enter this regime is also feasible, but at 2.2x the wall-clock cost of FPO.

AI.tldr: FPO是一种仅前向传播的MLP训练方法，通过利用变压器后层输出层预测误差近似真实梯度的观察，在不构造autograd图和层间传播信号的情况下适配大语言模型，实现了标准微调2.7-3.2倍吞吐量且峰值内存降低约40%，同时保持领域外基准在基线种子噪声范围内。
AI.motivation: 标准全网络微调需要完整的反向传播，计算成本高、内存占用大，且在某些情况下不能可靠地保持领域外基准表现。作者希望找到一种更高效的适配方法，能够在训练效率和模型性能之间取得更好的平衡。
AI.method: FPO基于单一经验观察：在变压器后层，输出层预测误差以0.47-0.59的余弦相似度近似真实梯度（覆盖六个公开模型）。方法包括：(1) 引入两分钟的逐层诊断，量化每层的近似程度，确定晚期层适配的可行性；(2) 在输出处计算单一误差信号并应用于每个目标层；(3) 不进行层间信号传播，也不构建任何autograd图。
AI.result: 在三个模型家族（OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-7B、Falcon3-7B）上评估，FPO均实现了域内困惑度改善，并使MMLU、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag和Winogrande保持在基线的种子噪声范围内。FPO达到标准微调2.7-3.2倍吞吐量，峰值训练内存减少约40%。局部化SFT也能进入该机制，但墙钟成本是FPO的2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，仅前向传播的MLP训练是一种可行且高效的大语言模型适配方法，其在训练效率和领域外性能保持方面均优于全网络微调。诊断工具和层定位策略为实际应用提供了指导。

title: Voltage Stability Assessment with Path-Coupled Load Growth and Corrective Generator Response
summary: Voltage stability margin assessment is essential for the secure operation of renewable-dominated power systems. Conventional continuation-based methods evaluate the margin along predefined load-growth paths with fixed generator partic- ipation, while practical operation allows generators to be redis- patched to alleviate voltage stress and reshape the power-flow trajectory as the system approaches voltage collapse. This paper proposes a path-coupled margin assessment approach that incor- porates corrective generator response into static voltage stability margin assessment. In the proposed approach, the load-growth direction and generator response direction are simultaneously determined at each continuation step, enabling the assessment trajectory to account for generator response while tracing the system toward voltage collapse. The voltage stability margin is then evaluated by the cumulative active load increase along this coupled trajectory. Based on the obtained trajectory and collapse point, a feasible redispatch direction is further derived to improve the margin of the current operating state. The economic cost of voltage stability enhancement is quantified through a marginal stability cost, providing an economic indicator for additional sta- bility support. Case studies on various test systems demonstrate that the proposed framework can effectively capture the impact of corrective generator redispatch on voltage stability assessment, provide effective guidance for margin enhancement, and quantify the cost associated with voltage stability improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种路径耦合的电压稳定裕度评估方法，在连续潮流过程中同时确定负荷增长方向和发电机响应方向，使评估轨迹反映发电机再调度行为，并进一步推导可行的再调度方向以提升裕度，通过边际稳定成本量化增强电压稳定的经济代价。
AI.motivation: 传统基于连续法的电压稳定裕度评估沿预设负荷增长路径且发电机参与方式固定，但实际运行中发电机可被再调度以缓解电压压力并重塑潮流轨迹，传统方法无法捕捉这一动态过程。
AI.method: 提出路径耦合的裕度评估方法：在每个连续步骤中同时确定负荷增长方向和发电机响应方向，使评估轨迹在追踪系统逼近电压崩溃的同时考虑发电机响应；沿此耦合轨迹以累积有功负荷增加量评估电压稳定裕度；基于所得轨迹和崩溃点推导可行的再调度方向以提升裕度，并通过边际稳定成本量化增强电压稳定的经济成本。
AI.result: 在多种测试系统上的案例研究表明，所提框架能有效捕捉校正性发电机再调度对电压稳定评估的影响，为裕度提升提供有效指导，并量化电压稳定改善的相关成本。
AI.conclusion: 所提路径耦合方法克服了传统固定路径评估的局限，将发电机校正响应纳入静态电压稳定裕度评估，同时提供了裕度提升指导和成本量化手段，对可再生能源主导电力系统的安全运行具有重要意义。

title: Regional advantage in rugby sevens: Is there a home effect when nobody is home?
summary: We study the existence of a \emph{Regional Differential} in rugby sevens: whether, in tournaments where no competing team enjoys formal home status, some national sides systematically over- or under-perform depending on \emph{where} the event is staged. Using the universe of 2672 men's and women's matches from international rugby sevens tournaments played between 2016 and 2025, principally the World Rugby Sevens Series, but also the World Cup Sevens and the Olympic Games, we replace the binary ``locality'' indicator of the classic home advantage literature with continuous measures of geographic, temporal, and cultural proximity between each team and the host country. We show that aggregate associations between proximity and performance (which appear large and highly significant in naive specifications) are almost entirely an artifact of \emph{team composition} and \emph{scheduling}: once team and opponent quality are absorbed through fixed effects in a symmetric team-match panel, no general regional advantage survives. However, this null aggregate masks substantial heterogeneity. For a well-defined subset of teams (most notably France, but also New Zealand, the United States, Canada, Spain, Ireland, Kenya, Samoa, and Brazil), performance declines significantly and monotonically with the distance separating the host city from home. Some of the established southern-hemisphere powers (Fiji, South Africa, Australia, Argentina) are essentially distance-neutral. We further show that for some teams the gradient operates through east-west jet lag rather than pure displacement. The Regional Differential in sevens is therefore real but \emph{team-specific} rather than universal, a distinction obscured by pooled estimation.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2016-2025年间2672场国际七人制橄榄球比赛的完整数据，检验"区域性差异"是否存在：即在没有正式主场优势的比赛中，球队是否因赛事举办地不同而系统性表现不同。研究发现，用地理位置、时区和文化距离等连续指标替代传统的二元"主客场"指标后，表面上的区域优势几乎完全是由球队构成和赛程安排的伪影造成的，一旦用固定效应控制球队和对手质量，普通的区域优势便消失。然而这一零结果掩盖了显著的异质性：法国、新西兰、美国等特定球队的表现随距离增加而显著下降，而斐济、南非等球队则对距离不敏感。区域差异是真实存在的但具有球队特异性。
AI.motivation: 传统的主场优势文献使用二元的"主客场"指示变量，这在没有正式主场球队的七人制橄榄球锦标赛中不适用。作者试图探索是否存在"区域性差异"——即某些国家队是否因赛事举办地位置而系统性表现更好或更差，并希望用连续的邻近度指标取代二元指标来更精确地度量这一效应。
AI.method: 使用2016-2025年间来自国际七人制橄榄球锦标赛（主要是World Rugby Sevens Series，也包括世界杯和奥运会）的2672场男女比赛的完整数据集。用地理距离、时区差异和文化邻近度等连续指标替代二元"主客场"指示变量。构建对称的球队-比赛面板，通过固定效应控制球队和对手质量，以隔离邻近度对表现的真实影响。同时探讨了东-西方向时差（jet lag）的作用。
AI.result: 朴素回归中邻近度与表现之间看似显著的正相关，在控制球队和对手质量后几乎完全消失，表明不存在普遍的"区域差异"。然而，特定球队（法国、新西兰、美国、加拿大、西班牙、爱尔兰、肯尼亚、萨摩亚和巴西）的表现随距离增加显著单调下降；而斐济、南非、澳大利亚、阿根廷等南半球强队则基本对距离不敏感。部分球队的效应通过东西向时差而非纯位移起作用。
AI.conclusion: 七人制橄榄球中的区域差异是真实存在的，但具有球队特异性而非普遍性，这种特异性在混合估计中被掩盖。研究强调需要用固定效应控制球队质量，并使用连续邻近度指标而非二元指标来准确识别此类效应。

title: zLend: A Dual-Scope Cash-Flow Reconstruction Framework for On-Chain Credit Underwriting
summary: Decentralized lending lacks a credit bureau: a borrower's capacity to repay must be inferred entirely from public on-chain activity, without income verification or a liability record. This paper presents zLend, a deployed cash-flow underwriting framework that reconstructs a wallet's daily balance history from raw token transfers and derives short-duration repayment-capacity signals from it. The reconstruction is performed twice per wallet, once restricted to a fixed stablecoin basket and once over all fungible transfers, on the premise that a wallet's total token holdings and its liquid, spendable balance are distinct quantities whose conflation misprices risk. From each series we derive liquidity coverage against a fixed loan size, cash-flow volatility and regularity, a drawdown-and-recovery statistic adapted from quantitative finance, and a recurring-counterparty detector that identifies salary-like payment cadence from transfer timing alone. The two views are then compared: a wallet with large aggregate holdings whose stablecoin reserve rarely covers the loan size is flagged as a liquidity mismatch irrespective of total wealth. We specify the pipeline formally, document the golden-master methodology used to verify a cross-language production migration to numerical tolerance 1e-9, and characterize the tier function's parameter sensitivity with an independent reimplementation validated to exact agreement (78 of 78 field assertions) against the deployed system's reference fixtures. Tier assignment is governed predominantly by the reference loan size, with four of six reference wallets changing tier across loan sizes from USD 10 to USD 25,000; the drawdown and coverage criteria bind on disjoint wallets, so neither subsumes the other; and no criterion in the tier rule is inert. zLend is deployed in production, informing real lending decisions via third-party API integrations.

AI.tldr: zLend是一个已部署的去中心化借贷现金流动承销框架，通过从链上代币转账重建钱包每日余额历史，推导短期还款能力信号，支持无信用局的贷款决策。
AI.motivation: 去中心化借贷缺乏信用机构，借款人的还款能力只能从公开链上活动推断，没有收入验证或负债记录。现有方法将总资产与流动性余额混为一谈，导致风险错误定价。
AI.method: 对每个钱包进行两次余额历史重建：一次限定于稳定币篮子，另一次涵盖所有可替代转账。从两条序列推导流动性覆盖率、现金流波动性与规律性、回撤与恢复统计，以及识别薪资式付款节奏的重复对手方检测器。比较两个视图，检测流动性错配。采用黄金母版方法验证跨语言生产迁移，并通过独立重新实现验证参数敏感性。
AI.result: 层级分配主要由参考贷款规模决定，六个参考钱包中四个在贷款规模从10美元到25,000美元间改变层级；回撤与覆盖率标准在不相交的钱包上生效，二者互不包含；层级规则中没有任何标准是无效的。78项字段断言与部署系统的参考夹具完全一致。
AI.conclusion: zLend已投入生产，通过第三方API集成影响真实贷款决策，并为去中心化借贷提供了首个可信的现金流承销基础设施。

title: Scalable Pontryagin-Guided Adjoint-to-Control Recovery for Constrained Dynamic Portfolio Choice
summary: We develop a scalable adjoint-to-control framework for continuous-time portfolio choice under smooth pointwise constraints. A feasible direct-policy-optimization (DPO) policy supplies rollouts; after training, fixed-latent open-loop BPTT (OL-BPTT) yields first- and second-order pathwise sensitivities, whose conditional projections produce adapted adjoint inputs. A nested antithetic common-random-number regression estimates the shifted wealth-row martingale input, and deployment solves the local generalized-Hamiltonian problem by an exact QP for quadratic-affine blocks or by a log barrier otherwise. We prove an OL-BPTT--PMP correspondence retaining orthogonal projection residuals, a local barrier--KKT approximation, and a performance-to-adjoint bridge under local quadratic growth. In an n=100 constrained Merton benchmark, the learned first adjoint has 0.46% mean relative error; under the analytical policy, the first adjoint, wealth curvature, and Brownian coefficient have nRMSEs of 0.031%, 0.035%, and 0.326%. In a terminal-only predictable-return CRRA benchmark, wealth homogeneity gives $P^{X\bullet,*}=D^2_{X\bullet}V$ and $ζ^{X,*}=0$. At the primary $512\times16$ projection budget, the full estimated-shift decoder has policy RMSE below $8.5\times10^{-3}$, while the benchmark-specific zero-shift oracle is below $2\times10^{-4}$. Across constraint, factor, barrier, and switching-region audits, recovery sharply reduces local KKT residuals and remains practical for portfolios with up to 100 risky assets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可扩展的伴随-控制（adjoint-to-control）框架，用于在光滑点约束下求解连续时间投资组合选择问题。通过直接策略优化（DPO）提供轨迹，利用固定隐变量开环BPTT（OL-BPTT）获得一阶和二阶路径敏感性，再通过条件投影生成自适应的伴随输入，最终通过精确QP或对数障碍求解局部广义Hamiltonian问题。
AI.motivation: 连续时间投资组合选择问题在光滑点约束下求解困难，现有方法在可扩展性和精度上存在不足，需要一种既能处理约束又能高效求解大规模问题的框架。
AI.method: 1) DPO策略提供rollouts；2) 固定隐变量OL-BPTT产生路径敏感性；3) 条件投影生成自适应伴随输入；4) 嵌套对抗共随机数回归估计漂移财富行鞅输入；5) 通过精确QP（二次仿射块）或对数障碍求解局部广义Hamiltonian问题；6) 证明OL-BPTT-PMP对应关系、局部障碍-KKT近似及性能-伴随桥。
AI.result: 在n=100约束Merton基准中，学习的第一伴随平均相对误差0.46%；解析策略下第一伴随、财富曲率、Brownian系数的nRMSE分别为0.031%、0.035%、0.326%。在终期可预测收益CRRA基准中，主预算512×16下完整估计位移解码器策略RMSE低于8.5×10^-3，零位移oracle低于2×10^-4。跨约束、因子、障碍、切换区域审计中能显著降低局部KKT残差，支持最多100个风险资产。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在理论上建立了BPTT与Pontryagin最小原理之间的对应关系，并在实践中验证了在大规模（100资产）约束投资组合问题上的有效性和可扩展性，能够显著降低KKT残差并保持实际可行性。

title: Sufficient Dimesion Reduction via Generalized Stein's Lemma
summary: Sufficient dimension reduction (SDR) seeks the minimal subspace of the predictors that captures the full conditional distribution of the response, which is known as the central subspace (CS). When the response is multivariate, the problem becomes considerably more challenging, particularly when the sample size is limited. Existing methods face different limitations:inverse regression approaches rely on strong distributional assumptions and matrix inversion, and their multi-response extensions suffer from severe slice sparsity; forward regression methods depend on computationally intensive iterative smoothing whose cost grows with the response dimension; and deep learning-based approaches demand large amounts of labeled data. To circumvent these shortcomings, we propose an SDR framework based on the generalized Stein's lemma. Our method constructs a cross-moment matrix between the multivariate response and the marginal score function of the predictors, and recovers the CS via its singular value decomposition. The proposed method does not rely on the linearity condition, avoids matrix inversion as well as iterative smoothing, and can leverage unlabeled data when available. We establish convergence guarantees for the proposed estimator under standard regularity conditions. Moreover, we propose a practical rank-selection algorithm to estimate the dimension of the CS. Extensive simulation studies and a real data application demonstrate that the proposed methods consistently outperform existing approaches across a variety of settings, particularly in moderate-dimensional, label-scarce scenarios with high noise levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于广义Stein引理的充分降维（SDR）框架，通过构造多元响应与预测变量边际得分函数之间的交叉矩矩阵，并利用奇异值分解恢复中心子空间（CS）。该方法不依赖线性条件、避免矩阵求逆和迭代平滑，且可利用无标签数据。通过标准正则性条件下的收敛性保证、实用的秩选择算法以及大量模拟和真实数据实验，证明了方法在多种场景下优于现有方法，尤其在中等维度、标签稀缺和高噪声场景下表现突出。
AI.motivation: 多元响应的充分降维问题在样本量有限时极具挑战性。现有方法各有缺陷：逆回归方法依赖强分布假设和矩阵求逆，其多元扩展面临严重的切片稀疏问题；前向回归方法依赖计算密集的迭代平滑，且成本随响应维度增长；深度学习方法需要大量标注数据。为规避这些不足，需要提出一种新的SDR框架。
AI.method: 基于广义Stein引理，构造多元响应与预测变量边际得分函数之间的交叉矩矩阵，通过奇异值分解恢复中心子空间。该方法不要求线性条件假设，避免了矩阵求逆和迭代平滑，并能利用无标签数据增强估计。同时提出了实用的秩选择算法来估计中心子空间的维度。
AI.result: 在标准正则性条件下建立了所提出估计量的收敛性保证。广泛的模拟研究和真实数据应用表明，所提方法在各种设置下一致优于现有方法，尤其是在中等维度、标签稀缺且噪声水平较高的场景中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于广义Stein引理的SDR框架有效克服了现有方法的三大局限（分布假设过强、计算成本高、依赖大量标注数据），为该问题提供了一种高效且鲁棒的解决方案，特别适用于实际中常见的标签稀缺和高噪声场景。

title: The Unwritten Benchmark: A New Challenge for Multimodal Machine Learning in Abstract Perceptual Reasoning
comment: To be published in CVPR Findings 2026
summary: Current multimodal models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in recognizing static visual and auditory content. However, their capacity for abstract perceptual reasoning, inferring unseen information from dynamic, generative processes, remains a critical and underexplored frontier. In this paper, we introduce The Unwritten Benchmark, a new challenge designed to probe this abstract perceptual and cognitive ability. We define the core task as acousto-kinematic word inference: models must decipher words, across 3 different writing styles, being written solely from the audio of pen scratches and the video of hand movements, without any visible ink trace. Our evaluation results reveal a profound gap between human and machine performance: while human participants achieve high ordered letter accuracy (over 80%), leading Multimodal Machine Learning Models, including GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5-Pro, struggle significantly, failing to surpass 10%. Furthermore, we identify a paradoxical fusion effect in the models, where providing both modalities often degrades performance rather than improving it. This finding indicates a fundamental breakdown in their ability to synthesize complementary perceptual cues for this cognitive task. These findings highlight significant limitations in both cross-modal causal reasoning and the understanding of the micro-kinematics essential for such cognitive and intuitive perceptual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 The Unwritten Benchmark，一个用于测试多模态模型抽象感知推理能力的新基准。任务要求模型仅凭笔划声音和手部运动视频（无可见墨迹）来推断被书写的文字，涵盖三种书写风格。结果显示人类有序字母准确率超80%，而GPT-4o和Gemini 2.5-Pro等先进多模态模型不足10%，且存在模态融合反而降低性能的悖论效应。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态模型擅长识别静态视觉和听觉内容，但缺乏从动态、生成性过程中推断未见信息的抽象感知推理能力。作者认为这是关键且未被充分探索的前沿领域，因此希望设计一个基准来揭示这一根本性局限。
AI.method: 创建了"无声写就基准"（The Unwritten Benchmark），核心任务是"声学-运动学单词推断"：模型需仅从笔划声频和手部运动视频中解码单词（三种书写风格），无任何可见墨迹痕迹。同时设计人机对比实验来评估该认知能力。
AI.result: 人类参与者有序字母准确率超过80%，而领先的多模态模型（GPT-4o和Gemini 2.5-Pro）未能超过10%。此外发现"悖论性融合效应"：同时提供两种模态反而降低模型性能，而非改善。
AI.conclusion: 模型在跨模态因果推理和对微运动学（micro-kinematics）的理解上存在根本性缺陷，这严重制约了它们在需要认知和直觉感知推理的任务中的表现。人类的高准确率与机器极低准确率的巨大差距，揭示了当前多模态模型深层认知能力的不足。

title: Multi-Modal Generative Fuzzy System: Fuzzy Inference Guided Large Model Interactive Question Answering Framework
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures
summary: In Multimodal Question Answering (MQA), models are required to jointly encode and integrate heterogeneous information from multiple modalities, including text, images, and speech, to perform complex semantic reasoning and decision making. Despite recent advances, existing approaches, including traditional deep learning models and Large Models (LMs) or prompt-based frameworks, continue to face several critical challenges. First, modality bias arises from discrepancies in feature distributions across different modalities, which limits effective cross modal collaborative understanding. Second, many questions require knowledge drawn from multiple domains, introducing significant uncertainty. Third, current methods often rely on shallow semantic matching, resulting in limited reasoning depth an reduced interpretability. To address these issues, inspired by the traditional fuzzy system (FS) framework, we propose a fuzzy-inference-guided multimodal generative architecture termed the Multi-Modal Generative Fuzzy System (MMGFS). The main contributions of MMGFS are two folds. First, it alleviates modality bias through a multimodal collaborative rumination mechanism. Second, it introduces fuzzy rules and a multi-hop inference mechanism to support cross-domain knowledge fusion and hierarchical reasoning, thereby strengthening uncertainty modelling and deepening semantic understanding. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on open-domain question answering datasets, including MultimodalQA and WebQA, as well as domain-specific benchmarks, including BioMol-VQA and EHRxQA. Experimental results demonstrate that MMGFS consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple datasets. It effectively mitigates modality bias and question uncertainty while achieving superior performance in answer accuracy, consistency, and generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模糊推理的多模态生成架构（MMGFS），旨在解决多模态问答（MQA）中存在的模态偏差、跨领域知识不确定性和浅层语义匹配等问题。MMGFS通过多模态协同反思机制缓解模态偏差，并引入模糊规则和多跳推理实现跨域知识融合与分层推理，在多个公开数据集上取得了优于现有方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有MQA方法面临三大挑战：(1) 不同模态间特征分布差异导致的模态偏差，限制了跨模态协同理解；(2) 跨领域问题引入的显著不确定性；(3) 现有方法依赖浅层语义匹配，导致推理深度不足和可解释性差。传统深度学习和大型模型框架均未能充分解决这些问题。
AI.method: 受传统模糊系统（FS）框架启发，提出多模态生成模糊系统（MMGFS）。核心包含两大机制：(1) 多模态协同反思机制，用于缓解模态偏差；(2) 模糊规则与多跳推理机制，支持跨域知识融合和分层推理，强化不确定性建模并深化语义理解。
AI.result: 在开放域问答数据集（MultimodalQA、WebQA）和领域特定基准（BioMol-VQA、EHRxQA）上的综合评估显示，MMGFS在多个数据集上一致优于现有方法，在答案准确性、一致性和泛化能力方面表现更佳，有效缓解了模态偏差和问题不确定性问题。
AI.conclusion: MMGFS通过将模糊推理思想融入多模态生成架构，为MQA任务提供了一种兼顾模态协同、不确定性建模和深层推理的新范式，在多个基准上验证了其有效性。该工作为多模态问答中的模态偏差和推理深度问题提供了可行解决方案。

title: Monotone Inclusion Approach to Weakly Monotone Discrete-Time Finite-Horizon Mean-Field Games
summary: We revisit the problem of computing mean-field equilibria (MFEs) in discrete-time, monotone, finite-horizon mean-field games (MFGs). We show that, when the transition kernel is independent of the state-measure term and the reward function satisfies the usual weak monotonicity condition and is Lipschitz continuous, anchored proximal gradient descent methods can be used to compute a monotone MFE. We also establish last-iterate convergence results for these methods. Our approach relies on formulating the computation problem as an optimization problem over the space of occupation measures. Using this formulation, we show that the problem is equivalent to a class of constrained Lipschitz monotone inclusion problems. We then apply iterative methods for this monotone inclusion formulation to derive a tractable algorithm. The resulting algorithm achieves a convergence rate of \(O(1/\sqrt{T})\) after \(T\) iterations, without requiring any regularization. This rate holds even in the absence of a uniqueness assumption for the corresponding MFE.

AI.tldr: 本文重新研究了离散时间、单调、有限时域平均场博弈（MFGs）中平均场均衡（MFEs）的计算问题。作者提出使用锚定近端梯度下降方法计算单调MFE，并建立了最后一次迭代的收敛性结果。该方法将计算问题转化为占用测度空间上的优化问题，进而等价于约束Lipschitz单调包含问题，最终算法在T次迭代后达到O(1/√T)的收敛率，且无需正则化，即使MFE不唯一也适用。
AI.motivation: 平均场博弈中的均衡计算是一个重要且具有挑战性的问题。现有的计算方法往往需要正则化处理或依赖于均衡的唯一性假设，这限制了算法的适用性和理论保证。作者希望开发一种无需这些限制的、具有明确收敛保证的计算方法。
AI.method: 1) 将MFE计算问题重新表述为占用测度空间上的优化问题；2) 证明该问题等价于一类约束Lipschitz单调包含问题；3) 对单调包含问题应用迭代方法（锚定近端梯度下降），推导出可计算的算法。关键假设包括：转移核独立于状态测度项，奖励函数满足弱单调性和Lipschitz连续性。
AI.result: 所提出的算法在T次迭代后达到O(1/√T)的收敛率，无需任何正则化，且不要求相应的MFE具有唯一性假设。同时建立了方法的最后一次迭代收敛性结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为离散时间单调有限时域平均场博弈提供了一个新的计算框架，通过单调包含问题的视角，在更宽松的条件（无需正则化、无需唯一性）下实现了具有明确收敛率保证的MFE计算方法。

title: Plausible but Not Valid: A Psychometric Audit of LLMs as Synthetic Survey Respondents
comment: 50 pages, 9 figures. Under review. Code and data will be released upon publication
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic survey respondents, but existing evaluations ask whether answers look plausible at the individual level. We argue the right question is psychometric: do LLMs preserve the joint distribution, latent structure, reliability, mediation pathways, and demographic effects of real human survey data? We introduce a Lithuanian organisational-psychology dataset (n=263 employees; Dunham Attitudes Toward Change, UWES-17, Koopmans IWPQ; 68 items, 12 subscales) and condition a 37-model lineup spanning OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and twelve open-weight families on real respondent profiles under a five-level persona-disclosure ladder, presentation and reasoning-effort ablations, counterfactual demographic swaps (gender, role, education), a cross-language check, and a verbatim-recall memorization probe. The resulting Psychometric Similarity Score (PSS) is anchored against five non-LLM statistical baselines and a held-out human-vs-human ceiling, with respondent-bootstrap confidence intervals and an item-permutation null for Tucker's phi. LLMs reproduce the qualitative direction of human psychometric relationships, but a Gaussian-copula baseline beats every LLM on the sample-driven PSS components; the LLM "crowd" is more similar to itself (mean inter-LLM PSS 0.73) than to humans; and memorization does not drive the leaderboard (recall-PSS rank correlation 0.00). Counterfactual swaps reveal education-driven effects (mean |d|=0.56) that dwarf gender (0.12) and role (0.18); Tucker's phi on UWES falls inside the permutation null for 8 of 37 models. Downstream, every LLM shows a strong acquiescence shift (+0.84 SD), synthetic-trained regressors lose predictive validity on held-out humans (mean R^2 -0.18 vs 0.28), and models fabricate indirect effects on 3 of 10 placebo mediation paths. LLM samples are not a drop-in replacement for human survey data.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入立陶宛组织心理学数据集（n=263），对37个LLM模型进行系统性的心理测量学评估，提出"心理测量相似度分数"（PSS）。研究发现LLM虽能复现人类心理测量关系的定性方向，但在样本驱动的PSS成分上甚至不如高斯copula基线；LLM"群体"彼此更相似（0.73）而非更像人类；记忆化不驱动排行榜；教育驱动的反事实效应远超性别和角色；所有LLM表现出强烈默许偏差（+0.84 SD），且合成训练回归器在真实人类数据上丧失预测效度。结论：LLM样本不能替代真实人类调查数据。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅从个体层面评估LLM作为合成调查受访者时回答是否"看起来合理"，但忽略了更根本的心理测量学问题：LLM是否保留真实人类调查数据的联合分布、潜在结构、信度、中介路径和人口学效应。作者认为应提升评估标准，从心理测量学角度严格检验LLM能否作为人类调查数据的替代品。
AI.method: 作者构建了立陶宛组织心理学数据集（n=263员工；涵盖变化态度、工作投入、个体工作绩效三个量表，共68题12个子量表），并在37个模型（涵盖OpenAI、Anthropic、Google及12个开源权重家族）上设置五级人设披露阶梯、呈现方式与推理努力消融、反事实人口学交换（性别/角色/教育）、跨语言检验和逐字回忆记忆化探测。提出PSS分数，以五个非LLM统计基线和人类-人类天花板为锚点，使用受访者自助法置信区间和条目置换零分布检验Tucker's phi。
AI.result: 主要发现：1）LLM复现了人类心理测量关系的定性方向，但高斯copula基线在样本驱动PSS成分上击败所有LLM；2）LLM彼此更相似（平均互LLM PSS 0.73）而非更像人类；3）记忆化与排行榜无显著相关（相关系数0.00）；4）教育驱动效应（|d|=0.56）远超性别（0.12）和角色（0.18）；5）UWES上仅37个模型中的8个落入置换零分布；6）所有LLM有强默许偏差（+0.84 SD）；7）合成训练的回归器在真实人类数据上预测效度下降（R²从0.28降至-0.18）；8）10条安慰剂中介路径中有3条被虚构。
AI.conclusion: LLM样本不能作为人类调查数据的直接替代品（drop-in replacement）。尽管LLM能捕捉定性关系方向，但在量化心理测量特性上存在系统性偏差，包括默许偏差、效应大小扭曲、中介路径虚构等问题，这警示研究者在将LLM用作合成受访者时需保持谨慎。

title: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Resolution Diffusion Models for Trajectory Generation in Urban Systems
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to KDD 2026
summary:
Understanding human mobility is critical for a wide range of urban applications, including traffic management, epidemic control, and urban planning. However, due to privacy concerns, the availability of large-scale public trajectory data remains limited, posing challenges for downstream mobility analysis. Existing methods for synthetic trajectory generation primarily focus on matching global distribution similarity, while often overlooking mobility patterns across different spatial and temporal resolutions that are essential for practical utility.
  To address these challenges, we propose a novel multi-resolution diffusion framework, MR-Traj, for large-scale trajectory generation. MR-Traj explicitly models trajectories as compositions of coarse-grained milestones and fine-grained segments, enabling the capture of complex spatial-temporal dependencies at multiple resolutions. Experimental results demonstrate that MR-Traj achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods in terms of global distribution similarity, while consistently outperforming them in modeling fine-resolution mobility patterns and supporting downstream urban mobility tasks. In addition, by introducing stochasticity at multiple resolution levels, MR-Traj generates more diverse trajectories, which empirically reduces trajectory linkage risk under a seed-guided data release setting. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ray0202/MR-Traj.

AI.tldr: MR-Traj是一个多分辨率扩散框架，用于大规模轨迹生成。它将轨迹建模为粗粒度里程碑和细粒度片段的组合，在保持全局分布相似性的同时，更好地捕捉多分辨率下的时空依赖模式，并生成更多样化的轨迹以降低隐私泄露风险。
AI.motivation: 由于隐私问题，大规模公开轨迹数据稀缺，现有合成轨迹生成方法主要关注全局分布相似性，忽视了不同空间和时间分辨率下对实际应用至关重要的移动模式。
AI.method: 提出多分辨率扩散框架MR-Traj，将轨迹显式建模为粗粒度里程碑和细粒度片段的组合，通过引入多分辨率级别的随机性来捕获复杂的时空依赖关系并增强轨迹多样性。
AI.result: 实验表明MR-Traj在全局分布相似性方面与最先进方法性能相当，在细分辨率移动模式建模和下游城市移动任务支持上持续优于现有方法，同时通过生成多样性轨迹降低了种子引导数据发布场景下的轨迹关联风险。
AI.conclusion: MR-Traj通过多分辨率建模有效解决了合成轨迹生成中全局相似性与细粒度模式保真之间的平衡问题，在实用性和隐私保护方面均展现出优势，代码已开源。

title: Passivity-Based Nonlinear Control
comment: 23 Pages, 2 figures
summary:
The passivity-based control (PBC) framework focuses on understanding and modifying the energy storage and dissipation in the system to be controlled. To this end, PBC techniques often proceed in two steps: (i) ensuring that the closed-loop system's energy is minimum at the desired point, and then (ii) forcing the system to dissipate energy until reaching that point. These control methods have proven effective in controlling a wide range of systems, especially physical ones, even when they exhibit highly nonlinear behaviors.
  This chapter discusses the main aspects of some PBC strategies for nonlinear systems.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了非线性系统的无源性控制（PBC）策略，该框架通过理解和修改被控系统中的能量存储与耗散来实现控制目标。
AI.motivation: 无源性控制框架关注系统的能量存储与耗散特性，通过两个步骤实现控制：确保闭环系统能量在期望点处最小，然后迫使系统耗散能量直至达到该点。该方法对高度非线性的物理系统控制效果显著，因此值得系统讨论。
AI.method: PBC方法采用两步策略：(i) 使闭环系统能量在期望工作点处达到最小值；(ii) 迫使系统耗散能量直至收敛到该期望点。
AI.result: PBC方法已被证明能有效控制广泛的系统，尤其是物理系统，即使这些系统表现出高度非线性行为。
AI.conclusion: 本章介绍了非线性系统PBC策略的主要方面，为该领域的控制方法提供了系统性的论述。

title: The Best Are Always the Best: COVID-19 Lockdown Stringency and the Dispersion of Olympic Medal Outcomes
summary: We ask whether COVID-19 lockdown stringency altered national Olympic performance between Rio 2016 and Tokyo 2020, using the Oxford Stringency Index and the 99 countries that won a medal in either edition. As in \citet{liu2024}, mean performance is unaffected: stringency is insignificant in every OLS and ANOVA specification. The distribution is not. Among the 84 non-traditionally dominant nations, medal changes are three to six times more dispersed in high-stringency countries; the difference is absent among dominant nations and concentrated in men's events. A common shock left the competitive hierarchy intact while sharply raising outcome uncertainty for smaller Olympic teams.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨COVID-19封锁严格程度是否改变了里约2016至东京2020奥运会期间的国家奥运表现。使用牛津严格度指数和99个在两届奥运会中获得奖牌的国家，研究发现平均表现不受影响，但分布发生了变化：在84个非传统主导国家中，高严格度国家的奖牌变化分散程度是低严格度的3到6倍，而这种差异在主导国家中不存在，且集中在男子项目中。共同冲击保持了竞争层级不变，但显著增加了小型奥运代表队的结果不确定性。
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行对全球体育赛事产生了前所未有的冲击，奥运会延期并受到各国不同封锁政策的影响。作者希望探究不同封锁严格程度是否对不同国家的奥运表现产生了差异化影响，特别是对非传统体育强国的竞争格局和结果不确定性造成的影响。
AI.method: 使用牛津COVID-19政府反应追踪系统的严格度指数作为关键自变量，选取里约2016和东京2020两届奥运会中获得过奖牌的99个国家为样本。采用OLS回归和ANOVA方差分析检验封锁严格度对奖牌变化的平均影响，同时通过分散度/方差分析检验对奖牌变化分布的影响，并按国家传统实力（是否为主导国家）和性别项目进行分层分析。
AI.result: 封锁严格度在所有OLS和ANOVA规格中对平均奖牌表现均无显著影响，证实平均表现不受冲击。然而在分布层面，84个非传统主导国家中，高严格度国家的奖牌变化分散程度是低严格度国家的3到6倍，该差异在主导国家中不存在，且集中在男子项目中。
AI.conclusion: COVID-19封锁作为共同冲击，并未改变奥运会的竞争层级结构（主导国家仍保持优势），但显著增加了非传统体育强国——尤其是小型奥运代表队——的比赛结果不确定性。这暗示封锁对训练条件、备赛资源等方面的差异化影响，可能通过增加结果波动性而非平均水平的改变来体现。

title: Detecting Money Laundering in Rwandan Mobile Money: A Machine Learning Framework
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures
summary: Mobile money has widened financial access across Sub-Saharan Africa and enlarged the surface for money-laundering and terrorism-financing (ML/TF) activity in ecosystems dominated by high-volume, low-value transactions. Rwanda is a case in point: several million active mobile-money users, telecom-led wallets on the MTN and Airtel networks, and a Financial Intelligence Centre (FIC) supervising transaction streams whose scale exceeds static rule-based monitoring. This paper develops and evaluates a transaction-monitoring framework aligned to the Rwandan AML/CFT regime under (i) extreme class imbalance (~0.1% prevalence), (ii) scarce and delayed labels, and (iii) bounded investigator capacity. Using SAML-D, a synthetic dataset of 9,504,852 transactions with 17 laundering typologies, we engineer account-centric behavioural features (rolling velocity, net-flow directionality, counterparty diversity, burstiness) and benchmark supervised classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, LightGBM), unsupervised anomaly detectors (Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor), a dense autoencoder, and a late-fusion meta-learner. Evaluation is operational: PR-AUC, recall at a calibrated ~90%-precision point, recall at top-K%, and alerts per 10,000. On the chronologically held-out test period, LightGBM attains PR-AUC = 0.0469, capturing 64 laundering cases at precision ~0.89 with 0.51 alerts per 10,000; the fusion stacker reaches PR-AUC = 0.0477 at precision ~0.91 and 0.46 alerts per 10,000, recovering 59 true positives. We map score bands to Rwanda-relevant analyst workflows and STR/SAR escalation, and outline a staged path from synthetic prototyping to real-data validation with the National Bank of Rwanda and FIC. The contribution is operational: a governance-aware pipeline and evaluation protocol calibrated to the constraints of an African mobile-money regulator, not a new algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文针对卢旺达移动货币生态中反洗钱/反恐融资（AML/CFT）监管难题，开发并评估了一个交易监控框架。在极端类别不平衡（~0.1%）、标签稀缺延迟、调查员容量受限的实际约束下，使用合成数据集SAML-D（950万笔交易、17种洗钱类型）构建账户中心化行为特征，并基准测试了监督学习、无监督异常检测、自编码器及融合元学习器。LightGBM达到PR-AUC=0.0469，在~90%精度下捕获64个洗钱案例；融合stacker达到PR-AUC=0.0477，~91%精度下恢复59个真阳性。文章将分数区间映射到分析师工作流及STR/SAR升级流程，提出从合成验证到真实数据验证的分阶段路径。
AI.motivation: 移动货币在撒哈拉以南非洲扩大了金融可及性，但也放大了高量低值交易生态中的洗钱/恐怖融资风险。卢旺达拥有数百万活跃用户、电信主导钱包以及金融情报中心（FIC）监管超出静态规则监控能力的交易流。现有静态规则监控无法应对大规模交易流，亟需适应监管约束的智能监控框架。
AI.method: 使用SAML-D合成数据集（9,504,852笔交易、17种洗钱类型），构建账户中心化行为特征（滚动速度、净流向性、对手方多样性、突发性），基准测试监督分类器（LR、RF、LightGBM）、无监督异常检测器（IF、LOF）、密集自编码器及晚期融合元学习器。评估采用操作性指标：PR-AUC、校准~90%精度点的召回率、top-K%召回率、每万笔告警数，并在时间外测试集上验证。
AI.result: 在时间外测试集上，LightGBM达到PR-AUC=0.0469，精度~0.89时捕获64个洗钱案例，每万笔0.51条告警；融合stacker达到PR-AUC=0.0477，精度~0.91时恢复59个真阳性，每万笔0.46条告警。框架将分数带映射到卢旺达相关分析师工作流及STR/SAR上报流程。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献在于操作性而非算法创新：提供了面向非洲移动货币监管机构约束的治理感知型流水线和评估协议。规划了从合成原型到与卢旺达国家银行及FIC进行真实数据验证的分阶段路径，为类似监管环境提供了可复制的实践框架。

title: When ratios fall: A dynamic approach to contingent convertibles
comment: 44 pages, 2 tables, 2 figures
summary: We propose a novel valuation framework for contingent convertible (CoCo) bonds based on the issuing bank's Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) ratio, which is widely acknowledged as an indicator of a bank's solvency. Our approach develops a bivariate jump-diffusion model that captures the dynamic relationship linking the CET1 ratios, share prices, and CoCo bond prices, incorporating both continuous market movements and correlated jump risk. The model advances existing literature through three key innovations: (1) a hybrid mechanism for modeling regulatory discretion in trigger decisions, (2) a class of power conversion schemes that generalizes traditional approaches while maintaining analytical tractability, and (3) a method to overcome the temporal discrepancy between high-frequency market data and low-frequency regulatory reporting.
