We derive semi-closed form formulas for both write-down and equity-convertible CoCo bonds and validate our model through five case studies spanning from 2009 to 2023, including an in-depth analysis of the 2023 Credit Suisse collapse. The results demonstrate a significant improvement in pricing and hedging performance while highlighting the model's data-adaptive nature that enables short-term predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于银行CET1比率的CoCo债券估值框架，采用双变量跳跃扩散模型捕捉CET1比率、股价与CoCo债券价格之间的动态关系，并通过混合监管裁量机制、幂次转换方案和数据频率匹配方法三项创新，推导出减记型和股权转换型CoCo债券的半闭式定价公式，在2009至2023年的五个案例（含2023年瑞信事件）中验证了定价和套期保值性能的显著提升。
AI.motivation: CoCo债券的估值需要准确反映发行银行的偿付能力，而CET1比率是关键指标。现有文献在建模监管裁量权、转换方案的一般性以及不同频率数据之间的时间错配方面存在不足，需要更全面的估值框架。
AI.method: 构建一个双变量跳跃扩散模型，同时建模CET1比率和股价的动态关系，并联动CoCo债券价格。三项核心创新包括：(1) 混合机制建模触发决策中的监管裁量权；(2) 提出一类保持解析可处理性的幂次转换方案，推广传统方法；(3) 解决高频市场数据与低频监管报告之间的时间差异问题。最终推导出两类CoCo债券的半闭式定价公式。
AI.result: 通过2009至2023年间五个案例的验证，特别深入分析了2023年瑞士信贷倒闭事件，结果表明模型在定价和套期保值性能上都有显著改进，且具有数据自适应性，能够支持短期预测。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在实际CoCo债券定价中表现优异，兼具理论严谨性与实践适用性，尤其能够捕捉监管裁量和极端事件（如瑞信危机）情形下的债券定价行为，为金融机构的风险管理和监管提供了有力工具。

title: Scale-Consistent Posterior Dynamics for Diffusion Inverse Problems
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables
summary: Posterior sampling with a pretrained diffusion prior is governed by a conditional score whose intermediate likelihood component is generally intractable. We begin from an ideal one-parameter posterior SDE family in which a stochasticity parameter controls probability-flow transport and stochastic exploration without changing the posterior marginals. To obtain a tractable model, we express the likelihood in a rescaled clean-image coordinate and use log-SNR to organize the resulting posterior proxies. Projecting the diffusion uncertainty through the forward operator then yields a noise-conditioned covariance path whose targets approach the clean posterior. Because endpoint consistency of these targets does not ensure that a surrogate transport follows them, we interleave the transport with a frozen-target Langevin corrector, producing a continuous surrogate SDE. We discretize this model with an outer Lie--Trotter splitting and a variance-matched split-step IMEX predictor that treats the learned prior explicitly, the linear likelihood implicitly, and the stochastic innovation after the implicit solve. We prove marginal invariance of the ideal family, posterior convergence of the continuous surrogate under mixing and transport-defect conditions, and a first-order weak error bound for the discrete algorithm. Experiments on FFHQ and ImageNet with 100 score evaluations demonstrate competitive reconstruction fidelity for super-resolution and deblurring. A controlled 100-image ablation separates scale consistency from the finite-step effects of stochastic-increment placement, continuation, and corrector allocation. A separate noiseless box-inpainting study shows that large exploration reaches a performance plateau only when the matched innovation is injected after the stiff likelihood solve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于预训练扩散先验的后验采样方法，通过理想单参数后验SDE族、重缩放坐标下的似然代理、噪声条件协方差路径以及Langevin修正器，构建了可解的连续代理SDE，并采用Lie-Trotter分裂与方差匹配的IMEX预测器进行离散化。实验表明在FFHQ和ImageNet上以100次评分评估实现了高质量的SR和去模糊重建。
AI.motivation: 扩散先验驱动的后验采样中，条件评分函数的中间似然分量通常不可解，需要设计可解且保持后验边缘分布的代理模型。
AI.method: 提出理想单参数后验SDE族（随机性参数控制概率流传输与随机探索）；在重缩放清洁图像坐标中表达似然并用log-SNR组织后验代理；通过前向算子投影扩散不确定性得到噪声条件协方差路径；结合冻结目标的Langevin修正器构建连续代理SDE；采用Lie-Trotter外分裂与方差匹配的split-step IMEX预测器离散化（先验显式、似然隐式、随机创新在隐式求解后注入）。
AI.result: 在FFHQ和ImageNet上以100次评分评估实现超分辨率和去模糊的竞争性重建保真度；100张图像消融实验分离了尺度一致性与随机增量放置、持续化及修正器分配的有限步效应；无噪声盒内修复实验表明仅在刚性似然求解后注入匹配创新时，大探索才能达到性能平台。
AI.conclusion: 证明了理想族边缘不变性、连续代理在混合与传输缺陷条件下的后验收敛性，以及离散算法的二阶弱误差界，验证了所提框架的理论保证与实验有效性。

title: When to Communicate: Belief Distributions and KL Divergence for Principled Gating in Multi-Agent RL
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: Effective communication in multi-agent reinforcement learning requires agents to decide not only \textit{what} to communicate, but when? Existing approaches either communicate at every timestep or learn a binary gate through REINFORCE policy gradients \cite{singh2019}, a high-variance signal that produces unstable and uninterpretable gating behavior. I propose a principled alternative: agents communicate only when the KL divergence between their learned belief distributions exceeds a fixed threshold. Each agent maintains a belief distribution over a latent world state computed as a softmax over its LSTM hidden state, and communicates only when belief disagreement is large enough to justify information exchange. I evaluate this approach on the Predator-Prey benchmark from IC3Net \cite{singh2019} across two environment sizes with 5 seeds each, and on MPE simple\_spread \cite{lowe2017}, comparing against IC3Net, CommNet, and an independent controller. On PP 10$\times$10, IC3Net outperforms KL-belief at all thresholds. On the harder PP 20$\times$20, a threshold ablation over $\varepsilon \in \{0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0\}$ reveals an inverted U-shape: $\varepsilon=0.5$ achieves 73.84 average steps and 42\% success rate versus IC3Net's 75.31 steps and 31\%, a gap of 1.47 steps and 11 percentage points with tighter seed variance. On MPE, the belief head improves mean reward by 12 points and reduces variance by 26$\times$ even when gating is inactive, suggesting two orthogonal contributions: principled gating when beliefs can converge, and improved latent representations that benefit coordination regardless.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于KL散度阈值的新型通信门控机制：智能体仅在信念分布分歧超过固定阈值时才通信，替代高方差REINFORCE梯度方法，在Predator-Prey和MPE基准上取得竞争性结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体通信方法要么每步都通信（浪费资源），要么通过REINFORCE策略梯度学习二元门控，但这种方法方差高、训练不稳定且门控行为不可解释。需要一种更原则化、更稳定的通信时机决策方法。
AI.method: 每个智能体维护一个关于潜在世界状态的信念分布（对LSTM隐藏状态做softmax），仅当智能体间信念分布的KL散度超过固定阈值ε时才进行通信。在10×10和20×20两种规模的Predator-Prey环境以及MPE simple_spread上，对ε∈{0.1,0.3,0.5,1.0}进行消融实验，并与IC3Net、CommNet和独立控制器对比。
AI.result: 在PP 10×10上IC3Net在所有阈值下均更优；在更难PP 20×20上呈倒U型关系，ε=0.5时达73.84平均步数、42%成功率，优于IC3Net的75.31步和31%（差距1.47步和11个百分点），且种子方差更小。在MPE上信念头使平均奖励提升12点、方差降低26倍，即使门控未激活也有效。
AI.conclusion: 该方法揭示两个正交贡献：一是基于信念分歧的原则化门控在信念可收敛时有效；二是信念头改进潜在表征本身就能促进协调，与门控机制无关。但方法收益具有环境依赖性，在简单环境下不如IC3Net。

title: Wiola 13M, a Gated Spiral Attention Architecture for Parameter Efficient Small Language Models
summary: Small language models in the ten to one hundred million parameter range are attractive for on device inference, rapid experimentation, and controlled scientific study, yet most of them reuse the standard transformer block without adaptation to the small scale regime. We present Wiola, a decoder only language model whose novelty is concentrated in three drop in components of every layer. First, Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding perturbs the standard rotary frequencies by a slowly growing per dimension factor so that phase trajectories fan outward, improving long range discrimination while adding no parameters. Second, Gated Spiral Attention introduces a per head, content adaptive scalar gate derived from a causal cumulative statistic of the query stream, providing an implicit and differentiable form of soft head selection at negligible cost. Third, the Butterfly feed forward block replaces the conventional expansion layer with a multiplicative interaction and an intra block bypass path, matching the parameter count of a four times gated linear unit block while improving gradient flow in shallow stacks. We formalize each component, derive exact parameter and computation budgets, and prove that the gated attention admits an exact and numerically verified equivalence between full sequence training and cached autoregressive decoding, so that no approximation is introduced at inference time. We also describe a fully reproducible training and evaluation protocol on a standard tiny story corpus. The reference implementation is released as an open source package with weights ready publishing support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Wiola，一个10M-100M参数范围的解码器语言模型，通过三个即插即用的组件改进标准Transformer架构：螺旋旋转位置编码（Spiral RoPE）、门控螺旋注意力（Gated Spiral Attention）和蝶形前馈块（Butterfly FFN），在不增加参数的情况下提升长距离区分能力、实现软头选择并改善梯度流。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型（10M-100M参数）在端侧推理、快速实验和受控科学研究中具有吸引力，但大多数此类模型直接复用标准Transformer块，没有针对小规模场景进行适配。作者希望填补这一空白，设计专为小参数量模型优化的架构组件。
AI.method: 提出三个核心组件：(1) 螺旋旋转位置编码——用缓慢增长的逐维度因子扰动标准旋转频率，使相位轨迹向外扇形展开，增强长距离区分能力且不增加参数；(2) 门控螺旋注意力——引入基于查询流因果累积统计量的每头内容自适应标量门控，以极小代价实现隐式可微的软头选择；(3) 蝶形前馈块——用乘法交互和块内旁路路径替代传统扩展层，在参数量与四倍门控线性单元（GLU）块相当的情况下改善浅层堆叠的梯度流。论文还形式化每个组件、推导精确的参数和计算预算，并证明门控注意力在完整序列训练与缓存自回归解码之间存在精确且数值验证的等价性。
AI.result: 论文推导了各组件精确的参数和计算开销预算，证明了门控注意力在训练与推理解码之间的精确等价性，消除了推理时的近似。在标准微型故事语料库上建立了完全可复现的训练和评估协议，并开源发布了参考实现和权重。
AI.conclusion: Wiola展示了针对小参数量级专门设计的架构组件可以有效替代标准Transformer块，在不增加参数的前提下提升位置编码区分能力、注意力选择性和梯度流动性，同时保证训练推理一致性，为小型语言模型研究提供了可复现的开源基准。

title: Consensusability of Continuous-Time Multi-Agent Systems With Unbounded Heterogeneous Constant Delays: A Signed Laplacian Perspective
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures
summary: The consensus of continuous-time multi-agent systems with unbounded and heterogeneous constant delays is investigated by combining frequency-domain analysis and algebraic graph theory. Several types of signed Laplacians are constructed to characterize consensusability under delays. The core results are established based on the defined delay-embedded signed Laplacian, where a small-delay link creates a cooperative interaction and a possibly unbounded large-delay link creates an antagonistic interaction between the agents. The dividing line between small and large delays is given by $τ_{ij}=π/2λ_{\max}(\bm{L}_0)$, where $λ_{\max}(\bm{L}_0)$ refers to the maximum eigenvalue of the conventional graph Laplacian. It is proved that the consensusability is preserved if the delay-embedded signed Laplacian is positive semi-definite with a simple zero eigenvalue. Moreover, we derived some consensus conditions in terms of the extended effective resistance which measures the overall coupling between two sets of agents. The obtained results provide new insights into the mechanism of delayed consensus from the interplay between the small-delay-induced cooperativeness and large-delay-induced antagonism in the underlying network topology.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有无界且异构常数时滞的连续时间多智能体系统的一致性（consensus）问题，通过结合频域分析和代数图论，构造了多种带符号拉普拉斯矩阵（signed Laplacians）来描述时滞作用下的一致性条件。核心结果基于所定义的“时滞嵌入带符号拉普拉斯矩阵”：小时滞链路产生合作交互，而可能无界的大时滞链路产生对抗交互。区分大小时滞的临界线为 $τ_{ij}=π/2λ_{\max}(L_0)$。证明当时滞嵌入带符号拉普拉斯矩阵为半正定且具有单一零特征值时，一致性得以保持。此外还推导了基于扩展有效电阻（extended effective resistance）的一致性条件，揭示了时滞诱导的合作性与对抗性之间的相互作用机制。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统在实际应用中不可避免地存在通信时滞，且时滞往往是非均匀的、可能无界的。传统研究大多假设时滞较小或有界，缺乏对无界、异构时滞下一致性的系统分析。作者希望通过构建新的理论框架（时滞嵌入拉普拉斯矩阵），揭示时滞如何通过改变智能体间交互的“符号”（合作或对抗）来影响系统一致性的内在机理。
AI.method: 1) 结合频域分析与代数图论，研究连续时间多智能体在无界异构时滞下的一致性；2) 构造多种类型的带符号拉普拉斯矩阵（signed Laplacians）来刻画时滞下的一致性能力；3) 定义延迟嵌入带符号拉普拉斯矩阵，将小时滞建模为合作交互（正作用），大时滞建模为对抗交互（负作用）；4) 利用半正定性和单一零特征值条件证明一致性保持；5) 利用扩展有效电阻推导进一步的一致性条件。
AI.result: 1) 确立了大小时滞的临界分界线为 $τ_{ij}=π/2λ_{\max}(L_0)$；2) 证明当时滞嵌入带符号拉普拉斯矩阵半正定且具有简单零特征值时，多智能体系统的一致性得以保持；3) 推导了基于扩展有效电阻的一致性条件，该电阻度量了两组智能体之间的整体耦合强度。
AI.conclusion: 本文从图论的新视角揭示了时滞对一致性的影响机制：小时滞诱导的合作性与大时滞诱导的对抗性在网络拓扑中相互作用，共同决定系统能否达成一致性。该研究为时滞多智能体系统的一致性分析提供了新的理论工具，并为理解和设计具有异构时滞的网络化控制系统提供了洞见。

title: Understanding AI Anxiety in the Workplace: A Multimethod Investigation Using Fear Acquisition Theory and the Technology Acceptance Model
summary: As artificial intelligence (AI) rapidly diffuses and concerns about job displacement intensify, the psychological mechanisms underlying AI job replacement anxiety remain insufficiently understood. Drawing on Integrated Fear Acquisition Theory and the Technology Acceptance Model, the present research investigates whether AI job replacement anxiety can be elicited through vicarious exposure to narratives emphasizing AI-over-human control, and whether perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use of AI moderate this response. Across two studies, we examine AI job replacement anxiety as a response that emerges through vicarious exposure to narratives emphasizing AI agency and human control loss, rather than through direct personal experience of job displacement. Study 1 employed a randomized experiment (N = 316), demonstrating that such exposure increased AI job replacement anxiety. This effect was moderated by perceived usefulness of AI, but not by perceived ease of use, and remained robust after controlling for core self-evaluations. Study 2 (N = 995) replicated the association between perceived AI-over-human control and job replacement anxiety in an observational design and provided convergent evidence for the moderating role of perceived usefulness, supporting the external validity of the findings. Together, the results provide the first causal evidence that perceptual and vicarious processes can trigger AI job replacement anxiety. By shifting attention from structural labor-market conditions to how AI agency is perceived and communicated, this work offers a mechanism-based account of when and why AI-related job fears arise.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于整合恐惧获得理论与技术接受模型，通过两项研究（随机实验N=316；观察性设计N=995）首次提供因果证据，证明替代性接触强调AI控制人类的故事叙述能诱发AI替代工作焦虑，且感知有用性（而非感知易用性）对这一效应起调节作用。
AI.motivation: AI快速普及加剧了人们对失业的担忧，但AI替代工作焦虑背后的心理机制尚未被充分理解。现有研究多关注结构性劳动力市场条件，缺乏对感知与替代性过程如何触发这种焦虑的机制性解释。
AI.method: 整合整合恐惧获得理论与技术接受模型，采用两个研究：研究1为随机实验（N=316），通过替代性接触强调AI能动性与人类控制丧失的叙事来诱发焦虑，检验感知有用性与感知易用性的调节作用，并控制核心自我评价；研究2为观察性设计（N=995），复制感知AI高于人类控制与替代焦虑的关联，验证外部效度。
AI.result: 研究1证明替代性叙事暴露显著提升AI替代工作焦虑，该效应受感知有用性调节（而非感知易用性），在控制核心自我评价后依然稳健；研究2在观察性设计中复制了上述关联并支持调节作用的收敛效度。
AI.conclusion: 研究首次提供因果证据表明，感知与替代性过程能触发AI替代工作焦虑。通过将关注点从结构性劳动力市场条件转向AI能动性如何被感知与传播，为AI相关职业恐惧何时及为何产生提供了基于机制的解释。

title: Geometry Is Not Robustness: A Trajectory-Level Study of PGD Evaluation
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures
summary: Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) is widely used to evaluate adversarial robustness, typically via final adversarial accuracy, which does not capture model behaviour throughout the attack. Recent work proposes trajectory-level diagnostics, such as loss evolution, gradient alignment, and steps-to-failure, for deeper insight into adversarial optimisation dynamics. However, whether these diagnostics reliably indicate robustness strength remains unclear. We conduct a trajectory-level investigation of PGD attacks on convolutional neural networks trained on Fashion-MNIST. We compare clean-trained and adversarially-trained models across multiple robustness regimes, using rigorous 20-step PGD evaluations with random initialisation and multiple restarts for robustness measurement, and single-initialisation trajectory recording for diagnostics. We record full PGD trajectories across 3000 clean-correct samples per model and analyse loss evolution, gradient alignment, and failure timing across attack iterations. Our results reveal a clear robustness hierarchy across models; however, trajectory metrics do not contribute equally to its identification. Mean loss trajectories and gradient alignment patterns appear quantitatively similar across adversarially-trained models with substantially different robust accuracies. In contrast, steps-to-failure distributions provide a clearer separation of robustness regimes, directly reflecting functional resistance to adversarial perturbation. These findings indicate that trajectory-level diagnostics describe optimisation geometry but do not independently measure adversarial robustness. Their interpretability depends on robustness regime, attack strength, and multi-metric evaluation. Trajectory-level analysis should be a complementary diagnostic tool, interpreted in context, rather than a replacement for standard robustness measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文对PGD攻击的轨迹级诊断指标（损失演化、梯度对齐、失败步数）进行了系统性研究，发现这些指标并不能独立衡量对抗鲁棒性，尤其是损失轨迹和梯度对齐在鲁棒性不同的对抗训练模型间表现出相似性；而失败步数分布能更清晰地区分鲁棒性级别。轨迹级分析应作为标准鲁棒性测量的补充诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 现有的PGD鲁棒性评估通常只看最终对抗准确率，无法捕捉攻击过程中的模型行为。虽然已有工作提出轨迹级诊断（损失演化、梯度对齐、失败步数），但这些指标能否可靠指示鲁棒性强弱尚不清楚。作者旨在系统性地验证这些轨迹级诊断指标的有效性。
AI.method: 在Fashion-MNIST数据集上，对卷积神经网络进行PGD攻击的轨迹级研究。将干净训练和对抗训练模型对比，覆盖多个鲁棒性体制。使用严格的20步PGD评估（随机初始化、多次重启）测量鲁棒性，用单初始化轨迹记录诊断信息。对每个模型记录3000个干净正确样本的完整PGD轨迹，分析损失演化、梯度对齐及失败时机。
AI.result: 实验揭示了清晰的模型鲁棒性层级，但轨迹指标对其识别的贡献不均等。平均损失轨迹和梯度对齐模式在不同鲁棒性的对抗训练模型间定量相似；相比之下，失败步数分布能更清晰地分离鲁棒性体制，直接反映对对抗扰动的功能抵抗力。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级诊断描述的更多是优化几何特性，而非独立衡量对抗鲁棒性。其可解释性依赖于鲁棒性体制、攻击强度和多重指标评估。轨迹级分析应作为情境化解释的补充诊断工具，而非标准鲁棒性测量的替代品。

title: Introduction to Passivity-based Control
comment: 26 pages, 1 figure
summary:
Passivity-based control (PBC) is a nonlinear control design framework that has proven adequate for controlling a wide range of systems, especially physical ones. Their main ingredients are physical quantities such as energy and dissipation, making the control design more intuitive and endowing the controllers with a physical interpretation. In contrast to other, mathematically-based nonlinear control approaches, the energy-based viewpoint and physical intuition of PBC often make this strategy more robust and energy efficient.
  This chapter provides an overview of PBC, revisiting the basic aspects of this powerful nonlinear control framework and the most common PBC approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于无源性的控制（PBC）这一非线性控制设计框架，回顾了其基本概念和最常见的PBC方法。
AI.motivation: PBC作为一种基于物理量（能量和耗散）的非线性控制框架，相比数学驱动的非线性控制方法更具鲁棒性和能效，因此需要对其基本方面和常用方法进行系统回顾与概述。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方式，重新审视PBC的基本方面，并介绍最常见的PBC方法（如能量整形、阻尼注入等）。
AI.result: 提供了PBC框架的全面概述，涵盖其核心思想、物理直觉优势以及主流PBC方法的分类与介绍。
AI.conclusion: PBC因其基于能量的直观设计理念和物理可解释性，在非线性控制领域具有重要价值，尤其在物理系统控制方面表现突出。

title: Estimation and Inference for Peer Effects under Conditional Random Assignment
summary: Empirical studies of peer effects often exploit conditional random assignment to peer groups within urns. We develop a GMM framework for estimation and inference in this setting. The framework separately identifies endogenous and contextual peer effects and nests tests of random peer-group assignment as a special case. It permits unknown heteroskedasticity and corrects finite-urn bias in variance estimation. Its asymptotic theory allows the number of peer groups to grow through more urns, more groups within urns, or both. We establish the asymptotic validity of the procedures and evaluate their finite-sample performance through Monte Carlo simulations. We apply the method to study peer effects on personality among university students. For traits with positive reduced-form peer effects, the estimates indicate that positive contextual effects are partly offset by negative endogenous effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于在条件随机分配（urn内随机分组）情境下估计同伴效应的GMM框架，能够分别识别内生性同伴效应和情境性同伴效应，并涵盖对随机分组假设的检验。该框架允许未知异方差、修正有限urn偏差，并建立了当urn数量和组内群体数量增长时的渐近理论。通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证有限样本表现，并应用于大学生人格同伴效应的实证研究。
AI.motivation: 实证研究同伴效应时，常利用urn内条件随机分配到同伴群体的设计。然而现有方法缺乏一个统一且严谨的估计与推断框架，难以分别识别内生性同伴效应（endogenous peer effects）和情境性同伴效应（contextual peer effects），同时在有限urn数量下存在方差估计偏差，需要更完善的渐近理论来处理结构复杂的同伴群体数据结构。
AI.method: 作者开发了一个GMM（广义矩估计）框架：1) 利用urn内条件随机分配结构构建矩条件，分别识别内生性和情境性同伴效应；2) 将随机同伴群体分配的检验作为框架的特例；3) 在方差估计中修正有限urn偏差，并允许未知异方差；4) 建立渐近理论，允许群体数量通过更多urn、更多组内群体或两者共同增长来增加；5) 通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估有限样本表现。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛模拟验证了方法的有限样本表现。实证应用中，对大学生人格的同伴效应研究显示：对于具有正向简约形式（reduced-form）同伴效应的特质，估计结果表明正向的情境性同伴效应部分被负向的内生性同伴效应所抵消。
AI.conclusion: 该GMM框架为urn内条件随机分配的同伴效应研究提供了统一的估计与推断工具，能够分离不同类型同伴效应并检验随机分配假设，其渐近性质在多种数据结构增长路径下均成立，实证结果揭示了大学生人格同伴效应中内生性与情境性效应的复杂交互关系。

title: Beyond Effective Sample Size: Effective Number of Proposals for Adaptive Importance Sampling
summary:
Population-based adaptive importance sampling (AIS) methods use a set of
  proposal densities to approximate complex target distributions. Their
  performance is commonly assessed through effective sample size (ESS) and related
  weight-based diagnostics, which measure the concentration of normalized
  importance weights. However, a large ESS only indicates that the normalized
  sample weights are not strongly concentrated; it does not describe how the
  proposal components are arranged in the sampling space. In population-based AIS,
  several proposal components may generate samples in the same region of the
  target, so the sample weights can appear well balanced even though the effective
  number of distinct proposal components is small. This letter introduces the
  effective number of proposals (ENP), a similarity-aware proposal-level diagnostic
  for population-based AIS. ENP combines the total normalized weight assigned to
  each proposal with a redundancy measure computed from similarities among
  target-weighted samples, estimating the number of non-redundant empirical
  proposal contributions to the approximation. We establish basic effective-number
  properties and show that ENP detects proposal collapse and duplication missed by
  standard ESS. We also illustrate its use as a targeted feedback signal for
  proposal rejuvenation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的诊断指标——有效提议数（ENP），用于群体自适应重要性采样（AIS）中衡量提议成分的有效数量。ENP结合每个提议的总归一化权重与目标加权样本间的相似性冗余度量，能检测出标准ESS无法发现的提议塌缩和重复问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的重要性采样诊断指标（如有效样本量ESS）只关注归一化权重的集中程度，但无法反映提议成分在采样空间中的分布情况。在群体AIS中，多个提议成分可能在同一目标区域生成样本，导致权重看似平衡但实际上有效提议成分很少。因此需要一种能感知相似性的提议级诊断指标。
AI.method: 提出有效提议数（ENP）指标：将每个提议分配的总归一化权重与从目标加权样本相似性计算出的冗余度量相结合，估计对逼近有贡献的非冗余经验提议数量。建立了基本的有效数性质，并将其作为提议再生的定向反馈信号。
AI.result: 实验表明ENP能够检测出标准ESS遗漏的提议塌缩和重复现象，并验证了其作为提议再生反馈信号的实用性。
AI.conclusion: ENP是群体AIS中一种更全面的提议级诊断工具，弥补了ESS在评估提议多样性方面的不足，能为提议自适应更新提供更有效的指导。

title: Global AI Regulations for FAIR and Ethics in High-Risk Use Cases: A Comparative Review
comment: 6 pages. Accepted at the 50th IEEE Computers, Software, and Applications Conference (COMPSAC 2026), Madrid, Spain, July 7-10, 2026
summary: AI governance is shifting from voluntary ethics to enforceable, risk-based regulation, yet cross-jurisdictional divergence creates compliance uncertainty for operators of high-stakes AI. We present a comparative matrix for the EU, US, and China that maps (i) risk classification triggers, (ii) binding obligations, (iii) enforcement and accountability mechanisms, and (iv) the degree to which FAIR principles are operationalised in practice. We stress-test the matrix on three high-impact domains: Electroencephalography (EEG)-guided rehabilitation robotics, AI-enabled debt collection in prospective Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) ecosystems, and AI-driven allocation of scarce Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) resources in emerging AI Factory infrastructures. Using primary legal texts and implementation evidence, we identify three recurring gaps: weak interoperability mandates, difficult operationalisation of cross-regime obligations (AI + sector regulation + data protection), and under-specified governance for critical digital infrastructure use cases. To bridge the implementation gap, we outline Knowledge Blocks, a machine-checkable compliance artefact pattern based on Resource Description Framework/Web Ontology Language (RDF/OWL), Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL), and Provenance Ontology (PROV-O), enabling audit-ready compliance-by-design across multiple regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个欧盟、美国、中国AI治理的比较矩阵，涵盖风险分类触发条件、约束性义务、执法问责机制及FAIR原则实操程度，并在三个高风险领域（EEG康复机器人、CBDC债务催收、GPU资源分配）进行压力测试，识别出三大治理缺口，并提出基于RDF/OWL、SHACL和PROV-O的机器可验证合规工件模式"Knowledge Blocks"来弥合实施差距。
AI.motivation: AI治理正从自愿性伦理转向强制性、基于风险的监管，但各司法管辖区之间的监管分歧给高风险AI运营商带来了合规不确定性，亟需跨司法管辖区的比较分析与可操作的合规解决方案。
AI.method: 构建欧盟、美国、中国三方比较矩阵，从风险分类触发、约束义务、执法问责、FAIR原则实操四个维度展开；在三个高风险领域进行压力测试；基于主要法律文本和实施证据识别治理缺口；提出Knowledge Blocks这一基于RDF/OWL、SHACL和PROV-O的机器可检查合规工件模式。
AI.result: 识别出三大反复出现的缺口：弱互操作性授权、跨制度义务（AI+行业监管+数据保护）的可操作性困难、关键数字基础设施用例的治理规范不足。
AI.conclusion: 通过Knowledge Blocks模式可实现跨司法管辖区的合规自证（compliance-by-design），提供审计就绪的合规基础设施，以弥合AI治理的实施鸿沟。

title: AutoMem: A Text-Gradient Recursive Self-Improvement Framework for Automated Memory Architectures Search
summary: Long-term memory is increasingly central to LLM agents, yet memory design remains a highly coupled architecture problem: what to encode, how to store it, how to retrieve it, and how to manage it can vary substantially across tasks and backbone models. We construct a discrete search space with 5 encoders, 5 stores, 6 retrievers, and 4 managers, and show that no single memory architecture consistently dominates: different tasks favor different module combinations, leading to substantial performance gaps. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{AutoMem}, a text-gradient recursive self-improvement framework for task-adaptive memory architecture search. \textsc{AutoMem} optimizes over the factored space through two components: Experience-Guided Architecture Search, which proposes candidate architectures from historical search trajectories and accumulated reflections, and Failure-Guided Module Diagnosis, which localizes memory-related failures to specific modules and converts them into targeted textual feedback. Experiments on GAIA, WebWalkerQA, and xBench-DeepSearch across two LLM backbones show that \textsc{AutoMem} consistently discovers task-adaptive memory architectures that outperform the strongest human-designed memory baselines, improving accuracy by $2.8$ points on average across six benchmark-backbone settings. Further analysis shows that \textsc{AutoMem} achieves a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off, reducing token cost by $14.3\%$ over the strongest accuracy baselines under Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, while also finding stronger architectures than substantially larger random searches within only a few guided iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoMem，一种基于文本梯度的递归自我改进框架，用于任务自适应记忆架构搜索。在5个编码器、5个存储、6个检索器、4个管理器组成的离散搜索空间中，AutoMem通过经验引导的架构搜索和失败引导的模块诊断，自动发现适合特定任务的记忆架构，在GAIA、WebWalkerQA、xBench-DeepSearch等基准上平均提升2.8个百分点的准确率，并减少14.3%的token开销。
AI.motivation: 长时记忆是LLM智能体的核心，但记忆设计是一个高度耦合的架构问题（编码什么、如何存储、如何检索、如何管理），不同任务和骨干模型偏好不同的模块组合，没有单一的记忆架构能持续占优，导致性能差距显著。因此需要一种任务自适应的记忆架构搜索方法。
AI.method: AutoMem包含两个核心组件：(1) 经验引导的架构搜索（Experience-Guided Architecture Search）：从历史搜索轨迹和累积反思中提出候选架构；(2) 失败引导的模块诊断（Failure-Guided Module Diagnosis）：将记忆相关失败定位到具体模块，并转化为针对性的文本反馈。通过文本梯度实现递归自我改进，在分解的搜索空间中进行优化。
AI.result: 在GAIA、WebWalkerQA和xBench-DeepSearch三个基准上，跨越两个LLM骨干模型进行实验，AutoMem一致地发现优于最强人工设计记忆基线的任务自适应记忆架构，平均提升2.8个百分点的准确率。在Qwen3.5-122B-A10B下相比最强准确率基线减少14.3%的token成本，并能在少量引导迭代内找到比大规模随机搜索更强的架构。
AI.conclusion: AutoMem证明了记忆架构搜索可以从高度耦合的人工设计中解放出来，通过文本梯度的递归自我改进实现任务自适应的记忆架构发现，在准确性和效率之间取得了有利的权衡。

title: Do You Have My Size In Stock? Assortment and Inventory Optimization Under the Consider-Fit-Then-Choose Choice Model
summary:
In apparel retail and other applications, when a customer's preferred size is unavailable, demand may shift to nearby sizes. This substitution creates new assortment and inventory optimization challenges by coupling product availability and demand across sizes. We introduce the consider-fit-then-choose (CFTC) model to capture such size-dependent choice behavior. Products may be offered in multiple sizes, which affect customer preferences and consideration sets through fit, measured by distance from the customer's ideal size. We study assortment optimization and show-all inventory selection, in which the retailer chooses initial inventory and subsequently offers every in-stock product.
  We show that assortment optimization under the CFTC model is NP-hard and develop a PTAS when customers deviate by at most $O(1)$ sizes from their ideal size. Combined with the recent black-box framework of Fu et al. (2026), this yields a nearly $0.272$-approximation for show-all inventory selection. We next exploit the specific choice dynamics of the CFTC model. By stocking only every other size, we decouple demand across stocked sizes and reduce CFTC to a special class of mixed multinomial logit models that we prove satisfies the convex chain decomposition (CCD) property of Goyal et al. (2023).
  For the fluid problem, we develop a polynomial-time $(1/2-ε)$-approximation under adjacent-size substitution and a mild condition on preference weights. For the stochastic problem, we establish an asymptotic $1/2$-approximation using a new coupling argument connecting the stochastic inventory process to its fluid counterpart. Numerical experiments calibrated using footwear data show small optimality gaps across a broad range of substitution patterns and problem settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了考虑尺码适配再选择的（CFTC）模型，用于建模服装零售中因缺码导致的相邻尺码替代行为。作者证明在该模型下品类优化问题是NP难的，并开发了PTAS算法（当顾客偏离理想尺码不超过O(1)个尺码时）；结合Fu等人（2026）的黑箱框架，得到近0.272近似的show-all库存选择算法。进一步利用每间隔一个尺码备货的策略解耦需求，将CFTC归约为满足凸链分解（CCD）性质的混合MNL模型。流体问题开发了(1/2-ε)近似算法，随机问题通过耦合论证建立渐近1/2近似。基于鞋类数据的数值实验显示在各种替代模式下最优性差距很小。
AI.motivation: 在服装零售等实际场景中，当顾客偏好的尺码缺货时，需求会转移到相邻尺码，这种替代行为使得产品可用性与跨尺码需求相互耦合，给品类优化和库存选择带来新的挑战。现有模型未充分捕捉这种尺码依赖的选择行为。
AI.method: 1) 提出CFTC模型刻画尺码依赖的选择行为；2) 证明品类优化NP-hard并开发PTAS；3) 结合黑箱框架获得show-all库存选择的近似算法；4) 通过间隔备货策略解耦需求，将CFTC归约为满足CCD性质的混合MNL模型；5) 对流体问题开发多项式时间(1/2-ε)近似；6) 对随机问题通过耦合论证建立渐近1/2近似。
AI.result: 品类优化在CFTC下是NP-hard的；PTAS在顾客偏差≤O(1)尺码时成立；show-all库存选择获得近0.272近似；流体问题得到(1/2-ε)近似；随机问题得到渐近1/2近似；基于鞋类数据的数值实验显示小最优性差距。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统解决了CFTC模型下的品类优化和库存选择问题，提供了从NP-hardness证明、近似算法到数值验证的完整研究框架，为尺码依赖的替代行为提供了理论坚实的优化方法。

title: The 2026 Singapore Consensus on Global AI Safety Research Priorities
comment: Available at https://aisafetypriorities.org/
summary: Frontier AI capabilities and autonomy are advancing rapidly. A growing number of real-world incidents make a trusted AI ecosystem essential to embracing AI with confidence. The 2026 Singapore Consensus is an outcome of the second International Scientific Exchange on AI Safety, bringing together over 100 contributors spanning 13 countries from frontier developers, government safety institutes, academia, and civil society. Building on the 2025 report, it presents a global understanding of technical AI safety research problems of top priority, now with a dedicated focus on societal resilience and on managing the risks of increasingly autonomous AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了2026新加坡共识，这是第二届人工智能安全国际科学交流的成果，汇聚了来自13个国家超过100名来自前沿开发者、政府安全机构、学术界和公民社会的贡献者。该共识在2025年报告基础上，提出了技术性AI安全研究的全球优先议题，特别聚焦于社会韧性和日益自主的AI智能体风险管理。
AI.motivation: 随着前沿AI能力和自主性快速发展，现实世界中发生的AI安全事故日益增多，建立一个可信赖的AI生态系统对于放心拥抱AI技术至关重要。
AI.method: 通过第二届国际科学交流（International Scientific Exchange on AI Safety）汇聚全球多方利益相关者（前沿开发者、政府安全机构、学术界、公民社会），形成跨13个国家、100多位贡献者的协商共识。
AI.result: 形成了2026新加坡共识，在2025年报告基础上扩展了全球技术性AI安全研究优先级框架，新增了社会韧性和自主AI智能体风险管理的专门关注。
AI.conclusion: 该共识代表了国际社会在AI安全研究优先级上的协同努力，强调在AI快速自主化的背景下，需要通过国际合作共同应对技术风险并增强社会韧性。

title: DumpsterCluster: From Dumpster Diving to Serving LLaMA-70B on $60 GPUs
summary: As AI datacenters retire functional GPUs, vast quantities of still capable accelerators enter secondary markets. This paper investigates whether these retired GPUs can find a productive afterlife to form a DumpsterCluster that can serve modern LLM inference, and under what conditions such repurposing is economically viable and environmentally sustainable. We physically built a 128-GPU DumpsterCluster from scratch using only second-hand components and ran it for one year. At current market prices (\$22K for the DumpsterCluster vs. \$600K for an 8-GPU B200 system), the economic advantages are substantial. Through pipeline-parallel optimizations, our V100 based DumpsterCluster achieves competitive LLaMA-70B throughput, validating production viability. However, our deployment reveals critical context dependencies. Older GPUs consume significantly more energy per token, making total cost of ownership favorable only in regions with inexpensive electricity. Under grid-average carbon intensity, second-hand systems can produce approximately 4x higher total carbon emissions per token for 8B models, and over 40x for 70B models, compared to current-generation hardware. These findings show that GPU afterlife is not universally sustainable - hardware repurposing must be strategically coupled with low carbon energy sources. When deployed in regions with favourable energy economics and clean electricity, second-hand GPUs offer a viable pathway for expanding AI capacity while advancing affordability, energy security, and environmental responsibility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究退役GPU构建"垃圾场集群"(DumpsterCluster)用于现代LLM推理的可行性与可持续性。研究者使用二手组件搭建了128-GPU集群并运行一年，发现其经济优势显著（$22K vs $600K），通过流水线并行优化可在V100上实现有竞争力的LLaMA-70B吞吐量。但环境可持续性具有强上下文依赖性：老旧GPU每token能耗更高，在电网平均碳强度下碳排放可达新硬件的4倍（8B模型）乃至40倍（70B模型），只有与低碳廉价电力结合时才具备真正价值。
AI.motivation: AI数据中心大量退役仍有算力余量的GPU进入二手市场，本文旨在探究这些GPU能否通过"再利用"方式服务现代LLM推理，并明确在何种条件下这种再利用在经济上可行且环境上可持续，填补了硬件循环利用与AI算力扩张之间的研究空白。
AI.method: 从零开始用纯二手组件物理构建128-GPU DumpsterCluster，实际运行一整年；采用流水线并行(pipeline-parallel)优化方案在V100集群上运行LLaMA-70B推理；对比当前市场价格（二手集群$22K vs 8-GPU B200系统$600K）；测量每token能耗并比较不同区域电价和碳强度下的总拥有成本和碳排放。
AI.result: 二手集群成本仅为新系统的约3.7%；通过流水线并行优化，V100集群可实现有竞争力的LLaMA-70B吞吐量，验证了生产可行性；但在电网平均碳强度下，二手系统8B模型碳排放约为新硬件4倍，70B模型超过40倍；只有在廉价且清洁电力区域部署时，总拥有成本才具有优势。
AI.conclusion: GPU"来世"并非普遍可持续——硬件再利用必须与低碳能源战略性地结合。在能源经济良好且电力清洁的地区，二手GPU为扩展AI算力提供了可行路径，兼顾可负担性、能源安全与环境责任；否则高能耗会抵消成本优势并带来显著碳足迹。

title: Stabilization Limits of Payoff-Based Higher-Order Replicator Dynamics
summary: Replicator dynamics (RD) is a fundamental model in learning in games, connecting evolutionary game theory and online learning. This paper studies payoff-based higher-order variants of RD represented as a cascade interconnection between an integrator in parallel with an auxiliary linear time-invariant (LTI) system and the softmax mapping. We investigate learnability of Nash equilibria under this Nash-stationary learning rule. First, we revisit recent results that establish convergence to Nash Equilibrium whenever the auxiliary LTI system is strictly passive and prove a converse passivity result: if the auxiliary LTI system is not passive, then there exists a static strictly contractive game whose interior Nash equilibrium is unstable under the closed-loop learning dynamics. Second, we show that there exists a class of games with isolated interior Nash equilibria that cannot be locally asymptotically stabilized by any payoff-based higher-order RD whose auxiliary LTI system is asymptotically stable and strictly proper. Finally, we show that if Nash stationarity (i.e., all Nash equilibria are stationary points of the learning dynamics) is relaxed, then generalized exponential RD (Ex-RD) can locally asymptotically stabilize a logit equilibrium for any continuously differentiable game. The stabilized equilibrium can be viewed as an entropy-regularized approximate Nash equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于收益的高阶复制子动力学（RD）变体，该变体由积分器与辅助线性时不变（LTI）系统的级联互联及softmax映射表示。作者证明了严格被动LTI系统可确保收敛到纳什均衡（并给出逆被动结果），同时揭示了某些博弈无法被渐近稳定LTI系统局部镇定，最后表明放宽纳什平稳性后，广义指数RD可局部渐近镇定任意连续可微博弈的对数均衡（即熵正则化的近似纳什均衡）。
AI.motivation: 复制子动力学是博弈学习中的基础模型，连接进化博弈论与在线学习。现有工作主要关注标准RD及其收敛性，但对高阶（payoff-based）变体的可学习性（尤其是纳什均衡的可镇定性和局限性）缺乏系统理解。本文旨在厘清高阶RD在何种条件下能/不能学习纳什均衡，并探索放宽约束后可能的新结果。
AI.method: 本文将高阶RD建模为积分器与辅助LTI系统的级联连接加softmax映射的闭环结构。主要方法包括：(1) 利用被动性（passivity）理论建立收敛充分条件，并证明逆被动结果（非被动则存在静态严格压缩博弈使内部纳什均衡不稳定）；(2) 构造一类具有孤立内部纳什均衡的博弈，证明其无法被渐近稳定且严格真的辅助LTI系统局部镇定；(3) 放宽纳什平稳性约束，提出广义指数RD（Ex-RD）并证明其可局部镇定任意连续可微博弈的对数均衡。
AI.result: (1) 建立了严格被动LTI系统的收敛充分性及逆被动定理（非被动→存在反例博弈使NE不稳定）；(2) 证明了存在一类博弈，其孤立内部纳什均衡无法被任何渐近稳定且严格真的高阶RD局部镇定；(3) 在放宽纳什平稳性后，广义Ex-RD可对任意连续可微博弈局部渐近镇定对数均衡，该均衡可视为熵正则化的近似纳什均衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统刻画了基于收益的高阶复制子动力学的纳什均衡可学习性边界：被动性条件既是收敛的充分条件也是本质必要的；在纳什平稳性约束下存在不可学习博弈类；但通过放宽纳什平稳性并采用广义指数RD，可以实现更广泛博弈的局部镇定（尽管目标变为近似纳什均衡）。这一结果揭示了学习动力学中"精确纳什均衡可学习性"与"近似均衡可达性"之间的基本张力。

title: Quantile restrictions, revealed rankings, and the limits of multinomial choice
summary:
This paper analyzes when choice probabilities reveal rankings of deterministic utility indices in semiparametric discrete choice models. It begins with binary choice, where quantile thresholds guarantee ranking recovery, and shows that such thresholds can arise either from behavioral departures from utility maximization (e.g., limited attention) under exchangeable unobservables, or from non-exchangeable unobservables under standard utility maximization. These behavioral and distributional routes are then extended to multinomial choice. Under limited attention, balance restrictions on attention probabilities yield global linear ranking partitions which are robust to the distribution of unobservables and, given sufficiently rich joint variation in the differences of utility indices, are also necessary. Absent the required attention restrictions, opposite rankings can produce overlapping probability images. Under non-exchangeable unobservables, a comparable distribution-uniform partition generally need not exist.
  Holding the distribution fixed, however, ranking recovery remains possible via an injective nonlinear map from normalized utility differences to choice probabilities under both behavioral and distributional extensions. Together, the results distinguish distribution-robust global ranking partitions from ranking recovery with a fixed distribution of unobservables and clarify the limits of extending binary quantile restrictions to multinomial choice.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了在半参数离散选择模型中，选择概率何时能够揭示确定性效用指数的排名。研究发现，二元选择中分位数阈值可以保证排名恢复，这既可能源于行为偏离（如有限注意力）加上可交换的不可观测变量，也可能源于标准效用最大化下不可交换的不可观测变量。在多元选择中，有限注意力下的平衡约束可产生全局线性排名划分，而在固定分布下，通过非线性映射仍可实现排名恢复。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在明确选择概率与效用指数排名之间的可识别性关系，区分两类不同的排名恢复途径：一类是对不可观测变量分布稳健的全局排名划分，另一类是在固定分布下通过非线性映射实现的排名恢复。这有助于阐明将二元分位数限制扩展到多元选择的局限性。
AI.method: 论文从二元选择出发，区分两种产生分位数阈值的途径：行为偏离（限注意力的假设）结合可交换不可观测变量，以及标准效用最大化结合不可交换不可观测变量。随后将这两种途径扩展到多元选择，分析有限注意力下的平衡约束如何产生全局线性排名划分，并考察这些划分在何种条件下是必要的，以及当约束缺失时可能出现的问题。
AI.result: 在有限注意力下，平衡约束能够产生对不可观测变量分布稳健的全局线性排名划分，且当效用指数差的联合变化足够丰富时，这些划分是必要条件；缺少注意力约束时，相反排名可能产生重叠的概率像。在不可交换不可观测变量下，通常不存在类似的分布均匀划分。但在固定分布条件下，通过从归一化效用差到选择概率的单射非线性映射，两种扩展下均可实现排名恢复。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了分布稳健的全局排名划分与固定分布下的排名恢复，阐明了将二元分位数限制扩展到多元选择的局限性，为理解半参数离散选择模型中的排名可识别性提供了清晰的理论框架。

title: Identifying parameter couplings and uncertainties of mixed-noise stochastic systems via full-covariance Gaussian mixture network
summary: Parameter identification of stochastic dynamical systems driven by mixed noises is challenging due to intractable likelihood functions. We propose PENN-GMD, a parameter estimation neural network that maps partially observed trajectories to a Gaussian mixture distribution (GMD) over the system parameters. Unlike conventional uncertainty estimates, the GMD employs full covariance matrices to explicitly reveal parameter couplings and multi-modal likelihood structures. The network is trained by minimizing the negative log-likelihood via a surjective parameterization that hard-encodes all GMD constraints, thereby approximating the true likelihood. We validate the method on five numerical examples with increasing complexity, including systems driven by fractional Gaussian and Lévy noises, oscillators with colored noise, coupled neurons under different observability, and an aeroelastic airfoil with unidentifiable stochastic disturbances. Results demonstrate that PENN-GMD accurately recovers likelihood distributions, captures parameter couplings, and naturally diagnoses non-identifiability through variance broadening or mode splitting. These capabilities establish PENN-GMD as a practical tool for uncertainty-aware parameter identification in complex stochastic systems where conventional likelihood-based methods are infeasible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PENN-GMD，一种参数估计神经网络，将部分观测轨迹映射到系统参数上的高斯混合分布，通过满协方差矩阵显式揭示参数耦合和多模态似然结构，解决了混合噪声驱动随机动力学系统中似然函数不可解的参数辨识难题。
AI.motivation: 混合噪声驱动的随机动力系统参数辨识面临似然函数难以处理的挑战，传统基于似然的方法在此类场景下不可行，需要一种能够处理复杂噪声、捕获参数耦合并诊断不可辨识性的实用方法。
AI.method: PENN-GMD通过一个参数估计神经网络将部分观测轨迹映射为系统参数上的高斯混合分布（GMD）；采用满协方差矩阵以揭示参数耦合和多模态似然结构；通过满射参数化硬编码所有GMD约束，训练时最小化负对数似然以逼近真实似然函数。
AI.result: 在五个复杂度递增的数值案例中验证（包括分数高斯和Lévy噪声驱动系统、有色噪声振荡器、不同可观测性下的耦合神经元、以及具有不可辨识随机扰动的气动弹性翼型），PENN-GMD能准确恢复似然分布、捕获参数耦合，并通过方差展宽或模态分裂自然诊断不可辨识性。
AI.conclusion: PENN-GMD为复杂随机系统中不确定性感知的参数辨识提供了实用工具，在传统似然方法不可行的场景下有效发挥作用。

title: Position: AI Lock-In Is in Progress, and We Must Be Prepared
comment: ICML 2026 Position Track Spotlight
summary: AI safety research has mainly focused on two areas: technical alignment (ensuring AI systems produce human-aligned outputs) and the regulation of generative AI's societal impacts (including unemployment risk and labor market disruption). However, an equally important dimension remains underexplored: the risk inherent in dependence on AI systems themselves. In this position paper, we argue that AI safety research should address AI Lock-In, the phenomenon whereby excessive reliance on AI systems leads to human deskilling, diminishes human capacity for independent functioning, and creates systemic vulnerabilities when AI systems become unavailable or compromised. We highlight that AI Lock-In is a systemic threat that is already emerging at individual, societal, and national levels, one that could be dramatically amplified by AI service disruptions or geopolitical conflicts. Drawing on detailed scenarios, we investigate how AI Lock-In emerges and escalates across multiple levels, ranging from individual skill atrophy to national-scale infrastructure failures. To address this, we provide guidance on how such risks can be mitigated and prepared for at each level. We contend that proactively addressing AI Lock-In before such dependencies become entrenched, or even irreversible, is essential for preserving individual autonomy and national security.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，提出AI安全研究应关注"AI锁定"（AI Lock-In）现象——即过度依赖AI系统导致人类技能退化、独立功能能力下降，并在AI系统不可用或受损时产生系统性脆弱性。作者认为这是一个已在个体、社会和国家层面显现的系统性威胁，并提供了多层面的缓解与准备建议。
AI.motivation: 现有AI安全研究主要聚焦于技术对齐和生成式AI的监管，但忽略了依赖AI系统本身所带来的风险。作者认为AI锁定是一个尚未被充分探索但同样重要的安全维度，且这种依赖一旦变得根深蒂固甚至不可逆转，将危及个人自主性和国家安全。
AI.method: 采用立场论文形式，通过构建详细场景来研究AI锁定如何在多个层面出现和升级——从个体技能萎缩到国家层面的基础设施故障，并为每个层面提供风险缓解和准备指导。
AI.result: 识别出AI锁定是个体、社会和国家三个层面的系统性威胁，可能因AI服务中断或地缘政治冲突而急剧放大，并提出了每个层面的缓解策略。
AI.conclusion: 主动应对AI锁定——在依赖关系变得根深蒂固或不可逆转之前——对于维护个人自主性和国家安全至关重要，应将AI锁定纳入AI安全研究的核心议程。

title: LLM Safety Alignment in Low-Resource Languages: A Systematic Literature Review
comment: The paper was accepted at LM4UC workshop organize by IJCAI. I added a screenshot of the decision (Open Review)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved substantial progress in safety alignment, yet their safety guarantees remain significantly weaker in low-resource and multilingual settings than in high-resource languages. In this paper, we conduct a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) of LLM safety alignment in low-resource languages by adopting the PRISMA 2020 methodology. Out of roughly 1,500 papers identified from Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and OpenAlex, 50 relevant studies have been selected and analyzed. Our review is organized around four themes: safety alignment methods, multilingual safety risks, evaluation benchmarks, and cross-lingual transferability. We further propose a taxonomy of safety alignment approaches based on three adaptation mechanisms: data adaptation, objective optimization, and mechanistic alignment. Across literature, translated English benchmarks fail to sufficiently represent culturally rooted harms, and multilingual models are more vulnerable to cross-lingual jailbreaks, code-switching attacks, and safety degradation in underrepresented languages. These failures are driven by several key factors, including uneven multilingual pre-training coverage, insufficient native-language preference data, poor transfer of safety representations, and a lack of culturally aware evaluation frameworks. The review also notes that many low-resource languages, especially African languages, have fewer safety benchmarks available than other multilingual regions. Overall, the results reveal a persistent multilingual safety gap, and suggest that future progress will require culturally grounded benchmarks, participatory data collection, balanced multilingual pre-training, and scalable multilingual alignment methods.

AI.tldr: 本文采用PRISMA 2020方法对低资源语言下LLM安全对齐进行了系统性文献综述，从约1500篇论文中筛选出50篇相关研究进行分析，围绕安全对齐方法、多语言安全风险、评估基准和跨语言迁移性四大主题展开，提出了基于数据适配、目标优化和机制对齐三种适应机制的安全对齐方法分类体系。
AI.motivation: LLM在安全对齐方面虽已取得显著进展，但其安全保障在高资源语言与低资源语言之间存在显著差距，而低资源语言场景下的安全对齐问题尚未得到系统性的梳理和分析。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA 2020系统综述方法，从Semantic Scholar、arXiv和OpenAlex三个数据库中检索约1500篇论文，经筛选后对50篇相关研究进行深入分析；构建了基于数据适配、目标优化和机制对齐三种适应机制的安全对齐方法分类学。
AI.result: 研究发现翻译后的英文基准无法充分反映文化根源性危害；多语言模型更容易遭受跨语言越狱、代码切换攻击以及低资源语言上的安全性能退化。此外，许多低资源语言（尤其是非洲语言）可用的安全评估基准明显少于其他多语言地区。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了持续存在的多语言安全鸿沟，指出未来需要文化基础的基准、参与式数据收集、均衡的多语言预训练以及可扩展的多语言对齐方法来解决这一问题。

title: Gain of Entrainment in Nonlinear Cascades
summary: We consider the gain of entrainment (GOE)--the difference between the average steady-state output under a periodic input and the steady-state output under a constant input with the same mean--for an $n$-stage feedforward cascade of stable first-order filters interleaved with static nonlinearities. The main result is an exact decomposition of GOE as a weighted sum of local Jensen gaps, where each gap quantifies the mean shift generated by a nonlinearity, and each weight is a product of downstream incremental gains divided by linear time constants. We provide a Bregman-divergence interpretation of the decomposition, and a second-order small-amplitude of GOE separating local curvature, fluctuation energy, and differential gains. We demonstrate the theoretical results using a Michaelis-Menten cascade showing that any nonconstant periodic feeding strictly reduces the average terminal product relative to constant feeding with the same mean.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了n级前馈级联系统（由稳定一阶滤波器与静态非线性交替组成）在周期输入下的"夹带增益"（GOE），即周期输入与同均值常数输入下稳态平均输出之差。核心结果是将GOE精确分解为局部Jensen间隙的加权和，每个权重由下游增量增益除以线性时间常数构成，并提供了Bregman散度解释及小振幅二阶近似。
AI.motivation: 理解非线性级联系统在周期输入下的平均输出行为，特别是"输入波动如何影响系统平均输出"这一基础问题，有助于分析生物系统和工程系统中的非线性整流效应。
AI.method: 将GOE分解为局部Jensen间隙的加权和；利用Bregman散度进行解释；推导小振幅下GOE的二阶近似（分离局部曲率、波动能量和微分增益）；通过Michaelis-Menten级联实例验证。
AI.result: 得到GOE的精确分解公式；给出了Bregman散度解释；在小振幅条件下获得了包含局部曲率、波动能量和微分增益的二阶表达式；Michaelis-Menten级联实例表明任何非常数周期喂养都会严格降低平均终端产物。
AI.conclusion: 非线性级联系统的周期输入效应可被系统分解并精确量化，为理解生物网络和工程系统中的整流/滤波效应提供了理论工具。

title: Traces of Abuse: How Generative AI Impacts Image-Based Sexual Abuse (IBSA) Investigations
comment: Accepted at the "Community Building for Researchers on Generative AI-Facilitated Image-Based Abuse" Workshop at SOUPS 2026
summary: The introduction of generative AI (GAI) into the workflow of image-based sexual abuse (IBSA) only worsened the ease of creation and distribution, victimizing more people than ever. We outline how the introduction of generative AI (GAI-IBSA) impacts the creation of traces and the type of reasoning they allow. We illustrate the impact by comparing the forensic traces available in four different IBSA scenarios. We discuss the impacts on the (possibility of) investigation, arguing that the advent of generative AI overall benefits abusers by making perpetration easier, and the perpetrator harder to trace.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了生成式AI（GAI）对基于图像的性虐待（IBSA）领域的影响，分析了GAI如何改变犯罪痕迹的生成方式及允许的推理类型，并通过四种IBSA场景的取证痕迹对比，论证生成式AI总体上有利于施虐者，使犯罪更容易实施、施虐者更难以被追踪。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的引入使基于图像的性虐待（IBSA）犯罪的制作和传播更加容易，受害人数激增。作者希望系统性地分析GAI对IBSA取证工作带来的挑战，特别是其对犯罪痕迹生成和侦查推理方式的影响，以引起对这一问题严重性的关注。
AI.method: 采用对比分析方法，通过比较四种不同的IBSA场景中可获得的取证痕迹，来展示GAI-IBSA对痕迹创建的影响，并进一步讨论这些变化对调查可能性（或不可能性）的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现生成式AI的引入显著改变了IBSA犯罪中取证痕迹的性质和可用性，使得传统的取证推理方式受到挑战，调查的可行性大大降低。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI的整体引入利好施虐者一方：它降低了实施犯罪的门槛，同时大大增加了追踪犯罪者的难度，对受害者保护和司法追诉构成了严峻的挑战。

title: Calibrated Trust, Not Sharper Prediction: An Empirical Test of Uncertainty Fusion
comment: 12 pages, 10 figures
summary: A recurring proposal in legal AI is to improve case-outcome prediction by fusing uncertainty tools (evidence graphs with belief propagation, sequential Bayesian odds updating, Dempster-Shafer combination, and conformal prediction) into one pipeline. We test this on 1,000 real European Court of Human Rights cases from LexGLUE and FairLex, predicting whether the Court found a Convention violation from the case's fact paragraphs. We compare three families across two frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5) as per-fact evidence estimators: (A) the raw LLM, (B) the LLM routed through the fusion pipeline, and (C) a term-frequency baseline through the same pipeline. Across roughly 4,750 tests we find: (1) on discrimination (AUROC around 0.83) the pipeline yields no improvement over either the raw LLM or the baseline; a frontier LLM used directly is the strongest single discriminator. (2) Naively composing an LLM with Bayesian-odds and Dempster-Shafer fusion more than doubles calibration error (ECE from about 0.16 to 0.46) via a prior-mismatch mechanism that replicates across both models. (3) Dempster-Shafer fusion is actively unsafe on long chains, committing confidently to wrong labels at below-chance accuracy; we recommend removing it. (4) The pipeline's genuine value is operational: routed through a conformal selective-prediction layer, the system decides which cases to automate and which to escalate. After removing Dempster-Shafer, recalibrating, and applying class-conditional risk control on the full 1,000-case set, the tuned engine auto-clears at 96.8 percent accuracy with 0.5 percent errors escaping and 96.3 percent caught for review, versus 85.9 / 3.8 / 72.1 for an untuned baseline. The contribution of such pipelines in law is calibrated trust, not sharper prediction.

AI.tldr: 本研究在1,000个真实的欧洲人权法院案例上，测试了将多种不确定性工具（证据图、贝叶斯赔率、Dempster-Shafer组合、保形预测）融合到法律AI案件结果预测流水线中的效果。结果发现：融合流水线在判别能力上并不优于直接用前沿LLM；朴素组合LLM与贝叶斯/Dempster-Shafer融合会大幅恶化校准误差；Dempster-Shafer在长链上不安全应移除；该流水线的真正价值在于通过保形选择性预测层实现操作性的自动化决策——经调优后自动放行准确率达96.8%，远超未调优基线（85.9%）。结论是此类流水线对法律的贡献是可校准的信任，而非更锐利的预测。
AI.motivation: 法律AI领域反复有人提议将多种不确定性工具融合进单一流水线以改进案件结果预测。作者希望系统性地检验这一主张是否成立，即融合各种不确定性方法是否真的能提升预测性能，还是仅仅增加复杂性。
AI.method: 在1,000个来自LexGLUE和FairLex的欧洲人权法院真实案例上，预测法院是否认定违反公约。比较三种证据估计器家族（原始LLM、经融合流水线路由的LLM、经同一流水线的词频基线），使用两个前沿LLM（Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5），开展约4,750项测试。流水线融合了证据图、顺序贝叶斯赔率更新、Dempster-Shafer组合和保形预测。
AI.result: (1)判别任务上流水线无改进（歧视案例AUROC约0.83），直接用LLM最强；(2)朴素组合LLM与贝叶斯/Dempster-Shafer使ECE从约0.16恶化到0.46（先验失配机制）；(3)Dempster-Shafer在长链上不安全，会以低于随机水平的准确率自信地选错标签，建议移除；(4)流水线的真正价值在操作层面：经保形选择性预测层调优后，自动放行准确率达96.8%（错误逃逸0.5%、96.3%被抓获送审），远优于未调优基线（85.9/3.8/72.1）。
AI.conclusion: 融合不确定性工具的流水线并不会带来更锐利的预测，其核心贡献在于通过校准的选择性预测机制提供可操作的"可信度筛选"，从而在法律场景中实现"可校准的信任"——即决定哪些案件可自动化、哪些需人工审查，而非提升判别精度本身。

title: Ranking-Augmented On-Policy Optimization with Adaptive Advantage-Normalization for Constrained Control
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC). (c) 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses, in any current or future media. The full copyright notice appears on the first page of the paper
summary: This paper analyzes the boundedness and feasibility properties of Advantage-Ranked Group Relative Policy Optimization (A-GRPO), a ranking-augmented, critic-free policy gradient method employing a Transformer-encoder actor for fixed-horizon control with terminal constraints. When feasibility is evaluated only at the final step, the resulting sparse feedback destabilizes critic-based advantage estimation and weakens standard Lagrangian approaches. A trajectory-level ranking mechanism that augments group-relative policy updates by reweighting advantages according to constraint satisfaction is formalized, and three results are established: (i) a scale-adaptive per-timestep normalization bounds advantage variance at every timestep independently, (ii) the ranked advantage strictly separates feasible from violating trajectories under a verifiable ranking-weight condition, biasing the policy gradient toward constraint satisfaction, and (iii) the adaptive dual variables remain bounded and exhibit a drift-balance property that acts as a feedback mechanism for feasibility. These results are validated on a 3,605-step series-hybrid powertrain energy management task with a terminal state-of-charge constraint, where A-GRPO achieves 75.4% mean sustained feasibility with return within 3.7% of the dynamic programming optimum, outperforming a Proximal Policy Optimization with Lagrangian penalties (PPO-Lag) baseline (27.4% sustained), and ablation experiments confirm that both the ranking and Lagrangian components are necessary for this performance.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了一种排名增强、无评论家的策略梯度方法A-GRPO，用于带终端约束的固定时域控制问题。该方法通过轨迹级排名机制和自适应对偶变量，在3,605步混合动力能量管理任务中实现了75.4%的持续可行性，性能接近动态规划最优值。
AI.motivation: 在仅有终端步骤评估可行性的场景下，稀疏反馈会破坏基于评论家的优势估计，并削弱标准拉格朗日方法的效果，因此需要一种无需评论家、能够有效处理稀疏终端约束的策略优化方法。
AI.method: A-GRPO采用Transformer编码器作为actor，通过轨迹级排名机制增强组相对策略更新，根据约束满足情况重新加权优势；建立了三个理论结果：尺度自适应逐时间步归一化、排名优势的可分离性条件、以及自适应对偶变量的有界性与漂移平衡性质。
AI.result: 在3,605步串联混合动力能量管理任务（带终端SOC约束）中，A-GRPO达到75.4%的平均持续可行性，回报与动态规划最优值相差3.7%以内，优于PPO-Lag基线（27.4%持续可行性）；消融实验确认排名和拉格朗日组件均不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: A-GRPO通过排名增强和无评论家的设计，有效解决了稀疏终端反馈下的可行性保持问题，理论性质与实验验证共同支撑其在实际顺序决策任务中的有效性。

title: Trading Scope for Credibility in Difference-in-Differences
summary: When parallel trends fails for some treated cohorts but not others, the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT), an average over all of them, is exactly the target that becomes hard to recover. We propose changing the estimand rather than defending it. The credible-subpopulation local ATT (LATT) is the effect for the subpopulation of cohorts whose parallel trends is credible, and it is point-identified under parallel trends for the selected cohorts alone, a weaker requirement that can hold when the ATT's fails. It is estimated by reweighting standard group-time effects toward those cohorts, and paired with honest sensitivity bounds on the residual violation that a pre-trend screen cannot rule out. The method's advantage grows with how informative pre-trends are about post-treatment violations, as simulations confirm. In an application, a significantly positive pooled estimate of the shale boom's effect on local house prices proves to rest on cohorts already trending before onset, and the credible subpopulation reveals no effect.

AI.tldr: 本文针对平行趋势假设在某些处理组群（cohort）成立而其他不成立的情况，提出将估计目标从整体ATT改为"可信子总体局部ATT"（LATT），即在平行趋势可信的组群子总体上的平均处理效应。该估计量仅需所选组群的平行趋势成立即可点识别，并通过重加权标准组群-时间效应估计，辅以对预处理趋势筛查无法排除的残余违反的诚实敏感性界。
AI.motivation: 当平行趋势假设对部分处理组群成立而对其他组群不成立时，对所有这些组群取平均的ATT变得难以可靠恢复。作者主张改变估计目标而非为ATT辩护，因为要求所有组群平行趋势成立过强，而仅要求所选可信组群的平行趋势成立则更弱、更易满足。
AI.method: 提出credible-subpopulation LATT作为新估计目标，即在平行趋势可信的组群子总体上的平均处理效应。估计方法是通过重加权标准的组群-时间效应（group-time effects）将权重偏向这些可信组群，并配套给出对预处理趋势筛查无法排除的残余违反项的"诚实"敏感性界（honest sensitivity bounds）。
AI.result: 模拟验证显示，该方法的优势随预处理趋势对事后处理违反的信息量增加而增大。在一项页岩气繁荣对当地房价影响的应用中，原本显著为正的合并估计被证明依赖于在处理开始前已呈趋势的组群，而可信子总体上的估计显示没有效应。
AI.conclusion: 当平行趋势对全体处理组群不成立时，ATT不可靠；转向在平行趋势可信的组群子总体上定义的LATT，可提供更可靠的点识别估计，并以敏感性界刻画残余违反。应用示例表明，看似显著的效应可能完全源于违反平行趋势的组群，可信子总体方法能揭示真实（无）效应。

title: The Distributional View of Knowledge Distillation
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures
summary: Token-level knowledge distillation (KD) matches two conditional distributions per position, yet the standard objectives compare them pointwise: a Kullback-Leibler gradient is blind to which wrong token receives probability mass. We develop a distributional view in which the teacher is represented not by a single softened output but by a family of multi-temperature views - marginals of the annealing path of its logits - and the student is trained against a geometry-aware aggregate of these views under an embedding-based ground cost. We formalize the resulting design space (mixtures, log-linear pooling, entropic Wasserstein barycenters, and a debiased Sinkhorn-divergence flagship in hub and path forms), prove an exact collapse result showing log-linear pooling of tempered views is equivalent to a single temperature, and give a multi-marginal Schrodinger-bridge reading that yields falsifiable predictions. On instruction-tuned Pythia pairs, experiments yield three empirical laws: (i) dispersion law - the benefit of multi-temperature aggregation grows monotonically with the effective temperature dispersion of the views, not with their number; (ii) dispersed views unlock the aggregation operator - the barycenter separates from the arithmetic mixture exactly when transport-based aggregation starts to beat averaging; and (iii) two-regime picture governed by the ceiling gap $Γ=\mathrm{PPL}_{\mathrm{SFT}}-\mathrm{PPL}_{T}$: when the fine-tuned teacher barely beats a supervised student the gentle transport objective is the best KD loss but no KD beats supervised fine-tuning, whereas at a real ceiling the ranking inverts - and the sign of the fidelity-generalization correlation flips. We argue that "which distillation loss is the best" is not a fixed property of the loss but a function of $Γ$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分布视角的 token 级知识蒸馏方法：教师不是用单一的软化输出表示，而是用一族多温度视图（其 logits 退火路径的边际分布）表示，学生在嵌入代价下针对这些视图的几何感知聚合进行训练。作者形式化了设计空间（混合、log-linear pooling、entropic Wasserstein barycenter 及去偏 Sinkhorn 散度），证明了 log-linear pooling 等价于单一温度，并通过实验发现三条经验定律，核心结论是"最优蒸馏损失"并非损失本身的固定属性，而是天花板差距 Γ 的函数。
AI.motivation: 标准 token 级知识蒸馏用逐点比较（如 KL 散度梯度）匹配条件分布，但对"错误 token 上概率质量落在何处"不敏感。作者希望发展一种分布化视角，让教师的信息以多温度视图族的形式呈现，并利用嵌入代价感知聚合，从而更充分利用教师分布的结构信息。
AI.method: 将教师表示为一族多温度视图（logits 退火路径的边际），在嵌入空间下对这些视图进行几何感知聚合（包括混合、log-linear pooling、entropic Wasserstein barycenter，以及 hub/path 形式的去偏 Sinkhorn 散度）。证明 log-linear pooling 与单一温度严格等价，并提供多边际 Schrödinger bridge 解释。
AI.result: 在 instruction-tuned Pythia 对上得到三条经验定律：分散律（多温度收益随有效温度分散度单调增长，而非视图数量）、分散视图解锁聚合算子（barycenter 恰在传输聚合开始优于平均时与算术混合分离）、由 Γ = PPL_SFT - PPL_T 控制的双区段图像（温和传输目标在低天花板时最优但 KD 无法超越 SFT；高天花板时排序反转且保真-泛化相关性符号翻转）。
AI.conclusion: "哪种蒸馏损失最好"不是损失的固定属性，而是天花板差距 Γ 的函数。这一结论提供了一个可证伪的预测框架，并揭示了蒸馏损失选择与教师/学生能力差距之间的深层耦合关系。

title: Position: Evaluations of AI Moral Reasoning Still Miss Half of the Picture
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for archival publication at the ACL 2026 Workshop on Evaluating Evaluations (EvalEval)
summary: Recent work on evaluating the moral competence of large language models (LLMs) has focused primarily on what we call the moral value problem, i.e., whether model outputs align with human moral values. In contrast, the moral norm problem, i.e., whether models can identify and correctly apply context-sensitive moral norms, remains underexplored. We posit that this imbalance stems from the field's reliance on descriptive ethics frameworks, such as Moral Foundations Theory and Kohlberg's stages of moral development, which emphasize value representation over normative application. We review existing benchmarks and evaluation methods, and show that they cluster heavily around the value problem, while discussion regarding normative ethics remains underrepresented. We identify three crucial gaps: (i) the absence of high-quality ground-truth data for moral norms and their applications, (ii) insufficient evaluation of intermediate reasoning processes, and (iii) limited attention to the identification of morally relevant features in context. Subsequently, we propose a research agenda that includes the development of standardized formal representations for normative theories, the construction of expert-annotated datasets capturing norm application, and evaluation protocols that explicitly distinguish between values-level and norms-level competence. Our goal is to encourage a more systematic study of normative reasoning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有LLM道德能力评估过分聚焦于"道德价值问题"（模型输出是否与人类价值观一致），而忽视了"道德规范问题"（模型能否识别并正确应用情境敏感的规范）。作者审查了现有基准与评估方法，识别出三个关键缺口，并提出包含规范理论形式化表示、专家标注数据集和分层评估协议的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM道德评估研究严重失衡：大量工作围绕描述性伦理学框架（如道德基础理论、科尔伯格阶段理论）评估价值表征，而规范性伦理学的应用能力（如情境化道德规范的识别与应用）被明显忽视。作者希望纠正这一不平衡，推动对LLM规范推理的系统研究。
AI.method: 作者首先对现有LLM道德评估的基准和方法进行系统性综述与分类，将其聚类到"价值问题"或"规范问题"两大范畴；在此基础上识别三个关键研究缺口：(i)缺乏高质量道德规范及应用的ground-truth数据，(ii)对中间推理过程评估不足，(iii)对情境中道德相关特征识别关注有限；最后提出包含五方面的研究议程：标准化规范理论形式化表示、专家标注数据集、分层评估协议等。
AI.result: 该研究属于观点/综述性质论文，没有实验数据结果。其主要"结果"包括：1) 证明现有评估工作高度集中于价值问题而规范问题代表性严重不足；2) 识别出三个具体研究缺口；3) 提出一套系统性的研究议程以弥补这些缺口。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁研究社区从"价值对齐"层面扩展到"规范推理"层面，通过区分价值级与规范级能力、开发形式化规范表示和专家标注数据，推动对LLM道德能力的更深入和系统性的理解与评估。

title: Inference-Time Mitigation of Adversarial Political Bias in Large Language Models
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become the mainstay for information retrieval and summarization tasks, ensuring that they are always non-partisan and invulnerable to political bias is a critical step towards safer and more trustworthy Artificial Intelligence (AI). Current model alignment paradigms, such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), make LLMs follow overarching safety instructions. However, this instruction tuning can be exploited via adversarial prompt injection and be used to generate unsafe content. In particular, political bias has not been specifically targeted by modern alignment techniques as harmful and biased content. To address this vulnerability of LLMs, we propose mitigation strategies using Chain of Thought (CoT) prompting and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Using a public dataset of legislative videos, we generate summaries using LLMs, inject bias via adversarial prompting and evaluate their performance on a four axis scale designed for political summarization. In this paper, we present different methods to shield LLMs against the injection of political bias. Our results demonstrate that the proposed Recursive Self-Correction approach raises model performance from a Political Neutrality Likert scale baseline of 2.14 to 4.56, averaged across all models, demonstrating effective inference-time mitigation of political bias in LLM-generated summaries.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM在信息检索和摘要任务中容易受到政治偏见注入攻击的漏洞，提出了基于思维链提示和直接偏好优化（DPO）的缓解策略，其中递归自校正方法将政治中立性评分从2.14提升至4.56（五级Likert量表），有效实现了推理时的政治偏见缓解。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM成为主流的信息检索和摘要工具，确保其非党派性和免受政治偏见影响变得至关重要。现有的RLHF等对齐范式虽然能让模型遵循总体安全指令，但容易被对抗性提示注入所利用，生成不安全内容。特别是政治偏见未被现代对齐技术专门作为有害和偏见内容加以针对，这是一个亟待解决的安全漏洞。
AI.method: 作者提出使用思维链（CoT）提示和直接偏好优化（DPO）两种缓解策略。具体包括：1）利用公开的立法视频数据集生成摘要；2）通过对抗性提示注入政治偏见；3）在专为政治摘要设计的四轴量表上评估性能；4）提出递归自校正（Recursive Self-Correction）方法作为推理时的偏见缓解机制。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的递归自校正方法在所有测试模型上平均将政治中立性Likert量表基线从2.14提升至4.56，证明了该方法在推理时能有效缓解LLM生成摘要中的政治偏见。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功展示了对抗性提示注入对LLM政治立场的威胁，并验证了递归自校正作为一种有效的推理时缓解手段，为构建更安全、更值得信赖的AI系统提供了可行路径。

title: Ergodic Stochastic Optimal Control Problems
summary: In this article, we introduce a novel approach to solving the ergodic stochastic optimal control problem whose dynamics is driven by a controlled stochastic differential equation. The coefficients of this stochastic differential equation are non-autonomous but periodic in time. We first prove that the infinite horizon average stochastic optimal control problem is ergodic, i.e., the value function equals a constant $ρ$ which is independent of the initial conditions. Based on the result of ergodicity, we construct an auxiliary function $w(t,x)$ that is well-defined and periodic in time. We can prove that the pair $(w,ρ)$ satisfies the dynamic programming principle and is a viscosity solution of the associated Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation. Finally, we apply our results to the study of ergodic backward stochastic differential equations. Our method is even new in the homogeneous case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种求解由受控随机微分方程驱动的遍历随机最优控制问题的新方法，该方程的系数是非自治但随时间周期的。作者首先证明无限时域平均随机最优控制问题具有遍历性，即值函数等于与初始条件无关的常数ρ。基于遍历性结果，构造了一个定义良好且随时间周期的辅助函数w(t,x)，并证明(w,ρ)对满足动态规划原理，是相应Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程的粘性解。最后将结果应用于遍历倒向随机微分方程的研究。
AI.motivation: 当前遍历随机最优控制问题的研究大多局限于自治（时不变）系统，对于系数随时间周期性变化的非自治系统缺乏系统性的理论框架。作者旨在扩展遍历随机最优控制理论到周期时变系统，并建立其与遍历倒向随机微分方程之间的联系。
AI.method: 1) 首先证明无限时域平均随机最优控制问题的遍历性，即值函数为与初始条件无关的常数ρ；2) 基于遍历性结果构造一个定义良好且时间周期的辅助函数w(t,x)；3) 证明(w,ρ)满足动态规划原理，并是相应Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程的粘性解；4) 将上述结果应用于遍历倒向随机微分方程的研究。该方法在齐次（自治）情形下也是全新的。
AI.result: 成功证明了周期时变系数下的随机最优控制问题具有遍历性，值函数为常数ρ且与初始条件无关；构造的辅助函数w(t,x)与常数ρ构成的配对满足动态规划原理，并是Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程的粘性解；该结果可进一步推广应用于遍历倒向随机微分方程的研究。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为系数随时间周期变化（非自治）的遍历随机最优控制问题提供了一套完整的理论框架，通过遍历性、辅助函数构造和粘性解方法解决了该问题，并将结果成功应用于遍历倒向随机微分方程。该方法甚至在自治（齐次）情形下也具有创新性，为这一领域提供了新视角和新工具。

title: Local AI pre-screening for human triple-blind peer review in health sciences
comment: 16 pages, 1 figure
summary:
Academic peer review is under mounting strain: NeurIPS 2025 received 21,575 submissions, ICLR 2025 received 11,603, and ICML 2025 received 12,107. This volume has outpaced the supply of qualified reviewers, and large language models (LLMs) are already filling the gap, largely undisclosed. An independent analysis of ICLR 2026 found roughly 21% of its 75,800 peer reviews were fully AI-generated, with over half showing some AI involvement (up from 15.8% in 2024). Documented risks include hallucinated citations in accepted papers and hidden prompt-injection instructions embedded in manuscripts to manipulate AI reviewers into favorable assessments.
  We propose a triple-blind, multi-LLM pre-screening framework for peer review, developed for a health sciences journal, that formalizes and discloses AI involvement while preserving human reviewers as the final decision-making authority. The framework routes a submission through five stages -- sanitization/anonymization, parallel AI pre-screening, an automated check gate, blinded human review, and editorial adjudication -- with return-to-author loops at the check and editor stages. Addressing the confidentiality concerns behind NIH/NSF bans on submitting unpublished proposals to third-party generative AI, all three AI reviewers run on locally-hosted, open-weight LLMs, keeping manuscript content within the journal infrastructure.
  The closest precedent, Shen et al., benchmarked five open-source LLMs on quartile classification of 200 manuscripts and found accuracy insufficient (35% exact-match) for autonomous use, supporting our decision to retain mandatory human adjudication. This transparent, human-supervised design offers a defensible alternative to today's opaque, unregulated AI use in peer review, potentially reducing the substantial delay of traditional review (avg. 13 weeks to first decision) without displacing human judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个三重盲法、多LLM预筛选的同行评审框架，用于正规化并披露AI在同行评审中的参与，同时保留人类审稿人作为最终决策权威。该框架在本地托管的开源LLM上运行三个AI审稿人，经过五个阶段（匿名化、并行AI预筛选、自动检查门、盲法人工评审、编辑裁决）处理投稿，以应对学术界日益增长的论文数量和AI秘密参与评审的现状。
AI.motivation: 学术同行评审压力剧增：NeurIPS 2025收到21,575篇投稿，且研究显示ICLR 2026约21%的评审完全由AI生成，超过一半有AI参与。现有问题包括幻觉引用和隐藏的提示注入指令操纵AI审稿人。同时，NIH/NSF禁止将未发表提案提交给第三方生成式AI，引发了保密性担忧。需要一个透明、规范、可披露AI参与且保护机密性的评审框架。
AI.method: 提出三重盲法多LLM预筛选框架，包含五个阶段：1) 清洗/匿名化；2) 并行AI预筛选（三个AI审稿人）；3) 自动检查门；4) 盲法人工评审；5) 编辑裁决。在检查和编辑阶段设置返回作者的循环。所有三个AI审稿人运行在本地托管的开源权重LLM上，确保稿件内容保留在期刊基础设施内。参考Shen等人的基准测试结果（35%精确匹配度不足以自主使用），保留强制性人工裁决环节。
AI.result: 该框架通过形式化AI参与、保持完全透明、在本地运行保护机密性，并依靠人工裁决确保最终判断权威，提供了对当前不透明、无规范AI使用的一种可辩护的替代方案。预计可减少传统评审的显著延迟（平均13周至首次决定），同时不取代人类判断。
AI.conclusion: 这个透明、人工监督的设计旨在解决同行评审中未披露的AI使用问题，为学术出版提供了一种可行且合规的中间路径——既利用LLM提高效率，又不放弃人类审稿人的最终决策权。

title: PIKFNO: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Physics Informed Kernel Function
summary: This work proposes a new interpretable neural operator framework, termed the Physics Informed Kernel Function Neural Operator (PIKFNO), which explicitly incorporates physics informed kernel functions derived from governing equations into the neural operator architecture. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which rely on deep networks to implicitly learn basis functions, PIKFNO constrains the trunk network through physics informed kernel functions, thereby aligning its operator structure with the kernel expansions used in meshless collocation methods. Two construction strategies are introduced: one learns kernel functions directly from data, where the learned kernel can be regarded as a nonsingular fundamental solution, while the other builds them through transformations of analytical fundamental solutions. Numerical experiments demonstrate that PIKFNO achieves high predictive accuracy with substantially improved interpretability and superior generalization under limited training data. The proposed framework offers a new pathway for developing efficient, physically consistent, and interpretable neural operators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的可解释神经算子框架——物理信息核函数神经算子（PIKFNO），通过将源自控制方程的物理信息核函数显式嵌入神经算子架构中，使算子结构与无网格配点法中的核展开对齐，在有限训练数据下实现高预测精度、强解释性和优越的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统神经算子（如DeepONet）依赖深度网络隐式学习基函数，导致模型缺乏可解释性，且在小样本数据条件下泛化能力有限。作者希望通过显式引入物理信息核函数来克服这些局限。
AI.method: PIKFNO框架包含两种核函数构建策略：(1)直接从数据中学习核函数，此时学习的核可视为非奇异基本解；(2)通过解析基本解的变换来构建核函数。该框架用物理信息核函数约束trunk网络，使其算子结构与无网格配点方法的核展开相一致。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，PIKFNO在有限训练数据下实现了高预测精度，同时显著提升了模型的可解释性和泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为开发高效、物理一致且可解释的神经算子提供了一条新路径。

title: Model-Free Based Computations of Recursive Control Barrier Function: Ultra-Local Model Approach
comment: 10 pages, 9 figures, submitted to Systems & Control Letters
summary: Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a systematic framework for enforcing safety constraints in nonlinear control systems. However, their implementation typically relies on accurate system models, which can limit their applicability in the presence of significant modeling uncertainties or unknown dynamics. This paper proposes a model-free framework for the computation of recursive control barrier functions based on the ultra-local model approach that leverages online estimation of the unknown system dynamics to construct CBF constraints. This approach does not require an explicit model of the system dynamics and enhances robustness with respect to disturbances and model mismatch. The resulting control architecture enables the enforcement as well as the anticipation of safety constraints for systems with higher relative degree. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is illustrated on the adaptive cruise control benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于超局部模型的无模型递归控制障碍函数（CBF）计算框架，通过在线估计未知系统动力学来构建CBF约束，无需显式系统模型，增强了对外部扰动和模型失配的鲁棒性，并在自适应巡航控制基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统CBF的实现依赖精确的系统模型，在存在显著建模不确定性或未知动力学时应用受限。为解决这一问题，需要开发不依赖精确模型的安全约束框架。
AI.method: 基于超局部模型（ultra-local model）方法，利用在线估计技术对未知系统动力学进行实时逼近，从而构建递归CBF约束。该方法不需要显式的系统动力学模型，能够处理具有较高相对度的系统的安全约束执行与预测。
AI.result: 在自适应巡航控制（ACC）基准测试上验证了所提出方法的有效性，证明了其在无模型条件下能够成功执行和预测安全约束。
AI.conclusion: 无模型CBF框架为解决存在不确定性和未知动力学场景下的安全控制提供了可行路径，兼顾了安全性保障与模型依赖性的降低，适用于更高相对度的系统。

title: Convolution Smoothed Quantile Regression for XGBoost
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures
summary: The increasing availability of large and complex datasets across many scientific disciplines has led to widespread adoption of machine learning (ML) for prediction. However, most ML algorithms focus on point estimation and provide limited information about predictive uncertainty or the conditional distribution of the response, restricting their ability to characterize rare or extreme outcomes. We develop QXGB, a quantile-based gradient boosting framework, and introduce a convolution smoothed loss within it that estimates conditional quantiles for constructing dense cumulative distribution functions (CDFs), exceedance probabilities, and tail behaviour relevant to extreme outcomes. This approach preserves the computational efficiency of extreme gradient boosting while restoring the Hessian information XGBoost relies on for tree splitting, in turn providing interpretable measures of extreme value and exceedance probability predictions. We derive the gradients and Hessians needed to integrate convolution smoothed quantile loss with different kernel specifications into XGBoost, and with simulated data, benchmark this approach against alternative smoothed quantile regression losses, the native quantile objective in the XGBoost Python package, and independent versus multi-output tree estimation. The practical relevance is illustrated in an application predicting fine particulate matter (PM$_{2.5}$) in northern California, including periods where levels were elevated due to wildfire smoke. Our results show that convolution smoothed QXGB, particularly when paired with multi-output trees, delivers accurate predictions with near-zero quantile crossing, well-calibrated CDF and exceedance probability estimates, and useful tail characterization for extreme values. Interval estimation is also evaluated as a measure of data spread.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了QXGB，一种基于分位数的梯度提升框架，通过引入卷积平滑损失来估计条件分位数，从而构建密集累积分布函数（CDF）、超越概率和尾部行为，用于刻画极端结果。该方法保留了XGBoost的计算效率，同时恢复Hessian信息用于树分裂，并在模拟数据和北加州PM2.5预测应用中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 大多数机器学习算法仅关注点估计，提供关于预测不确定性或响应条件分布的信息有限，难以刻画稀有或极端结果。作者希望开发一种既保持XGBoost计算效率，又能提供不确定性和极端值预测的方法。
AI.method: 开发QXGB框架，在梯度提升中引入卷积平滑损失估计条件分位数，用于构建密集CDF、超越概率和尾部行为。推导了将卷积平滑分位数损失（结合不同核函数）集成到XGBoost所需的梯度和Hessian，并比较了独立树与多输出树估计。
AI.result: 模拟数据基准测试显示，卷积平滑QXGB（尤其配合多输出树）提供准确预测，近零分位数交叉、校准良好的CDF和超越概率估计，以及有用的极端值尾部特征刻画。在预测北加州PM2.5（含野火烟雾导致的高浓度期）的应用中验证了实际相关性。
AI.conclusion: 卷积平滑QXGB是一种有效的框架，能在保持XGBoost计算效率的同时提供可靠的不确定性量化和极端值预测，适用于空气质量监测等需要刻画极端事件的实际场景。

title: From Doyle to AGM: A Survey and an Implementation Roadmap for Belief Change
comment: Author's accepted manuscript of an article published in The European Journal on Artificial Intelligence 2026 (SAGE). 65 pages, 2 figures. Final published version available at https://doi.org/10.1177/30504554261426170
summary: This paper presents a targeted narrative review establishing the historical and theoretical foundations for computational belief change implementation. Seeded by Doyle and London's foundational 1980 taxonomy, we trace the evolution of belief revision from computational origins through the theoretical transformation of the AGM framework to contemporary approaches. Our analysis demonstrates how pre-AGM computational pragmatism relates to AGM theoretical constructs, revealing both continuities and transformations across this evolution. We analyze how each taxonomical category evolved in the post-AGM era, identifying the theoretical foundations and historical precedents that inform contemporary implementation challenges. This foundation enables subsequent research into robust computational blueprints that synthesize historical insights with formal guarantees, providing the baseline for systematic implementation analysis and engineering-focused belief change research.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇针对性的叙事综述，以Doyle和London 1980年的分类法为起点，梳理了信念修正从计算起源、经过AGM框架理论转型到当代方法的演化历程，为计算信念变更的实现奠定历史与理论基础。
AI.motivation: 为计算信念变更的实现提供系统性的历史与理论基础，揭示从计算务实主义到AGM理论框架的演化脉络，识别当代实现挑战背后的理论渊源。
AI.method: 采用目标性叙事综述方法，以Doyle和London 1980年的分类法为种子，追踪信念修正从计算起源到AGM框架再到当代方法的演化，并分析每个分类类别在后AGM时代的演变。
AI.result: 展示了前AGM计算务实主义与AGM理论构造之间的关系，揭示了该演化过程中的连续性与转变，并为每一个分类类别在后AGM时代的演变提供了理论基础和历史先例分析。
AI.conclusion: 本综述为后续研究提供了基线，支持将历史洞见与形式化保证相结合的鲁棒计算蓝图研究，为系统化实现分析和工程导向的信念变更研究奠定基础。

title: Characterizing Rhetorical Misalignment in Decision-Making with Language Models
summary: Human decision-making is often shaped by a range of well-documented cognitive biases. As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly integrated into high-stakes human-AI decision-making, it is important to understand whether their outputs can amplify potential biases, how this influences human decisions, and crucially, whether it can lead to harmful consequences. In this work, we develop a decision-theoretic framework to study rhetorical misalignment, a failure mode where an LLM uses rhetorically inappropriate forms of presentation for a given decision context, thereby inducing suboptimal human decisions. We empirically investigate this phenomenon through a human-subject experiment in realistic clinical decision-making using a dataset curated from the United States Medical Licensing Examination. By measuring how LLM-generated information affects decisions, we observe that LLMs induce an average 2.81% rate of harmful decision flips across different models, where clinician participants change from a correct to an incorrect answer. Rationales reported by participants provide evidence that these revisions are closely related to the language used by LLMs that may induce different types of cognitive biases, including anchoring, authority bias, and loss aversion. To enable scalable evaluation, we instantiate our theoretical framework using decision-makers simulated by LLMs to computationally measure rhetorical misalignment. Our findings reveal a safety concern previously unrecognized in high-stakes domains: a model can be factually aligned yet still induce harm through its rhetorical presentation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM在人类-AI决策中的"修辞错位"现象——即LLM使用修辞不适当的呈现方式导致人类做出次优决策。通过临床试验（USMLE数据集）的人类受试者实验，发现LLM平均诱导2.81%的有害决策翻转，参与者报告显示这与锚定、权威偏见和损失厌恶等认知偏见有关。作者进一步用LLM模拟决策者以实现可扩展评估。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地融入高风险人机决策场景，确保它们的输出不会放大认知偏见并导致有害后果变得至关重要。现有研究多关注LLM的事实准确性，但忽视了其修辞呈现方式本身可能对人类决策产生的影响。
AI.method: 1) 建立决策理论框架来形式化"修辞错位"这一失败模式；2) 在USMLE数据集上开展真实医疗决策的人类受试者实验，测量LLM生成信息对决策的影响；3) 分析参与者报告的理性依据以识别认知偏见类型；4) 用LLM模拟决策者来实例化理论框架，实现可扩展的评估。
AI.result: LLM在不同模型上平均诱导2.81%的有害决策翻转（参与者从正确答案变为错误答案）；参与者报告的证据表明这些翻转与LLM语言诱导的锚定、权威偏见和损失厌恶等认知偏见密切相关。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了一个此前未识别的安全关切：一个模型即便在事实上对齐，仍可能通过其修辞呈现方式在高风险领域诱导人类伤害。因此，评估AI安全性不仅要看事实准确性，还必须考虑其修辞表达对人类决策的影响。

title: Self-fictitious-play for Potential Monotone Ergodic Mean-field Games
summary:
We investigate long-time learning in ergodic, potential, monotone mean-field games (MFGs) via a self-fictitious-play (SFP) dynamics coupling an optimally controlled diffusion with a slowly evolving belief. At each time, the state follows the optimal feedback associated with the current belief, while the belief is updated using the player's own empirical occupation measure rather than the population distribution. For ergodic monotone potential MFGs on the torus, we prove that the SFP dynamics is contractive and admits a unique invariant law. Moreover, we show that this invariant law is quantitatively close to the MFG Nash equilibrium, with an error of order equal to the square root of the belief-update rate.
  The proof combines uniform-in-time regularity estimates for the ergodic Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation with an energy argument based on the Lasry-Lions divergence. The linear-quadratic example shows that this rate is sharp, and the numerical experiments illustrate the predicted scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究遍历、势、单调平均场博弈（MFG）中的长时间学习问题，提出一种自虚构博弈（SFP）动力学：状态遵循当前信念对应的最优反馈，而信念通过玩家自身的经验占据测度而非群体分布来更新。作者证明在环面上的遍历单调势MFG中，SFP动力学是压缩的且存在唯一不变测度，该不变测度与MFG纳什均衡在数量上接近，误差阶为信念更新速率的平方根。证明结合了遍历哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程的一致时间正则性估计与基于Lasry-Lions散度的能量论证。线性二次例子表明该速率是尖锐的，数值实验验证了所预测的标度。
AI.motivation: 在平均场博弈中，研究玩家如何通过自身经验长期学习并收敛到纳什均衡，是连接博弈论与强化学习的重要问题。现有的虚构博弈方法通常假设玩家能观测到群体分布，而本文探讨仅依赖自身经验（自虚构博弈）的信念更新机制在长时间尺度下的行为，这更贴合实际场景中个体只能获取自身轨迹信息的情况。
AI.method: 作者提出自虚构博弈（SFP）动力学框架，其中信念通过玩家的经验占据测度缓慢更新。理论分析采用两步走：首先建立遍历哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程的一致时间正则性估计；然后利用Lasry-Lions散度构造能量论证，证明SFP动力学的压缩性和不变测度的存在唯一性，并量化不变测度与MFG纳什均衡的偏差。此外，通过线性二次模型分析速率尖锐性，并辅以数值实验验证。
AI.result: 证明了遍历单调势MFG中SFP动力学是压缩的，具有唯一不变定律；该不变定律与MFG纳什均衡的误差阶为信念更新速率的平方根；线性二次例子表明该平方根速率是尖锐的（不可改进）；数值实验验证了理论预测的标度关系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了自虚构博弈动力学在遍历MFG中长期学习的理论保证，表明即使玩家只依赖自身经验而非群体分布，仍能以平方根速率逼近纳什均衡。这为更现实的学习场景提供了理论基础，并揭示了信念更新速度与收敛精度之间的本质权衡。

title: Identifying Harm in Personalized, Generative AI Systems Requires User-Centered Auditing at the Interaction Level
comment: Ninth AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
summary: Personalized, generative AI systems increasingly adapt their behavior to individual users over time, fundamentally changing model behavior. While existing auditing approaches have been effective at surfacing harms in non-personalized contexts, they often rely on static, simulated evaluations and definitions of harm that aggregate across broad, group categories. In this position paper, we argue that such approaches can fail to capture emergent harms in personalized generative AI systems, where harms surface through interpretations of ongoing interaction and evolve with user history. We identify three presuppositions underlying many harm auditing paradigms: that harms can be (1) specified outside real-world interaction, (2) defined non-pluralistically within groups, and (3) treated as static. One might argue that personalized systems could simply learn definitions of what constitutes harm to individual users through repeated interactions. However, we argue that attempts to surface user harms through deeper personalization risk imposing asymmetric burdens of labor and privacy on marginalized users. Consequently, we propose reframing understandings of harm as adaptive, user- and community-centered processes, and outline design directions that shift auditing from retrospective evaluation toward infrastructures that support ongoing articulation of harm in interaction. Our work highlights the need for auditing and design practices that better reflect the pluralistic and evolving nature of harm understanding in personalized generative AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文（position paper），论证了现有审计方法无法捕捉个性化生成式AI系统中的涌现性危害，提出应将危害重新理解为自适应、以用户和社区为中心的过程，并将审计从回顾性评估转向支持交互中持续表达危害的基础设施。
AI.motivation: 现有AI审计方法基于静态、模拟的评估，以及在广泛群体类别上聚合的危害定义，这些方法在非个性化情境中有效，但在个性化生成式AI系统中失效——因为此类系统中的危害通过持续交互的解释浮现，并随用户历史演变。作者识别出当前审计范式的三大预设问题：(1)危害可在真实交互之外被具体化；(2)危害可在群体内被非多元地定义；(3)危害被视为静态的。此外，简单地让系统通过重复交互学习个体用户的危害定义，会对边缘化用户施加不对称的劳动和隐私负担。
AI.method: 作为立场论文，本文通过批判性论证识别并批判了主流危害审计范式的三个隐含预设，同时反驳了"更深个性化可学习个体危害定义"的替代方案，最后提出设计方向：将审计从回顾性评估转向支持交互中持续危害表达的基础设施，将危害视为用户和社区中心的自适应过程。
