For this, this paper introduces a universal ontology framework for the operational representation of intelligent cyber-physical power systems via a unified knowledge graph and an ontology capable of cross-domain reasoning. This work focuses on bridging cyber-physical simulators as a stepping stone towards that vision. By establishing a unified semantic middleware grounded in IEC 61970 (CIM) and IEC 62351/61850 standards, this framework integrates disparate cyber and physical simulation environments, illustrated via OMNeT++ and PowerWorld, into a single knowledge graph. Evaluation across three standard power system benchmarks demonstrates sub-linear scaling in both knowledge graph size and construction time. We further validate the framework's efficacy for real-time decision support, achieving millisecond-level query performance across both domains, maintained across six cumulative structural mutations to the knowledge graph. The resulting unified knowledge graph provides a robust, scalable information corpus for autonomous smart grid operations, enabling complex analysis of real-world power systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向智能网络物理电力系统的通用本体框架，通过统一知识图谱和跨域推理本体，基于IEC 61970 (CIM)和IEC 62351/61850标准构建语义中间件，将异构的网络物理仿真环境（OMNeT++和PowerWorld）集成到单一知识图谱中。在三个标准电力系统基准上的评估显示知识图谱规模和构建时间呈次线性扩展，查询性能达毫秒级，并在六次累积结构突变后仍保持稳定。
AI.motivation: 现代电力系统和智能电网由碎片化、异构的数据孤岛组成，缺乏跨域分析所需的凝聚力，阻碍了有效的跨域分析和智慧电网自动化运营。
AI.method: 引入基于IEC 61970 (CIM)和IEC 62351/61850标准的统一语义中间件，建立通用本体框架，通过知识图谱桥接网络域与物理域仿真环境（OMNeT++与PowerWorld），实现跨域推理和统一语义表示。
AI.result: 在三个标准电力系统基准上，知识图谱规模和构建时间呈次线性扩展；实时决策支持查询达毫秒级性能，且经过六次累积结构突变后性能保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的统一知识图谱为自主智能电网运营提供了健壮、可扩展的信息语料库，能够支持真实电力系统的复杂分析和跨域推理，是迈向智能网络物理电力系统通用表示的重要一步。

title: EMS Coreset: An Efficient Expectation-Maximization Algorithm for Sinkhorn Coreset
summary: Coresets distill large datasets into small, representative subsets for efficient downstream learning. Yet Optimal Transport (OT)-based selection typically requires intensive computation of transport plans, limiting scalability. We introduce a scalable Sinkhorn coreset method that permits closed-form updates of the entropically regularized OT coupling by allowing non-uniform coreset weights. This produces centroids that generalize k-means via soft assignments. We establish asymptotic consistency of the selected measure and Lipschitz stability to data perturbations, providing accuracy and robustness guarantees. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, the proposed method achieves competitive or improved approximation quality while substantially reducing runtime compared to Wasserstein- and standard Sinkhorn-based coreset selection, especially at large scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可扩展的Sinkhorn核心集方法，通过允许非均匀核心集权重实现熵正则化最优传输耦合的闭式更新，从而在不牺牲近似质量的前提下大幅降低核心集选择的计算开销。
AI.motivation: 基于最优传输（OT）的核心集选择方法通常需要密集计算传输计划，计算成本高昂，难以扩展到大规模数据集。
AI.method: 提出可扩展的Sinkhorn核心集方法：允许非均匀核心集权重，从而对熵正则化OT耦合进行闭式更新；产生质心以软分配方式泛化k-means；并建立所选测度的渐近一致性和对数据扰动的Lipschitz稳定性。
AI.result: 在合成和真实基准测试中，该方法在近似质量上达到竞争性或更优水平，同时相比Wasserstein和标准Sinkhorn核心集选择方法显著降低运行时间，尤其在大规模场景下优势明显。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的Sinkhorn核心集方法在保持准确性和鲁棒性保证的同时，成功解决了OT核心集选择的扩展性瓶颈，是一种高效、可扩展的核心集选择方案。

title: OGX: An Open-Source, Vendor-Neutral Generative AI Application Server
summary: OGX (Open GenAI Stack) is an open-source AI application server and Python library that implements the APIs of major frontier labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) with pluggable backend providers. Developers building agentic AI applications--such as retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, multi-turn agents, and tool-calling workflows--can develop against a single API surface and deploy with any combination of inference engine, vector database, and safety backend, without changing application code. OGX's primary focus is the Responses API for server-side agentic orchestration, conforming to the Open Responses specification. The server also supports the Anthropic Messages API and Google GenAI Interactions API, decoupling SDK choice from model and deployment decisions. With over 20 inference providers, 13 vector store backends, and a companion Kubernetes Operator for production deployment, OGX serves as the self-hosted, model-agnostic backend for AI-powered developer tools including Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, and OpenHands. The project has over 8,400 GitHub stars, 242 contributors, and 4,000 commits across nearly two years of public development.

AI.tldr: OGX是一个开源的AI应用服务器和Python库，实现了OpenAI、Anthropic、Google等前沿实验室的API，支持可插拔的后端供应商。开发者可以使用统一的API接口开发agentic AI应用，并自由组合推理引擎、向量数据库和安全后端，而无需修改应用代码。
AI.motivation: 开发者构建agentic AI应用（如RAG管道、多轮agent、工具调用工作流）时面临API碎片化和供应商锁定的问题。需要一个统一API表面来解耦SDK选择与模型及部署决策。
AI.method: OGX作为开源AI应用服务器，核心聚焦Responses API（符合Open Responses规范）用于服务端agentic编排，同时支持Anthropic Messages API和Google GenAI Interactions API。提供20+推理提供商、13个向量存储后端，并配有Kubernetes Operator用于生产部署。
AI.result: OGX已成为包括Claude Code、Codex CLI、OpenCode和OpenHands在内的AI开发者工具的自托管、模型无关后端。项目拥有超过8,400个GitHub星标、242位贡献者，以及在近两年公开开发中的4,000次提交。
AI.conclusion: OGX通过提供自托管的、模型无关的统一API后端，有效解决了多模型、多部署场景下的开发复杂性，已获得社区广泛采用和验证。

title: Prompting is not enough: supervised baselines and leakage control for measuring shared decision-making with LLMs in pediatric encounters
summary:
Objectives: To determine whether zero-shot prompting of a large language model (LLM) is sufficient to detect shared decision-making (SDM) behaviors in real clinical encounters, and whether supervised learning adds value under patient-grouped, nested evaluation.
  Methods: We analyzed 21 audio-recorded outpatient surgical decision encounters (19 unique patients; 7,566 utterance segments; ~6.1 hours) between families of children with multiple long-term conditions and their surgical providers. Trained coders labeled segments for 12 SDM behaviors (human-human macro Cohen's kappa = 0.695). We compared a zero-shot local LLM (Qwen 2.5 32B), a supervised classifier over frozen sentence embeddings, and their logistic stack, under patient-grouped outer folds with inner cross-fitted thresholds and patient-resampled confidence intervals.
  Results: The zero-shot LLM reached macro kappa = 0.139 (95% CI 0.111-0.164). The supervised classifier reached kappa = 0.227 (0.186-0.262), a paired improvement of 0.088 (0.051-0.119). A logistic stack of the two reached kappa = 0.242 (0.198-0.284). We identified multiple corpus-specific leakage paths, including grouping sibling recordings separately and allowing labels from an outer held-out patient to enter few-shot exemplars used while fitting downstream models.
  Conclusion: Zero-shot prompting alone is not sufficient to measure SDM behavior as reliably as a small supervised model, and patient-level grouping alone does not prevent leakage when labeled prompt exemplars are precomputed outside the outer evaluation loop. Reported performance is sensitive to the unit of data splitting and to where labeled exemplars enter the pipeline. External validation is needed before these findings generalize beyond this population, model, prompt, and codebook.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了零样本LLM提示在真实临床场景中检测共享决策（SDM）行为的有效性，并与监督学习方法在患者分组嵌套评估下进行比较。零样本LLM的宏kappa仅为0.139，监督分类器达到0.227，逻辑堆叠两者达到0.242。研究还揭示了多个语料特有的数据泄漏路径，表明患者级分组本身并不能完全防止泄漏。
AI.motivation: 共享决策（SDM）行为的自动化检测对临床质量评估具有重要意义，但现有方法在真实临床场景中的可靠性尚不清楚。作者希望检验零样本LLM是否足以胜任这一任务，并评估监督学习能否带来额外价值，同时关注评估过程中常见的数据泄漏陷阱。
AI.method: 分析21段门诊手术决策录音（覆盖19名患者，7,566个话语段，约6.1小时），由训练有素的编码员标注12种SDM行为（宏kappa=0.695）。比较三种方法：零样本本地LLM（Qwen 2.5 32B）、基于冻结句嵌入的监督分类器、以及两者的逻辑堆叠。采用患者分组的外层交叉验证、内层交叉拟合阈值及患者重采样的置信区间。
AI.result: 零样本LLM宏kappa=0.139（95% CI 0.111-0.164）；监督分类器kappa=0.227（0.186-0.262），配对提升0.088（0.051-0.119）；逻辑堆叠达到kappa=0.242（0.198-0.284）。识别出多个语料特有泄漏路径，包括兄弟姐妹录音的分组问题以及外层保留患者标签进入少样本示例的情况。
AI.conclusion: 零样本提示不足以可靠测量SDM行为，小型监督模型更为可靠。患者级分组本身无法防止所有泄漏；报告性能对数据分割单位和标注示例进入流程的位置高度敏感。研究结果需要在更广泛人群、模型、提示和编码手册中验证。

title: Adaptive Sampling Trust Region Optimization for Derivative-free Stochastic Functions and Deterministic Equality Constraints
summary: We study optimization problems with noisy zeroth-order objective observations and deterministic nonlinear equality constraints with available derivatives. We propose a constrained variant of the adaptive-sampling trust-region derivative-free optimization algorithm---ASTRO-DF. The method builds quadratic local models from estimated objective values at interpolation points within a moving trust region and promotes feasibility through a Byrd--Omojokun composite-step based on linearized constraints, following an SQP-like framework. We prove almost sure convergence using a new constrained criticality test and present numerical results on an equality-constrained stochastic activity network problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种带噪声零阶目标观测和确定性非线性等式约束的优化算法——ASTRO-DF的约束变体，该方法基于自适应采样信任区域和Byrd-Omojokun复合步，并证明了几乎必然收敛性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注无约束或不等式约束下的噪声零阶优化问题，但对带非线性等式约束的此类问题研究不足，且约束问题的收敛性分析较为困难。
AI.method: 在移动信任区域内，通过插值点估计目标函数值构建二次局部模型；采用Byrd-Omojokun复合步基于线性化约束促进可行性，遵循类似SQP的框架；提出新的约束临界性检验标准用于收敛性证明。
AI.result: 证明了几乎必然收敛性，并在等式约束的随机活动网络问题上给出了数值实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的约束ASTRO-DF算法能有效处理带确定性等式约束的噪声零阶优化问题，具备理论收敛保证和实际数值有效性。

title: Mitigating AI Risks in Computing Education via LLM-Driven Lecture Video Curation
comment: 7 pages, 3 tables, 1 figure
summary: This study evaluates the effectiveness of utilising large language models (LLMs) to retrieve targeted segments from delivered video recordings to answer student questions in introductory programming environments. By restricting AI to identifying existing, educator-verified media rather than generating open-ended text, this approach aims to mitigate common pedagogical risks such as generative hallucinations and cognitive bypassing. We benchmarked three distinct models, two proprietary (Gemini 3.1 Pro and GPT 5.4 Pro) and one open-weight (Qwen3.5 397B), against a human lecturer's manual video selections. An automated judging framework subsequently assessed the outputs for relevance, sufficiency, redundancy, and the presence of extraneous material. While the AI-retrieved timestamps rarely shared exact overlaps with the human baseline, the proprietary models achieved near-parity with the expert in delivering sufficient and highly relevant answers. Furthermore, a pilot deployment of this retrieval system in a large C programming cohort (n~=900) demonstrated strong user engagement, with students primarily utilising the tool to review foundational concepts. By leveraging AI to retrieve established lecture material, this approach shows potential for a reliable, high-fidelity pathway for safely integrating LLMs into novice computing courses.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了利用大型语言模型(LLMs)从已录制的教学视频中检索针对性片段来回答编程入门课程学生问题的方法。通过限制AI仅检索教师已验证的现有媒体而非生成开放式文本，规避了生成幻觉和认知捷径等教学风险。研究对比了三个模型（Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT 5.4 Pro和Qwen3.5 397B）与人类讲师手动视频选择的差异，发现专有模型在相关性和充分性上接近专家水平，并在约900人的C语言编程课程试点中展现了良好的用户参与度。
AI.motivation: 在编程入门教学中，学生常有问题需要解答，但直接让LLM生成开放式答案可能带来幻觉和认知捷径（学生不思考直接获取答案）等教学风险。现有视频资源中已包含教师验证过的讲解内容，如何安全、可靠地利用LLM帮助学生获取这些权威教育资源成为研究的出发点。
AI.method: 研究采用"检索而非生成"的策略，让LLM从课程视频中定位并返回相关时间戳片段来回答学生问题。实验对比了三个模型（Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT 5.4 Pro、Qwen3.5 397B）与人类讲师的手动视频选择基准，并使用自动化评判框架从相关性、充分性、冗余度和无关内容四个维度评估输出质量。此外，在约900人的C语言编程课程中进行了试点部署以评估用户参与度。
AI.result: AI检索的时间戳与人类基准很少完全重叠，但专有模型在提供充分且高度相关的答案方面达到了与专家近乎相当的水平。试点部署显示强大的用户参与度，学生主要使用该工具复习基础概念。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用AI检索既有已获教育界验证的教学材料，该方法展示了将LLM安全整合进编程入门课程的可靠、高保真路径，为在大规模教学中安全应用AI提供了可行方案。

title: BDIP-Net: Dual-Interaction Graph Learning for Property Prediction of Bilayer Materials
summary: Stacked bilayer materials exhibit rich stacking-dependent properties driven by the interplay between strong intra-layer bonding and weak inter-layer van der Waals interactions. The computational discovery of such materials is challenging because accurate structure generation typically relies on expensive DFT-based optimization, while existing machine-learning models often fail to explicitly distinguish different interaction types during property prediction. To address these challenges, we propose a machine-learning framework for efficient construction and property prediction of stacked bilayer materials. The framework employs a MatterSim-D3-based structural optimization workflow to generate DFT-quality bilayer structures from monolayer building blocks and stacking configurations at substantially reduced computational cost. For property prediction, we introduce BDIP-Net (Bilayer Dual-Interaction Potential Network), a graph neural network that explicitly models intra-layer and inter-layer interactions through interaction-specific potential representations and adaptive message fusion. We evaluate the proposed framework on BiDB, HetDB, and SAMBA, encompassing homobilayers, heterobilayers, and twisted bilayer systems. Results show that the MatterSim-D3-based workflow closely reproduces DFT-PBE-D3 optimized structures, while BDIP-Net consistently outperforms existing graph neural network and potential-based approaches for bilayer property prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个高效的机器学习框架，用于堆叠双层材料的构建与性质预测。该框架包含两部分：一是基于MatterSim-D3的结构优化流程，以低成本生成DFT质量的双层结构；二是提出BDIP-Net图神经网络，显式建模层内与层间交互，在多个数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 堆叠双层材料具有丰富的堆叠依赖性质，但计算发现面临两难：精确的DFT优化昂贵，而现有机器学习模型未能显式区分层内强键合与层间弱范德华力等不同交互类型，导致性质预测不准确。
AI.method: 1) 采用MatterSim-D3工作流从单层构建块和堆叠构型生成DFT质量的双层结构，大幅降低计算成本；2) 提出BDIP-Net（双层双交互势网络），这是一种图神经网络，通过交互特定的势表示和自适应消息融合，显式建模层内与层间交互。
AI.result: 在BiDB、HetDB和SAMBA数据集上（涵盖同质双层、异质双层和扭转双层系统），MatterSim-D3流程能紧密复现DFT-PBE-D3优化结构，BDIP-Net在双层性质预测上持续优于现有图神经网络和基于势的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的机器学习框架有效解决了双层材料计算发现中结构生成效率与性质预测精度之间的权衡，显式区分层内/层间交互的建模思路为多层材料性质预测提供了新范式。

title: Moving Horizon Estimation for Underwater Target Tracking Based on Time-Difference-of-Arrival Measurements
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. This work has been accepted to IFAC WC 2026 for publication
summary: There has been a flurry of activity in the development of robotic systems to localize and track underwater man-made or natural targets based on sparse acoustic data. Compelling examples include the development of surface tracking systems to aid in the navigation of groups of underwater vehicles performing environmental monitoring missions or to study the motion patterns of large underwater fauna. With current technology, the latter case can only be tackled using Time-Difference-of-Arrival (TDoA) techniques. Recent progress in nonlinear state estimation indicates that optimization-based methods may overcome the limitations of classical recursive filtering. However, achieving reliable estimator performance in the case of nonlinear target dynamics and sparse measurements remains a key challenge. In this paper, we study a Moving Horizon Estimation (MHE) approach to TDoA-based underwater target tracking. Through a 2D simulation environment capturing typical marine conditions, we show that the MHE-based estimator maintains reliable tracking in the considered scenarios even when the classical EKF becomes unreliable. The results highlight that multi-step trajectory coupling and physically consistent constraints, which are key advantages of the MHE approach, significantly enhance estimator robustness. It is shown that the MHE approach offers promise as a practical and scalable building block for future multi-agent tracking systems based on TDoA measurements operating in real underwater missions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于移动时差（TDoA）测量的水下目标跟踪问题，提出采用移动时域估计（MHE）方法替代经典扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF），通过2D仿真验证了MHE在稀疏观测和非线性目标动力学条件下相比EKF具有更可靠的跟踪性能和更强的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 水下目标跟踪中，基于声学数据的TDoA技术是目前跟踪大型水下生物等目标的唯一可行方案。然而，在非线性目标动力学和稀疏测量条件下，经典递归滤波方法（如EKF）的估计性能变得不可靠。因此需要探索优化类方法（如MHE）来克服经典方法的局限性。
AI.method: 采用移动时域估计（MHE）方法解决基于TDoA的水下目标跟踪问题。MHE充分利用多步轨迹耦合和物理一致性约束等优势，与经典的EKF递归滤波方法进行对比，并在模拟典型海洋环境的2D仿真场景中进行验证。
AI.result: 在2D仿真环境中，MHE在典型水下条件下能够保持可靠的目标跟踪性能，而经典的EKF在这些场景中变得不可靠。MHE的多步轨迹耦合和物理一致约束显著增强了估计器的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MHE方法为基于TDoA测量的水下目标跟踪提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案，有望成为未来多智能体水下跟踪系统的基础构建模块，适用于真实水下任务场景。

title: Coded Hankel Polynomial Chaos: Spectral Identification of Dominant Polynomial-Chaos Modes
summary: Identification of dominant polynomial-chaos modes is usually formulated as a sparse-regression problem on a sampled multivariate polynomial dictionary. We develop coded Hankel polynomial chaos (CH-PC), a complementary spectral formulation for dominant-mode identification. A finite generating transform converts PCE coefficients into a coefficient-generating polynomial, and evaluation along a geometric phase orbit produces a finite exponential sum. Its model order and spectral nodes are encoded by low-rank Hankel matrices, while coordinate phase shifts attach root-of-unity labels from which the full polynomial multi-indices are recovered. Coordinate-shifted probes are combined as common-node snapshots, and independent phase encodings provide redundant representations when a single spectral encoding is poorly conditioned. For finite observations, population, finite-data, and observed probes are kept distinct: sampling or quadrature error and observation error enter as separate Hankel perturbations, which are then connected to spectral stability, discrete decoding, and phase voting. For tensor-product candidate sets, the generating kernel factorizes into one-dimensional sums and can be evaluated without assembling the full multivariate PCE design matrix. Numerical experiments on sparse Legendre benchmarks and a stochastic Darcy problem illustrate exact recovery, noise stabilization, unknown-order identification by phase persistence, and dominant-mode recovery for a PDE-generated quantity of interest.

AI.tldr: 本文提出编码Hankel多项式混沌(CH-PC)方法，将PCE系数的稀疏回归问题转化为谱域求解：通过有限生成变换将PCE系数转化为系数生成多项式，沿几何相位轨道求值得到有限指数和，利用低秩Hankel矩阵编码模型阶数和谱节点，并通过坐标相位平移恢复完整多项式多重指标。数值实验在稀疏Legendre基准和随机Darcy问题上验证了精确恢复、噪声稳定性和未知阶数识别。
AI.motivation: 传统上，主导多项式混沌模式的识别被建模为在采样多元多项式字典上的稀疏回归问题，这类方法受限于设计矩阵的规模与病态性。作者希望发展一种互补的谱域求解框架，避免显式组装全多元PCE设计矩阵，同时实现对主导模式的精确、稳定识别。
AI.method: (1) 有限生成变换将PCE系数映射为系数生成多项式；(2) 沿几何相位轨道求值产生有限指数和，模型阶数与谱节点由低秩Hankel矩阵编码；(3) 坐标平移相位附加单位根标签以恢复完整多项式多重指标；(4) 坐标平移探针作为公共节点快照组合，独立相位编码为单谱编码病态时提供冗余表示；(5) 区分总体、有限数据和观测探针，采样/求积误差与观测误差作为分离的Hankel扰动；(6) 生成核因式分解为一维和，避免组装全PCE设计矩阵。
AI.result: 在稀疏Legendre基准测试和随机Darcy问题上，该方法实现了对PCE主导模式的精确恢复、噪声稳定性增强、基于相位持续性的未知阶数识别，以及PDE生成关注量的主导模式恢复。
AI.conclusion: CH-PC为PCE主导模式识别提供了一种有效的谱域替代方案，克服了传统稀疏回归方法在规模与病态性上的局限，尤其适用于张量积候选集和大规模PDE问题。

title: Euclid-Omni : A Unified Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Plane Geometry
summary: Euclidean geometry is a compelling testbed for AI reasoning, as it demands the combination of intuitive diagram understanding, axiomatic deduction, and algebraic computation. Yet, existing approaches typically address only a subset of these abilities or struggle with competition-level problems. We introduce \textit{Euclid-Omni}, a unified neuro-symbolic framework that couples a formal geometry system with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to tackle both calculation- and proving-style problems, in formal and natural languages, up to Olympiad-level difficulty. At its core, we develop \textit{Euclidea}, a versatile symbolic geometry solver that automatically generates reasoning steps through deductive inference and algebraic computation. Building on this, we develop a data-generation pipeline that synthesizes symbolic problems and solutions, renders diagrams, and translates them into natural language, producing large-scale, diverse datasets for training LLMs and VLMs across a wide range of reasoning settings. Experiments show that VLMs trained on our synthetic data achieve superior performance on calculation tasks, and that LLMs combined with \textit{Euclidea} are competitive with state-of-the-art systems on Olympiad-level proving problems, despite using orders of magnitude less compute and training data. Code and scripts are publicly available at https://github.com/20171130/Euclid-Omni

AI.tldr: 本文提出Euclid-Omni，一个统一的神经符号框架，结合形式化几何系统与LLM/VLM，用于解决奥林匹克级别的几何计算与证明问题。核心是Euclidea符号求解器，以及自动生成大规模合成数据集的pipeline。实验显示VLM在计算任务上表现优异，LLM结合Euclidea在证明任务上以极低算力成本达到SOTA水平。
AI.motivation: 欧几里得几何是AI推理的理想测试平台，因为它同时要求直观的图形理解、公理演绎和代数计算。然而现有方法通常只覆盖这些能力的一部分，或在竞赛级问题上表现不佳，缺乏一个统一的框架来同时应对计算和证明两类问题。
AI.method: 提出Euclid-Omni统一框架，包含两部分：1) Euclidea——通用的符号几何求解器，通过演绎推理和代数计算自动生成推理步骤；2) 数据生成pipeline——自动合成符号问题和解答、渲染图形、转换为自然语言，生成大规模多样化数据集用于训练LLM和VLM。
AI.result: 实验表明：1) 在合成数据上训练的VLM在计算任务上达到优越性能；2) LLM结合Euclidea在奥林匹克级证明问题上与最先进系统竞争力相当，且使用的计算资源和训练数据量少几个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Euclid-Omni证明了神经符号融合方法在几何推理中的有效性，以极低的资源消耗即可达到竞赛级推理能力，代码与数据已开源。

title: Beyond Tokens: A Survey on Decoding Methods for Large Language and Vision-Language Models
comment: ACM SIGKDD Explorations Newsletter, Volume 28, Issue 1
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated impressive generative capabilities, yet ensuring their outputs align with user intent is still challenging. While most existing approaches address this issue at the training stage, inference-time approaches like decoding methods offer a more efficient and scalable solution. Decoding methods control model generation by guiding token-level selection, performing sequence-level generation, or generating tokens in parallel to accelerate the process. In this survey, we identify three emerging paradigms from recent works on decoding methods for LLMs and LVLMs, provide a systematic review of these methods, highlight ongoing challenges, and discuss potential future research directions. Our goal is to underscore the efficiency and effectiveness of decoding methods and offer a practical view of their applications. Paper lists and more resources on decoding methods for LLMs and LVLMs can be found at https://github.com/wang2226/Awesome-LLM-Decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于大语言模型（LLMs）和大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）解码方法的综述论文，系统性地识别并总结了三种新兴的解码范式，旨在强调解码方法在模型部署阶段对齐用户意图方面的效率和有效性。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLMs和LVLMs展现出强大的生成能力，但确保输出与用户意图对齐仍然具有挑战性。大多数现有方法在训练阶段解决对齐问题，而推理阶段的方法（如解码方法）提供了更高效、可扩展的解决方案，但缺乏系统性综述。
AI.method: 作者从近期关于LLMs和LVLMs解码方法的研究中识别出三种新兴范式：（1）引导token级选择的解码方法；（2）执行序列级生成的解码方法；（3）并行生成token以加速过程的解码方法。论文对这些方法进行了系统综述，并提供了相关资源和论文列表。
AI.result: 论文识别并系统梳理了三种解码方法范式：token级引导、序列级生成和并行加速生成，展示了这些方法在效率和有效性方面的优势，同时指出了当前面临的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 解码方法为LLMs和LVLMs的输出对齐提供了高效且可扩展的推理阶段解决方案，但仍存在持续挑战，未来研究可进一步探索这些方法的完善与应用。

title: Dual-Thrust Switching Analytical Guidance Algorithm for Powered Landing with Attitude Smoothness Optimization
summary: Traditional numerical guidance methods for powered landing of reusable rockets are typically constrained by high computational complexity and inadequate real-time performance. Moreover, insufficient consideration of attitude smoothness often induces severe fluctuations in control commands; meanwhile, most existing approaches are tailored for single-thrust scenarios, failing to accommodate the guidance requirements of multi-engine thrust switching. To mitigate these limitations, this paper proposes an analytical guidance method optimized for attitude smoothness, which supports dual-thrust-mode switching. First, a corresponding optimal control problem is formulated, and it is theoretically proven that the optimal attitude command takes a concise piecewise cubic function form. This transforms complex trajectory optimization into a parametric analytical optimization problem, yielding a substantial improvement in computational efficiency. Further, a three-phase guidance framework is designed to enable adaptive determination of the guidance activation point and thrust switching point; when integrated with an aerodynamic correction strategy, this framework enhances the method's adaptability in complex flight environments particularly under high lift-to-drag ratio conditions. Simulation results demonstrate that the attitude command profile generated by the proposed method aligns closely with the theoretical optimal solution, with an ultra-short computation time, confirming its strong potential for online real-time implementation. Even under stringent conditions (e.g., limited thrust adjustment range, high lift-to-drag ratios, and parameter deviations), the method consistently achieves high-precision landing, showcasing promising prospects for engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向姿态平滑的解析制导方法，支持双推力模式切换，通过将轨迹优化转化为参数化解析优化问题，大幅提升计算效率，实现可重复使用火箭动力着陆的在线实时制导。
AI.motivation: 传统数值制导方法计算复杂度高、实时性差；姿态平滑性考虑不足导致控制指令剧烈波动；多数方法仅适用于单推力场景，无法满足多发动机推力切换的制导需求。
AI.method: 首先构建最优控制问题，理论证明最优姿态指令为简洁的分段三次函数形式，将复杂轨迹优化转化为参数化解析优化问题；进一步设计三阶段制导框架，实现制导激活点和推力切换点的自适应确定，并结合气动修正策略增强高升阻比等复杂飞行环境下的适应性。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，该方法生成的姿态指令剖面与理论最优解高度吻合，计算时间极短，具备在线实时实现潜力；在推力调节范围受限、高升阻比及参数偏差等严苛条件下仍能实现高精度着陆。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在计算效率、姿态平滑性和多推力模式适应性方面均具有显著优势，展现出良好的工程应用前景。

title: A Regulatory Placebo? The Systemic Failure of Mandatory GenAI Labeling
comment: 18 pages, 1 figures
summary: We examine the worldwide trend of mandatory labeling of generative artificial intelligence(GenAI) as a reactive, symbolic form of legislation triggered by technological panic and institutional responses. From a technical perspective, this study demonstrates that current mandatory labeling not only creates implementation dilemmas but also risks hindering the evolutionary trajectory of AI technology. We then systematically analyze the three dominant theoretical strands of this regime, the value dilution theory, the information authenticity theory, and the proactive regulation theory, and find that they are products of regulators' cognitive limitations in understanding the logic of modern technology. Not only do such formalistic compliance requirements become a regulatory placebo, but they also obscure the genuine legal demands of the technological era. This challenges the current governance paradigm and suggests a shift from identity-label governance to content governance, with an urgent need to address the complex problems associated with GenAI.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地审视了全球范围内生成式人工智能(GenAI)强制标注的立法趋势，认为这是一种由技术恐慌和制度反应驱动的象征性、反应性立法。作者指出强制标注不仅带来实施困境，还可能阻碍AI技术演进，并系统分析了支持该制度的三种理论（价值稀释论、信息真实性论、主动规制论）实为监管者对现代技术逻辑认知局限的产物。文章主张从身份标签治理转向内容治理。
AI.motivation: 当前全球掀起了对GenAI内容进行强制标注的立法浪潮，但作者认为这种立法形式存在根本性问题——它源于技术恐慌而非深思熟虑的治理设计，既无法实现预期目标，还可能产生负面效应。作者希望揭示这一制度的理论缺陷，并呼吁重新思考GenAI治理范式。
AI.method: 本文采用多维度分析方法：首先从技术角度考察强制标注的实施困境及其对AI技术演进的潜在阻碍；其次系统梳理并批判分析支撑该制度的三大理论流派（价值稀释理论、信息真实性理论、主动规制理论）；最后提出从身份标签治理向内容治理转型的替代性框架。
AI.result: 研究发现：强制标注制度在技术实施上存在难以克服的困境（如标注的可靠性、可规避性问题），并可能削弱AI技术本身的发展动力；支撑该制度的三种主流理论均为监管者认知局限的产物，无法为制度提供坚实理论基础；形式化的合规要求沦为"监管安慰剂"，反而掩盖了GenAI时代真正的法律需求。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为当前GenAI强制标注立法是一种失败或至少是无效的治理范式。建议治理范式应从"身份标签治理"转向"内容治理"，即不再关注"谁生成的内容"这一身份识别问题，而是直接针对内容本身的质量、真实性和法律合规性进行规制，从而更有效地应对GenAI带来的复杂挑战。

title: Training and Evaluating Ethical Reinforcement Learning Agents on Per-Episode Distributions
comment: 11 Pages, Under Review
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents trained on a single reward signal exploit the gap between the designed reward and the intended behavior. This is particularly a problem when we are trying to imbue ethical behavior into RL agents. An agent can look ethical on average while concentrating its violations in a few bad episodes, and a creature in the environment harmed in one episode is not restored by good conduct in another. We compare four ways of training ethical behavior in Craftax, an open-ended survival benchmark. The four are: scalar penalties with termination, a linear multi-objective weight sweep, an adaptive Lagrangian constraint, and a non-compensatory utility optimized per episode under the Expected Scalarized Returns (ESR) criterion. All are evaluated under a single detector-based protocol that counts every violation in every episode without censoring. On the frontier of mean return against mean violation rate, the four methods are indistinguishable; per episode they separate sharply. At matched mean return, the ESR agent holds its stated budget of one violation in effectively every episode (worst-decile 1.04 +/- 0.07 violations), the Lagrangian leaks past the same budget (1.14 +/- 0.03), and the weight sweep's worst episodes double it (2.20 +/- 0.20). An observation-augmentation control attributes the separation to the training objective rather than to what the agent observes, and the per-episode guarantee costs nothing on the mean frontier. When ethical violations do not average away across episodes, we argue both training and evaluation must target the per-episode distribution rather than the mean.

AI.tldr: 本文研究强化学习智能体在单一奖励信号下利用奖励漏洞产生不符合伦理行为的问题。在Craftax基准上比较四种训练伦理行为的方法，发现它们在平均性能上无法区分，但在每集（per-episode）分布上差异显著。其中ESR（预期标量回报）目标能在每集中严格控制违规数量，而其他方法会出现违规集中爆发。作者主张训练和评估都应关注每集分布而非平均值。
AI.motivation: RL智能体在单一奖励信号下会利用奖励设计与预期行为之间的差距，尤其在植入伦理行为时问题突出。一个智能体可能在平均上看起来道德，但违规行为集中在少数糟糕的片段中，且环境中被伤害的个体不会因其他片段的良好行为而恢复。因此单纯优化平均指标不足以确保伦理行为。
AI.method: 在Craftax（开放世界生存基准）上比较四种训练伦理行为的方法：(1)带终止的标量惩罚；(2)线性多目标权重扫描；(3)自适应拉格朗日约束；(4)基于期望标量回报（ESR）准则的每集非补偿效用优化。所有方法在统一的基于检测器的协议下评估，该协议计算每个片段的每次违规而不做删减。
AI.result: 在平均回报与平均违规率的前沿上，四种方法无法区分；但在每集层面差异明显。在匹配的平均回报下：ESR智能体在几乎所有片段中维持其承诺的1次违规预算（最差十分位1.04±0.07次），Lagrangian漏过同一预算（1.14±0.03），权重扫描的最差片段翻倍（2.20±0.20）。观测增强对照表明差异来自训练目标而非观测内容，且每集保证在平均前沿上没有代价。
AI.conclusion: 当伦理违规不能跨片段平均抵消时，训练和评估都必须针对每集分布而非平均值。ESR方法在保持平均性能的同时提供更强的每集伦理保证，是优于其他方法的伦理训练策略。

title: Rigidity-Aware Formation Tracking under Sensing Range Constraints via Single Control Barrier Function Constraint
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures
summary: This paper presents a control framework for formation tracking and rigidity maintenance in heterogeneous multi-robot systems with nonlinear dynamics under sensing range constraints. Since formation tracking alone does not ensure rigidity maintenance with a limited sensing range, despite rigidity being a prerequisite for establishing and preserving a unique formation, our work integrates both objectives through a single Control Barrier Function (CBF)-like constraint within a quadratic optimization framework. The proposed distributed controller requires only local relative information from neighbors, as verified with simulation case studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向异构多机器人系统的控制框架，在传感距离受限和非线性动力学条件下，通过单一CBF约束在二次优化框架中同时实现编队跟踪与刚性保持。
AI.motivation: 在多机器人系统中，编队跟踪本身并不能保证在有限传感范围下维持刚性（rigidity），而刚性是建立和保持唯一编队的前提条件。现有方法未能有效整合这两个目标。
AI.method: 通过单个类似控制障碍函数（CBF）的约束，在二次优化（QP）框架中同时整合编队跟踪与刚性保持两个目标。控制器为分布式设计，仅需邻居的局部相对信息。
AI.result: 通过仿真案例研究验证了所提出分布式控制器的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架能够在传感范围约束下同时实现异构多机器人系统的编队跟踪和刚性保持，且控制方案是分布式的，仅依赖局部相对信息。

title: LiD-GLM: Lipschitz-constrained Deep Generalized Linear Models
comment: 23 pages, 14 figures
summary: The combination of traditional statistical models and neural network (NN) components into semi-structured hybrid models is an intriguing approach to construct models that, ideally, combine traditional interpretability with the unprecedented flexibility of NNs. In order to preserve interpretability, it is usually necessary to restrict the NN components to prevent them from dominating the model. However, existing methods that enforce structural constraints on their NN components severely limit their models' flexibility; in contrast, methods that only enforce weak, indirect constraints lose meaningful interpretability. The method we propose therefore leverages invertible residual neural networks (i-ResNets) to equip generalized linear models with both nonlinear parameter estimation and a flexible correction of their distributional assumptions while always retaining stochastic monotonicity of the modeled distribution in the (formerly linear) predictor. The i-ResNets correspond to a controlled deviation from identity and by constraining their Lipschitz constant one can rigorously limit and quantify how far the hybrid model deviates from its traditional counterpart. This enables a user-specifiable compromise between flexibility and interpretability without limiting the structure of nonlinear and interaction effects that can be learned. Furthermore, we develop specific inherent interpretation techniques for our model and enforce model identifiability through an adapted post-hoc orthogonalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用可逆残差神经网络（i-ResNets）增强广义线性模型的半结构化混合建模方法，在保持随机单调性的同时实现非线性参数估计和分布假设的灵活修正，并通过约束Lipschitz常数来量化和控制模型与传统模型的偏差，从而在灵活性和可解释性之间提供用户可调的折衷方案。
AI.motivation: 传统统计模型与神经网络混合的建模方法旨在兼顾可解释性与灵活性，但现有方法存在两难困境：对NN组件施加严格结构约束会严重限制模型灵活性，而仅施加弱间接约束则会失去有意义的可解释性。
AI.method: 利用可逆残差神经网络（i-ResNets）增强广义线性模型：i-ResNets对应从恒等映射的可控偏离，通过约束其Lipschitz常数来严格限制和量化混合模型与传统模型的偏差；保留建模分布在（原线性）预测变量中的随机单调性；开发针对该模型的固有解释技术，并通过适配的后验正交化确保模型可辨识性。
AI.result: 该方法在不限制可学习的非线性和交互效应结构的前提下，实现了灵活性与可解释性之间的用户可指定折衷方案，并提供了相应的解释工具与模型可辨识性保证。
AI.conclusion: 该混合建模方法通过i-ResNets为广义线性模型赋予了非线性参数估计能力和分布假设修正能力，同时通过Lipschitz约束确保了模型偏离程度的可控性和可量化性，为统计可解释性与神经网络灵活性的结合提供了一种新的解决方案。

title: An Agentic Framework Using Rules and LLMs for Embedding and Annotating Descriptive Document Layouts: A Plant Science Use Case
summary: Background: Recent advances in information retrieval (IR) leverage both dense and sparse representations, large language models (LLMs), and specialized retrieval models to improve ranking accuracy, relevance, and cross-lingual performance. Complementary techniques such as passage indexing, document layout analysis, and semantic knowledge representation further enhance retrieval effectiveness by capturing fine-grained contextual and structural information. Emerging agentic LLM frameworks extend these capabilities by enabling planning, iterative reasoning, tool use, and multi-agent collaboration, thereby broadening applications across diverse domains. These frameworks also emphasize rigorous evaluation, ethical considerations, and trustworthiness, ensuring responsible deployment in real-world settings. We propose a modular, agent-based pipeline for botanical trait extraction. Optical character recognition (OCR) converts PDFs into machine-readable text, while segmentation and indexing organize content by genus and species. Rule-based parsers extract structured botanical traits, and ensembles of large language models (LLMs) expand trait vocabularies and resolve ambiguities. This approach ensures accurate species recognition, scalable annotation, and explainable integration of textual botanical descriptions, enabling robust and interpretable data extraction across large botanical corpora. Results: Using three regional botanical datasets, our system extracted 55,737 trait annotations across 4,961 species, averaging 9.1 traits per species. Integration of LLM-based enrichment improved coverage for 75% of traits, increasing total annotations by 59%. While the choice of OCR engine had a minor effect on species recognition, overall annotation counts remained stable, demonstrating the robustness, scalability, and reliability of the pipeline for large-scale botanical trait extraction.

AI.tldr: 提出一个模块化、基于代理的流水线用于植物性状提取。利用OCR将PDF转换为机器可读文本，通过分割和索引按属种组织内容，规则解析器提取结构化植物性状，LLM集成扩展性状词汇并解决歧义。在三个区域植物数据集中提取了55,737条性状注释，覆盖4,961个物种，LLM增强使75%的性状覆盖率提高，总注释量增加59%。
AI.motivation: 传统信息检索和提取方法在处理大规模植物学文本语料时面临挑战，需要一种能够准确识别物种、可扩展注释、且可解释地整合文本植物学描述的方法，以实现大规模植物性状数据的稳健提取。
AI.method: 采用模块化、基于代理的流水线方法：(1) OCR将PDF转换为机器可读文本；(2) 分割和索引按属种组织内容；(3) 规则解析器提取结构化植物性状；(4) LLM集成扩展性状词汇并解决歧义。该方法确保了准确的物种识别、可扩展的注释和可解释的植物学描述整合。
AI.result: 在三个区域植物数据集中提取了55,737条性状注释（4,961个物种，平均每物种9.1个性状）。LLM增强使75%的性状覆盖率提高，总注释量增加59%。OCR引擎选择对物种识别影响较小，整体注释数保持稳定，证明了流水线的稳健性、可扩展性和可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线在大规模植物性状提取中表现出色，兼具稳健性、可扩展性和可靠性，为大规模植物语料的解释性数据提取提供了有效解决方案。

title: Beyond the pale: Assessing prevalence and contents of extremist speech in LLM training data
comment: Accepted to the CPSS workshop @ KONVENS 2026
summary: Despite a strong interest on the part of the research community in the topic of trustworthy and safe AI, the composition of the text corpora that large language models (LLMs) encounter in pre- and post-training has not yet drawn much attention. In this work, we address the question of whether LLMs are exposed to unfiltered, uncontextualised extremist speech. Using several definitions of extremist speech, stemming from official documents and research literature, and an extraction pipeline combining automated text processing with expert verification, we provide a lower bound on the prevalence of extremist documents in Dolma, an open training corpus underpinning the OLMo series of models. We show that Dolma is likely to include hundreds of thousands of documents containing extremist content and hate speech of several types, including direct calls for violence, and discuss the implications of this for data curation and model pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）训练语料库中是否包含未经过滤的极端主义言论。通过在Dolma开放训练语料库上应用基于官方文件和文献的多种极端主义定义，结合自动化文本处理与专家验证的提取流程，发现该语料库中可能存在数十万份包含极端主义内容和多种仇恨言论的文档，包括直接的暴力呼吁，并讨论了这对数据策展和模型预训练的影响。
AI.motivation: 尽管研究社区对可信、安全的AI兴趣浓厚，但LLM在预训练和后训练阶段所接触的文本语料库组成尚未引起足够关注。作者希望回答LLM是否会接触到未经过滤、未语境化的极端主义言论这一关键问题。
AI.method: 采用多种源于官方文档和研究文献的极端主义定义，构建了一个结合自动化文本处理与专家验证的提取流水线，对Dolma开放训练语料库进行极端主义文档的检测与统计，提供极端主义文档流行率的下界估计。
AI.result: Dolma语料库很可能包含数十万份含有极端主义内容和多种类型仇恨言论的文档，其中包括直接的暴力呼吁。研究给出了极端主义文档在语料库中的流行率下界。
AI.conclusion: 训练语料库中存在大量未经过滤的极端主义内容，这对数据策展和模型预训练具有重要影响，凸显了在训练数据选择和处理过程中需要更加重视此类内容的筛选与治理。

title: On the Complexity of BFGS Method for Smooth Convex Optimization
summary: We study the BFGS method with an Armijo-Wolfe line search for minimizing convex functions with Lipschitz-continuous gradients, without assuming strong convexity. We establish a global iteration complexity bound of $\mathcal{O}(k^{-1/2})$ for the smallest gradient norm among the first $k$ iterates. Moreover, when the initial sublevel set is bounded, we show that the function value gap converges at a rate of $\mathcal{O}(k^{-1})$. Our analysis leverages the classical trace-log-determinant potential function and reveals that a key inequality underlying this potential function remains valid without strong convexity.

AI.tldr: 研究了不假设强凸性的BFGS方法（配合Armijo-Wolfe线搜索）在凸函数最小化中的全局迭代复杂度，建立了梯度范数最小的O(k^{-1/2})复杂度界，并在有界次水平集条件下证明了函数值间隙以O(k^{-1})速率收敛。
AI.motivation: 以往对BFGS方法的收敛性分析通常依赖于强凸性假设，但实际应用中许多凸函数并不满足强凸条件。作者希望在不假设强凸性的更一般凸函数设定下，分析BFGS方法的全局迭代复杂度。
AI.method: 利用经典的trace-log-determinant势函数进行分析，揭示了该势函数所依赖的关键不等式在缺少强凸性时仍然成立，从而将BFGS的复杂度分析推广到一般凸函数情形。
AI.result: 建立了两个主要结果：(1) 前k次迭代中最小的梯度范数以O(k^{-1/2})速率收敛到零；(2) 当初始次水平集有界时，函数值间隙以O(k^{-1})速率收敛。
AI.conclusion: BFGS方法配合Armijo-Wolfe线搜索在一般凸函数（无需强凸性）上仍具有良好的全局收敛速率，其复杂度保证与强凸情形下的已知结果相对应。

title: Characterizing Agentic Flooding of Government Services
comment: To appear in the proceedings of the 9th AAAI Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES), October 12-14, 2026
summary: AI agents are making it easier for the public to interact with government, such as by helping them apply for benefits, understand complex policies, and make their opinions heard. Although improving service accessibility is beneficial, any resulting surges in demand could strain unprepared government services. We term such surges agentic flooding of government services ("flooding") and provide three contributions. First, based on a collected dataset of 84 potential cases of flooding across 11 jurisdictions, we posit that flooding is likely occurring widely today, mostly through large language models (LLMs) generating text cheaply. Second, we evaluate what services are most exposed to flooding. We develop a risk matrix to analyze a service's exposure, and suggest that near-term risk is highest for financially attractive, but complex services. Finally, we map possible government responses to flooding. Precedent suggests these responses will likely be sufficient to stop most cases of flooding, but the fastest to deploy - friction-inducing measures like fees - often trade off equitable access to public services. Accordingly, we close by recommending near-term actions that may allow governments to mitigate flooding without invoking this trade-off.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次提出"AI代理洪泛"（agentic flooding）概念，指AI代理大规模使用政府服务导致的需求激增现象。作者基于11个司法管辖区84个潜在案例，指出该现象已广泛发生，主要源于LLM低成本生成文本。论文通过风险矩阵评估服务暴露程度，发现财务吸引力强但复杂的服务风险最高。同时映射政府应对措施，指出摩擦性手段（如收费）虽见效快但会损害服务公平性，最后提出既缓解洪泛又不损害公平的近期行动建议。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理使公众与政府交互更加便捷（如申请福利、理解政策、表达意见），虽然提升了服务可及性，但由此可能引发需求激增，使未准备好的政府服务不堪重负。研究者希望系统性地识别、评估和应对这一新兴但尚未被充分研究的问题。
AI.method: 论文采用三部分研究路径：1）通过收集11个司法管辖区共84个潜在案例构建数据集，实证分析洪泛现象的发生现状与机制；2）开发风险矩阵工具来评估不同政府服务对洪泛的暴露程度；3）基于先例系统性地梳理并映射政府可能的应对措施及其权衡。
AI.result: 研究发现：洪泛现象目前已在各地广泛发生，主要通过LLM低成本生成文本实现；短期内风险最高的是财务吸引力强但流程复杂的服务；基于先例，政府现有应对措施大多足以阻止洪泛，但最快见效的措施（如收费等摩擦性手段）往往以牺牲公共服务公平获取为代价。
AI.conclusion: 论文呼吁政府采取既能缓解AI代理洪泛、又不损害公共服务公平性的近期行动，避免在效率与公平之间被迫做出取舍。

title: DUET: Dual-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Same-Weight Disagreement for Prohibition Compliance
summary: Real-world LLM deployments increasingly rely on runtime-injected prohibitions--enterprise policies, PII redlines, tool boundaries--that vary per request and per tenant. Conventional post-training is structurally ill-suited: SFT hides the violation signal in compliant labels, and DPO's sequence-level preferences mismatch token-localized violations. We propose DUET, a token-selective on-policy distillation method for prohibition compliance. DUET pairs a teacher that sees the prohibition (positive) with an identical-weight teacher that does not (negative). Because the two teachers differ only in prohibition visibility, their per-token disagreement isolates the prohibition's causal effect--yielding a clean supervision signal uncontaminated by model capacity or mismatch. This disagreement drives two complementary mechanisms: signal cleaning, which discards agreement tokens as redundant or prefix-corrupted, and preference-directed learning, which pushes the student away from the negative teacher and toward the positive one at token granularity, embedding DPO-style optimization directly into OPD without offline preference data. We construct an industrial Prohibition-Compliance benchmark spanning five task families covering explicit-refusal, paraphrase robustness, and over-refusal. Across 1.5B-8B Qwen variants, DUET achieves 72.3-85.2% violation compliance while preserving 88-93% normal utility, dramatically outperforming teacher model and other distillation baselines. External evaluation on SysBench confirms improved safety alignment with minimal degradation on GSM8K and MATH-500.

AI.tldr: DUET是一种令牌选择性的在线策略蒸馏方法，用于处理LLM部署中的禁令合规问题。它通过一对仅在禁令可见性上不同的教师模型（一个看到禁令、一个看不到），利用它们的分词级分歧作为监督信号，结合信号清洗和偏好导向学习两个机制，在1.5B-8B Qwen模型上实现了72.3-85.2%的违规合规率，同时保持88-93%的正常效用。
AI.motivation: 现实世界LLM部署中存在运行时注入的禁令（企业策略、PII红线、工具边界），这些禁令随请求和租户变化。传统的后训练方法不适用：SFT将违规信号隐藏在合规标签中，而DPO的序列级偏好与令牌局部化的违规不匹配。
AI.method: DUET采用令牌选择性在线策略蒸馏方法。核心思路是构建一对权重相同的教师模型，区别仅在于是否看到禁令（正负教师）。两者的分词级分歧隔离了禁令的因果效应，提供干净的监督信号。该方法包含两个互补机制：(1)信号清洗——丢弃冗余或前缀损坏一致的令牌；(2)偏好导向学习——在令牌粒度上将学生从负教师推向正教师，将DPO风格优化直接嵌入在线策略蒸馏，无需离线偏好数据。
AI.result: 在工业级禁令合规基准（涵盖五个任务族：显式拒绝、释义鲁棒性、过度拒绝）上，DUET在1.5B-8B Qwen变体上达到72.3-85.2%的违规合规率，同时保持88-93%的正常效用，大幅优于教师模型和其他蒸馏基线。在SysBench外部评估上，安全对齐得到改善，且GSM8K和MATH-500仅有极小降级。
AI.conclusion: DUET通过利用禁令可见性的因果对比，提供了一种无需离线偏好数据即可实现令牌粒度上的禁令合规学习的方法，在工业环境中展示了良好的合规性和效用保持平衡。

title: Improving Observability of Relative Orbit Estimation Using Bearing Measurements and Light Curves
comment: 33 pages. Accepted for publication in Journal of Space Safety Engineering
summary: Relative orbit estimation using optical observations is a key technology for on-orbit servicing missions. In the far-range phase, the target appears as an unresolved point source, providing only bearing angles (azimuth and elevation) from the servicing satellite. Angles-only navigation is inherently challenging due to the weak observability of the relative range. To address this limitation, this study investigates the effectiveness of an estimation scheme that fuses photometric light curve data with bearing measurements. Since the light intensity depends on the relative distance, fusing light curves enhances the observability of the relative state. The Ashikhmin-Shirley model is used as the optical reflectance model, and observability analysis is conducted with the Fisher information matrix. Numerical simulations involving different target geometries, a flat plate and a box-wing satellite, demonstrate that integrating light curve measurements significantly enhances observability and enables faster convergence compared to conventional state estimation methods.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出将光度光变曲线数据与方位角测量融合的估计方案，以解决仅角度导航中相对距离可观测性弱的难题。通过Fisher信息矩阵进行可观测性分析，并使用Ashikhmin-Shirley反射模型，仿真实验表明该融合方法显著增强了可观测性并加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 在轨服务任务中，远距离阶段目标呈现为不可分辨点源，仅能提供方位角测量。然而仅角度导航面临相对距离可观测性弱的固有挑战，需要寻找增强可观测性的方案。
AI.method: 提出将光度光变曲线数据与方位角测量融合的估计方法。光强度依赖于相对距离，因此融合光变曲线可增强相对状态的可观测性。采用Ashikhmin-Shirley光学反射模型，并利用Fisher信息矩阵进行可观测性分析。通过平板和箱翼卫星两种目标几何构型进行数值仿真验证。
AI.result: 数值仿真表明，融合光变曲线测量显著增强了相对状态的可观测性，并且相比传统状态估计方法实现了更快的收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: 光变曲线与方位角的融合估计方案是解决仅角度导航可观测性不足问题的有效手段，可为在轨服务任务的远距离接近阶段提供更可靠的相对轨道估计。

title: Improved Regret Analysis for Parallel Gaussian Process Bandit Optimization
comment: 25 pages, 1 figure
summary: This paper studies the regret analysis for parallel Gaussian process (GP) bandit optimization. The known regret upper bounds for the widely used GP batched upper confidence bound and GP batched Thompson sampling (GP-BTS) suffer from a multiplicative factor with respect to the batch size $Q$. To avoid this degradation, existing analyses require a polynomial number of uncertainty sampling (US) for $Q$ at the beginning of optimization. However, this initial US phase is often ineffective in practice. This paper shows that the regret upper bound without the multiplicative factor on $Q$ can be achieved without the initial US phase, using GP-BTS as an example. Furthermore, we show much better regret upper bounds in the noiseless setting than in the noisy setting, as in the sequential GP bandit setting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了并行高斯过程（GP）bandit优化中的遗憾分析问题。针对现有的GP批量上置信界和GP批量汤普森采样（GP-BTS）算法遗憾上界中存在的批量大小Q的乘法因子退化问题，本文展示了无需初始不确定性采样（US）阶段即可消除该因子，并以GP-BTS为例进行了验证。此外，作者还证明在无噪声设置下可获得比有噪声设置更好的遗憾上界，这与顺序GP bandit设置中的结论一致。
AI.motivation: 现有的GP批量bandit优化算法（如GP-batched UCB和GP-BTS）的遗憾上界中存在与批量大小Q成比例的乘法因子，导致性能退化。虽然已有方法通过在优化初期引入多项式数量的不确定性采样（US）来避免这一退化，但该初始US阶段在实践中往往效率低下，因此需要寻找无需该阶段即可消除Q因子退化的方法。
AI.method: 以GP-BTS算法为研究对象，通过改进的理论分析证明了在不进行初始不确定性采样阶段的情况下，仍可获得不包含Q乘法因子的遗憾上界。同时，本文分别分析了无噪声和有噪声两种设置下的遗憾上界，展示了无噪声设置下更好的理论保证。
AI.result: 证明了无需初始US阶段即可消除遗憾上界中对批量大小Q的乘法因子依赖；在无噪声设置下获得了比有噪声设置更优的遗憾上界，与顺序GP bandit设置中的结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 本文推进了并行GP bandit优化的理论理解，消除了批量大小导致的遗憾退化因子，同时避免了效率低下的初始US阶段，并在无噪声场景下展现了更优的理论保证。

title: The Hallucination Snowball: Modeling Error Propagation as State Transitions in Multi-Agent LLM Pipelines
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures; accepted at the FAGEN Workshop (Failure Modes in Agentic AI), ICML 2026
summary: Sequential multi-agent LLM pipelines chain specialized agents without verification at handoffs, creating a structural flaw with measurable and severe consequences. We show that hallucinations injected at Stage 1 do not merely persist; they transform: raw numerical facts become derived computations, then narrative prose, then editorially approved conclusions. At each transformation, detectability degrades near-irreversibly. We formalize this as the hallucination snowball effect, a first-order Markov process over four states (Raw Fact $\to$ Derived $\to$ Narrative $\to$ Invisible) with empirically measured per-boundary escape probabilities of 24.6%, 48.3%, and 89.3%. Across 346 automatically injected hallucinations in a 4-agent financial analysis pipeline on FinanceBench, gpt-4o detection drops from 72.0% at Stage 1 to 50.9% at Stage 4, and 23.7% of hallucinations survive completely undetected in the final output. Even the strongest model tested (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, 87.0% at Stage 1) faces a structural ceiling; projected Stage 4 detection is only ${\sim}$60--65%. Critically, boundary gates using identical RAG verification tools reduce hallucination survival from 58.4% to 16.2% versus end-of-pipeline checking (Cohen's $h = -0.911$, $p < 0.000001$), while end-checking alone achieves merely 2.3 pp improvement over no verification. When you verify matters more than whether you verify. Our model predicts survival for $n$-agent linear pipelines and prescribes optimal verification resource allocation: invest at $S_1{\to}S_2$ first, where 75.4% of hallucinations are still catchable, not at $S_3{\to}S_4$ where 89.3% have already escaped.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了顺序多智能体LLM流水线中幻觉的"雪球效应"：幻觉在阶段间转换（原始事实→派生计算→叙事散文→编辑认可结论），可检测性逐级退化。通过马尔可夫模型量化跨界逃逸概率（24.6%、48.3%、89.3%），并提出在S1→S2投入验证资源比在流水线末端检查更有效（存活率从58.4%降至16.2%，而末端检查仅提升2.3个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 现有顺序多智能体LLM流水线在智能体交接处缺乏验证机制，导致幻觉不仅持续存在，还会在多次转换中"演变"并变得难以检测。需要形式化这一过程并给出最优验证策略。
AI.method: 将幻觉传播形式化为四状态一阶马尔可夫过程（Raw Fact→Derived→Narrative→Invisible），在FinanceBench上构建4智能体金融分析流水线，注入346个幻觉并测量各阶段转换的逃逸概率，对比边界门控验证与末端检查的效果差异。
AI.result: gpt-4o检测率从Stage 1的72.0%降至Stage 4的50.9%，23.7%的幻觉完全幸存。边界验证将幻觉存活率从58.4%降至16.2%（Cohen's h=-0.911, p<0.000001），而末端检查仅提升2.3个百分点。75.4%的幻觉在S1→S2仍可捕获，S3→S4时89.3%已逃逸。
AI.conclusion: 验证时机比验证本身更重要。最优资源分配应集中在早期阶段边界（S1→S2），而非流水线末端。该模型可预测n智能体线性流水线的幻觉存活率并指导验证资源分配。

title: Writing Style Similarity Reflects Academic Genealogy
summary: As authorship attribution systems are increasingly deployed to detect ghostwritten and AI-generated papers, their errors can support accusations against legitimate authors. These systems assume each author's style is their own. Researchers, however, study under advisors, and inherit their stylistic quirks. We build a corpus of arXiv authors with $\geq 2$ solo papers from the Mathematics Genealogy Project graph, giving $5{,}803$ total authors and $2{,}501$ ground-truth advisor-student pairings. Using embeddings from a fine-tuned model, advisors sit $39.9\%$ closer in cosine distance to their students than a random same-field author does. Two open encoders reproduce the effect at $12.6\%$ and $14.5\%$. \emph{Academic siblings}, two students of one advisor who may never have met, sit $30.4\%$ closer across $8{,}360$ pairs, even when they studied at different institutions. Pairs who share only an institution and a field show negligible similarity. Given a closed-set attribution task over the same corpus, the system's errors occur on the true author's advisors and academic siblings $11$ times more often than chance.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含5,803位arXiv作者及2,501对导师-学生关系的语料库，发现导师与学生的写作风格在嵌入空间中比随机同领域作者更接近（39.9%），学术同门（同一导师的不同学生）之间也显著相似（30.4%），即使他们从未在同一机构学习过。这种风格继承效应导致作者归属系统在真实作者是导师或学术同门时发生错误的概率比随机高11倍。
AI.motivation: 作者归属系统被用于检测代写和AI生成论文，但其基本假设是"每位作者的风格属于自己"。然而研究者受导师指导，会继承导师的风格特征，这可能导致系统误判无辜的作者。作者希望通过实证分析揭示这一系统性偏差及其对归属系统可靠性的影响。
AI.method: 从Mathematics Genealogy Project构建arXiv作者语料库（≥2篇独立作者论文），获得5,803位作者和2,501对真实的导师-学生配对。使用微调模型的嵌入表示，通过余弦距离度量导师-学生、学术同门、仅共享机构和领域的配对之间的风格相似度，并在封闭集归属任务中分析错误的分布模式，同时用两个开源编码器进行复现验证。
AI.result: 导师与学生间余弦距离比随机同领域作者近39.9%（两个开源编码器复现为12.6%和14.5%）；学术同门（8,360对）之间近30.4%，即使他们在不同机构学习；仅共享机构和领域的配对相似性可忽略不计；归属系统的错误发生在真实作者是导师或学术同门的概率比随机高11倍。
AI.conclusion: 导师-学生关系和学术同门关系在写作风格上存在显著的、可检测的相似性，这种"风格继承"效应会严重干扰作者归属系统的判断，导致对无辜研究者的误标。这对作者归属系统的实际部署提出了警示：其错误并非随机的，而是系统性偏向于将作者误判为与其有学术亲缘关系的人。

title: Mean-Field Oscillator Ising Machines: Gradient Flows and Classification of Limit Solutions
comment: 31 pages, 5 figures
summary: Oscillator Ising Machines (OIMs) have emerged as promising computational architectures for approximating solutions to combinatorial optimization problems. We derive and analyze the mean-field limit of an OIM model and show that it inherits the gradient-flow structure of the finite-dimensional dynamics. We identify conditions under which this mean-field evolution admits an Eulerian formulation as a gradient flow on the Wasserstein space of probability measures, and contrast this with a Lagrangian formulation which is always available. The gradient-flow structure strongly constrains the long-time dynamics and enables a complete classification of limit solutions and their stability in the symmetric case. In particular, all limit solutions are fixed points whose phases cluster into at most four groups, and for almost all parameter values, only binarized fixed points -- those with clusters at $0$ and/or $π$ -- can be stable. Since binarized states are exactly those for which a feasible solution to the original problem can be read out, this shows that feasible solutions can almost always be recovered. We provide tight bounds on the parameter thresholds for which fixed points in this binarized family are stable, thereby identifying the threshold for binarization in this model. We also present numerical evidence that the mean-field model correctly predicts behavioral regimes in large random networks, including Erdős-Rényi networks.

AI.tldr: 本文推导并分析了振荡器伊辛机（OIM）的均值场极限，证明其继承了有限维动力学的梯度流结构。在对称情形下，该结构使得所有极限解均为不动点且相位簇聚为至多四组；几乎所有参数值下，只有二值化不动点（相位位于0和/或π）能够稳定，而这些正是可读出原问题可行解的状态，从而保证了可行解几乎总能被恢复。文中还给出了二值化稳定不动点参数阈值的紧界，并用数值实验验证了均值场模型在大型随机网络（包括Erdős-Rényi网络）中的预测能力。
AI.motivation: OIM作为近似求解组合优化问题的新型计算架构，其动力学行为的理论理解尚不充分。理解均值场极限及其梯度流结构，有助于从理论上解释OIM为何能有效恢复可行解，并为参数选择和系统设计提供理论指导。
AI.method: 1) 推导OIM模型的均值场极限；2) 证明其继承梯度流结构，并给出欧拉表述（Wasserstein空间上的梯度流）成立的充要条件，同时与拉格朗日表述对比；3) 利用梯度流结构对对称情形的极限解进行分类和稳定性分析；4) 推导二值化固定点稳定的参数阈值紧界；5) 在大型随机网络上进行数值验证。
AI.result: 1) 均值场演化继承梯度流结构，欧拉形式在一定条件下成立；2) 对称情形下所有极限解均为不动点，相位簇聚至多四组；3) 几乎所有参数值下仅二值化不动点稳定，即可行解几乎总能恢复；4) 给出了二值化稳定性的参数阈值紧界，确定了二值化阈值；5) 数值实验证实均值场模型能正确预测大型随机网络（含Erdős-Rényi网络）的行为区间。
AI.conclusion: 梯度流结构为理解OIM的长期动力学提供了强大约束，理论上证明了可行解几乎总能从稳定固定点中恢复。均值场极限是大规模随机网络中OIM行为可靠的理论预测工具，为实际应用中的参数选择和性能分析奠定了坚实的理论基础。

title: The ultimate carbon cost of a ChatGPT query
comment: 5 pages,0 figures. Accepted at the 2nd International Workshop on Low Carbon Computing (LOCO 2026), Lancaster University, United Kingdom, 10-11 September 2026. Part of the LOCO 2026 proceedings, arXiv:LOCO2026/P15
summary: This paper reviews and combines findings from the fields of product and life-cycle analysis [36, 38], the usage of modern transformer- based large language models (LLM) [6], as well as on greenhouse gas emissions and the ultimate cost of their subsequent consequences for future generations [2]. In this paper, it is shown that the carbon cost of a LLM query is in the order of magnitude of (USD) $0.4 per query for the future human population in the form of environmental disruptions. This corresponds to emissions in the magnitude of 10 gCO2eq/query. The most significant unknown factor in that calculation being the number of tokens computed (1k to 100k tokens equal 1.2 cent/query to 120 cent/query). This number is subject to a wide range of calculation uncertainties and is less to be seen as a matter of fact and more as an order of magnitude estimate. This estimate is aimed towards aiding the discourse surrounding AI systems by uncover- ing the inevitable consequences of technological development by the means of attaching a consequence in a familiar unit to it. By the introduction of the per query ultimate carbon cost (QCC), even if attached to great uncertainty, it is highlighted that the use of AI services happens within hypercomplex interdependent systems and has concrete consequences for our planetary health. The spread of the awareness about the interdependence of planetary health and AI usage can be useful for the individual user in the formation of political opinion through discourse [5] as well as a literate usage of AI systems [31]. Ways to increase the accuracy of the estima- tions, such as incorporating the cost of AIs water consumption or further determining the realistic token count of a query, have been identified as further research targets.

AI.tldr: 本文结合产品生命周期分析、Transformer大语言模型使用和温室气体排放等领域的发现，估算出每次LLM查询的"最终碳成本"（QCC）约为每查询0.4美元，对应约10gCO2eq/query的排放，但该估算存在较大不确定性。
AI.motivation: 揭示AI技术发展对环境造成的不可避免后果，通过将后果转化为人们熟悉的货币单位，促进围绕AI系统的讨论，提高用户对AI使用与地球健康相互依存关系的认识。
AI.method: 综合产品与生命周期分析、Transformer-based LLM使用情况以及温室气体排放及其后代成本三个领域的文献和研究发现，提出每次查询的最终碳成本（QCC）概念进行估算。
AI.result: 每次LLM查询的碳成本约为0.4美元（面向未来人类群体的环境破坏），对应约10gCO2eq/query。token数量（1k至100k）是最大的不确定因素，使成本范围在每查询1.2美分至120美分之间。
AI.conclusion: QCC概念即使存在较大不确定性，也成功突出了AI服务使用处于高度复杂相互依赖的系统中，对地球健康有切实影响。未来研究应纳入AI水消耗成本，并进一步确定实际token数量以提高估算准确性。

title: Efficient Neural-Network-Based High-Resolution Radiative Transfer for CO___ Retrieval, and Application to Interferometric Sensing
summary: Studying climate change requires reducing uncertainties in CO2 and CH4 emission estimates to better distinguish anthropogenic from natural sources, which motivates spaceborne measurements with improved revisit frequency and spatial coverage. In this context, the Horizon Europe SCARBOn project assesses a low-cost satellite constellation featuring the NanoCarb imaging interferometer as its core sensor for monitoring CO2 and CH4 emissions in the atmosphere. However, estimating CO2 and CH4 concentrations with high revisit and spatial coverage poses significant challenges: full-physics retrieval algorithms commonly used rely on repeated high-resolution radiative transfer (RT) simulations, which are computationally expensive when using line-by-line RT models. As an alternative, we propose in this study a feedforward multilayer perceptron (MLP) surrogate designed to accurately and efficiently predict top-of-atmosphere radiances in the CO2 weak band, using a combined mean absolute error (MAE) loss on radiances and RT Jacobians to preserve both spectral accuracy and sensitivity to geophysical parameters. Coupling the MLP-based RT surrogate with the NanoCarb instrumental response yields an efficient and precise forward model for NanoCarb measurements, which shows promising results for CO2 concentration retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对气候监测中CO2和CH4排放估算不确定性的问题，提出了一种基于多层感知机（MLP）的辐射传输（RT）代理模型，用于高效预测CO2弱波段的星顶辐射，并结合NanoCarb成像干涉仪响应，构建了快速且精确的正向模型，为低成本卫星星座的大气CO2浓度反演提供了可行方案。
AI.motivation: 气候研究需要降低CO2和CH4排放估算的不确定性，这推动了具有更高重访频率和空间覆盖的星载测量需求。然而，全物理反演算法依赖逐线RT模型进行反复的高分辨率辐射传输模拟，计算成本极高，难以满足高重访和高空间覆盖的需求。
AI.method: 提出一种前馈多层感知机（MLP）代理模型，用于快速准确地预测CO2弱波段的星顶辐射。模型采用辐射和RT雅可比矩阵的联合平均绝对误差（MAE）损失函数进行训练，以同时保持光谱精度和对地球物理参数的敏感性。随后将MLP代理与NanoCarb仪器的响应函数耦合，形成用于NanoCarb测量的高效精确正向模型。
AI.result: MLP代理模型结合NanoCarb仪器响应后，能够提供高效且精确的正向模型，在CO2浓度反演方面显示出有前景的结果，显著降低了计算成本，同时保持了光谱精度和参数灵敏度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明MLP代理RT模型是传统逐线RT模型的有效替代方案，能够为SCARBOn项目的低成本卫星星座提供高效的正向建模能力，从而支持高频次、高覆盖的大气CO2监测，有助于更好地区分人为源和自然源排放。

title: Attitude Estimation from Photometric Data using Gaussian Process Regression
comment: Accepted for publication in Journal of Space Safety Engineering
summary: The rapid growth of resident space objects in Earth's orbit has intensified the need for advanced space situational awareness and space domain awareness to manage satellite traffic and prevent collisions. Attitude estimation is critical for accurate state propagation, as non-gravitational forces like solar radiation pressure and atmospheric drag depend on the object's attitude. This study explores using light curves, time variation of an object's brightness, to estimate a space object's attitude. Light curve inversion, traditionally used in astronomy, faces challenges when applied to resident space objects due to their non-convex shapes and specular reflections. Conventional methods for attitude estimation often assume known shape and surface parameters, which are usually unknown for space debris generated by a collision or breakup. To address this issue, this study proposes the estimation method combining Gaussian process regression with the unscented Kalman filter. This study uses Gaussian process regression for a non-parametric observation model, enhancing robustness against unknown surface parameters. Numerical examples consider a box-wing object in a geosynchronous orbit and demonstrate that the proposed method has better estimation accuracy than a conventional unscented Kalman filter. The numerical simulation results also represent the attitude estimation robust against uncertainties in surface properties, contributing to practical scenarios in space situational awareness and space domain awareness where the object parameters are unknown.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将高斯过程回归（GPR）与无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF）相结合的方法，利用光变曲线估计空间碎片的姿态，无需已知物体形状和表面参数，在地球同步轨道盒翼目标的数值仿真中验证了比传统UKF更优的估计精度和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 空间碎片数量快速增长，姿态估计对精确轨道传播至关重要（因太阳辐射压和大气阻力等非引力力依赖姿态）。传统光变曲线反演方法面临非凸形状和镜面反射的挑战，而常规姿态估计方法假设形状和表面参数已知，这对碰撞/解体产生的空间碎片通常不成立。
AI.method: 将高斯过程回归（GPR）用作非参数观测模型，替代依赖已知表面参数的物理观测模型，并与无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF）结合进行姿态估计。GPR增强了模型对未知表面参数的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 数值仿真采用地球同步轨道上的盒翼（box-wing）物体，结果表明所提方法比传统UKF具有更好的姿态估计精度，并且对表面属性不确定性具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为空间态势感知和空间领域感知中物体参数未知的实际场景提供了实用的姿态估计方案，有助于提升空间碎片管理的安全性。

title: Density-Reweighted Entropic Optimal Transport: Decoupling Geometry from Sampling Density
summary: Dataset alignment is a central step in data analysis across science and engineering, where the goal is to match observations between datasets. Entropic Optimal Transport (EOT) offers a computationally tractable framework for this task by encoding cross-dataset affinities in a transport plan. However, when two datasets are sampled from geometrically similar low-dimensional structures with substantially different sampling densities, the EOT plan may match points by relative sampling density rather than geometric proximity, yielding geometrically misleading correspondences. To address this issue, we propose a density-reweighted EOT framework in which the influence of sampling density on the transport plan can be discounted to a desired degree, ranging from standard EOT to alignment driven purely by underlying geometry. Under suitable regularity conditions, we establish convergence of the reweighted EOT plan to a family of population-level plans whose dependence on sampling density is made explicit. Through simulations, we show that our approach recovers geometrically faithful correspondences, improving over related EOT-based frameworks when datasets exhibit substantial sampling density disparity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种密度重加权熵正则最优传输（EOT）框架，用于解决数据集中采样密度差异导致EOT匹配计划在几何上产生误导对应关系的问题。
AI.motivation: 当两个数据集从几何相似的低维结构中采样但采样密度差异显著时，标准EOT计划会根据相对采样密度而非几何邻近性匹配点，导致几何上错误的对应关系，影响数据对齐的准确性。
AI.method: 提出密度重加权EOT框架，通过一个可调参数来控制采样密度对传输计划的影响程度，从标准EOT到完全由底层几何驱动的对齐之间连续过渡。在合适的正则条件下，证明了重加权EOT计划收敛到一族人口层面的计划，且这些计划对采样密度的依赖是显式的。
AI.result: 通过仿真实验表明，该方法能恢复几何上忠实的对应关系，在数据集存在显著采样密度差异时，优于相关的EOT框架。
AI.conclusion: 该密度重加权EOT框架有效解决了采样密度差异导致的EOT对齐偏差问题，为跨数据集对齐提供了一种可调节密度影响的通用解决方案。

title: Toward Safe LLM Agents: A Survey of Specification, Verification, and Enforcement
comment: 28 pages
summary: LLM agents increasingly perform irreversible real-world actions, including database updates, API calls, file operations, and autonomous use of tools. However, no existing system provides formally grounded, task-level safety guarantees for the plans these agents generate. Research remains fragmented across specification, verification, and enforcement, limiting understanding of the strengths and limitations of existing approaches. To address this gap, we conducted a PRISMA 2020 systematic review of 38 studies published between 2022 and 2026 and retrieved from six academic databases. Our analysis reveals four key findings. First, the specification bottleneck remains the primary challenge: natural-language-to-formal translation achieves only 24% to 35% semantic correctness, undermining downstream verification. Second, runtime monitoring is the most mature enforcement strategy, reducing unsafe actions by 40% to 65% in controlled settings, but it does not provide complete safety guarantees. Third, the verifier tax shows that blocking 94% of unsafe actions can still result in less than 5% safe task completion because agents exploit alternative unsafe paths. Finally, no existing approach simultaneously achieves soundness, scalability, semantic correctness, and task-level safety preservation. We contribute a three-level taxonomy, a comparative analysis of existing techniques, a synthesis of evidence on the verifier tax, and a ten-problem research agenda for trustworthy agentic AI.

AI.tldr: 本文对2022至2026年间38篇关于LLM智能体安全规划的研究进行了PRISMA 2020系统综述，揭示了规范瓶颈、运行时监控成熟度、验证器税（verifier tax）等四个关键发现，并提出三层分类体系、比较分析、证据综合及十项研究议程。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地执行不可逆的真实世界操作（如数据库更新、API调用、文件操作等），但现有系统缺乏基于形式化、任务级的安全保障。该领域研究在规范、验证和执行上碎片化，限制了对其优缺点整体理解，亟需系统性综述来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA 2020系统综述方法学，从六个学术数据库检索2022至2026年间发表的文献，最终纳入38项研究，并进行分类分析、技术比较和证据综合。
AI.result: 四个关键发现：(1) 规范瓶颈是主要挑战，自然语言到形式化翻译仅达到24%-35%的语义正确率；(2) 运行时监控是最成熟的强制策略，可减少40%-65%的不安全动作，但不提供完全安全保障；(3) 验证器税表明阻断94%的不安全动作仍可能导致不到5%的安全任务完成率；(4) 现有方法无法同时实现健全性、可扩展性、语义正确性和任务级安全性保持。
AI.conclusion: 提出了三层分类体系、现有技术的比较分析、验证器税的证据综合，以及面向可信智能体AI的十项研究议程，为该领域的未来研究指明方向。

title: What to Forget in Unlearning? Forget Set Curation for Language Models
comment: Presented at MemFM @ ICML 2026 and FoGen @ ICML 2026
summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted data or behaviors from a trained model without retraining from scratch. Yet most evaluations assume that the examples to forget are already known. In realistic language-model deployments, a requester may ask a model to stop reproducing a song or book without knowing which spans, documents, quotations, or near-duplicates in a trillion-token corpus support that behavior. We study this missing upstream problem, forget set curation: mapping a suppression request to the data passed to an unlearning algorithm. We introduce CleanSlate, a benchmark for verbatim output suppression over songs and books, with model-specific extraction profiles, content-grounded QA, and capability-retention evaluations. CleanSlate exposes two failure modes. Natural lexical and exact-substring curators often yield forget sets that lead to weak suppression. An evaluation-aware curator suppresses requested continuations almost completely, but causes collateral regression on non-requested content and model-dependent capability loss. These results show that practical unlearning is not only an optimization problem once a forget set is given: the data chosen for forgetting determines both what can be unlearnt and what else is damaged.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CleanSlate基准，研究了一个被忽视的上游问题——"遗忘集策展"（forget set curation）：如何将用户的抑制请求（如停止复现某歌曲或书籍）映射到传递给机器遗忘算法的具体数据。实验发现自然词法和精确子串策展器往往导致抑制效果弱，而评估感知的策展器虽能几乎完全抑制请求的延续内容，但会造成非请求内容的附带退化和模型能力损失。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘评估大多假设要遗忘的样本是已知的，但在实际语言模型部署中，请求者可能要求模型停止复现某歌曲或书籍，却不知道支持该行为的token级数据分布在万亿规模的语料中。这个"遗忘集策展"问题尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出CleanSlate基准，包含：1）针对歌曲和书籍的逐字输出抑制任务；2）模型特定的内容提取画像；3）内容锚定的问答评估；4）能力保持评估。对比自然词法策展器、精确子串策展器和评估感知策展器的遗忘效果。
AI.result: 自然词法和精确子串策展器生成的遗忘集导致抑制效果弱；评估感知策展器能几乎完全抑制请求的延续内容，但造成非请求内容的附带回归和模型相关的能力损失。
AI.conclusion: 实际中的机器遗忘不仅是给定遗忘集后的优化问题，遗忘集的选择同时决定了哪些内容可以被遗忘以及哪些其他能力会受到损害。遗忘集策展本身是决定遗忘实践成败的关键环节。

title: On the Local Linear Convergence of Operator Splitting Methods for Conic Programming
summary: Operator-splitting methods such as the primal-dual hybrid gradient method (PDHG) and the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) often exhibit linear convergence on conic programs, although general theory guarantees only sublinear rates. We identify two geometric conditions -- strict complementarity and quadratic facial violation -- that explain this local behavior: under these conditions, PDHG and ADMM converge linearly to an optimal solution when initialized sufficiently close to the converging strictly complementary solution. We establish this result through a unified and verifiable primal-dual error-bound framework. First, we show that strict complementarity, together with a quadratic facial-violation property of the associated complementary faces, implies uniform quadratic growth of both the primal and dual augmented Lagrangians near a strictly complementary solution. Second, we prove the local equivalence of three regularity conditions: uniform quadratic growth of the augmented Lagrangians, quadratic growth of a localized smoothed primal-dual gap, and metric subregularity of the saddle-point mapping. This equivalence clarifies the relationship among previously proposed conditions for local linear convergence. Third, using a unified formulation, we give a concise analysis showing that these equivalent conditions yield local linear convergence of PDHG and ADMM. We verify the quadratic facial-violation property for standard polyhedral and symmetric cones, as well as relevant faces of exponential and power cones, and show that it is preserved under Cartesian products. We also obtain an improved local rate using a restarted Halpern scheme. Finally, we extend the framework to convex composite optimization through a quadratic subdifferential-violation condition, which generalizes the quadratic facial-violation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了算子分裂方法（PDHG和ADMM）在锥规划问题上的局部线性收敛性。作者识别出两个几何条件——严格互补性和二次面违逆性质——足以解释这些方法在锥规划上的线性收敛行为，并建立了一个统一且可验证的原始-对偶误差界框架来证明这一点。文章还证明了三个正则性条件的局部等价性，验证了二次面违逆性质对多种标准锥体成立，并扩展到凸复合优化。
AI.motivation: 算子分裂方法（如PDHG和ADMM）在实践中对锥规划问题常表现出线性收敛，但一般理论只保证次线性收敛率。这一理论预测与实际观察之间的显著差距，促使作者寻找能够解释这种局部强收敛行为的几何条件，从而为实际算法性能提供理论支撑。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个统一的原始-对偶误差界框架：(1) 证明严格互补性结合互补面的二次面违逆性质，可推导出增广拉格朗日函数的均匀二次增长；(2) 证明三个正则性条件（增广拉格朗日均匀二次增长、局部平滑原始-对偶间隙的二次增长、鞍点映射的度量次正则性）的局部等价性；(3) 利用统一定义简洁地证明这些等价条件导出PDHG和ADMM的局部线性收敛，并采用重启Halpern方案获得改进的局部收敛率。
AI.result: 论文证明在严格互补性和二次面违逆条件下，PDHG和ADMM在初始点足够接近收敛的严格互补解时线性收敛。作者验证了标准多面体锥、对称锥以及指数锥和幂锥的相关面满足二次面违逆性质，并证明该性质在笛卡尔积下保持。此外，通过二次次微分违逆条件将框架扩展到凸复合优化。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个统一的、可验证的框架来解释和保证PDHG与ADMM在锥规划上的局部线性收敛，弥合了理论次线性率与实际线性收敛之间的鸿沟。三个正则条件的等价性澄清了先前文献中相关条件之间的关系，为理解和设计更高效的算子分裂算法提供了坚实的理论基理论基础。

title: "This Is So Claude!" Towards a Theory of the Recognition of AI Character Without Reidentification
comment: 13 pages. Submitted to Philosophical Studies
summary: Users sometimes judge that an unfamiliar response is "so Claude." What does this judgment recognize, if it does not identify which model, process, conversation, or mind produced the response? I distinguish three orders of inquiry into AI identity. Constraint-first inquiry begins with conditions that a persisting interlocutor should satisfy. Mechanism-first inquiry begins with structures peculiar to language models and asks whether they delimit plausible entities. Recognition-first inquiry begins with an ordinary capacity: recognizing a way of responding as Claudish before selecting a persisting bearer. I develop two conditional abductions. If blinded, graded judgments of Claudishness generalize across unfamiliar tasks after branding and familiar phrases are controlled, their best explanation may be a real, projectible conversational character. If that character coordinates several dispositions, its unity may in turn have a compact and causally effective realization in activation space. The second hypothesis is more speculative and requires independent prediction and intervention. Neither conclusion settles numerical identity. The same character may occur in different candidate bearers, and the same candidate bearer may persist through a change of character. This distinction matters for AI companions because continuity of recognizable character may be a focus of attachment even when continuity of the computational bearer remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨"so Claude"这类陌生回复判断的哲学基础，区分三种AI身份探究路径，提出基于认识的进路，并通过两个条件性溯因论证"可投射的对话人格"及其可能的神经实现。
AI.motivation: 用户常常判断陌生回复"很Claude"，但这种判断既非识别模型、过程、对话或心灵，作者希望阐明这种判断究竟在认识什么，并区分性格（character）与数值同一性（numerical identity）以解构AI身份问题。
AI.method: 区分三种探究进路：约束优先（先设持续对话者应满足的条件）、机制优先（从语言模型结构出发界定可能实体）、认识优先（先认识一种Claude式的回应方式，再选择持续承载者）。基于认识优先进路提出两个条件性溯因论证。
AI.result: 若盲测分级判断在控制品牌和熟悉短语后仍能跨陌生任务泛化，最佳解释可能是真实、可投射的对话性格；若该性格协调多种倾向，其统一性可能在激活空间中有紧凑且因果有效的实现，后者更需独立预测与干预验证。两种结论均不解决数值同一性。
AI.conclusion: 同一性格可出现在不同候选承载者中，同一候选承载者也可能经历性格变化。对AI伴侣而言，可辨认性格的连续性可能是依恋的核心，即使计算承载者的连续性尚未解决。

title: iFuzz-Meta: An Interpretable Fuzzy Learning Framework Bridging Top-Down and Bottom-Up Knowledge Integration
summary: Interpretable representation learning remains a key challenge in modern neural computation, particularly when models are expected not only to perform but also to explain their reasoning. This paper introduces iFuzz-Meta, an interpretable fuzzy rule-based learning framework that preserves human-understandable reasoning structures within modern neural architectures. Each fuzzy rule corresponds to a semantic and spatial prototype defined in the original feature space, enabling transparent inference and direct interpretability. Meta-learning is employed as an analytical paradigm to examine how these interpretable rules reorganize across tasks and domains, providing a principled means to link algorithmic adaptation with cognitive representation. A knowledge-guided regularization mechanism further enables a top-down-bottom-up integration, in which theoretical priors act as soft inductive biases while data-driven learning refines and extends them. This dual process ensures that adaptation proceeds along semantically and physiologically meaningful trajectories, rather than arbitrary parameter shifts. Evaluations demonstrate that iFuzz-Meta achieves interpretable reasoning and stable cross-domain generalization, establishing a potential general pathway toward explainable and knowledge-aware fuzzy systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出iFuzz-Meta，一种可解释的模糊规则学习框架，将人类可理解的推理结构嵌入现代神经架构中。每条模糊规则对应原始特征空间中的语义和空间原型，实现透明推理和直接可解释性。借助元学习分析可解释规则在任务间和域间的重组，并通过知识引导正则化实现自顶向下与自底向上的整合，使自适应沿着语义和生理上有意义的轨迹进行。
AI.motivation: 现代神经计算中可解释表示学习仍是一大挑战，模型不仅要表现好还要能解释其推理过程。现有模型往往缺乏人类可理解的推理结构，难以在推理透明性与性能之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 1) 基于模糊规则的表示学习框架，每条模糊规则对应原始特征空间中的语义和空间原型；2) 采用元学习作为分析范式，研究可解释规则跨任务和跨域的重组；3) 知识引导正则化机制实现自顶向下-自底向上整合，理论先验作为软归纳偏置，数据驱动学习加以细化和扩展。
AI.result: 评估表明iFuzz-Meta实现了可解释推理和稳定的跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为面向可解释和知识感知的模糊系统提供了潜在的通路，确保自适应沿着语义和生理上有意义的轨迹进行，而非任意的参数偏移。

title: Adaptive Relative Orbit Control Considering Laser Ablation Uncertainty
comment: Accepted for publication in Acta Astronautica
summary: This study proposes a relative orbit control law for laser debris removal missions considering the uncertainties of laser ablation and atmospheric drag. A removal spacecraft irradiates laser pulses to a target debris to generate the ablation force for deorbiting. The deorbiting force lowers the target altitude, and the removal spacecraft must follow it to maintain its relative position for continuous laser irradiation. The difficulty stems from uncertainties of the magnitude of laser ablation and external disturbances such as atmospheric drag. To tackle this problem, this study derives an adaptive control method using the Gaussian process regression to cancel the uncertainties with a nonparametric regression model. Numerical simulations verify the proposed control law under the uncertainties of laser ablation and atmospheric drag. The proposed control law can contribute to the realization of a safer and more secure mission not only for laser debris removal missions, but also for other on-orbit services.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种针对激光碎片清除任务中的相对轨道控制律，利用高斯过程回归的自适应控制方法，来抵消激光烧蚀和大气阻力等不确定性带来的影响，并通过数值仿真验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 激光碎片清除任务中，碎片在激光烧蚀力作用下轨道高度降低，清除航天器需要持续跟随以维持相对位置进行连续激光照射。然而，激光烧蚀的幅度和大气阻力等外部扰动存在不确定性，这给相对轨道控制带来了困难。
AI.method: 提出一种使用高斯过程回归的自适应控制方法，通过非参数回归模型来抵消激光烧蚀和大气阻力等不确定性。
AI.result: 数值仿真验证了所提出的控制律在激光烧蚀和大气阻力不确定性下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该控制律不仅有助于激光碎片清除任务，还能为其他在轨服务任务实现更安全、更可靠的运行做出贡献。

title: Hide&Seek: Learning to Explain in an End-to-End Differentiable Network
comment: 27 pages, 12 figures, 16 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026 (PMLR 306). Code at https://github.com/talellinson/hide-and-seek-icml2026
summary: Instance-wise feature selection is a valuable tool for interpreting labeled data and the predictions of black-box models. In contrast to global feature selection techniques, instance-wise methods dynamically identify important features for each instance. A growing number of methods learn a selector, which identifies important features, and a predictor, which uses these to make predictions. However, these pioneering methods face challenges including information leakage and lack of differentiability, which can slow training. In this paper, we present Hide&Seek, an end-to-end differentiable model for instance-wise feature selection. We jointly learn feature selection and prediction under a single objective without information leakage. Hide&Seek outperforms existing state-of-the-art models across a range of experiments and is fast to train. We achieve this by reformulating feature removal as a differentiable operation where instead of discretely removing features, we replace a proportion of each feature. Training is further stabilized via a parsimony-weight annealing framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hide&Seek，一个端到端可微分的实例级特征选择模型，通过将特征移除重新表述为可微分操作（替换每个特征的一部分而非离散移除），并采用简约权重退火框架稳定训练，在多项实验中超越现有方法且训练速度快。
AI.motivation: 现有的实例级特征选择方法通常分别学习选择器和预测器，面临信息泄漏和缺乏可微性等问题，导致训练速度慢且性能受限。
AI.method: 提出端到端可微模型Hide&Seek，将特征移除操作重新表述为可微分操作（用特征的一部分替换而非离散丢弃），并在单一目标下联合学习特征选择与预测，同时通过简约权重退火框架进一步提升训练稳定性。
AI.result: Hide&Seek在一系列实验中优于现有的最先进模型，并且训练速度快。
AI.conclusion: 通过可微化的特征移除操作和退火框架，Hide&Seek有效解决了信息泄漏与不可微性问题，实现了高效且优越的实例级特征选择。

title: Position: Medical AI Neglects Real Treatment Outcomes
comment: Published at ICML 2026. https://openreview.net/forum?id=0e1KEGU9RD
summary: Medical AI has rapidly improved its ability to perform diagnostic and prognostic tasks that lead to treatment decisions. But understanding of treatment itself is still inadequately trained and evaluated, using human opinions and syntheses (especially texts such as biomedical publications and clinical practice guidelines) rather than actual underlying data on treatment outcomes. This neglect seriously limits the potential of medical AI, and is already causing deficiencies in both frontier models and major benchmarks, as argued in this position paper. Real treatment outcomes, drawn from sources such as observational databases and randomized experiments, should be substantially incorporated into both training and evaluation. Improving these outcomes should be reemphasized as the downstream goal of all medical AI.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文（position paper），指出医疗AI虽然在诊断和预后任务上取得了显著进步，但在治疗理解方面仍存在严重不足——训练和评估过度依赖人类意见和文献综述（如生物医学出版物和临床实践指南），而忽视了真实的治疗结果数据。作者主张应将来自观察性数据库和随机实验的真实治疗结果大量纳入医疗AI的训练和评估，并将改善治疗结局作为医疗AI的最终目标。
AI.motivation: 作者认为当前医疗AI对治疗本身的理解训练不足且评估不充分，过度依赖主观的人类意见和文献综合，而非基于真实治疗结局的底层数据。这种忽视严重限制了医疗AI的潜力，并在前沿模型和主要基准测试中已造成明显缺陷。
AI.method: 作为立场论文，本文没有提出具体的技术方法，而是通过论证方式提出建议：将来自观察性数据库和随机对照实验的真实治疗结果数据系统地纳入医疗AI的训练和评估流程中，以弥补当前对治疗理解的不足。
AI.result: 论文指出当前医疗AI领域存在具体缺陷：前沿模型在治疗理解上训练不足，主要基准测试在设计上未能充分评估治疗能力，均源于对真实治疗结果数据的忽视。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁将改善治疗结局重新确立为所有医疗AI的下游目标，并在训练和评估两个环节实质性融入真实治疗结果数据，从而推动医疗AI从"感知和预测"向"理解和优化治疗"的范式转变。

title: Where Does Retrieval Fail? Evaluating RAG Architectures for Agricultural Advisory
summary:
Retrieval quality in RAG systems is commonly reported as a single aggregate score, which can hide large differences across query types and language conditions. We study this problem in Bengali agricultural advisory, where farmer queries are often colloquial while official advisory documents use formal scientific terminology. We construct a test collection of 1,000 queries and 2,882 knowledge nodes extracted from 284 official Bangladeshi agricultural publications, and use it to evaluate five retrieval architectures and six embedding models under three controlled language conditions.
  The results show that no single retrieval method is consistently best. For native Bengali queries, BM25 is the strongest single retriever (R@10 = 0.506) while Hybrid RRF reaches the highest overall R@10 of 0.539. However, dense retrieval performance varies sharply by query type: R@10 is 0.093 on colloquial farmer queries and 0.970 on formal safety queries. Across language conditions, BM25 R@10 drops from 0.506 on Bengali queries to 0.004 when English queries are matched against the Bengali corpus, while dense retrieval falls only from 0.464 to 0.425. We also find that embedding task configuration and passage length can each change reported R@10 by a factor of seven, independent of architecture. These results show why low-resource RAG evaluation should report performance by language condition and query type rather than relying on aggregate scores alone. The dataset and evaluation scripts are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/RaiyanKhaan/AgriTrust-RAG.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了孟加拉语农业RAG系统中检索质量评估的偏见问题，构建了包含1,000个查询和2,882个知识节点的测试集，在三种语言条件下评估了五种检索架构和六种嵌入模型。核心发现是：单一聚合分数会掩盖不同查询类型和语言条件下检索性能的巨大差异，例如密集检索在口语化农民查询上R@10仅为0.093，而在正式安全查询上高达0.970。研究建议低资源RAG评估应按语言条件和查询类型分别报告性能。
AI.motivation: RAG系统检索质量通常以单一聚合分数报告，这会掩盖不同查询类型和语言条件下的巨大性能差异。在孟加拉语农业咨询场景中，农民使用口语化表达而官方文件使用正式科学术语，这种语言鸿沟使得聚合评估分数具有误导性，无法反映系统在不同实际使用场景中的真实表现。
AI.method: 构建包含1,000个查询和2,882个知识节点（来自284份孟加拉国官方农业出版物）的测试集AgriTrust-RAG，在三种受控语言条件下，评估五种检索架构（含BM25、稠密检索和混合RRF）和六种嵌入模型，系统性地分析查询类型和语言条件对检索性能的影响。
AI.result: BM25在原生孟加拉语查询上表现最强（R@10=0.506），混合RRF达到最高总体R@10（0.539）。稠密检索在口语化农民查询上仅0.093，在正式安全查询上高达0.970。跨语言条件下BM25从0.506骤降至0.004，而稠密检索仅从0.464降至0.425。嵌入任务配置和段落长度可各自将R@10改变达7倍。
AI.conclusion: 没有任何单一检索方法在所有条件下都最优，聚合分数会严重误导对RAG系统真实性能的判断。低资源语言RAG评估应按照语言条件和查询类型分别报告性能，而不能仅依赖聚合分数。

title: The Price of Relearning: Ambiguity Provenance in Dynamic Decisions
comment: 71 pages, 2 figures; includes an electronic companion with complete proofs and supplementary computational and empirical evidence
summary: Dynamic robust systems often rebuild ambiguity sets as data arrive.
