The new set need not be the Bayesian continuation of the models that justified earlier actions: relearning can change the evaluator, not merely the estimate. Within the continuous compact-valued class, a likelihood quotient characterizes provenance-preserving constructors. When provenance fails, a selection-free triangular vintage representation is exact, and its directed welfare gap defines the Price of Relearning. Endpoint and memory results show why the vintage state is generally necessary and when coherent compression is possible. Specified finite models with explicitly listed one-step ambiguity laws remain polynomially evaluable, whereas universal certification is NP-hard. Compatible design provides the repair, and a conditional myopic pricing benchmark exhibits the action-information-ambiguity feedback; scanner evidence calibrates its scale without being interpreted as a causal protocol experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了动态鲁棒系统中随时间到达数据而重建模糊集（ambiguity set）的问题，指出新的模糊集不一定是贝叶斯式的延续，重新学习会改变评估者本身。提出了似然商刻画保留来源的构造方法，引入"重新学习代价"（Price of Relearning）概念，并探讨了该问题的可计算性与复杂性边界。
AI.motivation: 在动态鲁棒系统中，随着新数据的到达，模糊集需要被重建。然而新构建的模糊集不必是先前行动所依据模型的贝叶斯延续——重新学习可能改变的是评估者（evaluator）本身，而不仅仅是估计值。这种"来源丢失"现象给动态决策带来了根本性的理论挑战，需要被系统地表征和分析。
AI.method: 论文在连续紧值类中，利用似然商（likelihood quotient）刻画保留来源（provenance-preserving）的构造方法。当来源保留失败时，提出一种无选择（selection-free）的三角年份（triangular vintage）表示，并定义其定向福利缺口为"重新学习代价"。论文还分析了端点和记忆结果，证明了年份状态的一般必要性及相干压缩的可行条件；对指定有限模型给出了多项式可评估性证明，并指出了通用认证的NP-hard复杂性，最后提出相容设计作为修复方案，并以条件短视定价基准展示行动-信息-模糊反馈。
AI.result: 研究证明了：似然商可精确刻画保留来源的构造器；当来源保留失败时，三角年份表示是精确且无选择偏差的；年份状态在一般情况下是必要的，但在特定条件下可实现相干压缩；指定有限模型可多项式评估，而通用认证问题是NP-hard的；相容设计可修复问题，扫描仪证据可校准模型规模。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了动态鲁棒系统中"重新学习"与经典贝叶斯更新的本质区别——前者可以改变评估框架本身。通过引入重新学习代价和年份表示，为理解这类系统的信息价值提供了理论工具，同时给出了计算复杂性的明确边界和可行的修复设计路径。

title: SMOPD: Selective Token-Entropy Masking for Dirty-History Multi-Turn On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Dirty-history rollouts make multi-turn on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) brittle: once a student emits an erroneous intermediate reply, later turns are conditioned on that reply, and uniform distillation can spend loss on tokens that carry little corrective signal. We introduce SMOPD (Selective Masking for On-Policy Distillation), a loss-only stabilization method for multi-turn OPSD. For each generated middle-turn reply, SMOPD ranks token positions by student entropy and removes the lowest-entropy 20% from the clipped generalized Jensen-Shannon distillation loss; final-answer and FULL-preservation losses are unchanged. This design targets token-level uncertainty rather than coarse trajectory outcomes, adds no parameters, and has zero inference-time overhead. We compare SMOPD with a correctness-scaling variant that multiplies a common detached reliability proxy using final-answer correctness. On LiC with Qwen3 models, SMOPD improves SHARDED-view accuracy by 1.0-2.5 percentage points in single-seed 1.7B, 4B, and 8B comparisons, and a small 4B multi-seed check shows a +1.7pp mean SHARDED gain over baseline (two-tailed p = 0.022). Adding the outcome scalar is harmful without masking at 1.7B (-4.0pp) and remains scale-dependent when combined with masking (+1.3pp at 4B, neutral at 1.7B, and -0.5pp at 8B). These archived aggregate results suggest that token-level uncertainty is a more reliable stabilization signal than scalar final-answer correctness in this evaluated dirty-history OPSD setting, while leaving causal mechanism tests and broader benchmark validation to future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SMOPD（选择性掩码在线策略蒸馏），一种仅作用于损失函数的稳定化方法，用于缓解多轮在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中"脏历史"导致的脆性问题。SMOPD根据学生模型的熵对生成的中间轮token进行排序，将熵最低的20%从裁剪的广义Jensen-Shannon蒸馏损失中移除，最终答案和FULL保留损失不变。实验表明在LiC基准上，SMOPD将SHARDED视图准确率提升1.0-2.5个百分点，而基于最终答案正确性的标量缩放方法则表现不稳定甚至有害。
AI.motivation: 多轮在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）存在"脏历史"问题：学生模型一旦生成了错误的中间回复，后续轮次会基于该错误回复进行条件生成，而均匀蒸馏会在缺乏纠正信号的token上浪费损失。现有方法缺乏针对token级不确定性的稳定化策略，需要一种无需额外参数、无推理开销的稳定化方法。
AI.method: SMOPD的核心方法是：对每个生成的中间轮回复，按照学生模型的熵对token位置进行排序，将熵最低的20%（即模型最确定的token）从裁剪的广义Jensen-Shannon蒸馏损失中剔除；最终答案损失和FULL保留损失保持不变。该方法仅修改训练损失，不增加参数，推理时无额外开销。论文同时设计了一个对照变体：使用最终答案正确性作为可靠性代理进行正确性缩放。
AI.result: 在LiC基准上使用Qwen3模型，SMOPD在1.7B、4B和8B的单种子比较中使SHARDED视图准确率提升1.0-2.5个百分点；4B多种子验证显示平均+1.7个百分点改进（双尾p=0.022）。添加正确性标量在无掩码时对1.7B有害（-4.0pp），与掩码结合时表现依赖模型规模（4B时+1.3pp，1.7B时中性，8B时-0.5pp）。
AI.conclusion: SMOPD表明token级不确定性比基于最终答案正确性的标量信号在多轮脏历史OPSD设置中更可靠的稳定化信号。但论文承认当前结果仅为已存档的聚合结果，因果机制测试和更广泛的基准验证留待未来工作。

title: L-COIN: LLM-Assisted Counterfactual Inference for Game-Theoretic Distributed Computation Offloading in Sub-THz LEO Satellite Networks
summary: As Space-Based Information Networks (SBINs) evolve toward high-capacity, intelligence-centric paradigms, integrating sub-Terahertz (sub-THz) communication into Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations has emerged as a critical enabler for ultra-broadband and resilient global connectivity. By exploiting the ultra-wide bandwidth of sub-THz links to reduce transmission delays, resource-constrained ground devices can seamlessly offload compute-intensive tasks to LEO edge servers. However, satellite motion, short visibility windows, and limited onboard resources make offloading decisions highly time-varying. Existing distributed offloading schemes typically require repeated inter-device state exchange and poorly adapt to time-varying LEO topology or traffic conditions. To address these limitations, a decentralized game-theoretic offloading framework empowered by large language models (LLMs) and counterfactual inference is proposed in this paper. First, a realistic offloading system is established by integrating time-varying 3D-Walker topology. Second, a game-theoretic scheme using counterfactual inference is introduced to deduce unobserved states from local histories, eliminating global information reliance. Finally, an LLM-empowered semantic fusion algorithm is integrated into the counterfactual inference to enhance adaptability through zero-shot reasoning and self-reflection. Numerical results show that L-COIN reduces offloading cost by 10.9% to 27.7% relative to state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出L-COIN框架，将sub-THz通信与LEO卫星星座结合，利用LLM和反事实推断实现去中心化的博弈论任务卸载方案，在时变拓扑下降低卸载成本10.9%-27.7%。
AI.motivation: SBIN向高容量、智能化演进过程中，sub-THz通信成为关键使能技术，但卫星运动、短可见窗口和星上资源受限导致卸载决策高度时变。现有分布式卸载方案需要频繁设备间状态交换，难以适应时变LEO拓扑和流量条件。
AI.method: 1) 构建集成时变3D-Walker拓扑的卸载系统模型；2) 提出基于反事实推断的博弈论方案，从局部历史推断未观测状态，消除全局信息依赖；3) 将LLM赋能的语义融合算法集成到反事实推断中，利用零样本推理和自反思增强适应性。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，L-COIN相比最先进的基线方案，卸载成本降低10.9%至27.7%。
AI.conclusion: LLM与反事实推断结合的博弈论卸载框架能有效应对LEO卫星网络中的时变特性，在无需全局信息的情况下实现高效的任务卸载决策。

title: Non-Crossing Deep Quantile Regression for Distributional Survival Prediction
comment: 50 pages, 15 figures, 17 tables. Main text and supplementary material combined into a single document. Submitted to the Annals of Applied Statistics
summary: In survival analysis the way covariates act on the risk of an event often differs between early and late failure times, yet hazard- and mean-based summaries collapse this variation into a single number. Quantile-based modeling instead describes the full conditional distribution on the original time scale, but existing censored-data methods are either inflexible or produce logically inconsistent crossing quantile curves. We propose a Censored Non-crossing Quantile (CNQ) framework for right-censored data that jointly estimates several conditional survival quantiles and guarantees valid ordering by construction, with flexibility supplied by Kolmogorov-Arnold and Transformer backbones, and we establish a finite-sample excess-risk bound holding jointly across all fitted quantile levels. Across 27 simulation settings and six cohorts the framework attains lower pinball loss than quantile-, hazard- and tree-based competitors whenever the conditional distribution is asymmetric, with interval coverage closer to nominal on all six. In two clinical case studies (METABRIC, breast cancer; FLCHAIN, population mortality) it recovers covariate effects that vary across the survival distribution and would be hidden by a single hazard ratio, and yields coherent individualized quantile milestones. Code: https://github.com/BIG-S2/deepcnq

AI.tldr: 提出了一个用于右删失数据的Censored Non-crossing Quantile (CNQ)框架，联合估计多个条件生存分位数，通过构造保证分位数曲线不交叉，并使用Kolmogorov-Arnold和Transformer骨干网络提供灵活性，同时建立了联合有限样本超额风险界。在27个模拟设置和6个队列中表现优于现有方法，并在两个临床案例中恢复了被单一风险比掩盖的协变量效应。
AI.motivation: 生存分析中协变量对风险的作用在早期和晚期失败时间上往往不同，但基于风险和均值的方法将这种变化压缩为一个数字。分位数建模虽能描述原始时间尺度上的完整条件分布，但现有的删失数据处理方法要么不灵活，要么会产生逻辑上不一致的交叉分位数曲线。
AI.method: 提出CNQ框架，联合估计多个条件生存分位数，通过构造保证排序合法性（非交叉），采用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络和Transformer作为骨干网络提供灵活性，并建立了在所有拟合分位数水平上联合成立的有限样本超额风险界。
AI.result: 在27个模拟设置和6个队列中，当条件分布不对称时，CNQ的pinball损失低于分位数、风险和基于树的方法，且在全部6个队列中区间覆盖率更接近名义水平。在METABRIC（乳腺癌）和FLCHAIN（人群死亡率）两个临床案例中恢复了随生存分布变化的协变量效应，这些效应被单一风险比隐藏，并产生了连贯的个性化分位数里程碑。
AI.conclusion: CNQ框架为右删失数据提供了灵活且逻辑一致的分位数生存分析工具，能够揭示传统方法遗漏的协变量效应随时间的异质性变化，可用于生成连贯的个性化生存分位数里程碑。

title: When Do LLMs Apply the Wrong Law? Diagnosing LLM Failures in Temporal Legal Reasoning
summary: Legal reasoning tasks such as legal judgment prediction (LJP) require identifying the temporally correct version of the law governing a case -- a capability we term temporal applicable-law determination. However, whether large language models (LLMs) can reliably perform this task remains unexplored. In this paper, we construct a benchmark to evaluate LLMs on temporal applicable-law determination, and systematically investigate why they fail at temporal legal reasoning. Our experiments reveal four key findings. First, LLMs exhibit a strong bias toward applying the most recently enacted law, regardless of when the legally relevant facts occurred. Second, this bias does not stem from an inability to understand that laws have temporal scope, nor from a lack of knowledge about historical statutes. Third, we provide behavioral evidence that reinforcement-learning-shaped explicit reasoning may be a key mechanism: while improving general reasoning ability, it reduces the diversity of reasoning paths, causing models to converge on applying the current law. Fourth, this produces a counterintuitive inverse relationship: models with stronger general reasoning ability tend to perform worse on temporal legal reasoning. Our findings offer concrete guidance for future work on improving LLM performance in temporally grounded legal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个用于评估大语言模型在时间适用法律判定任务上表现的基准，发现LLM倾向于使用最近颁布的法律而非案件事实发生时有效的法律。这种偏差并非源于模型不理解法律的时间效力或缺乏历史法律知识，而是由强化学习塑造的显式推理导致推理路径多样性降低，使模型收敛于适用现行法律。这产生了反直觉的结论：通用推理能力越强的模型，在时间法律推理上表现反而更差。
AI.motivation: 法律推理任务（如法律判决预测）需要识别管辖案件的时间正确版本的法律（即时间适用法律判定），但大语言模型能否可靠地完成这一任务尚未被探索过。
AI.method: 构建一个用于评估LLM在时间适用法律判定任务上表现的基准，并系统性地调查模型在时间法律推理中失败的原因，通过实验揭示四个关键发现。
AI.result: 四个关键发现：（1）LLM强烈倾向于适用最近颁布的法律，无论法律相关事实发生在何时；（2）该偏差并非源于模型不理解法律有时间适用范围，也并非缺乏历史法规知识；（3）行为证据表明强化学习塑造的显式推理可能是关键机制：在提升通用推理能力的同时降低了推理路径的多样性，导致模型收敛于适用现行法律；（4）由此产生反直觉的逆相关关系：通用推理能力越强的模型在时间法律推理上表现越差。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为未来改进LLM在时间基础法律推理上的表现提供了具体指导。

title: Interpretable Cross-Lingual Alignment in Small Language Models: Probing Cultural and Pragmatic Reasoning in Japanese-English Bilingual LLMs
comment: 15 pages, no figures. Introduces the J-PragEval-v0 minimal-pair benchmark
summary:
Large language models work well on English and behave in poorly understood ways on languages typologically far from it. Japanese is a clean example, where evaluation still leans on translation quality and JGLUE-style benchmarks, which roll lexical, syntactic and pragmatic competence into a single score. The phenomena on which general-purpose models fail Japanese users are pragmatic: honorifics, in-group and out-group reference, context-sensitive politeness, zero anaphora.
  I introduce J-PragEval-v0, a minimal-pair benchmark isolating four such phenomena from surface fluency, and combine it with linear probes and teacher-forced log-probability evaluation to ask where inside TinySwallow-1.5B (28 layers, hidden size 1536) the corresponding contrasts live. The four features split three ways. Honorific register sits cleanly in the residual stream: 0.96 balanced accuracy at layer 15, and the model flips its preferred continuation with the scenario on 93 percent of items. Implicit subject and in-group reference are not linearly decodable at the final prompt token (0.48 and 0.38), yet flip rates are 0.77 and 0.79, so the contrast is worked out during generation rather than stored at the prompt. Indirect refusal is the negative case: 0.95 probe accuracy collapsing to a 0.43 flip rate under length-normalised teacher forcing, because the current minimal pairs conflate politeness with continuation length.
  I also specify Pragmatic Representation Steering, a parameter-free inference-time method that edits residual-stream activations along the class-mean-difference directions probing identifies. Feasibility is argued indirectly rather than demonstrated: the contrastive activation addition baseline, the same geometry the method would inject, recovers probe accuracy within one to two points of logistic regression wherever a linear signal exists. Scaling to Llama-3.1-Swallow-8B is the next step.

AI.tldr: 本文提出J-PragEval-v0，一个针对日语语用现象（敬语、内外群体指代、语境敏感礼貌、零主语省略）的最小对基准，结合线性探针和teacher-forced对数概率评估来定位TinySwallow-1.5B内部这些语用对比的表征位置。发现敬语在残差流中可线性解码（0.96准确率），隐式主语和群体内指代在生成过程中而非提示token处解决，间接拒绝则因最小对混淆了礼貌与续写长度而失败。作者还提出Pragmatic Representation Steering这一无参数推理时干预方法。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在英语上表现良好，但在类型学上远离英语的语言（如日语）上行为难以理解。现有日文评估依赖翻译质量和JGLUE式基准，将词汇、句法和语用能力混为一谈。作者发现通用模型在日语上失败的关键在于语用层面，而非表面流利度，因此需要专门的基准来隔离并定位这些语用现象。
AI.method: 1）构建J-PragEval-v0最小对基准，隔离四种语用现象；2）使用线性探针（linear probes）在残差流中检测语用对比是否可线性解码；3）使用teacher-forced对数概率评估检测生成时对比是否被解决；4）提出Pragmatic Representation Steering（PRS），一种无参数推理时方法，沿探针识别的类均值差方向编辑残差流激活。
AI.result: 敬语寄存器在第15层残差流中达到0.96平衡准确率，93%的项目中模型反转偏好续写。隐式主语（0.48）和群体内指代（0.38）在最终提示token处不可线性解码，但翻转率分别为0.77和0.79，表明对比在生成过程中解决。间接拒绝是负面案例：探针准确率0.95但翻转率仅0.43，因为最小对混淆了礼貌与续写长度。对比激活加法基线在存在线性信号处可恢复探针准确率，差距在1-2个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 四种语用特征在模型内部以三种不同方式分布：敬语作为静态寄存器存储在残差流中，隐式主语和群体内指代是生成过程中的动态计算，间接拒绝则被当前基准设计缺陷所掩盖。PRS方法的可行性通过对比激活加法基线间接论证，下一步是扩展到Llama-3.1-Swallow-8B。

title: ExaModels.jl: an Algebraic Modeling System for Nonlinear Programming on GPUs
summary: Large-scale nonlinear programs almost always exhibit partially separable and repetitive structure, yet most existing algebraic modeling systems do not take advantage of it. A nonlinear optimization solver queries the objective, the constraints, and their derivatives at every iteration, so the speed of these evaluations bears directly on the overall solution time. We present ExaModels.jl, a Julia-based algebraic modeling system that exploits this structure to evaluate the objective, the constraints, and their derivatives in parallel. At its core is a single-instruction, multiple-data abstraction that represents a nonlinear program as a small number of algebraic patterns, each repeated over many data points. Because the patterns are visible at compile time, a specialized model and derivative evaluation kernel is compiled for each pattern. Applying that kernel independently across the data points maps naturally onto GPU parallelism and, with sufficiently many threads, yields O(1) evaluation time regardless of the number of data points. On the largest instances of the Luksan-Vlcek library, GPU execution speeds up sparse Hessian evaluation by 76x over single-threaded CPU evaluation, and by 30x on COPS and 7.3x on PGLIB-OPF.

AI.tldr: ExaModels.jl 是一个基于 Julia 的代数建模系统，利用大规模非线性规划中普遍存在的部分可分离和重复结构，通过 SIMD 抽象将非线性规划表示为少量代数模式，每个模式重复应用于大量数据点。该系统为每种模式在编译期生成专用求值内核，并在 GPU 上并行执行，从而在足够多线程下实现与数据点数无关的 O(1) 求值时间。在 Luksan-Vlcek 库最大实例上，GPU 的稀疏 Hessian 求值相比单线程 CPU 加速 76 倍。
AI.motivation: 大规模非线性规划通常具有部分可分离和重复的结构，但现有代数建模系统大多未利用这一特性。由于非线性优化求解器每次迭代都要查询目标函数、约束及其导数，这些求值的速度直接影响整体求解时间，因此需要一种能利用结构并行加速求值的建模系统。
AI.method: 该方法提出一个 SIMD（单指令多数据）抽象，将非线性规划表示为一小组代数模式，每个模式在多个数据点上重复。由于模式在编译期可见，系统为每个模式编译专用的模型和导数求值内核；将内核独立应用于各数据点自然映射到 GPU 并行，从而在大规模实例上实现近乎常数时间的求值。
AI.result: 在 Luksan-Vlcek 库的最大实例上，GPU 执行将稀疏 Hessian 求值速度提升 76 倍（相比单线程 CPU）；在 COPS 上加速 30 倍，在 PGLIB-OPF 上加速 7.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: ExaModels.jl 证明了通过编译期模式识别和 GPU 并行求值，可以大幅加速利用结构的大规模非线性规划建模与求解过程，为代数建模系统的发展提供了新方向。

title: Discrete Diffusion Language Models Are Training-Free Multi-Label Classifiers
comment: Accepted to SIAM SDM 2026, 39 pages
summary:
We present dLLM-SetScore, a training-free method that uses discrete masked-diffusion language models for multi-label text classification. For each candidate label, it asks a short yes/no question and compares the probabilities of the two answer tokens at one masked position. The method uses no task-specific fine-tuning or training on textual-entailment datasets; a 200-example labelled validation slice selects thresholds, temperature, and prompt wording.
  We first show that placing all labels in one prompt creates a strong slot-position asymmetry: the first answer slot is predicted positive on $99.4\%$ of GoEmotions examples and $100\%$ of Reuters examples. Per-label scoring places every label in the same syntactic position, making predictions invariant to label order and avoiding this artifact. We evaluate LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B on six datasets against NLI models, an autoregressive LLM, SetFit, and supervised classifiers. On the five datasets shared by both diffusion families, Instruct checkpoints improve macro-F1 in 9 of 10 comparisons and micro-F1 in 8 of 10, although these comparisons do not identify the cause. Within our protocol, LLaDA-Instruct records the highest training-free values for both Reuters and ECtHR metrics. We prove permutation invariance, characterize thresholded decisions under weighted Hamming loss, and derive shortlist ceilings for recall and F1. An exploratory local Joint Set Refinement step lowers F1 from biased and unbiased initializations and is retained as a negative result.

AI.tldr: 提出dLLM-SetScore，一种无需训练的离散掩码扩散语言模型多标签文本分类方法。每个候选标签以简短是非问句形式询问，比较掩码位置两个答案token的概率。无需任务特定微调，仅用200个标注验证样本选择阈值、温度和提示词。论文发现将多个标签放入同一提示会产生槽位位置不对称伪影（第一个答案槽位在GoEmotions上99.4%、Reuters上100%被预测为正），而逐标签评分可避免该问题。在六个数据集上评估LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B，与NLI模型、自回归LLM等对比，证明排列不变性并给出理论分析。
AI.motivation: 多标签文本分类传统上依赖微调或训练，而扩散语言模型作为新兴生成范式虽有潜力但尚未被系统应用于该任务。作者发现将多个标签置于同一提示会引发严重的位置偏差伪影，因此需要设计一种规避该伪影、无需训练且理论上可靠的多标签分类方法。
AI.method: 利用离散掩码扩散语言模型（LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B），对每个标签构造是非问句，仅在一个掩码位置比较"Yes/No"两个答案token的预测概率。通过200个标注样本的验证集选择阈值、温度和提示词措辞。每个标签独立置于相同句法位置以保证排列不变性。此外提供了理论分析：排列不变性证明、加权Hamming损失下阈值化决策的表征、以及召回的shortlist上限推导。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上评估，覆盖GoEmotions和Reuters等。Instruct检查点在五个共享数据集上9/10的macro-F1和8/10的micro-F1对比中优于基线。LLaDA-Instruct在Reuters和ECtHR上取得训练-free方法最高值。实验还发现Joint Set Refinement步骤反而降低F1，作为阴性结果保留。
AI.conclusion: 逐标签评分是规避扩散LLM多标签提示中槽位位置偏差的有效策略，训练-free的dLLM-SetScore在多个数据集上展现出竞争力。论文同时通过理论证明保证了方法的排列不变性等性质，并诚实地报告了失败的细化尝试，为后续研究提供了清晰的经验与理论参考。

title: Unified Embodiment Description for functional evaluation of used components in circular manufacturing systems
comment: 24 pages, 12 figures, submitted to the Journal of Manufacturing Systems' special issue about circular factories, the manuscript is under review
summary: Circular manufacturing systems require functional evaluation of used components based on their physical state. Existing approaches describe this state from separate perspectives, such as design, manufacturing, and degradation, resulting in fragmented and incompatible representations. As a consequence, the physical state cannot be reliably linked to the functional behavior of the corresponding subsystem, which is a prerequisite for informed R-strategy decisions. This paper introduces the Unified Embodiment Description (UED), a state-dependent representation of mechanical components structured into two coupled layers. The first layer is a unified characteristic space, which adapts and extends as new lifecycle effects emerge. The second layer consists of functionally derived tolerance regions that link these embodiment characteristics to the functional behavior of the surrounding subsystem. A supporting UED method guides the model-building process of both layers. The UED is demonstrated in a case study on the spindle shaft of an angle grinder, in which manufacturing variations and degradation patterns such as polishing wear and scratches are quantified. These embodiment changes are embedded into the unified characteristic space and translated into functionally derived tolerance regions through experimental testing of the spindle-bearing subsystem. The results show that embodiment changes induced over the lifecycle can be consistently integrated within the unified characteristic space and that the relations between embodiment and functional behavior can be quantified to support end of life decisions. Overall, the UED provides a foundation for embodiment modeling that adapts to component state and enables decision-making based on functional evaluation for used components in circular manufacturing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一具身描述（UED）框架，用于在循环制造系统中对使用过的机械部件进行状态依赖的功能评估。UED包含两个耦合层：统一特征空间（可随生命周期效应扩展）和功能派生公差区域（将特征与子系统功能行为关联），并通过角磨机主轴箱案例验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法从设计、制造、退化等独立视角描述部件物理状态，导致表征碎片化且不兼容，无法可靠地将物理状态与子系统功能行为联系起来，而这恰是循环制造中R策略决策的前提。
AI.method: 提出统一具身描述（UED），包含两个耦合层：第一层为统一特征空间，可适应并扩展新出现的生命周期效应；第二层为功能派生公差区域，将具身特征与周围子系统的功能行为关联。配套的UED方法指导两层模型的构建。
AI.result: 在角磨机主轴案例中，制造变异和退化模式（抛光磨损、划痕）被量化并整合进统一特征空间，通过主轴-轴承子系统实验测试转化为功能派生公差区域。结果表明生命周期中的具身变化可一致整合，具身与功能行为的关系可量化以支持寿命末期决策。
AI.conclusion: UED为适应部件状态的具身建模提供了基础，使循环制造系统中基于功能评估的旧部件决策成为可能。

title: RouteTS: Frequency-Time Routing for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Real-world time series inherently intertwine global periodic structures with localized non-stationary variations. Existing approaches process these heterogeneous dynamics within a single computational domain, incurring fundamental limitations: time-domain models suffer from periodic misalignment over long horizons, while frequency-domain models over-smooth transient spikes. We argue that the optimal computational domain is not a property of the model, but of the data itself. Based on this principle, we propose RouteTS, a unified forecasting framework that partitions the frequency spectrum via amplitude routing and delegates components to their mathematically optimal domains. Dominant frequencies are processed by a complex-valued linear predictor in the frequency domain to preserve periodic structure, while residual spectral energy is reverted to the time domain and modeled by a lightweight MLP for local variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RouteTS achieves competitive prediction accuracy across diverse real-world datasets, with routing decisions guided by the underlying spectral signature. Furthermore, the lightweight design of RouteTS provides significant computational efficiency advantages, offering a principled solution to the longstanding dilemma between global periodicity and local transience.

AI.tldr: RouteTS是一个统一的时序预测框架，通过振幅路由将频谱分区：主导频率成分在频域用复数线性预测器处理以保留周期结构，残余频谱能量回到时域用轻量MLP建模局部变化，从而实现全局周期性与局部非平稳性的最优域分配。
AI.motivation: 现实时序数据同时包含全局周期结构和局部非平稳变化，现有方法在单一计算域中处理这些异构动态存在根本局限：时域模型在长时域预测中出现周期错位，频域模型则过度平滑瞬时尖峰。作者认为最优计算域不是模型属性，而是数据本身的属性，因此需要一种自适应的域分配机制。
AI.method: RouteTS框架通过振幅路由机制对频谱进行分区：将主导频率成分分配给频域中的复数线性预测器以保持周期结构，将残余频谱能量重新转回时域，由轻量级MLP建模局部变化。路由决策由数据的底层频谱特征驱动。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上，RouteTS达到了具有竞争力的预测精度，路由决策由频谱特征引导。此外，其轻量设计提供了显著的计算效率优势。
AI.conclusion: RouteTS为全局周期性与局部瞬态之间的长期困境提供了原则性解决方案，表明计算域应基于数据特征动态选择，而非固定于模型。

title: Do LLM Agents Negotiate Rationally? A Mechanism-Design Framework for Verifiable Multi-Agent Interaction over A2A/MCP
comment: 20 pages , 3 tables
summary:
Modern LLM-agent frameworks increasingly interoperate through standards such as Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-to-tool access and Google's Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol for agent delegation and negotiation. However, these protocols specify transport and discovery rather than strategic correctness and do not guarantee efficient, individually rational, or strategy-proof outcomes.
  We introduce a framework that (i) encodes classical negotiation mechanisms, including alternating-offers bargaining and Vickrey-Clarke-Groves-style auctions, as constraints over A2A message schemas; (ii) provides a lightweight runtime verification and repair layer that checks messages against protocol invariants; and (iii) offers a benchmark of negotiation and allocation tasks with known optimal solutions for measuring deviations from game-theoretic predictions.
  We evaluate multiple LLM backbones using unstructured dialogue, structured protocols, and structured protocols with verification. Across negotiation trials (N=30 per condition), verification reduces outcome variance, while structured protocols achieve 100 percent success for both models. After correcting parser artifacts, audited unstructured baselines achieve approximately 97 percent and 93.3 percent success.
  In auction experiments (N=30 per model), both models achieve 100 percent efficient allocation but differ sharply in truthful bidding: one bids its exact valuation in every trial, whereas the other does so in only 3.3 percent of trials. Thus, mechanism-level incentive compatibility does not automatically transfer to LLM-agent behavior. A three-party fair-allocation task produced only 4.2 percent usable outcomes; we report this negative result with a diagnosis. This work bridges classical multi-agent systems theory and modern LLM-agent infrastructure and defines verifiable interaction at the A2A protocol layer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个在A2A协议层面对LLM智能体协商行为进行验证与修复的框架，将经典博弈论机制（如交替报价谈判和VCG拍卖）编码为协议约束，并配套基准测试。实验发现结构化协议加验证能提升成功率并降低方差，但机制层面激励相容性并不能自动迁移到LLM智能体行为上。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体框架通过MCP和A2A等标准实现互操作，但这些协议只规定了传输和发现机制，无法保证智能体协商结果的策略正确性（如效率、个体理性、激励相容性），亟需在协议层引入博弈论约束与验证机制。
AI.method: (i) 将经典协商机制（交替报价谈判、VCG拍卖）编码为A2A消息模式上的约束；(ii) 提供轻量级运行时验证与修复层，检查消息是否违反协议不变量；(iii) 构建包含已知最优解的协商与分配任务基准，用于衡量与博弈论预测的偏差。
AI.result: 协商实验（每条件N=30）中，验证机制降低结果方差，结构化协议在两个模型上均达100%成功率；经解析器伪影修正后，非结构化基线分别约为97%和93.3%。拍卖实验中两个模型均实现100%高效分配，但诚实出价差异显著：一个模型每轮都报出真实估值，另一个仅3.3%轮次如此。三方公平分配任务仅产生4.2%可用结果。
AI.conclusion: 机制层面的激励相容性不会自动传递到LLM智能体行为中；将经典多智能体系统理论与现代LLM智能体基础设施桥接，可在A2A协议层定义可验证的交互，但需要更深入的机制设计来确保LLM遵循博弈论理性。

title: How Do Agents Fail on AutoResearch: End-to-End Diagnostic Evaluation on 100 Real-World Frontier Research Tasks
comment: *Equal Contribution (alphabetical order by last name)
summary: AI has long assisted scientific research, but the rapid advance of LLMs and agentic scaffolds is reshaping the landscape; a single system can now carry whole-stage research from an initial hypothesis all the way to final published paper, which is a paradigm now referred to as AutoResearch. Existing evaluations reveal little about how these agents operate or where they break down. Tasks are narrowly-scoped, evaluation measures performance but not process, and failure diagnoses lack systematic coverage or artifact-level visibility. To address this gap, we introduce AutoResearchEval, featuring 100 tasks grounded in published frontier science across 7 scientific domains and the full research lifecycle, including ideation, retrieval, execution, analysis, writing, and review. Evaluating 8 harness-model combinations yields 800 autoresearch agent trajectories, with process-level annotation. We organize these insights into AutoResearch Failure Taxonomy or ARFT, a framework of 45 empirically-grounded failure patterns. To enable scalable fine-grained attribution, we leverage a human-calibrated agent-as-a-judge pipeline to inspect complete trajectories and intermediate artifacts. Failure patterns converge on a single overarching limitation, namely that current agents lack a metacognitive loop, which entails the ability to check what they produced against what they found, revise when it does not hold up, and question whether the path they took was sound. The same patterns recur across all 8 harness-model combinations, including the strongest models tested, locating the deficit at the model level rather than in any particular scaffold; whether orchestration-level interventions can close it is an open question this work does not test. We publicly release AutoResearchEval and ARFT to facilitate continued research and development in autonomous scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoResearchEval基准，包含100个基于前沿科学出版物的任务，覆盖7个科学领域和完整研究生命周期（构思、检索、执行、分析、写作、评审）。通过评估8种harness-model组合生成800条带过程级标注的agent轨迹，并构建了包含45种经验失败模式的AutoResearch Failure Taxonomy（ARFT）框架。研究发现所有agent共同缺乏"元认知循环"能力，且这一缺陷存在于模型层面而非脚手架层面。
AI.motivation: 现有对AutoResearch（LLM驱动的全流程自动科研）的评估存在三大不足：任务范围狭窄、只衡量性能而不关注过程、失败诊断缺乏系统性覆盖和工件级可见性。研究者希望深入理解这些自主科研agent如何运作以及在哪里失败。
AI.method: 构建AutoResearchEval基准（100个任务、7个领域、全生命周期），评估8种harness-model组合得到800条轨迹，进行过程级标注；提出ARFT框架归纳45种失败模式；使用人类校准的agent-as-a-judge管道实现可扩展的细粒度归因，检查完整轨迹和中间工件。
AI.result: 失败模式收敛于一个核心局限：当前agent缺乏元认知循环（检查产出与发现是否一致、不一致时修订、反思路径是否合理）。该模式在全部8种harness-model组合中反复出现，包括最强模型，说明缺陷位于模型层面而非特定脚手架。
AI.conclusion: 公开发布AutoResearchEval和ARFT以促进自主科学发现领域的持续研究。同时指出编排层干预能否弥补模型层面的元认知缺陷仍是待解答的开放问题。

title: Stochastic Gradient Tracking over Time-Varying Networks: One-Step Lyapunov Analysis
summary: We study decentralized stochastic gradient tracking over a time-varying network of $N$ agents under a uniform window-mixing condition. Products of $τ$ consecutive doubly stochastic mixing matrices contract disagreement by a factor $λ<1$, although individual matrices need not contract disagreement strictly and individual communication graphs may be disconnected. We construct a time-varying quadratic norm that turns this window contraction into an exact one-step Lyapunov identity. This leads to coupled one-step recursions for the centroid and disagreement errors, without unrolling the dynamics over communication windows. For smooth strongly convex objectives, the leading stochastic term is $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(1/(NK))$; for smooth convex objectives, it is $\mathcal O(1/\sqrt{NK})$. Both match their centralized mini-batch counterparts and yield linear speedup after a network-dependent transient.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了时变网络下N个智能体的分布式随机梯度跟踪算法，在均匀窗口混合条件下，通过构造时变二次范数将窗口收缩转化为精确的一步Lyapunov恒等式，从而将质心与不一致误差的耦合一步递推关系解耦，证明了强凸目标下随机项为Õ(1/(NK))，凸目标下为O(1/√(NK))，均与集中式小批量方法匹配，并在网络相关暂态后实现线性加速。
AI.motivation: 现有随机梯度跟踪算法分析通常要求每步通信图严格连通或每步混合矩阵严格收缩，这在实际时变网络中往往不成立。作者希望放宽这一假设，仅要求经过τ步窗口后的乘积收缩不一致性，从而覆盖更实际的场景（如个别时刻图不连通）。
AI.method: 1) 引入均匀窗口混合条件：τ个连续双随机混合矩阵的乘积以因子λ<1收缩不一致性。2) 构造一个时变二次范数，将窗口收缩转化为精确的一步Lyapunov恒等式，避免展开动态过程。3) 利用该Lyapunov框架推导质心误差与不一致误差的耦合一步递推关系。4) 分别针对光滑强凸和光滑凸目标函数进行分析。
AI.result: 对于光滑强凸目标函数，领先随机项为Õ(1/(NK))；对于光滑凸目标函数，领先随机项为O(1/√(NK))。这两项均与集中式小批量随机梯度方法的收敛率匹配，并在网络相关的暂态之后实现线性加速（即与N呈反比）。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在仅需窗口混合条件（而非严格逐步行混合）的时变网络下，随机梯度跟踪算法仍能达到与集中式方法相当的最优收敛率，并实现线性加速。这显著推广了现有结果对每步网络连通性的要求。

title: Ring-based Spatial Transformer: Learning Non-linear Spatial Interactions between Building Distribution and Pedestrian Flow
summary: This study proposes a ring-based SpatialTransformer to learn how building uses at different distances from a railway station interact to generate pedestrian flow. Concentric ring buffers at 100-meter intervals up to 800 meters were defined around 100 randomly selected stations in Tokyo, treating each ring as a spatial token. Self-Attention was applied to learn inter-zone interactions directly from data, without prior structural assumptions. GPS-derived walking trip counts served as the target variable and Geographically Weighted Regression as the baseline. Across 30 independent trials, the SpatialTransformer consistently outperformed GWR in predictive accuracy. SHAP analysis revealed that mid-to-outer distance zone features dominate pedestrian flow prediction, while features from the 0-100m zone contributed little. The attention matrix showed that each distance zone attends most strongly to spatially distant zones, demonstrating that pedestrian flow is regulated by structural interactions across the entire catchment area rather than by any single zone in isolation. These findings challenge the compact city assumption that station-proximate development maximizes pedestrian flow, and suggest that land use distribution across the full walkable catchment area deserves greater consideration in urban planning practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于环形缓冲区的SpatialTransformer模型，用于学习火车站周边不同距离圈层土地利用与步行流量之间的交互关系。模型在东京100个车站的预测中优于GWR基线，并通过SHAP和注意力矩阵分析发现：中远距离圈层特征对步行流量预测起主导作用，各圈层间存在远距离交互，挑战了"紧凑城市"假设。
AI.motivation: 传统步行流量预测通常假设车站邻近区域（0-100米）的土地利用对步行流量贡献最大（紧凑城市假设），但忽略了车站步行范围内不同距离圈层之间土地利用的交互作用。作者希望突破先验结构假设，直接从数据中学习各距离区间之间的空间交互关系。
AI.method: 1) 在东京100个随机选取的车站周围定义从100米到800米、间隔100米的8个同心环形缓冲区；2) 将每个环形视为一个空间token；3) 应用Self-Attention机制学习圈层间的交互作用，无需预设结构假设；4) 以GPS衍生的步行出行量为目标变量，以地理加权回归（GWR）作为基线模型；5) 使用SHAP分析特征重要性，并通过注意力矩阵揭示圈层间的注意力模式。
AI.result: 在30次独立试验中，SpatialTransformer在预测精度上始终优于GWR。SHAP分析显示中远距离圈层特征主导步行流量预测，而0-100米圈层贡献甚微。注意力矩阵表明每个距离圈层最关注空间上较远的圈层，说明步行流量由整个步行集水区的结构性交互共同调节，而非任何单一圈层独立决定。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现挑战了"紧凑城市"假设（即车站紧邻区域开发最大化步行流量），表明整个可步行集水区的土地利用分布对步行流量有更重要的调节作用，应在城市规划实践中给予更大关注。

title: Paired Exact-Reset Evaluation of a Prediction-Derived Medium-to-Full World-Model Cascade
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables
summary: Existing adaptive-inference and world-action-model systems use cheap-stage outputs or predicted futures to allocate additional computation. We study a narrower question: under paired exact-reset physical outcomes, can a Medium-derived interface predict when switching to a separately frozen Full predictor improves task-specific decision loss enough to justify sequential overhead? Our contribution is a paired evaluation and audit protocol, not a new generic routing rule: all candidate actions are executed from the same reset state, Medium and Full act on the same candidate set and task, and their paired physical-loss difference defines the routing target. On a fresh PushT bank (V106; 1,600 states, 39 tasks, three checkpoint pairs), a frozen prediction-interface router lowers overhead-inclusive decision cost relative to standalone Medium, standalone Full, and a latency-advantaged task-only router. We then prospectively seal a second 1,600-state PushT confirmation (V107) against a stronger current-state control using the task, a dimension-matched projection of current DINO features, and all five candidate actions, with no DINO encoder latency charged. The prediction interface lowers priced physical decision cost by 0.002549 (state-clustered 95% interval [-0.002867, -0.002238]; one-sided 95% upper bound -0.002286), with negative effects for all three checkpoint pairs. A controlled-PyBullet audit independently supports a composite task-prediction-regime router. The sequential router remains slower than fixed policies, and its advantage is restricted to low compute prices. The evidence supports incremental routing information in the tested prediction interface beyond one deliberately favoured current-DINO control, but not causal sufficiency, compute saving, closed-loop value, or cross-family generality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种配对评估与审计协议，用于判断Medium预测接口是否能在精确重置的物理结果下，判断何时切换到冻结的Full预测器以改进任务特定决策损失。在PushT基准（V106与前瞻密封的V107）上验证了预测接口路由器的增量路由信息价值，但明确否定了因果充分性、计算节省、闭环价值与跨家族泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应推理和世界-动作模型系统利用廉价阶段输出或预测的未来来分配额外计算，但缺乏严格的配对协议来评估"何时切换"这一路由决策是否真正改善任务特定决策损失，且未考虑顺序推理的开销。
AI.method: 提出配对评估与审计协议：所有候选动作从同一重置状态执行，Medium和Full作用于同一候选集与任务，以配对物理损失差定义路由目标。采用冻结的预测接口路由器，并在V107前瞻密封验证中对比更强的当前状态控制（任务、维度匹配的当前DINO特征投影及五个候选动作），且不收取DINO编码器延迟。
AI.result: V107上预测接口将定价物理决策成本降低0.002549（状态聚类95%区间[-0.002867,-0.002238]），三个检查点对均为负效应。控制PyBullet审计独立支持复合任务-预测-体制路由器。但顺序路由器比固定策略慢，优势仅限于低计算价格场景。
AI.conclusion: 测试的预测接口在超越被刻意偏好的当前DINO控制方面具有增量路由信息，但不支持因果充分性、计算节省、闭环价值或跨家族泛化性的结论。

title: Reliability-Constrained Hybrid Beamforming for Multistatic ISAC in Vehicular Networks
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures
summary: This letter investigates reliability constrained hybrid beamforming for transceiver separated multistatic integrated sensing and communication in vehicular networks. A target position Cramer Rao bound minimization problem is formulated under outage probability, transmit-power, and analog constant modulus constraints. To handle the constrained non convex problem, we develop a proportional-integral Lagrangian proximal policy optimization algorithm. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm keeps the average outage probability at or below the reliability threshold, around 8%-10%, improves constraint satisfaction, and achieves stable sensing performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了车辆网络中收发分离多静态集成感知与通信的可靠性约束混合波束成形问题，提出了一种比例积分拉格朗日近端策略优化算法来解决目标位置克拉美罗界最小化问题，仿真表明该算法能将平均中断概率维持在可靠性阈值以下（约8%-10%），同时提高约束满足度并实现稳定的感知性能。
AI.motivation: 在车辆网络中，集成感知与通信需要满足可靠性要求，而收发分离的多静态架构下混合波束成形设计面临中断概率、发射功率和模拟恒模等多重约束，传统方法难以高效求解此非凸优化问题。
AI.method: 首先构建目标位置克拉美罗界最小化问题，并施加中断概率、发射功率和模拟恒模约束；随后提出比例积分拉格朗日近端策略优化（PIL-PPO）算法来处理该约束非凸优化问题，通过比例积分机制增强约束满足能力。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提算法能将平均中断概率维持在可靠性阈值或以下（约8%-10%），相比基线方法具有更好的约束满足度，同时获得稳定的感知性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了基于比例积分拉格朗日PPO的深度强化学习方法在解决多静态ISAC系统混合波束成形中的有效性，为复杂约束下的集成感知与通信设计提供了新的解决思路。

title: Rethinking Reverse KL as Adaptive Entropy Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to transfer the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to smaller students, but existing objectives often struggle to balance faithful imitation and robust generation. In particular, existing methods mainly combine FKL and RKL, overlooking that RKL itself provides a mechanism for adjusting the student's imitation strength. Motivated by this, we revisit on-policy Reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) distillation and decompose its objective into a teacher-fitting term and a student-entropy term, without introducing an explicit FKL branch. We show theoretically that the token-level optimal student distribution corresponds to a tempered variant of the teacher distribution, where the adaptive weight controls the trade-off between mode-seeking and uncertainty preservation. Guided by this insight, we propose \textbf{Adaptive Entropy Distillation (AED)}, which uses the teacher's entropy to dynamically calibrate token-level imitation strength. Experiments on instruction-following and mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that AED achieves superior overall performance and generally improves teacher--student distributional and entropy alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应熵蒸馏（AED），重新审视on-policy反向KL（RKL）蒸馏，将其目标分解为教师拟合项和学生熵项，无需显式引入前向KL分支。理论证明token级最优学生分布是教师分布的tempered变体，通过教师熵动态校准token级模仿强度，在指令遵循和数学推理基准上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有知识蒸馏方法主要结合FKL和RKL，但忽略了RKL本身已具备调节学生模仿强度的机制。已有目标在忠实模仿与稳健生成之间难以取得平衡。
AI.method: 重新审视on-policy RKL蒸馏，将其目标分解为教师拟合项和学生熵项；理论推导token级最优学生分布为教师分布的tempered版本，自适应权重控制模式寻求与不确定性保持的权衡；据此提出AED，利用教师熵动态校准token级模仿强度。
AI.result: 在指令遵循和数学推理基准上，AED取得了优越的整体性能，并普遍改善了师生分布对齐和熵对齐。
AI.conclusion: RKL本身可以提供调节学生模仿强度的机制，通过教师熵引导的自适应校准，AED在没有显式FKL分支的情况下实现了更好的蒸馏效果。

title: Large Language Models and their Awareness of Mechanics and Spatial Geometry
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on established code-generation and mathematical-reasoning benchmarks, but their capabilities in mechanics and spatial geometry, here denoted as mechanical engineering awareness, has not been quantified systematically. We present MecEng, a fully automated benchmark that evaluates LLMs on the creation of multibody simulation models from parameterized textual descriptions. The benchmark comprises 84 generic tasks on three difficulty levels, ranging from rigid-body systems with joints and contact to flexible multibody systems that require exact 3D geometry generation, tetrahedral finite-element meshing, and Hurty-Craig-Bampton model order reduction of machine parts. A dedicated pipeline with LLMs generates simulation-ready geometry from text using Netgen, and builds multibody system models for the code Exudyn, which are then verified against expert ground truth on several levels: system-graph isomorphism including graph node annotations, numerical solutions, and part-specific measures such as mass, geometry, and eigenfrequencies. In total, 32 open-weight and two proprietary LLMs are evaluated. On rigid-body tasks, the best open-weight model obtains an overall success rate of 86.0%, compared to 91.4% for the strongest proprietary model, while flexible multibody tasks remain considerably harder. Additional studies quantify the influence of sampling temperature, reasoning, prompt design, model size, and LLM-release date. The results indicate rapidly improving, but still error-prone, mechanical engineering awareness of current LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MecEng基准，一个全自动评估LLM机械工程意识的基准，包含84个多体仿真建模任务（三个难度等级），通过系统图同构、数值解和部件属性等多层次验证。评估了32个开源和2个专有LLM，发现最优开源模型在刚体任务上成功率86.0%，专有模型91.4%，柔性多体任务更难。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在代码生成和数学推理基准上表现良好，但机械力学和空间几何能力（称为机械工程意识）尚未被系统量化评估，缺乏专门的基准来测试LLM在多体仿真建模方面的能力。
AI.method: 构建MecEng基准：包含84个参数化文本描述的多体仿真建模任务（三个难度等级），通过专用pipeline让LLM使用Netgen生成仿真几何，构建Exudyn多体系统模型，并在系统图同构（含节点标注）、数值解、质量/几何/固有频率等部件层面与专家真值验证。
AI.result: 评估了32个开源和2个专有LLM。刚体任务中最好的开源模型成功率86.0%，最强专有模型91.4%；柔性多体任务显著更难。还量化了采样温度、推理、提示设计、模型大小和发布日期的影响。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM的机械工程意识正在快速提升但仍易出错，机械工程意识能力与模型规模和发布时间相关。

title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification
comment: Preprint
summary:
Open-weight language models are fine-tuned, quantized, pruned, and merged, yet their provenance is often undocumented. We study data-free white-box lineage verification: can weights alone reveal whether two compatible model checkpoints share ancestry?
  Residual training produces a shared identity-aligned component in branch products, so this structure alone cannot establish ancestry. We remove it and compare checkpoint-specific structure across residual blocks, yielding a symmetric lineage score calibrated against independent checkpoints. On residual-MLP and GPT-2 benchmarks, the score separates fine-tuned, LoRA-merged, pruned, and quantized descendants from independent and distilled models (AUROC=1.0), distinguishing weight ancestry from behavioral similarity. Under function-preserving checkpoint laundering experiments, weight-space baselines lose margin or fail; our score remains unchanged and runs 76x faster than the nearest robust baseline on GPT-2. The projection-pairing signal appears across six language-model families and beyond, and a case study correctly identifies 3 related and 7 unrelated LLaMA-2 public checkpoints. Collectively, these results establish a passive, data-free provenance signal for compatible open-weight language-model checkpoints

AI.tldr: 本文研究无需数据的白盒模型谱系验证问题，提出通过去除身份对齐分量后比较残差块中的检查点特定结构，从而构建对称的谱系评分，能在各种模型操作（微调、LoRA合并、剪枝、量化）后可靠区分权重祖先关系与行为相似性。
AI.motivation: 开放权重语言模型经常被微调、量化、剪枝和合并，但它们的来源（谱系）往往缺乏文档记录。作者希望仅凭权重就能验证两个兼容的模型检查点是否共享祖先，建立一个被动的、无需数据的谱系验证信号。
AI.method: 论文发现残差训练会在分支产物中产生共享的身份对齐分量，因此这种结构本身不能建立谱系关系。作者去掉该分量后，跨残差块比较检查点特有的结构，得到对称的谱系评分，并在独立检查点上进行校准。
AI.result: 在residual-MLP和GPT-2基准上，该方法能够将微调、LoRA合并、剪枝和量化的后代与独立及蒸馏模型区分开（AUROC=1.0）。在功能保持的检查点洗白实验中，基于权重空间的基线方法失效，而该评分保持不变，且在GPT-2上比最接近的稳健基线快76倍。信号在六个语言模型家族中均有效，案例分析正确识别了3个相关和7个无关的LLaMA-2公开检查点。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果建立了针对兼容开放权重语言模型检查点的被动、无数据谱系验证信号，能够有效区分权重祖先关系与行为相似性，且在多种模型操作和洗白攻击下保持稳健性。

title: An Inexact Riemannian Proximal Momentum Variance-Reduced Method: Complexity Bounds and KL Sequential Convergence
summary: We develop a unified analysis of inexact stochastic Riemannian proximal optimization for finite-sum nonsmooth composite problems over compact embedded submanifolds. The framework accommodates variance-reduced gradient estimators, projected momentum, and inexact tangent-space proximal solves under a single conditional error-dissipation condition, verified for projection-based SVRG, SARAH/SPIDER, SAGA, and SAG. A computable Fenchel-dual residual criterion, with tolerance prescribed before sampling and inner iterations, enables explicit control of the inner work. We establish conditional expected descent, subsequential stationarity, and an \(O(ε^{-2})\) outer complexity. With SARAH/SPIDER and accumulative regularization, iRPMVR attains \(O(n+\sqrt n\,ε^{-2})\) component-gradient and \(O(ε^{-3})\) proximal-operator complexities. We further develop an abstract KL principle for conditional expected descent with memory and summable tails using only the ordinary pointwise KL property. A counterexample shows that a power-type expected-KL implication used in earlier stochastic analyses can fail. The principle yields almost-sure finite length, whole-sequence convergence, and deterministic KL rates.

AI.tldr: 本文针对紧致嵌入子流形上的有限和不可微复合问题，提出了一种统一的非精确随机黎曼近端优化分析框架，兼容方差缩减梯度估计、投影动量和非精确切空间近端求解，建立了条件期望下降、子序列平稳性和O(ε⁻²)外层复杂度，并发展了基于普通点态KL性质的抽象KL原理。
AI.motivation: 现有随机黎曼优化的分析通常针对特定算法分别进行，缺乏统一框架来涵盖方差缩减估计器（如SVRG、SARAH、SAGA等）、投影动量和非精确近端求解的组合。此外，早期随机分析中使用的幂型期望KL蕴含可能不成立，需要更稳健的理论工具来保证收敛性。
AI.method: 提出统一条件误差耗散条件，验证了基于投影的SVRG、SARAH/SPIDER、SAGA和SAG等估计器；引入可计算的Fenchel对偶残差准则，在采样前指定容差以显式控制内层工作量；结合SARAH/SPIDER与累积正则化提出iRPMVR算法；发展仅依赖普通点态KL性质的抽象KL原理，用于带记忆和可和尾项的条件期望下降序列分析。
AI.result: 建立了条件期望下降、子序列平稳性和O(ε⁻²)外层复杂度；iRPMVR达到O(n+√n·ε⁻²)分量梯度和O(ε⁻³)近端算子复杂度；KL原理给出几乎必然有限长度、全序列收敛和确定性KL速率；同时构造反例表明早期随机分析中使用的幂型期望KL蕴含可能失效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为流形上的非精确随机黎曼近端优化提供了统一且可验证的理论框架，显著放宽了收敛性分析所需的条件，并通过反例揭示并修正了既有文献中的理论缺陷，具有重要的理论价值和广泛的应用潜力。

title: NRCD: An Open Database of Collegiate Running with Unified Performance Standardization
comment: Accepted to CIKM'26 Resources Paper - Main Conference
summary: Collegiate running in the United States generates thousands of race results annually in cross country and track and field, yet no large-scale dataset has been publicly available for research. Existing websites such as Athletic.net, MileSplit, and TFRRS host results but do not support bulk download, restricting prior analyses to ~500 performances, often skewing studies toward male athletes. We introduce the National Running Club Database (NRCD), the first openly available collegiate running dataset at scale: 128,963 approved performances from 28,913 athletes across 1,336 meets in four sports (cross country (XC), indoor and outdoor track, and road races), 36.3% women, spanning 2004 through 2026. Within that single export, meets from August 2023 onward carry comprehensive course distance, elevation gain and loss, weather at race time, and track venue metadata (97.7% of XC rows with weather fields); earlier seasons back to 2004 are included with sparser metadata. NRCD is community-governed through open submission and expert approval and is maintained as a live database whose meet volume has grown yearly. We release a unified performance standardization framework that operationalizes established distance, elevation, and heat adjustments in one pipeline. Furthermore, we recommend gender-stratified modeling. On XC, full standardization lowers median within-athlete cross-meet variability by 51.0% (women) and 34.4% (men) versus raw times. We release the dataset and pipeline with a python package `nrcd' under FAIR principles, supporting longitudinal athlete modeling, environmental-confounder studies, and gender-equity research in collegiate sport.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了首个大规模公开的美国大学跑步数据库NRCD，包含128,963条成绩、28,913名运动员、1,336场比赛，覆盖越野、室内外田径和路跑四个项目，女性占36.3%，时间跨度2004-2026年。数据库由社区治理、专家审核，并配套统一性能标准化框架，可降低越野跑运动员跨赛事成绩变异性达51.0%（女性）和34.4%（男性）。
AI.motivation: 美国大学跑步每年产生数千场比赛成绩，但缺乏大规模公开数据集。现有网站（如Athletic.net、MileSplit、TFRRS）不支持批量下载，导致以往研究仅基于约500条成绩，且偏向男性运动员，限制了研究的代表性和性别公平性。
AI.method: 构建NRCD开源数据库：通过开放提交与专家审核流程收集数据，覆盖四类赛事（XC、室内/室外田径、公路赛），包含丰富元数据（赛道距离、海拔升降、实时天气、场地信息）。同时发布统一性能标准化框架，整合距离、海拔和高温校正，并推荐按性别分层的建模方法。
AI.result: 数据库包含128,963条经批准的成绩，来自28,913名运动员，覆盖1,336场比赛，女性占36.3%，时间跨度为2004-2026。2023年8月后的数据97.7%的XC记录附带天气信息。标准化框架将越野跑运动员跨赛事成绩变异性降低51.0%（女性）和34.4%（男性）。
AI.conclusion: NRCD以FAIR原则开源发布数据集与Python包，为纵向运动员建模、环境混杂因素研究和大学体育性别公平研究提供支撑，填补了该领域大规模公开数据的空白。

title: Pushing the Limits of High-Resolution Weather Forecasting through Data Scaling
comment: Accepted by ECCV2026
summary: The development of 0.1$^{\circ}$ global weather forecasting models based on machine learning (ML) is constrained by the limited availability of high-resolution data, as decades of reanalysis are only available at 0.25$^{\circ}$ resolution. While existing approaches fine-tune 0.25$^{\circ}$ forecast models on limited 0.1$^{\circ}$ samples, we show that this transfer is hindered by the irreversible information loss inherent in coarse-resolution forecasting. Therefore, we propose BaguanHR, a framework that shifts the focus from transferring models to transferring data. We first show that super-resolution (SR) has lower conditional entropy and input amplification than forecasting, making it a more robust vehicle for resolution transfer. By leveraging this advantage through variable-wise SR, we synthesize extensive 0.1$^{\circ}$ data from ERA5. BaguanHR's performance on the synthetic-plus-real dataset exceeds both ML-based methods and IFS-HRES, achieving superior performance across over 85% of the lead times within 72 hours. Furthermore, our findings highlight a power-law scaling effect, as a twofold increase in data reduces RMSE by 4.6% for 72-hour forecasting and 4.9% for 120-hour forecasting. Our results demonstrate that scaling high resolution ML-based forecasting is primarily a data bottleneck, and that variable-wise super-resolution provides a simple yet general solution to unlock long coarse-resolution reanalyses for high-resolution training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BaguanHR框架，通过"转移数据而非转移模型"的策略，利用变量级超分辨率(SR)技术将ERA5 0.25°粗分辨率再分析数据合成为0.1°高分辨率数据，解决高分辨率天气预测模型面临的训练数据瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 0.1°高分辨率全球天气预测模型的发展受限于高分辨率数据的稀缺（数十年再分析数据仅有0.25°分辨率）。现有方法通过对有限0.1°样本微调0.25°模型，但粗分辨率预测过程中存在不可逆的信息损失，阻碍了这种模型迁移的有效性。
AI.method: 提出BaguanHR框架，核心思想是从"转移模型"转向"转移数据"。首先论证超分辨率相比预测具有更低的条件熵和输入放大效应，是更稳健的分辨率迁移载体；然后利用变量级超分辨率(SR)技术从ERA5粗分辨率数据合成大量0.1°高分辨率训练数据。
AI.result: 在合成+真实数据集上的性能超越ML方法及IFS-HRES，在72小时内超过85%的预测时效上表现更优。发现幂律缩放效应：数据量翻倍可使72小时预测RMSE降低4.6%，120小时预测RMSE降低4.9%。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率ML预报的扩展主要受数据瓶颈制约，变量级超分辨率提供了一种简单且通用的解决方案，能够解锁长期粗分辨率再分析数据用于高分辨率训练。

title: PANDA:A Matrix-Free Differentiable NMPC Solver via Proximal Averaged Quasi-Newton with Adaptive Linesearch Algorithm
summary: Differentiable nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) provides a principled way to embed optimal control structure into end-to-end learning paradigms, but its practical use is often limited by the computational and memory costs of both forward optimization and backward sensitivity propagation. This brief proposes PANDA, a matrix-free solver for differentiable NMPC. In the forward pass, PANDA combines proximal-gradient iterations with quasi-Newton acceleration and introduces an adaptive stepsize enlargement mechanism to mitigate the conservativeness of monotone stepsize reduction. The resulting stepsize behavior and its effect on local convergence are theoretically analyzed. In the backward pass, PANDA performs implicit differentiation from the residual equation and computes adjoint sensitivities using Krylov-subspace iterative methods together with automatic-differentiation-based Matrix-Vector product operators, thereby avoiding explicit Hessian and Jacobian construction. The method is evaluated on a nonconvex trailer NMPC problem embedded in an imitation learning task. The results show that PANDA achieves much faster forward and backward computation and lower memory overhead than representative differentiable optimization solvers, while maintaining effective imitation learning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PANDA，一个面向可微分非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）的无矩阵求解器。前向传播结合近端梯度迭代与拟牛顿加速，并引入自适应步长扩大机制；反向传播通过隐式微分和Krylov子空间迭代方法计算伴随灵敏度，避免显式构造Hessian和Jacobian矩阵。在非凸拖车NMPC模仿学习任务上验证，计算速度和内存效率均优于代表性可微分优化求解器。
AI.motivation: 可微分NMPC将最优控制结构嵌入端到端学习框架，但其实际应用受限于前向优化和反向灵敏度传播的计算与内存开销。现有方法在求解效率和内存占用方面存在瓶颈，需要更高效的求解方案。
AI.method: PANDA求解器包含两个关键设计：前向传播采用近端梯度迭代结合拟牛顿加速，并引入自适应步长扩大机制来缓解单调步长缩减的保守性；反向传播基于残差方程进行隐式微分，使用Krylov子空间迭代方法配合自动微分实现的矩阵-向量积算子计算伴随灵敏度，从而避免了显式Hessian和Jacobian矩阵的构造。
AI.result: 在非凸拖车NMPC问题嵌入模仿学习任务的实验中，PANDA相比代表性可微分优化求解器，在前向和反向计算速度上显著更快，内存开销更低，同时保持了有效的模仿学习性能。
AI.conclusion: PANDA通过无矩阵策略和自适应步长机制，有效解决了可微分NMPC在计算和内存上的瓶颈，为端到端学习中的最优控制结构嵌入提供了一种高效实用的求解方案。

title: Generative Learning of Separatrices
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures
summary:
The identification and reconstruction of the boundaries separating basins of attraction in multistable, multidimensional dynamical systems presents a fundamental challenge in computational dynamics. These structures govern transition pathways and other important large timescale behavior, yet they remain typically under-sampled since their neighborhood does not get routinely visited during direct simulations. Traditional computational approaches face computational limitations in high-dimensional systems and require a priori knowledge of the dynamical system and its equations. Simplistic sampling methods such as random or uniform sampling of the phase space typically fail to quantitatively approximate separatrices and their structure altogether.
  We introduce and implement a framework that combines supervised classification with generative modeling to address this challenge. Our approach first trains neural network classifiers on uniformly or randomly sampled initial conditions labeled by their corresponding basins of attraction in the system of interest. Using uncertainty metrics of the trained classifier to quantify decision boundaries, the method then identifies these high uncertainty regions and boundaries of the classifier as preliminary approximate separatrices. Subsequently, score-based generative models are trained specifically on samples from high-uncertainty regions, ultimately generating densities of samples consistent with the empirical density of samples on or close to the manifold that constitutes the separatrix between basins in the sampled region. This approach leverages the complementary strengths of (a) discriminative models for global phase space partitioning and (b) generative models for detailed geometric sampling, resulting in a systematic, iterative, data-driven framework that produces empirically consistent reconstructions of (approximate) separatrix manifolds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合监督分类与生成建模的框架，用于重建多稳态高维动力系统中吸引域之间的分界线（separatrix）。该方法先用神经网络分类器对随机或均匀采样的初始条件进行分类，利用分类器的不确定性度量识别高不确定性区域作为初步分界线；随后在這些高不确定性区域上训练基于评分的生成模型，以生成与流形上经验密度一致的样本，从而系统性地重建近似分界线流形。
AI.motivation: 多稳态高维动力系统中吸引域边界（separatrix）的重建是计算动力学中的基本挑战。这些结构控制着系统的转变路径和长时间尺度行为，但在直接模拟中很少被访问，导致欠采样问题。传统计算方法受限于高维系统的计算负担，且需要先验的动力学方程知识；简单的随机或均匀采样方法无法定量近似分界线及其结构。因此需要一种不依赖方程先验、能有效处理高维系统的数据驱动方法。
AI.method: 该方法由两个核心组件构成：(1) 判别模型：在均匀或随机采样的初始条件上训练神经网络分类器，根据其不确定性度量（如预测置信度）识别高不确定性区域，这些区域对应近似的分界线候选；(2) 生成模型：专门在这些高不确定性区域采样并训练基于评分的生成模型（score-based generative models），生成与分界线流形附近经验样本密度一致的样本点，迭代地细化分界线的几何重建。该方法结合了判别模型在全局相空间划分上的优势与生成模型在细节几何采样上的优势。
AI.result: 该框架能够系统地、迭代地重建多稳态系统中近似分界线流形，生成与经验密度一致的样本分布。通过判别模型实现全局相空间分区，通过生成模型实现局部高密度几何采样，最终得到与真实分界线流形经验一致的近似重建。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种无需显式动力学方程先验、可扩展至高维系统的数据驱动方案，有效解决了吸引域边界欠采样的问题，并展示了判别模型与生成模型互补结合在计算动力学中的潜力。

title: A Human-Centred Approach to Benchmarking LLMs for Parenting Advice
comment: 15 pages. Submitted for review
summary: People are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to seek advice, including for parenting. Parenting is a critical and socially sensitive domain. Thus, evaluating advice provided by LLMs requires indicators beyond aggregated information quality benchmarks to consider relational and behavioural elements of the responses. With a multi-dimensional rubric created by parenting experts, this paper evaluates 15 LLMs across 100 parenting scenarios in 2 languages (English and Chinese), using an LLM-as-a-judge method. Results show that aggregate scores can hide rubric item-specific weaknesses, models implicitly encourage different parenting styles, and language influences responses. We highlight the importance of evaluation output auditability and challenges involved in evaluating LLM-generated advice in domains like parenting. Our findings provide important insights for selecting LLMs for direct user engagement and the development of user-facing parenting advice applications.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM在育儿建议这一高敏感社会领域的表现，采用育儿专家创建的多维评估框架，以LLM-as-a-judge方法评估了15个LLM在100个育儿场景、2种语言（英/中）下的表现。研究发现总体分数可能掩盖具体指标上的弱点，模型会隐式鼓励不同的育儿风格，且语言会影响回应内容，强调了评估输出可审计性的重要性。
AI.motivation: 人们越来越多地使用LLM获取育儿建议，但育儿是高度敏感的社会领域。现有的聚合信息质量基准不足以评估此类建议，需要纳入关系性和行为性元素，以更全面地衡量LLM在育儿场景中的表现。
AI.method: 由育儿专家创建多维评估指标框架，选取15个LLM，在100个育儿场景（覆盖英语和中文两种语言）中使用LLM-as-a-judge方法进行系统评估。
AI.result: 发现聚合分数会掩盖特定指标上的弱点；不同模型隐式鼓励不同的育儿风格；语言会影响模型回应内容。这些发现为模型选择和用户端育儿应用开发提供了参考。
AI.conclusion: 强调了评估LLM生成建议时输出可审计性的重要性，并指出了在育儿等敏感领域评估LLM建议所面临的挑战，为面向用户的育儿建议应用和LLM选择提供了重要启示。

title: DA-RAC: Distance-Aware Calibration of LLM Judges for Trustworthy AI Auditing
summary: Generative AI systems are increasingly producing real-world artifacts, however their efficacy and validity are often evaluated via context-free LLM-scoring. These judges can be miscalibrated by irrelevant in-context reference examples, creating false confidence and allowing low-quality or harmful outputs to pass evaluation. We study this failure mode as context-induced miscalibration and introduce DA-RAC, a distance-aware reference-anchored calibration method for LLM judges. DA-RAC retrieves semantically and structurally similar labeled anchors for each judgement scenario, weights them by distance, and exposes neighborhood difficulty as a calibration and triage signal. On multi-run LLM-judge evaluation benchmarks, it improves calibration and reduces false-pass risk relative to zero-shot, chain-of-thought evaluation, and static-anchor baselines. Mechanistic analysis shows that judge scores vary systematically with anchor distance, while static references can induce misleading decision boundaries. Thus LLM-judgement requires not only better models, but also calibrated, auditable reference selection, especially when automated evaluation is used to support high-impact AI generated artifacts. Judgments should be grounded in relevant, inspectable, and contestable interpretive artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DA-RAC方法，通过检索语义和结构相似的标注锚点并按距离加权，解决LLM评测系统因上下文参考示例导致的校准失调问题，降低低质量或有害输出通过评估的假阳性风险。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI系统产生的实际制品通常通过无上下文的LLM评分进行评估，但这类评分容易被不相关的上下文参考示例误导，导致校准失调、产生虚假信心，使低质量或有害输出通过评估。作者将此失败模式定义为上下文诱导的校准失调（context-induced miscalibration）。
AI.method: 提出DA-RAC（Distance-Aware Reference-Anchored Calibration）方法：为每个评判场景检索语义和结构相似的带标签锚点，按距离加权，并将邻域难度作为校准和三重筛选（triage）信号暴露出来。
AI.result: 在多轮LLM-judge评估基准上，DA-RAC相比零样本、思维链评估和静态锚点基线，改善了校准效果并降低了假阳性通过风险。机制分析表明，评判分数随锚点距离系统性变化，而静态参考可能诱发误导性的决策边界。
AI.conclusion: LLM评判不仅需要更好的模型，还需要校准且可审计的参考选择，尤其是在自动化评估被用于支持高影响的AI生成制品时。评判应基于相关、可检查且可质疑的解释性制品。

title: A Two-Stage Learning PINN Approach for Solving the Inverse Problem of the 1D Porous Medium Equation
comment: 54 pages
summary: The Porous Medium Equation (PME), given by $u_t = Δ(u^m)$ for $m > 1$, is a degenerate nonlinear parabolic partial differential equation that arises in various physical applications such as fluid flow in porous media, heat transfer in plasmas, and population dynamics. It is known for its nonlinear diffusion and finite propagation speed. In this paper, we study numerical solutions of the one-dimensional direct and inverse PME using Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), and compare them with classical numerical methods and available analytical and manufactured solutions. While PINNs provide a flexible framework for solving both forward and inverse problems, we show that the standard inverse formulation suffers from a strong sensitivity to the initial guess, leading to only local convergence. To address this issue, we propose a novel two-stage PINN training framework for the inverse problem, which significantly improves convergence stability and allows reliable recovery of the unknown parameter even for poor initial guesses. Overall, the proposed approach demonstrates that PINNs are a flexible and accurate alternative to classical methods for the 1D PME, and the introduced two-stage training strategy substantially improves their robustness in inverse problems, providing a solid basis for extensions to more complex geometries and higher-dimensional cases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了利用物理信息神经网络（PINNs）求解一维多孔介质方程（PME）的正向和逆向问题，并与经典数值方法和解析/制造解进行对比。针对逆向问题标准公式对初始猜测敏感、仅能局部收敛的问题，提出了一种新颖的两阶段PINN训练框架，显著提高了收敛稳定性，即使初始猜测较差也能可靠恢复未知参数。
AI.motivation: PME是退化的非线性抛物型偏微分方程，在孔隙介质流动、等离子体传热和种群动力学等领域有广泛应用。标准PINN逆向公式对初始猜测高度敏感，仅能实现局部收敛，这严重限制了其在逆向问题中的实用性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 采用PINNs求解一维PME的正向与逆向问题；提出两阶段PINN训练框架：(1) 第一阶段进行粗粒度/预热训练以获得合理参数估计；(2) 第二阶段基于前一阶段的参数结果进行精细训练以精确恢复未知参数，从而克服初始猜测敏感性问题。
AI.result: 与传统逆向PINN方法相比，两阶段训练策略显著改善了收敛稳定性，即使在较差初始猜测下也能可靠地恢复PME中的未知参数。PINNs在正向问题求解中展现出与经典方法相当的精度和灵活性。
AI.conclusion: PINNs是求解1D PME的灵活且准确的替代方法，所提出的两阶段训练策略大幅增强了逆向问题的鲁棒性，为扩展到更复杂几何形状和更高维度问题奠定了坚实基础。

title: When Is an Agent Evaluation Over? Outcome Finality and Cross-Unit Separation
summary: Current agent evaluations score models on the state visible at the end of a stopped run which they count as one trial. However, interpreting the score as a final result would require two conditions that the endpoint does not itself necessarily establish: outcome finality and cross-unit separation. These conditions are independent, since reconciling a delayed outcome can settle the label while runs still share state and isolating runs can prevent carryover while the scored outcome remains unfinished. We develop a completion argument that specifies the evidence needed for each decision and argue that a final label is justified only when anything that could still change the claimed outcome is resolved, bounded, or retained as uncertainty. First, in a controlled replay to demonstrate the mechanism where an agent's actions were held fixed, we find that the endpoint and terminal labels differ for every delayed operation, while a delayed write changes the next run's score when service state persists between runs but not after isolation or verified reset. Second, in a review of ten public protocols, we find that all protocols identify when a run stops and what is scored, while unfinished operations and the evidence for treating runs as separate trials are documented less consistently. Finally, we propose an open-effects record that lists operations or resources that may remain relevant after the endpoint, their current status, and whether they could change the scored outcome or affect another run.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前智能体评估将运行结束时的状态作为单次试验的最终分数，但该做法未能满足结果终结性和跨单元分离两个独立条件。作者提出"完成论证"框架，规定判定最终标签所需的证据标准，并通过受控回放实验和十项公开协议的审查验证了该问题，最后提出"开放效应记录"来追踪端点后仍可能影响结果的操作或资源。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体评估框架在运行停止时直接计分，但该端点分数并未验证两个关键条件：(1) 结果是否已达最终状态（outcome finality），(2) 各次运行之间是否真正相互独立（cross-unit separation）。这两个条件相互独立——延迟结果可能需要时间才能被结算确认标签，但运行之间仍可能共享状态；而隔离运行可防止状态串扰，但被评分的结果仍未完成。因此端点分数可能无法代表真实最终结果。
AI.method: 本文采用三种方法：(1) 受控回放实验——固定智能体动作不变，对比端点与终态标签，发现在每个延迟操作处两者均有差异，且延迟写入在服务状态持久化时会改变下一次运行的分数，但隔离或验证重置后则不会；(2) 对十个公开协议的系统性审查——发现所有协议都能明确运行何时停止及评分内容，但对未完成操作及运行间独立性证据的记录不一致；(3) 提出"开放效应记录"方案，列出端点后仍可能相关的操作或资源、其当前状态、以及是否可能改变评分结果或影响其他运行。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：所有延迟操作都会导致端点标签与终态标签不同；延迟写入仅在服务状态跨运行持久化时才会影响后续运行分数。协议审查显示十个协议在运行停止时机和评分标准上均有明确约定，但在未完成操作处理和跨运行独立性证据方面记录不一致。本文据此提出开放效应记录作为解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 仅当任何可能改变已声明结果的因素被解决、限制或有界保留为不确定性时，最终标签才具有合理性。开放效应记录为评估者提供了一种系统性方法，以追踪端点后仍可能产生影响的操作，从而更可靠地判断结果终结性与跨运行分离是否成立。

title: Do Uncertainty Signals Help? A Systematic Study of Uncertainty-Aware Decoding with Rollback Mechanisms
summary:
Prediction uncertainty is a widely adopted metric for quantifying model confidence, with downstream applications spanning model explanation, data selection, and prediction rollback. Despite its demonstrated utility, the potential of uncertainty quantification to enhance code generation in large language models (LLMs) remains largely underexplored, raising a critical question: to what extent can uncertainty serve as an effective signal for improving LLM-based code generation?
  To answer this question, we study uncertainty-aware rollback decoding, an inference-time strategy that uses uncertainty signals to identify unreliable generation regions and roll back to earlier valid prefixes without retraining the model. We evaluate this framework on seven code LLMs, five code generation benchmarks, and eight token-level uncertainty signals under a unified decoding setup.
  Our results show that the complete rollback framework improves over equal-budget restart across the evaluated benchmarks and model settings, with gains of up to 0.26 in pass@1 and 0.35 in AvgTestPassRate on functional code generation benchmarks, and an absolute improvement of up to 6.4\% in Patch-Aligned Safe Rate on Dsec-Python. Among the evaluated signals, information-theoretic measures such as token entropy and negative log-likelihood show the most favorable overall trend, frequently achieving the best or near-best results on standard benchmarks. A component-controlled ablation further shows that feedback-guided rollback provides the main improvement, while uncertainty localization provides an additional gain when checking, budget, rollback, and branch decay are held fixed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不确定性量化在提升大语言模型代码生成能力中的作用，提出了一种不确定性感知的回滚解码（uncertainty-aware rollback decoding）策略，在不重新训练模型的情况下，利用不确定性信号识别不可靠的生成区域并回滚到早期有效前缀。实验覆盖7个代码LLM、5个代码生成基准和8种token级不确定性信号，结果显示该框架优于等预算重启动方法，在pass@1上最多提升0.26，在AvgTestPassRate上最多提升0.35。
AI.motivation: 预测不确定性虽已被广泛用于模型解释、数据选择和预测回滚等下游任务，但其在增强LLM代码生成方面的潜力尚未被充分探索。作者希望回答一个关键问题：不确定性在多大程度上能作为改进LLM代码生成的有效信号。
AI.method: 提出不确定性感知回滚解码框架，这是一种推理时策略。核心思想是使用不确定性信号识别生成中的不可靠区域，然后回滚到较早的有效前缀，整个过程无需重新训练模型。研究在统一解码设置下，对7个代码LLM、5个代码生成基准和8种token级不确定性信号进行系统评估。
AI.result: 完整回滚框架在所有评估基准和模型设置上优于等预算重启动方法：功能代码生成基准上pass@1提升最多0.26，AvgTestPassRate提升最多0.35；在Dsec-Python上Patch-Aligned Safe Rate绝对提升最多6.4%。信息论度量（token熵和负对数似然）整体表现最有利，经常取得最佳或接近最佳结果。组件消融实验显示，反馈引导的回滚提供了主要改进，而不确定性定位在控制其他因素时提供额外增益。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性信号能够有效增强LLM代码生成，特别是信息论类不确定性度量（如token熵和负对数似然）表现出最佳性能。回滚解码作为一种无需重训练的推理时策略，能显著提升代码生成质量，且反馈引导机制在框架中发挥核心作用。

title: ETA Coordination at UAM Corridor Merging Points Using Worst-Case and Stochastic Trajectory Bounds
comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 45th Digital Avionics Systems Conference (DASC 2026)
summary: We study an Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA)-based traffic-coordination framework for Urban Air Mobility corridors with merging at constrained waypoints (CWPs), where approved ETAs at CWPs serve as Required Times of Arrival (RTAs). Vehicle operators submit ETA plans at the merging point for approval by corridor-management authorities before corridor entry. Corridor entry is then scheduled by enforcing pairwise ETA gaps that maintain inter-vehicle separation on shared corridor sections. We develop two trajectory bounds to compute sufficient ETA gaps: a worst-case bound based on prescribed speed limits, and a stochastic bound based on probabilistic position envelopes under acceleration uncertainty. Using these bounds, we formulate sufficient ETA-gap computation and first-come, first-served corridor entrance scheduling. Simulations show that ETA coordination improves safety over an unscheduled baseline. The worst-case bound provides stronger robustness under higher disturbance levels, whereas the stochastic bound allows higher throughput under mild disturbances while relying on probabilistic modeling assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了城市空中交通走廊中基于预计到达时间（ETA）的交通协调框架，针对受限航路点（CWP）的合流场景。车辆在进入走廊前提交ETA计划，由走廊管理机构批准并作为所需到达时间（RTA）。通过强制两两ETA间隔来维持共享走廊段上的飞行器间距。作者开发了两种轨迹边界来计算足够的ETA间隔：基于速度限制的最坏情况边界和基于加速度不确定性下概率位置包络的随机边界。仿真表明ETA协调相比无调度基线提高了安全性。
AI.motivation: 城市空中交通（UAM）走廊中的合流点存在交通冲突与安全隐患，需要有效的协调机制来确保飞行器在共享走廊段保持安全间隔，同时兼顾安全性与通行效率。
AI.method: 提出基于ETA的交通协调框架：1) 飞行器提交ETA合流计划并经管理机构批准；2) 提出两种轨迹边界（最坏情况速度限界和概率位置包络）计算充分ETA间隔；3) 基于这些边界制定ETA间隔计算和先到先服务（FCFS）的走廊入口调度策略。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明：ETA协调相比无调度基线显著提升安全性；最坏情况边界在高扰动水平下提供更强的鲁棒性，而随机边界在温和扰动下允许更高的吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: ETA协调框架能有效保障UAM走廊合流安全。两种边界具有互补优势：最坏情况边界适合高干扰环境，随机边界在温和条件下可提高通行效率，但依赖概率建模假设。

title: PathFinder: Joint Decompositions of Linked Multimodal Datasets
summary: Low-rank matrix decompositions can uncover patterns and structure in data and have a number of different applications across many disciplines. Extensions to "joint" low-rank decompositions have been proposed to link datasets from different modalities. While these methods enable the discovery of common patterns across modalities, they require that all the multimodal data share one or more dimensions. We propose a new analysis method, PathFinder, that enables co-analysis of datasets that do not necessarily all share a dimension. The key insight is that as long as pairs or subgroups of matrices do share some dimension, and that there are one or more paths that link across the data matrices, a global joint decomposition can be sought out. This enables the joint estimation of common patterns across different modalities, species, or scales, where a one-to-one mapping across all data along some dimension is not necessarily available. We show that PathFinder is a general umbrella under which many matrix decomposition methods fall as special cases. It can be used to discover common patterns across disparate datasets and to make predictions for missing data or modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出了PathFinder方法，一种新的联合低秩矩阵分解框架，允许对不完全共享维度的多模态数据集进行联合分析，只要数据集间存在成对或子群的维度共享，并通过路径连接即可实现全局联合分解。
AI.motivation: 现有的联合低秩矩阵分解方法要求所有多模态数据共享一个或多个维度，这限制了其应用范围。许多实际场景中，不同数据集（如不同物种、尺度或模态）之间并不存在一对一的维度映射，因此需要一种更灵活的框架来处理这类数据。
AI.method: PathFinder的核心思想是：只要数据矩阵的成对或子群之间存在维度共享，并且存在一条或多条路径将这些矩阵联系起来，就可以寻求全局联合分解。这使得联合估计跨模态、跨物种或跨尺度的共同模式成为可能，是许多现有矩阵分解方法的统一概括框架。
AI.result: PathFinder作为一个通用框架，涵盖了多种矩阵分解方法作为其特例，能够发现不同数据集间的共同模式，并可用于缺失数据或模态的预测。
AI.conclusion: PathFinder扩展了联合低秩分解的适用范围，使其不局限于必须共享维度的数据，为跨模态、跨物种或跨尺度的数据联合分析提供了更灵活的解决方案。

title: Learning Agent Execution for KV-Cache Management in Agentic Serving
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems have emerged as an important deployment paradigm for AI services, where each user request is decomposed into a sequence of specialized agents. Across these workflows, every agent repeatedly executes a fixed context consisting of system prompts, tool definitions, and few-shot examples, creating substantial opportunities for KV-cache reuse. Existing LLM serving systems, however, manage KV-cache reactively using prefix caching and recency-based replacement, causing reusable agent contexts to be evicted before their next invocation and forcing repeated recomputation. We present CacheScout, an agent-aware KV-cache runtime layer for multi-agent LLM serving. The key insight is that future KV-cache reuse is governed by agent execution semantics rather than cache recency alone. CacheScout captures these semantics by learning agent execution transitions online, without requiring predefined workflow graphs or offline training, and uses the learned execution model to guide both cache eviction and proactive prefetching while leaving the serving critical path unchanged. We implement CacheScout on top of vLLM. Across representative real-world multi-agent workloads, CacheScout improves KV-cache hit rate by 10-18 percentage points, reduces mean TTFT by 18-45%, lowers mean per-turn latency by 29-38%, and increases peak throughput by up to 57%. These benefits also generalize to larger models, reducing TTFT by up to 54% while sustaining 37% higher throughput.

AI.tldr: CacheScout是一个面向多智能体LLM服务的KV缓存运行时层，通过在线学习智能体执行转换语义来指导缓存驱逐和主动预取，而非仅依赖缓存新旧程度，从而显著提升缓存命中率、降低时延并提高吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统中每个请求被分解为一系列专用智能体，每个智能体重复执行固定上下文（系统提示、工具定义、少样本示例），为KV缓存复用创造了巨大机会。然而现有LLM服务系统采用基于前缀缓存和最近使用（recency）的被动式缓存管理，导致可复用的智能体上下文在下一次调用前被驱逐，造成重复计算。
AI.method: CacheScout的核心洞见是未来KV缓存复用由智能体执行语义而非仅由缓存新旧程度决定。它通过在线学习智能体执行转换来捕获这些语义，无需预定义工作流图或离线训练。学习到的执行模型用于指导缓存驱逐和主动预取，同时不改变服务关键路径。实现基于vLLM。
AI.result: 在代表性真实多智能体工作负载上，KV缓存命中率提升10-18个百分点，平均TTFT降低18-45%，平均每轮时延降低29-38%，峰值吞吐量提升高达57%。在更大模型上同样有效，TTFT降低高达54%，同时维持37%更高的吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: CacheScout证明了在KV缓存管理中引入智能体执行语义可以显著超越传统的recency-based策略，为多智能体LLM服务的缓存优化提供了新的方向，且该方法具有通用性和可扩展性。

title: RamseyGadgets: A Graph Construction Dataset for LLMs
summary: Constructing special graphs is an important task within graph theory and computer science. Many popular graph constructions are the result of a comprehensive exploration of relevant graphs and human ingenuity. Given the rise of generative AI usage in mathematics, it is natural to test whether LLMs are able to construct graphs with specified properties using their reasoning capabilities. Unfortunately, many natural graph construction problems, such as finding extremal Ramsey-good graphs (i.e., avoiding specific monochromatic subgraphs), have been explored extensively in the literature, making it difficult to ascertain whether a construction is the product of an LLM's reasoning capabilities or its recollection from training data. In this work, we introduce \textbf{RamseyGadgets}, a novel dataset of 70 underexplored graph construction problems that require finding Ramsey-good graphs with special properties (e.g., containing an edge with a fixed color). These problems have reasonably sized solutions (at most 10 vertices) that can be verified by SAT solvers, making them suitable for automatic evaluation. Our dataset is easily expandable, as one can simply change the monochromatic subgraphs being avoided to obtain a new set of problems. We evaluate the performance of five open-source LLMs on our dataset and report the results. Our findings show that LLMs achieve only 37.70% accuracy on the hard-tier problems in our dataset, with Gemma-4-31B achieving the highest performance out of the five. We also showcase how our dataset allows us to ascertain what kind of hints help LLMs perform better at this task.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍RamseyGadgets数据集，包含70个未充分探索的图构造问题（寻找具有特殊性质的Ramsey-good图），这些问题解规模较小（最多10个顶点）且可用SAT求解器验证。作者评估了五个开源LLM在该数据集上的表现，发现LLM在困难级别问题上仅达到37.70%的准确率，其中Gemma-4-31B表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在数学领域的应用兴起，需要测试LLM是否具有构造满足特定属性图的能力。然而已有的图构造问题（如极值Ramsey-good图）已被文献广泛探索，难以区分LLM的输出是源于推理能力还是训练数据回忆，因此需要新的、未充分探索的问题集来公平评估。
AI.method: 作者创建RamseyGadgets数据集，包含70个需要寻找具有特殊性质（如包含特定颜色边）的Ramsey-good图的构造问题。这些问题此前未被充分研究，解规模合理（≤10个顶点），可通过SAT求解器自动验证。数据集易于扩展——只需改变需要避免的单色子图即可生成新问题。作者对五个开源LLM进行了系统评估。
AI.result: 五个开源LLM在RamseyGadgets困难级别问题上仅达到37.70%的平均准确率，其中Gemma-4-31B表现最佳。此外，数据集还能用于探究何种提示（hints）能更好地帮助LLM完成此类图构造任务。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在构造特殊属性的图上仍存在显著局限性，RamseyGadgets提供了一个可靠、可扩展且可自动验证的基准，可用于持续评估和提升LLM在图构造方面的推理能力，并有助于理解何种辅助提示能有效提升模型表现。

title: Consistent Path Selection for Bi-objective Median Location Problems on Graphs
summary: We consider single-facility median location problems on graphs where two conflicting cost values are associated with the edges. As an example, suppose that a decision maker wants to locate one new facility, e. g., a pizza delivery place, which uses bicycles for delivery. The two objective functions could then be the total traveling time and the total number of left turns, as the latter are very risky. Path choices then depend on the preferences of the decision maker, and in general, there may not exist a unique optimal path between a customer and a new facility location. In this paper, we consider the location decision and the routing decision in a coupled problem, i. e., we search for an optimal location and for consistent delivery paths simultaneously. We introduce the concept of consistent paths, where we assume that the choice of a path from the facility to a demand node implies certain preferences. All paths of a solution are consistent if the preferences of all paths do not contradict each other. We present an algorithm that computes a minimum complete set of efficient solutions with consistent path choices and illustrate the results at example instances in the city of Wuppertal in Germany.

AI.tldr: 本文研究图上单设施中位点选址问题，其中边关联两个冲突的成本值（如配送时间和左转次数）。作者将选址决策与路径决策耦合考虑，引入"一致路径"概念，提出一种算法来计算具有一致路径选择的最小完整有效解集，并在德国伍珀塔尔市的实例上验证了结果。
AI.motivation: 在实际选址问题中，边上的成本往往是多目标的（如配送时间与风险性），路径选择取决于决策者偏好，因此不存在唯一最优路径。传统方法将选址与路径决策分开处理，无法保证结果的一致性，需要一种耦合的方法来同时优化选址和一致的路径选择。
AI.method: 作者引入"一致路径"（consistent paths）概念，假设从设施到需求节点的路径选择隐含了特定偏好，若所有路径的偏好互不矛盾，则解是一致的。基于此提出一种算法，计算具有一致路径选择的最小完整有效解集（minimum complete set of efficient solutions）。
AI.result: 算法能够计算出最小完整的一致路径有效解集，并通过德国伍珀塔尔市的实例进行了演示，展示了方法在实际城市环境中的可行性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将选址与路径决策耦合，并引入一致路径约束，可以获得更符合实际决策场景的选址方案，为多目标选址-路径联合优化提供了新的理论框架和算法工具。

title: Platform Adaptation Under Governance Interventions: Actor Best-Response Modeling and an External Public-Case Benchmark
summary: Digital platforms govern by changing rules: rankings, monetization thresholds, moderation standards, verification systems, disclosure requirements, appeal processes, and access policies. These interventions are rarely absorbed passively. Creators, sellers, advertisers, moderators, users, developers, and strategic operators adapt to the new reward surface. This paper develops a platform-adaptation model for evaluating governance interventions as transitions in adaptive multi-actor information systems. The model represents actor best response, strategic gaming opportunity, moderation burden, user-incentive movement, enforcement response, externality formation, and downstream platform stability. We evaluate the model on 72 external public platform-governance cases covering media monetization, ranking systems, verification, delivery platforms, marketplaces, app stores, community platforms, and creator ecosystems. Across 9 methods and 648 method-case evaluations, the full platform-adaptation simulator achieves mean adaptation quality of 0.836338, compared with 0.669731 for a risk-register baseline, 0.589457 for causal-loop analysis, 0.492750 for generic governance critique, 0.369492 for engagement-only optimization, and 0.331965 for baseline policy review. Paired comparisons show a win rate of 1.00 against all tested baselines and channel ablations. The contribution is an information-systems theory and measurement framework showing why platform governance evaluation fails when it treats policy rules as static controls rather than interventions into adaptive actor-response fields.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种平台-适应模型（platform-adaptation model），用于评估平台治理干预措施在自适应多行为者信息系统中的效果。该模型在72个外部公共平台治理案例上，通过9种方法和648个方法-案例组合进行了评估，达到了0.836的适应质量均值，显著优于所有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 数字平台通过改变规则进行治理（如排名、变现门槛、审核标准、验证系统等），但这些干预很少被被动接受——创作者、卖家、广告商、用户等会主动适应新的奖励机制。现有治理评估方法往往将政策规则视为静态控制手段，忽视了行为者的自适应响应，导致评估失败。
AI.method: 开发一个平台-适应模型，将治理干预视为自适应多行为者信息系统中的转变。模型表征了行为者最佳响应、策略性游戏机会、审核负担、用户激励变化、执法响应、外部性形成以及下游平台稳定性等多个维度。在72个公共平台治理案例上，跨9种方法和648个方法-案例组合进行系统评估。
AI.result: 完整平台-适应模拟器在648个方法-案例评估中达到0.836338的平均适应质量，显著优于风险登记基线（0.669731）、因果环分析（0.589457）、通用治理批评（0.492750）、仅参与优化（0.369492）和政策审查基线（0.331965）。对所有测试基线和通道消融的配对比较胜率为1.00。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献在于建立了信息系统理论和测量框架，论证了平台治理评估失败的根本原因——将政策规则视为静态控制手段，而非对自适应行为者响应场的干预。治理评估必须考虑行为者的适应性与策略性响应。

title: FedImp: Enhancing Federated Learning Convergence with Impurity-Based Weighting
comment: Accepted author manuscript (AAM) to appear in IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Federated Learning (FL) is a collaborative paradigm that enables multiple devices to train a global model while preserving local data privacy. A major challenge in FL is the non-Independent and Identically Distributed (non-IID) nature of data across devices, which hinders training efficiency and slows convergence. To tackle this, we propose Federated Impurity Weighting (FedImp), a novel algorithm that quantifies each device contribution based on the informational content of its local data. These contributions are normalized to compute distinct aggregation weights for the global model update. Extensive experiments on EMNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets show that FedImp significantly improves convergence speed, reducing communication rounds by up to 64.4%, 27.8%, and 66.7% on EMNIST, and 44.2%, 44%, and 25.6% on CIFAR-10 compared to FedAvg, FedProx, and FedAdp, respectively. Under highly imbalanced data distributions, FedImp outperforms all baselines and achieves the highest accuracy. Overall, FedImp offers an effective solution to enhance FL efficiency in non-IID settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedImp算法，通过量化各设备局部数据的信息含量（不纯度）来归一化计算聚合权重，解决联邦学习中非独立同分布数据导致的训练效率低下和收敛缓慢问题。在EMNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上的实验表明，FedImp相比FedAvg、FedProx和FedAdp可减少最多66.7%的通信轮次，并在高度不平衡数据分布下取得最高精度。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习面临的核心挑战是设备间数据的非独立同分布特性，这会阻碍训练效率并减慢模型收敛速度。现有方法在处理高度不平衡的数据分布时效果有限，需要更有效的机制来评估和量化各设备对全局模型的贡献。
AI.method: 提出联邦不纯度加权（FedImp）算法，核心思想是基于设备局部数据的信息量（不纯度）来量化每个设备的贡献，并将这些贡献归一化，从而计算全局模型更新的不同聚合权重。设备数据的信息含量越高，其在全局模型聚合中的权重就越大。
AI.result: 在EMNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上进行了广泛实验。相比FedAvg、FedProx和FedAdp，通信轮次分别减少了64.4%、27.8%、66.7%（EMNIST）以及44.2%、44%、25.6%（CIFAR-10）。在高度不平衡的数据分布下，FedImp在所有基线中表现最优，并取得了最高精度。
AI.conclusion: FedImp为联邦学习在非独立同分布场景下的效率提升提供了一种有效解决方案，通过数据信息量驱动的聚合权重分配，显著加快了收敛速度并提升了模型精度。

title: Scalable Gaussian Process Regression via Deterministic Trigonometric Features: Uniform Bounds for Safe Model Predictive Control
summary: Learning-based Model Predictive Control (MPC) using Gaussian processes (GPs) is an effective approach for safe control in the presence of model mismatch.
