High-probability safety guarantees typically require uncertainty bounds that hold uniformly over the entire state--input domain, but existing bounds are available only for full GP regression. Since exact GP inference scales poorly with the number of data points, its deployment is impractical in large-data regimes. We close this gap by developing a scalable GP framework that admits the derivation of uniform uncertainty bounds. We formalize a deterministic trigonometric feature Gaussian process (DTF-GP), a finite-dimensional kernel approximation based on discretized trigonometric features that reduces GP regression to Bayesian linear regression in feature space. We derive a high-probability uniform uncertainty bound for the proposed DTF-GP and provide its closed-form solution for the squared-exponential kernel case. Finally, we integrate the DTF-GP into a learning-based MPC scheme and demonstrate that it provides high-probability safety guarantees and exploration performance comparable to a full GP while improving computational efficiency in large-data regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了确定性三角特征高斯过程（DTF-GP），一种基于离散化三角特征的有限维核近似方法，将高斯过程回归简化为特征空间中的贝叶斯线性回归，从而推导出适用于大规模数据场景下的高概率均匀不确定性界，并集成到学习型模型预测控制（MPC）中提供安全保证。
AI.motivation: 基于高斯过程的学习型MPC在存在模型失配时能提供安全控制，但高概率安全保证通常需要在整个状态-输入域上一致成立的不确定性界。现有这类界仅适用于完整GP回归，而完整GP推断随数据量增长计算复杂度高，在大数据场景下不实用。
AI.method: 提出确定性三角特征高斯过程（DTF-GP），通过离散化三角特征构造有限维核近似，将GP回归转化为特征空间中的贝叶斯线性回归；推导该框架下的高概率均匀不确定性界，并为平方指数核提供闭式解；最后将该框架集成到学习型MPC方案中。
AI.result: DTF-GP在大数据场景下提供了与完整GP相当的高概率安全保证和探索性能，同时显著提高了计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了可扩展GP框架与均匀不确定性界推导之间的差距，使得在大规模数据场景下仍能获得可验证的安全控制保证。

title: Do Geometry-Aware Positional Encodings Help Transformers in Spatial Imperfect-Information Games?
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables
summary: Transformers applied to spatial imperfect-information games must represent map geometry while tracking hidden entities through time. We ask whether geometry-aware positional encodings improve these capabilities, without claiming a new positional encoding. We construct a four-level benchmark on a hexagonal naval pursuit game: controlled geometry and topology probes, an exact-Bayes hidden-target tracking task, offline policy imitation at 1k and 10k games, and 7,200 fixed-seed games against three legacy opponents. Across matched Transformer backbones, HexRoPE reduces exact-belief posterior cross-entropy relative to no positional encoding by 0.278 on D6-transformed test orbits and 0.329 on a larger map; both hierarchical-bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero, and both Holm-adjusted p-values are below 0.001. At 1k games, HexRoPE improves policy action accuracy by 4.63 percentage points over no encoding and 2.05 points over rectangular relative bias; the gains shrink to 1.55 and 0.41 points at 10k games. However, HexRoPE does not improve aggregate gameplay win rate: its paired effect over no encoding is -1.56 percentage points (95% CI [-4.50, 1.17]). Rectangular relative bias is strongest on D6 belief consistency but fails sharply when extrapolating from radius 3 to radius 4, while graph bias provides only a small blocked-edge gain. The results show that geometric inductive bias improves belief estimation and data-efficient imitation, but those representation gains do not automatically produce stronger closed-loop play.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在空间不完美信息博弈中，几何感知的位置编码（HexRoPE）是否能提升Transformer对地图几何和隐藏实体的表征能力。通过四层基准测试发现，HexRoPE在信念估计和数据高效的模仿学习上有显著提升，但并未改善闭环博弈的胜率。
AI.motivation: Transformer应用于空间不完美信息博弈时，需要同时表征地图几何并随时间追踪隐藏实体。作者希望探究几何感知的位置编码是否能够改善这些能力，而非提出全新的位置编码方法。
AI.method: 构建了一个四层基准测试，基于六边形海军追击游戏：（1）受控的几何与拓扑探针；（2）精确贝叶斯隐藏目标追踪任务；（3）在1k和10k对局规模下的离线策略模仿学习；（4）针对三个遗留对手的7,200局固定种子对局。使用匹配的Transformer骨干网络，将HexRoPE与无位置编码、矩形相对偏置等基线进行对比。
AI.result: HexRoPE在D6变换测试轨道上将精确贝叶斯后验交叉熵降低了0.278（更大地图上为0.329），置信区间排除零且p<0.001。在1k对局下策略动作准确率提升4.63个百分点（相对矩形偏置提升2.05个百分点），10k对局时增益缩至1.55和0.41个百分点。但HexRoPE未改善总体胜率，配对效应为-1.56个百分点（95% CI [-4.50, 1.17]）。矩形相对偏置在D6信念一致性上最强但半径外推失败，图偏置仅有小幅阻塞边增益。
AI.conclusion: 几何归纳偏置确实能改善信念估计和数据高效模仿学习，但这些表征层面的增益并不会自动转化为更强的闭环博弈表现，揭示了两者之间的非平凡关系。

title: Accuracy and Reliability of Large Language Models in Cosmetic Chemistry and Skin Health: A Benchmarking Study
comment: 14 pages
summary: As consumers increasingly turn to AI chatbots for skincare advice, the technical accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) in cosmetic chemistry remains largely under-evaluated. We benchmarked 14 LLMs on a structured set of topics related to cosmetic chemistry, including the chemical properties of specific cosmetic ingredients and common cosmetic scenarios that may be of interest to consumers. Web search was disabled throughout to assess each model's internalized knowledge rather than its internet retrieval capacity. Overall performance was poor, with the most pronounced deficits in quantitative reasoning and structural identification tasks. While models handled general skincare questions with reasonability, responses consistently lacked the technical depth required for informed consumer decision-making. Notably, conversation with AI can pose a risk: outputs that sound authoritative but contain technical errors are less likely to generate skepticism compared to responses that explicitly acknowledge uncertainty. These findings suggest that general-purpose LLMs, trained predominantly on unverified public data, are currently not reliable sources of cosmetic chemistry information. Progress on two fronts, fine-tuning verified chemical and dermatological datasets, and substantial improvements to algorithmic reasoning, will likely be needed before these tools can be considered as resources for public use.

AI.tldr: 本文对14个大语言模型（LLM）在化妆品化学领域的知识准确性进行了基准测试，发现整体性能较差，尤其在定量推理和结构识别任务上缺陷最明显。研究还发现AI对话存在风险：听起来权威但包含技术错误的回答比明确承认不确定性的回答更难引起消费者的怀疑。作者认为通用LLM目前不可靠于化妆品化学信息，需要通过微调验证数据集和改进算法推理能力来提升。
AI.motivation: 消费者越来越多地使用AI聊天机器人获取护肤建议，但LLM在化妆品化学领域的技术准确性尚未得到充分评估。研究者希望系统性地评估LLM在该专业领域的知识内化水平，揭示其局限性并探讨潜在风险。
AI.method: 对14个LLM进行基准测试，测试内容涵盖化妆品化学的结构化主题集，包括特定化妆品成分的化学性质以及消费者可能感兴趣的常见化妆品场景。测试全程禁用网络搜索，以评估每个模型的内化知识而非互联网检索能力。
AI.result: 整体性能表现较差，最明显的缺陷集中在定量推理和结构识别任务上。模型在处理一般性护肤问题时较为合理，但回答始终缺乏消费者做出知情决策所需的技术深度。此外发现一个有风险的现象：听起来权威但含有技术错误的回答比明确承认不确定性的回答更不容易引发怀疑。
AI.conclusion: 通用LLM主要基于未经验证的公开数据训练，目前不可靠于提供化妆品化学信息。需要在两个方向取得进展：一是微调经过验证的化学和皮肤病学数据集，二是实质性改进算法推理能力，之后这些工具才能被视为可供公众使用的资源。

title: Harness the Memory: A Holistic Evaluation of Memory Substrates in Memory Agents
summary: Memory is becoming core infrastructure for long-horizon LLM agents, yet existing evaluations offer limited guidance on which memory substrate, namely the underlying medium in which memory is represented and stored, should be used under different operating regimes. We present a controlled harness evaluation of memory substrates for memory-augmented agents, covering dense and sparse indices, text records, structural stores, hierarchical stores, refinement-based memories, parametric updates, and activation-compatible context mechanisms. Across three backbone models and four benchmark suites spanning user-centric question answering and agent-centric decision-making, we instrument 26 performance and efficiency metrics under a unified harness. Our results show that no single substrate consistently dominates: broad retrieval benefits long-context factual QA, while excessive retrieval can harm sequential decision-making by shifting attention away from action-critical context. Scalability introduces a further routing axis, as substrates that perform well at moderate history lengths can become costly or brittle at longer horizons. These findings motivate substrate routing as a necessary component of adaptive agent memory systems and provide empirical guidance for designing efficient, reliable, and regime-aware long-term memory for LLM agents. Code will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个受控的基准测试框架，系统评估LLM智能体在不同记忆基质（memory substrate）下的表现。覆盖了密集/稀疏索引、文本记录、结构存储、层次存储、基于精化的记忆、参数化更新和激活兼容上下文机制等7类基质，跨3个骨干模型和4个基准套件，测量26项性能与效率指标。核心发现是没有单一基质能一贯占优，且可扩展性引入了新的路由维度，因此提出基质路由（substrate routing）作为自适应记忆系统的必要组件。
AI.motivation: 记忆正成为长时程LLM智能体的核心基础设施，但现有评测无法指导开发者在不同运行场景下选择何种记忆基质（即记忆表示与存储的底层介质）。缺乏系统性对比研究，导致记忆基质的选型缺乏实证依据。
AI.method: 构建统一的受控测试框架（unified harness），对记忆增强智能体进行评测。覆盖7类记忆基质，利用3种骨干模型和4个基准套件（涵盖以用户为中心的问答和以智能体为中心的决策），测量26项性能和效率指标。
AI.result: 1) 没有单一记忆基质能一贯占优；2) 广泛检索有利于长上下文事实问答，但过度检索会损害序列决策——将注意力从动作关键上下文转移；3) 可扩展性引入路由轴：在中等历史长度表现良好的基质在更长时程下可能变得昂贵或脆弱。
AI.conclusion: 基质路由（substrate routing）是自适应智能体记忆系统的必要组成部分。本文为设计高效、可靠且能感知运行场景的LLM智能体长期记忆提供了实证指导。

title: A Splitting Framework for Composite Semimonotone Inclusions
summary: We introduce a general framework for composite inclusion problems with affine constraints, covering both monotone and semimonotone regimes. The central idea is a new interpretation of the constrained inclusion through an operator-vector pair that separates the implicit inclusion from the affine constraint: the former is handled through possibly preconditioned resolvent evaluations, while the latter is handled through an explicit forward step in an auxiliary variable. This yields a single abstract iteration applicable to multioperator inclusions, linearly coupled inclusions, and block-separable inclusions with affine constraints. The freedom in choosing the operator-vector pair enables the systematic construction of problem-adapted splitting algorithms, including new schemes for several important problem classes. Exploiting the orthogonal decomposition induced by the constraint subspace, we develop a unified and streamlined convergence analysis and establish weak and strong convergence guarantees under semimonotonicity assumptions. When specialized to multioperator inclusions, the framework permits general bounded linear operator coefficients, rather than only scalar coefficients, and therefore accommodates preconditioned resolvents. The resulting schemes recover several existing methods while extending them to previously uncovered regimes, and in several important cases, require weaker assumptions and admit provably larger admissible parameter ranges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向带仿射约束的复合包含问题的通用框架，覆盖单调和半单调两种情形。核心思想是通过"算子-向量对"将隐式包含与仿射约束分离，前者用（可预处理的）预解算子处理，后者用辅助变量的显式前向步骤处理，从而得到一个统一的抽象迭代格式，适用于多算子包含、线性耦合包含及块可分包含等问题，并建立了统一收敛性分析及强弱收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 现有针对带仿射约束的复合包含问题的求解方法往往针对特定问题类设计，缺乏统一的理论框架；且现有方法在算子系数上多限于标量，无法处理一般的线性算子（如预处理预解），且可容许参数范围受限、假设条件偏强，需要更一般且更灵活的框架来系统化构造问题自适应的分裂算法。
AI.method: 本文通过"算子-向量对"(operator-vector pair)对约束包含进行新解释，将隐式包含与仿射约束解耦；隐式部分通过可能预处理的预解求值处理，约束部分通过辅助变量的显式前向步骤处理；利用约束子空间诱导的正交分解，在单调及半单调假设下建立统一收敛性分析，并给出强弱收敛保证；允许一般有界线性算子系数（而非仅标量系数），从而支持预处理预解。
AI.result: 该框架统一了多算子包含、线性耦合包含和带仿射约束的块可分包含问题的求解；可系统构造问题自适应分裂算法，包含针对多个重要问题类的新方案；在弱假设下恢复并扩展多种现有方法，在一些重要情形下容许更大的参数范围并给出弱/强收敛保证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为带仿射约束的复合包含问题提供了统一的抽象迭代框架，兼具理论普适性与算法灵活性，不仅覆盖了已有方法，还拓展到此前未覆盖的机制和更宽松的假设，具有重要的理论贡献和实际算法设计价值。

title: The Benchmark Trap: Structures of Power and Injustice in AI Evaluations
comment: to appear in the proceedings of AIES 2026
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) benchmarks are not neutral tools of evaluation but socio-technical artefacts that shape competition, power, and research priorities within AI. Benchmarks standardise the assessment of systems and facilitate the creation of leaderboards that reward state-of-the-art performance with prestige, citations, trust, and institutional influence. As the costs of developing competitive AI systems rise, these rewards increasingly concentrate among powerful, industry-funded labs. This paper situates these concerns within Iris Marion Young's theories of oppression and structural injustice. It argues that current benchmarking practices may perpetuate systematic harms affecting various actors in AI research, aligning with four of Young's "faces of oppression". Benchmarking culture is further framed as a source of structural injustice, as these harms emerge from normalised, individually defensible practices and network effects, even without explicit wrongdoing. By reinforcing existing power structures and narrowing possible research trajectories, benchmarking may in fact prevent the field from advancing in epistemically robust and socially beneficial ways.

AI.tldr: 本文从社会技术视角审视AI基准测试，指出其不仅是评估工具，更是塑造AI领域竞争、权力与研究优先级的制度性媒介。文章运用Iris Marion Young的压迫与结构性不正义理论，论证当前基准测试实践可能通过四种"压迫面貌"对AI研究中的各方参与者造成系统性伤害，并构成结构性不正义，最终阻碍AI领域在认识论上稳健且对社会有益的方向发展。
AI.motivation: AI基准测试被视为中立评估工具，但其实际影响被忽视——基准测试塑造了权力分配、研究优先级和资源集中。随着AI开发成本上升，奖励日益集中于有产业资助的大型实验室，导致不公平的系统性后果。文章旨在揭示这些被正常化实践背后的结构性不正义。
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析方法，将Iris Marion Young的压迫理论（五张面孔中的四张）和结构性不正义理论作为框架，对AI基准测试文化进行批判性分析，论证其如何通过正常化、个体上看似合理的实践和网络效应产生系统性伤害。
AI.result: 文章论证了基准测试文化与Young的四种压迫面貌相吻合，表明基准测试体系通过强化现有权力结构和收窄研究可能路径，构成了结构性不正义的来源，且这种不正义并非源于明确的错误行为，而是源于被正常化的日常实践。
AI.conclusion: 基准测试文化不仅是技术问题，更是社会正义问题。若不加以干预，持续的基准测试实践可能阻止AI领域在认识论上稳健且社会有益的方向发展，因此需要正视和重构现有基准测试体系。

title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Perception-Decision Misalignment in Omni-LLMs via Modality Subspace Activation
summary: Omni-Large Language Models (Omni-LLMs) power complex multi-modal reasoning in applications like World Action Models and autonomous agents. However, their strong performance often masks a profound Perceptual-Decision Misalignment (PDM), where decisions remain unfaithful to multi-modal perceptions. To diagnose this, we formalize Causal Modality Sensitivity (CMS), operationalized via a dual-lens framework: Answer Retention Rate (ARR) at the macro behavioral level, and Logit Angular Discrepancy (LAD) to track microscopic distribution shifts. We also curate CausalMSBench, a diagnostic dataset isolating language priors. Benchmarking reveals that popular Omni-LLMs exhibit critically low CMS, showing negligible distribution shifts even when key modalities are removed. To rectify this, we propose Modality Subspace Activation (MSA), a training-free inference-time framework that uses Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to estimate modal activation strengths. MSA dynamically balances modal projections in the last hidden state, effectively restoring CMS across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了Omni-LLMs中存在感知-决策错位(PDM)问题，即模型决策与多模态感知不一致。作者形式化了因果模态敏感性(CMS)概念，提出双视角评估框架（ARR和LAD），并构建了CausalMSBench诊断基准。为修复此问题，提出无需训练的模态子空间激活(MSA)推理框架，通过SVD估计模态激活强度并动态平衡隐状态中的模态投影，有效恢复了CMS。
AI.motivation: Omni-LLMs虽然性能强大，但其决策往往不忠实于多模态感知，存在严重的感知-决策错位问题。现有评估方法无法有效诊断这一问题，需要形式化的指标和系统性的诊断方法。
AI.method: 1) 形式化因果模态敏感性(CMS)概念；2) 提出双视角评估框架：宏观行为层面的Answer Retention Rate(ARR)和微观分布层面的Logit Angular Discrepancy(LAD)；3) 构建CausalMSBench诊断数据集以隔离语言先验；4) 提出Modality Subspace Activation(MSA)框架，利用SVD估算模态激活强度，在推理时动态平衡最后隐状态中的模态投影。
AI.result: 基准测试表明主流Omni-LLMs的CMS普遍较低，即使移除关键模态也只表现出可忽略的分布变化，证实了PDM问题的普遍性。应用MSA后，模型在基准上的CMS得到有效恢复。
AI.conclusion: Omni-LLMs存在严重的感知-决策错位问题，而MSA作为一种训练自由的推理时干预框架，能够有效缓解这一问题并恢复模型的因果模态敏感性。

title: Stable Multi-Step Rollouts via Uncertainty-Guided Hybrid Dynamics
comment: Accepted for presentation at, and publication in the Proceedings of the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
summary: Multi-step rollouts are essential for model-based reinforcement learning (RL) and predictive control, yet learned dynamics models often become unstable when recursively applied, leading to divergence and unreliable policy updates. This paper proposes a model-agnostic hybrid dynamics framework that blends a provably contracting nominal model with a flexible excursion model through an uncertainty-guided switching law. The switching signal is derived from calibrated epistemic uncertainty and activates only when the system leaves the nominal region, ensuring that each model operates within its reliability regime. Under clearly stated smoothness and boundedness assumptions, we show that the resulting hybrid predictor yields globally bounded recursive multi-step rollouts: trajectories remain Lyapunov-stable in the nominal region and exhibit at most affine growth during excursions. To illustrate the theory in practice, we instantiate the hybrid dynamics framework within a model-based RL scheme that uses real one-step transitions for value learning and hybrid rollouts for policy improvement. Experiments on a nonlinear Duffing oscillator demonstrate stable long-horizon prediction and improved cost-effort trade-offs relative to a stabilizing baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模型无关的混合动力学框架，通过不确定性引导的切换律，将可证明收缩的名义模型与灵活的偏差模型结合，实现递归多步推演的有界稳定性。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的强化学习和预测控制依赖多步推演，但学习到的动力学模型在递归应用时往往不稳定，导致发散和不可靠的策略更新。
AI.method: 构建混合动力学框架，包含一个可证明收缩的名义模型和一个灵活的偏差模型，通过基于校准认知不确定性的切换信号决定何时激活偏差模型。切换仅在系统离开名义区域时触发，确保每个模型在其可靠区域内运作。理论分析给出全局有界的递归多步推演保证；实践中嵌入模型基RL方案，用真实单步转移做价值学习，用混合推演做策略改进。
AI.result: 在非线性Duffing振荡器实验上，展示了稳定的长时域预测以及相比稳定化基线更优的成本-努力权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过名义模型与偏差模型的分工以及不确定性引导的切换机制，可以保证混合预测器在递归多步推演中保持Lyapunov稳定（名义区域内）和至多仿射增长（偏差期间），从而缓解学习动力学模型发散问题。

title: Learning reshapes power-law anisotropy in internal representations
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures
summary: Power-law anisotropy in internal representations has been observed across a wide range of biological and artificial neural systems, from state-of-the-art language models to the mouse cerebral cortex. This anisotropy is a key geometric property of high-dimensional information processing and underlies a variety of theoretical analyses. However, the mechanism by which it emerges from input structure and task-driven learning has remained unclear. Here, we characterize this formation process by exactly solving the learning dynamics of a wide two-layer linear neural network in a teacher--student setting with power-law input and teacher structures. We show that, in the feature-learning regime, the local power-law exponent of the internal-representation spectrum evolves nonmonotonically over the course of training and exhibits up to four distinct asymptotic regimes across modes and training times. By contrast, in the lazy regime, the exponent remains essentially unchanged. We further demonstrate numerically that similar exponent dynamics arise in more realistic nonlinear networks. Together, these results suggest a general mechanism by which the dynamic interaction between input statistics and task structure gives rise to power-law internal representations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过精确求解两层线性神经网络在学习动力学中的演变，揭示了内部表征幂律各向异性（power-law anisotropy）从输入结构和任务驱动学习中涌现的机制。研究发现，在特征学习（feature-learning）机制下，内部表征谱的局部幂律指数在训练过程中非单调演化，呈现多达四个不同的渐近阶段；而懒惰（lazy）机制下则基本不变。非线性网络中也有类似现象。
AI.motivation: 幂律各向异性广泛存在于生物和人工神经系统中（从大语言模型到小鼠大脑皮层），是理解高维信息处理的关键几何性质。然而，这一性质如何从输入结构和任务驱动学习中涌现的机制此前尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用教师-学生（teacher-student）框架，在具有幂律输入和教师结构设定下，对宽两层线性神经网络的动力学进行精确求解。系统分析特征学习机制与懒惰机制下的表征谱指数演化，并通过数值实验在更真实的非线性网络中验证。
AI.result: 在特征学习机制下，内部表征谱的局部幂律指数随训练非单调演化，模式维度和训练时间维度上共出现多达四种不同的渐近阶段；懒惰机制下指数基本保持不变。非线性网络中也观察到相似的指数动力学。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了一种一般性机制：输入统计与任务结构之间的动态交互催生了幂律内部表征，这对理解神经系统中广泛存在的各向异性结构提供了理论解释。

title: Task- and Session-Level Model Routing: A Common-Interface Hybrid Evaluation of Four Open-Source Routers Across Four Benchmarks
comment: 34 pages, 25 tables
summary: Agentic systems increasingly delegate model selection to a router, yet open-source routers are usually evaluated with different tasks, candidate pools, and execution protocols, limiting direct comparison. We present a common measurement protocol and hybrid evaluation of four router implementations across RouterBench, BFCL v4, tau2-bench, and WebArena. We evaluate 290 frozen tasks against a locked matrix of 2,610 candidate outcomes. Three routers emit constant or near-constant tier assignments; only vLLM Semantic Router varies materially with prompt content, and it has the highest observed success rate on none of the four benchmarks. Always-Mid matches Aurelio exactly on three benchmarks and within 0.003 on the fourth. For vLLM, task-level superiority tests detect no task-specific advantage over a share-matched content-blind allocation; equivalence is established only on WebArena at the protocol-declared five-percentage-point margin. The results show that, under these configurations and controls, observed gains track selected-tier composition more closely than demonstrated task-specific targeting. Fixed-tier baselines and selected-tier distributions are therefore necessary controls in router evaluation; the findings are scoped to these configurations, candidate pool, and frozen benchmark samples, not to routing paradigms in general.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的评测协议和混合评测方法，对四种路由器实现在RouterBench、BFCL v4、tau2-bench和WebArena四个基准上进行了评估。结果显示大多数路由器输出恒定或近似恒定的层级分配，只有vLLM Semantic Router会随提示内容实质变化，但它在四个基准上均未取得最高成功率。研究发现观察到的性能提升更多地与所选层级的构成相关，而非任务特定的定向能力。
AI.motivation: 开源路由器通常在完全不同的任务、候选池和执行协议下进行评估，导致无法直接比较不同路由器实现的性能，缺乏公平且可比的评测标准。
AI.method: 提出统一的测量协议，在四个基准（RouterBench、BFCL v4、tau2-bench、WebArena）上对四种路由器实现在290个冻结任务和2,610个锁定候选结果的矩阵上进行混合评测，并采用任务级显著性检验来验证路由器的任务特定优势。
AI.result: 三种路由器输出恒定或接近恒定的层级分配；vLLM Semantic Router是唯一随提示内容变化的，但未在任何基准上取得最高成功率。Always-Mid与Aurelio在三个基准上完全一致，第四个基准上差异在0.003以内。对vLLM的任务级检验未发现任何任务特定优势，仅在WebArena上以五个百分点的既定误差范围内建立了等价性。
AI.conclusion: 在特定配置和控制条件下，观察到的性能提升更多来源于所选层级的构成，而非任务特定的定向能力。因此，路由器评估中必须包含固定层级基线和所选层级分布作为必要的控制变量。研究结论仅限于特定配置、候选池和冻结基准样本，不推广到一般性的路由范式。

title: Handoff-H1: An Orchestrated Vision-Agent System for Material Quantity Takeoff from Construction Blueprints
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures. Evaluation harness available on https://github.com/handoffai/residential-takeoff-benchmark/. Request data via e-mail to research@handoff.ai
summary: Converting a set of architectural blueprints into a complete material quantity takeoff requires visual perception across drawing sheets, dimensional and multi-hop reasoning, and grounding in construction conventions that the drawings never state. We present Handoff-H1, a takeoff system built from three layers: purpose-built computer-vision models that extract primitives; tool-using agents equipped with image operations and in-house visual-task tools, including CV-model-backed counting, detection and plan decomposition; and a persistent, hierarchically structured project foundation, grounded in a curated construction knowledge base. We evaluate on the Construction Blueprint Takeoff Benchmark: 10 real residential blueprint sets paired with consensus-validated expert takeoffs - 2,009 verified line items, restricted for scoring to the 1,348 primary-tier materials that drive an estimate - scored per trade by an LLM judge on material coverage and quantity Precision@25% (P@.25) and combined into a weighted composite. Under identical scoring from the raw PDF, seven frontier and open-weight models span composites of 35-61, and independent professional estimators - scored against the same reconciled gold standard - post 77.6% (65.5% coverage, 87.9% P@.25). Handoff-H1, working end-to-end from the raw PDF, reaches 81.6% (86.1% coverage, 78.8% P@.25): roughly 20 points above the strongest frontier agent, and above the independent estimators by pairing near-human quantity precision with coverage they do not reach. The evaluation harness is public for the open harbor framework; the blueprint sets and ground truth are available upon request for research use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Handoff-H1，一个从建筑蓝图PDF端到端生成材料工程量清单（takeoff）的系统，由三个层次构建：专用CV模型提取图元、工具使用智能体集成图像操作与视觉任务工具、以及基于施工知识库的分层项目基础。在Construction Blueprint Takeoff Benchmark（10套真实住宅蓝图、2,009条专家核验清单）上，Handoff-H1达到81.6%的加权综合分（86.1%覆盖率、78.8% P@.25），比最强前沿智能体高约20个点，并超过独立专业估算师的77.6%。
AI.motivation: 将建筑蓝图转换为完整的材料工程量清单需要跨图纸的视觉感知、维度和多跳推理，以及图纸从未明示的施工惯例知识。现有前沿和开源模型在此任务上得分仅为35-61，远低于专业估算师的77.6%，说明该任务对现有AI系统构成重大挑战，需要专门设计的系统来弥合差距。
AI.method: Handoff-H1由三个层次组成：(1) 专用计算机视觉模型层，用于提取图纸中的基本图元；(2) 工具使用智能体层，配备图像操作工具和自研视觉任务工具，包括基于CV模型的计数、检测和平面图分解；(3) 持久化、分层结构的项目基础层，基于精选的施工知识库。评估采用LLM法官按工种对材料覆盖率和数量精度P@.25进行评分，组合为加权综合分。
AI.result: Handoff-H1端到端从原始PDF工作，达到81.6%的综合分（86.1%覆盖率、78.8% P@.25），比最强前沿智能体（61分）高约20个点，并超过独立专业估算师（77.6%，65.5%覆盖率、87.9% P@.25），通过接近人类的数量精度和超越人类的覆盖率实现。评估框架已公开，蓝图数据集和研究用途的ground truth可申请获取。
AI.conclusion: Handoff-H1证明了三层架构（专用CV模型+工具使用智能体+知识库驱动的基础层）能有效解决蓝图工程量清单这一复杂的视觉-推理-领域知识综合任务，其在覆盖率上的优势（86.1% vs 65.5%）弥补了精度上的小幅差距（78.8% vs 87.9%），整体表现超越人类专业估算师，为该领域设立了新的基准水平。

title: ADMM Fails to Achieve an $O(K^{-1})$ Ergodic KKT Residual Bound
summary: The Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) residual is a fundamental measure of first-order optimality and, under an error bound condition, is comparable to the distance to the KKT solution set up to constant factors. Despite the $O(K^{-1})$ ergodic rates known for objective error and feasibility violations, we show that the KKT residual of classical ADMM cannot, in general, satisfy a uniform $O(K^{-1})$ bound. Specifically, we construct a fixed-dimensional, horizon-dependent family of two-block convex optimization problems for which the KKT residual is $Ω(K^{-1/2})$ at both the last iterate and the equal-weight ergodic average at the prescribed horizon $K$. Consequently, a uniform $O(K^{-1})$ KKT residual bound is impossible for either output.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了经典ADMM算法的KKT残差收敛速率，证明尽管目标误差和可行性违规具有O(K⁻¹)的遍历速率，但KKT残差在一般情况下无法满足均匀的O(K⁻¹)界。作者构造了一族固定维数、依赖于时间范围的二块凸优化问题，在这些问题上KKT残差在最后一次迭代和等权遍历平均处均为Ω(K⁻¹/²)。
AI.motivation: KKT残差是衡量一阶最优性的基本指标，在误差界条件下与KKT解集的距离可比。此前已知ADMM在目标误差和可行性违规上有O(K⁻¹)的遍历速率，但KKT残差的收敛速率尚不清楚。作者试图探究经典ADMM的KKT残差是否也能达到O(K⁻¹)的均匀界。
AI.method: 通过构造特定反例来证明下界。作者构造了一族固定维数、依赖时间范围的二块凸优化问题，在这些问题上分析经典ADMM在指定时间范围K处的KKT残差行为，分别考察最后一次迭代输出和等权遍历平均输出两种情况。
AI.result: 证明存在固定维数、依赖于时间范围的问题族，使得经典ADMM的KKT残差在最后一次迭代和等权遍历平均处均为Ω(K⁻¹/²)。因此，对两种输出而言，均匀的O(K⁻¹) KKT残差界都是不可能的。
AI.conclusion: 经典ADMM虽然能在目标误差和可行性违规上达到O(K⁻¹)的遍历速率，但其KKT残差在最坏情况下只能保证Ω(K⁻¹/²)的下界，表明KKT残差的均匀O(K⁻¹)界在一般凸问题上不可行。这一发现澄清了ADMM收敛性理论中的一个重要局限。

title: Gated Against One Model, Open to the Next: Option-Only Solvability in Legal Multiple-Choice Benchmarks
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. Dataset, model predictions and code at https://huggingface.co/datasets/overthelex/ua-judge-exam
summary:
Multiple-choice benchmarks are graded on whether a model picks the right option, not on whether it needed the question. Measuring that gap takes care: a model answering A to most items scores above chance wherever the key sits at A, and reads as recognition when it is not. We measure it on UA-JudgeExam: 11,990 four-option items with official keys, published by Ukraine's Higher Qualification Commission of Judges.
  Shown the options and no question, Claude Haiku 4.5 scores 0.383 against chance, and the leak is concentrated: 11.8% of items are answered blind on all eight option orders, against 0.2 items expected by chance. It is not quotation: search over 280,059 editions of Ukrainian legislation recovers 0.128. Gating those out retains 8,128 items, on which the gating model itself now scores 0.204, and GPT-5.6, which took no part in the selection, still answers 0.515 of them with the question hidden. Scoring twelve held-out models on the whole set and subtracting each one's answer-position habit, only two keep an excess: GPT-5.6 at +0.265, Sonnet 4.6 at +0.081. Without it the ranking misleads: Llama 3.1 8B scores 0.292 blind, above every model but those two, purely by answering A to 92% of items.
  The gate does select something real: on the items it rejected, eleven of twelve models score 0.518-0.789, every interval clear of what the same model scores on the items it kept. But that signal is one model's, and filtering on it does not transfer upward. Neither is visible on a 400-item sample, where nine models read as "statistically at chance". Rewriting distractors instead overshoots to 0.168, below chance and as exploitable. The same probe on LEXam returns chance: every option there points into the stem, none longer than 33 characters. Item format decides whether the problem can arise; capability decides how much is extracted. We release the corpus, the predictions and the harness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多项选择题基准测试中模型是否真正需要问题才能作答，而非仅凭选项就猜出答案。作者发布UA-JudgeExam（乌克兰法官资格考试的11,990道四选项题目），发现Claude Haiku 4.5在无问题情况下盲选得分0.383，显著高于随机水平，且泄露集中在11.8%的题目上。通过门控筛选、位置习惯校正等方法，仅GPT-5.6和Sonnet 4.6存在真实超额。作者还发现题目格式决定泄露是否可能出现，能力决定能提取多少。
AI.motivation: 现有多项选择基准只评估模型是否选对选项，而不评估模型是否真的需要问题文本才能作答。这种"数据泄露/题目可盲选"的差距会误导模型能力排名，急需系统性测量方法。
AI.method: 使用乌克兰法官资格考试的11,990道真题（UA-JudgeExam），设计三套测量方案：(1)盲选测试——只给选项不给问题，对比随机水平；(2)门控筛选——用法规库检索排除引文泄露项，保留8,128项后重测；(3)位置习惯校正——减去各模型回答位置偏好后计算超额分数。还跨LEXam数据集验证，并做小型样本和改写干扰项对照实验。
AI.result: Claude Haiku 4.5盲选得分0.383（随机水平0.2），11.8%题目可在全部八种选项顺序下盲答。法规检索仅恢复0.128，排除引文泄露后保留的8,128项上，GPT-5.6仍盲选0.515。校正位置习惯后仅GPT-5.6（+0.265）和Sonnet 4.6（+0.081）有真实超额。门控筛选不向上迁移；400项小样本上九模型呈"统计随机"假象；改写干扰项过度到0.168（低于随机）。LEXam数据集上探针返回随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 多项选择基准存在可测量的"无问题盲选"信号，且该信号集中在特定模型与特定题目子集。题目格式（选项是否独立于题干）决定泄露能否发生，模型能力决定提取量。评估基准时需校正位置习惯和门控偏差，否则排名会严重误导。

title: P2E-VQ: ECG-linked representation augmentation for PPG via discrete patch retrieval
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 talbles
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely used in consumer wearables because of its low cost and ease of acquisition. However, unlike electrocardiography (ECG), PPG measures peripheral pulse dynamics rather than cardiac electrical activity, limiting its ability to predict cardiac conditions that rely on ECG-specific morphological cues. Existing methods attempt to bridge this gap by reconstructing ECG signals from PPG signals. However, this inverse mapping is inherently ill-posed, and faithful waveform reconstruction does not necessarily translate into improved downstream performance. To address this challenge, we propose P2E-VQ, a retrieval-augmented framework that replaces ECG waveform reconstruction with ECG-linked representation retrieval. Specifically, P2E-VQ converts PPG patches into discrete tokens and retrieves ECG-linked information from a memory bank constructed exclusively from the training data. This process augments PPG representations while requiring only PPG signals during inference. Extensive experiments on five public datasets covering six downstream tasks, including clinical endpoint prediction and affective state recognition, demonstrate that P2E-VQ consistently outperforms pretrained baselines under a unified frozen-feature linear-probing protocol.

AI.tldr: P2E-VQ是一种检索增强框架，通过将PPG信号转换为离散token并从训练数据构建的记忆库中检索与ECG相关的表示，替代了传统PPG到ECG的波形重构方法，在推理时仅需PPG信号即可提升下游任务性能。在五个公开数据集、六个下游任务上优于预训练基线。
AI.motivation: PPG信号虽广泛用于可穿戴设备，但缺乏ECG的心电形态学信息，难以预测依赖ECG特征的心脏状况。现有方法通过从PPG重建ECG来弥补差距，但该逆向映射本身是病态问题（ill-posed），且忠实重建波形并不一定提升下游任务性能。
AI.method: 提出P2E-VQ检索增强框架：1) 将PPG patches量化为离散token；2) 从仅由训练数据构建的记忆库中检索与ECG相关的信息；3) 将检索到的ECG关联表示增强到PPG表示中。推理阶段仅需PPG信号，无需重建ECG波形。
AI.result: 在五个公开数据集覆盖六个下游任务（包括临床终点预测和情感状态识别）上，P2E-VQ在统一的冻结特征线性探测协议下始终优于预训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 用检索增强替代波形重构是弥合PPG与ECG信息差距的更有效策略，避免了病态映射问题，同时保持推理时仅需PPG输入的便捷性。

title: Real-Time Control of Sustainable Data Centers: A Two-Layer Model Predictive Control Framework with Workload Flexibility and Heat Recovery
comment: 22 pages, 14 figures
summary: This paper proposes a two-layer model predictive control (MPC) framework for the real-time operation of data centers integrated with on-site photovoltaic generation, battery energy storage, waste heat recovery, and district heating. The upper layer employs scenario-based stochastic optimization to jointly optimize intraday market participation, workload scheduling, and energy management under uncertainty. The lower layer adopts an adaptive tube-based MPC strategy that compensates short-term disturbances while tracking the dispatch references given by the upper layer. The framework further integrates multi-horizon forecasting to support real-time decision making. Microservice-based simulation studies under representative clear-sky and overcast operating conditions demonstrate that the proposed framework accurately tracks dispatch plans despite fast photovoltaic and workload fluctuations. Compared with single-layer control strategies, the adaptive lower-layer controller substantially reduces real-time dispatch deviations and the associated imbalance costs. In addition, the proposed framework naturally adapts to seasonal operating conditions and responds to carbon-aware operating signals, offering a practical approach for economically efficient, sustainable, and grid-supportive operation of future data centers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个双层模型预测控制（MPC）框架，用于数据中心实时运营，集成光伏发电、电池储能、废热回收和区域供热。上层采用基于场景的随机优化，联合优化日内市场参与、工作负载调度和能源管理；下层采用自适应tube-based MPC策略，跟踪上层给出的调度参考并补偿短期扰动。仿真表明该框架能准确跟踪调度计划，显著减少实时调度偏差和不平衡成本，并适应季节变化和碳感知信号。
AI.motivation: 数据中心能耗巨大且快速增长，其运营面临可再生能源波动、负荷不确定性和电网交互等多重挑战。现有单层控制策略难以同时处理日内市场决策与实时扰动补偿，需要一种能够在多时间尺度上协调优化与控制的框架，以实现经济高效、绿色可持续且对电网友好的数据中心运行。
AI.method: 提出双层MPC框架：上层采用场景随机优化，在日内市场、工作负载调度和能源管理之间进行联合优化；下层采用自适应tube-based MPC，在跟踪上层调度参考的同时补偿光伏和负载的快速波动；并整合多时间尺度预测以支持实时决策。
AI.result: 在晴朗和阴天两种代表性工况下的微服务仿真表明：该框架能准确跟踪调度计划，应对光伏和负载的快速波动；相比单层控制策略，自适应下层控制器大幅减少实时调度偏差及相关不平衡成本；框架能自然适应季节性运行条件并响应碳感知信号。
AI.conclusion: 该双层MPC框架为未来数据中心提供了一种实用、经济高效且可持续的运行方案，兼具电网支撑能力，能够有效协调多时间尺度的规划与控制决策。

title: Shape Operator PCA: Curvature-Aware Projections for Geometric Machine Learning
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables
summary: In this paper, we propose SHOPCA (Shape Operator-based Principal Component Analysis), a novel method for unsupervised metric learning and dimensionality reduction that incorporates differential geometric information into the covariance structure of classical PCA. SHOPCA regularizes the global covariance matrix using the mean shape operator, defined as the average of the absolute local shape operators estimated from the data manifold, steering principal components toward directions of both maximum variance and informative curvature. A single trace-normalized mixing coefficient $α$ controls the regularization, recovering standard PCA at $α= 0$ and a curvature-driven embedding as $α\to \infty$. We further introduce a fully unsupervised criterion for selecting $α$ based on the spectral eigengap of the regularized covariance matrix, maximizing the relative separation between the top-$d$ and remaining eigenvalues without using class labels. We evaluate SHOPCA on more than 50 real-world benchmark datasets, comparing it with PCA, ISOMAP, and UMAP using Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), Fowlkes-Mallows index (FM), and V-measure. Results show that SHOPCA consistently improves clustering quality over PCA across a broad range of datasets and surpasses UMAP on small-sample settings, where iterative neighborhood-based manifold estimation can degrade. SHOPCA is computationally tractable, parameter-efficient, and applicable to domains requiring fully unsupervised, geometry-aware dimensionality reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SHOPCA（基于形状算子的主成分分析），一种将微分几何信息融入经典PCA协方差结构的无监督度量学习与降维方法。通过平均形状算子正则化全局协方差矩阵，引导主成分同时朝向最大方差和信息丰富曲率方向。引入基于谱特征隙的无监督混合系数α选择准则，在50多个真实数据集上与PCA、ISOMAP和UMAP对比，SHOPCA在聚类质量上持续优于PCA，并在小样本场景下超越UMAP。
AI.motivation: 经典PCA仅关注数据的全局方差结构，忽略了数据流形的局部几何（曲率）信息，导致在非线性数据结构上降维效果受限。现有非线性方法（如UMAP、ISOMAP）虽然能捕捉流形结构，但在小样本场景下迭代邻域估计易退化，且依赖超参数调优。因此需要一种既能利用几何信息又保持计算高效、无需标签的全无监督降维方法。
AI.method: SHOPCA的核心方法包括：(1) 从数据流形估计局部形状算子，取绝对值后求平均得到平均形状算子；(2) 用该平均形状算子正则化PCA的全局协方差矩阵；(3) 通过单一迹归一化混合系数α控制正则化强度（α=0退化为标准PCA，α→∞时为曲率驱动嵌入）；(4) 提出基于正则化协方差矩阵谱特征隙的完全无监督α选择准则，最大化前d个特征值与剩余特征值之间的相对分离度。
AI.result: 在50多个真实世界基准数据集上，使用ARI、NMI、FM和V-measure四个指标评估，SHOPCA相比PCA在广泛数据集上持续提升聚类质量，并在小样本设定下超越UMAP（此时迭代邻域流形估计方法性能退化）。方法计算上可行、参数高效。
AI.conclusion: SHOPCA成功地将微分几何信息整合进PCA框架，提供了一种计算高效、参数简洁、完全无监督且几何感知的降维方法，特别适合小样本场景和需要无需标签的几何感知降维的应用领域。

title: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs across Text and Audio Modalities for Accessible Disaster Assistance
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures
summary: Effective disaster risk communication is a foundational humanitarian challenge, yet current emergency infrastructure fails to meet the needs of individuals with access and functional needs, including hard-of-hearing individuals, pregnant women, mothers with toddlers, and elderly individuals with dementia. Recent advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI), especially Multi-Modal Large Language Models (MM-LLMs), demonstrate powerful capabilities to serve diverse users across text, audio, image, and video modalities within a single unified system, such as a chatbot. However, their suitability for deployment rests on a property that receives limited scrutiny, i.e., whether these systems produce consistent, actionable outputs regardless of the modality through which a user communicates. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive analysis to understand the status of open-weight MM-LLMs using real emergency alert scenarios across four different vulnerable personas. These state-of-the-art (SOTA) models are evaluated on consistency of responses across text and audio modalities when the same task scenario is given. Findings indicate that no model achieves reliable consistency across modalities, and that performance gaps are heightened for personas with access needs, introducing modality-dependent inequity that undermines the humanitarian value of these systems. These results inform concrete design recommendations for building equitable, trustworthy, and inclusive AI tools for disaster risk communication.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了开源多模态大语言模型（MM-LLMs）在灾害风险沟通场景下，针对不同弱势人群（听障人士、孕妇、带幼儿母亲、老年痴呆患者）在文本与音频两种模态下输出的一致性与公平性，发现所有模型均无法实现跨模态可靠一致，且对具有无障碍需求的人群表现差距更大，存在模态依赖的不公平现象。
AI.motivation: 灾难风险沟通是基础性人道主义挑战，但现有应急基础设施未能满足有功能和无障碍需求人群（如听障人士、孕妇、带幼儿母亲、老年痴呆患者）的需求。虽然MM-LLMs具备服务多样化用户的能力，但其跨模态输出的一致性（即用户无论通过何种模态沟通都能获得一致可操作的结果）缺乏充分审查，这直接关系到系统的部署适用性与公平性。
AI.method: 使用真实应急警报场景，针对四种不同的弱势人群角色（听障人士、孕妇、带幼儿母亲、老年痴呆患者），对开源权重MM-LLMs进行综合分析。评估这些最先进模型在给定相同任务场景下，跨文本和音频模态的响应一致性。
AI.result: 研究发现：没有任何模型能够实现跨模态的可靠一致性；对于有无障碍需求的人群，性能差距更加显著；这种模态依赖的不公平削弱了这些系统的人道主义价值。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为构建公平、可信、包容的灾害风险沟通AI工具提供了具体的设计建议，强调了在设计此类系统时必须将跨模态一致性与人群公平性作为核心考量因素。

title: RecurrentGPT: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation in Transformers
summary: Scaling transformer language models creates an inherent tension between expressivity and memory efficiency. While unique weights across layers preserve functional specialization---from input-grounding to abstract refinement---they incur a substantial memory footprint. Conversely, standard depth-sharing enforces uniform transformations that collapse representational diversity and degrade modeling quality. We introduce RecurrentGPT, a recurrent depth transformer where fixed-depth prelude and coda blocks bracket a single shared core iterated R times. Inspired by gated recurrent neural networks, we employ a lightweight projection and an elementwise update gate---conditioned on the hidden state, the fixed prelude output, and noise resampled at every step---to modulate the recurrent update. This allows the model to specialize the input to the same few layers across recurrences, rather than requiring many unique layers to achieve functional diversity. Under an isoFLOPS constraint, a 3-layer RecurrentGPT matches the accuracy of a 12-layer GPT-2 Small baseline with similar training and inference FLOPs, and leads MoR and heavy-tail depth sampling in all nine scale-by-budget cells; at medium and large scale it approaches dense quality at the standard token budget and overtakes it at medium scale once that budget is doubled. Under an isoPARAMS constraint, deeper recurrence achieves a 2.76 validation loss versus 2.84 for a non-recurrent counterpart at matched parameter and data budget. Our results demonstrate that adaptive depth reuse is a principled strategy for trading parameters for quality: at large scale, 63% fewer parameters and 59% less peak decoding memory for a 10% increase in compiled generation latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RecurrentGPT，一种递归深度Transformer架构，通过固定深度的prelude和coda块包裹一个被迭代R次的共享核心块，并引入轻量级投影和基于门控的更新机制（受门控RNN启发），在isoFLOPS约束下用3层模型匹配12层GPT-2 Small的精度，在isoPARAMS约束下以更深的递归取得更低的验证损失，实现参数换质量的权衡（大尺度下减少63%参数和59%峰值解码内存）。
AI.motivation: 缩放Transformer语言模型存在表达性与内存效率之间的内在张力：各层使用独特权重能保留功能特化（从输入锚定到抽象精炼），但带来巨大的内存开销；反之，标准深度共享强制统一变换，会坍塌表征多样性并降低建模质量。作者希望在不牺牲功能多样性的前提下减少内存占用。
AI.method: 引入RecurrentGPT：固定深度的prelude和coda块包围一个共享核心块，该核心块被迭代R次。受门控循环神经网络（GRU）启发，使用轻量级投影和逐元素更新门——该门以隐藏状态、固定prelude输出及每步重新采样的噪声为条件——来调节递归更新。这使得模型能够将输入特化到同一组少数层中跨递归迭代，而非需要许多独特层来实现功能多样性。
AI.result: 1) isoFLOPS约束下：3层RecurrentGPT匹配12层GPT-2 Small基准精度，训练和推理FLOPs相当；在所有9个scale-by-budget单元中优于MoR和heavy-tail深度采样；中大规模下在标准token预算时接近密集质量，在中等规模预算加倍时超越密集质量。2) isoPARAMS约束下：更深的递归在参数和数据预算匹配时达到2.76验证损失，优于非递归对应模型的2.84。3) 大尺度下仅用63%的参数和59%更少的峰值解码内存，换取10%的编译生成延迟增加。
AI.conclusion: 自适应深度复用是一种原则性的策略，用于以参数换取质量。结果表明重复使用共享核心块并配合门控调制，可以在保持或提升建模质量的同时大幅减少参数和内存开销，为Transformer的高效深度设计提供了新思路。

title: On the Absence of Identifiable Manifolds in Finite-Max Composite Optimization
comment: 57 pages, 6 figures
summary: In nonsmooth optimization, identifiable sets describe the local region eventually reached by sequences converging to a prescribed critical point. When such a set is a $C^2$ manifold on which the objective restricts to a $C^2$ function, it is called an identifiable manifold. Their appeal lies in what they enable: many first-order methods identify these manifolds in finitely many iterations, after which the iterates enter a region in which the problem is effectively smooth. Consequently, many powerful tools and guarantees from smooth optimization transplant naturally to the nonsmooth setting. Owing to these properties, much existing work has focused on characterizing conditions that guarantee their existence. In this work, we study a complementary question: under what conditions is a critical point devoid of any identifiable manifold? We answer this by developing a deterministic branching criterion for a broad class of finite-max composite optimization problems, characterizing when a critical point admits no identifiable manifold. This criterion is surprisingly mild in certain classes of problems: it holds with high probability for overparameterized robust low-rank recovery and almost surely at common interpolators of random minimax regression, suggesting that the absence of identifiable manifolds may be the rule rather than the exception in modern optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非光滑优化中可识别流形缺失的问题，提出一个确定性分支准则，用于刻画有限最大值复合优化问题中临界点何时不拥有任何可识别流形。该准则在过参数化鲁棒低秩恢复和随机极小极大回归插值器上以高概率或几乎必然成立，表明现代优化中可识别流形缺失可能是常态而非例外。
AI.motivation: 已有大量工作聚焦于刻画保证可识别流形存在的条件，因为可识别流形使一阶方法在有限次迭代后进入平滑区域，从而移植平滑优化的工具。本文研究互补问题：在什么条件下临界点完全缺乏可识别流形。
AI.method: 针对一类广泛的有限最大值复合优化问题，发展了一个确定性分支准则（branching criterion），用于刻画临界点不拥有可识别流形的充分条件。
AI.result: 该准则在过参数化鲁棒低秩恢复问题中以高概率成立，在随机极小极大回归的常见插值器上几乎必然成立，说明可识别流形缺失在现代优化场景中广泛存在。
AI.conclusion: 可识别流形的缺失可能比以往认知更为普遍，这挑战了对非光滑优化问题行为的传统预期，提示需要重新审视一阶方法在这类问题上的收敛分析工具。

title: LUNG-KGMM: Knowledge-Guided Multimodal Learning for Lung Cancer Incidence Prediction
comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables, accepted by PRCV Oral
summary: Early identification of lung cancer risk is critical for timely intervention, yet existing prediction models are limited by their reliance on single data modalities and their inability to leverage structured clinical knowledge. We propose LUNG-KGMM, a knowledge-guided multimodal framework that integrates longitudinal electronic health records, radiology reports, chest radiograph representations, and guideline-derived knowledge for 1-to-6-year incident lung cancer prediction. To address modality heterogeneity and potential data leakage, we develop a leakage-sanitized report processing pipeline and a horizon-masked cumulative training objective that handles incomplete follow-up. We further introduce a knowledge-graph representation of clinical guidance that encodes report-triggered finding-attribute-action relations as an auditable knowledge stream. We build a multimodal development cohort from the publicly available MIMIC databases and construct a real-world validation cohort from the Xiamen Medical Big Data Platform. Extensive experiments on the MIMIC cohort demonstrate that LUNG-KGMM achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art methods, and validation on the Xiamen cohort further characterizes its cross-cohort portability and the need for local adaptation. The MIMIC development cohort is publicly accessible; the Xiamen cohort is governed by local data privacy regulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LUNG-KGMM，一个知识引导的多模态框架，整合纵向电子健康记录、放射学报告、胸片表征和指南知识，用于1-6年肺癌发病预测，并在MIMIC和厦门两个队列上验证了性能与跨队列可移植性。
AI.motivation: 早期识别肺癌风险对及时干预至关重要，但现有预测模型受限于依赖单一数据模态，且无法利用结构化临床知识。
AI.method: 提出LUNG-KGMM框架：(1)整合EHR、放射学报告、胸片表征及指南知识的多模态框架；(2)泄漏消毒的报告处理流程和水平掩蔽累积训练目标以处理模态异质性和数据泄露；(3)知识图谱表示临床指导，编码报告触发的发现-属性-行动关系作为可审计知识流。
AI.result: 在MIMIC队列上优于最先进方法，在厦门队列上验证了跨队列可移植性并揭示了本地适配的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 知识引导的多模态框架能显著提升肺癌预测性能，但跨队列应用需要本地化适配，MIMIC开发队列已公开可访问。

title: Stimulated Oscillations in Renewable Energy Integrated Power Systems - Part I : Mechanism and Analysis Methods
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Power Systems, 8 pages, 9 figures
summary: Oscillation is a critical issue that power systems have long faced. Especially over the past two decades, with the large-scale inte-gration of renewable energy into the grid, oscillation problems have posed a serious threat to the secure operation of power systems. However, the current literature has not fully explained the oscillation mechanism of renewable energy integrated power systems (REIPSs). In this paper, the underlying mechanism of stimulated oscillations is explored, with novel analytical methods proposed. Firstly, it is explained from both mathematical formu-las and physical interpretations that for an oscillation mode characterized by a pair of complex conjugate poles, the oscilla-tion risk under disturbance depends on the relative positional relationship between the corresponding poles and all other poles and zeros on the complex plane, rather than their standalone locations, i.e., the stability perceived by classical theory. Then the underlying mechanism of high amplitude oscillations induced by closely-located poles under even slight disturbance is clarified. On this basis, a theoretical framework for stimulated oscilla-tions applicable to REIPSs, covering its definition, mechanism, and methods, is proposed. Finally, this paper discusses the rela-tionship between the stimulated oscillation theory proposed herein and the classical stability-based theory, revealing that the research findings surpass rather than negate the classical theo-ries.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可再生能源并网电力系统（REIPSs）中的受激振荡问题，提出了一种新的理论框架。研究发现，振荡风险并不取决于极点的独立位置（经典稳定性理论的观点），而取决于闭环极点与所有其他极点、零点在复平面上的相对位置关系。论文从数学公式和物理解释两方面阐明了这一机制，提出了适用于REIPSs的受激振荡理论，并指出该理论是对经典稳定性理论的超越而非否定。
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源大规模并网，电力系统的振荡问题对安全运行构成严重威胁，但现有文献尚未完全解释REIPSs的振荡机理。经典的稳定性理论无法充分说明实际中观测到的高幅值振荡现象，亟需从新视角揭示其内在机制。
AI.method: 论文首先从数学公式和物理解释两方面阐明：对于由一对复共轭极点表征的振荡模态，扰动下的振荡风险取决于该极点与复平面上所有其他极点和零点的相对位置关系，而非其独立位置。进而澄清了紧密排列的极点在即使是微小扰动下也能诱发高幅值振荡的内在机理，并在此基础上构建了涵盖定义、机理和方法的受激振荡理论框架。
AI.result: 提出了一个适用于REIPSs的受激振荡理论框架，包括其定义、机理和分析方法；阐明了紧密排列的极点在轻微扰动下导致高幅值振荡的底层机制；并揭示了该理论与经典稳定性理论之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: 受激振荡理论是对经典稳定性理论的超越而非否定，它为理解REIPSs中的振荡现象提供了新的理论视角，有望补充和完善现有电力系统振荡分析体系。

title: Optimal Lower Bounds for Networked Information Aggregation
summary:
The problem of networked information aggregation, studied in Kearns et al. (2026), involves a group of learners situated on the vertices of a directed acyclic graph $G$, each learning a linear predictor $\widehat Y$ for a fixed random variable $Y$ given access to a local feature, as well as the predictors learnt by its parents. Learning proceeds iteratively, with learners ordered according to a topological sort of $G$. The main quantity of interest is the error incurred by the current learner, constrained to this flow of information, with respect to the best linear predictor using all the features seen so far. When the studied error is the MSE, i.e., $\mathbb{E} (\widehat Y - Y)^2$, Kearns et al. (2026) show that the error is at most $O(1/\sqrt{D})$ along a path of length $D$. They also obtain a hard instance where the MSE is lower bounded by $Ω(1/D)$, leaving the correct order open. In this work, we resolve this central open problem, and obtain a family of worst case problem instances with a MSE lower bound of $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$.
  By exploiting invariances in the structure of the learnt predictors, our analysis generalizes to all convex loss functions $\ell(\widehat Y, Y)$ satisfying regularity conditions which include strong convexity in a ball around the origin, and that the ideal predictor minimizing the population loss is positively correlated with the label. We show that networked information aggregation on a gaussian instance in our worst case family incurs an $\ell$-error lower bounded by $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$ with respect to this ideal predictor. We demonstrate that a variety of common losses satisfy these regularity conditions. In particular, the logistic loss satisfies them, and hence our analysis also closes the gap between the upper and lower bounds in Bateni et al. (2026).

AI.tldr: 本文解决了Kearns等人(2026)提出的网络化信息聚合问题中的核心开放问题，将均方误差（MSE）下界从Ω(1/D)提升至Ω(1/√D)，与上界匹配，从而闭合了差距。同时，分析推广到满足正则条件的各类凸损失函数。
AI.motivation: 网络化信息聚合问题中，Kearns等人(2026)证明了沿长度为D的路径误差上界为O(1/√D)，但仅获得Ω(1/D)的下界，二者之间存在阶数差距，该问题的正确阶数尚未确定。此外，误差分析仅针对MSE。
AI.method: 通过利用所学预测器结构中的不变性，构造一族最坏情况的高斯实例，证明在这些实例上MSE下界为Ω(1/√D)。分析进一步利用预测器结构的对称性，将结果推广到满足特定正则条件（包括原点附近强凸性、理想预测器与标签正相关）的一般凸损失函数。
AI.result: 获得了最坏情况实例族及其MSE下界Ω(1/√D)，与已知上界O(1/√D)匹配，闭合了MSE情形的开放问题。对于满足正则条件的凸损失（如Logistic损失），同样获得ℓ-误差下界Ω(1/√D)，同时闭合了Bateni等人(2026)工作中对数损失的上下界差距。
AI.conclusion: 该工作完全解决了网络化信息聚合中MSE误差的正确阶数问题，并将结果推广至更广泛的凸损失函数类别，验证了多种常见损失函数满足所需正则条件。

title: When Uncertainty Isn't Enough: An Empirical Study of Self-Correction in Code Generation
summary: Large language models for code generation often produce incorrect solutions without reliable indicators of failure. We study whether uncertainty estimation methods developed for natural language transfer to code generation, and whether such signals can improve code generation via selective self-correction. We evaluate five uncertainty methods: mean token entropy, verbalized confidence, $P(\text{True})$, entropy ensembles, and semantic entropy probes, across three small code LLMs on HumanEval and BigCodeBench. We find that multi-sample $P(\text{True})$ achieves the strongest correlation with correctness, while all the other methods, including semantic entropy probes, yield only weak correlation. We then use these uncertainty signals to drive three self-correction policies: adaptive decoding, uncertainty-based regeneration, and verification-based regeneration. Our results reveal a stronger negative finding than anticipated: uncertainty-based self-correction fails to reliably improve Pass@1, degrading accuracy in 5 of 6 configurations across both benchmarks ($-3$pp to $-10$pp), and adaptive decoding degrades accuracy in 4 of 6 configurations. Only verification-based self-correction reliably improves Pass@1, with gains of $+6$ to $+26$ percentage points on HumanEval and $+8$ to $+20$ percentage points on BigCodeBench, scaling inversely with baseline strength. These findings replicate consistently across both benchmarks and suggest that cheap uncertainty estimators are insufficient on their own to improve code correctness, and that their practical value lies in serving as gating signals for costlier execution-based correction loops rather than as standalone substitutes for verification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不确定性估计方法能否从自然语言迁移到代码生成任务，并评估其能否通过选择性自我纠错提升代码正确性。研究发现多采样P(True)与正确性相关性最强，但基于不确定性的自我纠错普遍无法可靠提升Pass@1（在6个配置中有5个导致精度下降3-10个百分点），只有基于验证的自我纠错能稳定提升性能（+6到+26个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成代码时经常产生错误且缺乏可靠的失败信号，作者希望探究自然语言领域的不确定性估计方法能否迁移到代码生成，并检验这些信号是否能通过选择性自我纠错提升代码正确率。
AI.method: 评估五种不确定性方法（平均token熵、口头化置信度、P(True)、熵集成、语义熵探针），在三个小型代码LLM上对HumanEval和BigCodeBench进行实验，并设计三种自我纠错策略：自适应解码、基于不确定性的再生、基于验证的再生。
AI.result: 多采样P(True)与正确性相关性最强，其他方法相关性较弱。基于不确定性的自我纠错在6个配置中5个导致准确率下降（-3到-10个百分点），自适应解码在6个配置中4个下降。只有基于验证的自我纠错可靠提升性能：HumanEval上+6到+26个百分点，BigCodeBench上+8到+20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 廉价的不确定性估计器本身不足以改善代码正确性，其实际价值在于作为更昂贵的基于执行的纠错循环的门控信号，而非独立替代验证机制。

title: A Pilot Study of Autocompleting Tokenizers
summary: Modern input methods routinely rely on autocomplete to omit information that can be recovered from local context. Inspired by these autocomplete-assisted writing systems, we investigate whether Transformer inputs can be compressed in a similar manner. Byte-level tokenization offers a simple and language-independent alternative to subword tokenization, but its longer input sequences typically result in increased computational cost and reduced model quality. We propose a compression scheme that employs a lightweight autoregressive byte language model to identify and remove bytes that are easily predictable from their surrounding context before Transformer processing. The resulting compressed representation is then provided as input to a standard encoder--decoder Transformer. Experiments on machine translation show that a substantial fraction of source-language bytes can be omitted without degrading translation quality. On English--French, our best method preserves translation performance while reducing source sequence length by nearly one-third. Additional experiments on Finnish--English, Russian--English, and Chinese--English demonstrate that the approach generalizes across diverse writing systems and morphological typologies, yielding comparable or improved translation quality at compression ratios between 0.47 and 0.67. These findings suggest that many input bytes are predictable enough to be represented implicitly rather than explicitly, providing a simple mechanism for reducing the sequence-length overhead associated with byte-level models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于字节级压缩的Transformer输入压缩方案，利用轻量级自回归字节语言模型识别并去除可预测的字节，在保持翻译质量的同时大幅缩短源序列长度，实验表明在多个语言对上可实现0.47-0.67的压缩比。
AI.motivation: 字节级分词虽简单且语言无关，但会产生更长的输入序列，导致计算成本增加和模型质量下降。受自动补全输入法的启发，作者探索是否可以在Transformer处理前压缩输入中可预测的字节。
AI.method: 使用轻量级自回归字节语言模型识别并移除可由上下文轻松预测的字节，将压缩后的表示输入标准的编码器-解码器Transformer。
AI.result: 在英语-法语翻译中保持翻译性能的同时将源序列长度减少近三分之一；在芬兰语-英语、俄语-英语和中文-英语上均取得可比或更好的翻译质量，压缩比在0.47到0.67之间。
AI.conclusion: 许多输入字节具有足够的可预测性，可以隐式而非显式地表示，这为减少字节级模型的序列长度开销提供了一种简单机制。

title: Doubling the dimension yields a benign landscape for the squared-stress
comment: 38 pages
summary:
We consider the Euclidean distance geometry problem (EDG): given a subset of the pairwise distances of an unknown cloud of $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^\ell$, recover the point cloud up to rigid motions. When $n$ is large, a popular practical approach is to minimize a nonconvex quartic, known as the squared-stress or s-stress, over point clouds in $\mathbb{R}^k$, with $k$ potentially larger than $\ell$. It is a long-standing open problem to understand the optimization landscape of the s-stress when all pairwise distances are known (Malone and Trosset, 2000; Parhizkar, 2013). It was recently shown that the landscape is not benign when $k=\ell$, and it was conjectured that the landscape becomes benign as soon as $k\ge \ell+1$ (Song et al., 2025; Criscitiello et al., 2026).
  Here, we show that the complete-graph s-stress has a benign landscape whenever $k\ge 2(\ell+1)$, establishing the conjecture up to a factor of two. A key idea is to view second-order criticality as a containment of two ellipsoids; finding a descent direction then corresponds to finding a separating hyperplane that violates this containment. This dual perspective yields the stated landscape result, and also applies to any measurement operator whose inverse satisfies a simple frame condition.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了欧几里得距离几何问题的s-stress（平方应力）函数的优化景观。已知所有成对距离时，作者证明了当嵌入维度k≥2(ℓ+1)时，完全图的s-stress具有良性景观（即所有二阶临界点都是全局最优），将此前关于k≥ℓ+1的猜想建立到了两倍因子内。核心思想是将二阶临界性转化为两个椭球的包含关系，寻找下降方向等价于找到违反该包含关系的分离超平面。
AI.motivation: 欧几里得距离几何问题（EDG）是从部分成对距离中恢复点云的重要问题。在n较大时，实践中常用最小化非凸四次函数（s-stress）的方法，但其优化景观一直未被理解。这是一个长期未解的问题（Malone和Trosset, 2000; Parhizkar, 2013）。近期研究表明当k=ℓ时景观并非良性，并有猜想认为当k≥ℓ+1时景观变为良性。证明这一猜想对理解该优化问题的全局收敛性至关重要。
AI.method: 作者采用了一个关键的双重视角：将二阶临界性视为两个椭球的包含关系。具体而言，寻找下降方向的问题被转化为寻找一个违反该椭球包含关系的分离超平面。这种对偶视角不仅用于证明完全图s-stress在k≥2(ℓ+1)时具有良性景观，还被推广到任何其逆满足简单框架条件（frame condition）的测量算子。这一框架统一了多种测量场景下的景观分析。
AI.result: 作者证明了完全图的s-stress在k≥2(ℓ+1)时具有良性景观，即在该维度条件下所有二阶临界点都是全局最小值，从而将先前关于k≥ℓ+1的猜想推进到两倍因子之内。该结果还适用于任意满足框架条件的测量算子，具有更广泛的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作显著推进了对EDG问题s-stress优化景观的理解，通过椭球包含与分离超平面的几何对偶框架，建立了良性景观的充分条件。虽然尚未完全证明k≥ℓ+1的原始猜想，但两倍因子内的结果为此方向提供了重要的方法论基础和进一步优化的空间。

title: pico-type: A 1.5M-Parameter Byte-Level Multi-Head Content Classifier
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables
summary: We introduce pico-type, a byte-level multi-head content classifier with approximately 1.5 million parameters that simultaneously predicts seven content properties from raw UTF-8 bytes in a single forward pass. Operating directly at the byte level -- no tokenizer, no subword vocabulary, no pretrained embeddings -- pico-type classifies coarse type (12 classes), modality (8), subtype (24), code language (62), text language (30), file MIME type (90), and risk flags (6-label multi-label: API keys, JWTs, passwords, emails, phone numbers, SSH keys). The architecture combines a learned byte embedding, three convolutional blocks with growing receptive fields, two bidirectional attention layers with rotary position encodings, and a statistical pooling layer feeding seven Matryoshka-style classification heads. Four tiered variants (tiny/small/base/pro) share the same trunk with sliced representations from 16 to 576 dimensions, yielding ONNX exports under 210 KB and CPU inference under 10 ms. Trained on a mixture of synthetic templates and real-world data (8709 GitHub code samples, 5000 Wikipedia articles), pico-type achieves 60.3 percent code language accuracy on The Heap benchmark (24 languages) and 98.2 percent text language accuracy on Wikipedia (30 languages) -- improvements of +57 and +79 percentage points respectively over the synthetic-only baseline. Format-based heads (coarse, modality, subtype, file_mime, risk) maintain 100 percent accuracy on synthetic benchmarks. The model, code, and pretrained weights are released under Apache 2.0.

AI.tldr: pico-type 是一个约150万参数的字节级多内容分类器，无需分词器或预训练嵌入，直接在原始UTF-8字节上同时预测七种内容属性（粗类型、模态、子类型、代码语言、文本语言、MIME类型和风险标志），模型体积小（ONNX导出<210KB）、推理快（CPU<10ms），在合成+真实数据训练后显著提升了代码和文本语言分类准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有内容分类器通常依赖分词器和预训练嵌入，模型体积大、推理开销高，难以在资源受限场景下部署。作者希望构建一个无需分词、轻量级且能同时预测多种内容属性的分类器。
AI.method: 架构包含学习型字节嵌入、三个卷积块（感受野递增）、两个带旋转位置编码的双向注意力层、统计池化层，以及七个Matryoshka风格分类头。提供tiny/small/base/pro四个变体（16-576维切片）。训练数据为合成模板与真实数据混合（8709个GitHub代码样本+5000个Wikipedia文章）。
AI.result: 在The Heap基准上代码语言准确率达60.3%（24种语言），Wikipedia上文本语言准确率98.2%（30种语言），较纯合成基线分别提升+57和+79个百分点。格式相关头（粗类型、模态、子类型、MIME、风险）在合成基准上保持100%准确率。
AI.conclusion: pico-type证明无需分词器的纯字节级轻量模型即可高效完成多任务内容分类，在体积、速度和准确率之间取得良好平衡，且以Apache 2.0开源发布。

title: Novel methodology for obtaining design structure matrices using network identification
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to System engineering
summary: Design structure matrices (DSMs) are used to comprehensively represent complex systems. They visualize and describe the dependencies between various variables, processes, states, and events. As such they are used in several system engineering approaches, such as requirement and interface management, fault detection, and supervisory control. Currently, a DSM is typically built from knowledge of experts. This may lead to an incomplete or imbalanced DSMs. For instance, elements and links might be missing or superfluous. In this article, we propose a novel method to acquire the DSM using state-of-the-art network identification methods. This demonstrates a proof-of-principle of identifying DSMs from data as an additional tool to the standard heuristic approach. In the future, we plan to embed DSMs in system design and supervisory controllers. We apply this technique to identify the DSM of a fusion reactor modelled by a five-chamber plasma model describing the transport in a tokamak.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用网络识别方法从数据中自动获取设计结构矩阵（DSM）的新方法，作为传统专家启发式构建DSM的补充工具，并在一个五腔室托卡马克等离子体模型上进行了原理验证。
AI.motivation: 传统的DSM通常由领域专家凭经验构建，可能导致矩阵不完整或不平衡，例如元素和连接可能缺失或多余。因此需要一种更客观、数据驱动的方法来自动获取DSM。
AI.method: 利用当前先进的网络识别方法，从系统数据中自动识别DSM，将其作为标准启发式方法的补充工具。
AI.result: 该方法成功应用于一个由五腔室等离子体模型描述的聚变反应堆（托卡马克）中，识别出其DSM，验证了该方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了从数据中识别DSM的原理可行性，未来计划将DSM嵌入系统设计和监督控制器中。

title: PERO: Efficient Robust Post-Training Foundation Models for Encrypted Traffic Classification
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables, conference
summary: Encrypted traffic classification is vital for network security, yet real-world deployments are inherently sensitive to rare but high-loss errors such as misclassification of malicious traffic. The encrypted traffic foundation model, as a promising general-purpose technique, can achieve impressive overall performance. However, employing standard objectives such as empirical risk minimization often overlooks high-risk tail events, and commonly used performance metrics hardly reflect robustness limitations in risk-sensitive scenarios. Directly applying robust optimization objectives, such as conditional value-at-risk, to post-training is computationally prohibitive for large models, as identifying high-loss samples exhausts substantial computation. To this end, we propose Pre-Evaluation Robust Optimization (PERO), an efficient robust post-training framework for encrypted traffic foundation models. PERO employs a lightweight proxy to estimate sample-wise risk and selects a subset of high-risk samples to update the foundation model, decoupling risk estimation from expensive large-model optimization. Extensive experiments on typical encrypted traffic datasets show that PERO achieves competitive or superior robustness and average performance compared to outstanding robust post-training methods, while significantly reducing computational and memory costs.

AI.tldr: PERO是一个针对加密流量基础模型的高效鲁棒后训练框架，通过轻量级代理模型估计样本风险并仅选择高风险样本子集更新模型，将风险估计与昂贵的大模型优化解耦，在显著降低计算和内存成本的同时实现与传统鲁棒方法相当或更优的鲁棒性和平均性能。
AI.motivation: 加密流量分类中，恶意流量误分类等高风险尾部事件虽罕见但损失巨大。现有基础模型使用标准经验风险最小化目标忽略了高风险尾部事件，而直接应用条件风险价值等鲁棒优化目标对大型模型进行后训练计算开销过高，因为识别高损失样本需要消耗大量计算资源。
AI.method: PERO框架包含两个关键设计：(1) 使用轻量级代理模型估计样本级风险，避免了在大模型上进行昂贵的风险识别；(2) 基于代理模型估计出的风险选择高风险样本子集，仅用这些样本更新基础模型，从而将风险估计与大规模模型优化解耦。
AI.result: 在典型的加密流量数据集上的大量实验表明，PERO相比优秀的鲁棒后训练方法能够达到竞争性甚至更优的鲁棒性和平均性能，同时显著降低计算和内存开销。
AI.conclusion: PERO为加密流量基础模型提供了一种计算高效的鲁棒后训练方案，能够在资源受限条件下实现对高风险样本的关注，兼顾鲁棒性与实用性。

title: Cross-Domain Industrial Fault Detection by Causal Mechanism Monitoring
summary: Unsupervised fault detection in industrial systems is dominated by reconstruction based methods that monitor individual sensor marginal distributions. This misses coupling faults, where the physical relationship between sensor groups breaks while marginal statistics remain normal. Such faults evade marginal monitoring and persist as latent failures, with direct consequences for system reliability and safety. We propose CMR-Mamba (Causal Mechanism Representation Mamba), which trains per domain Mamba state-space encoders on healthy data. A causal cross-modal predictor regularises these encoders so that the effect-channel manifold reflects the normal cause-to-effect coupling. Anomalies are scored by k-nearest-neighbour (kNN) distance on this manifold or by the mechanism residual between the observed and the causally predicted effect embedding. We evaluate CMR-Mamba on electromechanical (Paderborn bearings), hydraulic (ZeMA) and cyber-physical (SWaT) coupling-fault domains. Ablations establish two findings. First, k-NN manifold scoring, rather than the encoder family, is the dominant source of gain over reconstruction-error scoring, improving baselines by up to 0.42 AUROC and exceeding the gain from causal regularisation. Second, aggregate AUROC is saturated by easy faults that any strong method solves, so the methods separate only on the low-separability subset. There CMR-Mamba leads the evaluated baselines on Paderborn artificial defects and on SWaT stealthy attacks, which keep every sensor inside its normal range and which marginal methods detect only at chance. CMR-Mamba therefore offers an interpretable and consistently competitive approach to coupling-fault detection across mechanical, hydraulic and cyber-physical systems. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/status/CMR_Mamba_MFD_1177.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CMR-Mamba（因果机制表示Mamba），一种面向工业系统耦合故障的无监督检测方法。它使用Mamba状态空间编码器在健康数据上训练，并通过因果跨模态预测器正则化，使效应通道流形反映正常的因果耦合关系。通过kNN流形距离或机制残差打分，在机电、液压和网络物理系统上验证了有效性，尤其擅长检测每个传感器都在正常范围内的隐蔽攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有的无监督故障检测主要基于重构方法，仅监控单个传感器的边际分布，无法检测耦合故障——即传感器组之间的物理关系断裂而边际统计仍正常的情况。这类故障会逃避边际监控并持续存在，对系统可靠性和安全性构成直接威胁。
AI.method: 1) 在每个域上训练独立的Mamba状态空间编码器，输入为健康数据；2) 使用因果跨模态预测器正则化编码器，使效应通道的流形反映正常的"因到果"耦合关系；3) 通过两种方式评分异常：kNN距离（在效应流形上）或机制残差（观测到的效应嵌入与因果预测的效应嵌入之差）。
AI.result: 在Paderborn轴承（机电）、ZeMA（液压）和SWaT（网络物理）三个耦合故障域上评估。消融实验发现：1) kNN流形打分是主要增益来源（比重构误差打分提升高达0.42 AUROC），超过因果正则化带来的增益；2) 总体AUROC被简单故障饱和，方法差异体现在低可分离性子集上。CMR-Mamba在Paderborn人工缺陷和SWaT隐蔽攻击上领先基线，后者使边际方法只能达到随机水平。
AI.conclusion: CMR-Mamba提供了可解释且持续有竞争力的耦合故障检测方法，适用于机械、液压和网络物理系统。它对每个传感器都保持正常范围的隐蔽攻击尤其有效，弥补了边际监控方法的根本缺陷。

title: Why Vision Fails as a Universal Bridge: Rectifying Modality Asynchrony in Multilingual MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit substantial performance degradation in non-English visual reasoning, despite the strong multilingual competence of their text-only backbones. While mechanistic evidence from text-only models suggests that non-English inputs are routed through an English-centric latent space, the multimodal implications of this phenomenon remain unexplored. Through rigorous mechanistic analysis, we identify the \textbf{Ghost Anchor} phenomenon: a temporal modality asynchrony where linguistic translation to the English semantic manifold completes in early layers, while visual semanticization remains immature. Consequently, visual signals are physically present yet functionally invisible during the early alignment window. To rectify this, we propose \textbf{ANCHOR}, a training framework employing Proactive Visual Anchoring (PVA) to accelerate early visual semantic emergence, ensuring visual representations proactively guide linguistic translation. Mechanistic interventions confirm that ANCHOR successfully restores the causal influence of visual signals during early translation. Furthermore, extensive experiments on XMMMU, MaXM, and CVQA demonstrate that ANCHOR consistently outperforms standard baselines, achieving robust visual reasoning across both fine-tuned and zero-shot languages.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机制分析发现多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在非英语视觉推理中性能下降的深层原因——"Ghost Anchor"现象（时间模态异步：语言翻译在早期层完成，而视觉语义化尚未成熟），并提出ANCHOR训练框架，通过主动视觉锚定（PVA）加速早期视觉语义涌现，从而恢复视觉信号在早期翻译阶段的因果影响力，在XMMMU、MaXM、CVQA基准上显著提升非英语视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管MLLMs的文本骨干具有强大的多语言能力，但在非英语视觉推理中仍存在显著的性能退化。已有文本模型的机制证据表明非英语输入通过英语中心潜在空间进行路由，但这一现象在多模态情境下的影响尚未被探索。作者希望揭示其深层机制并加以纠正。
AI.method: 1) 通过严格的机制分析识别"Ghost Anchor"现象：语言翻译到英语语义流形的过程在早期层完成，而视觉语义化仍不成熟，导致视觉信号在早期对齐窗口期间"物理存在但功能不可见"。2) 提出ANCHOR训练框架，采用主动视觉锚定（Proactive Visual Anchoring, PVA）加速早期视觉语义的涌现，使视觉表征能够主动引导语言翻译过程。
AI.result: 机制干预证实ANCHOR成功恢复了视觉信号在早期翻译阶段的因果影响。在XMMMU、MaXM和CVQA基准上的大量实验表明，ANCHOR在微调语言和零样本语言上均一致优于标准基线，实现了稳健的视觉推理性能。
AI.conclusion: ANCHOR通过解决Ghost Anchor（时间模态异步）问题，有效弥合了MLLMs在非英语视觉推理中的性能差距，证明通过主动视觉锚定可以确保视觉表征在语言翻译早期阶段发挥引导作用，从而实现跨语言鲁棒的视觉推理。

title: Battery-Swapping Station Operation Under Forecast Uncertainty: A Scenario-Based Stochastic MPC Framework
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures
summary: Battery-swapping stations (BSSs) can shorten electric-vehicle energy replenishment while using centrally managed battery inventories as flexible grid-connected storage. Realizing both benefits requires the station to schedule charging, grid discharge, and swapping service before future customer demand and electricity prices are known. This paper develops a forecast-aware rolling-horizon operating framework for this problem. A lightweight DLinear model predicts 24-hour price and demand trajectories, Stein variational gradient descent quantifies their uncertainty through representative scenarios, and a two-stage stochastic model predictive controller converts those scenarios into station decisions. The controller accounts for service shortfall, terminal readiness, a protected service buffer, and electrochemical degradation without assuming perfect future information. The application contribution is an implementable controller that coordinates the station's mobility-service and energy-storage roles. The methodological contribution is a modular forecast-to-control interface that separates the operational value of mean-forecast accuracy from that of uncertainty representation. In a 120-day closed-loop evaluation, DLinear-SVGD SMPC achieves the lowest cost among the implementable controllers. Relative to deterministic DLinear MPC, it reduces final cost by 1.2\% and service-shortfall hours by 80.7\%, with 99.10\% of the evaluated hours free of shortfall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种预测感知的滚动时域运行框架，用于电池换电站（BSS）的调度决策。该框架采用DLinear模型预测24小时电价与需求，通过Stein变分梯度下降生成代表性场景量化不确定性，并由两阶段随机模型预测控制器（SMPC）将这些场景转化为换电站决策，在120天闭环评估中实现最低成本与显著减少服务缺口的成效。
AI.motivation: 电池换电站既能缩短电动汽车补能时间，又能利用集中管理的电池库存作为灵活的并网储能，但要同时实现这两项效益，需要在未来客户需求和电价未知的情况下调度充电、电网放电及换电服务，这是一个具有挑战性的不确定环境下的决策问题。
AI.method: 方法包含三个模块：(1) 轻量级DLinear模型预测24小时电价与需求轨迹；(2) Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）通过代表性场景量化预测不确定性；(3) 两阶段随机模型预测控制器（SMPC）将场景转化为决策，并考虑服务短缺、末端就绪状态、保护性服务缓冲区及电化学退化等因素，不假设完美的未来信息。
AI.result: 在120天闭环评估中，DLinear-SVGD SMPC在所有可实施的控制器中实现最低成本。相比确定性DLinear MPC，最终成本降低1.2%，服务短缺小时数减少80.7%，且99.10%的评估小时无服务短缺。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献在于：应用层面提供了一个可实施的控制器，协调换电站的移动服务与储能双重角色；方法层面提出了模块化的"预测到控制"接口，将均值预测精度的运行价值与不确定性表征的价值分离，为电池换电站的运行优化提供了新的技术路径。

title: Demand-Driven Vertiport Siting and Discrete-Event Fleet Simulation for On-Demand Urban Air Mobility Network Design
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026)
summary: This paper presents a demand-driven framework for on-demand Urban Air Mobility (UAM) network design that links vertiport siting, fleet simulation, and door-to-door travel-time feasibility. Demand is estimated from commuter and passenger activity data, converted into spatial trip-end points, and clustered using K-means to generate candidate vertiport locations. Candidate networks are screened using range and minimum station-spacing constraints, then evaluated with a discrete-event simulation that models multi-vehicle dispatch, deadhead relocation, battery swaps, and service regularity. Flight time and energy consumption are computed using a point-mass eVTOL performance model. In a Greater Los Angeles case study, the preferred design expands from four stations and four eVTOLs at low demand to sixteen stations and twelve eVTOLs at the highest tested demand level. Results show that larger fleets improve completion time and vehicle-arrival regularity but do not eliminate deadhead flights, indicating that spatial demand imbalance remains an operational burden. The travel-time savings analysis further suggests that UAM is most defensible for longer or congestion-heavy trips where sufficient non-flight time remains after accounting for flight time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种需求驱动、按需响应的城市空中交通（UAM）网络设计框架，将垂直起降场选址、车队仿真与门到门出行时间可行性评估相结合。通过通勤与乘客活动数据估算需求，利用K-means聚类生成候选站点，并通过离散事件仿真评估多车辆调度、空驶调度、电池更换与航班准点率。大洛杉矶案例研究表明，需求增长时站点与机队规模需同步扩张，但空间需求不均衡仍造成空驶负担，且UAM在长距离或拥堵场景下最具出行时间优势。
AI.motivation: UAM网络设计需要综合考虑基础设施选址、运营调度与实际出行时间可行性，但现有研究往往将这些问题割裂处理，缺乏一个统一的需求驱动框架来评估网络在不同需求水平下的表现。
AI.method: 采用需求驱动框架：先从通勤与旅客活动数据估算需求并转换为空间出行端点，再通过K-means聚类生成候选垂直起降场位置，利用航程和最小站间距约束筛选候选网络，最后用离散事件仿真（模拟多车调度、空驶再定位、电池更换、准点率）结合点质量eVTOL性能模型评估飞行时间与能耗。
AI.result: 在大洛杉矶案例中，需求从低到高时，最优网络从4个站点/4架eVTOL扩展至16个站点/12架eVTOL。更大机队改善了完成时间和车次到达规律性，但无法消除空驶飞行，说明空间需求不均衡仍是运营负担。出行时间节约分析表明UAM在长途或拥堵严重的行程中最具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: UAM网络设计需随需求动态扩展基础设施与机队规模；操作层面，空驶调度难以完全消除，UAM的服务价值应聚焦于长距离或高拥堵场景，以保留足够的非飞行时间来体现其出行时间优势。

title: Benchmarking Quantum Machine Learning for Power-System Attack Detection: Evaluation Choices Decide the Outcome Before the Models Do
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables. Code, configs, and seeded pipelines: https://github.com/rzn-git/quantum_grid_attack_detection_benchmark
summary: Machine-learning detectors for power-system cyberattacks are themselves attack surfaces, and quantum machine learning has been proposed for them. We benchmark fidelity-kernel SVMs and variational classifiers against six tuned classical models on public power-system attack data (Mississippi State/ORNL), across white-box, transfer, decision-based black-box, and poisoning attacks. Our headline finding is methodological: the benchmark's answers are set by the evaluator's choices before the models. Eight choices -- six in the evaluation protocol, two in the tuning the benchmark itself runs -- each reversed or moved a conclusion at fixed models. The largest is the split: the row-level protocol scores 0.905 macro-F1 where holding whole source files out leaves 0.594, and in the capped matched-dimensionality regime the quantum arm sits within noise of chance with the classical arm 0.024 above it. A fidelity kernel looks most robust until attacked directly (retention 0.886 to 0.064); a mis-fitted surrogate manufactures a 10x asymmetry; an unseeded black-box attack moves 75% between restarts. A positive control explains the accuracy null: the labels, not the pipeline. We give the control that catches each choice and release the seeded benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文对电力系统网络攻击的机器学习检测器（含量子机器学习方案）进行基准测试，核心发现是评估结论主要由评估协议的选择决定，而非模型本身。作者识别了八个关键选择（六个在评估协议，两个在基准调优），每个都能在固定模型下逆转或改变结论，并提供了对应的阳性对照实验及公开的带种子基准。
AI.motivation: 电力系统网络攻击的机器学习检测器本身也是攻击面，量子机器学习被提出用于此场景。但先前研究缺乏严格的基准测试，且评估协议的选择可能系统性扭曲结论，亟待一个方法论层面更严谨的基准来检验这些模型的真实性能与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 在公开的密西西比州立大学/橡树岭国家实验室电力系统攻击数据上，将保真度核SVM和变分分类器与六个调优后的经典模型进行对比，在四种攻击场景（白盒、迁移、基于决策的黑盒、投毒）下评估，并系统性地检验八个评估/调优选择对结论的影响，辅以阳性对照实验。
AI.result: 逐行划分得0.905 macro-F1，而留出整个源文件时仅0.594；量子支臂在受限的匹配维度体制下与随机噪声无异，经典支臂仅高出0.024。保真度核在未直接攻击时最鲁棒（保持率0.886），但被直接攻击后骤降至0.064；错误拟合的替代模型制造了10倍不对称性；无种子的黑盒攻击在重启间移动75%。
AI.conclusion: 基准测试的答案在模型评估之前就已被评估者的选择所决定。作者提供了能够捕获每个选择的控制实验，并发布了带种子的基准以供复现，呼吁研究界警惕评估协议选择对结论的决定性影响。

title: Position: AI Agents in Scientific Teams Should Be Studied as Human-Agent Systems
comment: 15 pages. Accepted at the COLM 2nd Workshop on Language Models for Scientific Discovery
summary: Large language model-based agents are increasingly deployed as collaborators in scientific discovery yet most current work focuses on the autonomous capabilities of "AI Scientists". We argue that this overlooks the social aspects of scientific teamwork, and that studying AI Scientists as human-agent systems (HAS)--where the unit of analysis is the human-agent pair--is both underexplored and undervalued. We establish these points through literature and empirical analysis, and highlight recent incidences and studies which show that deploying agents in science without accounting for human-agent dynamics introduces near-term risks, including reduced diversity of scientific inquiry. Through analysis of real-world case studies, we show that scientists and agents can augment each other's capabilities. We call for new research that adopts the HAS lens to develop mathematical frameworks for understanding and fostering human-AI synergy in scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前AI科学家研究过度关注自主能力，忽视了科学团队协作的社会性。作者主张应以"人-智能体系统"(HAS)视角研究AI科学家，即把分析单位定为人-智能体对，并通过文献分析、实证研究和真实案例论证了这一观点的必要性和价值。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数AI科学家研究聚焦于智能体的自主能力，但忽略了科学团队协作中的社会层面。本文认为这存在不足，因为忽视人机动态会带来短期风险（如科学研究多样性降低），因此需要从人-智能体系统视角重新审视AI科学家的研究与部署。
AI.method: 通过三方面开展工作：(1)文献分析与实证研究论证HAS视角被低估；(2)列举近期事件和研究案例，展示忽视人机动态带来的风险；(3)通过真实案例分析展示科学家与智能体能够相互增强各自的能力。
AI.result: 研究证实：忽视人-智能体动态会带来短期风险（包括降低科学研究多样性）；同时真实案例表明科学家和智能体在协作中能够互补增强彼此能力，验证了采用HAS视角的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁学界采用人-智能体系统视角开展新研究，建立数学框架来理解和促进科学发现中的人类-AI协同效应。

title: A Declarative-Procedural Perspective on Expert Routing in Bilingual Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables (including appendix)
summary: We investigate whether Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models develop linguistically structured expert routing during bilingual language acquisition. Inspired by the Declarative-Procedural framework, we analyze lexical, grammatical, and syntactic processing in a decoder-only English-German MoE Transformer trained under sequential language exposure. We construct a probe-based validation set and extract token-level routing distributions to quantify category-dependent specialisation using mutual information, routing entropy, and Jensen-Shannon distance. The curriculum-trained model exhibits a peak mutual information of 0.1148 at layer 5, indicating category-dependent differences in routing distributions across linguistic categories. Surprisingly, a no-curriculum baseline trained on mixed English-German data shows stronger aggregate specialisation, reaching a peak mutual information of 0.2599 at the same layer. These results suggest that interpretable linguistic organization emerges within MoE routing patterns even without sequential language exposure. A replication at a second training seed shows that the no-curriculum condition's specialisation concentrates on a single language whose identity is seed-dependent, whereas the curriculum consistently yields a stable, language-balanced routing profile; rather than uniformly increasing specialisation, staged bilingual exposure reduces single-language dominance. The official Github repository: https://github.com/Amrit828/DP-Theory-MOE-Interpretability-Research

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合专家（MoE）语言模型在双语习得过程中是否发展出具有语言学结构的专家路由。通过在英语-德语顺序暴露训练的MoE Transformer上，使用探针验证集和令牌级路由分布分析，发现类别相关的专业化确实出现，而混合数据训练（无课程）反而表现出更强的总体专业化，但课程训练产生更稳定、语言平衡的路由配置。
AI.motivation: 受声明性-程序性（Declarative-Procedural）框架启发，探究MoE语言模型在顺序语言暴露下是否形成语言学上有组织的专家路由，以及不同训练策略（课程 vs 混合）对路由专业化的影响。
AI.method: 构建探针验证集，提取令牌级路由分布，使用互信息、路由熵和Jensen-Shannon距离量化类别依赖的专业化。训练基于顺序暴露的课程模型和混合数据的无课程基线模型，并进行第二种子复制实验。
AI.result: 课程模型在第5层达到峰值互信息0.1148；无课程基线在相同层达到0.2599，总体专业化更强。但复制实验显示无课程条件的专业化集中在单一语言（具体身份依赖种子），而课程训练稳定地产生语言平衡的路由配置。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的语言学组织即使在无顺序语言暴露的情况下也会在MoE路由模式中出现；顺序双语暴露的作用不是均匀增加专业化，而是减少单一语言主导，促进语言平衡的路由配置。

title: Nonnegative Quadratics over a Quadrant with a Bilinear Constraint
summary: We study quadratic polynomials that are nonnegative on the non-compact set \[ F:=\{(x_1,x_2)\in\mathbb R^2:\ x_1\ge 0,\ x_2\ge 0,\ x_1x_2\le 1\}. \] All extreme rays of the cone of nonnegative quadratic polynomials are characterized on this set. The characterization allows us to study parameterized valid inequalities for quadratic convexifications involving $F$, which yields a semidefinite representation of its lifted convex hull in the quadratic space. Our analysis on extreme ray characterization separates the positive-semidefinite (PSD) and non-PSD branches, reduces the latter to boundary nonnegativity, and classifies the boundary contacts of the relevant extreme rays. By reparameterization, we also find a non-trivial and non-permutation-symmetric six-dimensional linear section of the cone of nonnegative homogeneous ternary octics that are sum-of-squares. We also show that our lifted convex hull result yields a degree-bounded preordering certificate of nonnegative quadratics on $F$ and a degree-bounded certificate for a family of nonnegative quartics on the half-strip.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在非紧集F（第一象限且x₁x₂≤1）上非负的二次多项式，完整刻画了该非负二次多项式锥的所有极端射线，并利用此刻画研究涉及F的二次凸化的参数化有效不等式，得到其在二次空间中的提升凸包的半定表示。
AI.motivation: 非负二次多项式在约束集上的锥结构是多项式优化和凸化理论的核心问题。此前对非紧集上的非负二次多项式极端射线刻画尚未完成，这限制了参数化有效不等式和半定松弛的发展。
AI.method: 将极端射线刻画分为PSD和非PSD两个分支：非PSD分支化简为边界非负性判定，并分类相关极端射线的边界接触点。通过重新参数化，还构造了非负齐次三元八次式中和-平方锥的一个六维非平凡且非排列对称的线性截面。
AI.result: 完整刻画了F上非负二次多项式锥的所有极端射线，得到提升凸包的半定表示，并证明该结果导出了F上非负二次的多项式次数有界的前序证书，以及半条带上非负四次多项式族的次数有界证书。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过极端射线刻画为一般二次凸化建立了理论框架，分离PSD与非PSD分支的方法具有普适性，并揭示了该框架与和-平方表示、前序证书之间的深层联系。

title: An automatic-differentiation framework for time-lapse electrical resistivity tomography inversion of hydrologic dynamics
comment: Main text: 10 figures. Supplementary Information: 2 figures and 2 tables
summary: Time-lapse electrical resistivity tomography (TL-ERT) provides spatially distributed information on subsurface hydrologic changes. However, inversion of long monitoring sequences is computationally demanding. Modifying the data misfit, regularization, model parameterization, or petrophysical transformation may also require new gradient derivations and separate implementations. Here, we present AD-TLERT, a unified, GPU-accelerated framework for time-lapse ERT inversion based on automatic differentiation. The framework integrates model parameterization, differentiable petrophysical transformations, forward modeling, data misfit, regularization and auxiliary constraints into a single computational chain. Alternative inversion formulations can therefore reuse the same PDE derivative implementation without re-deriving the complete ERT sensitivity for each case. Comparisons with pyGIMLi showed close agreement in the forward responses, gradients, and recovered resistivity models. Under the tested configuration, AD-TLERT achieved an approximately 51-fold speedup.
