Synthetic experiments showed that inversion choices affect the amplitude, geometry, and temporal behavior of recovered anomalies. By propagating gradients through the embedded petrophysical relationship, AD-TLERT enabled direct water-content inversion and yielded more accurate estimates than post-inversion conversion for the tested model. A field application further demonstrated how ERT, temperature, and soil-moisture observations can be combined to image snowmelt-driven hillslope wetting. AD-TLERT provides an efficient and flexible framework for time-lapse ERT inversion and hydrologic interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AD-TLERT，一个基于自动微分的GPU加速时移电阻率层析成像（TL-ERT）反演框架。该框架将模型参数化、可微分的岩石物理变换、正演建模、数据拟合、正则化及辅助约束整合为单一计算链，使得不同反演方案可以复用相同的偏微分方程导数实现，无需为每种情况重新推导完整的ERT灵敏度。与pyGIMLi对比验证了正演响应、梯度和反演模型的一致性，在测试配置下实现了约51倍加速。实验表明反演选择会影响恢复异常体的振幅、几何形状和时间行为，且通过内嵌岩石物理关系传播梯度可实现对含水量更直接、更准确的反演。野外应用展示了如何结合ERT、温度和土壤水分观测来成像融雪驱动的山坡浸润过程。
AI.motivation: 传统TL-ERT反演在处理长监测序列时计算开销大，且修改数据拟合、正则化、模型参数化或岩石物理变换时，往往需要重新推导梯度并单独实现，缺乏统一灵活的反演框架。
AI.method: 基于自动微分技术构建统一框架，将模型参数化、可微分岩石物理变换、正演模拟、数据拟合、正则化和辅助约束整合为单一计算链，并利用GPU加速，使得不同反演公式能够复用相同的PDE导数实现。
AI.result: 与pyGIMLi对比显示正演响应、梯度和恢复的电阻率模型高度一致；在测试配置下实现约51倍加速；合成实验表明反演选择影响恢复异常体的振幅、几何和时间特征；通过内嵌岩石物理关系传播梯度实现直接含水量反演，精度优于反演后转换方法；野外案例成功结合ERT、温度和土壤水分观测成像融雪驱动的山坡浸润。
AI.conclusion: AD-TLERT为时移ERT反演和水文解释提供了高效且灵活的统一框架，能显著加速计算并支持更直接、更准确的水文参数反演。

title: Sparse Prototype Code Underlies Classification and Prediction Across Modalities
comment: 33 pages, 13 figures, 14 tables
summary: Neural representations have become a central tool for studying the internal mechanisms of modern AI models, yet their complex high-dimensional structure makes them difficult to interpret. We show that classification tasks give rise to a universal representational geometry, shared across state-of-the-art models in vision, audio, and language processing. The key structure is that within-class variability is not random in representation space. Instead, its classifier-relevant component has strong and structured correlations with the class's own centroid and with the centroids of its competing classes. Building on this observation, we derive an analytical mean-field theory governed mainly by the variability along true-class and rival-class centroid coordinates, together with a global renormalization of the class radius that compensates for the non-Gaussian statistics of real representations. The theory accurately predicts classification accuracy across architectures and modalities. The relevant geometric quantities improve systematically with model scale, mirroring the observed gains in accuracy. A striking feature of the theory is its sparsity: accurate prediction requires only a small set of centroid coordinates associated with the true class and its strongest rivals - connecting our framework to sparse-feature extraction approaches such as sparse autoencoders. Together, these results provide a parsimonious predictive theory of neural representations and suggest that classification in deep networks is governed by a sparse, centroid-aligned structure embedded within the full high-dimensional representation space.

AI.tldr: 本文发现分类任务在视觉、音频和语言处理的SOTA模型中产生一种普适的表征几何结构：类内变异的分类器相关成分与类质心和竞争类质心存在结构化相关。基于此推导出解析平均场理论，仅需真实类和最强竞争类的质心坐标及全局类半径重整化即可准确预测分类精度，且该几何量随模型规模系统提升，表现出高度稀疏性。
AI.motivation: 神经表征是高维且复杂的，难以解释。研究者希望找到跨架构、跨模态的普适表征几何规律，从而建立可解析预测分类性能的理论框架，而不仅仅依赖黑箱式的经验观察。
AI.method: 1) 实证发现类内变异的分类器相关成分与真实类质心及竞争类质心存在结构化相关；2) 基于该观察推导解析平均场理论，核心变量为沿真实类和竞争类质心方向的可变性以及全局类半径重整化；3) 用该理论预测分类精度，并与稀疏自编码器等稀疏特征提取方法建立联系。
AI.result: 理论能跨架构和跨模态准确预测分类精度；相关几何量随模型规模提升而系统性改善，与精度增益一致；理论具有高度稀疏性——仅需少量与真实类和最强竞争类相关的质心坐标即可准确预测。
AI.conclusion: 深度网络中的分类由一种稀疏的、质心对齐的结构主导，该结构嵌入在高维表征空间中。这为神经表征提供了一种简约的预测性理论，并桥接了表征几何与稀疏特征提取（如稀疏自编码器）之间的联系。

title: Beyond Correctness: Toward Automated Novelty Verification with Lean 4
comment: 20 pages. Preliminary version; a large-scale quantitative evaluation (N theorems x M models) is left to future work. Comments welcome. Code: https://github.com/ayrtonporto/avid-journal
summary:
Artificial intelligence systems applied to mathematics verify correctness but not novelty: an automatically generated theorem can compile in Lean without errors and yet be an already known result. This article presents AViD Journal, a pipeline that receives a LaTeX article, formalizes its statements in Lean 4, and issues a novelty verdict through a decision tree over three dimensions: prior existence in a formal corpus (Mathlib) and an informal one (TheoremSearch and Matlas, with temporal filter and LLM judge), non-triviality via automatic tactics, and structural distance between proofs measured as Jaccard distance over premise sets.
  Evaluation on papers withdrawn from arXiv due to declared duplication produced a result more informative than any performance measure: the identification of three obstacles that limit the approach regardless of this implementation. First, successful compilation of a Lean file does not guarantee semantic fidelity. Second, the recall ceiling is imposed by the coverage of theorem indices, not by the similarity metric. Third, arXiv removes the source code of articles upon withdrawal, compromising the reproducibility of any benchmark built upon them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AViD Journal流水线，用于自动判断数学论文中定理的新颖性。它接收LaTeX文章，在Lean 4中形式化其陈述，并通过决策树综合三个维度（形式化语料库Mathlib和两个非正式语料库的存在性检查、基于自动tactics的非平凡性检查、基于Jaccard距离的证明结构相似度）给出新颖性判定。在arXiv撤稿论文上的评估揭示了三个根本性障碍：编译成功不保证语义保真、查全率受限于定理索引覆盖率而非相似度度量、arXiv撤稿删除源码损害基准可复现性。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI数学系统只能验证正确性（如Lean编译通过）但无法验证新颖性，一个自动生成的定理可能已经是已知结果。因此需要开发自动化工具来判断数学论文中定理是否具有新颖性。
AI.method: 构建AViD Journal流水线：1) 接收LaTeX文章并形式化其陈述为Lean 4；2) 通过决策树综合三个维度给出新颖性判定：a) 在形式化语料库（Mathlib）和非正式语料库（TheoremSearch和Matlas，含时间过滤和LLM评判）中的先验存在性；b) 通过自动tactics评估非平凡性；c) 用Jaccard距离度量证明之间的结构距离（基于前提集合）。
AI.result: 在因声明重复而从arXiv撤稿的论文上评估时，发现的结果比任何性能指标都更有信息量：识别出了三个限制该方法（无论具体实现）的障碍：1) Lean文件编译成功不保证语义保真；2) 查全率上限由定理索引覆盖率决定，而非相似度度量；3) arXiv在撤稿时删除文章源码，损害基于这些论文构建的任何基准的可复现性。
AI.conclusion: AViD Journal揭示了自动新颖性判定面临的根本性挑战：语义保真、索引覆盖率和基准可复现性三者共同构成该领域的天花板，这些问题超越具体实现本身。

title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models
comment: paper under revision
summary: We systematically compare word order preferences in decoder-only language models across 192 artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages. On artificial languages, models exhibit a left-branching preference that aligns with neither natural language universals nor human word order learning biases. On natural languages, monolingual models show no clear base word order bias at small scales, but as data grows, a preference for right-branching subject-verb-object (SVO) languages emerges while SOV falls behind despite being the most frequent order cross-linguistically. This SVO advantage extends to multilingual models and correlates with language resource level and data quality rather than word order. Thus, the same architecture exhibits opposite preferences on artificial and natural languages, establishing that word order biases observed in practice are data-driven. Since highly-resourced languages are overwhelmingly SVO, these biases risk gradually reducing word order diversity, particularly in languages that productively use multiple word orders, with the widespread adoption of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统比较了仅解码器语言模型在192种人工语言和类型多样的自然语言中的词序偏好。模型在人工语言上表现出左分支偏好，与自然语言普遍规律和人类学习偏差都不一致；在自然语言上，单语模型在小规模数据下无明确词序偏好，但随着数据增加，右分支的SVO语言逐渐占优，而跨语言最常见的SOV词序却落后。这种SVO优势在多语言模型中同样存在，且与语言资源水平和数据质量相关而非词序本身。模型在人工和自然语言上表现出相反的偏好，证明实际观察到的词序偏置是数据驱动的，并可能随着LLM的广泛采用逐渐减少词序多样性。
AI.motivation: 理解语言模型是否具有固有的词序偏好，以及这些偏好是源于内在架构还是训练数据驱动，对评估LLM对语言多样性的潜在影响至关重要。
AI.method: 在192种人工语言和类型多样的自然语言上，系统比较仅解码器语言模型的词序偏好，通过改变数据规模训练单语和多语模型，分析不同词序（如SVO、SOV）的表现差异，并关联语言资源水平和数据质量。
AI.result: 人工语言上模型呈现左分支偏好（与自然语言普遍规律不符）；自然语言上小规模无明确偏好，数据增加后SVO占优而SOV落后；SVO优势在多语言模型中也存在，且与资源水平和数据质量相关而非词序本身。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在人工和自然语言上表现出相反的词序偏好，说明实际观察到的偏好是数据驱动的而非架构固有的。由于高资源语言多为SVO，LLM的广泛采用可能逐渐减少词序多样性，特别是对灵活使用多种词序的语言构成风险。

title: Lyapunov Constructions for System Interconnections Arising from Adaptation in Some Optimization Methods
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Revised and resubmitted to IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control
summary: Interconnected systems have been widely studied, with a focus on interconnected systems whose subsystems are solely input-to-state stable (ISS) or passive systems. The focus of this work is on the interconnected systems that appear in adaptive gradient methods. In adaptive gradient methods, one subsystem seeks to move parameters of a cost function towards a minimizer while the other subsystem works to estimate some derivative information about the cost function to help determine the direction of the parameter update. This work studies instances of such interconnected systems and gives various Lyapunov function constructions for them using different techniques. In doing so, adaptive gradient optimizers are proven to be globally asymptotically stable (GAS), and the methods for constructing the Lyapunov functions that certify this are presented.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自适应梯度方法中出现的互联系统，通过构造多种Lyapunov函数来证明自适应梯度优化器的全局渐近稳定性（GAS）。
AI.motivation: 现有互联系统研究主要聚焦于子系统为ISS或无源系统的情形，而自适应梯度方法中出现的一类特殊互联系统（一个子系统移动参数，另一个子系统估计导数信息）尚未被系统研究，缺乏对其稳定性的理论保障。
AI.method: 将自适应梯度优化器建模为互联系统，利用不同技术（如ISS、无源性等）为这类互联系统构造多种Lyapunov函数，并据此证明其全局渐近稳定性。
AI.result: 成功证明了自适应梯度优化器是全局渐近稳定的（GAS），并给出了用于认证该稳定性的Lyapunov函数构造方法。
AI.conclusion: 为自适应梯度优化器的稳定性提供了严格的理论基础，同时展示了互联系统理论在优化算法分析中的新应用。

title: In-Context Learning to Assess Built Environment Impacts on Perceived Neighborhood Walkability Among Mobility-impaired Older Adults
comment: 8 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure
summary: As global populations age, enhancing neighborhood walkability through inclusive urban design is important for mitigating built environment (BE) barriers that discourage physical activity and social participation among older adults. This study investigates the utility of in-context learning (ICL), using the transformer-based foundation model TabPFN, to determine how BE features influence perceived walkability, as measured by the Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale (NEWS-A) survey. Using a small-scale dataset (N = 257) comprising a unique demographic of older adults with knee osteoarthritis or a history of falls, TabPFN achieved a macro F1 score of 54.89% for walkability perceptions categorized as Low, Neutral, and High using equal-width binning. This result outperformed optimized, grid-searched baseline models, including Random Forest (45.85%) and XGBoost (50.56%). To interpret these results, we employed Shapley Interaction Quantification (SHAP-IQ) to identify the hierarchical importance of feature interactions. Preliminary results revealed that the model's predictive logic was primarily driven by higher-order interactions. For example, the interaction between average street circuity and the ratio of drivable roads emerged as the primary discriminator of perceived walkability. Neighborhood greenery was found to have substantial predictive importance only when combined with an individual's fear of falling or perception of age-friendliness. Overall, ICL using TabPFN demonstrates superior performance on small-scale datasets, enhancing the fidelity of the resulting interpretive insights. Furthermore, SHAP-IQ provides a synergistic perspective on how higher-order feature interactions drive the model's predictions.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用基于Transformer的基础模型TabPFN结合上下文学习（ICL），在小型老年人群数据集（N=257）上预测社区步行适宜性（NEWS-A），宏F1达54.89%，优于随机森林和XGBoost基线模型，并通过SHAP-IQ揭示高阶特征交互对预测的驱动作用。
AI.motivation: 全球人口老龄化背景下，需要改善社区步行适宜性以促进老年人身体活动和社会参与。传统方法在小规模数据集上难以有效建模建筑环境（BE）特征与老年人感知步行性之间的复杂关系，且缺乏对特征交互的深入解释。
AI.method: 采用基于Transformer的基础模型TabPFN，利用上下文学习（ICL）在小规模数据集上建模；以NEWS-A调查测量的感知步行性为标签，将其分为低、中、高三类（等宽分箱）；与网格搜索优化的随机森林和XGBoost基线对比；使用Shapley Interaction Quantification（SHAP-IQ）分析特征交互的层级重要性。
AI.result: TabPFN在宏F1分数上达到54.89%，优于随机森林（45.85%）和XGBoost（50.56%）。SHAP-IQ显示模型预测主要由高阶特征交互驱动，其中平均街道迂回度与可驾驶道路比率的交互是感知步行性的主要判别因素；社区绿化仅在结合跌倒恐惧或年龄友好感知时才具有显著预测重要性。
AI.conclusion: TabPFN结合ICL在小规模数据集上表现优于传统机器学习模型，提高了可解释性洞见的保真度；SHAP-IQ为理解高阶特征交互如何驱动模型预测提供了协同视角，有助于包容性城市设计干预措施的制定。

title: A Unified Mamba--MoE Surrogate for Closed-Loop Simulation and Measurement-Window Forecasting of Inverter Transients
summary: This paper proposes a Mamba surrogate model with mixture-of-experts (MoE) routing to represent the transient dynamics of inverter-based resources. A Mamba surrogate model is a predictive machine learning model built on the Mamba architecture. MoE routing uses a router network to assign data-dependent weights to specialized subnetworks (experts). The resulting Mamba--MoE surrogate can perform two tasks: (i) closed-loop simulation and (ii) measurement-window forecasting of inverter transients. A single Mamba backbone with task conditioning and expert routing serves both tasks, replacing two separate specialists. Task-matched objectives fit each prediction form, and an adaptive conformal layer provides prediction intervals for both tasks. For the considered grid-following inverter, the unified surrogate model remains in the same low-error regime as a Mamba specialist pair while using 13% fewer parameters. The prediction intervals achieve 94--96% empirical mean marginal coverage across the two tasks. For transient dynamics---that is, beyond the vicinity of an equilibrium point---our surrogate model with MoE routing yields lower errors across all outputs in both tasks compared to a shared Mamba backbone without expert routing. A controller hardware-in-the-loop simulation validates our results and shows that adapting only the shared output head with limited measured data reduces held-out forecasting error.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Mamba架构和混合专家（MoE）路由的代理模型，用于表示逆变器资源的瞬态动态。该统一模型同时支持闭环仿真和测量窗口预测两项任务，通过任务条件和专家路由在单一骨干网络上实现，相比双专家模型节省13%参数，预测区间覆盖率达94-96%，并在控制器硬件在环仿真中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 逆变器资源的瞬态动态建模对电力系统稳定性至关重要，但传统方法在处理瞬态（远离平衡点）动态时精度不足。现有的专用模型需要分别针对仿真和预测任务单独设计，缺乏统一高效的建模方案。
AI.method: 采用Mamba架构作为基础代理模型，引入MoE路由机制通过路由器网络为不同专家子网络分配数据依赖的权重。单一Mamba骨干网络通过任务条件化（task conditioning）和专家路由同时服务闭环仿真与测量窗口预测两项任务，配合任务匹配的目标函数和自适应保形层（conformal layer）生成预测区间。
AI.result: 统一代理模型与Mamba专家对保持相同低误差水平，参数减少13%；预测区间在两项任务上实现94-96%的经验边际覆盖率。在瞬态动态场景下，带MoE路由的代理模型在所有输出和任务上的误差均低于无专家路由的共享Mamba骨干。控制器硬件在环仿真表明，仅用有限测量数据适配共享输出头即可降低持有外预测误差。
AI.conclusion: Mamba-MoE统一代理模型能够高效表示逆变器瞬态动态，在降低参数开销的同时保持预测精度和良好的区间覆盖率，且无需路由机制的骨干模型在瞬态场景下性能显著提升，验证了MoE路由对瞬态建模的有效性。

title: FirstDiff: One-Step Diffusion-Based Anomaly Detection for Multivariate Time Series via Initial Noise Prediction
summary:
Diffusion models have recently shown strong potential for multivariate time-series anomaly detection by learning the distribution of normal data through iterative denoising. Existing diffusion-based approaches, however, typically perform anomaly detection after completing the reverse diffusion process, relying primarily on the final reconstructed signal and overlooking informative representations produced during denoising. This design incurs substantial computational cost and limits the use of intermediate diffusion information for anomaly detection.
  In this paper, we propose FirstDiff, a diffusion-based anomaly detection framework based on the observation that the predicted diffusion noise at the initial reverse-diffusion evaluation already contains sufficient information for accurate anomaly detection. FirstDiff models the statistical distribution of predicted diffusion noise under normal behavior using validation data, enabling anomaly inference from a single denoising-network evaluation rather than completing the reverse diffusion trajectory.
  To model complex temporal and inter-sensor dependencies, FirstDiff employs a Diffusion Transformer as the denoising backbone. Extensive experiments on five public benchmark datasets demonstrate that FirstDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing diffusion inference from the full reverse trajectory to a single denoising-network evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FirstDiff，一种基于扩散模型的多变量时间序列异常检测框架。其核心洞察是：逆向扩散过程中第一次去噪网络评估所预测的扩散噪声已包含足够信息用于准确异常检测，因此无需完成完整的逆向扩散轨迹。FirstDiff使用Diffusion Transformer作为去噪骨干网络，并利用验证数据建模正常行为下预测扩散噪声的统计分布，从而实现单次去噪网络评估即可完成异常推断。在五个公开基准数据集上，FirstDiff达到最先进性能，同时将扩散推理从完整逆向轨迹缩减为单次去噪网络评估。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的时间序列异常检测方法通常在完成完整逆向扩散过程后才进行异常检测，仅依赖最终重建信号，忽略了去噪过程中产生的中间表示。这种设计不仅计算开销巨大，还限制了对中间扩散信息的利用。
AI.method: FirstDiff的核心方法包括：(1) 基于"初始逆向扩散评估的预测噪声已足够用于异常检测"的观察，仅需单次去噪网络评估；(2) 利用验证数据对正常行为下预测扩散噪声的统计分布进行建模，实现异常推断；(3) 采用Diffusion Transformer作为去噪骨干网络，以建模复杂的时序和跨传感器依赖关系。
AI.result: 在五个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FirstDiff取得了最先进的性能，同时将扩散推理从完整的逆向轨迹大幅缩减为单次去噪网络评估，显著降低了计算成本。
AI.conclusion: FirstDiff证明了扩散模型用于时间序列异常检测时，无需完整逆向扩散过程即可实现高效且准确的检测，为扩散模型在该领域的实际部署提供了更实用的方案。

title: Auditing an AI-Generated Mathematical Proof: A Correction to a Greedy Conditioning Lemma in Quantum Parallel Repetition
comment: 8 pages, 5 references, Auditing an OpenAI's Generated Mathematical Proof
summary:
Chapter 6 of OpenAI's *Ten Advances in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science* claims an exponential parallel-repetition theorem for all finite two-player, one-round entangled games. Early in the proof, the chapter uses a quantitative greedy conditioning lemma. The lemma is meant to select a small set of coordinates (D) such that, after conditioning on winning every coordinate in (D), a randomly chosen remaining coordinate is won with average probability at least (1-δ). The statement is correct, but the proof as printed contains a polarity error. Its continuation test is written in terms of average success, while the next step requires a coordinate with a large conditional failure probability. That implication is false, and even simple examples can leave the printed procedure without a valid next move.
  This note gives an explicit counterexample, identifies the intended continuation condition, and supplies a complete corrected proof. The repair is local: it leaves the statement of the lemma and the parameters used later in the chapter unchanged. It should not, however, be read as an independent verification of the main parallel-repetition theorem. More broadly, the example shows how a mathematically plausible AI-generated argument can hide a small but decisive reversal between complementary events.

AI.tldr: 本文指出OpenAI《数学与理论计算机科学十大进展》第六章中一个定量贪婪条件化引理的证明存在极性错误（将平均成功率误写为条件失败率），并给出显式反例、识别出预期的续延条件，提供完整修正证明。修复是局部的，不影响引理陈述及后续参数，但作者强调这不应被视为对主定理（指数级并行重复定理）的独立验证。
AI.motivation: 该章节声称对所有有限双人单轮纠缠博弈证明了指数级并行重复定理，其证明早期依赖一个定量贪婪条件化引理。但该引理的证明存在极性错误：续延测试以平均成功率表述，而下一步需要的是具有大条件失败概率的坐标——这一蕴含关系是错误的。即使简单例子也能使打印版证明流程无法继续，因此需要指出错误并提供修正。
AI.method: 作者给出一个显式反例展示原证明中的极性错误，识别出预期的续延条件（应基于条件失败概率而非平均成功率），然后补充一个完整的修正证明。修复是局部的，不改变引理陈述本身，也不改变章节后续使用的参数。
AI.result: 提供了显式反例证明原证明有误，识别了正确的续延条件，并给出了完整且正确的修正证明。修复保持引理陈述及其后续参数不变，但作者谨慎声明该修复不应被视为对主并行重复定理的独立验证。
AI.conclusion: 该案例展示了AI生成的数学论证可能在看似合理的外表下隐藏着互补事件之间微小但关键的反转（极性错误），即使陈述本身正确，证明细节中的逻辑缺陷也可能使整个论证失效。这提醒我们在验证AI辅助生成的形式化数学证明时需要特别警惕这种类型的错误。

title: TRACE-BN: Transferring Bangla-English Tutoring Behavior to a Sub-1B Offline Language Model
summary: Bangla-English tutoring requires more than producing a correct translation: learners also need explanations of grammar differences, awareness of their likely errors, and targeted practice. We present TRACE-BN, a curriculum-guided dataset of structured tutoring traces for Bangla-speaking learners of English at the CEFR A1-A2 level. Each trace combines word-level glosses, literal and natural translations, Bangla grammar explanations, a plausible learner error, and a targeted practice question with its answer. The traces are generated by Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite as the teacher model from NCTB Classes 9-10 English curriculum units, then filtered for structural validity, script integrity, and semantic duplication. We transfer the resulting structured tutoring behavior to Qwen3-0.6B using LoRA with 4-bit quantization for resource-constrained offline deployment. On held-out inputs, schema validity increases from 85.4% to 95.8%, while, against teacher-model references, chrF++ improves from 15.28 to 34.77 and BLEU from 4.52 to 21.03. Field-level evaluation by two independent judges shows improvements across translation, grammar explanation, learner-error diagnosis, and practice alignment, while a human audit supports the quality of the supervision data. The results show that curriculum-guided structured supervision can transfer multi-component tutoring behavior to a sub-1B model under these resource constraints. The dataset, model checkpoints, and code are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/RaiyanKhaan/Trace-BN

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE-BN，一个面向孟加拉语英语学习者（CEFR A1-A2级）的课程引导式结构化辅导数据集。每个辅导轨迹包含词级注释、直译与自然翻译、孟加拉语语法解释、学习者典型错误及针对性练习。数据由Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite从NCTB课程单元生成并过滤，随后通过LoRA 4-bit量化将辅导行为迁移到Qwen3-0.6B小模型上，在资源受限的离线场景中取得了显著的生成质量提升。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语-英语辅导不仅仅需要正确的翻译，学习者还需要语法差异的解释、对自身易犯错误的认知以及针对性练习。现有的机器翻译方法无法满足这种多组分的辅导需求。
AI.method: 1) 使用Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite作为教师模型，从NCTB 9-10年级英语课程单元生成结构化辅导轨迹；2) 对生成数据进行结构有效性、脚本完整性和语义去重过滤；3) 使用LoRA与4-bit量化将教师模型的辅导行为迁移到Qwen3-0.6B小模型上。
AI.result: 在预留测试集上，模式有效性从85.4%提升至95.8%；相对教师模型参考，chrF++从15.28提升至34.77，BLEU从4.52提升至21.03。两名独立评审员的字段级评估显示翻译、语法解释、学习者错误诊断和练习对齐方面均有改进。
AI.conclusion: 课程引导的结构化监督能够将多组分辅导行为成功迁移到小于10亿参数的小模型上，即使在这些资源约束条件下也能实现高质量的辅导效果。数据集、模型检查点和代码已公开。

title: From Errors to Proofs: Minimal-Core-Guided Repair for Neuro-Symbolic Constraint Solving
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Workshop on Logic and Symbolic Reasoning (LogiSymb), poster
summary: Making language models solve constraint problems reliably often means having them translate the problem into a formal specification and delegating the search to a sound solver. But the translation is itself a language-model task, and an unfaithful translation makes the solver faithfully solve the wrong problem. Existing pipelines repair only translations that crash, returning the solver's error message and falling silent when the program runs but is wrong. We replace the error message with a proof: when the generated program is unsatisfiable, we extract a minimal unsatisfiable core over the model's own constraints and hand it back the exact set that cannot hold together, a leakage-free signal that localizes the fault. On a new benchmark of 77 problems with an exact oracle, translation to Answer Set Programming is faithful on six of seven domains and fails only on aggregate coverage scheduling, which concentrates the translation tax in one diagnosable pattern. A minimal core, rather than a bare error, is what stops a weaker model from fabricating solutions to infeasible problems, cutting fabrication from 79% to 7%. A strong chain-of-thought baseline meanwhile matches the symbolic route on accuracy, so the route's value is not accuracy but certificates and its refusal to fabricate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用最小不可满足核（minimal unsatisfiable core）替代传统错误信息来修复语言模型生成的约束问题翻译，当生成程序不可满足时，提取出无法同时成立的约束子集作为定位故障的可证明信号。在77个问题的基准上，翻译到Answer Set Programming在六个领域中忠实，仅聚合覆盖调度失败。最小核将较弱模型的虚构率从79%降至7%。强思维链基线在准确率上与符号路线持平，但符号路线的价值在于证书和拒绝虚构。
AI.motivation: 让语言模型可靠地解决约束问题通常需要将其翻译为形式化规范并委托给求解器搜索，但翻译本身是LM任务，不忠实的翻译会使求解器求解错误的问题。现有管线只修复崩溃的翻译，返回求解器错误信息，但当程序运行却错误时保持沉默，无法定位故障。
AI.method: 当生成的程序不可满足时，提取最小不可满足核（覆盖模型自身约束的最小不可满足集合），将其作为泄漏自由的精确定位信号交还给模型，替代传统的错误信息。在77个问题的基准上使用精确oracle进行翻译到ASP的评估，并对比弱模型与强思维链基线的表现。
AI.result: 翻译到Answer Set Programming在六七个领域中忠实，仅在聚合覆盖调度上失败。最小核而非裸错误能阻止弱模型虚构不可行问题的解，将虚构率从79%降至7%。强思维链基线在准确率上与符号路线持平。
AI.conclusion: 符号管线的价值不在于超越LLM的准确率，而在于提供可验证的证书（证明）并拒绝虚构。最小不可满足核是诊断约束翻译故障的有效信号，比裸错误信息更能引导模型停止捏造。

title: Quantifying Depth Sufficiency in Residual Neural Networks: A First-Order Criterion
summary: How can we determine whether a trained neural network is already deep enough? We study this under a fixed function-preserving residual-growth protocol specifying insertion locations, residual families, zero-output initializations, and zero-state first-order updates. We define first-order residual depth saturation as the absence of a strict local decrease from every admissible insertion. We prove residual non-degeneracy is necessary and sufficient: additional depth has first-order value exactly when conditional activation gradients have a nonzero projection onto at least one admissible residual tangent space. This boundary is shared by descent-compatible zero-state updates and invariant under regular local reparameterizations preserving that tangent space. Under residual-signal realizability, raw activation-gradient vanishing exactly certifies saturation. Across ResNets, GPT-2-style models, and continued-pretrained Pythia checkpoints, the maximum activation-gradient norm decreases toward a low-signal regime with depth. Function-preserving growth also achieves converged performance competitive with training from scratch. These results support activation-gradient magnitude as a conservative diagnostic of the remaining empirical first-order value of residual depth.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何判断已训练的神经网络是否已足够深，提出"一阶残差深度饱和"概念，并证明残差非退化性是充分必要条件：当且仅当条件激活梯度在某个可容许残差切空间上有非零投影时，增加深度才有一阶价值。
AI.motivation: 在实际训练中，如何判断一个神经网络是否已经"足够深"是一个重要但未充分研究的问题。作者希望在固定函数保持的残差增长协议下，为"增加深度是否还有价值"提供严格的理论刻画。
AI.method: 在函数保持的残差增长协议下（规定插入位置、残差族、零输出初始化和零状态一阶更新），定义一阶残差深度饱和。通过理论分析证明残差非退化性与一阶价值之间的充要关系，并在ResNets、GPT-2风格模型和继续预训练的Pythia检查点上进行实证验证。
AI.result: 证明激活梯度的非零投影是增加深度有一阶价值的充要条件；该边界与下降兼容的零状态更新共享，且在保持切空间的局部重参数化下不变。实证表明最大激活梯度范数随深度增加而趋近低信号区，函数保持增长可达到与从头训练竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: 激活梯度幅值可作为残差深度剩余一阶经验价值的保守诊断指标，为判断网络是否已"足够深"提供了理论和实证依据。

title: Learning Stock Trading Policies via Barycenter-Based Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Designing effective trading strategies using reinforcement learning remains challenging due to delayed and noisy rewards, poor exploration, and the difficulty of enforcing explicit risk constraints. In this work, we propose BRaG, a barycenter-based adversarial inverse reinforcement learning framework for stock trading that learns trading behavior from multiple heterogeneous expert strategies. BRaG aggregates expert demonstrations using a performance-weighted Wasserstein barycenter, yielding a stable pseudo-expert representation that captures shared structure across diverse trading styles. This representation is used to pretrain a trading policy via adversarial imitation learning, which alleviates unstable exploration during reinforcement learning. The pretrained policy is subsequently refined using reinforcement learning with true market rewards. To ensure risk-aware decision-making, BRaG incorporates control barrier functions that constrain action execution and regularize policy learning to satisfy drawdown limits. We evaluate the proposed approach on four major global equity markets, including the US, UK, Indian, and Taiwanese indices. Across all the markets, the proposed approach achieves stronger performance than both classical trading rules and recent deep reinforcement learning methods, while exhibiting more stable risk characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BRaG框架，一种基于重心（barycenter）的对抗逆强化学习方法，用于股票交易策略设计。BRaG通过性能加权Wasserstein重心聚合多个异构专家策略，构建稳定的伪专家表征，以此预训练交易策略（缓解强化学习中不稳定探索问题），再用真实市场奖励进行微调，并引入控制障碍函数（CBF）约束行动以符合回撤限制。在美、英、印、台四个全球股票市场验证，性能优于传统交易规则和近期深度强化学习方法，且风险特征更稳定。
AI.motivation: 强化学习设计交易策略面临三大挑战：奖励信号延迟且含噪、探索效率差、难以显式施加风险约束。现有方法难以同时解决这些问题，因此需要一种能稳定学习、高效探索且能满足风险约束的交易策略设计框架。
AI.method: 1) 使用性能加权的Wasserstein重心聚合多个异构专家演示，生成稳定的伪专家表征，捕获不同交易风格的共享结构；2) 通过对抗模仿学习（AIRL）用伪专家表征预训练交易策略，缓解强化学习的探索不稳定问题；3) 使用真实市场奖励对预训练策略进行强化学习微调；4) 引入控制障碍函数（CBF）约束动作执行并正则化策略学习，满足回撤限制。
AI.result: 在美、英、印度、台湾四个全球主要股票市场上，BRaG在收益表现上优于经典交易规则和现有深度强化学习方法，同时展现出更稳定的风险特征（如更低的回撤等）。
AI.conclusion: BRaG通过将对抗逆强化学习与重心聚合及控制障碍函数相结合，有效解决了RL交易策略设计中奖励延迟、探索不稳定和风险约束难执行等核心问题，在多个国际市场验证了其优越性和鲁棒性。

title: When Agentic Executions Fail: Detecting and Localizing Runtime Faults from Telemetry
summary: Reliability in LLM-based agentic systems is a property of the whole execution (its tool calls, model calls, guardrails, and inter-agent messages), not of the final answer alone, yet evaluating only task outcomes reveals little about how or why a run fails. We present AGENTCHAOSBENCH, a benchmark for detecting and localizing runtime faults in agentic systems from their execution telemetry. We run five heterogeneous applications that coordinate agents over the Agent-to-Agent protocol and call tools through the Model Context Protocol, and inject ten types of operational fault (unavailable or slow tools, corrupted or oversized responses, and delayed, looped, or misrouted delegations and bypassed guardrails) at their tool, model, guardrail, and inter-agent boundaries, alongside a no-fault control. The resulting dataset contains 275 sanitized traces: 250 faulty executions spanning ten fault types and 25 no-fault controls. Each faulty trace is aligned with the no-fault execution of the same input; fault-type labels and, where applicable, location labels are held out from diagnosis. On structured single-trace inputs, a first set of zero-shot LLM baselines shows the task is far from solved: local detectors up to 14B parameters reach only 13.6-19.2% top-1 fault-type accuracy and the frontier DeepSeek-v4-pro only 24.8%, while jointly identifying the fault type and its location tops out at 22%; reference-dependent faults (above all a bypassed guardrail) stay near-unsolved from a single trace. An aligned reference improves selected relative faults but does not resolve guardrail bypass. The held-out labels and compact prediction format support reproducible comparison of LLM-based and non-LLM diagnosis methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGENTCHAOSBENCH基准，用于检测和定位基于LLM的智能体系统中的运行时故障。基准包含5个异构应用、10种故障类型、275条净化轨迹（250条故障+25条无故障对照），通过结构化单轨迹评估发现LLM诊断准确率很低（最佳仅24.8%），表明该任务远未解决。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体系统的可靠性是整个执行过程（工具调用、模型调用、护栏、智能体间消息）的属性，而非仅最终答案。现有评估只关注任务结果，无法揭示运行失败的方式和原因，因此需要一种检测和定位运行时故障的基准。
AI.method: 运行5个基于Agent-to-Agent协议协调智能体、通过Model Context Protocol调用工具的异构应用，在工具、模型、护栏和智能体间边界注入10种运维故障（工具不可用/缓慢、响应损坏/过大、委托延迟/循环/错路、护栏被绕过），并设置无故障对照。将故障轨迹与同一输入的无故障执行对齐，隐藏故障类型标签和位置标签供诊断。
AI.result: 零样本LLM基线表现显示任务远未解决：本地检测器（最大14B参数）仅达13.6-19.2%的top-1故障类型准确率，前沿模型DeepSeek-v4-pro仅24.8%；联合识别故障类型与位置的准确率最高22%；依赖参考的故障（尤其护栏绕过）从单条轨迹几乎无法解决；对齐参考能改善部分相对故障但无法解决护栏绕过。
AI.conclusion: AGENTCHAOSBENCH提供了可复现的评估框架，其隐藏标签和紧凑预测格式支持LLM与非LLM诊断方法的可比较评估。当前LLM在智能体运行时故障诊断上表现不足，该任务仍有很大改进空间。

title: Time as Structure: Temporal Dependency Graphs for Verifiable Deadline Computation over Legal Documents
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Preprint
summary: Miss a filing deadline by one day and the claim is barred, however strong the case. Computing that deadline is rarely simple: the period runs from a triggering event, is counted by a statutory convention, and may be suspended by a mandatory conciliation window. We ask whether a language model should answer such questions directly, or read the document and leave the arithmetic to code. We extract dated facts and their dependencies into a temporal dependency graph and compute deadlines from it with a calendar-correct engine. On UK Employment Appeal Tribunal judgments the engine reproduces six of seven timeliness rulings, and matches the judges' own dates to the day. The strongest of four language models, asked the same cases, gets the arithmetic right and the answer wrong: in six of twenty-one responses its stated verdict contradicts its own thinking, and every contradiction runs the same way, calling a late claim timely. To test the systems at scale we move the dismissal date across the statutory boundary, generating 427 cases whose answers are computed rather than annotated. On the cases both systems answer, the pipeline is right 90.2% of the time against 61.2% for direct answering. The limit is extraction: on contracts the errors are almost never in the arithmetic, but in choosing which event the period starts from.

AI.tldr: 本文研究法律期限计算任务，提出将日期事实提取为时间依赖图并用日历正确引擎计算截止日期的方法，而非让语言模型直接回答。在UK劳动上诉法庭判决上，该流水线能复现6/7的时效裁决，而最强的语言模型在算术正确的情况下却常给出矛盾答案（偏向认定逾期主张为及时）。扩展测试中流水线准确率90.2%对直接回答61.2%，瓶颈在于事件起点选择而非算术。
AI.motivation: 法律期限计算至关重要（错过一天即丧失权利），但计算复杂：涉及触发事件、法定计数规则、强制调解窗口暂停等。作者希望探究语言模型应直接回答此类问题，还是应阅读文档后将算术交给代码处理。
AI.method: 将文档中的日期事实及其依赖关系提取为时间依赖图（temporal dependency graph），再通过日历正确的计算引擎（calendar-correct engine）从图中计算截止日期。同时与直接回答的语言模型进行对比实验。
AI.result: 在UK Employment Appeal Tribunal判决上，流水线复现6/7时效裁决，日期精确到天。最强语言模型在6/21次回答中其明确结论与自身推理矛盾，且所有矛盾均朝同一方向：将逾期主张认定为及时。将解雇日期跨法定边界移动生成427个用例后，流水线准确率90.2%，直接回答仅61.2%。错误几乎不出现在算术上，而出在选取期限起算的触发事件。
AI.conclusion: 将日期推理交给计算引擎的混合方法显著优于纯语言模型直接回答。语言模型存在系统性的"偏及时性"（pro-timeliness）偏差。当前系统的主要瓶颈是信息提取——即正确识别期限从哪个事件起算，而非日期计算本身。

title: Andy: A Mathematical Agent for Rigorous Proof and Autonomous Research
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures. Research logs, reports, and simulation code are available at https://github.com/mowaiwaim/Andy
summary: Andy is an autonomous mathematical research agent that solves and verifies submitted problems, formulates new research problems, and constructs rigorous proofs. It separates proof generation from correctness evaluation and supports knowledge acquisition, targeted revision, and multistage verification. This paper illustrates the workflow using a published result on self-triggered impulsive consensus as a starting point. Andy formulates a global exponential leader-follower synchronization problem for delayed heterogeneous networks with switching communication topologies. The proposed hybrid control combines self-triggered impulses with execution delay and recovery-phase continuous feedback. After each delayed impulse, this feedback cancels the delayed error channel during a recovery window. Sufficient conditions for global exponential synchronization are established, and Zeno behavior is excluded for both the sampling and impulse sequences. A numerical example confirms the result. This case demonstrates Andy's ability to learn from existing results, formulate meaningful research problems, and develop and verify rigorous proofs.

AI.tldr: Andy是一个自主数学研究智能体，能够求解和验证数学问题、提出新研究问题并构建严谨证明。本文以自触发脉冲一致性成果为起点，Andy提出了延迟异构网络在切换通信拓扑下的全局指数领导者-跟随者同步问题，设计了结合自触发脉冲（含执行延迟）和恢复阶段连续反馈的混合控制策略，建立了充分条件并排除了Zeno行为。
AI.motivation: 探索人工智能体自主进行数学研究的能力，将证明生成与正确性评估分离，支持知识获取、定向修正和多阶段验证，以提升数学研究的自动化水平。
AI.method: Andy智能体将证明生成与正确性验证分离，采用混合控制方法：自触发脉冲（带有执行延迟）与恢复阶段的连续反馈相结合，在每次延迟脉冲后通过反馈抵消延迟误差通道，从而解决延迟异构网络在切换拓扑下的同步问题。
AI.result: 建立了全局指数同步的充分条件，同时排除了采样序列和脉冲序列的Zeno行为，并通过数值算例验证了理论结果的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该案例展示了Andy能够从现有研究中学习、提出有意义的研究问题，并开发和验证严谨的数学证明，证明自主智能体在数学研究中的潜力。

title: When Does the Best Sampling Temperature Rise with the Budget? Sufficient Conditions for Pass@k
comment: Theory paper, 13 pages, 1 analytical figure. Deterministic verification code is included as ancillary material. No new language-model experiment
summary: The temperature that maximizes pass@$k$ is often low for a small sampling budget and higher for a large budget. This pattern has been reported from Codex through recent multi-sample inference studies. It is not an algebraic property of pass@$k$: as Slocum et al. (ICLR 2025) observe, for one fixed task the maximizing temperature is independent of $k$. Building on that fixed-task observation and the hard/easy-task explanation, we give a formal population-level sufficient condition for the aggregate pattern. For task $X$, let $p_t(X)$ be one-sample success probability at temperature $t$, and define the conditional log-success response $m_t(u)=\mathbb{E}[\dot p_t(X)\mid p_t(X)=u]/u$. If $m_t(u)$ is nonincreasing in current success probability, then the normalized temperature derivative of aggregate pass@$k$ is nondecreasing in $k$. Consequently, derivative signs are nested across budgets; if each temperature-performance curve is strictly single-peaked, its unique maximizer is nondecreasing in $k$. The proof identifies the mechanism as a monotone-likelihood-ratio power tilt toward lower-success tasks. We derive a closed-form two-stratum phase diagram, including upward and downward regimes, and show that the marginal temperature derivative admits an exact $\mathrm{Beta}(2,k)$ kernel representation whose kernel concentrates at one-sample success of order $1/k$. Interpreting that scale as task-level localization additionally requires a regular, nonvanishing density-response factor near zero. A signed-moment representation yields diagnostic shape restrictions, while a short appendix records exact discrete refinements of the existing multi-configuration allocation formulation. No language model is trained, and no model query is used as an experimental measurement: the contribution is a conditional theory of an established empirical phenomenon, with assumptions that can be tested in future work.

AI.tldr: 本文给出一个形式化的总体层面充分条件，解释"pass@k的最优温度随采样预算k增大而升高"这一经验现象，并提出该模式的机制是单调似然比功率倾斜（向低成功率任务倾斜）。
AI.motivation: 此前研究从Codex到多采样推理均观察到pass@k最大化温度随预算k增加而升高，但Slocum等人（ICLR 2025）指出单一固定任务上该温度与k无关。作者希望在此基础上建立总体（population-level）层面的理论解释，澄清这一聚集现象的条件与机制。
AI.method: 以条件对数成功响应函数m_t(u)为核心，证明若m_t(u)对当前成功率u非增，则聚合pass@k的归一化温度导数对k非减。由此推出导数符号嵌套性，若温度-性能曲线单峰则最优温度随k非减。进一步导出两层级相图、Beta(2,k)核表示、有符号矩表示，并给出离散多配置分配的精确修正。
AI.result: 建立了可检验的充分条件，揭示了机制为单调似然比向低成功率任务的功率倾斜；给出了封闭形式的两层级相图（包含上升与下降区间），并得到边际温度导数的精确Beta(2,k)核表示，核集中在一阶成功率尺度1/k处。
AI.conclusion: 本文是一个条件性（非实验性）理论贡献，不训练模型也不做模型查询，为既有经验现象提供了形式化框架，其假设可在未来工作中进行实证检验。

title: Cross-Entropy Risk Estimation for Language Models: Inconsistency Must Be Dense, and the Holdout Method Is No Exception
summary: Language models are compared by their held-out per-token cross-entropy risk---the quantity scaling laws are fitted to. We show that it cannot be consistently estimated. Consistency, or convergence to the estimand, is defined relative to a \emph{possible state of the world}: a pair consisting of a data-generating distribution and a model we turn out to train. Quantifying over models as well as data-generating mechanisms is essential, because what decides whether a model's risk is estimable is a tail property of the distribution its weights induce, which no sample reveals. The per-token cross-entropy risk is hard to estimate because of a topological fact: among the possible states, finite risk and infinite risk each lie arbitrarily close to every instance of the other. Consequently no estimator---not merely the holdout average---is consistent at every state at which the risk is defined. Worse, inconsistent estimation persists under both bounding the expected sequence length and restricting to full-support models; and in that restricted setting the states at which inconsistency occurs are even dense. Two interesting ways out are identified, and neither is free. Way out 1: using a bounded context window, we can floor a model's next-token probabilities, making its risk finite exactly when the data-generating distribution has finite expected sequence length---a new, statistical rationale for a choice that was made on computational grounds, though the assumption it substitutes is itself beyond the reach of any test. Way out 2: reporting the risk only when it falls below a threshold fixed in advance restores consistency, at no cost to what model selection actually requires---but we need to recognize that the goal of estimation is revised.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了语言模型的每token交叉熵风险（用于拟合scaling laws的指标）无法被一致估计。无论使用何种估计器，在有限的样本下都无法收敛到真实风险值，因为"风险有限"与"风险无限"这两种状态在拓扑上相互穿插、无法区分。文章提出了两种可行的出路：使用有界上下文窗口并对概率设下限（使风险有限性等价于数据分布的期望序列长度有限），或仅在风险低于预设阈值时才报告风险（修订估计目标）。
AI.motivation: 语言模型评估依赖held-out per-token交叉熵风险，这是scaling law的核心指标。但作者发现该指标存在根本性的可估计性（estimability）问题——它不能被任何估计器一致地估计。这种不一致性源于拓扑结构：有限风险与无限风险的状态在可能状态空间中任意接近，导致任何样本都无法区分它们。这个发现动摇了依赖该指标进行模型比较和scaling law拟合的基础。
AI.method: 作者采用形式化的统计一致性框架进行分析：将一致性定义为相对于"可能的世界状态"（数据生成分布+训练得到的模型）的收敛性。他们通过拓扑论证证明，在可能状态空间中，有限风险与无限风险的状态彼此稠密接近，因此不存在一致估计器。进一步，他们分析了两种缓解方案：（1）有界上下文窗口+概率下界（floored probabilities），使风险有限性可判定；（2）仅报告低于预设阈值的风险值。两种方案各有代价。
AI.result: 主要结果：（1）每token交叉熵风险不能在任何定义状态下被一致估计，连holdout平均估计器也不例外；（2）即使限制期望序列长度有界且仅考虑全支撑模型，不一致性依然存在，且不一致发生的状态在该受限集合中甚至稠密；（3）出路1（有界上下文+概率下界）使风险有限性判定变得可行，但依赖的假设本身无法被检验；（4）出路2（阈值化报告）恢复一致性且不影响模型选择需求，但改变了估计目标的性质。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型的每token交叉熵风险本质上不可一致估计，这是拓扑层面的根本限制而非估计器设计问题。文章给出的两种出路各有代价：第一种源于计算动机的上下文窗口限制意外获得了统计合理性，但它所依赖的假设不可检验；第二种通过修订估计目标（只报告低于阈值的结果）恢复了一致性，以改变问题实质为代价。这提示研究社区需要重新审视以交叉熵风险为核心的模型评估和scaling law框架。

title: A Comprehensive Survey of Wireless Foundation Models for AI-Native 6G Networks
comment: 28 Pages, submitted to IEEE Communications Surveys and Tutorials
summary: Foundation models are emerging as a transformative paradigm for AI-native sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks by enabling scalable, transferable, and data-efficient intelligence across diverse communication tasks. Unlike conventional deep learning models that are trained for individual applications, wireless foundation models (WFMs) learn generalized representations from large-scale heterogeneous wireless data and can be efficiently adapted to communication, sensing, localization, and network optimization tasks with minimal task-specific supervision. Despite rapid progress, current research remains fragmented across architectures, training paradigms, and application domains, with no unified survey dedicated to the design, learning, and deployment of WFMs. This survey presents a comprehensive and unified review of wireless foundation models. We first establish the fundamental concepts of WFMs and introduce a taxonomy that organizes the field according to model architectures, pre-training paradigms, and applications. We then review representative architectures, self-supervised pre-training strategies, parameter-efficient adaptation methods, datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation methodologies, highlighting their roles in enabling transferable wireless intelligence. Furthermore, we examine emerging applications spanning physical-layer signal processing, network intelligence, and cross-layer optimization, and discuss the key challenges of data availability, generalization, interpretability, efficient edge deployment, and standardization. Finally, we outline future research directions toward scalable, trustworthy, and general-purpose wireless intelligence for AI-native 6G networks. This survey provides a comprehensive reference for researchers and practitioners developing next-generation intelligent wireless systems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇全面的综述论文，系统性地回顾了无线基础模型（WFM）的设计、学习与部署。文章建立了WFM的基本概念，提出了基于架构、预训练范式和应用的分类体系，并全面覆盖了代表性架构、自监督预训练策略、参数高效适配方法、数据集、基准和评估方法，同时探讨了物理层信号处理、网络智能和跨层优化等新兴应用以及关键挑战和未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 尽管无线基础模型发展迅速，但当前研究在架构、训练范式和应用程序领域之间仍然碎片化，缺乏一个统一且全面的综述来系统性地梳理WFM的设计、学习和部署，这阻碍了该领域的整体发展和知识整合。
AI.method: 本文采用综述研究方法：首先建立无线基础模型的基本概念，提出包含模型架构、预训练范式和应用程序三个维度的分类体系；然后系统回顾代表性架构、自监督预训练策略、参数高效适配方法、数据集、基准和评估方法；最后分析新兴应用场景及面临的挑战，并展望未来研究方向。
AI.result: 本文提供了一份综合性的无线基础模型参考指南，涵盖了WFM从概念、分类到架构、训练、适配、评估和应用的完整技术栈，并识别了数据可用性、泛化能力、可解释性、边缘部署效率和标准化等关键挑战。
AI.conclusion: 无线基础模型代表了面向AI原生的6G网络的可扩展、可信赖、通用无线智能的发展方向，未来需要解决数据、泛化、可解释性和部署等多方面的挑战，以推动下一代智能无线系统的实现。

title: When Do Concepts Become Functionally Sufficient During Language-Model Training?
summary: Understanding a model and its learning mechanisms in depth requires identifying when its internal structures become useful, rather than simply looking at the final state. We study this through concept dynamics: at each layer and checkpoint, we decompose activations, select sparse soft masks, and inject masked reconstructions into the model. Concept analysis is therefore tested functionally: a mask is useful only insofar as it preserves a target under intervention. We compare sufficiency for activation reconstruction, linear decodability, true downstream preservation, and checkpoint transfer under learned alignment. The framework treats decomposition assumptions as hypotheses rather than interpretability guarantees, monitoring functional sufficiency across checkpoints and source-to-final reconstructability under learned alignment. At the shared fixed-penalty operating point across seven models, downstream masks retain substantially less soft mass than reconstruction masks; predictive-distribution shifts remain small.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过概念动态（concept dynamics）来研究模型内部结构的形成过程，即在每个层和检查点对激活进行分解、选择稀疏软掩码并注入掩码重建，从功能性角度测试概念掩码的有效性，而非仅关注最终状态。
AI.motivation: 深入理解模型及其学习机制，需要识别内部结构何时变得有用，而不仅仅是观察最终状态。现有的可解释性分析往往只关注模型的最终表现，忽略了内部概念在训练过程中的形成与演化动态。
AI.method: 在每一层和检查点分解激活，选择稀疏软掩码，并将掩码重建注入模型。通过功能性测试评估掩码的有效性：比较激活重建充分性、线性可解码性、真实下游任务保持能力，以及在学到对齐下的检查点迁移能力。将分解假设视为需检验的假说而非可解释性保证，跨检查点监测功能充分性。
AI.result: 在七个模型共享的固定惩罚操作点下，下游任务掩码保留的软质量显著少于重建掩码，而预测分布偏移保持较小。
AI.conclusion: 概念存在与否及其有用性需要通过功能干预来验证，且随训练动态演化；下游任务掩码的稀疏性与重建掩码存在显著差异，说明不同用途的概念结构具有不同特性。

title: Decision-Driven Regularization: A Blended Model for Learning and Optimization
comment: 42 pages (including appendix), 7 figures in main, journal paper
summary: In contextual optimization, the decision-maker seeks optimal decisions to minimize a cost function, that varies based on observed features. This context is common in many business applications ranging from on-demand delivery and retail operations to portfolio optimization and inventory management. In this paper, we study the learning and optimization approach, which first learns how outcomes result from the features, and then selects optimal decisions based on these outcomes. We focus on the integrated learning and optimization literature, and identify that a lack of control for prediction accuracy can lead to overfitting and a loss of decision effectiveness against simple separate learning and optimization models. Instead, we propose a bi-objective formulation that balances prediction accuracy and cost minimization, termed decision-driven regularization. It also addresses ambiguity in the definition of the cost function via a surrogate that depends on a new hyperparameter. We additionally show that alternative perspectives for formulating the problem, namely robust optimization and regret minimization, lead to models that are closely related to our proposed model. As a consequence, our framework generalizes models such as SPO+. Our model is shown to be numerically superior to other benchmarks, such as OLS, Random Forest, XGBoost, SPO+, Perturbation Gradient, and Learning and Rank, in our synthetic studies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究情境优化中的集成学习与优化方法，提出一种名为"决策驱动正则化"的双目标模型，平衡预测精度与成本最小化，并证明其泛化能力及数值优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有的集成学习与优化方法缺乏对预测精度的控制，容易导致过拟合，使得决策效果甚至不如简单的分离式学习和优化模型。
AI.method: 提出双目标公式（决策驱动正则化），通过一个代理函数和新的超参数来平衡预测精度与成本最小化，并处理成本函数定义中的模糊性。同时证明鲁棒优化和遗憾最小化视角与所提模型密切相关，框架可推广SPO+等模型。
AI.result: 在合成研究中，该模型在数值上优于OLS、Random Forest、XGBoost、SPO+、Perturbation Gradient和Learning and Rank等基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的决策驱动正则化框架能有效控制预测精度，避免过拟合，提升决策有效性，并统一了多种现有模型，具有广泛的适用性和优越性能。

title: ARGUS: Attention-Guided Transformers for Scalable Person Identification Using Wi-Fi Telemetry
summary: Passive, device-free person identification offers an alternative to camera- and wearable-based biometrics, yet existing wireless approaches rely largely on gait or activity cues and are rarely evaluated at scale. In this paper, we present \emph{Argus}, a passive Wi-Fi sensing system that identifies people from commodity Channel State Information (CSI) without requiring an attached device or a prescribed motion. Argus converts short CSI spans into compact \emph{statgrams}: statistical maps built from the channel views available on a given device. A lightweight decoder-only Transformer then reads coarse statgram patches as tokens, and segment-level logit aggregation combines evidence over time. On a 154-subject CSI dataset evaluated with a strict physical-segment split, Argus reaches $78.88\% \pm 1.62\%$ Top-1 accuracy on 6-second windows and $84.85\% \pm 1.31\%$ after aggregating 19 overlapping windows over a 60-second segment; Top-3 and Top-5 reach $98.61\%$ and $99.26\%$. For a 60-second statgram, Argus improves over a raw-CSI Transformer baseline by 7.75 points while using $4.4\times$ fewer FLOPs per window. Attention-guided compression preserves full single-window accuracy with only half of the EHealth patches. On WiMANS, a multi-user benchmark across three rooms and two Wi-Fi bands, Argus remains within 1.23 percentage points of the strongest per-configuration baselines on average while using $27\times$ fewer inference FLOPs. These results show that compact CSI statistics can scale passive identification while also exposing deployment limits in open-set rejection and cross-room transfer.

AI.tldr: Argus是一个基于被动Wi-Fi CSI的无线人体识别系统，通过将信道状态信息转换为紧凑的统计图（statgrams），并使用轻量级decoder-only Transformer进行识别。在154名受试者的数据集上达到78.88%的Top-1准确率（6秒窗口），通过60秒时间聚合提升至84.85%，同时相比基线减少4.4倍FLOPs。
AI.motivation: 现有无线人体识别方法主要依赖步态或活动线索，且很少在大规模数据集上评估。作者希望提供一种无需设备佩戴、无需规定动作、可扩展的被动无线识别方案。
AI.method: 1) 将短CSI片段转换为紧凑的统计图（statgrams），利用设备上可用的信道视图构建统计映射；2) 使用轻量级decoder-only Transformer，将粗粒度statgram块作为token处理；3) 通过segment-level logit聚合，在时间范围内组合证据。
AI.result: 在154人数据集上用严格物理分段划分，6秒窗口Top-1准确率78.88%±1.62%；60秒内聚合19个重叠窗口后达84.85%±1.31%；Top-3和Top-5分别达98.61%和99.26%。相比raw-CSI Transformer基线提升7.75个百分点，FLOPs减少4.4倍。在WiMANS基准上保持接近最强基线的性能同时减少27倍推理FLOPs，并揭示了开集拒绝和跨房间迁移方面的部署局限。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的CSI统计特征能够支撑大规模被动人员识别，且具有较高的计算效率。但研究同时暴露了在开集拒绝和跨房间迁移场景下仍存在局限性，为后续工作指明了方向。

title: Large Language Model Assisted Operational Monitoring for Battery Energy Storage System Integrated Power Distribution Networks
summary: Battery energy storage systems (BESS) are increasingly used in distribution networks for voltage regulation and demand response, which increases the volume and complexity of operational telemetry available to grid operators. This paper presents an AI-enabled monitoring framework that connects a large language model (LLM) interface with a structured telemetry database for BESS-integrated distribution system analysis. Operator questions are submitted in natural language and translated into validated SQL queries using predefined database schema information and approved KPI views. Retrieved measurements, including bus voltages, state of charge, active power, and reactive power, are evaluated against engineering constraints for voltage limits, BESS operation, and demand response tracking. The framework is validated using hardware-in-the-loop co-simulation data from a BESS-equipped distribution feeder operating under reactive power-based voltage control and price-driven demand response. Case studies show that the framework generates valid database queries, identifies repeated voltage violations, detects reactive power overshoot, and evaluates active-power tracking performance. The results show that LLM-assisted monitoring can connect structured grid telemetry with automated engineering assessment for BESS operation analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个AI监控框架，将大语言模型接口与结构化遥测数据库连接，用于电池储能系统（BESS）集成配电系统的分析。操作员用自然语言提问，框架将其转换为经过验证的SQL查询，检索电压、荷电状态、有功和无功功率等测量数据，并对照工程约束进行评估。通过硬件在环协同仿真验证，结果表明该框架能生成有效查询、识别电压违规、检测无功超调并评估有功跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: BESS在配电网中日益普及用于电压调节和需求响应，导致电网运营商需要处理的运行遥测数据量更大、复杂度更高。传统方法难以高效地将大量结构化遥测数据与工程判断结合起来进行分析，因此需要一种能将自然语言查询与结构化数据检索和自动工程评估相连接的智能监控方案。
AI.method: 框架连接LLM接口与结构化遥测数据库。操作员以自然语言提交问题，LLM利用预定义的数据库模式和经批准的KPI视图，将问题翻译为有效的SQL查询。检索到的测量数据（母线电压、SOC、有功/无功功率）再对照工程约束（电压限值、BESS运行限制、需求响应跟踪）进行评估。采用硬件在环协同仿真数据验证，场景为基于无功功率的电压控制和价格驱动需求响应的BESS配电馈线。
AI.result: 案例研究表明该框架能够生成有效的数据库查询、识别重复的电压违规、检测无功功率超调，并评估有功功率跟踪性能。LLM辅助监控可以成功地将结构化电网遥测数据与自动化工程评估连接起来，用于BESS运行分析。
AI.conclusion: LLM辅助监控为BESS集成配电系统提供了一种可行的智能监控方案，能够弥合自然语言人机交互与结构化遥测数据工程分析之间的鸿沟，提升电网运营商对复杂运行数据的分析和决策效率。

title: Synchronized Logit Steering: Real-world Steganography
summary: Steganography in large language models offers a way to embed hidden messages within natural-sounding text. Existing token and logit-level methods typically require the sender and receiver to share an identical prompt context, which is rarely guaranteed in production pipelines that use retrieval-augmented generation or proprietary system instructions. We introduce Synchronized Logit Steering (SLS), a deterministic steganographic scheme that eliminates this dependency by deriving a proxy prompt from the generated output itself, allowing both parties to reconstruct the same logit distribution without access to the original prompt. SLS encodes payload values as token ranks within high-entropy regions of the proxy prompt distribution, and we extend the scheme with periodic recurrence and payload bursts to scale information density. Across ShareGPT, GSM8K, and SWE-bench Verified, we show that the KL divergence between the true and proxy prompt distributions falls below 0.5 nats once the synchronization window reaches 40 tokens, and SLS encoding does not meaningfully disrupt this convergence relative to greedy generation. We also find that the periodic-burst variant achieves 0.20 bits per token, or roughly 10x the capacity of single-payload encoding. Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests further confirm that SLS outputs are statistically difficult to distinguish from greedy generations, demonstrating that covert, prompt-agnostic communication through LLMs is both practical and stealthy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出同步logit引导（SLS）方案，一种确定性隐写方法，通过从生成输出本身推导代理提示（proxy prompt）来消除发送方和接收方共享提示上下文的需求，使双方无需访问原始提示即可重建相同的logit分布。实验表明该方案在多个数据集上实现KL散度低于0.5 nats的收敛，周期突发变体达到0.20比特/令牌的容量（约为单载荷编码的10倍），且统计上难以与贪心生成区分。
AI.motivation: 现有基于token和logit级别的隐写方法要求发送方和接收方共享完全相同的提示上下文，但在生产环境中（如检索增强生成或专有系统指令）这一条件几乎无法保证。这严重限制了隐写在真实LLM管线中的应用。
AI.method: SLS从生成的输出本身推导代理提示，使双方无需原始提示即可重建相同logit分布。载荷值以token排名形式编码在高熵区域的代理提示分布中，并通过周期性递归和载荷突发扩展信息密度。
AI.result: 在ShareGPT、GSM8K和SWE-bench Verified上，同步窗口达40个token时真实与代理提示分布的KL散度降至0.5 nats以下；周期突发变体实现0.20比特/令牌容量（约为单载荷编码的10倍）；Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验确认SLS输出与贪心生成统计上难以区分。
AI.conclusion: 通过LLM进行隐蔽、提示无关的通信既实用又具有隐蔽性，为隐写在生产LLM管线中的应用开辟了新途径。

title: Logical Embeddings for Argument Analysis
summary: We propose a new framework for machine-learning-oriented argument analysis tasks. Our proposal involves replacing traditional contextualized word embeddings used in most NLP tasks with logical embeddings, an alternative encoding that directly exploits argumentation structures. In essence, logical embeddings encapsulate the logical semantics of an argument, allowing for a better representation of its meaning. Supporting these embeddings is a mathematical logic-based similarity measure that offers a transparent notion of proximity and is guaranteed to satisfy several desirable theoretical properties that current cosine similarity-based contextualized word embeddings cannot assure. This similarity measure induces a positive semi-definite kernel on the set of arguments, enabling us to uniquely define logical embeddings using the theory of Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHS). Moreover, we prove that this encoding is optimal, in the sense that no logical information is lost in the process. As with other RKHS applications, logical embeddings can be used in numerous supervised and unsupervised tasks. We provide an implementation of the method and aim to test it against literature benchmarks. Additionally, we demonstrate that logical embeddings outperform most standard embedding methods on a classification task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于机器学习导向论证分析任务的新框架，用逻辑嵌入（logical embeddings）替代传统的上下文词嵌入。逻辑嵌入直接利用论证结构，封装论证的逻辑语义，并基于数学逻辑的相似度度量来定义。该相似度度量满足若干理想的理论性质，诱导正半定核，从而可通过RKHS理论唯一定义逻辑嵌入，并证明该编码在逻辑信息保留上是最优的。实验表明逻辑嵌入在分类任务上优于大多数标准嵌入方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的上下文词嵌入（如基于余弦相似度的嵌入）在论证分析任务中存在不足：它们无法直接利用论证结构，且基于余弦相似度的邻近性度量缺乏透明的逻辑语义，也无法保证某些理想的理论性质。
AI.method: 提出逻辑嵌入（logical embeddings）替代上下文词嵌入。核心方法包括：(1) 设计一种基于数学逻辑的相似度度量，提供透明的邻近性概念；(2) 证明该相似度度量诱导正半定核，利用Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHS)理论唯一定义逻辑嵌入；(3) 证明该编码在逻辑信息保留上是最优的。
AI.result: 提供了方法实现，并在文献基准上进行了测试。在分类任务上，逻辑嵌入优于大多数标准嵌入方法。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑嵌入为论证分析提供了一种理论上可保证、逻辑信息无损的替代编码方案，既具备透明的相似度概念，又在实验中展现出优于标准嵌入方法的性能。

title: Take it Personally: The Limits of General SSL Representations for Real-Life PPG Emotion Detection
comment: 9 pages, 4 Figures, 2 Tables, Accepted as the 14th International Conference on Affective Computing and Intelligent Interaction (ACII 2026)
summary: While Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) effectively extracts general representations from noisy, unconstrained physiological signals such as photoplethysmography (PPG), its suitability for highly subjective tasks remains unproven. In this work, we evaluate the efficacy of PPG-based SSL for real-life intense emotion detection. First, we pretrain a Real-Life PPG encoder (RL-PPG) on unconstrained, real-life data. As a rigorous sanity check, we demonstrate that these representations transfer exceptionally well to an objective physical activity recognition task, yielding almost 5-fold increase in performance over baselines in a leave-one-subject-out evaluation (LOSO). However, when applied to a~subjective real-life emotion detection task, these same general representations fail to surpass naive baselines under the LOSO protocol. Using an Across-Time validation strategy, we establish that incorporating an individual's personal data during fine-tuning is the main driver of predictive performance, outweighing the benefits of population-level pretraining. Ultimately, our findings indicate that in the evaluated scenario, general SSL representations may be insufficient for subjective affective inference, suggesting that personalization is likely a key component for real-world emotion recognition. To support future research, we share the code and pretrained RL-PPG~encoder~weights.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了基于PPG信号的自监督学习（SSL）在真实生活强烈情绪检测中的有效性。结果表明SSL表示在客观的身体活动识别任务中表现优异（性能提升近5倍），但在主观情绪检测任务中无法超越朴素基线。研究发现个体数据在微调中的融入是预测性能的主要驱动因素，而非群体级预训练，表明通用SSL表示可能不足以支撑主观情感推理，个性化可能是关键。
AI.motivation: SSL在从无约束生理信号（如PPG）中提取通用表示方面效果显著，但其在高度主观任务（如情绪检测）中的适用性尚未得到验证。作者希望探究SSL表示能否迁移到主观情感推理场景。
AI.method: 1) 在无约束真实生活数据上预训练RL-PPG编码器；2) 在客观任务（身体活动识别）上进行转移性验证；3) 在主观任务（真实生活强烈情绪检测）上进行评估，比较LOSO和Across-Time两种验证策略，并分析个体数据微调与群体预训练的相对贡献。
AI.result: SSL表示在身体活动识别中性能提升近5倍（LOSO评估），但在情绪检测中无法超越朴素基线。Across-Time验证显示个体微调数据是预测性能的主要驱动力，优于群体级预训练的收益。
AI.conclusion: 在评估场景下，通用SSL表示对主观情感推理可能不足，个性化很可能是真实世界情绪识别中的关键组成部分。作者开源了代码和预训练权重以支持后续研究。

title: Conditional Evaluation of Language Models with Cheap Auxiliary Signals
summary: Aggregate accuracy hides where models succeed and fail. Estimating conditional performance profiles from gold labels alone is expensive, while cheap auxiliary signals such as LLM-judge scores, pairwise comparisons, confidence scores, and judge-disagreement features can be collected for every benchmark item but are often biased or miscalibrated. We propose LACE (Local Augmented Control-Variate Evaluation), a semi-supervised estimator for conditional LLM evaluation. The key step is local centering: after subtracting the conditional mean of a cheap signal within the target profile region, any linear augmentation has zero conditional mean and therefore cannot change the estimand. The augmentation coefficient is used only for efficiency, and a local ridge control variate combines a gold-label residual mean from the labeled subset with a cheap-signal mean from the full item pool. We prove calibration-free identification, unbiasedness for grouped profiles, local oracle optimality within centered linear augmentations, and first-order adaptivity to the estimated coefficient. The resulting gain formula is governed by a population local $R^2$, which characterizes how the efficiency attainable from the cheap signals varies across profile values. We also derive corresponding estimators for direct paired model gaps and deployment-weighted scores. We empirically evaluate the primary performance-profile estimator on MATH-500, ScienceQA, MMLU, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, GSM8K, and ARC.

AI.tldr: 提出LACE（局部增广控制变量评估）方法，一种半监督的条件LLM评估估计器。通过局部中心化的关键步骤，使得廉价信号（如LLM裁判分数、成对比较、置信度分数等）的线性增广具有零条件均值，从而不会改变估计目标。使用局部岭控制变量结合标注子集的黄金标签残差均值和全项池的廉价信号均值，实现无偏、校准自由的估计。
AI.motivation: 聚合准确率掩盖了模型在何处成功与失败。从黄金标签估计条件性能画像成本高昂，而廉价辅助信号虽然可以为每个基准项收集，但往往有偏或校准不良，需要一种有效利用廉价信号来估计条件性能的方法。
AI.method: 提出LACE方法，核心是局部中心化（local centering）：在目标画像区域内减去廉价信号的条件均值后，任何线性增广都具有零条件均值，不会改变估计目标。增广系数仅用于提高效率。局部岭控制变量将标注子集的黄金标签残差均值与全项池的廉价信号均值结合。证明了校准自由识别、分组画像无偏性、局部线性增广内的局部最优性及一阶自适应性。
AI.result: 增益公式由总体局部R²控制，表征廉价信号在不同画像值上可获得的效率。推导了直接配对模型差距和部署加权分数的对应估计器。在MATH-500、ScienceQA、MMLU、WinoGrande、HellaSwag、TruthfulQA、GSM8K和ARC上进行了主要性能画像估计器的经验评估。
AI.conclusion: LACE提供了一种校准自由、无偏且自适应的半监督条件LLM评估框架，通过局部岭控制变量有效利用廉价信号，在理论保证和实证效果上均展现出优势。

title: Semantic Uncertainty-Guided Orchestration in Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables
summary: As large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems become increasingly capable, coordinating agents under uncertainty becomes a fundamental challenge. Existing orchestration strategies typically rely on fixed interaction patterns and often lack mechanisms for assessing the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, allowing errors and hallucinations to propagate through the system. This paper introduces a semantic-uncertainty-guided orchestration approach, HASSUM as a general framework for uncertainty-aware coordination in multi-agent systems. The method estimates uncertainty using semantic entropy and semantic density, which measure trust at the level of answer semantics rather than output probabilities. These signals enable adaptive orchestration decisions, including output verification, selective reprompting, additional deliberation, and confidence-aware response selection. Because the approach operates independently of any particular agent architecture, it can be integrated into a broad range of hierarchical and collaborative multi-agent systems. The evaluations demonstrate an implementation within a hierarchical agent framework and evaluate it on StrategyQA, JailbreakBench, and TruthfulQA benchmarks. Across tasks that require complex reasoning and are prone to ambiguity or hallucinations, uncertainty-guided orchestration yields more reliable outcomes than uncertainty-unaware coordination. Semantic entropy and semantic density in tandem outperformed either metric alone. Ablations testing different thresholds and model sizes demonstrated that both influence the effectiveness of semantic metrics. The results suggest that semantic uncertainty is a practical and general-purpose signal for improving robustness and trustworthiness in agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HASSUM，一种基于语义不确定性的多智能体系统编排框架，利用语义熵和语义密度来估计中间推理步骤的信任度，从而实现自适应编排决策（如输出验证、选择性重新提示、额外推理和置信度感知的响应选择），在StrategyQA、JailbreakBench和TruthfulQA基准上展现了比不考虑不确定性的方法更可靠的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM多智能体系统编排策略依赖于固定的交互模式，缺乏对中间推理步骤可靠性的评估机制，导致错误和幻觉在系统中传播。随着智能体系统能力增强，在不确定性下协调智能体成为一个根本性挑战。
AI.method: 提出语义不确定性引导的编排框架HASSUM，通过语义熵和语义密度在答案语义层面估计信任度（而非输出概率层面），这些信号驱动自适应编排决策，包括输出验证、选择性重新提示、额外推理和置信度感知的响应选择。该框架与具体智能体架构无关，可集成到多种层次化与协作式多智能体系统中。
AI.result: 在StrategyQA、JailbreakBench和TruthfulQA基准上的评估表明：语义不确定性引导的编排在不考虑不确定性的方法上取得了更可靠的结果；语义熵与语义密度结合使用优于单独使用任一指标；消融实验显示阈值和模型大小均影响语义指标的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 语义不确定性是提升智能体AI系统鲁棒性和可信度的实用且通用的信号，为多智能体系统的可靠性协调提供了新方向。

title: When AI Rewrites, Classifiers Relax: Uncertainty-Aware Sentiment Analysis on Sarcastic and AI-Paraphrased Social Text
summary: Sentiment classifiers are increasingly applied to social media content that is either sarcastic or AI-generated --- two distributional regimes where standard evaluations offer little guidance. We present a three-part empirical study of sentiment classifier behaviour under these conditions. First, we find that confidence scores on sarcastic text are significantly lower than on non-sarcastic text (Mann--Whitney $p = 2 \times 10^{-6}$), confirming that classifiers sense their own uncertainty on ironic content even without explicit uncertainty modelling. Second, and counterintuitively, we show that sentiment classifiers achieve higher accuracy on AI-paraphrased reviews than on the original human-authored text (RoBERTa: $+5.8$ pp for Qwen3.5-4B paraphrases, $+3.7$ pp for Gemma4-E4B), revealing a cross-domain stylistic alignment effect: AI paraphrases remove distributional noise that confounds Twitter-trained classifiers, producing cleaner, more prototypical sentiment text. Third, we demonstrate that a lightweight abstention wrapper --- flagging the $14\%$ of inputs with confidence below $0.6$ --- improves accuracy from 82.2\% to 88.9\% ($+6.7$ pp) on the retained set. We further compare Semantic Entropy and MC-Dropout-style disagreement as uncertainty signals and find near-identical AUROC ($0.650$ vs.\ $0.646$) on sarcastic text, suggesting that for short social media inputs, both methods are interchangeable. Our results motivate a shift from confident single-label prediction to uncertainty-aware abstention in high-stakes sentiment applications such as mental health flagging and content moderation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三部分实证研究，考察了情感分类器在讽刺文本和AI生成文本这两种分布外场景下的表现。研究发现：(1) 分类器在讽刺文本上的置信度显著更低；(2) 分类器在AI改写评论上的准确率反而高于原始人类文本，因为AI改写去除了混淆Twitter训练分类器的分布噪声；(3) 轻量级弃权包装器通过标记低置信度输入，可将准确率从82.2%提升至88.9%。研究还比较了两种不确定性信号方法，发现它们在短文本上表现几乎相同。
AI.motivation: 情感分类器被越来越多地应用于社交媒体内容，而这些内容往往包含讽刺或AI生成文本——这两种分布场景下，标准评估无法提供有效指导。现有研究缺乏对分类器在这两种"分布外"条件下行为的系统性理解。
AI.method: 三部分实证研究：(1) 使用Mann-Whitney检验比较分类器在讽刺与非讽刺文本上的置信度差异；(2) 比较分类器在AI改写评论与原始人类文本上的准确率；(3) 提出轻量级弃权包装器，对置信度低于0.6的输入进行标记排除。同时比较Semantic Entropy和MC-Dropout两种不确定性信号方法。
AI.result: (1) 讽刺文本置信度显著更低（p = 2×10⁻⁶）；(2) AI改写文本上准确率反而更高（RoBERTa在Qwen3.5-4B改写上+5.8pp，Gemma4-E4B上+3.7pp）；(3) 弃权包装器在保留集上提升准确率6.7个百分点（82.2%→88.9%）；Semantic Entropy和MC-Dropout的AUROC近乎相同（0.650 vs 0.646）。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持在高风险情感应用（如心理健康标记和内容审核）中，从自信的单标签预测转向不确定性感知的弃权策略。讽刺文本和AI改写文本代表两个不同的分布外场景，需要不同的处理策略。

title: Beyond Pass@k: Measuring Reliability and Security of Agentic Code Generation
summary: AI coding agent benchmarks rank agents with the Chen et al. (2021) pass@k estimator, but current implementations misapply it: they set n to the number of unit tests in a single submission rather than the number of independent rollout attempts, conflating test-suite size with attempt independence. We diagnose this operationalization error, prove it by counterexample, and propose reliability@k, the same estimator applied correctly, with n = independent rollouts and c = fully-passing rollouts per (task, agent) pair. In a synthetic multi-rollout benchmark, the misapplied metric inflates reported scores by 0.85-0.97 in absolute terms (0.96-0.98 reported vs. 0.00-0.12 corrected), and a cheap single-rollout proxy fails to substitute for repeated runs (Spearman $ρ= 0.417$). Motivated by evidence that functional correctness does not imply security safety, we additionally propose security-adjusted reliability@k, which counts only rollouts that are both functionally correct and free of high-severity insecure patterns. In an initial live-API test with three agents, the adjustment did not change any ranking under our current scanner and threshold, so we present it as a proposed complementary lens whose decisive evaluation requires better-powered future runs. Finally, a preliminary 5-task SWE-bench Verified pilot observes the same core concern in a real repository setting: macro-averaged hidden-test pass rate was 0.80 while strict task resolution was 0.20.

AI.tldr: 本文诊断了AI编码智能体基准测试中对pass@k估计器的误用问题：现有实现错误地将n设为单个提交中的单元测试数量，而非独立的rollout尝试次数，从而混淆了测试套件规模与尝试独立性。作者提出reliability@k作为正确应用的估计器，并进一步提出安全调整版本（security-adjusted reliability@k），结合功能正确性与安全性双重标准进行评估。
AI.motivation: 当前AI编码智能体基准测试虽声称使用Chen等人(2021)的pass@k估计器，但实际实现存在系统性误用，导致报告分数被严重高估（在合成基准中膨胀0.85-0.97绝对值）。此外，功能正确性并不等同于安全性，现有评估框架完全忽视了智能体生成代码的安全风险，因此需要同时解决度量误用和安全盲区两个问题。
AI.method: 1) 通过反例证明现存的pass@k误用问题，指出n应被设置为独立rollout次数而非测试数量；2) 提出reliability@k，以n=独立rollouts、c=完全通过的rollouts每(task, agent)对进行计算；3) 提出security-adjusted reliability@k，仅计数功能正确且无高危不安全模式的rollouts；4) 通过合成多rollout基准、live-API测试（3个智能体）和SWE-bench Verified试点（5个任务）进行验证。
AI.result: 合成基准显示，误用的度量将报告分数从0.00-0.12膨胀至0.96-0.98（绝对膨胀0.85-0.97）；单rollout代理无法替代多次运行（Spearman ρ=0.417）；security调整在3个智能体的live-API测试中未改变排名（因当前扫描器和阈值灵敏度过低）；SWE-bench试点中，宏平均隐藏测试通过率0.80而严格任务解决率仅0.20，证实了核心问题的现实存在性。
AI.conclusion: AI编码智能体评估中的pass@k误用是普遍且严重的问题，reliability@k提供了正确的评估框架；安全调整虽在当前测试中未改变排名，但作为互补视角具有重要价值，需更强力的实验验证。研究呼吁社区采用正确的估计器，并同时关注代码功能正确性与安全性。

title: The Machine's Internal Clock: Do LLMs Share Human Temporal Illusions?
comment: 25 pages, 24 figures
summary: Human perception of time is subjective. Well-documented temporal illusions show that the brain relies on context and relational cues for judging duration instead of tracking elapsed time directly. Prior studies established these effects with visual and auditory stimuli. Existing LLM evaluations of temporal perception focus on estimating event durations or multi-step temporal reasoning. In this work, we investigate whether written narratives alone can evoke human temporal illusions, using a new benchmark of 6,684 narrative pairs spanning five illusions. We find that human readers (60 participants) prefer expected scenarios in only two of the five illusions, those where the manipulation is directly visible in text rather than requiring readers to internally simulate duration. We evaluate 14 LLMs on the same benchmark. Surprisingly, we find that models pick the literature-predicted scenario across four of the five illusions, diverging from human behavior. Reasoning traces show that ~70% of responses explicitly evoke psychology research, suggesting that this alignment is consistent with retrieval of published findings rather than human-like temporal biases.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨书面叙事能否引发人类时间错觉，构建了涵盖五种错觉的6684对叙事基准。60名人类读者仅在半数错觉中表现出预期偏好，而14个LLM在四种错觉中选择文献预测场景，但其推理痕迹显示约70%的回应明确引用心理学研究，表明模型的表现源于检索已发表发现而非类人时间偏差。
AI.motivation: 已有研究通过视觉和听觉刺激确立了时间错觉现象，现有LLM时间感知评估聚焦于事件时长估计或多步时间推理，但尚未探究纯书面叙事是否能引发人类的时间错觉，以及LLM在此类任务上的表现如何。
AI.method: 构建包含6684对叙事的新基准，覆盖五种时间错觉；招募60名人类读者进行评估；对14个LLM进行相同基准测试，并分析其推理痕迹（reasoning traces）以探究模型决策依据。
AI.result: 人类读者仅在五种错觉中的两种表现出对预期场景的偏好（这两种的操控在文本中直接可见）；14个LLM在四种错觉中选择文献预测场景，与人类行为相偏离；推理痕迹显示约70%的回应明确引用心理学研究。
AI.conclusion: LLM在时间错觉任务上与人类行为存在显著分歧，其表现更可能源于检索已发表的心理学发现而非真正模拟人类的时间感知偏差。这提示在评估LLM的类人认知能力时需谨慎区分记忆检索与真实认知模拟。

title: One Score, Two Decisions: Selective Prediction on the Rare-Disease Tail
summary: Given a patient's clinical findings, a diagnostic system ranks possible diseases and must decide when to endorse its first prediction or defer it for review. This decision is usually made by thresholding the top score. Selective prediction over ranked outputs begins with two checks. First, the ranker must produce enough correct top-ranked predictions to make the target feasible. Across 2,000 patient records stratified by disease prevalence, eight small open-weight LLMs achieve at most 4.6% Recall@1 on ultra-rare diseases. At 10% coverage, even a perfect confidence ranking of their existing predictions therefore cannot reach 50% selective accuracy. More accurate models pass the same check, showing that the limit is regime-specific. Second, the confidence signal must match the decision being made. For fixed-candidate rankers, the top-two margin cancels components shared across candidates. On phenotype-only Exomiser, it selects 10% of cases at 29.0% accuracy, compared with 13.3% overall, while the top score provides no reliable gate. Yet that cancellation can remove information needed to detect whether the candidate list contains an answer. SciFact retrieval and biomedical entity linking confirm this distinction. Finally, we prove that unlabelled scores alone cannot determine whether switching to the margin will help.

AI.tldr: 本文研究诊断系统中选择性预测（selective prediction）的可行性问题，通过两个关键检查（排名器准确率和置信度信号匹配）论证了在超罕见疾病上选择性预测存在根本性限制，并证明基于未标注分数无法判断切换置信度指标是否有益。
AI.motivation: 诊断系统需要对疾病进行排名并决定是否给出预测或推迟人工审查，但当前阈值化顶层分数的方式缺乏系统性的可行性验证。作者希望建立选择性预测的两个前置检查框架，以评估在特定疾病流行度下选择性预测是否真正可行。
AI.method: 采用两层检验框架：(1) 可行性检验——评估排名器在目标疾病流行度分层下是否产生足够多的正确的top-1预测（使用8个小型开放权重LLM在2000份患者记录上测试）；(2) 置信度匹配检验——比较top分数（top score）与top-2差值（margin）作为置信度信号的效果，在Exomiser表型任务、SciFact检索及生物医学实体链接上进行验证，并辅以理论证明。
AI.result: 超罕见疾病上最好模型的Recall@1仅4.6%，即使完美置信度排名在10%覆盖率下也无法达到50%选择性准确率。top-2 margin在Exomiser上选择性准确率达29.0%（优于整体13.3%），而top分数无可靠门控能力；但margin的差值消除可能丢失候选列表中是否含答案的信息。理论证明单独的未标注分数无法决定切换置信度指标是否有益。
AI.conclusion: 选择性预测的效果不仅取决于置信度信号的选择，还取决于排名器的准确率和任务特性。目前的小型LLM在超罕见疾病上无法支撑有效选择性预测，而不同任务需要匹配不同的置信度信号，且哪些信号有效无法仅凭未标注分数判断。

title: Advanced modelling and data analytics in aviation
summary: The aviation industry characterized by its stringent safety standards has seen a growing need for innovative approaches to enhance safety measures. Despite the vast accumulation of aviation safety data over time, its full potential in predicting and preventing incidents has not been fully realized. This research addresses this gap by applying machine learning (ML) and natural language processing (NLP) techniques to analyze aviation safety data from Socrata, the Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB), the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), and the Aviation Safety Network (ASN). By leveraging existing ML models, including deep learning and transformer-based architectures alongside NLP methods for mining aviation incident narratives, this study uncovers patterns contributing to safety related incidents such as accidents and near-misses. Additionally, it employs various topic modelling techniques to extract meaningful themes from unstructured safety reports, enhancing the interpretability of incident analysis. Causal inference techniques and interpretable AI frameworks are further explored to improve model transparency and trustworthiness. A key contribution of this work is the deployment of advanced ML methodologies in a structured aviation safety context, assessing their effectiveness and providing insights into their practical implementation. The findings offer valuable insights for aviation stakeholders, including regulators, airlines, and policymakers, by providing data-driven solutions that enhance incident analysis and decision making. Ultimately, this research supports the industry s ongoing efforts to minimize risks, improve passenger and crew security, and integrate AI driven methodologies into aviation safety management.

AI.tldr: 本研究将机器学习和自然语言处理技术应用于航空安全数据分析，整合了Socrata、ATSB、NTSB和ASN等多个数据源，通过深度学习、Transformer架构、主题建模、因果推断和可解释AI等方法，从海量航空安全数据中挖掘事故和险肇事件的模式，为监管机构、航空公司和政策制定者提供数据驱动的安全决策支持。
AI.motivation: 航空业虽然积累了大量的安全数据，但其在预测和预防事故方面的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。现有数据未能充分发挥价值，需要创新的方法将数据转化为可操作的安全洞察。
AI.method: 采用机器学习和NLP技术，具体包括：1）利用深度学习和基于Transformer的架构进行事故模式挖掘；2）运用NLP方法分析航空事故叙述文本；3）使用多种主题建模技术从非结构化安全报告中提取有意义主题；4）结合因果推断技术和可解释AI框架提升模型透明度和可信度。
AI.result: 研究揭示了导致安全事故（如事故和险肇事件）的潜在模式，并通过结构化航空安全情境中的高级ML方法部署评估了其有效性，为航空利益相关者提供了数据驱动的洞察和可操作的决策建议。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过将AI驱动的方法整合到航空安全管理中，支持行业持续降低风险、提升乘客和机组安全性的努力，为航空安全的预测性分析和智能化管理提供了实践路径。

title: Mitigating Rubric Interference in LLM Judges via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: LLM judges increasingly evaluate responses against fine-grained rubric checklists. When a sample requires multiple rubrics, current methods typically assess each in a separate inference call. Evaluating all rubrics in a single pass is a natural alternative with greater efficiency, but we find that it introduces rubric interference: the verdict on one rubric shifts depending on which other rubrics are co-present. In a preliminary study, only one-third of samples receive fully consistent verdicts when evaluated under rubric sets of varying composition. We develop a measurement framework that probes interference through four controlled operations: rubric set expansion, subsetting, reordering, and noise injection. To mitigate interference without external supervision, we propose Self-Anchored Rubric Alignment (SARA). SARA uses a model's own single-rubric judgments as stable anchors and aligns multi-rubric reasoning with these anchors through on-policy self-distillation. We validate SARA on three datasets (HealthBench, FLASK, ResearchQA) and two model families (Qwen3, Llama-3.1). SARA consistently improves evaluation consistency while maintaining agreement with both base models and GPT-4.1 as a reference judge. Furthermore, the learned consistency transfers across datasets, confirming that SARA teaches a general capability rather than fitting dataset-specific patterns.

AI.tldr: 论文发现LLM裁判在多规则同时评估时存在"规则干扰"问题（仅1/3样本在不同规则组合下保持一致的判断），为此提出Self-Anchored Rubric Alignment (SARA)方法，利用模型自身的单规则判断作为稳定锚点，通过自蒸馏对齐多规则推理，在多个数据集和模型上显著提升评估一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM裁判在评估多条细粒度规则时通常需要对每条规则进行单独的推理调用，虽然单次调用评估所有规则更高效，但会导致规则干扰——一条规则的判定结果会因其他规则的共同存在而发生偏移。这种不一致性会损害评估的可靠性和公平性。
AI.method: 1) 提出一个测量框架，通过四种受控操作（规则集扩展、子集、重排序、噪声注入）探测规则干扰；2) 提出SARA方法：以模型自身的单规则评判作为稳定锚点，通过on-policy自蒸馏将多规则推理与这些锚点对齐，无需外部监督。
AI.result: 在三个数据集（HealthBench、FLASK、ResearchQA）和两个模型族（Qwen3、Llama-3.1）上验证，SARA一致地提升评估一致性，同时保持与基座模型和GPT-4.1参考裁判的一致性；学到的一致性可跨数据集迁移。
AI.conclusion: SARA不仅提高了多规则评估的一致性，还证明这种能力是可迁移的通用能力而非数据集特定的模式拟合，为高效的多规则LLM评估提供了可靠方案。

title: Graph Machine Learning: An Opportunity for Power Systems
summary: Modern power systems face growing operational complexity driven by the integration of renewable energy sources, decentralization, and the need for real-time decision-making across a wide range of timescales. Addressing these challenges traditionally relies on model-based methods that, while accurate, can be too slow for operational demands. Machine learning (ML) has therefore emerged as a faster, data-driven alternative. As grid topology plays a central role in power system operation, graph machine learning (GML) methods offer a natural framework for incorporating topological dependencies as an inductive bias. We survey nearly 800 papers at the intersection of GML and power systems, covering forecasting, state estimation, optimization, control, fault diagnosis, and cybersecurity. Power systems constitute an unusually rich benchmark setting for GML, as they combine hard physical constraints, multi-scale dynamics, safety-critical requirements, and scarce labeled data within a single, well-defined domain. Conversely, power systems can benefit from utilizing GML to complement classical solvers, as GML provide scalable, topology-aware approximations with promising generalization and computational efficiency. We identify open challenges, including limited real-world deployment and the need for interpretable models in safety-critical settings. Despite the rapidly growing number of publications, standardized benchmarks and open datasets remain scarce, leaving many results difficult to reproduce and undermining the long-term scientific credibility of the field. We further derive a structured requirements catalog for ML-ready power grid benchmarks, intended to guide future dataset development and improve reproducibility across studies. We call on the community to prioritize dedicated benchmark studies and the release of open datasets and models.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了近800篇图机器学习（GML）与电力系统交叉领域的论文，覆盖预测、状态估计、优化、控制、故障诊断和网络安全等方向。文章指出电力系统为GML提供了丰富的基准测试场景（硬物理约束、多尺度动态、安全关键性、稀缺标注数据），同时GML能为经典求解器提供可扩展、拓扑感知的近似方案。文章识别了关键挑战（实际部署有限、可解释性需求、标准化基准和开放数据稀缺），并提出了面向ML就绪电力网格基准的结构化需求目录，呼吁社区优先开展基准研究并开放数据集和模型。
AI.motivation: 现代电力系统因可再生能源整合、去中心化以及跨时间尺度实时决策需求而面临日益复杂的运行挑战。传统基于模型的方法虽然精确但速度不足以满足运行需求，机器学习作为更快的数据驱动替代方案应运而生。由于电网拓扑在电力系统运行中具有核心作用，图机器学习自然成为纳入拓扑依赖作为归纳偏置的理想框架。然而该领域虽出版量快速增长，却缺乏标准化基准和开放数据集，导致结果难以复现，因此需要系统梳理并建立规范。
AI.method: 作者对GML与电力系统交叉领域近800篇论文进行了系统性综述，涵盖预测、状态估计、优化、控制、故障诊断和网络安全六大方向。文章分析了电力系统作为GML基准测试场景的独特优势（硬物理约束、多尺度动态、安全关键性、稀缺标注数据），并推导出一套面向ML就绪电力网格基准的结构化需求目录，用于指导未来数据集开发和提升跨研究的可复现性。
AI.result: 综述识别出该领域面临的关键挑战包括：实际部署案例有限、安全关键场景下需要可解释模型、标准化基准和开放数据集稀缺导致结果难以复现。文章提出了一个结构化的ML就绪电力网格基准需求目录，并呼吁社区优先开展专用基准研究、开放数据集与模型。
AI.conclusion: 电力系统构成GML异常丰富的基准测试环境，GML也能有效补充经典求解器，提供可扩展且拓扑感知的近似方案。但领域正处于快速扩张期，亟需通过标准化基准和开放数据来保障长期科学可信度。作者呼吁社区协作，优先发布开放数据集、模型和基准研究，以推动该交叉领域的健康发展。

title: Agentic Data Cleaning Without a Clean Reference: An Experimental Study of Capabilities and Trade-offs
comment: 21 pages, 3 figures, Submitted to New Generation Computing
summary: Data cleaning without a trusted clean reference is challenging because unusual values may represent either genuine errors or valid observations. This paper studies how different agent capabilities affect reference-free data cleaning and proposes an evidence-grounded framework that combines structured context, profiling, LLM reasoning, executable checks, controlled evidence retrieval, source ranking, citation alignment, conservative repair, reversible scripts, and provenance logging. Seven configurations are evaluated across financial, clinical, and environmental-monitoring datasets using controlled synthetic corruption and original-data descriptive analysis, resulting in 126 completed runs. The evaluation includes two comparison baselines and a progressive LLM-based sequence that adds executable tools, evidence retrieval, evidence controls, and conservative repair. In the synthetic evaluation, the deterministic profiling baseline achieved the highest detection F1-score of 0.561. Among the LLM-based configurations, the full conservative configuration achieved the highest F1-score of 0.421, but no configuration performed best across all evaluation criteria.
