A review of 56 methodological and empirical sources identifies 16 complementary measurement directions spanning resources, inference budgets, reliability, agentic work, safety, human preference, field outcomes, and forecast backtesting. No direction supplies a replacement scalar. The result is not that frontier AI forecasting is impossible, but that a defensible dated forecast is a claim about a versioned measurement system with explicit joins, protocols, links, and source dependence, not merely a fitted curve or calendar date.

AI.tldr: 本文对前沿AI定量预测的测量记录进行了审计，构建了一个冻结的、以事件为中心的记录（含62个系统、12个版本化基准、144个分级事件等），发现训练计算与METR任务时域之间的联合观测极少，基准更替造成对数尺度斜率高达1.206的"桥梁"断裂，且测量来源高度集中（73.2%来自单一测量项目）。结论是：有根据的日期化预测必须是对版本化测量系统的明确声明，而非单纯拟合曲线或日历日期。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI的定量预测常将日期目标与基准分数、训练计算、发布时间或专家信念的趋势相关联，但这一前提——公共测量记录能否支持这些关联——从未被系统审计。作者旨在检验这些趋势连接背后的测量证据是否可靠。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个冻结的、以事件为中心的审计样本（截至2026年8月12日），包含62个选定系统、12个版本化基准、7项能力或影响标准、144个分级事件、27个来源记录和408个类型化关系。通过分析训练计算与METR时域的联合观测覆盖率、基准更替的斜率对比（METR 1.0到1.1与MMLU到MMLU-Pro）、统计功效以及来源集中度，并综述56个方法学和实证来源，识别16个互补测量方向。
AI.result: 仅7个系统同时具有训练计算估计和METR 50%任务时域观测；19/27个封闭系统中缺少训练计算数据（包括2026年所有选定的封闭发布）；35个开放权重系统中无一个具有METR时域观测。METR Time Horizon 1.0到1.1的七系统链接对数尺度斜率为1.206（95%CI 1.021-1.390），而MMLU到MMLU-Pro的六系统比较在logit和probit链接下呈平移状但在线性/对数链接下并非如此。桥梁仅有约80%的功效来检测接近25%的斜率偏离。52/71个实质性定量事件（73.2%）来自单一测量项目，76.1%为实验室发布。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论并非前沿AI预测不可行，而是：有充分依据的日期化预测本质上是对版本化测量系统的一种声明——必须明确其连接（joins）、协议、链接和来源依赖性，而非简单地拟合一条曲线或在日历上标注一个日期。

title: QuantumPhaseNet: A Gauge-Covariant Geometric and Quantum-Spectral Theory of Semantic Concept Hierarchies with Prototype Validation of a Classical Quantum-Inspired Model
comment: [PAGES] pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Extends arXiv:2602.14419 (WavePhaseNet). Includes prototype validation with an offline Validation Studio; RQ5 reports a negative result for quantum advantage
summary: We present QuantumPhaseNet, a gauge-covariant geometric and quantum-spectral extension of Transformer representations. Context-dependent semantic states are modeled as complex amplitudes; a covariant phase rate induces a semantic wavelength used as a proxy for conceptual scale; and low-frequency graph modes define a document-level discourse direction. The theoretical part establishes local gauge invariance, unitarity of the quantum block, boundedness and conditional stability of WavePhase Attention, and a calibratable hallucination-risk formulation. We also implemented a fully offline Validation Studio for the classical quantum-inspired pipeline in Section 14.1 and evaluated the five research questions in Section 16.1 on its built-in synthetic setting (n=240, observation noise 0.22, circuit noise 0.08, five seeds). RQ1 yielded a wavelength-hierarchy Spearman correlation of 0.852 versus 0.707 for the baseline, 87.3% direction accuracy, and AUC 0.953. RQ2 achieved discourse alignment 0.933 versus 0.589 and 41.2 versus 16.2 paragraphs before drift. RQ3 achieved AUROC 0.881 versus cosine 0.765 and phase-shuffle 0.536. RQ4 achieved error-detection AUROC 0.854 versus entropy 0.634, with Brier 0.150 and ECE 0.098. RQ5 did not show quantum advantage: target probability and end-to-end cost efficiency were 25.5% and 0.107, compared with 70.7% and 0.707 for the Chebyshev classical approximation. These results provide initial synthetic evidence for the classical quantum-inspired components, but not external validity or unconditional quantum speedup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QuantumPhaseNet，一种规范协变的几何与量子谱Transformer扩展。它将语义状态建模为复振幅，利用协变相位率导出语义波长作为概念尺度代理，并通过低频图模态定义文档级话语方向。理论上建立了局部规范不变性、量子块幺正性、WavePhase Attention的有界性与条件稳定性，以及可校准的幻觉风险公式。在离线Validation Studio合成环境（n=240）上对五个研究问题进行评估：RQ1-RQ4在波长层级、话语对齐、幻觉检测和错误检测上均优于基线；但RQ5显示量子优势不成立，目标概率与端到端成本效率远低于Chebyshev经典近似。
AI.motivation: 探索Transformer表示是否可通过量子几何与量子谱理论进行扩展，以建模更深层的语义结构（如概念尺度、话语方向、幻觉风险），并验证"量子启发的经典计算"能否在若干任务上超越现有基线，同时诚实地检验量子优势是否存在。
AI.method: 提出QuantumPhaseNet架构：以复振幅建模上下文相关语义状态；引入规范协变相位率推导语义波长作为概念尺度；使用低频图模态建立文档级话语方向。理论上证明局部规范不变性、量子块幺正性、WavePhase Attention的有界性和条件稳定性，并提出可校准的幻觉风险公式。实现离线Validation Studio，在合成设置下完成经典量子启发管线（Section 14.1）和五个研究问题的评估（Section 16.1）。
AI.result: RQ1：波长层级Spearman相关0.852（基线0.707），方向准确率87.3%，AUC 0.953；RQ2：话语对齐0.933对0.589，漂移前段落41.2对16.2；RQ3：AUROC 0.881对cosine 0.765和phase-shuffle 0.536；RQ4：错误检测AUROC 0.854对熵0.634，Brier 0.150，ECE 0.098；RQ5：量子优势不成立——目标概率25.5%对70.7%，端到端成本效率0.107对0.707（Chebyshev经典近似）。
AI.conclusion: 经典量子启发组件在合成数据上取得初步积极证据（RQ1-RQ4），但缺乏外部效度，且RQ5未显示量子优势——量子方案在目标概率与成本效率上均逊于Chebyshev经典近似，表明不应无条件宣称量子加速。

title: LLMs Can Predict Failure Risk, But Struggle to Predict Which Collaboration Protocol Pays Off: Cost-Aware Protocol Routing Across Reasoning Tasks
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures; includes appendices and ancillary aggregate-result CSV files
summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can improve reasoning by spending more computation, but deployment requires deciding when extra collaboration is worth its cost. We isolate this decision by running every problem under four protocols while holding the solver fixed within each setting: direct solving (Baseline), iterative self-correction (Single), planner-executor-reviewer collaboration (PER), and multi-agent deliberation (Broadcast). The primary benchmark comprises 4,181 competition-level math problems; paired robustness checks cover four benchmarks spanning competition math, biology, and broader science with two solver families. Across fixed policies, trained routers, and frozen LLM routers, conservative policies under-escalate, whereas higher-solve frozen routers often over-escalate. A post-answer, pre-collaboration gpt-oss-120b probe ranks Baseline failures with 0.8847 AUROC (4,151 parseable cases; 95% CI [0.8732, 0.8955]). The same score remains informative for predicting whether any collaboration helps (0.7683 AUPRC), but is much weaker for identifying PER- or Broadcast-specific value (0.1674 and 0.1041 AUPRC). Separately, the pre-answer self-confidence gate reaches 78.0% solve at 45K tokens, compared with 73.8% at 71.3K for a frozen gpt-oss-120b router and 92.4% for a retrospective fixed-order oracle. Across 10 paired model-condition settings, the oracle adds 23.2-58.3 points of retrospective coverage over Baseline, but protocol profiles vary by task. In the six settings with held-out router evaluations, oracle gaps remain 18.5-28.9 points. Confidence can therefore support initial escalation, while protocol-specific cost-aware routing remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了多智能体LLM系统中协作协议（直接求解、迭代自校正、规划者-执行者-评审者协作、多智能体讨论）的推理成本与收益权衡，发现保守策略升级不足，而高正确率路由器过度升级。通过gpt-oss-120b探针在回答后、协作前阶段实现0.8847 AUROC的失败预测，但预测特定协议价值的能力较弱。自我置信度门控在45K token下达到78.0%正确率，优于冻结路由器（73.8%），但与92.4%的理想oracle相比仍有差距。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统可以通过增加计算量提升推理能力，但部署时需要决定何时额外的协作值得其成本。现有的路由器方法难以在保守（欠升级）和激进（过度升级）之间取得良好平衡，需要更好地理解何时应该进行协作升级。
AI.method: 采用四种协议（Baseline、Single、PER、Broadcast）固定求解器运行每个问题，主基准包含4,181道竞赛数学题，并用四个基准、两个求解器家族进行稳健性检验。评估固定策略、训练路由器、冻结LLM路由器，并引入gpt-oss-120b探针在回答后协作前预测失败，以及自置信度门控方法。
AI.result: gpt-oss-120b探针在预测Baseline失败上达到0.8847 AUROC，预测任何协作是否有帮助为0.7683 AUPRC，但预测PER或Broadcast特定价值较弱（0.1674和0.1041 AUPRC）。自置信度门控在45K token下实现78.0%正确率，优于冻结路由器（73.8% at 71.3K），但低于oracle的92.4%。oracle在不同设置间提供23.2-58.3点的回顾性提升，在六个held-out评估中仍有18.5-28.9点的差距。
AI.conclusion: 置信度信号可以支持初始的协作升级决策，但协议特定的成本感知路由仍然是未解问题。现有方法在判断协作是否值得以及选择哪种协议上仍有显著局限。

title: A Cognitively Motivated Multidimensional Framework for Evaluating Metaphor Explanations
comment: Preprint of paper accepted at INLG 2026
summary: Current evaluation of metaphor explanations relies mainly on holistic quality ratings, revealing little about how explanation quality is structured or where human judgments agree and diverge. We introduce a cognitively motivated framework that decomposes metaphor explanation quality into six theoretically grounded dimensions. In a dense annotation study (11,200 ratings), we find that: {\bfseries(i)} explanation quality is genuinely multidimensional; {\bfseries(ii)} annotator disagreement is systematic rather than random; and {\bfseries(iii)} the six dimensions collapse into a shared cluster and two independent axes of judgment. An exploratory feasibility study further shows that a standard automatic evaluation pipeline can recover parts of this structure, predicting the most discriminative dimensions well while its errors correlate human (dis)agreement. Together, these results suggest that multidimensional evaluation offers richer diagnostic insight than holistic ratings, and that automatic evaluators for open-ended generation tasks should be judged on how well they preserve the structure of human judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个认知驱动的框架，将隐喻解释质量分解为六个理论维度，通过密集标注研究（11,200个评分）发现解释质量是多维的，标注者分歧是系统性的而非随机的，并且六个维度可归为一个共享簇和两个独立判断轴。初步可行性研究表明标准自动评估流程能恢复部分结构，预测最具区分性的维度表现良好，其错误与人类（不）一致性相关。
AI.motivation: 当前隐喻解释评估主要依赖整体质量评分，无法揭示解释质量的结构或人类判断的一致性/分歧模式。本文旨在弥补这一缺陷，提出更细粒度的多维评估框架。
AI.method: 提出六维度隐喻解释质量分解框架；进行密集人工标注研究（11,200个评分）；通过统计方法分析维度结构与标注者分歧模式；开展探索性可行性研究，测试标准自动评估流程能否恢复人类判断的结构。
AI.result: 研究发现：解释质量确实具有多维度性；标注者分歧是系统性的而非随机的；六个维度可归纳为一个共享簇加两个独立判断轴。自动评估器能较好预测最具区分性的维度，其错误模式与人类分歧相关。
AI.conclusion: 多维评估比整体评分能提供更丰富的诊断性见解；对开放生成任务的自动评估器，应以其保留人类判断结构的能力来评判，而非仅看整体评分。

title: Is Grokking a Loss of Normal Hyperbolicity of the Interpolation Manifold?
summary: A recent line of work recasts the post-memorization phase of grokking as constrained optimization: once a network interpolates the training set, weight decay drives a slow drift along the zero-loss manifold toward lower norm. In the language of dynamical systems, this is a fast-slow system in which the interpolation manifold plays the role of a slow manifold. We ask a question that this framing makes natural but the existing literature does not address: is the sharp generalization transition a loss of normal hyperbolicity of that manifold: a fold- or bifurcation-like event in which a normal restoring direction goes flat? Or does the manifold stay uniformly attracting while generalization happens by smooth drift? We propose a simple, optimizer-agnostic diagnostic: the smallest nonzero singular value $σ_{\min}^{+}(\mathbf J)$ of the residual Jacobian, which, for the squared loss, equals the slowest normal restoring rate of the manifold. On a two-layer ReLU network trained to grok modular addition under squared loss, $σ_{\min}^{+}(\mathbf J)$ does not collapse at the transition; it is near zero only before memorization and attains its largest values during the transition. The result holds across five seeds, and the six smallest singular values behave identically; there is no subspace-local collapse either. This is preliminary evidence against the bifurcation hypothesis and in favor of the smooth-contraction picture. We are explicit that a single-setting, gradual-transition experiment under Adam optimizer does not prove the absence of a bifurcation; it constrains where one could hide.

AI.tldr: 本文研究grokking现象中泛化突变的机制，通过残差Jacobian的最小非零奇异值σ_min+(J)作为诊断工具，在模加法任务的两层ReLU网络上测试了一个关键问题：泛化转变是流形正常双曲性丧失（分岔事件）还是光滑收缩过程。实验结果表明σ_min+(J)在转变时并未坍缩，反而达到最大值，初步反对分岔假说，支持平滑收缩图景。
AI.motivation: 现有文献将grokking的记忆后阶段视为约束优化问题（权重衰减驱动零损失流形上的低范数漂移），但尚未回答一个自然的问题：急剧的泛化转变究竟是慢流形正常双曲性丧失（折叠或分岔事件）导致的，还是流形保持均匀吸引而泛化通过平滑漂移发生？回答这一问题有助于理解grokking的根本机制。
AI.method: 提出一个与优化器无关的诊断指标：残差Jacobian的最小非零奇异值σ_min+(J)，在平方损失下该值等于流形最慢的法向恢复速率。在两层的ReLU网络（平方损失下训练模加法grokking）上，追踪该指标在训练全程的变化，并检验六个最小奇异值的表现以排除子空间局部坍缩。
AI.result: 在五个随机种子下，σ_min+(J)在泛化转变时并未坍缩；它仅在记忆化之前接近零，在转变过程中达到最大。六个最小奇异值行为一致，不存在子空间局部坍缩。
AI.conclusion: 该结果初步反对分岔假说，支持平滑收缩（smooth-contraction）图景。作者明确承认单设置、Adam优化器、渐变式转变的实验不能证明分岔不存在，只是约束了分岔可能隐藏的位置。

title: Small Models Scout Bottleneck Order for Large-Model Data Control
comment: Submitted to AAAI 2027
summary: Small proxy models are commonly used to identify data mixtures for larger-scale training. We ask whether their training trajectories reveal another transferable structure: the order in which larger models should resolve skill bottlenecks. We formulate first-passage skill training, where each monitored skill has a target floor and the objective is to minimize the tokens required to reach all floors. We introduce LogFloor, a closed-loop controller that directs each round toward current bottlenecks, producing phase-ordered resolution trajectories. Across five bAbI skill slices on Qwen2.5-1.5B, LogFloor reduces token cost by 56.2% on average. In 70M-to-12B transfer, three-round replay of a 70M scout path reaches every floor in all eight target runs, saving 30.9% by pair mean, 39.4% in pooled training tokens, and 37.6% under source-cost accounting. On MMLU-control, a frozen scout path succeeds across all eight 12B runs. Collapsing a path to its static marginal mixture or reversing its phase order removes most benefits, while bottleneck labels alone remain partially useful. These results identify phase-ordered bottleneck resolution as a transferable curriculum structure for monitored skill-targeted training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首达技能训练（first-passage skill training）框架，并引入LogFloor闭环控制器，利用小代理模型（如70M）的训练轨迹来指导大规模模型（如12B）的技能瓶颈解决顺序。实验表明该方法在bAbI技能切片上将token成本平均降低56.2%，在70M到12B的迁移中将训练token节省约30-39%。
AI.motivation: 小型代理模型常用于识别大规模训练的数据混合，但作者探索其训练轨迹是否还能揭示另一种可迁移的结构——大规模模型应该按何种顺序解决技能瓶颈。目标是找到更高效的课程学习顺序，而非仅仅静态的数据分配。
AI.method: 1) 形式化首达技能训练问题：每个被监控技能有目标下限，目标是最小化达到所有下限所需的token数。2) 提出LogFloor闭环控制器，每轮将训练引导至当前瓶颈技能，产生相位有序的解决轨迹。3) 通过小模型（70M scout）的先导轨迹，将相位顺序迁移到大规模模型（12B）训练中。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B上的五个bAbI技能切片中，LogFloor平均降低token成本56.2%。在70M到12B迁移中，三轮回放70M先导路径在所有八个目标运行中均达到所有技能下限，按配对均值节省30.9%，按池化训练token节省39.4%，按源成本核算节省37.6%。在MMLU-control上，冻结的先导路径在全部八个12B运行中成功。将路径坍缩为静态边际混合或反转相位顺序会移除大部分收益，而仅保留瓶颈标签仍部分有用。
AI.conclusion: 相位有序的瓶颈解决是一种可迁移的课程结构，可用于监控技能目标训练。这种"先解决瓶颈"的顺序结构比单纯的静态数据混合更有价值，且顺序本身（而非单一混合比例）是关键的可迁移信息。

title: MicroVerse: An Instrument for Measuring Self-Authored Identity Drift in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Language-Model Simulations
summary: Long-horizon, multi-agent language model (LM) simulations are widely proposed for studying social behavior, yet instruments to measure whether persona-conditioned agents maintain identity fidelity under sustained pressure are lacking. We present MicroVerse, a behavioral-science instrument that measures identity drift in generative agents. Agents carry an immutable "soul file" (core values, moral boundaries, personality, goals) and inhabit a resource-scarce 50 x 50 environment where water is a non-respawning survival constraint. Scarcity is operationalized via a per-tick existence-cost gradient. The eight-verb action space maps directly to moral boundaries (trade, talk, attack, scavenge). Using a three-layer memory architecture, agents periodically revise a mutable current identity against their immutable original soul via importance-triggered reflection. To mitigate survivor bias, MicroVerse decouples measurement from behavior using uniform longitudinal engine snapshots every N ticks alongside a forced-end snapshot of all living and dead agents. Identity drift is scored offline using a paraphrase-aware, value-anchored, multi-register diff rather than raw cosine similarity. We evaluate the instrument via a controlled seed run (n = 25) and a reflection-threshold sweep (thresholds {40, 80, 150}) to determine if drift dynamics are gate artifacts or threshold-robust properties. We report two primary findings: (1) Anti-self-deception emerges unprompted as the single largest semantic category of identity modification (27 of 111 added boundaries, 24%). (2) The system is threshold-robust; lower gates accelerate and increase revision frequency but preserve drift direction. All empirical results are strictly preliminary existence proofs and effect shapes (one model, one seed per arm, n = 25) rather than statistical significance claims.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MicroVerse，一个用于测量生成式智能体身份漂移的行为科学仪器。智能体携带不可变的"灵魂文件"并在资源稀缺环境中生存，通过三层记忆架构和重要性触发的反思机制来周期性修订当前身份。研究发现反自我欺骗是最大的身份修改类别，且系统对反思阈值具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 长时程、多智能体语言模型模拟被广泛用于研究社会行为，但缺乏衡量人格条件化智能体在持续压力下能否保持身份保真度的工具。现有方法无法系统测量身份漂移现象。
AI.method: MicroVerse包含：(1)不可变的"灵魂文件"编码核心价值、道德边界、人格和目标；(2)50x50资源稀缺环境，水是不可再生的生存约束，通过每tick存在成本梯度实现稀缺性；(3)八动词动作空间直接映射到道德边界；(4)三层记忆架构，通过重要性触发的反思定期修订可变当前身份；(5)通过统一纵向快照和强制结束快照减轻幸存者偏差；(6)使用释义感知、价值锚定、多语域diff进行离线身份漂移评分。
AI.result: 两个主要发现：(1)反自我欺骗自发涌现为身份修改的最大语义类别（27/111条新增边界，占24%）；(2)系统对反思阈值具有鲁棒性——较低阈值加速并增加修订频率，但保持漂移方向不变。所有结果仅为初步存在性证明。
AI.conclusion: MicroVerse为测量LM智能体在压力环境中的身份漂移提供了系统性仪器。研究结果是初步的存在性证明，而非统计学显著性声明，未来需要更多模型、种子和更大样本量来验证。

title: Disentangling Homophily and Rarity: Explaining Failure in Graph Neural Networks
comment: 9 pages of main text, 33 pages total, 11 figures, 17 tables
summary: Are heterophilic nodes in a graph harder to classify because they are heterophilic or because they are rare? Some existing work frames classification of such nodes as a subgroup generalisation problem, where a model performs well on the majority group at the expense of the rare group. Others explain this as a problem of neighbourhood aggregation in graph neural networks (GNNs). We assess these two viewpoints through a detailed evaluation of six GNNs on five datasets of varying homophily, and find that homophilic nodes tend to be easier to classify, even when they are rare---challenging the subgroup framing. However, our findings also nuance existing beliefs about how GNNs misrepresent heterophilic nodes. We demonstrate that the information needed to classify heterophilic nodes correctly is often recoverable by retraining the classification head of a model, or even just the final linear classification layer.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性评估六种GNN在五个不同同质性数据集上的表现，探讨异嗜性节点分类困难的根本原因。研究发现同嗜性节点即使稀有也更容易分类，挑战了子群体泛化框架；同时发现分类异嗜性节点所需的信息往往可以通过重训分类头或仅重训最后一层线性分类层来恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对异嗜性节点分类困难的原因存在两种对立解释：一种归因于子群体泛化问题（多数群体表现好而牺牲稀有群体），另一种归因于GNN的邻域聚合机制导致的信息表征问题。作者希望通过系统评估来厘清这两种观点的适用性。
AI.method: 对六种GNN模型在五个不同同质性水平的数据集上进行详细评估，对比同嗜性与异嗜性节点的分类表现，并测试通过重训分类头或仅重训最终线性分类层来验证信息可恢复性。
AI.result: 发现同嗜性节点即使在稀有情况下也更容易分类，这与子群体泛化框架的预期不符；但同时也发现异嗜性节点分类所需信息往往可以从模型中重训分类头来恢复，说明问题并非不可修复的信息丢失。
AI.conclusion: 异嗜性节点分类困难的根源既非简单的稀有性子群体问题，也非邻域聚合导致的不可逆信息丢失，而是介于两者之间——模型表征中可能保留着足够信息，但需要调整分类方式来充分利用。

title: When Less Is Enough: Context Selection and Prompting Strategies for Bengali News Headline Generation
comment: 11 pages
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in text generation tasks, yet their effectiveness on headline generation remains sensitive to how input context is selected and presented. In this work, we investigate Bengali news headline generation as a document-level generation task that requires effective selection and presentation of salient contextual information from long-form articles. Using Gemini-2.0-Flash, Llama-3.3-70B, and GPT-4o, we systematically study the effects of context selection, prompting strategies, and in-context learning (i.e., few-shot) on the quality of headline generation. Our experiments show that providing the full article does not necessarily improve performance; instead, using selected lead paragraphs of the article can maintain, and in some cases improve, headline generation quality. We further compare Bengali Native Prompting (BNaP) and Cross-Lingual Prompting (XLP), and examine how each interacts with context-enriched prompt templates incorporating auxiliary contextual cues. Results demonstrate that prompting strategies substantially influence generation quality: XLP often yields stronger performance, particularly when combined with contextual enrichment, but its benefits are model-dependent. Additionally, few-shot prompting substantially improves Gemini, with most of the gain obtained from a single demonstration, whereas Llama shows limited benefit from additional examples. Overall, our findings highlight that effective Bengali news headline generation depends more on context relevance and prompt design than on increasing input length, offering practical insights for multilingual and low-resource LLM applications.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了孟加拉语新闻标题生成任务，发现相比提供全文，选择文章的主要段落作为上下文反而能维持甚至提升生成质量；同时提示策略（尤其是跨语言提示XLP与上下文增强模板的结合）比增加输入长度更能影响生成效果，且少样本提示对Gemini收益显著但对Llama作用有限。
AI.motivation: 虽然大语言模型在文本生成任务上表现强劲，但标题生成的效果对输入上下文的选择和呈现方式非常敏感。现有研究缺乏对孟加拉语这类低资源语言的新闻标题生成中，上下文选择、提示策略与上下文学习之间交互作用的系统探讨。
AI.method: 使用Gemini-2.0-Flash、Llama-3.3-70B和GPT-4o三个模型，对孟加拉语长篇新闻文章进行系统实验，比较（1）全文vs.选择性段落作为上下文的差异；（2）孟加拉语原生提示（BNaP）与跨语言提示（XLP）的对比；（3）上下文增强提示模板的作用；（4）少样本（in-context learning）学习的影响。
AI.result: 实验发现：提供全文并不一定提升性能，使用选定的文章导语段落可以维持甚至改善标题生成质量；XLP在结合上下文增强时往往表现更强，但收益因模型而异；少样本提示显著提升Gemini（单个示例即可获得大部分收益），但对Llama的额外示例帮助有限。
AI.conclusion: 孟加拉语新闻标题生成的质量更依赖于上下文的相关性和提示设计，而非增加输入长度。该发现为多语言和低资源场景下的LLM应用提供了实用见解。

title: M-LINKX: Multiview Graph Learning for Brain Cognitive Disease Detection
comment: Accepted at the 25th IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2026). 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: Electroencephalogram (EEG) is a non-invasive and relatively low-cost procedure that measures brain electricity for the detection of cognitive diseases. EEG-based classification of dementia-related conditions, including Alzheimer's disease (AD), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and frontotemporal dementia (FTD), remains challenging because EEG signals are noisy, non-stationary, and vary across subjects. Segment-based learning provides a practical way to model long EEG recordings by converting them into fixed-length inputs. For each segment, discriminative information may be explored by using signals within each channel (i.e. electrode), as well as interactions between EEG channels. In this paper, we propose M-LINKX, a multi-view graph learning framework for EEG-based dementia classification. For each segment, we extract channel-level node features and construct multiple functional-connectivity (FC) graph views, where each view is defined by a specific combination of connectivity metric, frequency band, and topology filter, respectively. Instead of relying on message passing over the constructed graphs, M-LINKX follows a simple design in modeling node features and adjacency-based connectivity representations. The graph-view representations are fused using global trainable view weights, and subject-level prediction is obtained by averaging segment-level probabilities. Experiments on two three-class EEG datasets with different diagnostic groups, CAUEEG (HC/MCI/Dementia) and AHEAP (HC/AD/FTD), show that M-LINKX achieves the best subject-level performance under the main experimental settings. Our study suggests that multi-view functional connectivity can improve EEG-based dementia classification when integrated with an appropriate graph-learning architecture. Code and data are available at https://github.com/anphantt/MLINKX.

AI.tldr: 本文提出M-LINKX，一种基于多视图图学习的EEG痴呆分类框架。它从每个EEG片段中提取通道级节点特征，构建多种功能连接（FC）图视图，每种视图由连接度量、频段和拓扑滤波器的特定组合定义。模型采用简单设计直接建模节点特征和邻接表示，而非传统消息传递，并通过全局可训练视图权重融合多视图表示，最终通过平均片段级概率获得受试者级预测。在CAUEEG和AHEAP两个三分类EEG数据集上取得最佳受试者级性能。
AI.motivation: EEG信号具有噪声大、非平稳、跨受试者差异大的特点，基于EEG的痴呆相关疾病（AD、MCI、FTD）分类仍然具有挑战性。现有方法在利用通道内信号信息和通道间交互方面存在不足，需要更有效的建模方式来充分利用EEG中的判别信息。
AI.method: M-LINKX框架包含以下关键步骤：(1) 对每个EEG片段提取通道级节点特征；(2) 构建多视图功能连接图，每个视图由连接度量、频段和拓扑滤波器组合定义；(3) 采用类似LINKX的简单设计直接建模节点特征和邻接矩阵表示，而非基于消息传递的GNN；(4) 使用全局可训练的视图权重融合图视图表示；(5) 通过平均片段级概率得到受试者级预测。
AI.result: 在两个三分类EEG数据集（CAUEEG: HC/MCI/Dementia 和 AHEAP: HC/AD/FTD）上，M-LINKX在主要实验设置下取得了最佳的受试者级分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，多视图功能连接与适当的图学习架构相结合，能够有效提升基于EEG的痴呆分类性能。多视图方式捕捉了EEG信号在不同连接度量、频段和拓扑下的互补信息，而简单直接的图表示学习架构相比复杂消息传递机制更为有效。

title: Skill Blocks: How Should an Agent Load Its Skill? A Caching-Correct Comparison of Pre-load, On-Demand Tool-Loading, Progressive Disclosure, and Hybrid
summary: Agent skills are often injected in full on every request, increasing token cost. We compare four content-preserving loading methods: Full, Skill Block, Reference, and Hybrid. Across SearchQA, SpreadsheetBench, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SynthProc, we measure token usage using raw input for single-turn tasks and cache-correct effective input for multi-turn tasks. Results show no universal winner. Hybrid reduces input by 27.4% on SearchQA and 39.8% on SpreadsheetBench. On large multi-turn skills, Skill Block and Hybrid achieve substantial reductions, reaching 62.5% and 52.8% on ScienceWorld and 73.0% and 66.6% on SynthProc. ALFWorld shows smaller gains because procedures are short and repeatedly needed. Paired outcome tests detect no quality differences, though they do not establish equivalence. Overall, conditional loading is most beneficial when large portions of a skill are not needed on every turn.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了四种内容保持型技能加载方法（Full、Skill Block、Reference、Hybrid）在五个基准测试中的token使用效率，发现没有通用最优方法，但条件加载（Hybrid）在技能中大部分内容非每轮必需时收益最大。
AI.motivation: Agent技能通常在每次请求时被完整注入，导致token成本高昂。作者希望探索更高效的技能加载方式，在保持内容完整性的前提下降低token消耗。
AI.method: 提出四种内容保持型加载方法：完整注入（Full）、技能块（Skill Block）、引用（Reference）和混合（Hybrid）。在SearchQA、SpreadsheetBench、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和SynthProc五个基准上，对单轮任务使用原始输入、多轮任务使用缓存校正的有效输入来衡量token使用量。
AI.result: 没有出现通用最优方法。Hybrid在SearchQA上减少27.4%输入，在SpreadsheetBench上减少39.8%。在大型多轮技能场景中，Skill Block和Hybrid分别大幅减少ScienceWorld 62.5%/52.8%及SynthProc 73.0%/66.6%的输入。ALFWorld因程序简短且反复需要而收益较小。配对结果测试未检测到质量差异，但未确立等价性。
AI.conclusion: 条件加载（conditional loading）在技能中有大部分内容并非每轮都需要时收益最显著，为Agent技能注入策略提供了实用的选择依据。

title: PLSQLBench: Benchmarking LLM Systems for Executable Procedural Database Programming
summary: We present PLSQLBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can write executable PL/SQL programs, with correctness measured through execution-based tests. Existing LLM evaluations largely target general-purpose code generation or declarative text-to-SQL, leaving procedural database programming underexplored. PLSQLBench contains 2,865 instances: 2,594 single-turn tasks and 271 multi-turn conversations spanning 978 turns. The benchmark combines complex schema-grounded tasks over enterprise-style Spider 2 databases, simpler schema-grounded tasks derived from Spider, and MBPP-derived procedural problems, covering varying levels of database grounding and procedural complexity. Experiments with eight LLMs reveal recurring difficulties in schema grounding, PL/SQL dialect fidelity, procedural control flow, exception handling, and cross-turn consistency. Tool-augmented LLM agents improve performance on several schema-grounded evaluations, although substantial gaps remain. These results highlight procedural database programming capabilities not directly assessed by conventional code generation or text-to-SQL benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/oracle-samples/plsqlbench.

AI.tldr: PLSQLBench 是首个评估 LLM 能否生成可执行 PL/SQL 程序的基准，包含 2,865 个实例（2,594 个单轮任务和 271 个多轮对话）。实验发现 LLM 在模式接地、PL/SQL 方言保真度、过程控制流、异常处理和跨轮一致性方面存在持续困难。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 评估主要聚焦通用代码生成或声明式 text-to-SQL，忽略了过程式数据库编程这一重要领域。需要一个专门的基准来评估 LLM 编写可执行 PL/SQL 程序的能力。
AI.method: 构建 PLSQLBench 基准，包含三种任务类型：基于企业风格 Spider 2 数据库的复杂模式接地任务、从 Spider 派生的简单模式接地任务、以及源自 MBPP 的过程式编程问题。通过执行测试来衡量正确性，并评估八个 LLM 的表现。
AI.result: 八个 LLM 的实验揭示了在模式接地、PL/SQL 方言保真度、过程控制流、异常处理和跨轮一致性方面的困难。工具增强的 LLM 代理在多个模式接地评估上提升了性能，但仍存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: PL/SQL 过程式数据库编程能力是传统代码生成或 text-to-SQL 基准无法直接评估的，PLSQLBench 填补了这一空白，为更全面地评估 LLM 的数据库编程能力提供了基础。

title: Can Neural Networks Learn by Experimenting on Themselves? Self-Interventional Learning from Functional Consequences to Predictive Self-Knowledge
comment: 37 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research (JMLR)
summary: Machine-learning systems usually model external data, while their internal functional organization is analyzed by external observers. This work introduces Self-Interventional Learning (SIL), in which a neural system perturbs its own functional structure, observes consequences, learns a predictive self-model, generalizes to unexecuted interventions, and uses predictions to guide later structural action. In a construction-known synthetic system, SIL recovered critical structure, redundancy, and replaceability, while synergy was not reliably recovered. Across 30 fresh confirmatory seeds, increasing the pairwise intervention budget from 4 to 56 reduced held-out prediction error from 0.0335 to 0.0148 and increased Spearman correlation from 0.629 to 0.883. In a matched ablation, preserving the correct intervention--consequence mapping reduced prospective prediction error by 81.3%, while using the same learned self-model for action reduced normalized regret by 31.7% relative to ignoring it. However, model-guided action did not significantly outperform a direct empirical-memory policy, and powered CIFAR-10/ResNet validation showed no robustness advantage over equal-budget direct repair search. These results support SIL as an intervention-driven framework for learning predictive knowledge about a network's own functional organization, while showing that the self-model remains incomplete and is not universally superior to simpler direct strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自干预学习（SIL）框架，让神经网络通过扰动自身功能结构、观察结果、学习预测性自模型，并利用该模型指导后续结构操作。实验表明SIL能恢复关键结构信息，但在动作引导上并未全面优于简单直接策略。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习系统只建模外部数据，其内部功能组织由外部观察者分析。本文希望让系统自身通过干预自身结构来学习关于自身功能组织的预测性知识，实现"自我建模"而非依赖外部分析。
AI.method: SIL包含四个阶段：1）扰动自身功能结构；2）观察扰动后果；3）学习预测性自模型（泛化到未执行干预）；4）利用预测指导后续结构动作。在合成系统中验证结构恢复能力，并通过消融实验和CIFAR-10/ResNet验证进行对比评估。
AI.result: SIL成功恢复关键结构、冗余性和可替换性，但未能可靠恢复协同性。增加成对干预预算（4到56）降低预测误差（0.0335至0.0148）并提升Spearman相关性（0.629至0.883）。保留正确的干预-后果映射使前瞻预测误差降低81.3%，使用自模型指导动作降低31.7%归一化遗憾。但模型引导动作未显著优于直接经验记忆策略，CIFAR-10/ResNet验证也无鲁棒性优势。
AI.conclusion: SIL是干预驱动的学习框架，能学习关于网络自身功能组织的预测性知识，但自模型仍不完整，且并非普遍优于更简单的直接策略。

title: Trust Is Not Enough: Influence Calibration for On-Policy Self-Distillation in Agentic RL
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) gives language agents dense token-level supervision from a privileged self-teacher on the policy's own trajectories. Existing methods allocate this supervision mainly by teacher trust, but trust does not reveal whether emphasizing a token supports the current policy objective. We call this the trust-utility mismatch and introduce Influence Calibration for Self-Distillation (ICSD). For each supervised token, ICSD measures the first-order response of its importance-weighted RL surrogate contribution to a teacher-directed output perturbation. Batch-adaptive calibration converts this non-stationary signal into a bounded allocation weight while preserving the original auxiliary-loss mass within each action turn. These detached weights affect only the distillation loss and require no additional model pass. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA, ICSD improves all matched aggregate metrics over trust-only allocation under Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO), across two model families spanning 1.5B to 7B. At 7B, it reaches 96.1% ALFWorld success and a WebShop score of 93.1. Frozen-batch analyses show that ICSD reduces teacher-supported mass assigned to objective-opposed tokens from 60.1% to 37.8% and raises cosine compatibility with the RL gradient by 0.192. A companion repository is avail- able at https://github.com/lanqz7766/Influence-Calibration-for-On-Policy-Self-Distillation-in-Agentic-RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出影响校准自蒸馏（ICSD）方法，解决on-policy自蒸馏中"信任-效用不匹配"问题。传统方法仅依据教师信任度分配监督权重，但信任度并不能反映强调某个token是否真正支持当前策略目标。ICSD通过测量每个token的重要性加权RL替代贡献对教师方向输出扰动的一阶响应，再通过批自适应校准转换为有界分配权重，在不增加模型前向计算的前提下实现更优的监督分配。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏方法按教师信任度分配token级监督，但信任度高并不等于该token对当前策略优化有帮助，存在信任-效用不匹配问题。这会导致监督信号可能引导策略偏离RL优化目标，需要一种能直接反映token对策略目标贡献的分配机制。
AI.method: ICSD对每个受监督token测量其重要性加权RL替代贡献对教师方向输出扰动的一阶响应（即影响校准信号），然后通过批自适应校准将该非平稳信号转换为有界分配权重，同时保持每个动作回合内原始辅助损失的总量不变。这些解耦的权重只影响蒸馏损失，不需要额外的模型前向计算。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和Search-QA三个基准上，ICSD在GRPO和GiGPO两种优化器下、覆盖1.5B到7B的两个模型家族中，所有匹配的聚合指标均优于纯信任分配。在7B规模下达到ALFWorld 96.1%成功率、WebShop 93.1分。冻结批次分析显示，ICSD将分配给与目标相反token的教师支持质量从60.1%降至37.8%，与RL梯度的余弦兼容性提升0.192。
AI.conclusion: ICSD通过引入影响校准机制解决了自蒸馏中信任-效用不匹配问题，在不增加计算开销的前提下显著提升了语言智能体的RL训练效果，证明了将监督分配与策略目标直接对齐的有效性。

title: Token Distribution versus Data Volume: Domain Balancing in Multi-Domain Meeting Summarisation
comment: Accepted at 19th International Natural Language Generation Conference (INLG 2026), Utrecht, Netherlands
summary: Jointly fine-tuning an LLM on meeting-summarisation corpora of widely varying size raises a question that prior work leaves confounded: when a domain-balanced training mixture helps, is the gain due to the distribution of tokens across domains, or merely to the volume of data seen? We disentangle these factors by constructing balanced and natural (native-proportional) token mixtures at matched token budgets (2-32M) over five English meeting corpora, fine-tuning Mistral-7B with QLoRA, and evaluating per domain. Balancing redistributes quality, improving the data-scarce minority domains at a low cost to the data-rich ones. The trade favours balancing whenever the minority domains matter: their share under proportional allocation is fixed at 1-2% regardless of budget, so matching balanced quality on those domains requires far more total data. We further find that pruning low-value transcript lines removes ~15% of tokens from the conversational corpora at no measurable cost, and that balancing by tokens is not the same as balancing by examples. A two-annotator study of 741 judge-labelled facts validates our fact-level evaluation. Together these results give practitioners a basis for deciding when to balance an imbalanced multi-domain mixture, and on what unit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在多领域会议摘要语料上联合微调LLM时，领域平衡的数据混合是否真的优于自然比例混合。通过在同一token预算（2-32M）下构建平衡和自然混合，解耦"token分布"与"数据量"两个混淆因素，发现平衡混合能提升数据稀缺领域的质量（代价是数据丰富领域的小幅下降），且只要少数领域重要，平衡就值得。此外还发现剪枝低价值转录行可节省约15% token且无性能损失，以及按token平衡与按示例平衡并不等价。
AI.motivation: 以往工作混淆了领域平衡混合带来的收益究竟来自token的领域分布，还是仅仅来自看到的数据总量。这一混淆使得实践者无法判断何时应该平衡多领域混合数据。
AI.method: 在五个英文会议语料上，以匹配的token预算（2-32M）构造平衡与自然（原生比例）两种混合方案，使用Mistral-7B+QLoRA进行微调，按领域分别评估；同时剪枝低价值转录行以节省token，并用两标注者741条事实级评估验证评测可靠性。
AI.result: 平衡混合重分配了质量：提升数据稀缺少数领域的性能，仅以数据丰富领域的小幅下降为代价。少数领域在自然比例下份额固定为1-2%，要达到平衡质量需大量额外数据。剪枝可移除约15% token而无可测损失。按token平衡与按示例平衡不同。
AI.conclusion: 当少数领域重要时，平衡多领域混合数据是值得的；剪枝是免费节省token的手段；实践者应以token而非示例为单位进行平衡。

title: Degeneracy Counting Quantum Algorithm using Decoherence
summary: Counting the global optima of a classical optimization problem is a #P-hard task. We develop the canonical thermal pure quantum (CTPQ) state-based degeneracy counting (CTPQsd#) algorithm that determines the number of global optima of a classical optimization problem P by measuring only a small probe S, without finding individual minima. The method exploits a perturbative relation between the decoherence measure of S and the degeneracy of P when S and P are together in a CTPQ state. We provide the first numerical demonstration that this relation can be used to count the global minima, applying it to problems encoded by diagonal random-energy Hamiltonians as a maximally unstructured testbed for classical binary optimization problems. Classical simulations of up to 20 problem qubits quantify the algorithm's sensitivity to variations in the temperature of the CTPQ state, the Hamiltonian energy range, the problem size, and degeneracy. We establish the temperature threshold for determining the exact degeneracy and identify a second, lower threshold that provides a temperature window to count near-degenerate minima within a user-defined energy tolerance. By confining measurement to S, the protocol replaces tomography over the exponentially large problem Hilbert space with tomography over a small probe represented by only four qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于正则热纯量子（CTPQ）态的简并度计数算法（CTPQsd#），通过仅测量一个小型探针S而非寻找个体最小值，来确定经典优化问题全局最优解的个数（这是一个#P-hard问题）。该方法利用S与P在CTPQ态中共同存在时，S的退相干度量与P的简并度之间的微扰关系。作者在由对角随机能量哈密顿量编码的问题上首次数值证明了该关系的可用性，模拟了多达20个问题量子比特，并建立了精确确定简并度的温度阈值以及可计数近简并最小值的第二低温阈值窗口。
AI.motivation: 计算经典优化问题全局最优解的个数是#P-hard问题，传统方法需要逐一寻找最小值，计算成本极高。作者希望通过量子方法，利用CTPQ态的微扰性质，仅通过测量小型探针即可高效确定全局最优解的简并度，从而避免对整个指数级问题希尔伯特空间进行层析。
AI.method: 1. 构建系统P与探针S共同处于CTPQ态。2. 利用S的退相干度量与P的全局简并度之间的微扰关系建立映射。3. 将测量限制在仅含四个量子比特的探针S上，通过对S的层析代替对整个问题空间的层析。4. 以对角随机能量哈密顿量编码的经典二元优化问题作为最大化无结构测试基准进行验证。5. 通过经典模拟（最多20个问题量子比特）系统研究算法对CTPQ态温度、哈密顿能量范围、问题规模和简并度的敏感性，确定温度阈值。
AI.result: 对多达20个问题量子比特的经典模拟表明，CTPQsd#算法能够有效计数全局最小值。作者建立了确定精确简并度的温度阈值，并发现了第二个较低阈值，在该阈值下存在一个温度窗口可对用户定义能量容差内的近简并最小值进行计数。测量仅需对四比特探针进行，避免了指数级希尔伯特空间的层析开销。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次数值证明了CTPQ态微扰关系可用于计数全局最小值，为#P-hard的简并度计数问题提供了一种可扩展的量子途径。通过巧妙地将问题空间与小型探针耦合，并在合适的温度窗口内进行测量，CTPQsd#算法在避免完整问题层析的同时实现了简并度（含近简并）的精确计数，为经典优化问题的统计分析提供了新工具。

title: RETRACE: Resilience-Guided Trait-Conditioned Craving Estimation from Wearable Physiology in Opioid Use Disorder
summary: Detecting opioid craving from wearable physiological signals is critical yet difficult, with the potential to support proactive interventions for individuals with opioid use disorder (OUD). This challenge is especially pronounced under subject-independent evaluation because craving is subjective, heterogeneous, and often physiologically entangled with stress. Our empirical analysis shows that stress elicits strong and reproducible autonomic responses, while craving-related signals are weaker, sparse, and largely embedded within stress-related physiology. We further show that psychological resilience, which shapes stress regulation and craving vulnerability, is not reliably observable from short-term wearable windows, but can be captured through reusable subject-level proxies, including post-stress heart-rate recovery and autobiographical memory recall.Motivated by these findings, we introduce RETRACE, a resilience-guided trait-conditioned framework for subject-independent craving estimation from wearable physiology. RETRACE reframes craving detection as trait-conditioned physiological interpretation: rather than assuming the same physiological pattern has the same meaning across individuals, it uses resilience-related subject context to guide inference. Technically, RETRACE introduces a novel dual-encoder design that separates generalizable stress physiology from subject-specific craving interpretation. It combines a frozen stress-pretrained encoder with a resilience-conditioned craving encoder, using feature-level gating and representation-level fusion to enable lightweight personalization without target-user craving labels or per-user retraining. We evaluate RETRACE on a novel multimodal OUD dataset containing wearable physiology, stress and craving annotations, and autobiographical narratives. Under LOSO setup, RETRACE achieves up to 7% absolute improvement over the strongest baseline

AI.tldr: 本文提出RETRACE框架，一种韧性引导的特质条件化框架，用于从可穿戴生理信号中进行主体无关的渴求（opioid craving）估计。该框架通过双编码器设计，将普适的压力生理学与主体特定的渴求解读分离，利用压力预训练编码器和韧性条件化渴求编码器，实现无需目标用户渴求标签的轻量级个性化。
AI.motivation: opioid craving的检测对OUD患者的主动干预至关重要，但在主体无关评估下极具挑战性，因为渴求具有主观性、异质性，且与压力生理信号纠缠。作者实证发现：压力诱发强且可复现的自主神经反应，而渴求相关信号弱、稀疏且嵌入压力生理中；心理韧性无法从短期可穿戴窗口可靠观测，但可通过可复用的主体级代理（如压力后心率恢复和自传体记忆回忆）捕获。
AI.method: RETRACE将渴求检测重构为特质条件化生理解读问题，采用新颖的双编码器设计：一个冻结的压力预训练编码器负责提取普适的压力生理特征，一个韧性条件化的渴求编码器负责主体特定的渴求解读。通过特征级门控和表示级融合实现轻量级个性化，无需目标用户的渴求标签或逐用户重训练。
AI.result: 在包含可穿戴生理、压力和渴求标注及自传体叙事的全新多模态OUD数据集上，采用LOSO（留一受试者）评估设置，RETRACE相比最强基线实现最高7%的绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，利用可复用的主体级韧性代理信息和特质条件化建模思路，可以有效改善主体无关的渴求检测性能，为OUD主动干预提供了新的技术路径。

title: Aborted but Not Forgotten: KV-Cache Retention Breaks Rollback Consistency in Language Agents
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables
summary: Stateful language agents assume a rejected branch can be taken back by clearing it from the application transcript. We show this breaks when the serving session retains key/value (KV) state across the logical abort: the model can continue attending to content the application believes it discarded. We formalize the missing guarantee as rollback consistency: a complete abort must restore the state the model attends, not just the transcript. The key failure is cross-layer: a correct logical rollback need not compose with retained inference state, and the gap can remain invisible to the application. To isolate cache effects from text effects, we introduce a same-token/different-cache audit that holds decision-step tokens identical while varying only whether the cached prefix is stale or rebuilt from committed state. Across seven open-weight families (3.8B-36B), retained KV alone flips a typed protected effect in 25 of 63 audited cells, while attacker tokens are absent from the served request in all 63; rebuilding the cache closes every cell. The channel reproduces in an end-to-end session application, on the default Hugging Face Transformers cache-reuse path, and under LangGraph time-travel, where verified logical rollback can still leave attended KV stale. Susceptibility varies across models, but the underlying attended-state integrity violation is structural. We rule out position and length confounds, generalize across protected effects, policy structures, and a cache-isolated Mixture-of-Experts model, and show that transaction-local cache restoration closes the channel without requiring a global cache flush. All headline results are deterministic and reproducible from released artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文发现语言代理的"回滚"机制存在安全缺陷：即使应用层从对话记录中清除被拒绝的分支，服务会话中保留的KV缓存仍会让模型继续"看到"本应被丢弃的内容。作者将这一缺失的保证形式化为"回滚一致性"，并通过引入"同token/不同缓存"审计方法，证明仅保留陈旧KV缓存就能翻转受保护类型的效果（63个被测单元中25个被翻转），而重建缓存可完全消除该通道。
AI.motivation: 有状态语言代理假设被拒绝的分支可以通过从应用转录中清除而回退，但这个假设在服务会话跨逻辑中止保留KV状态时被打破。作者希望获得一个形式化保证：完整的回滚必须恢复模型所注意到的状态，而不只是转录文本，否则会留下安全隐患。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"回滚一致性"概念；2) 引入"同token/不同缓存"审计方法，保持决策步骤token相同但仅变化缓存前缀为陈旧或重建；3) 在7个开源模型家族（3.8B-36B）上测试；4) 在端到端会话应用、Hugging Face Transformers默认缓存复用路径以及LangGraph time-travel场景中复现。
AI.result: 在63个审计单元中，仅保留KV缓存就翻转了25个受保护效果，且攻击token在全部63个单元中都不出现在服务请求里；重建缓存可关闭全部通道。跨层性质导致逻辑回滚与应用保留的推理状态不兼容，且该差距对应用不可见。
AI.conclusion: 模型对受审计状态完整性违规是结构性的，跨模型易感性有差异。事务局部缓存恢复即可关闭通道，无需全局缓存清空；所有结果确定性可复现。该工作揭示了有状态语言代理回滚机制中的根本性安全漏洞。

title: T-LLM Compiler: Trusted LLM-based Code Optimization and Verification Framework
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have opened opportunities to apply high-level code transformations to the field of code optimization, and it has since emerged as one of the most fundamental tasks for LLMs to perform; however, at present, LLMs struggle to apply wide-ranging code optimization tasks due to both the complexity of the code and the inability to independently verify the correctness of the transformations. In this paper, we present the Trusted LLM (T-LLM) Compiler, which proposes an advancement in compiler technology through a collaborative effort involving high-level LLM code transformations, traditional compilers, and verification tools. Experimental results reveal that it can significantly improve code correctness when tested on a set of PolyBench/C benchmarks. Our approach facilitates iterative code optimization efforts with verification strategies that enable corrective actions. Through this approach, T-LLM Compiler achieves code optimization accuracy of up to 83.3% and a speedup of up to 16.1\% on the PolyBench/C benchmarks, with the transformed code reaching an average of 26.7% speedup wrt standard baselines. Additionally, we release the project's source code to the open-source community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Trusted LLM (T-LLM) Compiler，通过结合大语言模型的高层代码变换、传统编译器和验证工具，实现可信的代码优化。在PolyBench/C基准测试上，该编译器显著提升了代码正确性，实现了高达83.3%的优化准确率和16.1%的加速比，平均加速比达到26.7%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在代码优化领域展现出潜力，但面临两大挑战：代码复杂度高导致LLM难以进行广泛优化，以及无法独立验证代码变换的正确性。现有方法缺乏有效的验证机制来确保优化后代码的正确性。
AI.method: 提出T-LLM Compiler框架，通过协作方式整合三个组件：1) 高层LLM代码变换，利用LLM对代码进行语义级别的优化变换；2) 传统编译器，执行底层的代码优化；3) 验证工具，用于验证变换的正确性。同时采用迭代优化策略，通过验证机制实现纠错功能，确保优化过程的安全性和正确性。
AI.result: 在PolyBench/C基准测试上，T-LLM Compiler实现了高达83.3%的代码优化准确率和16.1%的加速比，变换后的代码相对标准基线平均获得26.7%的加速提升。此外，项目源代码已开源至社区。
AI.conclusion: T-LLM Compiler证明了将LLM高层变换与传统编译器和形式化验证工具相结合的有效性，能够在保证代码正确性的前提下实现显著的性能优化，为LLM在编译器领域的应用提供了可信的解决方案。

title: The Null Token Knows: Reducing Message-Free Hallucination in ASR and NMT
comment: Submitted to the Thirty-Ninth AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI-27)
summary: Modern encoder-decoder systems can produce fluent text even when their input contains no recoverable message. We study this failure in ASR and NMT through the models' reserved null tokens, asking whether the score for ending generation already carries a usable abstention signal. Across speech recognizers and translation models, we audit native null-token scores and scalar logit shifts. In Whisper, we additionally probe decoder states and compare supervised row edits with conventional external gates. The evaluated models often expose a useful abstention signal, but stock decoding does not reliably act on it. Raising the null-token score can sharply suppress fabrication, but aggressive intervention also deletes valid speech or shortens legitimate translations. These findings turn the null token into a diagnostic lens on hallucination and motivate evaluating abstention methods by both suppression and deletion costs, rather than by hallucination reduction alone.

AI.tldr: 本文研究ASR和NMT系统中模型在没有可恢复信息时仍产生流畅文本的"幻觉"问题。通过分析模型保留的空token（null token）分数作为弃权（abstention）信号，发现该信号有用但标准解码不会可靠地利用它。提高空token分数可抑制幻觉，但过度干预会误删有效语音或缩短合法翻译。
AI.motivation: 现代编码器-解码器系统即使输入中没有可恢复的消息，仍能生成流畅的文本（即幻觉现象）。现有的弃权方法通常需要外部门控，缺乏对模型内在信号的系统性研究。作者希望探索一个更自然、更轻量的信号——模型自身的null token分数——是否可以作为有效的幻觉检测与弃权机制。
AI.method: (1) 在ASR和NMT模型中审计native null-token分数和标量logit偏移；(2) 在Whisper中额外探测解码器状态，并比较有监督的行编辑方法与传统外部门控；(3) 系统性地操纵null token分数，观察其对幻觉抑制和有效内容保留的影响。
AI.result: 评估的模型通常暴露了有用的弃权信号，但标准解码不能可靠地利用它。提高null token分数可以显著抑制幻觉生成，但激进的干预也会删除有效语音或缩短合法的翻译，即存在抑制与删除之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: null token可以作为诊断幻觉的一个有效透镜。评估弃权方法时，不能仅看幻觉减少率，还应同时考虑抑制成本和删除代价，以全面衡量方法的实际效用。

title: LLM-based Framework for Generating and Verifying Parallel DEVS Statecharts
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables, 1 algorithm
summary: The development of models demands sound modeling and simulation knowledge as well as domain knowledge. Every model should accurately represent a system's dynamics and be verifiable. Toward this objective, this research introduces an agentic PDEVS-LLM framework to assist human modelers in generating and verifying PDEVS statecharts for behavior modeling of atomic Parallel Discrete Event System Specification (PDEVS) models. The framework supports (re)generating plausible facts from a system description prompt using the agentic LLM used for generating plausible facts. Inconsistencies in plausible facts lead to incorrect PDEVS statecharts having logical structure and behavioral inaccuracies. A controlled-correction mechanism is developed to verify the logical consistency of the plausible facts. The agentic LLM is used to generate key behavioral conditions from the system description prompt. The plausible facts are then verified against the behavioral conditions using propositional logic entailment for a finite number of times. The verification results enable the generation of modification prompts that can reduce errors in generated plausible facts, resulting in more accurate PDEVS statecharts. To verify a statechart's logical correctness, its Timed Automata counterpart is manually created and verified for deadlock and reachability properties. The human modeler may regenerate plausible facts and PDEVS statecharts iteratively and incrementally. A basic correctness metric is introduced to quantify the completeness and accuracy of the expected behavioral traits of the PDEVS statechart models. A collection of example systems with varying levels of complexity is developed to demonstrate the capabilities and limitations of LLMs. The evaluation of the proposed verification mechanism shows a substantial improvement in the logical consistency of generated statecharts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个agentic PDEVS-LLM框架，利用LLM辅助建模者生成和验证PDEVS状态图（statecharts），并通过受控校正机制和命题逻辑推理来验证事实的语义一致性，同时使用时序自动机验证状态图的逻辑正确性。
AI.motivation: 模型开发需要建模与仿真知识以及领域知识，且每个模型都应准确表示系统动态并可验证。然而LLM生成的PDEVS状态图可能存在逻辑结构和行为上的不准确之处，需要一种机制来确保生成模型的一致性、准确性和可验证性。
AI.method: 框架包含：(1) 利用agentic LLM从系统描述提示中(re)生成合理事实；(2) 开发受控校正机制，通过LLM生成关键行为条件，并使用命题逻辑蕴含推理对合理事实进行有限次验证；(3) 根据验证结果生成修改提示以减少错误；(4) 将状态图的Timed Automata对应物手动创建并验证死锁和可达性属性；(5) 引入基本正确性度量来量化PDEVS状态图模型期望行为特征的完整性和准确性。
AI.result: 通过一系列不同复杂度示例系统的评估，所提出的验证机制在生成状态图的逻辑一致性方面表现出显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持人类建模者迭代式、增量式地重新生成合理事实和PDEVS状态图，通过多层次的验证机制提高了生成模型的逻辑一致性和准确性，同时也展示了LLM的能力和局限性。

title: SEER: Long-Context Reasoning via Selective Visual-Text Compression
comment: COLM 2026, Third Conference on Language Modeling
summary: Long-context reasoning remains computationally expensive for large language models due to the quadratic complexity of attention over text tokens. Visual-text compression offers a promising alternative by rendering text into images and processing them with vision-language models, often reducing token usage. However, existing approaches apply uniform compression regardless of query relevance, potentially sacrificing precision where detailed extraction is required. We present SEER, a framework that learns to select query-relevant images through visual scanning and retrieve textual content only where needed, combining the efficiency of visual compression with the precision of text-based reasoning. Through supervised fine-tuning on tool-interaction trajectories, SEER learns adaptive tool invocation for selection and retrieval. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that SEER improves extraction precision through selective text retrieval while retaining average prompt-token savings relative to full-text baselines. On LongBench, SEER achieves 51.11% average accuracy, outperforming the visual-text baseline Glyph-9B by 2.33 points and Qwen3-8B by 3.49 points. Code can be accessed at https://github.com/jiaweixu98/SEER

AI.tldr: SEER是一个通过视觉扫描选择与查询相关的图像、并仅在需要时检索文本内容的框架，结合了视觉压缩的效率与基于文本推理的精度，在LongBench上达到51.11%的平均准确率，优于视觉文本基线Glyph-9B 2.33个百分点。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理因注意力机制的二次复杂度而计算开销巨大。现有的视觉文本压缩方法对所有文本采用统一压缩策略，未考虑查询相关性，在需要精细提取的场景下可能损失精度。
AI.method: SEER框架通过视觉扫描学习选择查询相关的图像，并仅检索所需位置的文本内容。通过工具交互轨迹的监督微调，学习自适应工具调用来进行选择和检索。
AI.result: 在LongBench上达到51.11%的平均准确率，比Glyph-9B高2.33个百分点，比Qwen3-8B高3.49个百分点。在保持平均提示词元节省的同时，通过选择性文本检索提升了提取精度。
AI.conclusion: SEER证明了将视觉压缩的效率与选择性文本检索的精度相结合的有效性，为长上下文推理提供了一种更优的压缩与推理方案。

title: Command-Space Counterfactual Explanations for Pareto-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures
summary: Pareto Conditioned Networks learn multiple multi-objective reinforcement learning behaviours by conditioning a single policy on a desired return command. However, the local mapping from command and state to action remains opaque. We propose command-space counterfactual explanations for PCNs: given a fixed state, original command, and foil action, we search, in a black-box setting, for a minimally changed desired-return command under which the same trained policy would choose the foil. Our contributions are threefold. First, we formulate PCN explanations as return-command interventions, using a return-only PCN variant that avoids the added ambiguity of horizon-conditioning. Second, we adapt adversarial machine learning methods to reinforcement-learning explanations. Third, we introduce a boundary-seeded directional search that improves over purely local optimization in the command-action landscape, resulting in our proposed approach CF-ZOO. The resulting explanations are actionable and intuitively expressed in the user's own preferences: "If your trade-off had shifted slightly towards X, the agent would have chosen Y."

AI.tldr: 本文提出CF-ZOO方法，为Pareto Conditioned Networks（PCN）生成命令空间反事实解释。通过黑盒搜索最小改变的期望返回命令，使策略选择目标对抗动作，从而为多目标强化学习提供可操作的解释。
AI.motivation: PCN能够通过条件化单一策略于期望返回命令来学习多种多目标强化学习行为，但命令与状态到动作的局部映射是不透明的（黑盒）。用户无法理解为什么智能体在给定命令下做出特定决策，因此需要可解释性方法。
AI.method: 1) 将PCN解释形式化为返回命令干预问题，使用仅返回命令的PCN变体避免水平条件化的歧义；2) 将对抗机器学习方法适配到强化学习解释中；3) 提出边界种子定向搜索（boundary-seeded directional search），改进纯局部优化在命令-动作空间中的效果，形成CF-ZOO方法。
AI.result: CF-ZOO能够在黑盒设置下找到最小改变的命令，使得策略在该命令下选择目标对抗动作，生成的解释直观且可操作，表述为"如果你的权衡略微偏向X，智能体将选择Y"。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的CF-ZOO方法通过边界种子定向搜索优于纯局部优化，生成的解释以用户自身的偏好语言表达，既直观又可操作，为多目标强化学习提供了有效的可解释性工具。

title: Does a Tool Result Carry More Authority Than Plain Text? Three Prospective Studies of False-Claim Adoption in a Synthetic Assignment Task with Claude Opus 5
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures. Includes two document-preregistered studies, exact prompts, and complete program disclosure
summary: Language-model systems increasingly read from stores they also write to, so a claim that was merely written earlier can return looking retrieved. We tested whether the message package carrying an unsupported assignment changes which answer a model gives in a synthetic lookup task. Claude Opus 5 selected a color code for a named item or abstained. In an exploratory four-arm study, false-code adoption was 0/24 with no target claim, 0/22 scorable trials when a prior assistant assertion named the target, 14/24 when a tool-result record named it, and 15/24 when that result used a ten-field metadata wrapper that marked it unchecked. The tool-result arm selected the record's code in 11/12 supported trials and 14/24 unsupported trials, ruling out a fixed output-token bias while leaving substantial planted-token heterogeneity. A document-preregistered replication reproduced the tool-result versus assistant-assertion gap, 7/24 against 0/24, one-sided Fisher exact p = 0.0047. The tool-result rate nevertheless fell from 14/24 to 7/24 across runs made four days apart. A second preregistered study gave the earlier comparison a live text control: both records were announced in advance and placed in the same final user turn, then target binding was swapped between the linked tool result and later inline JSON. Inline text was sufficient for false-code adoption in 60/60 trials; the tool-result condition produced 57/60, so the registered result-first superiority criterion failed, p = 1. The result does not show that tool results have no effect. It shows that native tool-result placement was not necessary and that this experiment did not find greater behavioral weight for the result package than for announced inline text. The findings concern a single model on one synthetic task template, accessed through one API.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过合成查找任务，在Claude Opus 5模型上检验了不同消息包装（tool-result vs assistant-assertion vs inline text）对模型采信无依据（unsupported）编码的影响。结果表明，tool-result记录比助手断言更容易导致虚假编码被采信（14/24 vs 0/24，复制研究7/24 vs 0/24），但当两类记录均事先公布并置于同一用户轮次时，内联文本与tool-result的采信率相当（60/60 vs 57/60），说明原生tool-result放置并非必要，实验未发现结果包裹比已宣布的内联文本有更大行为权重。
AI.motivation: 语言模型系统日益从它们写入的存储中读取信息，导致"仅仅被写入过的声明"可能看起来像是"被检索到的"。作者希望检验消息包裹（message package）的类型（助手断言 vs 工具结果 vs 内联文本）是否会改变模型在查找任务中对无依据信息的采信程度，从而理解模型对信息来源可信度加权的机制。
AI.method: 在合成查找任务中，让Claude Opus 5为指定物品选择颜色编码或弃权。研究包括探索性四臂研究（无目标声明、助手断言、tool-result记录、带元数据包裹的tool-result），随后进行文档预注册的复制研究，以及第二项预注册研究：将两条记录事先公布并置于同一最终用户轮次，在关联的tool-result与后续内联JSON之间交换目标绑定。
AI.result: 探索性研究：虚假编码采信率在无目标声明组为0/24，助手断言组0/22，tool-result组14/24，带元数据包裹组15/24。tool-result组在支持性试验中11/12正确，无支持试验中14/24采信，排除固定输出token偏置。第一项预注册复制研究重复了tool-result（7/24）与助手断言（0/24）之间的差异（单侧Fisher精确检验p=0.0047），但tool-result率从14/24降至7/24。第二项预注册研究：内联文本采信率60/60，tool-result条件57/60，注册的"结果优先"优势标准未满足（p=1）。
AI.conclusion: 结果并不表明tool-result没有影响，但表明原生tool-result放置并非必要条件，且该实验未发现结果包裹比已宣布的内联文本具有更大的行为权重。研究局限于单一模型、单一合成任务模板和单一API访问方式，结论的可推广性有限。

title: LLMs Get Smarter from Targeted Synthetic Multilingual Data
summary: Language-specific competency (LSC) is the phenomenon of a language model performing better or worse depending on the language of the prompt. In other words, a language model outputs different (and potentially incorrect) responses to the same semantic query when prompted in different languages. Prior work attributes this to an internal misalignment of semantic representation across languages. Currently, there are two main approaches to address LSC in the literature: (1) routing all queries through English, improving performance, but limiting language expressivity to English; or (2) training on language-balanced data, equalizing model performance across languages, but reducing overall performance. In this work, we take a data centric perspective and introduce HOTFIXR: Hardness Optimized Training data For Improving X-Lingual Reasoning. It is a data generation framework that uses models to probe and learn a student model's multilingual weaknesses, and generates data to mitigate them. HOTFIXR can generate multilingual synthetic training data that can improve multilingual performance. We evaluate on three in-distribution tasks, three out-of-distribution tasks, and four out-of-distribution languages. On average, HOTFIXR (1) improves in-distribution performance by 6.2%, (2) reduces catastrophic forgetting (induced by fine-tuning) on OOD tasks by 3.7%, and (3) on OOD languages by 7.1%. Overall, as many real-world applications requires multilingual LLMs, our work contributes to the efforts of making LLMs multilingually proficient. We will release code upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HOTFIXR框架，一种数据生成方法，通过探测学生模型的多语言弱点并生成针对性训练数据来提升语言模型的跨语言推理能力，在分布内任务提升6.2%，并减少分布外任务和语言的灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 语言模型存在语言特定能力（LSC）问题，即同一语义查询在不同语言下会得到不同甚至错误的回答。现有两种解决方案各有缺陷：通过英语路由虽提升性能但限制语言表达性；训练语言平衡数据虽均衡性能但降低整体表现。需要一个既能保持整体性能又能改善多语言能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出HOTFIXR（Hardness Optimized Training data For Improving X-Lingual Reasoning）数据生成框架。该方法利用模型来探测和了解学生模型在多语言上的弱点，并针对性地生成合成训练数据来弥补这些弱点，从而提升多语言性能。
AI.result: 在三个分布内任务、三个分布外任务和四种分布外语言上评估：(1) 分布内性能平均提升6.2%；(2) 将微调引起的灾难性遗忘在分布外任务上减少3.7%；(3) 在分布外语言上减少7.1%的遗忘。
AI.conclusion: HOTFIXR通过数据为中心的视角有效缓解了LSC问题，为多语言LLM的实际应用做出贡献，代码将在接受后开源。

title: A Physiology-Informed Digital Twin Framework for Simulating Liver Health Progression
comment: This paper is under review at IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (JBHI)
summary: We present a physiology-informed digital twin of the human liver designed for longitudinal simulation of liver function and early-stage disease progression. The model, referred to as HEPATWIN, integrates key hepatic processes, including carbohydrate, lipid, and protein metabolism, bilirubin conjugation, bile production, and detoxification, within a unified systems-level framework to generate clinically observable biomarker trajectories. Unlike purely data-driven approaches, HEPATWIN incorporates mechanistic representations of liver physiology and patient-specific inputs such as diet, activity, and baseline biomarkers to simulate disease evolution over time. To ensure consistency with clinical progression patterns, we introduce a stage-transition-driven calibration mechanism that aligns simulated outputs with population-level biomarker distributions across disease stages, including NAFLD, fibrosis, and cirrhosis. Validation using the NIDDK NAFLD dataset demonstrates that HEPATWIN produces longitudinal biomarker estimates within clinically acceptable ranges and can forecast trajectories over multi-year horizons. Furthermore, simulated biomarkers retain sufficient clinical signal to support downstream NASH detection with competitive performance relative to models using ground-truth laboratory data. These results highlight the potential of physiology-informed digital twins for personalized, non-invasive diagnosis and prediction of organ health in general and liver health monitoring in particular.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为HEPATWIN的生理学信息驱动的肝脏数字孪生模型，用于纵向模拟肝功能及早期疾病进展。该模型整合碳水化合物、脂质和蛋白质代谢、胆红素结合、胆汁生成和解毒等关键肝脏过程，通过统一的系统级框架生成临床可观察的生物标志物轨迹。与纯数据驱动方法不同，HEPATWIN包含肝脏生理的机制性表征，并结合饮食、活动量和基线生物标志物等患者特定输入来模拟疾病随时间的演变。通过阶段转换驱动的校准机制，模型确保与NAFLD、纤维化和肝硬化等疾病阶段的群体生物标志物分布一致。在NIDDK NAFLD数据集上的验证表明，该模型能产生临床可接受范围内的纵向生物标志物估计，并可预测多年时间跨度内的轨迹。模拟的生物标志物保留了足够的临床信号，可支持下游NASH检测，其性能与使用真实实验室数据的模型相当。
AI.motivation: 肝脏疾病（如NAFLD、纤维化、肝硬化）的进展通常需要多年时间，纵向监测对于早期诊断和干预至关重要。然而，获取长期、连续的临床数据成本高昂且困难，纯数据驱动方法缺乏生理机制基础，难以推广到新患者或解释疾病进展的因果关系。作者旨在开发一种结合生理机制的数字化模型，能够利用患者特定输入生成长期纵向生物标志物轨迹，从而实现个性化、非侵入性的肝脏健康监测。
AI.method: HEPATWIN采用统一系统级框架，整合了碳水化合物、脂质和蛋白质代谢、胆红素结合、胆汁产生和解毒等关键肝脏生理过程。模型接受患者特定输入（如饮食、活动水平和基线生物标志物），通过机制性表征模拟疾病随时间的演变。引入阶段转换驱动的校准机制，将模拟输出与不同疾病阶段（NAFLD、纤维化、肝硬化）的群体生物标志物分布对齐，确保与临床进展模式一致。
AI.result: 在NIDDK NAFLD数据集上的验证表明，HEPATWIN能够产生处于临床可接受范围内的纵向生物标志物估计，并能预测多年时间跨度的疾病轨迹。模拟的生物标志物保留了足够的临床辨别信号，可用于下游NASH检测，其性能与使用真实实验室数据的模型相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 生理学信息驱动的数字孪生方法在个性化、非侵入性肝脏健康诊断和预测方面展现出巨大潜力。HEPATWIN证明了将机制性生理模型与患者特定输入结合，可以在不依赖大量真实临床数据的情况下生成可靠的长期疾病轨迹预测，为肝脏健康监测和更广泛的器官健康管理提供了新范式。

title: S2-MoE: Enabling Efficient Self-Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts on Edge Devices
comment: 13 pages, 10 figures
summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for inference on edge devices is challenging due to severe memory and bandwidth constraints. While speculative decoding and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) have been proposed to improve inference efficiency, naively combining them often incurs excessive verification overhead and poor expert reuse, limiting their effectiveness in memory-bound edge settings. In this work, we propose S2-MoE, an efficient self-speculative decoding framework for MoE inference on edge devices. S2-MoE reduces redundant verification through routing-aware adaptive speculative expansion, improves verification efficiency with reuse-aware expert gating, and aligns draft and target execution via shared context. Implemented in llama.cpp, S2-MoE achieves up to 5.3x speedup (about 2.0x on average) over standard autoregressive de?coding across diverse MoE models and datasets on edge devices.Code is available at https://github.com/angerybob/S2-MoE.

AI.tldr: S2-MoE是一个用于边缘设备上MoE模型推理的自推测解码框架，通过路由感知的自适应推测扩展减少冗余验证，利用复用感知的专家门控提升验证效率，并通过共享上下文对齐草稿与目标执行。在llama.cpp上实现，相比标准自回归解码在不同MoE模型和数据集上平均提速约2.0倍，最高达5.3倍。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备部署LLM推理面临严重的内存和带宽限制。虽然推测解码和MoE分别被提出来提升推理效率，但简单组合两者常常带来过多的验证开销和较差的专家复用，限制了其在内存受限的边缘场景中的有效性。
AI.method: 提出S2-MoE框架，包含三个关键机制：(1) 路由感知的自适应推测扩展以减少冗余验证；(2) 复用感知的专家门控以提升验证效率；(3) 通过共享上下文对齐草稿与目标执行。系统在llama.cpp中实现。
AI.result: 在边缘设备上的多种MoE模型和数据集上，S2-MoE相比标准自回归解码实现最高5.3倍加速，平均约2.0倍加速。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: S2-MoE有效解决了推测解码与MoE朴素结合时的验证开销和专家复用问题，为边缘设备上高效的MoE推理提供了一种实用的加速方案。

title: Whose Gold? Annotator-Pool Disagreement Is Large at the Item Level, and Hidden by Small Leaderboards
comment: Submitted to the HAIC workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary:
Preference benchmarks are built by hiring annotators, and the identity of those annotators is treated as an implementation detail. We measure what that detail buys. On the 2,885 MultiPref items where both pools are internally unanimous, so no tie-breaking convention is consulted at all, expert and crowd annotators assign a different majority label to 23.6% and name the opposite winner on 9.2%; on the 246 comparably unanimous MT-Bench cells, benchmark authors and recruited experts differ on 30.5% and reverse on 8.5%. Yet on both corpora the resulting model leaderboards are bit-identical: Kendall tau = 1.00 with zero of six models displaced.
  That invariance is far weaker evidence than it looks, and we quantify how weak. Switching pools moves a model's win rate by 1.9pp (SD), one adjacent pair in our own leaderboard sits 0.8pp apart and had a 38% chance of swapping, and an item-level bootstrap displaces at least one model in 28% of resamples. The observed zero is the common outcome, not a property of aggregation: on the same measured perturbation, a ten-model leaderboard is displaced with probability 0.86 and a twenty-model leaderboard with probability 0.9997. Reporting a six-model leaderboard is safe; the safety does not generalise, and everything that consumes labels per item is not safe at any size. We make the distinction precise, show that a widely used dataset's stated assumption of no intra-group annotator variability is false, and show that an LLM judge tracks the crowd pool over the expert pool on all three models we test, including one from a different vendor. All code, per-call outputs, and pre-registered decision rules will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本篇论文研究了偏好基准测试中标注者身份差异的影响。研究发现专家与大众标注者在多数标签上存在显著分歧（约24-30%），但六模型排行榜却完全一致（Kendall tau=1.00）。然而，这种一致性是脆弱的：模型胜率标准差为1.9pp，项目级bootstrap在28%的重采样中会置换至少一个模型。作者通过量化分析表明，小规模排行榜的稳定性不能推广到更大规模，并指出广泛使用的数据集关于组内标注者无变异的假设是错误的，同时发现LLM裁判更倾向于跟随大众而非专家标注者。
AI.motivation: 偏好基准测试依赖人类标注者，但标注者身份被视为实现细节而非重要变量。作者希望通过系统性测量来揭示标注者身份选择（专家 vs 大众）对基准测试结果和模型排行榜的实际影响程度，质疑现有基准测试的可靠性和泛化性。
AI.method: 作者在MultiPref（2,885个内部一致的标注项）和MT-Bench（246个一致单元）两个语料库上，比较专家和大众标注者分配的多数标签差异。通过量化模型胜率变化、bootstrap重采样分析、概率模型计算等方式，系统评估标注者身份切换对模型排行榜稳定性的影响，并测试LLM裁判对不同标注池的跟随倾向。
AI.result: 专家和大众标注者在内部一致的项目上存在显著分歧（MultiPref上23.6%标签不同、9.2%胜者相反；MT-Bench上30.5%不同、8.5%相反），但六模型排行榜完全一致。切换标注池使模型胜率变动1.9pp，28%的bootstrap重采样会置换至少一个模型。作者证明这种零位移是特定规模的巧合而非普遍属性：十模型排行榜被置换概率为0.86，二十模型为0.9997。广泛使用数据集关于组内无标注者变异的假设被证伪，LLM裁判在三个模型（含跨供应商）上均更贴近大众标注池。
AI.conclusion: 小规模排行榜（如六模型）的鲁棒性不能被推广到更大规模或逐项目消费标签的场景。标注者身份的选择对基准测试结果有实质性影响，研究者需要区分"排行榜层面安全"与"逐项目安全"的区别，并重新审视依赖标注者假设的数据集。

title: Gathered, Not Admitted: How Attention Brings a Latent Variable into Verbalizable Form
comment: 26 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/parsa-mz/innerj
summary: Language models hold latent quantities in a form they can report on, and more of a quantity is present in that form when the task requires reusing it flexibly. What causes a representation to enter that form is open, and the word workspace invites an admission story: a gate that decides what gets in. Testing it on open-weight models with Jacobian lenses, over a benchmark whose five arms share an identical context, we find no gate where it predicts one. Demand raises a concept's lens visibility beyond what applying an operator to a supplied value produces: +0.050 [+0.045, +0.057] in percentile rank on our primary checkpoint, positive on all four we measure, though that arm answers at ceiling and the accuracymatched contrast is stronger under that readout. At the same time one shared linear map decodes the variable from every arm, the control included, at 6.4-9.0x its selection-corrected floor. What produces the later readable form at the queried position is attention-mediated gathering inside a mid-depth window: separating patch depth from readout depth puts transport there at least 17x above anywhere shallower under non-saturating readouts, with no tested MLP output contributing positively inside it. Under the saturating percentile rank the same grid does not localise the window, which is a fact about that measure. An arm that needs the variable for nothing concentrates sevenfold less, so the window is demand-specific. That window has two measured edges, a survival failure below and destruction above, and it falls at the same fractional depth in a 64-layer hybrid and a 62-layer dense model from another family. We localise where the variable is installed and read, not the route from the passage, which transports nothing. But the readout is not a calibrated measure of use: three components move it to within 12% of one another and differ 7.4x in what they do to the answer.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Jacobian透镜在开放权重语言模型上研究"工作空间"假设，发现语言模型以可报告形式持有潜在量，且当任务需要灵活复用时该量更充分。研究未发现预测中的"门控"机制，而是发现注意力介导的中深窗口负责聚集变量形成可读形式，该窗口具有需求特异性和跨模型家族的一致性。
AI.motivation: 探索语言模型如何以可报告形式持有潜在量，以及什么原因导致表征进入这种形式。工作空间概念暗示存在一个决定"什么能进入"的门控，本文旨在检验这一假设。
AI.method: 使用Jacobian透镜对开放权重模型进行测试，构建五个臂共享相同上下文的基准。分离补丁深度与读出深度，考察注意力运输与MLP输出在不同深度窗口的作用，并跨两个不同模型家族（64层混合模型和62层稠密模型）验证窗口位置的一致性。
AI.result: 未发现预测中的门控机制。需求能将概念透镜可见性提高+0.050（百分位排名），在四个检查点上均正向。共享线性映射可从所有臂（含控制组）解码变量，为选择校正基底的6.4-9.0倍。注意力介导的运输在非饱和读出下至少是浅层17倍以上，且MLP输出无正向贡献。需求特异窗口具有生存失败下限和破坏上限两个边界。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型中可读形式的产生来自中深窗口内注意力介导的聚集，而非门控机制。窗口具有需求特异性，且窗口位置在不同模型家族中保持一致的分数深度。但读出不是使用量的校准度量——三个组件可使读数接近但实际作用差异达7.4倍。

title: From Sequence to Structure: Relational Uncertainty Propagation for LLM Agents
summary: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for deploying large language model (LLM) agents in complex interactive environments. Existing UQ methods largely rely on local signals, such as token probabilities, predictive entropy, or per-step confidence, and therefore overlook the long-range dependencies through which errors accumulate across an execution trajectory. As a result, they may fail to identify agent failures whose causes originate several reasoning or interaction steps before the final answer. We propose RUPA (Relational Uncertainty Propagation for Agents), a trajectory-level UQ framework for LLM agents. RUPA represents an execution history as a directed trajectory graph in which reasoning states, tool interactions, and environment feedback are nodes connected by temporal and semantic dependency edges. It then propagates uncertainty over this graph to capture how execution risk accumulates and transfers across interaction steps. The propagated signal is combined with trajectory-level behavioral features and goal-alignment information to produce a confidence estimate for the full agent trajectory. We evaluate RUPA on representative agent benchmarks, including $τ$-2, Terminal-Bench-2, and GAIA, using 6 open-source LLMs spanning multiple model families. Experimental results show that RUPA consistently outperforms existing UQ methods by providing more accurate uncertainty estimates, enabling earlier failure detection, and improving uncertainty-guided agent execution across diverse agent tasks. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling relational dependency is crucial to reliable UQ for long-horizon LLM agents, providing a practical foundation for trustworthy agent execution.

AI.tldr: RUPA是一个面向LLM智能体的轨迹级不确定性量化框架，通过将执行历史建模为有向轨迹图并在图上传播不确定性，捕捉长距离依赖与错误累积，从而更可靠地量化智能体执行风险。
AI.motivation: 现有UQ方法主要依赖局部信号（如token概率、预测熵或单步置信度），忽略了执行轨迹中错误跨步骤累积的长距离依赖关系，因此难以识别根源在最终答案之前数步就已产生的智能体失败。
AI.method: RUPA将执行历史表示为有向轨迹图：推理状态、工具交互和环境反馈作为节点，通过时间与语义依赖边连接；随后在图上传播不确定性以捕捉风险在交互步骤间的累积与转移，并结合轨迹级行为特征与目标对齐信息，生成整体轨迹的置信度估计。
AI.result: 在τ-2、Terminal-Bench-2和GAIA基准上，使用6个跨模型族的开源LLM评估，RUPA在不确定性估计准确性、早期失败检测以及与不确定性引导的智能体执行方面一致优于现有UQ方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模关系依赖对于长时程LLM智能体的可靠UQ至关重要，RUPA为可信赖的智能体执行提供了实践基础。

title: Lipschitz Bandits with Arbitrary Feedback Delays
comment: 10 pages of main contents, 26 pages in total
summary: The Lipschitz bandit problem extends the traditional multi-armed bandit framework to continuous action spaces by assuming that the reward functions satisfy a Lipschitz condition. This work investigates Lipschitz bandits under arbitrary feedback delays, where reward signals are not received immediately upon taking an action but after an arbitrarily chosen delay. We consider both stochastic and adversarial reward settings, proposing an elimination-based algorithm and an EXP3-based algorithm, respectively. For both settings, our algorithms achieve a regret bound of $\tilde{O}\left(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}+\sqrt{D}\right)$ over a time horizon $T$ with total delay $D$, where the main difference between settings lies in the definition of the zooming dimension $d_z$. Our bounds match existing delay-free regret guarantees for Lipschitz bandits and characterize the additional $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$ impact introduced by feedback delays.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了任意反馈延迟下的Lipschitz赌博机问题，分别在随机和对抗两种奖励设置下提出了消除算法和EXP3算法，实现了$\tilde{O}(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}+\sqrt{D})$的遗憾界，其中$d_z$为缩放维度，$D$为总延迟。该结果与无延迟情况下的遗憾界相匹配，并刻画了反馈延迟带来的$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$额外影响。
AI.motivation: Lipschitz赌博机问题将传统多臂赌博机扩展到连续动作空间，但现有研究大多假设奖励信号即时反馈。在实际应用中，反馈延迟是普遍存在的现象（如推荐系统、在线广告等场景），因此研究任意反馈延迟下的Lipschitz赌博机问题具有重要的理论和实践意义。
AI.method: 针对两种不同的奖励设置分别提出算法：(1) 随机奖励设置下，提出基于消除（elimination-based）的算法；(2) 对抗奖励设置下，提出基于EXP3的算法。两种算法均考虑了缩放维度$d_z$，且两种设置的主要区别在于$d_z$的定义方式不同。
AI.result: 两种设置下的算法均实现了$\tilde{O}(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}+\sqrt{D})$的遗憾界（时间跨度$T$，总延迟$D$）。该界与无延迟Lipschitz赌博机的最优遗憾界相匹配，同时额外添加了$\sqrt{D}$项以表征反馈延迟造成的影响。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次在任意反馈延迟条件下为Lipschitz赌博机问题提供了统一的遗憾界分析，展示了延迟对学习性能的影响可以量化为$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{D})$，且不牺牲延迟为零时的最优性能保证。

title: LLM-Based Hierarchical Coordinated Control with Continuation-Aware Policy Learning
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures
summary: Coordinating multiple interacting units in complex engineering systems is challenging when system interactions are difficult to model, operational information is heterogeneous, and low-level actions must satisfy strict constraints. We propose an LLM-based hierarchical framework in which the LLM coordinates interacting units based on heterogeneous operational context, while task-specific controllers or optimizers generate executable and constraint-aware actions. We further introduce Continuation-Aware GRPO to capture the consequences of coordination decisions over subsequent control intervals. Rather than judging a decision only by its immediate outcome, the method also evaluates how the system evolves afterward under the current policy. We validate the framework on multi-ramp traffic control and virtual power plant (VPP) energy management, using simplified system models for training and more realistic simulators for evaluation. Across both tasks, the proposed method consistently outperforms direct task-specific control and optimization, end-to-end reinforcement learning, rule-based and RL-based hierarchical coordination, and prompting-only LLM coordinators, demonstrating the value of heterogeneous-context reasoning, hierarchical execution, and continuation-aware policy learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于LLM的分层框架，用于协调复杂工程系统中的多个交互单元。LLM负责基于异构运行信息进行协调决策，任务特定的控制器/优化器生成可执行且满足约束的动作。作者还引入了Continuation-Aware GRPO算法，评估协调决策对后续控制区间的长期影响。
AI.motivation: 复杂工程系统中协调多个交互单元面临三大挑战：系统交互难以建模、运行信息异构、底层动作需满足严格约束。现有方法难以同时处理这些问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出LLM-based分层框架：LLM在上层基于异构上下文进行协调，任务特定控制器/优化器在下层生成约束感知的可执行动作；2) 提出Continuation-Aware GRPO算法，不仅评估决策的即时效果，还评估系统在当前策略下的后续演化，从而捕获协调决策的长期后果；3) 使用简化系统模型训练，用更真实的仿真器评估。
AI.result: 在多匝道交通控制和虚拟电厂能源管理两个任务上，该方法优于直接的任务特定控制/优化、端到端强化学习、基于规则和基于RL的分层协调，以及仅提示的LLM协调器。
AI.conclusion: 异构上下文推理、分层执行和continuation-aware策略学习相结合，能有效提升复杂交互系统的协调性能。

title: ReRef-3D: A Benchmark for Spatial Referring Expression-Guided 3D Scene Rearrangement
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (ARR)
summary: We introduce ReRef-3D, a benchmark for language-guided placement in 3D scenes. It contains 33,826 instructions across 998 CLEVR-derived scenes, spanning 16 placement families and direct, one-hop, and two-hop references. Each instruction must be resolved into a valid new placement position. Given that an instruction defines a region of acceptable placements rather than one coordinate, our evaluation inserts a prediction into the scene, recomputes relations, and tests relation satisfaction and physical validity. Each instruction also includes a verified naturalized rewrite. After fine-tuning, LLaVA-3D, 3D-LLM, and PlaceIt3D produce valid placements for 68.3%, 31.6%, and 22.4% of instructions, respectively. Across models, relation satisfaction surpasses physical validity, relations such as nearest and between are the most difficult, and phrasing has minimal effect on performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ReRef-3D基准，用于评估3D场景中的语言引导放置任务。包含998个CLEVR派生场景中的33,826条指令，涵盖16种放置类别和直接、一跳、两跳引用。评估时将预测放入场景、重算关系并检验关系满足度和物理有效性。实验表明LLaVA-3D表现最佳（68.3%有效放置率），关系满足度普遍高于物理有效性，nearest和between关系最难，措辞变化影响最小。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景中语言引导放置任务缺乏系统化基准，且指令通常定义的是一个可接受放置区域而非单一坐标，需要对预测结果进行关系重算与物理有效性验证。
AI.method: 构建ReRef-3D基准：基于CLEVR场景生成998个场景和33,826条指令，涵盖16种放置类别，支持直接引用、一跳引用和两跳引用。每条指令附带验证过的自然化改写版本。评估方法为将模型预测插入场景，重新计算物体间关系，检验关系满足程度和物理有效性（如碰撞、支撑等）。
AI.result: 微调后，LLaVA-3D、3D-LLM和PlaceIt3D的有效放置率分别为68.3%、31.6%和22.4%。所有模型的关系满足度均高于物理有效性；nearest和between关系最难处理；指令措辞变化对模型性能影响最小。
AI.conclusion: ReRef-3D揭示了当前多模态3D模型在语言引导放置任务中的能力差距，证明关系推理（特别是nearest和between）和物理约束满足仍是主要瓶颈，而语义理解（措辞变化）已相对成熟。

title: Certifying Compressed Language Models: An Audit and a Statistical Toolkit
comment: 109 pages, 3 figures, 20 tables. Artifacts and per-item outputs: doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21939143
summary: A fraction of a point of benchmark accuracy is the usual evidence that a compressed model is equivalent to its original. That quantity is least informative when two models are most alike: a net delta is what survives cancellation between opposing per-item changes, and cancellation is most complete in the regime equivalence claims occupy. Across an atlas of 1,707 paired model-by-task cells mined from public per-item evaluation dumps (1.3B-405B), churn runs roughly five times the net accuracy delta, and cells scoring identically to their baseline still disagree on individual items. In a preregistered audit of 17 equivalence claims from three registered frames (method papers, model cards, vendor documentation), 16 are eligible. None states a prospective numerical equivalence margin, and none releases task-matched per-item outputs, though 3 release outputs for other tasks only; 5 report too little to assess numerically, so a reader cannot check them at any sample size. We audit evidential sufficiency, not truth: no claim is called false. We supply the missing instrument: paired equivalence testing at a declared margin, with certification tables giving the items an evaluation needs, computed from disagreement observed under compression, not from independent-binomial variance. A controlled experiment pairs GPTQ and AWQ on byte-identical calibration samples across five seeds. Under the frozen eight-cell decision rule H3 is supported: changing the calibration draw was sufficient to reverse the observed method ordering in 5 of 8 confirmatory cells. The reporting standard we propose is five lines: declare a margin, run the paired test, report churn beside net delta, cite the sample size you met, release per-item outputs. It applies to any comparison between two models alike enough to be worth comparing. All per-item outputs, protocols and code are released.

AI.tldr: 本文指出压缩模型与原始模型等价的证据——基准测试净精度差——在模型高度相似时信息量最低。作者通过1707个配对模型-任务单元的分析发现，逐项波动（churn）约为净精度差的5倍。对17个等价声称的预注册审计显示，没有任何声称声明了前瞻性的数值等价边际或发布任务匹配的逐项输出。作者提出配对等价检验工具及认证表，并通过对GPTQ与AWQ的受控实验表明，改变校准采样足以在5/8的确认单元中逆转方法排序，最终提出五项报告标准。
AI.motivation: 传统上以基准测试准确率的一小部分差异作为压缩模型与原模型等价的证据，但这种净差异是最不具信息量的指标：它只反映对逐项变化相互抵消后的净结果，而模型越相似，抵消越彻底。现有等价声称缺乏严格证据标准，既无明确数值边际，也不发布逐项输出，使得读者无法在任意样本量下验证其声称。
AI.method: 作者构建了1707个配对模型-任务单元分析公共逐项评测数据；对17个等价声称进行预注册审计；提出了配对等价检验方法，基于压缩下观察到的分歧而非独立二项方差计算所需样本量；在五个种子上对字节相同的校准样本执行GPTQ和AWQ的受控实验，使用冻结的八单元决策规则检验校准抽取是否足以逆转方法排序。
AI.result: 逐项波动约为净精度差的5倍；与基线得分相同的单元仍在个别项目上存在分歧；16个等价声称符合审计条件但无一声明前瞻性数值边际或发布任务匹配的逐项输出；受控实验中H3得到支持：5/8的确认单元中改变校准抽取足以逆转观察到的方法排序。
AI.conclusion: 净准确率差不足以证明模型等价性，应改用声明边际的配对等价检验，报告应包含波动与净差异并列、满足的样本量以及逐项输出发布。该报告标准适用于任何足够相似的模型比较，所有输出、协议与代码均已公开。

title: SCOPE: Score-Isolated Agentic Optimization for Video World Models
summary: Video world models are increasingly used as simulators for planning and embodied decision making, yet improving them at inference time introduces a subtle evaluation problem: prompts, samplers, verifiers, and selectors may evolve together, making it difficult to attribute gains or prevent held-out feedback from shaping the final policy. We introduce \scope (\emph{\scopefullname}), a framework for auditable inference-time adaptation of frozen video world models. \scope represents external controls as a typed state, updates this state only through bounded changes supported by development evidence, and freezes the resulting policy before held-out evaluation. On Physics-IQ benchmark, \scope improves over the exact frozen base by $+14.24$ (95\% CI $[+8.10,+21.23]$). Controlled ablations further identify gains from scene specification, sampling, and learned selection, while the margin over the strongest matched agentic baseline remains unresolved. Cross-backbone and prospective evaluations reveal a complementary result: useful inference-time updates exist, but their benefits do not transfer uniformly across models and settings. Together, these findings suggest that reliable inference-time adaptation requires not only better proposals, but also a principled mechanism for deciding which updates should become part of the deployed system. Code is available at https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/SCOPE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOPE框架，用于视频世界模型的可审计推理时适应（inference-time adaptation），通过类型化状态、受限更新和策略冻结机制，在保持模型冻结的前提下实现可控的性能提升。在Physics-IQ基准上相对基线提升+14.24，并揭示了推理时更新的收益并不能跨模型和设置均匀迁移。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型作为模拟器越来越多地用于规划和具身决策，但在推理时改进它们引入了微妙的评估问题：提示、采样器、验证器和选择器可能共同演化，导致难以归因性能提升的来源，也无法防止留出反馈污染最终策略。
AI.method: SCOPE将外部控制表示为类型化状态（typed state），仅通过由开发证据支持的有界变化（bounded changes）来更新该状态，并在留出评估前冻结最终策略。这提供了可审计的推理时适应机制。
AI.result: 在Physics-IQ基准上，SCOPE相对精确冻结基线提升+14.24（95% CI [+8.10, +21.23]）。受控消融实验识别出场景规范、采样和学习选择带来的增益，但与最强匹配的智能体基线的差距仍未解决。跨骨干网和前向评估显示推理时更新有用但收益不跨模型和设置均匀迁移。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的推理时适应不仅需要更好的提议（proposals），还需要一个原则性的机制来决定哪些更新应该成为部署系统的一部分。SCOPE框架为此提供了可审计的解决方案。

title: $R^3$-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets
comment: Code is available at https://github.com/NineAbyss/R-3-Bench . The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/R-3-Bench/R-3-Bench
summary: In cognitive science, resource rationality asks how an agent should allocate limited computation to maximize expected value.
