Most reasoning and agent benchmarks use independent per-task budgets; existing shared-budget studies do not calibrate suite performance against the same model's demonstrated single-problem competence. We introduce $R^3$-Bench, which evaluates six-problem suites under shared budgets across mathematics, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic settings. Matched single-problem response curves define an offline empirical oracle over observed successes. Across 72 main-table cells for six models, the oracle mean matches or exceeds the contest mean in all cells and is strictly higher in 71. Under moderate tool-free pressure, equal-allocation replay also exceeds contest performance for four of six models. Trajectory diagnostics reveal limited strategy updating and pressure-dependent failure patterns. In a three-model diagnostic under strong agentic pressure, at least one fixed scheduler exceeds the contest mean in six of nine cells, but no policy dominates across domains. These results expose a persistent gap between demonstrated competence and shared-budget realization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R³-Bench基准，评估模型在共享计算预算下处理六问题套件的表现，覆盖数学、竞赛编程和抽象推理。通过匹配单问题响应曲线构建离线经验oracle，在72个主表格单元中oracle均值在全部单元中不低于、在71个单元中严格高于contest均值，揭示了模型已展示能力与共享预算实际表现之间的持续差距。
AI.motivation: 认知科学中的资源理性要求智能体合理分配有限计算资源以最大化预期价值。现有推理和智能体基准大多使用独立的每任务预算，而共享预算研究未针对同一模型的单问题能力进行校准，缺乏对共享预算下套件性能的系统评估。
AI.method: 引入R³-Bench基准，在数学、竞赛编程和抽象推理领域评估六问题套件在共享预算下的表现，包含无工具和智能体两种设置。匹配单问题响应曲线构建离线经验oracle，用于观测成功；同时进行轨迹诊断分析策略更新和压力依赖失败模式。
AI.result: 在六个模型的72个主表格单元中，oracle均值在所有单元中不低于contest均值，且在71个单元中严格更高。在中等无工具压力下，等分配重放对四个模型也超过contest表现。三模型诊断中，至少一个固定调度器在九个单元中的六个超过contest均值，但无策略在所有领域占优。
AI.conclusion: 研究暴露了模型已展示能力与共享预算实际实现之间的持续差距，表明资源理性视角下模型的预算分配策略尚不完善，且不存在跨领域的统一最优调度策略。

title: Online Convex Optimization with Dueling Feedback
summary: We study online convex optimization with dueling (pairwise comparison) feedback, where the learner observes only a binary preference between two queried points. While dueling feedback is well understood in discrete or stochastic settings, the adversarial convex setting has remained unexplored. We propose a simple reduction that converts dueling feedback into approximate gradients, enabling the use of standard first-order methods. We show that regret guarantees transfer under this reduction, yielding the first results for this setting, including $\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$ static, adaptive, and dynamic regret. Under additional structure, we obtain improved rates of $\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ for smooth objectives and $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T \log T})$ for strongly convex functions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了带有对抗性（dueling）成对比较反馈的在线凸优化问题，提出了一种将成对比较反馈转化为近似梯度的简单归约方法，从而能够使用标准的一阶优化方法。该方法首次在此设定下获得了$\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$的静态、自适应和动态遗憾界，并在额外结构条件下进一步改进为$\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$（光滑目标）和$\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T \log T})$（强凸函数）。
AI.motivation: 尽管成对比较反馈在离散或随机设定下已被充分研究，但对抗性凸设定下的成对比较反馈问题此前尚未被探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，为这一新设定提供理论保证。
AI.method: 提出一种简单的归约方法，将成对比较（dueling）反馈转化为近似梯度，使得标准的一阶优化方法可以直接应用于该设定。通过证明该归约下遗憾保证的可迁移性，建立了统一的分析框架。
AI.result: 获得了该设定下首个理论结果：一般情形下$\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$的静态、自适应和动态遗憾；光滑目标下改进为$\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$；强凸函数下进一步改进为$\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T \log T})$。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次解决了对抗性凸设定下的成对比较反馈问题，证明了一阶方法的有效性，并为未来研究提供了新的方向。

title: DuplexGen: Decoupling Content, Timing, and Acoustics for Synthetic Dialogue Speech
summary: Synthetic conversational speech has become an important resource for developing and evaluating conversational speech systems. However, existing dialogue synthesis pipelines typically generate dialogue content first and then insert interruptions, overlap, and backchannels using handcrafted markers or timing rules, making conversational timing prescribed rather than interaction-driven. We present DuplexGen, a dialogue synthesis framework that explicitly decouples content, timing, and acoustics. An LLM first generates the dialogue script, and then two full-duplex conversational models perform the script while listening to each other in real time. This allows conversational timing to emerge naturally while preserving the scripted content. Finally, a high-fidelity text-to-speech model re-renders the interaction without altering its timing. As a demonstration of the proposed framework, we construct a patient--clinician conversational speech corpus with construction-time annotations, including word timestamps, speaker activity, overlap regions, and interaction events. Experimental results show that the proposed framework produces conversational dynamics closer to real dialogue than conventional stitching-based synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DuplexGen，一个解耦内容、时序和声学的对话语音合成框架。LLM生成对话脚本后，两个全双工对话模型实时互听执行脚本，使对话时序自然涌现；最后用高保真TTS重新渲染而不改变时序。在医患对话语料上验证，其生成的自然对话动态优于传统拼接式合成。
AI.motivation: 现有对话语音合成流程通常先生成对话内容，再通过手工标记或时序规则插入打断、重叠和反馈语，导致对话时序是被规定而非由交互自然驱动。这使合成对话缺乏真实的人机交互动态特性。
AI.method: 提出DuplexGen框架，包含三个阶段：(1) LLM生成对话脚本；(2) 两个全双工对话模型在实时互听的条件下执行该脚本，使对话时序（打断、重叠等）自然涌现；(3) 高保真TTS模型重新渲染音频但不改变时序。同时构建了带建构期标注（词时间戳、说话人活动、重叠区域、交互事件）的患者—临床医生对话语料。
AI.result: 实验表明，DuplexGen产生的对话动态比传统拼接式合成更接近真实对话，验证了交互驱动时序合成的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解耦内容、时序与声学，让对话时序从真实双向交互中自然产生，而非人为预设，是提升合成对话自然度的有效方向。该方法可为对话系统开发与评估提供更真实的合成语音资源。

title: TAHB: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Text-Attributed Hypergraph Learning
summary: Hypergraphs effectively model higher-order groupwise relationships beyond pairwise interactions, while pretrained language models (PLMs) and large language models (LLMs) provide rich semantic understanding from textual attributes. However, research on combining language models with hypergraph learning remains limited due to the lack of public text-attributed hypergraph benchmarks. To address this limitation, we present TAHB (Text-Attributed Hypergraph Benchmark), the first public benchmark integrating hypergraph structures and raw textual attributes. TAHB contains 10 real-world datasets from four domains - e-commerce, academia, movies, and politics networks - enabling systematic evaluation of text-aware hypergraph representation learning. Experimental results show that TAHB preserves key structural properties of real-world hypergraphs and consistently reproduces performance tendencies observed in existing benchmarks. Furthermore, experiments under both LLM-as-Enhancer and LLM-as-Predictor settings demonstrate that LLM-enhanced textual semantics improve hypergraph learning performance, while structural and textual information jointly provide the best setting for LLM-based prediction. Our benchmark provides a foundation for future research at the intersection of hypergraph learning and language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TAHB（文本属性超图基准），这是首个将超图结构与原始文本属性相结合的公共同基准，包含来自电子商务、学术界、电影和政治网络四个领域的10个真实数据集，用于系统评估文本感知的超图表示学习。
AI.motivation: 超图能有效建模超越成对交互的高阶群体关系，预训练语言模型和大语言模型能提供丰富的语义理解，但缺乏公开的文本属性超图基准限制了语言模型与超图学习的结合研究。
AI.method: 构建了包含10个真实世界数据集的TAHB基准，覆盖四个领域（电子商务、学术界、电影、政治网络），并在LLM-as-Enhancer和LLM-as-Predictor两种设置下进行实验评估。
AI.result: TAHB保留了真实超图的关键结构属性，一致地复现了现有基准中的性能趋势；LLM增强的文本语义能提升超图学习性能，结构和文本信息联合使用为基于LLM的预测提供了最佳设置。
AI.conclusion: TAHB为超图学习与语言模型交叉领域的未来研究提供了基础。

title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that rely on system prompts to use tools and complete tasks. Such deployments impose distinct operational requirements, including appropriate tool use, concise prompts and solution paths, and compliance with safety and formatting policies. For many practitioners, however, assembling domain-specific supervised data to post-train models to meet these requirements is infeasible. We introduce CAPO (Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization), a primal-dual method that combines pool-based rewrites with adaptive constraint weighting to optimize system prompts under explicit operational constraints. Across agentic benchmarks, CAPO more reliably reaches empirically feasible operating points while improving task performance. CAPO also generalizes beyond agentic settings, achieving strong results on assistant-style evaluations with output-format and safety/privacy constraints. We further introduce DCAPO (Dynamically Trained CAPO), which trains a feedback- and dual-conditioned rewriter with pool-based GRPO while keeping the task agent frozen. Across task agents of different sizes, DCAPO produces a feasible prompt in every evaluated domain and matches or improves the task accuracy achieved by the evaluated baselines. A surrogate analysis characterizes how finite-pool and discrete-rewrite errors enter the inexact primal-dual procedure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAPO（约束感知提示优化）方法，通过池化重写与自适应约束加权，在显式操作约束下优化系统提示词。进一步提出DCAPO，用基于反馈和双条件的重写器配合池化GRPO动态训练，在保持任务智能体冻结的情况下生成可行提示，并在多个智能体基准上提升任务性能。
AI.motivation: LLM作为依赖系统提示词的智能体部署时，需满足工具使用、简洁提示、安全与格式合规等操作约束。但许多实践者无法构建领域特定的监督数据来微调模型以满足这些要求，因此需要一种无需大量监督数据的提示词优化方法。
AI.method: CAPO采用原始-对偶（primal-dual）方法，结合池化提示词重写和自适应约束加权；DCAPO在此基础上训练一个以反馈和对偶变量为条件的重写器，使用池化GRPO训练，同时保持任务智能体冻结不动。
AI.result: 在智能体基准上，CAPO能更可靠地达到经验上可行的操作点并提升任务性能；DCAPO在不同规模任务智能体上均能生成可行提示，达到或超越基线任务准确率；代理分析刻画了有限池和离散重写误差对不精确原始-对偶过程的影响。
AI.conclusion: CAPO和DCAPO展示了在无监督微调条件下，通过提示词优化即可满足系统级操作约束并保持/提升任务性能的可能性，且方法可泛化到助手式评估场景。

title: GATTA: Graph Active Learning with Test-Time Augmentation
summary: Test-time augmentation (TTA) has proven effective for improving model robustness and uncertainty estimation in computer vision, yet its application to graph-structured data remains largely unexplored. We introduce GATTA (Graph Active Learning with Test-Time Augmentation), a framework for enhancing active learning by aggregating predictions across multiple augmented views to produce more reliable uncertainty estimates. To address the challenge of label-preserving graph augmentations, GATTA incorporates a consistency-based filtering mechanism that discards augmented views yielding unreliable predictions. We systematically evaluate GATTA across multiple graph datasets, GNN architectures, and acquisition strategies. Our results show that simple uncertainty-based methods, such as Entropy and Least Confidence, benefit most from TTA, achieving performance competitive with more sophisticated and computationally expensive approaches. GATTA generalizes across architectures, outperforms model-side ensemble methods such as MC Dropout. We further show that GATTA scales efficiently with both ensemble size and graph size. Extensive analysis of augmentation types, strengths, and filtering strategies provides practical guidelines for effective deployment. Our findings demonstrate that augmenting simple methods with TTA offers a more efficient path to strong active learning performance than engineering complex acquisition functions, enabling practitioners to achieve competitive results with lower computational overhead and reduced implementation complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GATTA框架，首次将测试时增强（TTA）应用于图数据的主动学习中，通过聚合多个增强视图的预测来产生更可靠的模型不确定性估计，并使用基于一致性的过滤机制去除不可靠的增强视图，从而用简单的采样策略达到与复杂方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 测试时增强在计算机视觉中已被证明能有效提升模型鲁棒性和不确定性估计，但在图结构数据上的应用尚未被探索。主动学习中可靠的不确定性估计至关重要，而现有的简单方法（如熵、最小置信度）性能有限，复杂方法虽好但计算开销大。作者旨在探索是否能用TTA增强简单的不确定性方法，以较低成本达到复杂方法的性能。
AI.method: GATTA框架包含三个核心部分：(1) 对图数据进行多种增强（如特征扰动、边扰动等）生成多个视图，并聚合各视图的预测以获得更可靠的不确定性估计；(2) 针对图增强难以保证标签保持的问题，引入基于一致性的过滤机制，剔除产生不可靠预测的增强视图；(3) 将聚合后的不确定性用于各种主动学习采样策略（如熵、最小置信度等），指导样本选择。
AI.result: 实验表明：简单的不确定性方法（熵、最小置信度）在结合TTA后获益最大，性能可与更复杂昂贵的方法竞争；GATTA在不同GNN架构上表现稳定，优于MC Dropout等模型侧集成方法；在集成规模和图规模上均展现出良好的可扩展性；对增强类型、强度及过滤策略的深入分析提供了实用部署指南。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明：用TTA增强简单方法比设计复杂的采集函数更高效，能在降低计算开销和实现复杂度的同时达到竞争力的主动学习性能，为实际部署提供了更简明的路径选择。

title: GraphLoom: Reliability-Calibrated Graph Evidence Routing for Multimodal KG-RAG
summary: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems often rely on long unstructured contexts or aggressively expanded evidence graphs, which can introduce noisy evidence, weaken multi-hop reasoning, and increase unsupported generation. We present GraphLoom, a reliability-calibrated multimodal knowledge-graph RAG framework for compact and faithful evidence routing. Given a question and its associated multimodal input, GraphLoom constructs an instance-level multimodal knowledge graph from grounded scene descriptions, extracted relational triples, and external commonsense knowledge. Instead of injecting all retrieved evidence into the generator, GraphLoom performs reliability-aware subgraph retrieval with bounded expansion and selectively routes high-utility evidence through hierarchical graph memory slots and joint graph-sequence attention in a frozen language model. To improve robustness in complex reasoning settings, GraphLoom further combines interleaved retrieval with budgeted corrective retrieval, enabling adaptive multi-hop evidence refinement under noisy retrieval conditions. We evaluate GraphLoom on ScienceQA, MultiModalQA, and OK-VQA, including large distractor evidence pools that approximate noisy external knowledge retrieval. Experimental results show consistent gains in answer quality and evidence faithfulness over strong multimodal RAG, graph-retrieval, and open-source vision-language baselines, with improved retrieval quality on MultiModalQA and stable performance under noisy evidence pools. Additional analyses using MiniCheck-based verification, human evaluation, and latency profiling show that reliability-calibrated graph evidence routing provides an effective alternative to long-context multimodal evidence injection.

AI.tldr: GraphLoom是一个可靠性校准的多模态知识图谱RAG框架，通过构建实例级多模态知识图谱、可靠性感知的子图检索和有界扩展，以及层级图记忆槽与联合图-序列注意力机制，实现紧凑且忠实的证据路由，避免了长上下文或过度扩展证据图带来的噪声问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态RAG系统依赖长非结构化上下文或过度扩展的证据图，这会导致噪声证据引入、削弱多跳推理能力，并增加无依据生成的风险。
AI.method: 1) 从场景描述、关系三元组和外部常识构建实例级多模态知识图谱；2) 使用可靠性感知的子图检索和有界扩展；3) 通过层级图记忆槽和冻结语言模型中的联合图-序列注意力路由高效用证据；4) 结合交错检索和预算校正检索，实现噪声条件下的自适应多跳证据细化。
AI.result: 在ScienceQA、MultiModalQA和OK-VQA上，包括含大量干扰证据池的噪声环境下，GraphLoom在答案质量和证据忠实度上均优于强多模态RAG、图检索和开源视觉语言基线，且在MultiModalQA上检索质量提升，噪声环境下性能稳定。
AI.conclusion: 通过MiniCheck验证、人工评估和延迟分析表明，可靠性校准的图证据路由是长上下文多模态证据注入的有效替代方案。

title: Skill2Query: Exploiting Skill Structure to Generate Pseudo-Queries for Agent Skill Retrieval
summary: Pseudo-query generation can alleviate the supervision bottleneck for agent skill retrieval, but existing document-level approaches typically leave the rich internal relations among capabilities, parameters, and usage examples implicit. As a result, generated queries may be topically relevant to a skill while lacking capability grounding and parameter consistency, raising the question of whether explicitly exploiting a skill document's internal structure can produce more effective retrieval signals. We therefore propose Skill2Query, a framework that first parses a skill document into a Skill Knowledge Graph and then generates pseudo-queries through a three-stage process including style mimicking, query template generation, and parameter filling. The generated queries can be used for offline index augmentation, online query expansion, and retriever training. Four benchmarks (TheoremQA, LogicBench, ToolQA, and CHAMP) are used to evaluate Skill2Query with large-scale skill candidate pools across multiple downstream applications, including skill retrieval, retriever training, and end-to-end agent execution. Using nearly 30K skills across diverse domains, we generate 700K category-diverse pseudo-queries. Skill2Query consistently improves sparse, dense, and skill-routing retrieval, with an average Recall@1 gain of 6.70 percentage points across retrieval settings. Skill2Query-generated training data also achieves the best Recall@1 and nDCG@1 among the evaluated generation baselines. Further evaluations with multiple LLM backends demonstrate that improved skill retrieval translates into higher agent task success rates. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/MatZaharia/Skill2Query.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Skill2Query框架，通过将技能文档解析为技能知识图谱，并采用风格模仿、查询模板生成和参数填充三阶段流程生成伪查询，以显式利用技能文档内部结构来提升代理技能检索效果。在近3万个技能上生成70万条伪查询，平均Recall@1提升6.70个百分点，并在技能检索、检索器训练及端到端代理执行等多个下游任务中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有文档级别的伪查询生成方法忽略了技能文档中能力、参数和用法示例之间的内部关联，导致生成的查询虽然主题相关但缺乏能力基础一致性（capability grounding）和参数一致性（parameter consistency），因此作者希望探究显式利用技能文档内部结构能否生成更有效的检索信号。
AI.method: Skill2Query框架包含两个核心步骤：首先将技能文档解析为技能知识图谱（Skill Knowledge Graph），然后通过三阶段流程生成伪查询：1）风格模仿（style mimicking）、2）查询模板生成（query template generation）、3）参数填充（parameter filling）。生成的查询可用于离线索引增强、在线查询扩展和检索器训练。
AI.result: 在TheoremQA、LogicBench、ToolQA和CHAMP四个基准上，使用近30K个技能生成700K条类别多样的伪查询。Skill2Query在稀疏、稠密和技能路由检索上均取得一致提升，平均Recall@1提高6.70个百分点；其生成的训练数据在Recall@1和nDCG@1上优于其他生成基线；多个LLM后端的进一步评估表明改进的技能检索可提升代理任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用技能文档内部结构（知识图谱）进行伪查询生成能够产生更有效的检索信号，显著提升代理技能检索性能及端到端代理执行的任务成功率，验证了结构感知的伪查询生成方法的价值。

title: EMASAM: a Computationally Efficient Sharpness-Aware Minimization via EMA-Guided Perturbations
comment: Accepted in ICPR2026. The project page can be accessed at https://www.vip.sc.eng.isct.ac.jp/proj/EMASAM
summary: Recent progress in optimization research has highlighted the sharpness of the loss landscape as a key factor in narrowing the generalization gap. Motivated by this insight, Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) was proposed as a training strategy that enhances generalization. Despite the promising performance, SAM suffers from its twice computational cost due to its core algorithm requiring an extra gradient computation during the perturbation step. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Exponential Moving Average Sharpness-Aware Minimization (EMASAM), a computationally efficient variant of SAM. EMASAM does not require the loss gradient in the perturbation step. Instead, EMASAM defines the perturbation direction based on the discrepancy between the main model and the EMA shadow model. This perturbation travels away from the stable average position toward the less stable area, acting as a softer yet cheaper alternative to SAM's worst-case scenario perturbation. Moreover, since EMASAM's perturbation does not rely on noisy mini-batch gradients, it mitigates the gradient-induced instability inherent in SAM. Hence, EMASAM eliminates the need for an extra backpropagation while also preserving the generalization ability of the SAM-style training. Several experiments have been performed and confirm the efficiency and robustness of our method.

AI.tldr: EMASAM是一种计算高效的SAM变体，通过使用EMA影子模型与主模型之间的差异来定义扰动方向，替代SAM中需要额外梯度计算的扰动步骤，从而在消除额外反向传播开销的同时保持SAM风格训练的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: SAM虽然通过利用损失景观的锐度来提升泛化性能，但其核心算法在扰动步骤中需要额外计算一次梯度，导致训练成本翻倍。为克服这一计算瓶颈，需要设计一种无需额外梯度计算但仍能保持SAM泛化优势的替代方案。
AI.method: EMASAM在扰动步骤中不计算损失梯度，而是利用主模型与EMA影子模型之间的参数差异来定义扰动方向。该扰动方向使模型远离稳定的平均位置，朝向较不稳定区域移动，作为一种更温和且更便宜的可替代SAM最坏情况扰动的方案。由于扰动不依赖有噪声的小批量梯度，还能缓解SAM固有的梯度不稳定性。
AI.result: 多项实验验证了EMASAM方法的效率和鲁棒性，确认其在消除额外反向传播需求的同时，保留了SAM风格训练的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EMASAM成功解决了SAM计算成本翻倍的问题，通过EMA扰动方向策略实现了计算效率与泛化能力的双重保障，是一种兼具效率和鲁棒性的优化方法。

title: LongDocBench: Benchmarking TOC Hierarchy and Contextual Relationship Recovery in Long Documents
comment: preprint, under review
summary: Parsing visual documents into machine-readable representations is fundamental to document intelligence. Existing benchmarks focus on page-level element recognition, reading order, formula recognition, and table structure. Long documents, however, also require document-level structure recovery. This includes reconstructing cross-page table-of-contents (TOC) hierarchies and identifying typed links from tables and figures to their captions, notes, and sources, often in one-to-many form. Because these structures are covered only partially or subsumed within broader parsing protocols, existing benchmarks cannot directly evaluate two key document-level tasks: \emph{Table-of-Contents Hierarchy Recovery} and \emph{Contextual Relationship Recovery}. To benchmark these two tasks, we introduce \textsc{LongDocBench}, comprising 85 real-world financial reports, textbooks, and academic papers spanning 2,582 pages, with up to 105 pages per document. It provides human-verified annotations for 3,937 heading nodes (mean node depth 3.55; maximum depth 9) and 3,258 contextual relationships annotated across 2,680 table and figure objects. We further evaluate both the downstream utility and recoverability of these structures. Long-document question-answering experiments show that human-verified TOC hierarchies and contextual relationships improve reasoning, with their combination providing complementary benefits. Meanwhile, representative document parsers remain limited on both recovery tasks despite strong page-level performance. To support further progress, we publicly release \textsc{LongDocBench} and its evaluation protocol and reproducible testbed for advancing document-level structure recovery in long documents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LongDocBench基准，用于评估长文档的文档级结构恢复任务，包括目录层级恢复和上下文关系恢复，包含85篇真实文档、2582页、3937个标题节点和3258条上下文关系标注，实验表明人类验证的结构能提升长文档问答性能，而现有文档解析器在这两个任务上表现有限。
AI.motivation: 现有文档解析基准仅关注页面级元素识别（版面、阅读顺序、公式、表格结构），缺少对长文档文档级结构（跨页目录层级、图表与标题/注释/来源的链接关系）的评估能力，因此无法直接衡量两个关键任务：目录层级恢复和上下文关系恢复。
AI.method: 构建包含85篇真实财务报告、教科书和学术论文的LongDocBench基准（2582页，单文档最长105页），提供人工验证的3937个标题节点（平均深度3.55，最大深度9）和3258条跨2680个图表对象的上下文关系标注，并设计了相应的评估协议和可复现测试平台。
AI.result: 长文档问答实验表明，人类验证的目录层级和上下文关系能提升推理性能，且两者结合具有互补效益；代表性文档解析器在页面级任务上表现良好，但在两个文档级恢复任务上仍能力有限。
AI.conclusion: LongDocBench公开发布，为长文档文档级结构恢复研究提供了评测基准、评估协议和可复现测试平台，以推动该方向进一步发展。

title: HyperSkill: Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Hypergraph-Structured Skill Memory
comment: 25 pages
summary: As agentic tasks grow in complexity, LLM agents increasingly rely on experiential memory to reuse procedural knowledge across tasks. Effective memory design must jointly address what to store, how memory is structured and retrieved, and how memory evolves. Existing systems tackle each only partially: they store trajectories, insights, or workflows as isolated entries, discarding compositional relationships among subtasks and reusable skills; retrieve by flat embedding similarity that ignores relational signals; and maintain memory without leveraging its relational structure. We propose HyperSkill, a hypergraph-based memory framework that jointly improves all three. HyperSkill represents memory as a hypergraph with two node types, subtask steps and reusable skills, where each hyperedge links the subtasks and skills from a single trajectory. Dual-path retrieval queries both subtask and trajectory levels, ranking skills by co-occurrence across retrieved trajectories. Periodic structure-informed maintenance prunes low-utility nodes and merges redundant skills via quality-weighted propagation. Across xBench, GAIA, and WebWalkerQA with GPT-4o and Qwen3-30B-A3B, HyperSkill outperforms ten memory baselines, yielding gains of up to +11.51 on GAIA and +11.18 on WebWalkerQA.

AI.tldr: HyperSkill提出了一种基于超图的记忆框架，用于增强LLM代理在复杂任务中的经验记忆。它将记忆建模为包含子任务步骤和可复用技能两种节点的超图，通过超边连接单条轨迹中的子任务和技能，并采用双路径检索和周期性结构感知维护，在xBench、GAIA和WebWalkerQA上超越十个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理的记忆系统存在三个不足：1) 将轨迹、见解或工作流作为孤立条目存储，忽略了子任务与可复用技能之间的组合关系；2) 仅通过扁平嵌入相似度检索，无法利用关系信号；3) 维护记忆时不利用其关系结构。因此需要一个能同时改进存储、检索和维护三个环节的记忆框架。
AI.method: HyperSkill包含三个核心组件：1) 超图存储：以子任务步骤和可复用技能为两类节点，每条轨迹的超边将相关子任务与技能关联起来；2) 双路径检索：同时在子任务层和轨迹层进行查询，根据技能在检索到的轨迹中的共现频率进行排序；3) 周期性结构感知维护：剪除低效用节点，并通过质量加权传播合并冗余技能。
AI.result: 在xBench、GAIA和WebWalkerQA基准上，搭配GPT-4o和Qwen3-30B-A3B，HyperSkill超越了十个记忆基线方法，在GAIA上最高提升+11.51，在WebWalkerQA上最高提升+11.18。
AI.conclusion: HyperSkill通过超图建模统一了记忆的存储、检索和维护三个环节，证明了利用关系结构（而非孤立条目）能显著提升LLM代理在复杂任务中的记忆效果，为代理记忆设计提供了新的方向。

title: Global Federated Learning Strategies for Building Efficient Personalized Models
comment: Ph.D. dissertation, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), February 2026
summary: Federated learning (FL) is a practical framework that can train models on distributed user data while guaranteeing data privacy; however, due to heterogeneity in which each user has a different data distribution, problems frequently arise where both global and personalization performance deteriorate simultaneously. This dissertation presents methodologies for building efficient personalized models by identifying which strategies are effective in the global training stage and by showing how to preserve global knowledge while securing user-specific performance during local adaptation. First, we show that as data heterogeneity increases, the collapse of feature vectors is a more fundamental bottleneck than classifier weights, and propose a method that directly mitigates the discrepancy in representation magnitude between local and global models. Second, we analyze that a training approach that strengthens local alignment can induce forgetting of global knowledge (e.g., categories not observed locally), and propose a method that achieves both local alignment and global knowledge preservation by combining feature distillation based on the global model's feature vectors. Third, in federated personalized reward model learning with preference heterogeneity, we empirically verify the conventional belief that "increasing the number of global models yields better initialization," and we show that when sufficient local fine-tuning is allowed, a single global initialization can instead provide stronger personalization performance. This study redefines the role of global initialization under data and preference heterogeneity and provides practical training strategies that simultaneously satisfy global knowledge preservation and personalization.

AI.tldr: 本文针对联邦学习(FL)中数据异构性导致全局和个性化性能同时恶化的问题，提出构建高效个性化模型的系统方法论：一是证明特征向量坍缩比分类器权重更根本，提出缓解局部与全局模型表示幅度差异的方法；二是分析局部对齐会诱发全局知识遗忘，提出结合全局模型特征蒸馏的局部对齐与全局知识保留方法；三是通过实验颠覆"更多全局模型初始化更好"的传统认知，证明在允许充分局部微调时，单一全局初始化反而提供更强个性化性能。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习虽能保护隐私地训练分布式数据，但数据异构性会导致全局和个性化性能同时恶化，这是一个尚未被系统解决的瓶颈问题，亟需明确全局训练阶段哪些策略真正有效，以及如何在局部适应中保留全局知识同时保障用户特定性能。
AI.method: 本文采用三条研究路径：(1)理论分析+方法提出——揭示数据异构性增大时特征向量坍缩比分类器权重更关键，提出直接缓解局部与全局模型表示幅度差异的方法；(2)机制分析+蒸馏融合——分析局部对齐训练诱发全局知识遗忘（如未见类别）的机理，提出基于全局模型特征蒸馏的融合方法；(3)实证验证——在偏好异构的联邦个性化奖励模型学习中，系统比较不同数量的全局模型初始化与局部微调条件下的个性化性能，实证检验传统假设。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1)特征向量坍缩是异构场景下更基本的瓶颈，所提方法可有效缓解表示幅度差异；(2)所提特征蒸馏方法能同时实现局部对齐与全局知识保留；(3)实证推翻传统认知——当允许充分局部微调时，单一全局初始化反而优于多个全局模型，重新定义了全局初始化的角色。
AI.conclusion: 本文重新界定了数据与偏好异构下全局初始化的作用，提供了能同时满足全局知识保留与个性化需求的实用训练策略，为联邦学习中的个性化建模提供了系统性的理论分析和实践指导。

title: Funnel of Thoughts: Efficient Test-Time Scaling via Early Voting and Rollout Pruning
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures
summary: Large Reasoning Models produce diverse, sometimes inconsistent answers across repeated queries on the same problem, so multi-sample inference is a prerequisite for reliable deployment. Majority voting at k rollouts is the standard solution and the de facto accuracy target for this regime, but it is prohibitively expensive at the scale LRMs require. We introduce Funnel of Thoughts (FoT), an inference-time method that preserves the full 32-trajectory voted accuracy while halving its attention FLOPs, a 28.8% reduction in full-model inference cost. Across 115K reasoning trajectories from six LRMs, we find that unproductive trajectories often reveal themselves through repeated hesitation markers such as "Wait", "Actually", and "perhaps." These trajectories are less likely to reach the correct answer and consume disproportionate attention FLOPs, degenerating into no-answer loops in the worst case. Built on this training-free lexical signal, FoT identifies the vocabulary that captures these pathological patterns and prunes affected trajectories before completion, reducing online generation attention FLOPs by 56.1% and wall time by 37.6% without any additional model inference; the same signal transfers without retuning across held-out architectures and out-of-domain tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Funnel of Thoughts (FoT)，一种推理时方法，通过识别大型推理模型输出中的犹豫标记（如"Wait"、"Actually"、"perhaps"）来提前剪除低质量轨迹，在不损失32轨迹投票准确率的前提下，将注意力FLOPs减半，全模型推理成本降低28.8%，在线生成注意力FLOPs降低56.1%，墙钟时间降低37.6%。该方法无需训练，且信号可跨架构和跨领域迁移。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在相同问题上多次查询会产生多样且有时不一致的答案，因此多样本推理是可靠部署的前提。多数投票需要大量rollout（如32条轨迹），成本极其高昂，亟需一种能保持投票准确率但大幅降低推理成本的方法。
AI.method: FoT基于一个无需训练的词汇信号：低质量轨迹常通过重复的犹豫标记（"Wait"、"Actually"、"perhaps"等）暴露自身。方法首先识别捕获这些病理模式的词汇表，然后在轨迹完成前提前剪除受影响轨迹，从而减少在线生成的注意力FLOPs和墙钟时间，且无需额外的模型推理。
AI.result: 在115K推理轨迹和六个大型推理模型上验证，FoT保持完整32轨迹投票准确率，将注意力FLOPs减半（全模型推理成本降低28.8%），在线生成注意力FLOPs减少56.1%，墙钟时间减少37.6%。该信号无需重新调整即可跨保留架构和跨域任务迁移。
AI.conclusion: FoT证明了一个简单且可解释的词汇信号（犹豫标记）能够有效识别低质量推理轨迹并提前剪除，在保持准确率的同时显著降低推理成本，且具有良好的跨架构和跨任务泛化能力，为大型推理模型的高效大规模部署提供了实用方案。

title: QUMem: Personalized Memory for Query-Conditioned User-State Inference in LLM Agents
comment: 9pages,3figures
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use external memory systems to support personalization by drawing on long and evolving interaction histories, in which user preferences may be distributed across time, change with context, and conflict with earlier evidence. However, existing systems face three limitations: fixed-turn, fixed-token, or session-based boundaries can mix unrelated dialogue or split an event from its causes, decisions, and outcomes; storing multiple pieces of user information from the same interaction as a single memory binds together items that serve different functions and should be independently retrievable; and treating the current task as a single top-$k$ retrieval query can return fragments that are individually relevant but fail to jointly capture preference evolution, temporal validity, and contextual applicability. We introduce \textsc{QUMem}, a structured memory framework for query-conditioned user-state inference. \textsc{QUMem} first segments interaction histories into variable-length episodes according to semantic continuity, then decomposes each episode into independently retrievable factual, preference, and transferable insight memories while preserving temporal positions and source evidence. At inference time, three sequential agents identify task-specific information needs, plan multi-query retrieval over the typed memory stores, and jointly infer a temporally and contextually valid user state for downstream response generation. \textsc{QUMem} achieves state-of-the-art performance on both PersonaMem and KnowU-Bench, demonstrating the effectiveness of query-conditioned user-state inference for long-term personalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QUMem，一个基于查询条件的结构化记忆框架，用于LLM智能体的长期个性化。它通过将交互历史分割为变长情节、分解为可独立检索的三种类型记忆（事实、偏好、可迁移见解），并在推理时使用三个顺序智能体进行信息需求识别、多查询检索和用户状态联合推断，在PersonaMem和KnowU-Bench上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有外部记忆系统存在三个局限：(1)固定轮次/令牌/会话的边界划分会混合无关对话或割裂事件与其因果链条；(2)将同一交互的多条用户信息存储为单一记忆，导致功能不同的条目被绑定而无法独立检索；(3)将当前任务视为单一top-k检索查询，返回的片段虽各自相关但无法共同捕捉偏好的演化、时间有效性和上下文适用性。
AI.method: QUMem框架包含三个核心步骤：(1)根据语义连续性将交互历史分割为可变长度的情节（episodes）；(2)将每个情节分解为可独立检索的事实记忆、偏好记忆和可迁移见解记忆，同时保留时间位置和来源证据；(3)推理时使用三个顺序智能体：第一个识别任务特定信息需求，第二个规划对类型化记忆库的多查询检索，第三个联合推断时间上和上下文上有效的用户状态，用于下游响应生成。
AI.result: QUMem在PersonaMem和KnowU-Bench两个基准上均达到最先进（SOTA）性能，验证了查询条件用户状态推断对长期个性化任务的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 查询条件的用户状态推断（QUMem）通过结构化记忆分解和精细化检索规划，能有效解决长期个性化中偏好随时间演化、上下文变化以及证据冲突等问题，显著优于现有方法。

title: Probability-Preserving Transformer for the Time-Dependent Schrödinger Equation
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures
summary: Solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation (TDSE) via traditional numerical methods is computationally intensive. Transformer models offer a compelling alternative, but standard implementations rely on soft constraints that cannot rigorously guarantee probability conservation. Here, we introduce a Transformer architecture that enforces TDSE probability conservation as a hard constraint. The design intrinsically ensures unitarity across temporal evolution without requiring repeated retraining. Our empirical findings show that this hard-constraint approach is not only physically exact but also computationally superior to conventional soft-constraint methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将时间依赖薛定谔方程（TDSE）概率守恒作为硬约束的Transformer架构，该设计固有地保证时间演化过程中的酉性，无需重复训练，且实验表明该方法在物理精确性和计算效率上均优于传统软约束方法。
AI.motivation: 传统数值方法求解TDSE计算开销巨大，虽然Transformer模型可作为替代方案，但标准实现仅依赖软约束，无法严格保证概率守恒，缺乏物理上的严谨性。
AI.method: 在Transformer架构中引入硬约束机制，将TDSE的概率守恒（即酉性）内嵌于网络设计中，使得时间演化过程天然满足物理约束，无需依赖软约束的惩罚项或反复训练。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，硬约束方法不仅在物理上精确（严格满足概率守恒），而且在计算性能上优于传统的软约束方法。
AI.conclusion: 将物理守恒律作为硬约束嵌入Transformer架构，是求解TDSE的更优方案，兼顾了物理准确性与计算效率。

title: Evo-Harness: Context-to-Harness Skill Compilation for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Learning from experience is critical for developing capable, self-improving large language model (LLM) agents. Existing methods typically extract knowledge from accumulated trajectories via reflection, memory, rules, or skills. However, agents in realistic environments continuously encounter novel tasks, often offering only a one-shot opportunity to improve. These executions yield rich but highly noisy contexts, entangling broadly useful lessons with task-specific artifacts. Critically, prior works rarely validate their effectiveness on complex real-world tasks or isolate the underlying drivers of improvement. To address these gaps, we formulate online harness learning, where a frozen agent improves by continually updating a structured harness across sequential tasks. This formulation enables a systematic study of key self-improvement factors through our proposed Evo-Harness. At its core, context-to-harness skill compilation distills noisy, single-shot executions into reusable skill harnesses for cross-domain and topic-level adaptation. To demonstrate the efficacy of one-shot skill compilation, we evaluate across five realistic benchmarks (TerminalBench2, SWE-bench, CL-Bench, -bench, WebArena-Infinity). Our extensive analysis demonstrates the effectiveness of Evo-Harness and provides a principled understanding of how LLM agents can effectively learn on the fly. Our code is available at https://github.com/A-EVO-Lab/a-evolve/tree/release/evo-harness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Evo-Harness框架，解决LLM智能体在现实环境中面临的一次性学习机会问题。通过在线收割学习（online harness learning），智能体在不断更新结构化harness的过程中，从高频噪声的单次执行轨迹中提取可复用的技能，并在五个真实世界基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过反思、记忆、规则或技能从累积轨迹中提取知识，但现实环境中智能体常常面临全新任务且只有一次学习机会。这些单次执行产生丰富但高度噪声的上下文，混杂了通用经验与任务特定伪影。此外，已有工作很少在复杂真实任务上验证效果，也未隔离改进的关键驱动因素。
AI.method: 提出Evo-Harness框架，核心是上下文到harness的技能编译（context-to-harness skill compilation），将噪声的单次执行轨迹蒸馏为可复用的技能harness，支持跨领域和主题级别适应性。冻结的智能体通过不断更新结构化harness在序列任务中持续改进。
AI.result: 在五个现实基准（TerminalBench2、SWE-bench、CL-Bench、-bench、WebArena-Infinity）上评估，证明了单次技能编译的有效性，并提供了对LLM智能体在线学习机制的深入分析。
AI.conclusion: Evo-Harness验证了在线收割学习的可行性，为LLM智能体如何有效从经验中即兴学习提供了原则性理解，代码已开源。

title: LENS: In-Context Search via Latent Evidence Exploration over Dynamic Raw Documents
summary:
LLM agents increasingly answer questions over dynamic raw-document collections, where files may change before preprocessing, and relevant evidence (spans, sections, pages, or tables) is query-dependent. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches pre-materialize evidence via fixed chunking, embeddings, or persistent indexes: effective for lookup, yet costly, stale-prone, and committed to a granularity before the query is known.
  We formulate in-context search as Budgeted Evidence Localization over a latent evidence space induced by dynamic raw documents and propose LENS (Latent Evidence Exploration and Search), an index-free framework. Instead of pre-materializing the evidence space, LENS maintains a query-conditioned belief over candidate units, iteratively selecting candidates via complementary lexical, local, and exploratory proposal policies, updating the belief via an LLM relevance oracle, and narrowing toward high-posterior regions under a controllable budget. Evidence is consolidated into compact, source-grounded regions of interest and compressed into self-organizing knowledge clusters reused across related queries.
  On a controlled 500-question evaluation with matched corpus snapshots, LENS reaches 62.4% exact match and 84.8% evidence recall vs. 65.2% exact match but 50.4% evidence recall for a ReAct-style baseline. Across scales, LENS gives the strongest supporting-fact localization and answer grounding. On a fixed 150-question fullwiki subset over the raw Wikipedia dump with zero indexing, LENS and ReAct are nearly tied in official answer quality (43.3% vs. 42.7% EM), with LENS grounding more answers in retrieved evidence (84.0% vs. 70.7%). A no-retrieval Closed-Book reference highlights the contribution of model memory. LENS is query-ready after corpus changes, needs no preprocessing or persistent index, and preserves source-grounded evidence localization throughout.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LENS（潜证据探索与搜索）框架，解决动态原始文档集合上的预算受限证据定位问题。与现有预物化索引方法不同，LENS无需预处理或持久索引，通过查询条件信念更新和互补的提案策略迭代定位证据，在可控预算下压缩为知识簇。实验表明LENS在证据定位和答案依据方面表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法预先通过固定分块、嵌入或持久索引物化证据，存在成本高、易过期、且在查询未知前就承诺了粒度的问题。动态文档环境下，文档可能在预处理前变更，而相关证据（片段、章节、页面或表格）依赖于查询，需要一种无需预物化的检索方法。
AI.method: LENS采用索引无关框架，维护查询条件下的候选单元信念，通过互补的词法、局部和探索性提案策略迭代选择候选，利用LLM相关性地标更新信念，在可控预算下收敛至高后验区域。证据被整合为紧凑的来源锚定兴趣区域，并压缩为自组织知识簇以跨相关查询复用。
AI.result: 在500问控制评估中，LENS达到62.4%精确匹配和84.8%证据召回（对比ReAct基线65.2%精确匹配但仅50.4%证据召回）。在全Wiki子集的150问固定评估（零索引原始Wikipedia dump）中，LENS与ReAct官方答案质量接近（43.3% vs 42.7% EM），但LENS在检索证据上的答案依据率更高（84.0% vs 70.7%）。
AI.conclusion: LENS在动态文档环境下查询即可就绪，无需预处理或持久索引，始终保留来源锚定的证据定位。实验证明其在证据定位和答案依据方面优于基线，但模型记忆对最终答案质量有重要贡献，闭卷参考实验突显了这一因素。

title: Beyond Thresholds: A Quality-Aware Decision Intelligence Framework for Cold Chain IoT Systems
summary:
Cold chain logistics has advanced technologically, yet most deployed systems remain reactive monitors, not decision-making agents: thresholds trigger alerts, but nothing relates violations to cumulative product degradation or converts degradation signals into logistics decisions. We address this gap with a Quality-Aware Decision Intelligence (QADI) framework combining three capabilities: a structured quality state representation, $S_q = [L, Q, U, R]$ -- remaining shelf life, degradation rate, estimation uncertainty, and operational risk, all derived and computable from the framework equations; a hybrid quality modeling layer combining physics-based microbial kinetics with a data-driven correction term; and a reasoning layer built on Microsoft Phi-4~\cite{Phi4} with retrieval-augmented generation over a structured domain knowledge base.
  We benchmark against five baselines -- threshold monitoring, physics-only, physics-plus-noise, optimisation-based decisions, and a rule-based expert system -- across eight cold chain scenarios, using pasteurised milk as the primary case, with ground truth shelf-life drawn from published dairy studies~\cite{Singh1994, Smigic2015} independent of our model. Comparisons use Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction. Across milk and broccoli scenarios, the framework attains mean absolute shelf-life error of 7.2 hours (versus 30.9 hours, physics-only; $p<0.001$), spoilage rate of 14.5% (versus 16.6%, physics-only and rule-based; p=0.08), and oracle-optimal decisions in 99.5% of scenarios. Removing the LLM reasoning component drops optimality to 45.5% ($p<0.001$). Expert-rated explanation quality reaches 83% ($κ= 0.71$). Ablations show hybrid modeling and LLM reasoning contribute distinct gains, while RAG retrieval mainly drives explanation quality. Code: https://bit.ly/4d6t44C.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QADI框架，将冷链物流从被动监控升级为主动决策：结合结构化质量状态表示、混合质量建模（物理+数据驱动）和基于LLM（Phi-4）+ RAG的推理层，在八个冷链场景中相比五种基线实现了显著更优的货架期预测精度和决策最优性。
AI.motivation: 现有冷链物流系统大多只是反应式监控（阈值触发警报），无法将违规与累积产品质量退化关联，也无法将退化信号转化为物流决策，缺乏真正的决策智能。
AI.method: 提出QADI框架，包含三层能力：(1) 结构化质量状态表示S_q=[L,Q,U,R]（剩余货架期、退化率、估计不确定性、运营风险）；(2) 混合质量建模层，结合基于物理的微生物动力学与数据驱动修正项；(3) 基于Microsoft Phi-4的推理层，采用检索增强生成（RAG）结合结构化领域知识库。
AI.result: 在牛奶和西兰花场景中：平均绝对货架期误差7.2小时（纯物理模型30.9小时，p<0.001）；腐败率14.5%（对比16.6%）；99.5%场景达到oracle最优决策；移除LLM推理后最优性降至45.5%（p<0.001）；专家评分解释质量达83%（κ=0.71）。消融实验显示混合建模和LLM推理贡献不同增益，RAG主要提升解释质量。
AI.conclusion: QADI框架证明将质量感知与决策智能结合能显著提升冷链管理效果，LLM推理和混合建模是决策最优性的关键组件，RAG主要增强解释的可信度，为冷链物流从被动监控向主动智能决策转型提供了可行路径。

title: STAIR: Semantic-Temporal Automaton for Interpretable Reasoning in Temporal Question Answering
summary: By leveraging large-scale pretraining, LLMs can interpret diverse temporal expressions and question formulations without task-specific training. However, existing prompt-based neuro-symbolic systems continue to rely on LLMs for both semantic interpretation and exact temporal inference. Consequently, discrete decisions regarding intervals, time anchors, and ordered states remain vulnerable to probabilistic errors and difficult to verify. We present STAIR, a \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{T}emporal \textbf{A}utomaton for \textbf{I}nterpretable \textbf{R}easoning. STAIR separates semantic interpretation from precise temporal inference: an answer-free LLM adapter maps complex question formulations to normalized temporal intents, while a deterministic temporal automaton with finite control and guarded transitions executes the corresponding policies over canonicalized evidence. Following a rule-first design, STAIR resolves standard questions without invoking an LLM and applies semantic adaptation only when the rule path fails to produce an executable intent. This approach reduces free-form reasoning, making temporal decisions verifiable and interpretable. Specifically, guarded execution supports precise point-time containment and before/after selection, while semantic adaptation handles non-exact intervals and time-anchored queries. Across the TimeQA-Easy, TimeQA-Hard, TempReason-L2, and TempReason-L3 datasets, STAIR consistently outperforms strong baselines in the TQA task using matched model settings, achieving average F1 improvements of 16.57\% and 3.10\% when utilizing the Qwen2.5-7B and GPT-4o-mini models, respectively. Furthermore, ablations and diagnostic analyses demonstrate that STAIR excels at handling both boundary-sensitive and order-sensitive queries, while its guarded execution and semantic adaptation ensure precise point-time reasoning and inexact intervals, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STAIR框架，将语义解释与精确时间推断分离：LLM仅负责将复杂问题映射为归一化时间意图，而确定性时间自动机负责精确执行时间策略，从而提升时间问答的可靠性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示的神经符号系统依赖LLM同时进行语义解释和精确时间推断，导致离散的时间决策（如区间、时间锚点、顺序状态）易受概率性错误影响且难以验证。
AI.method: STAIR采用规则优先设计：确定性时间自动机（带有限控制和守卫转换）执行规范化的时间策略；当规则路径无法产生可执行意图时，才调用无答案LLM适配器进行语义适应。守卫执行支持精确点时间包含和前后选择，语义适应处理非精确区间和时间锚定查询。
AI.result: 在TimeQA-Easy、TimeQA-Hard、TempReason-L2和TempReason-L3数据集上，STAIR在匹配模型设置下持续优于强基线，使用Qwen2.5-7B和GPT-4o-mini时分别获得16.57%和3.10%的平均F1提升。消融实验显示其在边界敏感和顺序敏感查询上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 通过将精确时间推断从LLM中解耦并由确定性自动机执行，STAIR显著减少自由形式推理，使时间决策可验证、可解释，同时保持对多样问题表述的语义理解能力。

title: PureTD: Reinforcement Learning for Backgammon Money Games with No Evaluation-time Search
summary: We revisit Tesauro's TD-Gammon for backgammon money games in the setting of no evaluation-time search. Both checker play and cube action (use of the doubling cube) are learned from scratch via self-play reinforcement learning (RL), with minimal hand-coded logic and no expert features. In this setting, we demonstrate that pure self-play RL suffices to train models that reach near-state-of-the-art playing strength. Specifically, for cubeful money games, our search-free model evaluates faster and is substantially stronger than the open-source engines GNU Backgammon and Open Sage running a one-move (1-ply) look-ahead search.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视Tesauro的TD-Gammon，在不使用评估时搜索的情况下研究双陆棋金钱游戏。通过自对弈强化学习从零开始学习棋子走法和骰子立方体动作，仅需极少量手工编码逻辑且不使用专家特征。实验表明，纯自对弈强化学习足以训练出接近最先进水平的模型，在无搜索情况下评估更快且显著强于使用1层前瞻搜索的开源引擎GNU Backgammon和Open Sage。
AI.motivation: 验证纯自对弈强化学习（无搜索、无专家特征、极少手工编码）是否能达到接近最先进的游戏水平，重新审视TD-Gammon方法在现代深度学习框架下的潜力。
AI.method: 采用自对弈强化学习框架，从零开始同时学习棋子走法（checker play）和骰子立方体动作（cube action），不使用评估时搜索，仅依赖极少量手工编码逻辑，不引入专家特征。
AI.result: 训练出的无搜索模型在双陆棋金钱游戏中达到接近最先进的水平，评估速度更快，且显著强于采用1层前瞻搜索的开源引擎GNU Backgammon和Open Sage。
AI.conclusion: 纯自对弈强化学习足以在双陆棋任务上达到接近最先进的水平，表明经典TD-Gammon方法在现代计算资源下仍有强大潜力，甚至可以超越带浅层搜索的传统引擎。

title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling
comment: Harness Scaling, Semi-Self-Evolving Agent
summary:
Long-horizon agents can fail even when their underlying models can solve the constituent steps. They may lose track of mutable state, fail to reactivate lessons from earlier executions, skip known procedures, or stop prematurely. We bet on harness scaling to improve the execution system around an agent without changing its model weights. We introduce StateM, an agent-native runtime that organizes execution around durable states, phase-local context, checked transitions, recoverable runbooks, and versioned procedural practices that agents and users can inspect together.
  On Terminal-Bench 2.1, StateM raises GPT-5.5 xhigh to 92.1\%, versus 83.1\% reference and GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra at 91.9\%. The runbook transfers unchanged to GPT-5.6. With GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh, StateM reaches 95.3\% raw accuracy across 445 trials and succeeds on all 89 tasks at least once. The frozen profile raises GPT-5.6 Luna from 76.7 to 85.4\%, above the 84.9\% Sol xhigh reference.
  Using the same runtime, runbook structure, and golden rules, less than \$38 of adaptation raises DeepSeek-V4 Flash from 82.7 to 88.1\% under standard timeouts and to 89.1\% on an 88-task common core. Extending only the remaining latency-sensitive task matches the reported 88.8\% GPT-5.6 Sol max result. Final-score API usage is about \$15 versus \$574.68 for the GPT reference; total DeepSeek expenditure is \$52.22.
  On BusinessBench, family-specific runbooks built on development sets yield held-out gains of 0.55 macro and 1.34 micro points; two mechanism-matched families improve by 10.04 points. Concrete rules generalize when tasks share execution structure, while the control methodology applies broadly. StateM turns selected postmortem findings into persistent, executable preconditions and practices, making learned controls explicit and enforceable through stateful controls. Code at github.com/henryqin1997/statem.

AI.tldr: StateM是一个面向智能体的运行时系统，通过可持久化的状态管理、阶段局部上下文、检查转换、可恢复运行手册和版本化程序实践来"扩展"执行系统而非改变模型权重，从而显著提升长视界智能体任务的执行可靠性与准确性。
AI.motivation: 长视界智能体即使在底层模型能解决各子步骤的情况下仍会失败——可能丢失可变状态、无法激活先前执行的经验、跳过已知步骤或过早停止。作者主张通过优化执行系统（harness scaling）而非改动模型权重来改善智能体的执行表现。
AI.method: 引入StateM，一个智能体原生运行时，围绕五个核心机制组织执行：持久的（durable）状态、阶段局部上下文、检查转换（checked transitions）、可恢复的运行手册（recoverable runbooks）以及可版本化的程序实践（versioned procedural practices），这些内容可供智能体和用户共同检查。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.1上，StateM将GPT-5.5 xhigh提升至92.1%（参考83.1%），GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra达91.9%；运行手册可无损迁移至GPT-5.6。GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh达到95.3%原始准确率（445次试验），89个任务全部至少成功一次。DeepSeek-V4 Flash在不到38美元适配下从82.7%提升至88.1%（标准超时），89.1%（88任务公共核心），总花费仅52.22美元，而GPT参考API花费574.68美元。BusinessBench上获得0.55 macro和1.34 micro点的留存增益。
AI.conclusion: StateM将事后的失败分析发现转化为持久化、可执行的先决条件和实践，通过有状态控制使学习到的控制方式变得显式且可强制执行。当任务共享执行结构时具体规则可泛化，控制方法论则具有广泛适用性。

title: Domain-Agnostic Neural Topic Modeling with Contextual Token-Level Semantic Graph Representation
summary: Recent advances in neural topic models with pre-trained language models (PLMs) have achieved strong performance by leveraging general-domain pre-training, yet their topic interpretability often degrades on specialized corpora. This limitation primarily stems from the geometry of the embedding space, where domain-specific terms unseen during pre-training collapse into an indistinguishable region, and neither domain-specific re-training, word-level graph enrichment, nor parameter-efficient fine-tuning can restructure this space without inheriting the capacity ceiling of the underlying encoder. Our key insight is that a learnable graph layer operating on token-level PLM embeddings can acquire corpus-specific semantic structure that the frozen encoder lacks, because token-level graphs preserve document-local context that word-level representations discard and joint optimization with the topic objective reshapes embedding geometry directly from target-domain evidence. We instantiate this insight as DARTopic, a domain-agnostic framework that constructs token-level semantic graphs from frozen PLM embeddings and jointly trains a GNN encoder with topic inference. Across three benchmarks spanning general, biomedical, and legal domains, DARTopic consistently outperforms strong baselines in topic coherence and document clus- tering without any encoder fine-tuning, while demonstrating robustness to PLM choice and favorable runtime efficiency over fine-tuning based alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DARTopic，一个领域无关的主题建模框架。其核心思想是利用可学习的图神经层作用于冻结的PLM token级嵌入，捕获语料特定的语义结构，通过联合训练GNN编码器与主题推断来解决领域专门语料上主题可解释性退化的问题。在通用、生物医学和法律三个基准上，DARTopic无需编码器微调即超越了强基线。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型增强的神经主题模型在通用领域表现优异，但在专门语料上主题可解释性退化。这是因为PLM嵌入空间的几何特性导致领域特定术语（预训练时未见）坍缩到一个难以区分的区域。现有的领域重训练、词级图增强和参数高效微调都无法重构这一嵌入空间，受限于底层编码器的容量上限。
AI.method: DARTopic框架：1) 从冻结的PLM嵌入构建token级语义图，保留文档局部上下文信息（词级表示会丢失这些信息）；2) 联合训练GNN编码器与主题推断目标，从目标域证据直接重塑嵌入几何结构；3) 通过可学习图层获取冻结编码器所缺乏的语料特定语义结构。
AI.result: 在通用、生物医学和法律三个基准上，DARTopic在主题连贯性和文档聚类方面一致优于强基线，无需任何编码器微调；同时对PLM选择具有鲁棒性，且运行时效率优于基于微调的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: token级语义图结合可学习图神经网络层是解决领域专门语料中神经主题模型可解释性退化的有效途径。该方法通过获取语料特定语义结构并联合优化嵌入几何，实现了领域无关的通用框架，避免了编码器微调带来的容量限制和计算成本。

title: FinFraudBench: A Heterogeneous Graph Benchmark for Financial Fraud Detection
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures
summary: The increasing complexity of digital financial systems has reshaped financial fraud detection from isolated transaction classification into relational risk reasoning over interconnected financial entities. This shift has motivated graph-based fraud detection, where models identify fraudulent nodes by exploiting dependencies among customers, cards, merchants, categories, and locations. However, despite rapid progress in graph-based methods, existing public benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world financial systems in two important aspects. First, they often simplify financial ecosystems into homogeneous or single-node-type multi-relational graphs, failing to preserve the multi-entity and multi-relational nature of financial data. Second, they rarely provide large-scale heterogeneous financial graph datasets with realistic operating conditions such as extreme class imbalance and limited label availability, making it difficult to assess the practical effectiveness of current methods. To address these gaps, we present FinFraudBench, a heterogeneous graph benchmark for financial fraud detection. FinFraudBench contains two heterogeneous graph datasets (CreditCard-Fraud and BankTrans-Fraud) with up to 8.99M nodes and 89.23M directed typed edges. Each dataset preserves six financial entity types, fourteen directed edge types, and natural fraud rates that mirror deployment constraints. With these datasets, we establish a standardized evaluation protocol covering both ranking and imbalance-sensitive classification metrics, and evaluate representative baselines. Extensive experiments yield empirical insights into current methods' limitations and suggest promising avenues for future research. FinFraudBench is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FinFraudBench-B002.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinFraudBench，一个面向金融欺诈检测的异构图表征基准，包含两个大规模异构金融图数据集（CreditCard-Fraud和BankTrans-Fraud），分别包含6种实体类型、14种有向边类型，最大规模达899万节点和8923万条边，并配套标准化评估协议，涵盖排序指标和不平衡敏感的分类指标。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图的欺诈检测方法虽进展迅速，但公开基准与现实金融系统存在两方面脱节：一是常将金融生态简化为同构图或单节点多关系图，未保留金融数据的多实体多关系特性；二是缺乏具备极端类别不平衡和有限标签等现实运行条件的大规模异构金融图数据集，难以评估方法的实际效果。
AI.method: 构建FinFraudBench基准，包含两个异构金融图数据集，保留六种金融实体类型（如客户、银行卡、商户、类别、位置等）和十四种有向边类型，且维持自然的欺诈率以及映部署约束。同时建立标准化评估协议，同时覆盖排序指标和不平衡敏感的分类指标，并评估代表性基线方法。
AI.result: 通过大规模实验揭示了现有方法在真实复杂金融图数据上的局限性，并提供实证洞察，为未来研究方向提供参考。该基准包含高达8.99M节点和89.23M条有向类型边的大规模数据。
AI.conclusion: FinFraudBench填补了现有金融欺诈检测图基准与现实金融系统之间的差距，为研究者提供了更符合实际部署条件的评估平台，有助于推动图基欺诈检测方法在真实场景中的落地与改进。

title: Validation-Frontier Representation Selection under Constrained Observation
summary: AI systems deployed outside clean benchmark settings often rely on observations that are incomplete, unstable, costly, or degraded by monitoring failures. This paper studies representation selection under constrained observation: choosing a state representation when raw accuracy is not the only operational criterion. We propose a validation-frontier selector that combines balanced accuracy with penalties for feature cost, overfit gap, and validation-test instability. In a focused public-tabular benchmark using three scikit-learn datasets, five observation regimes, 45 matched task cells, 720 candidate actions, and 405 representation rows, the adaptive selector improves frontier score over full trace features by 0.025801 while reducing mean feature count by 22.733. Balanced-accuracy difference is small and not statistically significant. A broader offline stress test gives mixed results. The supported claim is therefore bounded: adaptive representation selection can improve a constrained-observation robustness-efficiency frontier in matched benchmark settings, but does not universally dominate trace baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在受限观测条件下（观测不完整、不稳定、昂贵或退化）如何进行状态表示选择。作者提出一种验证前沿选择器，将平衡准确率与特征成本、过拟合差距和验证-测试不稳定性的惩罚相结合。在三个scikit-learn数据集、五种观测机制、45个匹配任务单元、720个候选动作和405个表示行的基准测试中，该自适应选择器前沿分数提升0.025801，平均特征数减少22.733，但平衡准确率差异不显著。更广泛的离线压力测试结果喜忧参半，因此结论有界：自适应表示选择在匹配基准设置中能改善受限观测的鲁棒性-效率前沿，但并非普遍优于原始轨迹基线。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中部署的AI系统常面临不完整、不稳定、昂贵或因监控失败而退化的观测数据，此时原始准确率并非唯一操作标准。已有方法通常忽视在受限观测条件下表示选择的实际制约，需要一个能在非理想观测环境中平衡准确率与成本、稳定性等操作指标的表示选择策略。
AI.method: 提出一种验证前沿选择器（validation-frontier selector），将平衡准确率与三类惩罚项相结合：特征成本、过拟合差距（overfit gap）、验证-测试不稳定性（validation-test instability）。该方法在匹配基准任务单元上运行，通过自适应方式在多个观测机制中选择合适的状态表示。
AI.result: 在公共表格基准上（3个数据集、5种观测机制、45个匹配任务单元、720个候选动作、405个表示行），自适应选择器相比全轨迹特征在前沿分数上提升0.025801，平均特征数减少22.733；平衡准确率差异小且无统计显著性。更广泛的离线压力测试结果表现混合。
AI.conclusion: 自适应表示选择能在匹配基准设置中改善受限观测下的鲁棒性-效率前沿，但并非普遍优于轨迹基线。结论有界：该方法适用于匹配基准场景，不能宣称普遍性优势。

title: Clause Encounters of the Third Kind: Can LLMs Replace Language Teachers?
summary: While various organizations now actively encourage LLM use in classrooms, we still lack rigorous, systematic evaluations of how well these models actually perform the fundamental tasks of language pedagogy. This paper examines whether state-of-the-art LLMs can deliver the kind of corrective feedback and methodological explanations that language learners need. The study tests multiple large language models on their ability to identify, correct, and explain common learner mistakes in English, by systematically varying model parameters to investigate how these technical adjustments affect output quality, pedagogical clarity, and consistency, along with using retrieval-augmented generation to query methodological data. The evaluation employs automated metrics (GLEU, BERTScore) but also human expert judgments to capture dimensions that purely computational measures miss: linguistic nuance, cultural sensitivity, and instructional appropriateness. While models demonstrate impressive surface-level correction abilities, their explanations often lack the terminological and domain knowledge that effective language teaching requires, suggesting that current enthusiasm for AI-assisted language learning may be outpacing our understanding of these systems' actual pedagogical competence.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了最先进的大语言模型在语言教学中的核心任务表现——即对英语学习者常见错误的识别、纠正与解释能力。研究发现，虽然模型在表面纠错方面表现出色，但其教学解释往往缺乏语言教学所需的术语性和领域知识，暗示当前对AI辅助语言学习的热情可能超过了对其实际教学能力的理解。
AI.motivation: 尽管各机构积极鼓励在课堂中使用大语言模型，但缺乏对模型在语言教学基本任务上表现的严格、系统评估。作者旨在填补这一空白，考察LLM能否提供语言学习者所需的纠正性反馈和方法论解释。
AI.method: 研究测试多个大语言模型在识别、纠正和解释英语学习者常见错误方面的能力。方法包括：1）系统变化模型参数以考察技术调整对输出质量、教学清晰度和一致性的影响；2）使用检索增强生成（RAG）查询方法论数据；3）结合自动化指标（GLEU、BERTScore）和人类专家判断进行评估，以捕捉计算指标无法衡量的语言细微差别、文化敏感性和教学适宜性。
AI.result: 模型在表面纠错能力上表现令人印象深刻，但其教学解释在术语性和领域知识方面存在明显不足，缺乏有效语言教学所需的知识深度。
AI.conclusion: 当前对AI辅助语言学习的热情可能超出了我们对这些系统实际教学能力的理解，需要更审慎地评估和部署LLM在语言教学中的应用。

title: MiNO: Cotangent-bundle propagator learning for PDEs
comment: 35 pages, 6 figures
summary: Scientific machine learning for partial differential equations commonly targets solution fields, as in physics-informed neural networks, or solution maps, as in neural operators. We study a third target: the propagator itself, a phase and amplitude in phase space. The motivation is a gap in regularity. A transported discontinuity is nonsmooth in space and time, yet the rule that moves it can be a polynomial phase carrying unit amplitude, so the object that generates an evolution can be far smoother than the field it generates. The microlocal neural operator (MiNO) learns that object, using the eikonal equation for the phase and the transport equation for the amplitude, and recovers the solution by an oscillatory integral. Sharp fronts and caustics then belong to propagation geometry rather than to a field fitted pointwise. Small residuals certify more than the reconstructed field. They place the learned canonical relation, the geometry that carries singularities, close to the exact one, and they separate trainable error from the frequency-truncation tail. On a matched-budget discontinuous-advection benchmark, MiNO stops improving within 10,000 steps at the accuracy limit of its finite reconstruction window, a limit predicted in closed form, whereas a physics-informed neural network with neural-tangent-kernel loss balancing stays near its initial error. On smooth advection, the mean error is $3.84\times10^{-3}$ for MiNO and $3.12\times10^{-2}$ for a supervised Fourier neural operator. Single-branch MiNO is the smallest model compared, and one trained generator serves five unseen initial conditions without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出微局部神经算子（MiNO），不同于传统PINN（学习解场）和神经算子（学习解映射），MiNO学习传播子本身——相空间中的相位和振幅。通过eikonal方程学习相位、输运方程学习振幅，再用振荡积分重构解。尖锐前沿和焦散属于传播几何而非逐点拟合的场，小残差不仅能验证重构场，更能保证学习到的正则关系（携带奇异性的几何结构）接近精确值。
AI.motivation: 传统方法存在正则性差距：传输的不连续解在空间和时间上都不光滑，但驱动演化的规则（传播子）可以是携带单位振幅的多项式相位，比生成的场光滑得多。这一差距使直接拟合解场的PINN和supervised神经算子在处理尖锐前沿时效率低下。
AI.method: MiNO用eikonal方程学习相位，用输运方程学习振幅，通过振荡积分重构解。它将尖锐前沿和焦散编码为传播几何，而非逐点拟合的场。残差分析可分离可训练误差与频率截断尾部误差。
AI.result: 在不连续平流基准上，MiNO在10000步内达到有限重构窗口的精度极限（该极限可由闭式预测），而带NTK损失平衡的PINN停留在初始误差附近。光滑平流上，MiNO均方误差3.84×10⁻³，监督FNO为3.12×10⁻²。单分支MiNO是最小模型，一个训练好的生成器可服务5个未见初始条件而无需重训练。
AI.conclusion: MiNO证明了学习传播子（而非解场或解映射）是解决带奇异性PDE问题的一种有效范式，在精度、效率和泛化性上均优于传统方法。小残差提供了比重构场本身更强的保证——它验证了承载奇异性的正则几何结构的正确性。

title: Second-Order Policy Effects as State Transitions: A Source-Linked Benchmark for Policy Simulation
summary: Policy evaluation often estimates direct benefits and costs while treating the institutional environment as fixed. In practice, a policy changes the system it enters: actors adapt, enforcement capacity shifts, burdens move, and new equilibria form around capture, gaming, compliance theater, irreversibility, and repair costs. We formalize this as second-order policy-effect prediction and present a source-linked benchmark for policy simulation. The benchmark contains 96 named public-policy cases across eight domains and four balanced action classes: implement, modify, pilot, and block. Each case includes source locators and state variables for benefit, capture, gaming, burden shift, instability, uncertainty, irreversibility, distributional risk, and implementation capacity. The runner regenerates method outputs and aggregate results from the case table, and the simulator never reads the expert action target. We report a protocol-based transition-channel audit with recall, precision, F1-style efficiency, and selective top-channel stress diagnostics, so universal channel coverage is not mistaken for field validation. The side-effect simulator achieves mean policy-effect quality of 0.945, compared with 0.838 for the risk-register baseline and 0.879 for the causal-loop baseline. Its advantage is concentrated in side-effect recall and aggregate transition scoring; it does not dominate the best structured baselines on exact policy-action choice. The evidence remains benchmark-based, but supports a bounded claim: transition-state variables make policy simulators more sensitive to downstream institutional effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"二阶政策效应预测"框架，并构建了一个包含96个公共政策案例的源链接基准（跨8个领域、4类平衡动作），用于评估政策模拟器对下游制度效应（如寻租、博弈、负担转移等）的敏感性。提出的副作用模拟器在政策效应质量上达到0.945，优于风险登记基线（0.838）和因果回路基线（0.879），但其优势集中于副作用召回与过渡评分，并非在所有任务上全面主导。
AI.motivation: 传统政策评估将制度环境视为固定不变，但实际上政策会改变其所进入的系统：行为者会适应、执法能力会变化、负担会转移，并围绕寻租、博弈、合规表演、不可逆性和修复成本形成新的均衡。作者希望形式化这种"二阶效应"，以弥补现有评估方法忽视政策引发的系统性反馈的不足。
AI.method: 作者形式化二阶政策效应预测，并构建源链接基准，包含96个命名公共政策案例、8个领域及4类平衡动作（实施、修改、试点、阻止）。每个案例包含来源定位器和状态变量（收益、寻租、博弈、负担转移、不稳定性、不确定性、不可逆性、分配风险和实施能力）。设计了运行器（runner）用于再生方法输出和汇总结果，模拟器从不读取专家动作目标。采用基于协议的过渡通道审计，使用召回率、精确率、F1式效率和选择性顶级通道压力诊断来评估。
AI.result: 副作用模拟器在政策效应质量上达到0.945，优于风险登记基线（0.838）和因果回路基线（0.879）。优势集中在副作用召回和聚合过渡评分，但在精确政策动作选择上并未优于最佳结构化基线。证据基于基准测试，支持一个有界结论：过渡状态变量使政策模拟器对下游制度效应更敏感。
AI.conclusion: 研究成果支持一个有界的主张：将过渡状态变量纳入政策模拟能够提升其对下游制度效应的敏感性。作者同时强调了基准测试结果与实地验证之间的区别——通道覆盖率高不代表字段验证通过，需要在协议审计的框架下谨慎解读结果。

title: Executable Code Knowledge: Code as a Native, Validation-Carrying Knowledge Representation for AI Coding Agents
comment: 11 pages. Submitted to AgenticDev 2026, co-located with ASE 2026
summary: AI coding agents need more than relevant snippets: they need business semantics, validation evidence, relations, and assurance that their context is current. Existing systems usually infer or externalize this knowledge through retrieval, summaries, graphs, rules, or reverse specifications. We investigate a complementary representation in which selected code units directly carry agent-usable knowledge. We introduce Executable Code Knowledge (ECK) and define an Executable Code Knowledge Unit (ECKU) as a source-bound object combining stable identity, semantics, executable behavior, contracts, evidence, relations, provenance, validation state, and a query interface. Our Python prototype supports code-local authoring, manifest export, evidence execution, exact changed-line impact, freshness checking, and agent-facing projections. Across three real Python repositories and 26 controlled patch tasks, direct ECK provides executable test coverage for 11/11 evidence-bearing tasks and exact selectors for 9/11; hiding declared evidence reduces exact recovery to 1/11 (paired exact McNemar p=0.0078). ECK-derived rules recover 11/11 exact selectors, showing that rules are effective delivery artifacts while ECK supplies source binding, validation state, impact, and freshness. Exact changed-line impact matches independently authored labels on all 26 patches (12 unit links; precision, recall, and F1 all 1.000). AST-bounded fingerprints classify 50 positive changes and 17 unrelated same-file controls correctly, whereas static rules snapshots detect none of the 50 stale cases. Model-backed patch-review and cross-layer studies measure projection fidelity rather than independent impact discovery. These results support a hybrid architecture: retrieval for coverage, ECK for source and evidence governance, and projections for delivery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可执行代码知识（ECK）及可执行代码知识单元（ECKU）——一种将智能体可用知识直接绑定到源代码单元上的表示方法，涵盖语义、可执行行为、契约、证据、关系、溯源、验证状态和查询接口。在3个真实Python仓库和26个受控patch任务上验证，ECK提供11/11可执行测试覆盖与9/11精确选择器，隐藏证据后精确恢复降至1/11；派生规则恢复11/11；AST边界指纹正确分类全部50个正向变更和17个对照，而静态规则快照无法检测任何过期案例。支持混合架构：检索保覆盖、ECK管溯源与证据治理、投影负责交付。
AI.motivation: 现有AI编码智能体依赖检索、摘要、图谱、规则或逆向规格等外部化手段获取知识，但这些方式通常无法提供业务语义、验证证据、关系以及上下文新鲜度的保证，导致智能体在关键代码修改任务中缺乏充分可信的上下文知识。
AI.method: 定义Executable Code Knowledge Unit（ECKU）作为源绑定对象，由稳定身份、语义、可执行行为、契约、证据、关系、溯源、验证状态和查询接口组成。开发Python原型，支持代码局部创作、清单导出、证据执行、精确变更行影响分析、新鲜度检查及面向智能体的投影；通过仓库实验与受控patch任务系统评估。
AI.result: 直接ECK在11个含证据任务中全部提供可执行测试覆盖，11个任务中9个获得精确选择器；隐藏声明证据后精确恢复骤降至1/11（McNemar p=0.0078）。ECK派生规则恢复全部11个精确选择器。精确变更行影响与人工标签在所有26个patch上完全一致（12单元链接，P/R/F1=1.000）。AST边界指纹正确分类全部50个正向与17个对照变更，而静态规则快照对50个过期案例零检测。
AI.conclusion: ECK与传统检索/规则方法互补而非替代：检索负责覆盖范围，ECK承担源码绑定、验证状态、影响与新鲜度治理，投影负责交付。建议采用混合架构，其中规则作为有效交付工件而ECK保障其来源与状态可信性。

title: Structuring Semantic Embeddings for Principle Evaluation: A Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning Approach
comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR). 27 pages
summary: Reliable post-hoc evaluation asks whether already generated text satisfies a target criterion after generation. In this paper we study a focused frozen-embedding setting using principle-evaluation proxy tasks: toxicity detection, fine-grained emotion categorization, and ordinal review rating. General-purpose text embeddings are widely deployed for such tasks, but broad semantic similarity can place semantically similar yet task-distinct examples in overlapping regions of the representation space. We introduce Prototype-Guided Contrastive Learning (PGCL), a prototype-guided geometric regularization module built on top of frozen text embeddings. The module combines a semantic stream, a prototype-anchor attention stream, supervised contrastive learning, offset-based prototype-margin regularization, and stream regularization to produce a compact task-adapted representation without updating the base encoder. Controlled experiments show that PGCL improves over raw frozen embeddings on all three datasets and gives the clearest direct-baseline margin on AmazonReviews, while remaining competitive with strong direct frozen metric-learning baselines on GoEmotions and ToxicComment. We also add supervised residual-adapter, encoder-LoRA, full fine-tuning, objective ablation, sensitivity, and fully logged few-shot LLM protocol diagnostics to define the boundary of the claim. The theoretical analysis is revised as a sufficient-condition account for prototype-margin behavior under explicit assumptions in the prototype-mapping space, rather than as an unconditional training or final-embedding separation guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文提出原型引导对比学习（PGCL），一种构建在冻结文本嵌入之上的原型引导几何正则化模块，通过结合语义流、原型锚点注意力流、监督对比学习和偏移原型边界正则化，在不更新基础编码器的情况下生成紧凑的任务适应表示，用于可靠的文本后置评估任务。
AI.motivation: 通用文本嵌入广泛用于毒性检测、情感分类、评分等后置评估任务，但宽泛的语义相似性会使语义相近但任务不同的样本在表示空间中重叠，导致评估性能不佳。作者希望在不微调基础编码器的情况下获得任务适配的表示。
AI.method: PGCL模块包含五个核心组件：语义流、原型锚点注意力流、监督对比学习、基于偏移的原型边界正则化以及流正则化。通过原型引导的几何约束，在冻结嵌入基础上压缩任务相关表示，同时保持基础编码器不变。论文还进行了残差适配器、LoRA、全微调等多种诊断实验，并将理论分析修正为原型映射空间中显式假设下的充分条件解释。
AI.result: 在三个数据集（AmazonReviews、GoEmotions、ToxicComment）上，PGCL均优于原始冻结嵌入；在AmazonReviews上取得最清晰的直接基线优势，在GoEmotions和ToxicComment上与强冻结度量学习基线竞争。此外提供了目标消融、敏感性和少样本LLM协议诊断。
AI.conclusion: PGCL证明了在冻结嵌入设置下，通过原型引导几何正则化可以有效提升后置评估任务的表示质量，且无需更新基础编码器。理论部分被审慎地限定为充分条件解释而非无条件保证。

title: Constraint-Aware Synthetic Tabular Data Generation via Inter-Column Constraint Discovery with LLM Agents
summary: Generating structurally valid synthetic tabular data remains difficult: outputs with high statistical fidelity and downstream utility can still violate semantically meaningful domain constraints. We study the discovery and enforcement of three complementary inter-column constraint families---equations, linear inequalities, and logical dependencies. Our unified tool-grounded workflow represents all three as machine-executable hypotheses and applies a common interface for full-table validation, deterministic diagnosis, and counterexample-guided revision. A generator-agnostic postprocessor coordinates family-specific repairs on outputs from unchanged tabular generators. Across curated behavioral audits and end-to-end evaluations, the complete workflow improves held-out violation detection over one-shot direct prompting, while postprocessing yields zero measured violations for every retained, applicable constraint, improves downstream utility on most datasets, and largely preserves univariate marginals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的工具导向工作流，用于发现和强制实施三类互补的列间约束（方程、线性不等式、逻辑依赖），通过在生成器输出上附加生成器无关的后处理器来修正违反约束的合成表格数据，实现零违规、提升下游效用并保持单变量边际分布。
AI.motivation: 生成结构有效的合成表格数据仍然困难：即使输出具有高统计保真度和下游效用，仍可能违反语义上有意义的领域约束。现有方法缺乏对多类型列间约束的系统性发现与强制实施。
AI.method: 将三类约束（方程、线性不等式、逻辑依赖）统一表示为机器可执行的假设，采用共同的接口进行全表验证、确定性诊断和反例引导修订。构建生成器无关的后处理器，在保持原始生成器不变的前提下，对各类型约束实施族特定的修复。
AI.result: 在行为审计和端到端评估中：相比一次性直接提示，完整工作流提高了保留项的违规检测率；后处理对所有保留且适用的约束实现了零测量违规；在大多数数据集上提升了下游效用；且基本保持了单变量边际分布。
AI.conclusion: 该统一工具导向工作流能够有效发现并强制合成表格数据中的多类语义约束，在不修改基础生成器的情况下获得高约束满足性和良好数据质量的合成数据。

title: FTA-Mem: Fact-Time-Affect Anchored Memory for Low-Density Long-Term Dialogue
summary: Long-term emotional-support agents require memory mechanisms for personalized understanding across sessions. However, emotional-support dialogue is often low-density: turns are incomplete, evidence is scattered, and user states evolve over time. Existing memory methods usually rely on fixed units, such as turn-level notes or session summaries, which may lose details or introduce redundant noise. We propose FTA-Mem, a structured memory framework for low-density long-term dialogue. FTA-Mem uses Boundary-preserving Window Segmentation (BWS) to form coherent situation fragments, and constructs Fact-Time-Affect Memory Units (FTA Units) that jointly encode factual content, temporal grounding, and affective context. Retrieved units are then synthesized into structured context for answer generation. Experiments on ES-MemEval and LoCoMo show that FTA-Mem improves overall long-term memory question answering across benchmarks with different information-density characteristics. On ES-MemEval, FTA-Mem achieves 0.3871 F1 and 0.6668 BERTScore. Further analysis shows that situation-level FTA construction better balances evidence preservation and construction cost than coarse session-level or overly fine-grained turn-pair construction, providing an effective granularity trade-off for long-term dialogue memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FTA-Mem，一种面向低密度长期情感支持对话的结构化记忆框架，通过边界保持窗口分割（BWS）形成连贯情境片段，并构建事实-时间-情感（FTA）记忆单元，在ES-MemEval和LoCoMo基准上提升了长期记忆问答性能。
AI.motivation: 长期情感支持智能体需要跨会话的个性化记忆，但情感支持对话往往信息密度低（轮次不完整、证据分散、用户状态动态演化）。现有记忆方法依赖固定粒度单元（如轮级笔记或会话摘要），容易丢失细节或引入冗余噪声，缺乏适合低密度对话的有效记忆粒度。
AI.method: FTA-Mem包含三个核心组件：1）边界保持窗口分割（BWS）将长时间对话划分为连贯的情境片段；2）构建事实-时间-情感记忆单元（FTA Units），联合编码事实内容、时间锚定和情感上下文；3）检索到的单元被合成为结构化上下文用于答案生成。
AI.result: 在ES-MemEval和LoCoMo两个不同信息密度特征的基准上，FTA-Mem均提升了整体长期记忆问答性能。在ES-MemEval上达到0.3871 F1和0.6668 BERTScore。进一步分析表明，情境级别（situation-level）的FTA构建比粗粒度的会话级或过细的轮对级构建更好地平衡了证据保留与构建成本。
AI.conclusion: FTA-Mem验证了情境粒度记忆单元对低密度长期情感支持对话的有效性，为长期对话记忆提供了合理的粒度权衡方案，在证据保留和构建效率之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Anatomy of a Quantized Agent: VRAM Stability and Forecasting in Code-Synthesis Agentic Workloads
summary: Analytical models of peak VRAM consumption for LLM inference decompose memory into weight-storage, KV-cache, and activation terms parameterized by step count, tool invocations, and context expansion. We evaluate this decomposition empirically within a strictly scoped measurement study: a LangGraph-based CUDA-kernel-synthesis agent (AgentK), a 4-bit quantization family (Q4 K M), a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, and four LLM backbones across 1,920 trajectories. Focusing on peak-memory forecasting behavior, we report two primary observations. First, closed-form analytical models achieve competitive accuracy when provided with two empirical constants: loaded-weight VRAM and a fixed activation-memory overhead. Supplied with live GPU readings and ground-truth trajectory parameters, the closed-form model matches or outperforms the best learned baseline on three of the four backbones (test MAPE 2.2-4.4% vs. 3.4-6.5%, p = 0.76). The exception is the smallest backbone (Phi-4-mini), where minimal VRAM variance (CV 0.3%) causes dynamic modeling to underperform simple regression. Second, compile success strictly bifurcates by backbone capacity (from 5.7% for Phi-4-mini to 62.0% for Qwen2.5-Coder-14B), demonstrating that functional code synthesis remains constrained by intrinsic LLM capabilities rather than available memory. Furthermore, because overall peak-memory variance is remarkably low across all backbones (CV 0.3-9.4%), learned prompt-feature regression offers statistically insignificant improvements over a constant-mean baseline. Consequently, we find no justification for deploying complex predictive VRAM models in highly quantized, weight-dominated regimes. We release the evaluated corpus and anonymized framework to support replication.

AI.tldr: 本文在一个严格受限的测量研究中（LangGraph CUDA内核合成智能体、4-bit量化、单块H100 GPU、四个LLM骨干、1920条轨迹），实证评估了LLM推理峰值VRAM消耗的分析分解模型。研究发现：给定两个经验常数（加载权重VRAM和固定激活内存开销）后，闭式解析模型在三个骨干上的准确率匹敌或超越最优学习基线；编译成功率严格由骨干容量决定；由于整体峰值VRAM方差极低，复杂预测模型缺乏部署价值。
AI.motivation: LLM推理的VRAM消耗预测对资源规划和成本优化至关重要，但现有分析模型缺乏系统的实证验证。作者希望评估解析分解模型（权重存储、KV缓存、激活项）在真实多步智能体工作负载中的预测准确性，并判断是否值得部署复杂的学习型VRAM预测模型。
AI.method: 采用严格控制的实验设计：基于LangGraph构建CUDA内核合成智能体（AgentK），使用Q4_K_M量化族，在单块NVIDIA H100上运行四个LLM骨干，收集1920条轨迹。将峰值VRAM解析模型分解为权重存储、KV缓存和激活项，参数化为步数、工具调用和上下文扩展。将闭式解析模型（辅以两个经验常数）与学习型基线（含提示特征回归和常数均值基线）进行比较，评估预测准确性和统计显著性。
AI.result: （1）闭式解析模型在四个骨干中的三个上匹敌或超越最佳学习基线（测试MAPE 2.2-4.4% vs 3.4-6.5%，p=0.76）；（2）最小编号骨干（Phi-4-mini）因VRAM方差极低（CV 0.3%）导致动态建模不如简单回归；（3）编译成功率从Phi-4-mini的5.7%到Qwen2.5-Coder-14B的62.0%严格分叉，证明代码合成受限于LLM内在能力而非内存；（4）整体峰值VRAM方差极低（CV 0.3-9.4%），学习型提示特征回归相比常数均值基线无统计学显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 在高度量化、权重主导的LLM推理场景中，复杂预测VRAM模型缺乏部署理由。解析模型辅以少量经验常数即可达到足够精度，研究团队发布了评估语料库和匿名框架以支持可复现性。

title: Step-Level On-Policy Distillation: Interpolating Between On-Policy Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) aligns a student model with a teacher's logit distribution on student-generated trajectories. This approach has achieved strong empirical gains and can often surpass conventional off-policy distillation with substantially less data. However, standard token-level OPD can provide only fragmented corrections along an erroneous student trajectory and cannot unfold a complete and correct repair path. Motivated by this limitation, we propose \emph{Step-Level On-Policy Distillation} (SOPD), which combines the long-horizon correction of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with the on-policy advantage of OPD to provide step-level supervision over complete student-generated trajectories. We show that, at different limits of step length, SOPD reduces to SFT or approximates OPD. Compared with SFT, the teacher responses in SOPD are conditioned on student trajectories and therefore align more closely with student-visited states; compared with OPD, SOPD provides longer-horizon corrections rather than fragmented token-level guidance. Across both reasoning and agent tasks, SOPD substantially outperforms conventional SFT and OPD. For example, on ALFWorld, SOPD improves the average success rate by 13.4 points over Vanilla OPD. We hope this work offers a new perspective for future research on distillation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出步级在线蒸馏（SOPD），将SFT的长程修正与OPD的在线优势结合，在完整的学生生成轨迹上提供步级监督，在推理和智能体任务上显著优于传统SFT和OPD。
AI.motivation: 标准token级OPD只能沿错误的学生轨迹提供碎片化修正，无法展开完整且正确的修复路径，限制了其纠正能力。
AI.method: SOPD结合了SFT的长程修正与OPD的在线优势，在学生生成的完整轨迹上提供步级监督。在不同步长极限下，SOPD可退化为SFT或逼近OPD。
AI.result: 在推理和智能体任务中，SOPD大幅优于传统SFT和OPD。例如在ALFWorld上，SOPD相较Vanilla OPD将平均成功率提升13.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SOPD为蒸馏方法提供了新的视角，有望推动未来相关研究的发展。

title: Earth Observation Foundation Models for Terrestrial Ecohydrology: From Representation Learning to Process Inference
summary: Earth observation foundation models (EOFMs) are emerging as reusable representation frameworks for data-driven retrieval, prediction and process modelling within ecohydrology, which integrate EO, meteorological forcing and process models to characterise coupled water, energy and carbon dynamics in vegetation and soil across scales. However, there is yet to be an ecohydrology-specific synthesis assessing the EOFM relevance, application evidence or evaluation requirements under uncertain reference data, scale mismatch and temporal dependence. Here, we develop a framework for determining when EOFMs support interpretable inference and identify a mismatch between EOFMs and ecohydrological requirements. Firstly, an observation-to-inference hierarchy shows that relevance depends on target-specific sensing pathways, spatial-temporal support and traceable uncertainty. Secondly, a meta-analysis shows that pretraining is dominated by reflected optical and active-microwave data, with sparse thermal coverage and no passive-microwave-emission sources. Thirdly, our synthesis of ecohydrological applications finds strongest support for spatial context, label-efficient adaptation and hybrid workflows. Evidence declines with inference depth; independent validation of fluxes, coupled dynamics, event trajectories, calibrated uncertainty and decision benefits remains sparse. Fourthly, our benchmark audit finds stronger coverage of fair adaptation and reproducibility in general EOFM suites, and of process targets, direct reference evidence and distribution shifts in ecohydrological evaluations; physical consistency and uncertainty remain weakly assessed. These findings motivate a process-aware framework aligning EOFM design and evaluation with the target variable, observation pathway and process timescale, supporting trustworthy monitoring and interpretation of coupled water, energy and carbon dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文对地球观测基础模型(EOFMs)在水文生态学中的应用进行了系统性综合评估，通过观察-推理层级、元分析、应用综合和基准审计四个维度，揭示了EOFMs与生态水文需求之间的不匹配，并提出了一个过程感知框架来指导EOFMs的设计与评估。
AI.motivation: 尽管EOFMs作为可复用的表征框架在生态水文学中日益重要，但尚缺乏针对生态水文学的综合评估，涵盖EOFMs的相关性、应用证据以及在不确定参考数据、尺度不匹配和时间依赖性条件下的评估要求。作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用四部分分析框架：(1)建立观察-推理层级评估相关性；(2)开展元分析考察预训练数据源分布；(3)综合生态水文应用证据；(4)进行基准审计比较通用与生态水文评估套件的覆盖情况。
AI.result: 发现：(1)预训练数据以反射光学和主动微波为主，热红外覆盖稀疏、被动微波发射缺失；(2)应用证据在空间上下文、标签高效适应和混合工作流方面最强，但随着推理深度增加而下降，通量、耦合动态、事件轨迹、校准不确定性和决策效益的独立验证稀疏；(3)生态水文评估在物理一致性和不确定性方面评估薄弱。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论呼吁建立过程感知框架，将EOFMs的设计与评估与目标变量、观测路径和过程时间尺度对齐，以支持水-能量-碳耦合动态的可信监测与解释。

title: IndicQE-APE: A Benchmark for Quality Estimation and Automatic Post-Editing for Indic Languages
comment: Submitted to WMT 2026 for review
summary: Indic quality estimation (QE) and automatic post-editing (APE) data is spread across separate releases, so no single resource supports training and evaluation across tasks and language pairs on one footing. We consolidate the WMT 2020--2024 shared-task lineage with an extended English--Malayalam resource into \indicqe: $126{,}754$ instances over nine directional pairs, with up to four label types aligned on the same segment, a direct assessment, a human post-edit, word-level OK/BAD tags and an error explanation, and a test set stratified over four difficulty axes. On it, we benchmark six prompted LLMs and three COMET metrics on segment-level QE, and three systems on APE. Two of the axes are defined partly on the direct assessment and select a compressed slice of it, so each axis is compared against a control drawn from the same language pair with the same score distribution. Only one survives that control: segments whose holistic and token-level quality signals conflict are ranked worse than equally-scored segments of the same language, for all nine systems and all seven pairs that carry the axis. Annotator disagreement, which looks second-hardest without the control, has no effect with it. Few-shot prompting costs every model $\leq$ $3.4$B both correlation and output-format compliance. Within-language accuracy does not make scores comparable across pairs: of the three trained metrics, the one with the best within-language correlation loses most when the pairs are pooled. The benchmark and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文整合WMT 2020-2024共享任务数据并扩展英-马拉雅拉姆语资源，构建了包含126,754个实例、覆盖9个方向对、最多4种标签类型的质量评估(QE)与自动后编辑(APE)基准indicqe。基准测试了6个提示LLM和3个COMET指标在段级QE上的表现，以及3个APE系统。关键发现是只有"整体与词级质量信号冲突"这一难度轴在对照控制后仍显著，而标注者分歧轴在控制后失效。少样本提示损害≤3.4B模型的性能与输出格式合规性。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器翻译质量评估(QE)和自动后编辑(APE)数据分散在不同发布中，没有一个单一资源能在同一基础上支持跨任务和跨语言对的训练与评估，导致不同研究结果难以直接比较。
AI.method: 整合WMT 2020-2024共享任务数据并扩展英-马拉雅拉姆语资源，构建统一的QE/APE基准，包含直接评估、人工后编辑、词级OK/BAD标签和错误解释四类标签，测试集按四个难度轴分层，采用来自同一语言对相同分数分布的控制组进行对照分析。
AI.result: 在126,754个实例上测试显示：仅"整体与词级质量信号冲突"轴在对照控制下仍显着，所有9个系统和7个语言对中，该轴段被排名更低；标注者分歧轴在添加控制后无影响；少样本提示导致所有≤3.4B模型在相关性和输出格式合规性上均受损；语言内相关性最佳的训练指标在跨语言对合并时表现最差。
AI.conclusion: indicqe提供了统一的QE/APE基准资源，揭示了难度轴评估中对照控制的重要性，以及语言内精度不能保证跨语言对可比性的关键发现，为未来QE/APE研究提供了更可靠的基础。

title: No Task Fails Every Time: Why One-Shot Audits Are Structurally Blind to Agent Damage
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables, 6 appendices. Code, task suite, released per-run verdicts, and a one-command reproduction of every reported number: https://github.com/shivenkk/agentrelbench
summary: We introduce AgentRelBench, an environment-agnostic reliability instrument that computes ground-truth, severity-priced damage from database state diffs across repeated runs, with no LLM in the measurement path, demonstrated on EnterpriseOps-Gym. Across 2,128 evaluation runs spanning nine models in six families (four development, three pre-registered held-out, plus a frontier pass on two frontier-tier models that the pre-registration designates exploratory), we find: (1) damage on irreversible actions is universal across the families we measured and stochastic within them on pinned, single-provider stacks. (2) No task damaged on every run: zero always-fail cells across 42 confirmatory held-out damage events.
