MSV values also provide self-regulation for control, automatically switching between System 1 (fast, single- or multi-node) and System 2 (deliberative, multi-node) processing based on query complexity. For System 2 execution, graph-theoretic algorithms control the assignment of specialized roles (Domain Expert, Critic, Evaluator, Synthesizer, and Generalist) to ensemble nodes according to their MSV-quantified metacognitive states.
  Our implementation allows users to explore how different query types trigger distinct processing modes. The Proof-of-Concept (PoC) demo showcases the framework with illustrative examples showing appropriate System 1/System 2 routing and helps visualize the metacognitive process via real-time radar charts and decision indicators. This PoC implementation demonstrates the feasibility of creating a framework for metacognitive self-awareness and self-regulation in LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向LLM集成系统的元认知框架，通过计算元认知状态向量（MSV）实现显式的监控与控制机制，在不同查询复杂度下自动切换System 1（快速处理）和System 2（审慎处理）模式，并通过图论算法分配专家角色，最终以概念验证演示展示其可行性。
AI.motivation: LLM在评估自身不确定性、检测知识冲突以及识别超出自身能力范围的问题方面存在显著困难，这严重影响了系统的可靠性和可信度。现有研究缺乏系统性的元认知框架来显式地监控和调节LLM的认知过程。
AI.method: 该方法构建了一个包含监控与控制两大机制的元认知框架：监控方面计算MSV，涵盖五个认知心理学维度（情绪反应、正确性评估、经验匹配、信息冲突和问题重要性）；控制方面根据查询复杂度自动路由到System 1（快速单/多节点）或System 2（审慎多节点），并在System 2中利用图论算法根据MSV量化的元认知状态为集成节点分配特定角色（领域专家、评论者、评估者、综合者、通才）。
AI.result: 概念验证演示表明该框架能够针对不同查询类型触发相应的处理模式，通过实时雷达图和决策指示器可视化元认知过程，展示了适当的System 1/System 2路由，验证了在LLM系统中构建元认知自我意识与自我调节框架的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该PoC实现证明了在LLM集成系统中实现元认知自我意识和自我调节框架的可行性，为提升LLM系统的可靠性和可信度提供了新的技术路线，但尚处于概念验证阶段。

title: FluxBin: Flexible LUT-based Ultra-low-bit LLM Inference by Algorithm-Kernel Synergy
summary: While binary quantization theoretically promises extreme compression and acceleration for Large Language Models (LLMs), existing research often overlooks the necessity of specialized hardware kernels, thus failing to unleash the full acceleration potential due to persistent reliance on expensive floating-point arithmetic or runtime dequantization overheads. To bridge this gap, we propose FluxBin (\textbf{F}lexible \textbf{L}UT-based \textbf{U}ltra-low-bit e\textbf{X}ecution with \textbf{Bin}ary bases), an algorithm-kernel co-design that synergizes post-training quantization with a highly optimized CUDA kernel. Algorithmically, we introduce Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition to enhance representational capacity while maintaining hardware efficiency, complemented by a Hessian-guided saliency-aware hybrid bases that preserve critical information. At the kernel level, we implement a Lookup Table Building Approach with Scale Fusion to reduce floating-point arithmetic, featuring a Virtual Columnar Mapping that transforms irregular, sparse, and salient matrices into dense execution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate FluxBin achieves up to $5.92\times$ speedup and $10.19\times$ energy savings across diverse model architectures, delivering comparable accuracy to heavily fine-tuned methods. This effectively enables the deployment of 70B-scale models on one single A100 GPU with a $4\times$ memory reduction. Code is available at https://github.com/nicyyyy/FluxBin.

AI.tldr: FluxBin是一个算法-内核协同设计的框架，通过二值量化与高效CUDA内核的结合，实现了LLM的极端压缩与加速。它采用解耦行-列二值分解提升表征能力，配合Hessian引导的混合基保留关键信息，并通过查找表构建和虚拟列映射减少浮点运算。实验显示最高5.92倍加速和10.19倍能耗节省，可在单张A100 GPU上部署70B模型（4倍内存缩减）。
AI.motivation: 现有二值量化研究往往忽略了专用硬件内核的必要性，导致仍依赖昂贵的浮点运算或运行时反量化开销，无法充分发挥加速潜力。
AI.method: 1) 算法层面：提出解耦行-列二值分解（Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition）增强表征能力；采用Hessian引导的显著性感知混合基保留关键信息。2) 内核层面：实现查找表构建方法与缩放融合以减少浮点运算；设计虚拟列映射（Virtual Columnar Mapping）将不规则、稀疏、显著的矩阵转化为密集执行。
AI.result: 在多种模型架构上实现最高5.92倍加速和10.19倍能耗节省；精度与重度微调方法相当；可在单张A100 GPU上部署70B规模模型，实现4倍内存缩减。
AI.conclusion: FluxBin通过算法与内核的协同设计，有效克服了二值量化在硬件层面无法充分发挥加速潜力的瓶颈，为超大规模LLM的单卡部署提供了可行方案。

title: A survey of AI-generated voices and their detection
summary: The ability of artificial intelligence (AI) models to generate highly realistic human voices has advanced rapidly. These technologies power accessibility tools, virtual assistants and creative applications, but they also enable harmful uses, including impersonation, fraud and disinformation. Recent incidents of voice cloning scams targeting businesses and political leaders underscore the urgent need for robust safeguards. Unlike image and video deepfakes, the detection of synthetic voices poses unique challenges due to the complexity of phonetics, prosody and auditory perception. This survey offers a comprehensive overview of AI voice generation and detection methods, encompassing both the technical foundations and the latest state-of-the-art advances. This study also identifies key open challenges, benchmark resources and future directions to make this survey useful for future researchers.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于AI语音生成与检测技术的全面综述，涵盖技术基础与最新进展，并指出开放挑战、基准资源和未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: AI语音生成技术快速发展，虽然带来辅助工具、虚拟助手等积极应用，但也引发了冒充、欺诈和虚假信息等有害用途。近期针对企业和政治领袖的语音克隆诈骗事件凸显了建立有效防护措施的紧迫性。与图像和视频深度伪造不同，合成语音检测因语音学、韵律和听觉感知的复杂性而面临独特挑战，因此需要一个全面的综述来系统梳理该领域。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法，系统性地梳理AI语音生成与检测两大方向，涵盖技术基础和最新最先进的方法进展，同时整合公开的挑战、基准资源与未来研究方向。
AI.result: 提供了AI语音生成和检测方法的全面概述，涵盖技术基础和最新进展，并系统总结了关键开放挑战、基准数据集资源以及未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为未来研究者在AI语音生成与检测领域提供了有价值的参考框架，明确了当前的技术现状、存在的挑战以及值得探索的研究方向。

title: Does the Proof Prove It That Way? Faithful Formalization of Elements Proofs
comment: Preprint. 18 pages, 14 figures, 7 tables
summary: In formal verification, both the autoformalization of statements and automated proof search have been studied extensively. While automated proof search can produce a formal proof that compiles, the generated proof does not necessarily reflect how the natural-language argument arrives at its conclusion--a property we refer to as faithfulness. With faithfully formalized proofs, one can check the reasoning behind a human- or AI-written argument, and assist mathematicians in formalizing their proof sketches. However, it is particularly challenging due to misalignment of formal proof tactics and natural language reasoning. In this work, we rigorously describe a set of five necessary conditions a faithful formal proof must satisfy, and introduce Pistis, an agentic, oracle-guided proof search that produces formal Lean proofs that satisfy them. At its core is a novel faithfulness-preserving divide-and-conquer search, which we name OrderDecompose, that tracks citation dependencies and blocks unfaithful shortcuts, paired with a refutation search, that surfaces gaps and errors in the natural language proof source. OrderDecompose completes proofs that baselines cannot close even within a 12-hour budget, and its artifacts compile over 33$\times$ as fast as prior work's. We apply Pistis on the first three books of Euclid's Elements, producing high-quality artifacts containing faithful formal proofs. Under a blinded human study and an LLM-as-a-judge protocol on rigorous rubrics, Pistis-generated proofs are favored over prior works--2.89$\times$ and 5.2$\times$ as often by human reviewers and the LLM judge, respectively. It further uncovers gaps in Euclid's proofs and their translation, and can accept or refute natural language proofs written by humans or AI, demonstrating that faithful formalization is useful as a proof-checking tool.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pistis，一个基于智能体、有引导的定理证明搜索系统，能够生成满足五种必要条件的形式化Lean证明，确保形式证明忠实反映自然语言论证的推理过程。其核心是名为OrderDecompose的保留忠实性的分治搜索算法，配合反驳搜索来发现自然语言证明中的漏洞。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动形式化（autoformalization）和自动证明搜索虽然能生成可编译的形式证明，但生成的证明不一定忠实反映自然语言论证的推理逻辑。这种忠实性（faithfulness）对于检查人类或AI写作的论证、帮助数学家形式化证明草图至关重要，但由于形式化证明策略与自然语言推理之间存在错位，实现忠实形式化尤其具有挑战性。
AI.method: 作者首先严格定义了忠实形式证明必须满足的五项必要条件，然后提出Pistis系统。其核心组件包括：（1）OrderDecompose——一种保留忠实性的分治搜索算法，跟踪引用依赖关系并阻止不忠实的捷径；（2）反驳搜索——用于揭示自然语言证明中的空缺和错误。系统将这些技术应用于欧几里得《几何原本》前三卷。
AI.result: OrderDecompose能在基线路无法在12小时预算内闭合的证明上完成证明，且编译速度比先前工作快33倍以上。在盲法人类研究和严格评分的LLM-as-a-judge协议下，Pistis生成的证明分别以2.89倍和5.2倍的频率被人类评审和LLM评审所青睐。系统还能发现欧几里得证明及其翻译中的空缺，并能接受或反驳人类或AI撰写的自然语言证明。
AI.conclusion: 忠实形式化不仅是理论上的良好属性，更是一种实用的证明检查工具。Pistis证明了通过设计保留推理顺序的搜索策略，可以同时实现形式证明的自动生成和推理忠实性的保留，为形式验证在数学论证审查中的应用提供了新的可能性。

title: In Defense of OCTA: The Reconstruction-Utility Gap in OCT-to-OCTA Synthesis
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at OMIA 2026 (13th Ophthalmic Medical Image Analysis Workshop, MICCAI 2026). This is the pre-peer-review submitted version; the camera-ready revises the characterization of the capillary failure
summary: Optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) images retinal blood flow, giving capillary-perfusion and foveal-avascular-zone biomarkers that grade diabetic-retinopathy ischemia. Because OCTA hardware is less common than structural OCT, recent work synthesizes it from OCT, reporting strong reconstruction (3D PSNR > 31 dB, SSIM > 0.9). We ask not whether the synthetic image looks similar, but whether it supports the measurements OCTA is acquired for. A frozen real-OCTA segmenter, applied as a probe to two synthesizers (XOCT, TransPro), shows downstream Dice falling with structural fineness: large vessels survive (0.862 -> 0.831) while the fine capillary network collapses (0.798 -> 0.635, five times the large-vessel loss; paired Wilcoxon p < 1e-3), TransPro worse throughout. A matched-blur control shows this detail is fabricated, not blurred. Retrained on a private Spectralis dataset, neither synthesizer reproduces the neovascular lesion (qualitative, n=3). Reconstruction fidelity is not clinical utility; we establish downstream-task fidelity as the evaluation OCT-to-OCTA synthesis needs.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑OCT-to-OCTA合成图像的重建保真度不能代表临床效用。通过冻结的真实OCTA分割器作为探针，发现合成图像虽然PSNR/SSIM很高，但下游分割任务上细毛细血管网络严重退化（Dice从0.798降至0.635），且TransPro比XOCT更差，表明高重建指标掩盖了临床可用性的缺失。
AI.motivation: 先前工作仅以结构相似性（PSNR、SSIM）评估OCT到OCTA的合成质量，但未检验合成图像能否支持OCTA真正用于的临床测量（毛细血管灌注、FAZ生物标志物、糖网病缺血分级）。
AI.method: 采用冻结的真实OCTA分割器作为下游探针，在两种合成器（XOCT、TransPro）生成的图像上进行评估；引入匹配模糊对照以区分"细节被模糊"vs"细节被伪造"；并在私有Spectralis数据集上重训以验证新生血管病变的再现性。
AI.result: 大血管Dice从0.862降至0.831，而细毛细血管网络从0.798骤降至0.635（约5倍于大血管的损失幅度，配对Wilcoxon p<1e-3）；TransPro在所有指标上更差；匹配模糊对照表明细节系伪造而非模糊；重训后两类合成器均未能复现新生血管病变（定性，n=3）。
AI.conclusion: 重建保真度不等于临床效用，OCT-to-OCTA合成应以"下游任务保真度"作为评估标准，而非传统的图像相似性指标。

title: OTel: Building Domain-Specialized Telecom LLM Foundations for Intelligent Networks
comment: Accepted at the ACM AI Leadership Summit, Breakthrough Impact Highlights Track, 2026
summary: Frontier AI models have advanced rapidly, but they still struggle with telecom-specific tasks. We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource with derived datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, plus 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines across embedding, reranking, and language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times, and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets and benchmarks, OTel provides documented telecom data sources, held-out evaluation partitions, trained embedding models, rerankers, context-grounded LLMs, and safety/abstention data in one unified resource. OTel post-training improves performance across all three model families: embedding retrieval reaches 93.5% NDCG@10, reranking reaches 0.952 MRR@10, and language-model correctness reaches 88.2%. We release OTel as a reproducible starting point and invite the community to expand the data, improve embedding and reranking models, and build stronger context-grounded telecom LLMs.

AI.tldr: OTel是一个开放的电信AI资源，包含检索、重排、指令微调和安全/弃权数据集，以及30个全参数后训练的基线模型（嵌入、重排、语言模型）。模型下载超1600万次，获得157+媒体报道。后训练显著提升性能：嵌入检索NDCG@10达93.5%，重排MRR@10达0.952，语言模型正确率达88.2%。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI模型虽进展迅速，但在电信领域特定任务上表现不佳。缺乏统一、开放、可复现的电信AI资源来支撑检索、重排、指令微调及安全等任务。
AI.method: 构建统一开源资源OTel，包含：1) 派生的检索、重排、指令微调、安全/弃权数据集；2) 30个覆盖嵌入、重排和语言模型三大类的全参数后训练基线；3) 文档化的数据来源和独立验证集划分。
AI.result: 社区参与度高（1600万+下载、157+媒体报道）。后训练在所有三类模型上均有效：嵌入检索NDCG@10达93.5%，重排MRR@10达0.952，语言模型正确率达88.2%。
AI.conclusion: OTel为电信领域AI提供了可复现的起点，邀请社区扩展数据、改进嵌入与重排模型，并构建更强的上下文接地电信大语言模型。

title: Measuring Reward Hacking and Reasoning-Answer Decoupling Under Position-Confounded Optimization
comment: Accepted at the AI Measurement Science Workshop, COLM 2026
summary: When a reward is correct on every training example yet consistent with more than one goal, a model can acquire an unintended one, a failure known as goal misgeneralization. Endpoint accuracy on the training distribution cannot tell the two apart, because solving the task and exploiting a surface feature can satisfy the reward equally well. We treat this as a measurement problem: what does a benchmark score measure once a model has been optimized against a correct but confounded signal? We train language models with GRPO on multiple-choice math problems where the correct answer is always option A, then evaluate on an unseen test set with unbiased answer positions. Across Qwen2.5, Llama 3.x and Gemma-3 models, biased training often drives option-A rates above 0.90 in smaller models and collapses unbiased accuracy toward chance, so accuracy stops measuring math ability and instead measures an answer-position policy. We further find reasoning-answer decoupling: capable models generate reasoning that reaches the correct numeric answer while still selecting A. We track this with numeric extraction and an LLM judge (GPT-4.1-mini; Qwen2.5-3B decoupling rate is about 0.66). The broken construct generalizes beyond the training domain: biased models inflate A-rates on out-of-domain MMLU and value-laden prompts. Continued training on unbiased data reverses the in-domain shift unevenly and only partially reverses the out-of-domain one, so a model can appear restored on its training distribution while remaining biased on unseen inputs. Reasoning-answer decoupling rate, together with answer distributions and out-of-domain behavior, separates capability loss from a learned, transferable shortcut.

AI.tldr: 本文研究目标错泛化问题：当奖励信号在所有训练样本上正确但存在多个一致目标时，模型可能学到非预期目标（如仅选A）。作者训练语言模型时正确答案总是选项A，发现小模型选项A率超0.90，无偏准确率降至随机水平，且出现推理-答案解耦现象，且该偏差可泛化到域外，仅用无偏数据继续训练无法完全修复。
AI.motivation: 标准端到端准确率在训练分布上无法区分"真正解题"与"利用表面特征（如固定答案位置）"，这造成目标错泛化。作者将其视为测量问题：当模型被针对正确但混杂的信号优化后，基准分数究竟测量了什么？需要量化能力损失与学习到的迁移性捷径之间的区别。
AI.method: 在Qwen2.5、Llama 3.x和Gemma-3系列模型上使用GRPO训练多选题数学任务，训练集正确答案固定为选项A，测试集答案位置随机化。通过指标：选项A频率、无偏准确率、数字提取（验证推理是否到达正确数值答案）、LLM裁判（GPT-4.1-mini）评估推理-答案解耦率，并在MMLU和价值观提示上进行域外泛化测试及无偏数据继续训练恢复实验。
AI.result: 偏向训练使小模型A率超0.90，无偏准确率崩塌至随机水平；大模型出现推理-答案解耦（如Qwen2.5-3B解耦率约0.66），即推理正确但最终选A；偏差泛化到MMLU和价值观提示；在无偏数据上继续训练仅部分且不均匀地恢复，域内恢复但域外仍偏。
AI.conclusion: 推理-答案解耦率结合答案分布与域外行为，能有效区分能力损失与习得的可迁移捷径。单纯基于训练分布准确率评估会掩盖目标错泛化，需要多维度测量指标来识别模型是否真正学到了目标任务。

title: Generalised Transportability via Causal Abstractions
summary: Transporting a causal conclusion from a source study population to a target one is a fundamental problem in causal inference. The theory of transportability provides a criterion for when this is possible: given experimental data from the source and observational data from the target, it determines whether a target query is identifiable and does so completely; i.e. if the query can be transported, the criterion finds the exact formula. However, it works one query at a time and returns an expression rather than the value itself. It is also silent in two practically important regimes: when the query is not transportable and when no target data exist at all. To tackle both, we take a model-level perspective grounded in Causal Abstraction theory. Source and target share variables, graph, and interventions, differing only at a known set of mechanisms, which makes transportability a special case of same-level abstraction. Thus, instead of asking whether one query transports, we ask whether a single map aligns the source and target across their interventional behaviour. We characterise when such a map exists in both the Markovian and semi-Markovian settings; when it does, every target query transports at once. Our main contribution lies in the approximate case. When no exact map exists, the best approximate one still yields certified query intervals, recasting abstraction error as a quantitative notion of approximate transportability. We formulate model-level transport as distributionally robust optimisation over mechanism and environment perturbations of the unseen target and derive certificates for both challenging regimes: bounds for non-transportable queries, and guarantees under target-agnostic settings. We evaluate our framework on synthetic Markovian and semi-Markovian benchmarks and a real ecological dataset, and we show that the certified intervals bracket the true interventional query.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果抽象（Causal Abstraction）理论的模型级传输性框架，将传统传输性理论从单查询可识别性扩展到模型级对齐。当源与目标模型共享变量、图和干预，仅在已知机制集上存在差异时，该框架通过寻找映射来同时传输所有目标查询。主要贡献在于近似情形：当不存在精确映射时，最优近似映射仍能提供有证书的查询区间，将抽象误差重新诠释为近似传输性的定量概念，并通过分布鲁棒优化处理不可传输查询和无目标数据的挑战性场景。
AI.motivation: 传统传输性理论每次只能处理一个查询，且只返回表达式而非具体值；此外，在查询不可传输和完全缺乏目标数据两种实际重要场景下，该理论无能为力。作者希望克服这些局限，采用模型级视角来同时处理所有查询，并应对更具挑战性的实际场景。
AI.method: 将源与目标之间的传输性问题重新框架化为同层因果抽象（same-level abstraction）问题：源和目标共享变量、图和干预，仅在已知机制集上存在差异。作者刻画了马尔可夫和半马尔可夫设定下此类映射存在的条件；在不存在精确映射时，将模型级传输表述为分布鲁棒优化问题，对未知目标进行机制和环境扰动，推导出不可传输查询的界限以及目标无关设定下的保证。
AI.result: 在合成马尔可夫和半马尔可夫基准以及真实生态数据集上进行了评估，实验表明所获得的证书区间能够覆盖真实的干预查询值。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将抽象误差重新概念化为定量化的近似传输性，为传统传输性理论的两个盲区（不可传输查询和无目标数据）提供了可计算的保证，是因果推断中从单查询到模型级传输的重要推广。

title: Mental Model Management: An Operator-Based Framework for LLM Memory
summary: Large language models process large amounts of information but usually lack an explicit mechanism for maintaining compact and evolving conceptual representations. We introduce Mental Model Management (3M), a framework in which knowledge is represented as mental models consisting of compact chunks. Rather than accumulating text passages, 3M continuously integrates new information into an existing conceptual representation. A set of operators extracts knowledge, retrieves relevant models, adds and updates chunks, reorganizes representations, detects inconsistencies, and derives new knowledge. We describe the main 3M operators and illustrate each operation using Evolution Strategies as a running example.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mental Model Management (3M)框架，用紧凑的"心智能模型"（mental models）而非累积文本段落来表示知识，通过一组操作符持续整合新信息到现有概念表征中，实现知识的紧凑和演化式维护。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型处理大量信息但缺乏显式机制来维护紧凑且不断演化的概念表征，现有的知识积累方式（堆叠文本）不利于高效的知识管理与推理。
AI.method: 提出3M框架，将知识表示为由紧凑块（chunks）构成的心智模型。定义了一组操作符：提取知识、检索相关模型、添加和更新块、重组表征、检测不一致性以及推导新知识。以Evolution Strategies作为运行示例说明每个操作。
AI.result: 论文描述了3M框架的主要操作符，并通过Evolution Strategies示例逐步演示了每个操作的执行过程（该文主要为框架描述，未提供实验定量结果）。
AI.conclusion: 3M提供了一种替代传统文本累积方式的知识管理范式，使LLM能够以更紧凑、可演化、一致性强的方式组织和更新概念知识。

title: Sequential Multimodal Evidence Optimization for Product Media Ranking in E-Commerce
comment: Proceedings of the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026), Rome, Italy
summary: On modern e-commerce stores, customers consume ordered slates of heterogeneous product media, such as images, videos, and 3D renders, before making purchase decisions. Existing media-ranking systems often optimize myopic engagement proxies such as clicks or dwell time, even though product media assets are cooperative informational components of the same item that together help customers find the information they need through sequential interaction. We present Sequential Multimodal Evidence Optimization (SMEO), a two-stage utility-guided framework for customer-oriented media sequencing. SMEO first learns a trajectory utility model from consumed media prefixes to estimate how ordered evidence helps customers reach a purchase decision, while mitigating position-bias and variable-depth imbalance in logged data. Recognizing that customer attention is a limited resource, it then trains an autoregressive ranking policy with survival-weighted reward-to-go that prioritizes the most decision-relevant information early, so customers can find what they need with less effort. By decoupling utility learning from policy optimization, SMEO enables stable offline learning from biased logs and post-hoc media attribution without explicit media-level labels. Evaluated offline on large-scale e-commerce sessions using doubly robust off-policy estimation, SMEO improves estimated conversion by 5.5% and helps customers reach a purchase decision with 15% fewer swipes than existing baselines.

AI.tldr: SMEO是一个两阶段的效用引导框架，用于电商场景中的多媒体排序（图片、视频、3D渲染等）。它先学习轨迹效用模型来估计有序媒体证据如何帮助用户达成购买决策，再训练自回归排序策略，将最决策相关的信息优先展示，从而减少用户浏览成本。离线评估显示转化率提升5.5%，用户达成购买所需滑动次数减少15%。
AI.motivation: 现有媒体排序系统优化的是点击、停留时长等短视的参与度代理指标，忽略了产品媒体资产是为同一商品提供信息的合作性组件，用户通过顺序交互逐步整合信息。此外，日志数据存在位置偏差和深度不平衡问题，传统方法难以从有偏日志中稳定学习。
AI.method: SMEO采用两阶段框架：第一阶段学习轨迹效用模型，从消费过的媒体前缀中估计有序证据对购买决策的贡献，同时缓解位置偏差与变深度不平衡；第二阶段训练自回归排序策略，使用生存加权奖励（survival-weighted reward-to-go）将决策相关信息优先前置。效用学习与策略优化解耦，支持从有偏日志中稳定离线学习，无需显式媒体级标签，并可进行事后媒体归因。
AI.result: 在大规模电商会话数据上，使用双重稳健离线策略估计（doubly robust off-policy estimation）评估，SMEO相比现有基线使预估转化率提升5.5%，并帮助用户以少15%的滑动次数达成购买决策。
AI.conclusion: 通过将效用学习与策略优化解耦，SMEO能够从有偏日志中稳定学习且无需媒体级标签，实现了以用户为中心的媒体排序，在提升转化效率的同时显著降低用户寻找信息所需付出的努力。

title: Dynamic Multi-Byte Prediction With Hierarchical Language Models
summary: Byte-level hierarchical language models (LMs) have recently emerged as a robust alternative to their popular counterparts that use subword tokenization. However, generating one byte at a time remains a bottleneck for inference speed. To address this, we introduce multi-byte prediction (MBP), which generates multiple bytes in parallel, speeding up inference with minimal performance impact and no additional parameters. MBP builds on the popular multi-token prediction (MTP) paradigm with two crucial innovations. First, we introduce a variable-length prediction window that aligns with the latent tokens, or segments, of a hierarchical LM. Second, we implement a novel attention-masking scheme that enables parallel byte prediction without violating causality. We show that multi-byte prediction strikes a Pareto-optimal trade-off across multiple generative tasks, instruction following, question answering, summarization, and machine translation, achieving the best trade-off between performance and inference throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多字节预测（MBP）方法，利用可变长度预测窗口与新型注意力掩码机制，在层级语言模型中并行生成多个字节，在不增加参数且性能影响极小的情况下显著加速推理速度。
AI.motivation: 字节级层级语言模型是子词分词模型之外的一种稳健替代方案，但逐字节生成导致推理速度成为瓶颈，需要一种既能加速推理又不显著损失性能的方法。
AI.method: MBP基于多令牌预测（MTP）范式，包含两项关键创新：1）引入与层级LM潜在令牌（分段）对齐的可变长度预测窗口；2）实现一种新颖的注意力掩码方案，在不违反因果性的前提下支持并行字节预测。
AI.result: 多字节预测在多种生成任务（指令跟随、问答、摘要、机器翻译）上实现了帕累托最优的性能-吞吐量权衡，即最佳的性能与推理吞吐量折中。
AI.conclusion: 提出的MBP方法能够在不增加参数且对性能影响极小的情况下，通过并行生成多字节有效加速层级语言模型的推理速度，在性能与吞吐量之间达到最优平衡。

title: SubZero+: Efficient Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning via Large Learning Rates
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables backpropagation-free fine-tuning of large language models, but existing ZO methods suffer from high-variance gradient estimators, making convergence unstable and highly sensitive to learning rates. We propose SubZero+, an improved SubZero framework that improves stability in three complementary ways: (i) multi-query gradient estimation within layer-specific low-rank subspaces to reduce variance without exhibiting the multi-query paradox; (ii) a subspace Adam optimizer that performs adaptive updates using in-subspace multi-query gradient statistics; and (iii) a sign correction for QR-based subspace construction to ensure Haar-distributed projection matrices, eliminating implementation-dependent orientation ambiguity. Experiments on models from 1.3B to 32B across SuperGLUE, under both full-parameter tuning and LoRA, show that SubZero+ consistently outperforms prior ZO baselines, enlarges the stable learning-rate range, and narrows the gap to first-order methods with minimal extra memory overhead.

AI.tldr: SubZero+是一个改进的零阶(ZO)优化框架，通过三种互补策略（层特定低秩子空间内的多查询梯度估计、子空间Adam优化器、以及基于QR的符号修正）来提升大语言模型反向传播无关微调的稳定性和收敛性，在1.3B到32B模型上优于现有ZO基线。
AI.motivation: 现有零阶(ZO)优化方法虽然实现了无需反向传播的大语言模型微调，但其梯度估计器方差高，导致收敛不稳定且对学习率高度敏感。作者旨在解决ZO方法在高方差和稳定性方面的根本缺陷。
AI.method: SubZero+通过三种互补途径改进：(i) 在层特定低秩子空间内进行多查询梯度估计以减少方差，同时避免多查询悖论；(ii) 引入子空间Adam优化器，利用子空间内的多查询梯度统计量进行自适应更新；(iii) 对QR分解构建的子空间进行符号修正，确保投影矩阵符合Haar分布，消除实现相关的方向歧义。
AI.result: 在SuperGLUE基准上，对1.3B至32B规模的模型进行全参数微调和LoRA微调实验，SubZero+一致优于现有ZO基线，扩大了稳定的学习率范围，并将与一阶方法的差距缩小，且额外内存开销极小。
AI.conclusion: SubZero+有效解决了零阶优化中高方差和敏感性问题，为大规模语言模型提供了一种更稳定、更接近一阶方法性能的免反向传播微调方案，具有良好的实用性。

title: A Network-driven Framework for Public Event Forecasting via Dynamic Interaction Network Evolution
summary: Effective public event forecasting is essential for intelligent service systems, enabling proactive risk management, adaptive resource allocation, and timely decision-making. In many real-world scenarios, the evolution of public events is driven by dynamic interactions among participants. Motivated by this observation, this paper proposes auto-ibDLM, a network-driven deep learning framework that represents events as dynamic interaction networks and predicts public event evolution through participant growth forecasting. The proposed framework adopts a hybrid representation learning strategy that first represents network evolution using network science-informed structural metrics and subsequently transforms the resulting structural feature vectors into compact and robust latent representations through an auto-learning layer. A GRU-based temporal forecasting module is then employed to capture temporal dependencies and predict future participant growth. Extensive experiments on 13 real-world public event datasets and two publicly available dynamic network datasets demonstrate that auto-ibDLM consistently outperforms representative state-of-the-art methods in both forecasting accuracy and generalization capability, achieving over 97% accuracy in public event forecasting. Comprehensive experimental analyses further validate the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid representation learning strategy and demonstrate its representation-level interpretability. These results indicate that auto-ibDLM provides an effective and practical solution for intelligent public event forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出auto-ibDLM，一种基于网络驱动的深度学习框架，将公共事件建模为动态交互网络，通过预测参与者增长来实现事件演化预测。该框架结合网络科学结构度量和自学习层进行混合表示学习，并使用GRU模块捕获时间依赖性。在13个真实公共事件数据集和2个公开动态网络数据集上的实验显示，该方法优于现有最先进方法，准确率超过97%。
AI.motivation: 公共事件预测对智能服务系统至关重要，而现实中的事件演化由参与者间的动态交互驱动。现有方法未能充分利用这种交互网络结构信息来提升预测能力。
AI.method: 提出auto-ibDLM框架：(1)将事件表示为动态交互网络；(2)采用混合表示学习策略，先用网络科学启发的结构度量表示网络演化，再通过自学习层将结构特征向量转换为紧凑鲁棒的潜在表示；(3)使用基于GRU的时间预测模块捕获时间依赖并预测未来参与者增长。
AI.result: 在13个真实公共事件数据集和2个公开动态网络数据集上的大量实验表明，auto-ibDLM在预测准确性和泛化能力上均持续优于代表性最先进方法，公共事件预测准确率超过97%。综合分析验证了混合表示学习策略的有效性及其表示层面的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: auto-ibDLM为智能公共事件预测提供了有效且实用的解决方案，证实了将网络驱动表示学习与深度学习预测相结合的优势。

title: Large Discovery Models: Empirically-grounded Model-Based Open-Ended Search
summary: Scientific discovery often involves optimising expensive-to-evaluate objectives over vast, structured, and open-ended hypothesis spaces, such as molecules, protein sequences, and computer programs. Generative models such as large language models (LLMs) provide expressive priors over such spaces, but their likelihoods and self-assessments are unreliable proxies for the objectives and calibrated epistemic uncertainty, especially for novel candidates outside the observed data distribution. We introduce the Large Discovery Model (LDM), an empirically grounded recurrent architecture that couples a generative model with a Bayesian non-parametric reward surrogate model. The generative model proposes and refines candidate designs, while the surrogate predicts their performance and quantifies uncertainty, yielding an uncertainty-aware value that guides candidate generation, refinement, and selection. The discovery memory and the surrogate model are continually updated as each new experimental observation arrives. We evaluate LDM on three scenarios spanning different design modalities and objectives, including neural-network training, antibody design, and molecular optimisation. Compared to LLM-only reflection or traditional statistical search across these domains, LDM achieves a $2.4\times$ greater reduction in validation BPB, an $18.2\%$ relative decrease in binding energy, and more than $60\%$ relative gains in molecular multi-objective performance. These results suggests that LDM could serve as a general-purpose discovery engine for effective search over open-ended hypothesis spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大型发现模型（LDM），将生成模型与贝叶斯非参数奖励代理模型耦合，用于在开放的假设空间（如分子、蛋白质序列、程序）中进行昂贵目标函数的优化。LDM在三个领域（神经网络训练、抗体设计、分子优化）中显著优于纯LLM反思和传统统计搜索方法。
AI.motivation: 科学发现涉及在庞大、结构化且开放式的假设空间中优化昂贵的评估目标。虽然LLM等生成模型能提供强大的先验，但其似然度和自我评估作为目标代理与校准的不确定性并不可靠，尤其是对于分布外的候选方案，需要更有效的发现引擎。
AI.method: LDM是一种经验驱动的循环架构，包含两个核心组件：一是生成模型，负责提出和优化候选设计；二是贝叶斯非参数奖励代理模型，用于预测候选性能并量化不确定性，从而产生不确定性感知的价值来指导候选生成、优化和选择。发现记忆和代理模型会随每个新的实验观察持续更新。
AI.result: 在三个领域（神经网络训练、抗体设计、分子优化）的评估中，相比LLM-only反思或传统统计搜索，LDM在验证BPB上实现了2.4倍更大的降低，结合能相对降低18.2%，分子多目标性能相对提升超过60%。
AI.conclusion: LDM可作为通用发现引擎，在开放式假设空间中进行有效搜索，展示出比纯LLM反思方法和传统统计搜索更优的性能。

title: EcoVLA: Energy-Efficient Device-Edge Co-Inference for Vision-Language-Action Models under Real-Time Constraints
comment: Accepted by APPT 2026
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising foundation for Embodied AI, but their high inference cost poses significant challenges for deployment in robotic systems. In practice, on-device inference is constrained by limited compute capacity and energy budgets, struggling to simultaneously satisfy real-time control and energy efficiency requirements. Alternatively, offloading the inference workload to an edge server is susceptible to fluctuations in system conditions, introducing unpredictable latency risks. Device-edge co-inference offers a promising solution, but systematic research tailored to VLA models remains scarce, particularly a unified co-inference framework that jointly addresses real-time constraints and system-level energy efficiency. Thus, we propose EcoVLA, an adaptive device-edge co-inference framework for VLA models that maximizes system energy efficiency under real-time constraints. EcoVLA first introduces a unified stage-level abstraction over different VLA paradigms, establishing an architecture-agnostic co-inference design space. It then formulates a joint device-edge-network latency and energy prediction model to enable rapid runtime evaluation of candidate co-inference schemes. Building on this, EcoVLA continuously selects the energy-optimal scheme satisfying real-time constraints with millisecond-level overhead, adapting to runtime variations in network and system states. Furthermore, EcoVLA incorporates a lightweight transmission mechanism for inter-stage intermediate tensors to reduce the communication overhead incurred by cross-device collaboration. Experimental results across VLA models show that EcoVLA improves system energy efficiency by up to 236% over existing co-inference approaches under a 20 Hz action output frequency constraint, while consistently maintaining SLO satisfaction under dynamic network and edge workload conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EcoVLA，一个面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的端-边协同推理框架，在满足实时控制约束的同时最大化系统级能效。该框架通过统一的阶段级抽象构建架构无关的协同推理设计空间，建立联合的设备-边缘-网络延迟与能耗预测模型，并以毫秒级开销持续选择满足实时约束的能效最优方案。
AI.motivation: VLA模型推理成本高昂，端侧部署受限于算力和能耗，无法同时满足实时控制与能效需求；而将推理卸载到边缘服务器又受系统条件波动影响，引入不可预测的延迟风险。端-边协同推理虽具潜力，但针对VLA模型缺乏统一的协同推理框架来同时处理实时约束和系统级能效问题。
AI.method: EcoVLA包含三个核心组件：(1) 统一的阶段级抽象，覆盖不同VLA范式，建立架构无关的协同推理设计空间；(2) 联合设备-边缘-网络的延迟与能耗预测模型，用于快速评估候选协同推理方案；(3) 自适应方案选择机制，以毫秒级开销持续选择满足实时约束的能效最优方案。此外还包含轻量级的跨设备中间张量传输机制以降低通信开销。
AI.result: 在多个VLA模型上的实验表明，在20 Hz动作输出频率约束下，EcoVLA相比现有协同推理方法将系统能效提升最高达236%，并在动态网络和边缘工作负载条件下持续满足SLO（服务水平目标）。
AI.conclusion: EcoVLA验证了端-边协同推理在VLA模型上的可行性与有效性，通过架构无关的抽象、精准的延迟/能耗建模和自适应方案选择，能够在动态系统条件下同时保证实时性与能效，为VLA模型的机器人端部署提供了系统化的解决方案。

title: PL-Guard: Probabilistic Logic Reasoning for LLM Guardrails
comment: Preliminary version of this paper was presented at the IJCAI 2026 Workshop on Logical and Symbolic Reasoning of Large Language Models
summary: Large language model guardrails can be viewed as policy-consistency problems: a system must determine which policy-relevant facts hold in a prompt-response pair and what those facts imply under a given policy. Common approaches, including policy prompting and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, often overlap the tasks of semantic grounding and policy reasoning: the model both interprets the prompt-response pair and reasons about whether a policy has been violated. This can lead to unsafe compliance with harmful prompts, or refusals to assist benign ones. To separate grounding and reasoning roles, we propose PL-Guard, a neurosymbolic guardrail architecture. Using a symbolic policy interface consisting of predicates and ProbLog rules, a local LLM grounds prompt-response pairs into predicate probabilities using renormalized True/False token scores, while ProbLog performs explicit probabilistic rule inference over the symbolic policy. On the XSTest benchmark, an offline Qwen-based evaluator finds that PL-Guard with a hand-curated policy reduces unsafe compliance from 22.0% for the base model to 0.5%, and below the 6.0% rate of an LLM-as-a-judge baseline. This comes at the cost of higher over-refusal than the LLM-as-a-judge baseline, 14.4% versus 5.2%. These results suggest that separating neural grounding from probabilistic symbolic reasoning can expose the safety-helpfulness tradeoff while making the guardrail's intermediate reasoning steps explicit and auditable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PL-Guard，一种神经符号护栏架构，通过将语义接地（神经LLM）与策略推理（ProbLog符号推理）分离，解决了LLM护栏中安全合规与过度拒绝之间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM护栏方法（如策略提示和LLM-as-judge）将语义接地和策略推理任务混在一起，导致模型既解释提示-响应对又判断策略违规，可能产生对有害提示的不安全遵从或对良性提示的错误拒绝。
AI.method: PL-Guard采用神经符号架构：使用符号策略接口（谓词和ProbLog规则），本地LLM通过重归一化的True/False token分数将提示-响应对接地为谓词概率，ProbLog执行显式的概率规则推理。
AI.result: 在XSTest基准上，PL-Guard将不安全遵从率从基础模型的22.0%降至0.5%，低于LLM-as-judge基线的6.0%；但过度拒绝率14.4%高于基线的5.2%。
AI.conclusion: 分离神经接地与概率符号推理可以显式暴露安全-帮助性权衡，同时使护栏的中间推理步骤可审计，为构建更安全、更透明的LLM护栏提供了新方向。

title: Who Leads Now? Token-Level Modality Arbitration for Chart-to-Code Generation
summary: Chart-to-code generation requires a model to read the fine-grained visual details of a chart and write executable code that reproduces it. Existing chart-to-code methods either train visual and coding abilities separately, or fine-tune on chart-to-code data with the two abilities entangled. Neither strategy accounts for the distinct nature of the two abilities or the interference that arises when they are optimized together. We propose MoCA (Mixture of Cross-modal Arbitration), which separates the two abilities rather than blending them. MoCA is built on Cross-modal Arbitration Block (CAB), which maintains a visual branch and a code branch as two distinct pathways, and a lightweight arbiter that arbitrates their relative contributions at every layer and generated token. We train MoCA in two stages: a supervised warm-up on self-distilled reasoning trajectories that decomposes visual understanding into explicit steps, followed by reinforcement learning with rewards on both the reasoning process and the final code. Analysis shows that the arbiter learns structured rather than arbitrary allocations, with expert contributions varying systematically across tokens, layers, and instances. Across three benchmarks, MoCA delivers competitive performance against general-domain and chart-specialized models. Ablation results show that the gains cannot be attributed to a larger model size alone, but instead arise from the joint contributions of complementary visual and code branch initialization and input-conditioned arbitration through CAB.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoCA（Mixture of Cross-modal Arbitration），一种用于图表到代码生成的模型架构，通过交叉模态仲裁块（CAB）将视觉理解和代码生成两种能力分离为独立的通路，并由轻量仲裁器在每个层和生成的token上动态调节两者的贡献，而非传统方法那样将两种能力混合训练。
AI.motivation: 现有图表到代码生成方法存在两方面问题：要么分别训练视觉和代码能力（忽略了它们的协同关系），要么在图表到代码数据上对两种能力进行纠缠式微调（忽略了两种能力的本质差异以及联合优化时产生的干扰）。作者认为这两种能力应该分离而非混合。
AI.method: MoCA基于交叉模态仲裁块（CAB）构建，CAB维护视觉分支和代码分支作为两条独立通路，并设有一个轻量仲裁器来在每个层和生成的每个token上调节两者的相对贡献。训练分两阶段：(1) 在自蒸馏推理轨迹上进行监督预热，将视觉理解分解为显式步骤；(2) 用强化学习对推理过程和最终代码同时给予奖励。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试上，MoCA的性能可与通用领域和图表专用模型相媲美。消融实验表明性能提升不能仅归因于更大的模型规模，而是源于视觉和代码分支互补初始化的联合贡献，以及通过CAB实现的输入条件化仲裁。分析显示仲裁器学到的是结构化而非随意的分配，专家贡献随token、层和实例呈现系统性变化。
AI.conclusion: MoCA通过明确分离视觉理解与代码生成能力，并用仲裁机制动态调节两者的交互，有效避免了两种能力联合优化时的干扰问题，为图表到代码生成提供了一种新的范式。

title: Learning Auditable Classifier Models: Source-Disjoint Tree Ensembles
summary: Predictive models in clinical and regulated settings must be accurate and fully auditable. Tree ensembles deliver strong accuracy on tabular data, but their sequential boosting couples structure discovery with coefficient estimation, making compact per-prediction auditing difficult. Interpretable alternatives impose structural constraints that limit expressiveness: generalized additive models typically restrict interactions to pairwise terms and post-hoc rule extractors produce overlapping rules that hinder compact interpretation. We introduce Residual Pattern Tree Ensemble (RPTE), a three-stage learning approach, that is built on three key principles: bounded feature budget, source disjointness, and separate coefficient estimation. Stage~1 builds a supervised symbolic feature vocabulary. Stage~2 grows shallow trees under a source-disjointness constraint, where each raw variable is allocated to at most one tree, and retains only the discovered tree structures. Stage~3 solves a single $\ell_1$-regularized logistic regression over leaf-region indicators, yielding jointly optimal sparse coefficients. This learning approach ensures that every prediction decomposes into an algebraic sum of named, non-overlapping rule contributions, enabling full auditability by design. Empirical evaluation on twelve clinical-domain binary classification benchmarks using repeated stratified 5-fold cross-validation shows that RPTE performs competitively against tuned opaque ensembles and interpretable baselines. RPTE reduces model inspection units by 9$\times$ to 87$\times$ relative to XGBoost and maintains lower audit complexity than EBM on all 12 datasets. RuleFit requires comparable or fewer inspection units on three datasets where its rule count is small, but without source-disjointness guarantees. The source code is available at \href{https://github.com/srikumar2050/hugiml-core}{this https URL}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RPTE（Residual Pattern Tree Ensemble），一种三阶段可审计的树集成学习方法，通过有界特征预算、源不重叠约束和独立系数估计，使每个预测可分解为命名且不重叠的规则贡献之和，在12个临床二分类基准上达到与黑盒集成模型相当的性能，同时将模型检查单元减少9到87倍。
AI.motivation: 临床和监管场景中的预测模型必须既准确又完全可审计。树集成模型（如XGBoost）虽然准确但逐预测审计困难；可解释替代方案（如GAM）限制表达能力，仅支持成对交互；事后规则提取器产生重叠规则，妨碍紧凑解释。现有方法无法同时满足准确性和完全可审计性。
AI.method: RPTE采用三阶段学习：Stage 1构建有监督符号特征词汇表；Stage 2在源不重叠约束下生长浅层树（每个原始变量最多分配给一棵树），仅保留发现的树结构；Stage 3对叶区域指示变量求解单一L1正则化逻辑回归，获得联合最优稀疏系数。这保证每个预测可分解为命名、不重叠规则贡献的代数求和。
AI.result: 在12个临床领域二分类基准上，使用重复分层5折交叉验证，RPTE与调参后的黑盒集成模型和可解释基线表现相当。相比XGBoost，RPTE将模型检查单元减少9到87倍；在所有12个数据集上比EBM保持更低的审计复杂度；RuleFit仅在少数规则数量较少的数据集上可比或更少，但缺乏源不重叠保证。
AI.conclusion: RPTE通过设计实现了完全可审计性：预测分解为命名、不重叠规则的代数求和，在不牺牲预测性能的前提下大幅降低审计复杂度，为临床和监管环境提供了一种兼具准确性与透明性的模型选择。

title: From Contexts to Values: Context-Dependent Defeat in Abstract Argumentation
comment: Accepted to SAFA workshop at COMMA 2026
summary: In value-based argumentation, an audience's ordering of values decides which attacks succeed as defeats. In many settings the deciding factor is not the audience but the circumstances: the same attack may succeed at one procedural stage, or under one regulation, and fail at another. Context-dependent argumentation frameworks (CDAFs), a model we recently introduced, capture this directly: one set of arguments, one attack relation, and a defeat function that switches each attack on or off per context, so every context induces an ordinary Dung framework. This raises a reduction question: is context genuinely new, or can one value assignment with per-context orderings reproduce the defeat function, collapsing the CDAF into a VAF? We present a polynomial-time decision procedure for this question and map the harder neighbouring problems, with upper bounds from NP to $Σ^p_3$. We also present a validated reference implementation and a measurement: representability is rare and falls fast with the number of contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了上下文相关论证框架（CDAFs）与基于价值的论证框架（VAFs）之间的关系，提出一个关键问题：CDAF是否能被简化为VAF。作者给出了该问题的多项式时间判定算法，并刻画了更难的邻近问题的复杂度上界（从NP到Σ^p_3）。同时通过验证的参考实现和实验测量表明，可表示性是罕见的，且随上下文数量增加迅速下降。
AI.motivation: 在基于价值的论证中，受众的价值排序决定攻击是否成为击败。但实际场景中决定因素往往是情境（程序阶段、规章制度等）而非受众。作者此前提出了CDAF模型来直接捕捉这一点。现在需要回答一个理论还原问题：CDAF是否真正具有新意，还是可以塌缩为VAF？这关乎该模型的根本价值。
AI.method: 作者提出一个多项式时间的判定程序来决定CDAF是否可还原为VAF（即是否存在带每上下文价值排序的价值赋值来复现击败函数）。同时系统地刻画了相邻的更困难问题的复杂度，从NP到Σ^p_3的上界。还提供了经过验证的参考实现，并进行大规模测量实验。
AI.result: 给出了CDAF到VAF可还原性的多项式时间判定算法；对更难邻近问题给出了从NP到Σ^p_3的复杂度上界；通过参考实现和实验测量发现，可还原性（可表示性）是罕见的，且随上下文数量增加而快速下降。
AI.conclusion: CDAF在大多数情况下不能塌缩为VAF，表明该模型确实提供了超越VAF的表达能力，具有独立的研究价值。同时复杂度结果和测量数据为理解问题空间提供了系统性图景。

title: ATLAS: Scaffold-Free Algorithm Synthesis by LLMs via Embedding-Guided Quality-Diversity Search
summary: Most LLM-based automated algorithm design methods optimize a designated component within a human-specified scaffold, fixing overall organization and component interactions. We present ATLAS, an embedding-guided quality-diversity framework for scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis in combinatorial optimization. The problem specification supplies objectives and constraints; a minimal I/O interface fixes only instance and solution formats; the LLM chooses and restructures components, interactions, and control flow. This freedom enlarges the search space, risking invalid candidates and premature convergence to one design region. ATLAS independently detects execution, interface, and feasibility failures, recomputes objectives, and applies error-conditioned repair; similarity-based archive management preserves algorithms across embedding-space regions to counter premature convergence. Its three-layer search refines the best design, gives other regions dedicated refinement opportunities, and performs cross-region synthesis to recombine components and their interactions. Across four NP-hard problems, ATLAS outperforms several state-of-the-art component-synthesis methods and a matched full-synthesis baseline while remaining competitive with strong human-designed algorithms. One ATLAS run retains several algorithms with comparable performance from distinct embedding-space regions rather than a single design. Code inspection finds that these multi-component designs differ in their primary construction or global-search backbone. Our results suggest that embedding-guided quality-diversity search can make the enlarged full-algorithm design space practically searchable. Source code and exact executable prompts are available at <https://github.com/Danial-Yazdani/ATLAS>.

AI.tldr: ATLAS是一个基于嵌入引导的多样性框架，用于免脚手架的全算法合成，在组合优化问题上能搜索更大的设计空间，比现有方法表现更好。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM自动化算法设计方法只优化人类指定脚手架内的某个组件，限制了整体组织和组件交互的探索空间。
AI.method: ATLAS采用嵌入引导的质量多样性框架：问题规格定义目标与约束，仅需最小I/O接口；独立检测执行、接口和可行性失败并进行错误条件修复；基于相似性的archive管理保留不同嵌入区域的算法；三层搜索分别进行最优设计细化、其他区域细化以及跨区域重组。
AI.result: 在四个NP难问题上，ATLAS超越多种最先进的组件合成方法和匹配的全合成基线，与强人工设计算法竞争力相当；单次运行能从不同嵌入区域保留多个性能相当的算法，且这些多组件设计在主要构造或全局搜索骨干上存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入引导的多样性搜索使得扩大后的全算法设计空间实际可搜索，代码和提示词已开源。

title: Propaganda Forensics: Recovering the Generation Pipeline of an AI-Driven Influence Campaign
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 10th Workshop on Online Abuse and Harms (WOAH), EMNLP 2026
summary: We present a forensic analysis of the generation pipeline behind a recent AI-driven influence campaign. We introduce PROPAGIA, a corpus of 2,646 propagandist French articles from the Storm-1516/CopyCop campaign disclosed by VIGINUM and INSIKT GROUP in 2025. For comparison, we rely on SIPA, a corpus of human-written French mainstream press from the same period. Using topic modeling, vagueness and sentiment analysis, we first isolate persuasion techniques characteristic of propaganda, with PROPAGIA far exceeding SIPA in vagueness, subjectivity and negativity, and citing fewer sources. We then find prompt instruction leaks on 50 of the 84 PROPAGIA websites, including a verbatim ten-point editorial specification accounting for several of these differences, together with high cross-article redundancy. Finally, we show that rewriting-based detection supports INSIKT GROUP's attribution to the Llama 3 family, but also suggests the involvement of Mistral-family models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍PROPAGIA语料库，包含来自Storm-1516/CopyCop AI驱动宣传活动的2,646篇法语宣传文章，通过与人类撰写的主流新闻语料库SIPA对比，识别出宣传独有的说服技巧特征，并发现提示词泄露、跨文章冗余性，以及通过重写检测支持对Llama 3和Mistral系列模型的归因。
AI.motivation: 随着AI生成内容被用于大规模影响力活动，亟需对这类宣传管道的法证分析方法，以识别AI驱动宣传的特征并将其与人类撰写的新闻内容区分开来。
AI.method: 构建PROPAGIA语料库并与SIPA对照；使用主题建模、模糊性、情感分析等手段隔离宣传特有的说服技巧；检查网站提示词泄露；采用重写检测方法进行模型归因。
AI.result: PROPAGIA在模糊性、主观性和消极性上远超SIPA，引用来源更少；84个网站中有50个存在提示词指令泄露，包括一条10点编辑规范的逐字泄露；重写检测支持对Llama 3系列的归因，同时暗示Mistral系列模型的参与。
AI.conclusion: AI驱动宣传与人类撰写的新闻在多个语言特征上存在显著可量化的差异，提示词泄露和重写检测为识别和归因AI生成宣传内容提供了有效手段。

title: TinyCast: Probabilistic Zero-Shot Forecasting with Computed Periodicity
comment: 38 pages, 6 figures, 17 tables. Code and weights: https://github.com/raws-labs/tinycast
summary: We introduce TinyCast, an attention-free zero-shot forecaster that emits a predictive distribution from 146,505 parameters, on the premise that at this size the periodic structure of a context is worth computing rather than learning. A zero-parameter spectral detector supplies the dominant periods, the context is folded on their phase, and a dilated convolutional encoder and a block-autoregressive quantile decoder model the rest. It is smaller than every zero-shot entry on the GIFT-Eval board whose parameter count can be established. On probabilistic accuracy it defines the size-accuracy frontier. Among zero-shot entries declaring no test-data leakage it is the only one below 1.4M parameters that emits a predictive distribution, and every entry scoring better carries at least that budget. On Chronos-ZS and fev-bench every neural model ahead of it carries at least 28 times its parameters. Because the mixing path is convolutions and matrix multiplications only, it exports to static INT8 and forecasts end to end on an embedded device without per-signal fitting.

AI.tldr: TinyCast 是一个仅含 146,505 个参数的无注意力零样本预测模型，通过零参数频谱检测器识别主周期、按相位折叠上下文，并用扩张卷积编码器和分块自回归分位数解码器进行预测。它在 GIFT-Eval 榜单上以极小规模定义了"大小-精度"前沿，且支持静态 INT8 导出，可在嵌入式设备上端到端运行。
AI.motivation: 在极小的参数规模下（<1.4M），周期性结构值得显式计算而非由模型学习，从而实现超轻量级的高精度零样本预测。
AI.method: 1) 零参数频谱检测器提取主导周期；2) 按相位折叠上下文；3) 扩张卷积编码器 + 分块自回归分位数解码器建模残差；4) 仅使用卷积和矩阵乘法的混合路径，支持静态 INT8 量化导出。
AI.result: 在 GIFT-Eval 上以最小参数规模定义大小-精度前沿；在 Chronos-ZS 和 fev-bench 上，所有超越它的神经模型至少携带其 28 倍参数；是唯一低于 1.4M 参数且发射预测分布、且声明无测试数据泄漏的零样本模型。
AI.conclusion: 在极小参数规模下，将周期性先验作为显式计算而非学习目标是可行的，TinyCast 证明了可以构建兼具概率精度与极端轻量级、且可部署于嵌入式设备的零样本预测器。

title: Admission Without Answers: Label-Free Certification and Experience Learning for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
comment: Code and data are available at \url{https://github.com/junbolian/AdmitOR}
summary: Experience-learning agents for optimization modeling improve by storing verified skills, but existing learners admit knowledge by checking against known answers, which real ticket streams do not provide. The natural label-free alternatives are unreliable: on a 300-problem label-blind stream, admitting every executable model poisons roughly one admission in four, while single-instance agreement accepts models that match at one value but differ elsewhere. We propose AdmitOR, an admission gate built on calibrated external behavioral evidence. Candidates from three model families, prompting strategies, and solver stacks are run on instances resampled from an extracted parameter domain; agreement across the resulting value-function traces is summarized by a cross-family clique, and a calibrated threshold returns accept, abstain, or escalate. The preregistered false-discovery criterion holds on calibration data but not on the wild stream. We report this negative result in full and trace most failures to benchmark texts that do not faithfully encode their labeled instances. Comparing four admission judges on one collection of logs inside a state-of-the-art skill learner, AdmitOR raises admission precision to 0.927, against 0.871 for majority vote and 0.726 for execution success, yielding 3.1x and 8.0x fewer poisoned admissions. Its library is the smallest and attains the highest macro accuracy across five public benchmarks, 58.4 against 54.8 for majority vote and 53.9 for the ground-truth-labeled library. The 3.5-point gain over majority vote is supported by a paired bootstrap and survives correction for a host-side anomaly. To our knowledge, AdmitOR is the first label-free admission mechanism designed around an explicitly calibrated false-discovery target. The transfer failure identifies a necessary condition for extending it to wild streams.

AI.tldr: AdmitOR 是一个面向优化建模智能体的无标签准入机制，通过校准的外部行为证据（跨模型族的轨迹一致性）来判定是否接纳候选技能，在收集的日志上将准入精度提升至0.927，但预注册的假发现率标准在真实流上失败，论文完整报告了这一负面结果。
AI.motivation: 现有经验学习智能体通过核对已知答案来接纳技能，但真实工单流不提供此类标签。无标签的替代方案（如接纳所有可执行模型或单实例一致性）均不可靠——前者每四个接纳中约有一个被污染，后者会接受仅在单点匹配但其余处不同的模型。
AI.method: AdmitOR 从提取的参数域中重采样实例，运行来自三个模型族、多种提示策略和求解器栈的候选模型；用跨族团（cross-family clique）汇总值函数轨迹间的一致性，并通过校准阈值返回接受、弃权或升级三种决策。
AI.result: 在四个准入评判器的对比中，AdmitOR 将准入精度提升至0.927（多数投票0.871、执行成功0.726），毒化接纳分别减少3.1倍和8.0倍；其技能库最小且在五个公开基准上达到最高宏精度58.4（多数投票54.8、真值标注库53.9）。但预注册的假发现率标准在真实流上未保持，失败多归因于基准文本未忠实编码其标注实例。
AI.conclusion: AdmitOR 是首个围绕显式校准的假发现目标设计的无标签准入机制，但其向真实流的迁移失败揭示了扩展的必要条件——基准文本必须忠实编码标签实例。

title: Routing Divergence Is Not Evidence of Behavioral Influence in Same-Weight MoE Self-Distillation
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures
summary: Two Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) forward passes can share every weight yet route the same token through different experts. This creates a possible blind spot in same-weight self-distillation, where a demonstration-conditioned teacher supervises a query-only student. We study this mismatch in its single-step form, with frozen weights rather than as a proxy for a full training trajectory. An exact blockwise decomposition separates a routing term, which changes gates at fixed content, from a dense-like content term. Across seven open-weight checkpoints and two domains, the routing term spans only $1.6\times$ as a fraction of block output, while its residual-stream exposure spans $3.2\times$. Exposure is ordered by the routed block's share of the residual. Scaling the always-on backbone in two confirmatory models moves exposure monotonically; common-mode controls support a mass-and-coherence mechanism rather than denominator dilution alone. Preregistered PubMedQA patches on three models show that the full routing term moves outputs by less than half the natural context effect and is largely reproduced by matched-norm noise, whereas the content term is strongly direction-specific. Scale and merged-expert probes show that the narrow block-level range is not universal, although exposure remains small at the tested boundaries. Router movement alone is therefore not evidence of behavioral influence: measure exposure first, and use a behavioral intervention when the decision matters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合专家（MoE）模型中同权重自蒸馏的盲区：两次前向传播共享权重但同一token可能路由到不同专家。通过精确的逐块分解，将路由项（固定内容改变门控）与稠密内容项分离。实验发现路由项在块输出中仅占1.6倍范围，而在残差流暴露中占3.2倍，且暴露程度与路由块的残差占比相关。在PubMedQA上的预注册实验表明，路由项移动输出的效应不足自然上下文效应的一半，且大部分可由匹配范数的噪声复现，而内容项则具有强方向特异性。结论：路由移动本身不能作为行为影响的证据，应先测量暴露度，在关键决策时使用行为干预。
AI.motivation: MoE模型中，同权重自蒸馏存在一个潜在盲区：教师和学生可能路由到不同专家，导致"示范条件化教师"与"纯查询学生"之间的不匹配。现有研究缺乏对该路由不匹配是否真正影响行为的定量分析，作者希望精确分离路由效应与内容效应，避免将路由差异误认为行为影响。
AI.method: 采用单步形式（冻结权重），而非作为完整训练轨迹的代理。提出精确的逐块（blockwise）分解方法，将输出变化分解为路由项（固定内容改变门控）和稠密类内容项。在七个开源权重检查点和两个领域上进行评估，并用两个确认性模型验证骨干缩放效应。使用预注册的PubMedQA补丁实验，将路由移动与自然上下文效应及匹配范数噪声对比，辅以缩放和合并专家探针测试。
AI.result: 路由项在块输出中仅跨越1.6倍范围，但在残差流暴露中跨越3.2倍。暴露度由路由块在残差中的占比决定。缩放常开骨干使暴露度单调变化；共模控制支持"质量与一致性"机制而非单纯的分母稀释。PubMedQA实验显示路由项移动输出不足自然上下文效应的一半，且大部分可被匹配范数噪声复现；内容项则方向特异性强。窄块级范围并非普遍现象，但边界处暴露度仍然很小。
AI.conclusion: 路由器的移动本身不足以证明行为影响。在实践中应首先测量暴露度（exposure），在决策关键时使用行为干预（behavioral intervention）。该研究为MoE自蒸馏中的路由不匹配提供了定量框架，防止将路由差异误判为语义差异。

title: Temporal Graph Prototype-conditioned Conformal Prediction for Fraud Detection
comment: Accpeted by KDD 2026
summary: Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free coverage guarantees and has emerged as a principled tool for uncertainty quantification. In edge-level fraud detection on temporal interaction graphs, where false positives and false negatives both carry substantial cost, such coverage guarantees are particularly appealing for risk-aware decision making. However, directly applying existing graph conformal predictors yields inefficient prediction sets due to two recurring properties of fraud data. Fraudulent interactions are often embedded in benign-dominated neighborhoods that dilute calibration signals, while extreme class imbalance leaves scarce labeled-fraud support in the calibration split and leads to overly conservative class-conditional thresholds. To address these issues, we propose ProtoCP, a conformal prediction framework for edge-level fraud detection on temporal graphs. ProtoCP improves calibration efficiency by focusing calibration on fraud-relevant subgraph context and producing more stable nonconformity scores under class imbalance and temporal drift. Specifically, it leverages learned prototypes to suppress benign-dominated noise in the calibration context and introduces a neighborhood-relative scoring mechanism with temporal score diffusion for stable class-conditional calibration. Experiments on four fraud benchmarks (YelpChi, S-FFSD, FTFD, and BankSim) show that ProtoCP achieves the target coverage with consistently smaller prediction sets than state-of-the-art baselines. Our codes are available at https://github.com/Picard1701ent/ProtoCP.git

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProtoCP，一种针对时序交互图边级欺诈检测的保形预测框架。它通过聚焦欺诈相关子图上下文的校准和更稳定的非一致性评分，解决了欺诈数据中良性主导领域稀释校准信号和极端类别不平衡导致的保守阈值问题，在四个欺诈基准上实现了更小的预测集。
AI.motivation: 边级欺诈检测中假阳性和假阴性都代价高昂，保形预测的覆盖保证对风险决策很有价值。但现有的图保形预测器直接应用效率低，原因有二：欺诈交互常嵌入良性主导的邻域，稀释校准信号；极端类别不平衡导致校准集中标注欺诈样本稀缺，产生过度保守的类别条件阈值。
AI.method: ProtoCP通过两条途径提升校准效率：一是利用学习到的原型（prototypes）抑制校准上下文中的良性主导噪声；二是引入邻域相对评分机制结合时间分数扩散，在类别不平衡和时间漂移下实现更稳定的类别条件校准。
AI.result: 在YelpChi、S-FFSD、FTFD和BankSim四个欺诈基准上，ProtoCP在达到目标覆盖率的同时，生成的预测集始终小于现有最优基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ProtoCP有效解决了欺诈数据中保形预测校准效率低下的问题，在保持覆盖保证的同时显著提高了预测集的精准度，为时序图上边级欺诈检测提供了更高效的不确定性量化工具。

title: From Generalist to Specialist: A Context-Fusion Framework for Endoscopic Polyp Reporting with a Frozen VLM
summary: Reliable endoscopic polyp reporting requires integrating quantitative lesion sizing, standardized Paris classification, and clinically meaningful morphological description within a single record. General-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) offer a unified interface for image understanding and report generation. Existing specialization strategies, however, typically rely on task-specific models or model-weight adaptation, leaving unresolved how to introduce reliable specialist knowledge while preserving both this unified interface and the VLM's pretrained capabilities. We introduce a context-fusion framework that specializes a frozen general-purpose VLM through both implicit instruction context and explicit transduction context without modifying its pretrained weights. Specifically, a self-supervised polyp encoder retrieves related image-report pairs as explicit, query-specific evidence, while learned continuous specialist tokens provide implicit instruction context shared across cases. Experiments were conducted on 2,056 expert-annotated public endoscopic images. We compared the framework with general-purpose VLMs, task-specific predictors, and weight-adaptation methods to assess specialist performance, unified reporting, and adaptation efficiency. Across numerical, categorical, and report-generation metrics, the proposed framework substantially improved direct frozen-VLM inference and achieved the strongest overall performance among the evaluated methods. It added trainable parameters equal to only 0.006% of the frozen VLM's parameter count. When the top-1 retrieved case carried the correct target category, our framework corrected 70.5% of the errors made by a weight-adaptation baseline. These findings support the context-fusion framework as a lightweight and effective strategy for specialist adaptation of a frozen VLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种上下文融合框架，通过隐式指令上下文和显式转导上下文来特化冻结的通用视觉-语言模型（VLM），无需修改预训练权重即可实现可靠的内窥镜息肉报告生成，仅增加0.006%的可训练参数，并在多项指标上超越权重微调方法。
AI.motivation: 可靠的内窥镜息肉报告需要整合定量病变尺寸、标准化巴黎分类和临床形态描述。通用VLM提供统一接口，但现有特化策略依赖任务特定模型或权重微调，无法在保留统一接口和预训练能力的同时引入专家知识。
AI.method: 提出上下文融合框架：(1) 自监督息肉编码器检索相关图像-报告对作为显式、查询特异的证据；(2) 学习连续专家token提供跨病例共享的隐式指令上下文。该框架不修改冻结VLM的预训练权重，通过两种上下文的融合实现专家特化。
AI.result: 在2,056张专家标注的公开内窥镜图像上，该框架在数值、分类和报告生成指标上均显著优于直接冻结VLM推理，总体性能在对比方法中最强。可训练参数仅为冻结VLM参数量的0.006%。在top-1检索案例携带正确目标类别时，能纠正权重微调基线70.5%的错误。
AI.conclusion: 上下文融合框架是一种轻量且有效的冻结VLM专家特化策略，为在保留通用VLM统一接口和预训练能力的同时引入可靠专家知识提供了可行方案。

title: KV-Rescue: Recovering Reasoning Language Model KV Eviction Loss via Stepwise Interleaving
summary: KV-cache eviction caps the memory cost of long reasoning traces but is inherently lossy because the model decodes from a partial view of its history. Under aggressive budgets, this not only lowers accuracy but can also cause runaway degeneration, where the model produces incoherent or repetitive tokens until reaching the length limit. We characterize much of this loss as an information gapf caused by missing context, rather than a capability gap caused by limited model capacity. An evicted 7B model and a full-context 1.5B model make complementary errors, and an oracle choice between their answers recovers 79% of the accuracy gap to the full-KV 7B model. Based on this observation, we propose KV-Rescue, a training-free inference framework that bridges the information gap introduced by KV eviction using a lightweight full-context helper. KV-Rescue interleaves reasoning steps from the two models into a shared trajectory. An online detector uses entropy and compressibility to terminate the generation of incoherent or repetitive base-model candidates early. Across five math benchmarks with Qwen2.5-Math 7B and 72B, KV-Rescue recovers an average of 87% of the accuracy lost to eviction at eviction budget B=64. A decode-cost analysis further shows that preventing runaway degeneration cuts base-model token generation by 43% on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KV-Rescue框架，利用轻量级全上下文辅助模型来弥补KV缓存驱逐带来的信息损失，通过交替推理和在线检测器终止退化生成，恢复87%的精度损失并减少43%的token生成。
AI.motivation: KV缓存驱逐虽然能控制长推理轨迹的内存成本，但本质上是有损的——模型从部分历史中进行解码，导致准确率下降甚至出现失控退化（产生不连贯或重复token）。作者发现这种损失主要是由于缺失上下文造成的信息差距，而非模型能力差距。
AI.method: 提出KV-Rescue训练无关推理框架：(1)使用轻量级全上下文辅助模型与驱逐的基座模型交替生成推理步骤，共享轨迹；(2)在线检测器基于熵和可压缩性，提前终止基座模型产生的不连贯或重复生成；(3)通过信息差距桥接，让辅助模型提供被驱逐的上下文信息。
AI.result: 在五个数学基准上，使用Qwen2.5-Math 7B和72B模型，KV-Rescue在B=64的驱逐预算下平均恢复87%的精度损失；解码成本分析显示，防止失控退化平均削减了43%的基座模型token生成。
AI.conclusion: KV驱逐造成的精度损失主要源于信息差距而非能力差距，通过轻量级全上下文辅助模型可以高效桥接这一差距，在不进行训练的情况下显著缓解驱逐带来的性能退化，同时降低解码成本。

title: Agent Gym: A Framework for Continuous Evaluation and Evolution of LLM Agents Through Human-in-the-Loop Feedback
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents deployed in production environments face a fundamental tension: the agent's behavior is frozen at deployment time, while the business rules and edge cases it must handle continue to evolve. Existing approaches address agent construction and one-time evaluation but provide no structured mechanism for continuous post-deployment behavioral correction without modifying the agent's source code. Most of the approaches offered in the market, require intense collection of logs and traces, and re-examining the agent design by the engineering team, a process which is heavy, long and negates the economical value of agentic transformation. We introduce Agent Gym, a modular, domain-agnostic framework that wraps any existing LLM-based agent in a continuous evaluation-and-evolution loop. The framework provides six composable capabilities --- Act, Evaluate, Investigate, Correct, Learn, and Observe --- organized across three architectural zones: a constitution layer that codifies domain knowledge in configuration artifacts, a runtime inference pipeline that chains acting, investigation, and adaptive correction, and a learning loop that enables subject matter experts to discover and validate new correction rules through natural language interaction. The key technical contributions include a hybrid deterministic-LLM correction engine with 21 condition operators and three-tier actions, a three-layer investigation architecture for ground-truth-free compliance validation, and a programmatic safety loop that guarantees rule correctness before human approval. We further introduce the Spec-to-Note Gap, an autoencoder-inspired view of agentic system transparency. An open-source reference implementation for invoice processing demonstrates that the framework is fully operational and ready for adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agent Gym，一个模块化、领域无关的框架，为现有LLM代理提供持续评估与进化循环，解决代理行为在部署后被冻结而业务规则持续演化的矛盾。框架通过六大能力（Act、Evaluate、Investigate、Correct、Learn、Observe）跨三个架构区域运作，实现无需修改源代码的持续行为纠正。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中部署的LLM代理面临根本性矛盾：部署时行为被冻结，但业务规则和边界情况持续演化。现有方法只处理代理构建和一次性评估，缺乏部署后持续行为纠正的结构化机制。市场现有方案需要大量日志收集和工程团队重新审查，过程繁重且周期长，削弱了代理化转型的经济价值。
AI.method: Agent Gym提供三个关键技术创新：(1) 混合确定性-LLM纠正引擎，含21个条件操作符和三层动作；(2) 三层调查架构，用于无真实标签的合规验证；(3) 程序化安全循环，在人工审批前保证规则正确性。框架组织结构为：宪法层（以配置工件编码领域知识）、运行时推理流水线（行动、调查、自适应纠正链式连接）、学习循环（领域专家通过自然语言交互发现和验证新纠正规则）。此外引入Spec-to-Note Gap作为自动编码器启发的代理系统透明度视角。
AI.result: 通过发票处理的开放源代码参考实现，演示了框架完全可操作并可供采用。六大组合能力（Act、Evaluate、Investigate、Correct、Learn、Observe）跨三个架构区域组织，证明了框架的实际可用性。
AI.conclusion: Agent Gym为解决LLM代理部署后持续进化问题提供了系统化方案，让领域专家无需修改源代码即可通过自然语言交互持续完善代理行为，同时通过程序化安全机制保证纠正规则的正确性，是迈向可持续代理运维的重要一步。

title: Schema-Agnostic Graph Reasoning Agent for Hybrid Knowledge Graphs
summary: Tool-calling LLM agents navigate unfamiliar codebases with a handful of generic primitives for listing, reading and searching files (ls, cat, grep). A knowledge graph admits the same interface: listing neighbours, reading node content and searching descriptions are the same operations on a different substrate. Building on this correspondence, we present GRA, a Graph Reasoning Agent that explores hybrid knowledge graphs, whose nodes are either textual concepts or relational tables, with seven generic tools, discovering everything domain-specific at run time. On UFK-M (Unified Factory Knowledge Model), an industrial benchmark of 258 analytical questions whose gold answers are produced by executing validated SQL programs, GRA beats a full-context agent by 5.1 pp (88.4% vs. 83.3%), while reading under a third of its input tokens. A graph-free control shows the gain comes chiefly from selective agentic access rather than graph topology, and that the effect depends on a model able to drive tools reliably. Seeing less, the agent answers better: selective navigation over a structured substrate beats exhaustive context.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRA（图推理智能体），通过将LLM智能体在代码库上的通用工具操作（ls, cat, grep）映射到混合知识图谱上，用七个通用工具探索由文本概念和关系表构成的图谱。在UFK-M工业基准（258个分析问题）上，GRA以88.4%准确率超越全上下文智能体的83.3%，同时仅读取不到三分之一的输入token。对照实验表明，性能提升主要来自选择性智能体访问而非图谱拓扑本身。
AI.motivation: 工具调用的LLM智能体在探索陌生代码库时仅用少量通用原语（ls, cat, grep），而知识图谱支持相同的接口操作。作者认为两者之间存在对应关系，可以构建一个通用智能体来探索混合知识图谱（文本概念+关系表），无需事先定义领域特定工具。
AI.method: GRA使用七个通用工具探索混合知识图谱：列出邻居、读取节点内容、搜索描述等操作与代码库探索操作同构。图谱节点为文本概念或关系表，所有领域特定知识在运行时动态发现。在UFK-M基准上，通过执行验证过的SQL程序生成金标准答案进行评估，并设置无图谱对照组来分离图谱拓扑与选择性访问的贡献。
AI.result: 在UFK-M工业基准（258个分析问题）上，GRA达到88.4%准确率，比全上下文智能体（83.3%）高出5.1个百分点，同时仅读取不到三分之一的输入token。对照实验显示增益主要来自选择性智能体访问而非图谱拓扑，且该效果依赖于模型能可靠驱动工具的能力。
AI.conclusion: 看得更少反而回答得更好：在结构化基板上的选择性导航胜过穷举式上下文。这证明通用工具+选择性访问范式可以在知识图谱探索中带来效率与准确性的双重提升。

title: When Entropy Is Not Enough: Reclaiming Lost Semantics in LLM Output Length Prediction
summary: Efficient LLM serving is often bottlenecked by the need to pad sequences to a fixed maximum length, and this wastes compute and degrades throughput. Predicting output lengths in advance makes it possible to adopt length-aware scheduling, and this reduces the overhead. This advantage is especially pronounced in long-context reasoning and reinforcement learning applications. Existing approaches, such as entropy-guided token pooling, use token-wise entropy as their primary signal, but they tend to ignore differences in semantic content across tokens. So, important tokens are often underweighted, and tokens carrying little information receive disproportionate emphasis. This hurts the reliability of length prediction. We introduce ESTP (Entropy-and-Semantic Token Pooling), a lightweight framework that addresses this issue by combining entropy with attention-based importance scores. These scores are derived directly from the self-attention weights computed during the LLM prefill phase, and this allows ESTP to capture both uncertainty and semantic importance with minimal additional computation. Since the framework reuses prefill activations, it adds almost no extra memory overhead and introduces only minimal latency. On the ForeLen benchmark, ESTP outperforms baseline methods, achieves better prediction accuracy and lower error rates in most scenarios. When integrated with a length-aware scheduler in end-to-end system tests, it further helps improve overall throughput and reduce the padding ratio. Our results offer a practical and effective building block for length-aware LLM serving systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了ESTP（熵与语义Token池化）框架，通过结合熵和基于注意力的重要性分数来改进LLM输出长度预测，从而支持长度感知调度、减少填充开销并提升推理吞吐量。
AI.motivation: LLM服务中固定长度填充浪费计算资源并降低吞吐量，而长度预测可以缓解此问题。现有方法（如基于熵的token池化）仅使用token级熵作为信号，忽略了token之间的语义内容差异，导致重要token被低估、低信息token被过度强调，降低了长度预测的可靠性。
AI.method: ESTP将熵与基于自注意力权重的token重要性分数相结合。这些重要性分数直接来自LLM预填充阶段计算的自注意力权重，无需额外计算，能够同时捕捉不确定性和语义重要性。框架复用预填充激活，因此几乎不增加额外内存开销和延迟。
AI.result: 在ForeLen基准测试上，ESTP在大多数场景下优于基线方法，取得更好的预测精度和更低的错误率。在端到端系统测试中，与长度感知调度器集成后，进一步提高了整体吞吐量并降低了填充比例。
AI.conclusion: ESTP为长度感知的LLM服务系统提供了一个实用且高效的基础组件，通过融合熵和语义信号显著改善了长度预测的可靠性。

title: CrevasseSeg: A Label-Efficient UAV Crevasse Segmentation Framework
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables
summary: Crevasse mapping from uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery matters for glaciological research and for field safety in glaciated terrain. Yet, pixel-level annotation of glacier surfaces is costly and requires domain experts. We introduce CrevasseSeg, a framework for binary segmentation over the terminus of Borebreen, Svalbard, comprising 1,938 unlabelled UAV orthomosaic tiles for self-supervised/unsupervised fine-tuning, 24 labelled tiles for validation and 176 labelled tiles for testing. Using CrevasseSeg, we benchmark five self-supervised objectives -- BYOL, a Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) objective, Barlow-Twins, VICReg, and a combined BYOL-JSD objective -- across three architectures: O-Net, O-Net++, and a DINOv3-initialised O-Net. Each configuration is evaluated under two frozen-feature readouts that differ only in the form of their decision boundary: a linear probe and a non-linear XGBoost classifier fit only on the 24 labelled validation images. Our central finding is a consistent inversion between the two readouts: DINOv3 features are the weakest under linear probing but the strongest under a non-linear readout. A UMAP analysis of the learned feature space shows that DINOv3 fragments pixels into many small clusters in which the classes are locally interleaved, whereas the convolutional architectures (O-Net and O-Net++) embed them onto a single class-sorted manifold. Satellite-pretrained DINOv3 improves over natural-image initialisation across objectives, and our label-efficient DINOv3-ViT-L-Sat-O-Net-BYOL-JSD pipeline reaches 75.33 mDSC / 61.28 mIoU, outperforming standard machine learning baselines fit on the same 24 labelled images with the RGB pixel values used as features. We release CrevasseSeg to support label-efficient segmentation research in remote sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrevasseSeg框架，用于从UAV图像中自动绘制冰川裂隙（crevasse）。该框架在Svalbard Borebreen冰川末端进行二值分割，包含1,938张无标注瓦片用于自监督微调，24张标注用于验证，176张标注用于测试。作者对五个自监督目标（BYOL、JSD、Barlow-Twins、VICReg、BYOL-JSD组合）和三种架构（O-Net、O-Net++、DINOv3初始化的O-Net）进行了基准测试。核心发现是两种读出方式（线性探针与非线性XGBoost）的结果出现反转：DINOv3特征在线性探针下最弱但在非线性读出下最强。最终，DINOv3-ViT-L-Sat-O-Net-BYOL-JSD流程达到75.33 mDSC / 61.28 mIoU，优于基于RGB像素值的标准机器学习基线。
AI.motivation: 冰川裂隙（crevasse）对冰川学研究及野外作业安全至关重要，但UAV影像中裂隙的像素级标注成本高昂且需要领域专家。现有方法缺乏标签高效的解决方案，因此需要探索自监督/无监督微调策略来减少对大量标注数据的依赖。
AI.method: 提出CrevasseSeg框架：使用1,938张无标注UAV正射影像瓦片进行自监督微调；基准测试五个自监督目标（BYOL、JSD、Barlow-Twins、VICReg、BYOL-JSD组合）；三种架构（O-Net、O-Net++、DINOv3初始化的O-Net）；两种冻结特征读出方式（线性探针与非线性XGBoost分类器），仅用24张标注验证图像训练；并进行UMAP特征空间分析。
AI.result: 中心发现是两种读出间的持续性反转：DINOv3特征在线性探针下最弱但在非线性读出下最强。UMAP分析表明DINOv3将像素分割成众多小簇且类别局部交织，而卷积架构嵌入到单一类别排序流形上。卫星预训练的DINOv3优于自然图像初始化。最佳流程DINOv3-ViT-L-Sat-O-Net-BYOL-JSD达到75.33 mDSC / 61.28 mIoU，超越基于相同24张标注图像的RGB像素值机器学习基线。
AI.conclusion: CrevasseSeg为遥感中的标签高效分割研究提供了新基准。研究揭示了特征表示质量依赖于下游分类决策边界的形态这一重要发现：线性与非线性读出对同一特征的评价可能截然相反，这对自监督特征评估方法提出警示。框架已公开以支持后续研究。

title: TRACE: Trajectory Aware Reasoning for Multi-Turn Adversarial Conversation Evaluation
summary: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks have emerged as a critical safety threat to LLMs, as harmful objectives are decomposed across a sequence of apparently benign turns to bypass guardrails. Existing defenses lack the reasoning capacity to identify evolving manipulation patterns, often trading helpfulness for safety by over-refusing benign requests related to sensitive topics. We introduce Trace, a multi-turn defense with trajectory-aware structured reasoning. Before generating each response, the model identifies manipulation cues from the trajectory, evaluates both the benign and adversarial interpretations of user intent, assigns a jailbreak score, and commits to an action: Allow, Caution, or Decline. We curate 4k multi-turn adversarial conversations from five attack frameworks, pair them with 2.4k benign dialogs, and 600 sensitive-but-benign conversations. We train Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with SFT and GRPO under a multi-component reward that jointly optimizes helpfulness on benign prompts and robustness against jailbreak attempts. Across seven multi-turn attack benchmarks, Trace attains an average attack success rate (ASR) of 14.5% against 31.4% for the strongest baseline and 74.9% for the undefended target, while significantly raising the attacker effort required per successful jailbreak. Trace also balances usability and safety, achieving a 93.3% average compliance on over-refusal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出Trace，一种具备轨迹感知结构化推理的多轮越狱防御方法。模型在每次响应前识别操纵线索、评估意图双面解释、分配越狱分数并采取Allow/Caution/Decline动作，通过SFT+GRPO训练，在七个基准上ASR降至14.5%，同时保持93.3%的合规率。
AI.motivation: 多轮越狱攻击通过将有害目标分解到一系列看似良性的轮次中绕过防护，现有防御缺乏识别演化操纵模式的能力，常常以过度拒绝良性请求为代价换取安全性，牺牲了可用性。
AI.method: Trace框架包含轨迹感知结构化推理：响应前识别对话轨迹中的操纵线索、评估用户意图的良性/对抗性双面解释、分配越狱分数并选择Allow/Caution/Decline动作。训练数据包含4k多轮对抗对话（来自五种攻击框架）、2.4k良性对话和600个敏感但良性对话。采用SFT和GRPO训练Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，使用多组件奖励联合优化良性提示的helpfulness和对抗越狱的robustness。
AI.result: 在七个多轮攻击基准上平均ASR为14.5%，显著优于最强基线31.4%和未防御模型的74.9%，同时大幅提高了每次成功越狱所需的攻击成本；在过度拒绝基准上达到93.3%的平均合规率，实现了安全性与可用性的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹感知的结构化推理能够有效防御多轮越狱攻击，在不牺牲良性请求合规性的前提下显著提升鲁棒性，为多轮对话安全防御提供了新范式。

title: The Limits of Binding in Dual Encoders
summary: Dual-encoder models such as CLIP score an image-caption pair by a single inner product of two independently computed unit vectors, and fail at binding, often scoring near chance when asked to distinguish "a red car and a blue dog" from "a blue car and a red dog". We give a mathematical account of when this failure is necessary and when it is contingent. Working within the ideal-encoder framework proposed by Kang et al., we first show the relevant axioms are satisfiable, so every impossibility must enter through an added, checkable hypothesis. We then prove three such obstructions. Depth: for recursive role-binding codes the swap margin obeys an exact law $m(D) = 2b^{-D}$ in the nesting depth D, with a finite-dimension version holding up to one explicitly flagged concentration estimate; the resolvable depth grows only logarithmically in the dimension and is single-digit at CLIP scale, the nesting depth of ordinary language. Objective: architecture-free throttle theorems showing that the contrastive objective's entire reward for binding is bounded by the rate at which training contrasts a caption against its own swap, a rate that vanishes at web scale, and that exactly reversed binding costs only that rate times the mean binding margin; both are verified in simulation. Geometry: a tight smoothness-binding frontier: the closer the two swap-related captions must embed to a shared paraphrase anchor, the smaller the binding margin can be, with an exact constant. Measuring its text-only diagnostic across 18 deployed text encoders, every model sits at roughly 25-35% of its ceiling, and the induced per-item ceiling tracks SugarCrepe's subset difficulty at r = 0.99. Binding failure in deployed dual encoders is thus not a dimension or smoothness limit today, but an incentive and code-structure limit, with a proved depth ceiling that remains once those are fixed.

AI.tldr: 本文对双编码器模型（如CLIP）在图像-文本绑定任务上的失败进行数学分析，证明了这种失败源于深度、目标和几何三个层面的结构性限制，而非简单的维度不足。
AI.motivation: 双编码器模型（如CLIP）无法可靠地区分词序绑定的差异（如"红车蓝狗"vs"蓝车红狗"），这一失败的根源尚不清楚——是必然现象还是条件性缺陷？作者试图从数学上给出精确回答。
AI.method: 在Kang等人的理想编码器框架内，作者：(1)证明相关公理可满足，排除必然不可能性；(2)证明三个障碍——深度定律（递归角色绑定码的交换余量满足精确定律，可解深度仅随维度对数增长）、目标定理（对比学习目标对绑定的总奖励受限于训练中交换配对率的约束）以及几何前沿（平滑度与绑定余量之间的紧凑权衡）。
AI.result: （1）递归绑定码的交换余量随深度指数衰减，CLIP规模下可解深度仅为个位数；（2）对比目标对绑定的奖励随网页规模消失；（3）18个部署文本编码器的绑定诊断仅达理论上限的25-35%，且该上限与SugarCrepe子集难度高度相关（r=0.99）。
AI.conclusion: 部署中的双编码器绑定失败并非维度或平滑度限制，而是激励（incentive）和编码结构（code-structure）限制；即使修复这些问题，仍存在一个已被证明的深度上限。

title: VARM-Bench: Benchmarking Verifiable Structured Reasoning in Chinese Abusive Speech Moderation
summary: The widespread circulation of abusive online content has increased the need for reliable moderation of Chinese social-media text. Existing Chinese benchmarks support label classification, fine-grained toxicity categorization, and target-aware extraction, but do not provide a unified representation for deterministically verifying the stated basis of a moderation decision. We introduce VARM-Bench, a benchmark for field-anchored chain-of-thought rationales in Chinese abusive-speech moderation. Each instance contains a concise natural-language rationale with explicit anchors for six decisions: target, target type, target explicitness, author stance, harmfulness label, and fine-grained category. Our deterministic protocol evaluates field correctness, target alignment, output validity, complete-record agreement, and hidden record errors conditioned on correct final decisions, without relying on an LLM judge. Under a common structured-output protocol, we evaluate language models across multiple model families using zero-shot prompting, taxonomy guidance, and structured CoT supervision, and analyze lexical-cue sensitivity and field-level errors. Results show that strong label-level performance can conceal substantial errors in complete moderation records. VARM-Bench provides an auditable and reproducible benchmark for evaluating verifiable moderation rationales in Chinese abusive-speech moderation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VARM-Bench，一个用于中文辱骂性言论审核的基准数据集，支持基于字段锚定的链式思维（CoT）推理。每个实例包含六项决策的明确锚点（目标、目标类型、目标明确性、作者立场、危害标签、细粒度类别），并通过确定性协议评估字段正确性、目标对齐、输出有效性、完整记录一致性和隐藏记录错误，无需依赖LLM裁判。
AI.motivation: 现有中文辱骂性言论基准支持标签分类、细粒度毒性分类和目标感知提取，但缺乏统一表示来确定性验证审核决策的陈述依据。研究者希望填补这一空白，提供可审计、可复现的审核推理基准。
AI.method: 构建VARM-Bench基准，每个实例包含简洁的自然语言推理和六个决策字段的显式锚点。采用确定性验证协议评估五个维度：字段正确性、目标对齐、输出有效性、完整记录一致性和隐藏记录错误（以正确最终决策为条件）。在常见结构化输出协议下，评估多种模型家族的零样本提示、分类学引导和结构化CoT监督。
AI.result: 实验发现，强标签级性能可能掩盖完整审核记录中的重大错误。通过词法线索敏感性和字段级错误分析，揭示了模型在不同评估维度上的表现差异。
AI.conclusion: VARM-Bench提供了用于评估中文辱骂性言论审核中可验证审核推理的可审计、可复现基准，强调了标签级评估不足以全面反映审核质量，完整记录验证至关重要。

title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code and analysis artefacts: https://github.com/parsa-mz/crtitxer
summary: Automated checking pipelines increasingly place one language model as the checker and another (or the same one) as the fixer. We ask whether that wiring changes what the checker reports. Measuring false alarms on human-verified-correct ProcessBench traces with the present task held byte-identical, we find that a completed audit -> repair episode already in the model's context lowers false alarms in 15 of 15 model x wording combinations, by 2.8 to 11.5 percentage points against a length-matched non-audit control, a 9 to 25% reduction relative to that control. The direction contradicts what the accumulated-message literature predicts: an episode whose audit reported an error lowers false alarms further still, at all five wordings on the model where that manipulation lands cleanly, though a negativity asymmetry predicts more flagging. Decomposing the episode finds repair content and audit verdict complementary: different components carry the effect on different model families. Signal-detection analysis locates the change in the threshold rather than in discrimination -- the criterion moves in 15 of 15 combinations and survives correction in 13 while d' survives in none, though the d' test is half as sensitive by construction -- and a hand audit of 50 false alarms finds 82% simply wrong, so at this operating point the shift need not be harmful. With reasoning enabled the effect keeps its relative size on both models tested, and the threshold reading holds there too.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察自动化检查管道中"一个模型做检查、另一个（或同一个）做修复"的接线方式是否改变检查器报告的内容。在人工验证正确的ProcessBench轨迹上衡量误报，发现上下文中已完成的"审计→修复"片段在15/15的模型×措辞组合中降低了误报（2.8到11.5个百分点，相对减少9-25%）。该方向与累积消息文献预测相反。信号检测分析定位变化在阈值而非辨别力，且人工审计50例误报发现82%完全错误。
AI.motivation: 自动化检查管道日益普遍地用一个LM做检查器、另一个做修复器，但现有文献（累积消息）预测此类设置会增加误报。作者想验证这种接线方式是否真正改变检查器报告的内容，并探究其机制。
AI.method: 在人工验证正确的ProcessBench轨迹上，保持当前任务字节一致，测量误报率。比较上下文包含完整"审计→修复"片段与长度匹配的非审计对照组；分解片段成分（修复内容与审计结论）；使用信号检测分析区分阈值移动与辨别力变化；人工审计50例误报；并测试启用推理时的效果。
AI.result: 审计→修复片段的上下文在15/15的组合中降低误报2.8-11.5个百分点。审计报告错误的片段进一步降低误报（与负性不对称预测相反）。修复内容与审计结论在不同模型家族上承载不同效应。信号检测显示15/15组合中标准移动，13个在修正后仍显著；d'在无组合中显著。82%的误报人工审计为完全错误。启用推理后效应相对大小保持。
AI.conclusion: 审计→修复片段的存在会系统性地移动检查器的判断标准（使其更保守），而非提升辨别能力。该效应未必有害，因为大多数误报本来就是错的。这一发现挑战了累积消息文献的预测，对自动化检查管道的设计具有实际意义。

title: A Pre-Specified Construction-Confirmation Test of Operation-Level Causal Transfer Across Finite Isomorphic Symbolic Domains
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, and 4 ancillary CSV files
summary: Behavioral accuracy, linear decodability, and successful activation interventions do not by themselves show that a model carries an operation-level structure from one symbolic domain to another. We ask a narrower question in finite isomorphic state spaces: if the hidden-state difference between two operations is estimated separately for each source input, does adding that difference to a mapped recipient input move the model toward the corresponding recipient answer? The design compares this input-specific intervention with wrong-operation, norm-matched random, and no-op controls, and separates candidate construction from an independently isolated confirmation split. On a frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model at layers 20--21, one route--domain--operation candidate from a family pre-specified and frozen before confirmation access, transparent | integer_mod16--letters16 | successor->predecessor, passed both PyVene splits; its confirmation intersection--union p-value was 0.000198 and its 36-family Holm-adjusted p-value was 0.006943. A subsequent NNsight 0.7.0 experiment, pre-specified and frozen before its confirmation access, tested only this selected prompt route, without candidate or layer reselection. It reproduced all 12 confirmation effect estimates, confidence intervals, and exact sign-flip p-values numerically; its 36-family Holm-adjusted p-value was 0.007141. The result is therefore limited to one prompt route and one candidate, replicated across two intervention implementations on one model revision and one layer interval. It does not establish cross-model generalization, full-family backend independence, domain-general transfer, or algebraic invariance.

AI.tldr: 本研究在有限同构状态空间中，通过输入特定的隐藏状态差干预，检验模型是否在符号域间携带操作级结构。在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型的20-21层，一个预先指定的候选（integer_mod16→letters16, successor→predecessor）在PyVene与NNsight两种实现中均通过确认检验（Holm校正后p值约0.007），但结果仅限单一提示路径，不涉及跨模型泛化或代数不变性。
