AI.motivation: 行为准确性、线性可解码性和成功的激活干预不足以证明模型在符号域间携带操作级结构。作者希望提出一个更严格、更窄的问题，通过输入特定的干预设计来检验模型是否真的在不同符号域间转移操作级表示结构。
AI.method: 在有限同构状态空间中，对每个源输入分别估计两个操作的隐藏状态差，然后将该差值加到映射后的接收输入上，检验是否将模型推向对应接收答案。设计包含错误操作、范数匹配随机和无操作对照，并将候选构建与独立隔离的确认分裂分开。第一轮在PyVene框架中测试预指定的候选族，第二轮用NNsight 0.7.0复现选定的提示路径。
AI.result: 在冻结的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型的20-21层，候选integer_mod16→letters16（successor→predecessor）在PyVene中确认交集-并集p值为0.000198，36族Holm调整后p值为0.006943。NNsight实验复现了全部12个确认效应估计和p值，Holm调整p值为0.007141。
AI.conclusion: 结果显示模型在一个特定提示路径和单一候选上存在操作级结构转移的证据，且该结果在两种干预实现中一致复现。但作者明确限定结论范围：不涉及跨模型泛化、完全后端独立、域一般迁移或代数不变性，表明这是一个证据强度被严格界定的有限发现。

title: Bias-Corrected Ceilings of Emotion Predictability from Human Label Variation Based on Instance-Level Fano Bounds
summary: Emotion recognition from text keeps improving on benchmarks, yet whether an accuracy ceiling has been reached is seldom asked with discipline. Our aim is not to pin this ceiling to a single number, but to quantify how far it depends on finite annotation, estimator choice, annotation noise, and the evaluation protocol, and thereby to discipline how confidently saturation can be claimed. We propose Bias-corrected Affective Ceiling Estimation (BACE), an analysis framework that estimates a bias-corrected ceiling, separates irreducible from reducible error, and disciplines the resulting claims. An anchored Dirichlet-mixture empirical Bayes estimator, bracketed between plug-in and NSB, recovers the human-consensus distribution; an annotator split, a noise deconvolution, and a fixed claim gate then attribute error without circularity. Methodologically, unconstrained point estimates place reachability anywhere from 0.38 to 1.03, so saturation cannot be decided by any single estimator. Substantively, the only assertion passing the claim gate is that at least about 33% of a representative classifier's error on GoEmotions is irreducible, with the same pattern recurring on offensiveness and irony.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BACE（偏差校正的情感上限估计）分析框架，用于量化文本情感识别准确率天花板对标注数量、估计器选择、标注噪声和评估协议的依赖程度，从而严谨地判断是否达到饱和。关键发现是：没有任何单一估计器能决定饱和状态，唯一通过验证的结论是GoEmotions数据集上代表性分类器约33%的错误是不可约的，该模式在冒犯性和讽刺任务中也一致出现。
AI.motivation: 情感识别模型在基准测试上持续进步，但很少被严谨地追问准确率天花板是否已到达。作者旨在系统性地量化天花板对有限标注、估计器选择、标注噪声和评估协议的依赖程度，以规范"饱和"论断的严谨性，避免盲目声称已达到性能上限。
AI.method: 提出BACE分析框架：1）使用锚定狄利克雷混合经验贝叶斯估计器（居于plug-in和NSB之间）恢复人类共识分布；2）通过标注者分割（annotator split）、噪声反卷积（noise deconvolution）和固定声明门控（fixed claim gate）无循环地归因错误；3）将误差拆分为不可约误差和可约误差。
AI.result: 方法上，无约束点估计将可达性置于0.38到1.03之间，表明任何单一估计器都无法决定饱和状态。实质上，唯一通过声明门控的结论是：GoEmotions上代表性分类器至少约33%的错误是不可约的，且该模式在冒犯性检测和讽刺识别任务上同样出现。
AI.conclusion: 饱和状态的声称必须经过系统性的偏差校正和多重证据检验才能成立；仅依赖单一估计器或单一评估协议可能会导致误导性结论。BACE为情感识别性能天花板研究提供了一套严谨的分析纪律。

title: Reconstruction: A Blind Benchmark for Recovering Research Ideas from Pre-Publication Bibliographies
summary: Can a language model recover the true research idea of a published paper when given only that paper's pre-publication bibliography? We introduce Reconstruction, a blind idea-recovery benchmark that withholds the seed paper and all contemporaneous or future literature, and asks models to propose hypotheses that an independent large language model judge matches against the held-out ground-truth idea. A strict anti-leakage protocol-temporal citation cutoff, anonymous reference IDs, and frozen per-paper bibliographies, which prevents prompt-time leakage of the seed idea. Across six scientific domains and 643 evaluated papers, seven frontier models achieve only modest Match rates (approx. 3-15%). We then evaluate a reference-only multi-agent (top 4) pipeline that combines cross-model review with a Swiss tournament over aligned hypothesis slots, without external web search. Cross-model review plus tournament selection raises Match rates to approx. 23-42% across all six domains, which is an observed approx. 2.4x lift over the best single-model baseline. This draft reports the protocol, anti-leakage design, and current results as an arXiv timestamp.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Reconstruction基准，用于测试语言模型能否仅凭论文的预发表参考文献恢复其真实研究想法。通过严格的反泄漏协议（时间截断、匿名引用ID、冻结参考文献），研究表明前沿模型仅能达到3-15%的匹配率，而结合跨模型评审与瑞士锦标赛选择的多智能体流水线可将匹配率提升至23-42%，较最佳单模型基线提升约2.4倍。
AI.motivation: 探索语言模型能否从参考文献中推断出论文的核心研究想法，是一个评估模型科学推理与假设生成能力的全新视角。现有基准多直接使用论文内容，缺少对"想法恢复"这一盲测任务的研究，且需防止数据泄漏以确保评估有效性。
AI.method: 提出Reconstruction基准：隐藏种子论文及所有同期/未来文献，仅提供预发表参考文献，让模型生成假设，由独立LLM裁判与真实想法匹配。设计三重反泄漏机制（时间截断、匿名引用ID、冻结参考文献），并构建包含跨模型评审与瑞士锦标赛（Swiss tournament）对齐假设槽位的多智能体流水线（top 4）。
AI.result: 在六个科学领域共643篇论文上，七个前沿单模型仅达到约3-15%的匹配率；而跨模型评审+锦标赛选择的多智能体流水线可将匹配率提升至约23-42%，相对最佳单模型基线有约2.4倍提升。
AI.conclusion: 单模型从参考文献恢复研究想法的能力有限，但多智能体协作策略能显著增强这一能力。该工作提供了协议、反泄漏设计与当前结果，作为arXiv时间戳发布，为后续研究奠定了基础。

title: KOALA: Koopman Operator Learning for WiFi-Based Anticipatory Hum
comment: 27 pages, 3 figures
summary: WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) has emerged as a privacy-preserving alternative to cameras for human pose estimation. However, existing approaches treat pose inference as an instantaneous regression problem and do not model temporal dynamics, making future motion prediction infeasible. Naively applying vision-based prediction methods compounds the estimation noise already present in CSI-derived poses, as autoregressive rollouts amplify errors at every step. We propose KOALA, the framework for human motion prediction directly from WiFi CSI, by lifting noisy CSI-derived pose sequences into a learned Koopman latent space where nonlinear dynamics become linear, enabling multi-horizon prediction via simple matrix-vector products without autoregressive iteration or error accumulation. A residual CSI-conditioned operator resolves the identity attractor problem inherent from Koopman formulations, and an anchor-delta prediction head eliminates the degenerate shortcut of copying the current pose across all horizons. To regularise the lifting and operator jointly, we introduce a Koopman Anchored Latent (KAL) loss that operates in the temporal-encoder feature space, enforcing dynamical consistency across prediction horizons without requiring contrastive, spectral, or auxiliary losses. Experiments on MM-Fi and WiPose show that KOALA achieves robust, consistent performance across both short- and long-term prediction horizons, outperforming all baselines by a substantial margin.

AI.tldr: KOALA是一个直接从WiFi CSI信号进行人体运动预测的框架，通过将噪声CSI姿态序列提升到学习的Koopman潜空间（非线性动力学在此变为线性），实现多时间尺度的预测，无需自回归迭代和误差累积，在MM-Fi和WiPose数据集上大幅超越所有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有WiFi CSI人体姿态估计方法将姿态推理视为瞬时回归问题，不建模时间动态，因此无法进行未来运动预测。而朴素地应用基于视觉的预测方法会复合CSI姿态中已有的估计噪声，自回归展开会在每一步放大误差。
AI.method: 1) 将噪声CSI姿态序列提升到学习的Koopman潜空间，使非线性动力学线性化，通过简单矩阵-向量乘积实现多时间尺度预测；2) 提出残差CSI条件算子解决Koopman公式固有的恒等吸引子问题；3) 引入anchor-delta预测头消除复制当前姿态的退化捷径；4) 提出Koopman Anchored Latent (KAL)损失，在时序编码器特征空间中联合正则化提升和算子，无需对比、频谱或辅助损失。
AI.result: 在MM-Fi和WiPose数据集上的实验表明，KOALA在短期和长期预测范围内均实现稳健一致的表现，显著超越所有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: KOALA验证了Koopman算子理论在WiFi CSI人体运动预测中的有效性，通过潜空间线性化避免了自回归误差累积，为无相机环境下的人体运动预测提供了新范式。

title: Rotation-Invariant Multi-IMU Activity Recognition under Independent Per-Location Orientation Shifts
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. ACM International Symposium on Wearable Computing (ISWC) 2026
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) with self-administered wearables, such as at-home rehabilitation and exercise monitoring, often requires reattaching inertial measurement units (IMUs) across sessions. In multi-IMU settings, this can induce independent orientation offsets across body locations, a deployment shift that conventional scalar HAR models do not structurally handle. Existing remedies rely on rotation augmentation, whose robustness depends on sampled transformations, or calibration and orientationnormalization pipelines requiring additional reference-frame assumptions or explicit procedures. We present Truly Rotation-Invariant HAR (TRI-HAR), a rotation-invariant framework that makes robustness to independent per-location IMU orientation offsets a structural model property. TRI-HAR reshapes accelerometer and gyroscope streams into triaxial vectors, applies a shared SO(3)-equivariant backbone and invariant projection to each IMU location, and fuses the resulting invariant features for activity classification. Across four multi-IMU benchmarks, TRI-HAR preserves macro-F1 under fixed independent per-location SO(3) rotations and outperforms rotation-augmented baselines under this target shift without requiring rotational augmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出TRI-HAR框架，利用SO(3)-等变骨干网络和不变投影，使多IMU人体活动识别对每个传感器位置独立的方向偏移具有结构性旋转不变性，无需旋转增强或校准。
AI.motivation: 多IMU可穿戴设备在跨会话使用时，各身体位置的IMU会面临独立的方向偏移（部署偏移）。传统标量HAR模型无法从结构上处理这种偏移，现有方法依赖旋转增强（鲁棒性依赖采样变换）或需要额外假设的校准/方向归一化流程。
AI.method: 将加速度计和陀螺仪流重塑为三轴向量，对每个IMU位置应用共享的SO(3)-等变骨干网络和不变投影，再将各位置得到的不变特征融合用于活动分类，使旋转不变性成为模型的结构属性。
AI.result: 在四个多IMU基准数据集上，TRI-HAR在固定独立逐位置SO(3)旋转下保持宏F1分数，并在目标偏移下优于旋转增强基线，且无需旋转增强。
AI.conclusion: 通过将旋转不变性内建为结构属性，TRI-HAR为多IMU部署中的方向偏移提供了无需增强或校准的鲁棒解决方案，验证了SO(3)-等变架构在该任务中的有效性。

title: Policy Iteration with Human Feedback: Bringing Post-Training RL to In-context Learning
comment: PIHF method paper
summary:
Generative pretraining established reusable task representations; later work on language-based task conditioning and in-context learning showed that a fixed model could adapt its behavior from instructions and demonstrations. Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) builds on this development and the recurrent evaluate-and-improve structure of generalized policy iteration. PIHF uses a pretrained language model as its execution substrate and moves persistent revision to a versioned natural-language policy and tool set. A language-model critic and clinical expert review complete-panel reasoning and tool-use trajectories to localize recurrent failures and form candidate revisions; the expert may reinterpret the evidence and retains authority over admission and rollback, while Recall@1 and Recall@5 validate outcomes after candidate execution.
  Across cumulative ablations and ultra-rare-disease benchmarks, a PIHF-derived policy improved Recall@1 in one proprietary executor and three open-weight executors spanning 3 to 49 billion active parameters. Gains were 32.7 percentage points for GPT-5.4 and 31.1 points for Qwen3.6-35B, a difference of 1.7 points. These results support the feasibility of using pretrained language models as fixed-weight execution substrates for expert-guided policy development in rare-disease diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出策略迭代与人类反馈（PIHF）方法，利用预训练语言模型作为固定权重的执行基底，结合版本化的自然语言策略和工具集，通过语言模型批评者与临床专家的迭代评估-改进循环来优化罕见病诊断策略，在多个执行器上实现了显著的Recall@1提升。
AI.motivation: 生成式预训练已建立可复用的任务表征，语言条件化和上下文学习使固定模型能适应指令与示范。作者希望进一步探索：能否在保持预训练模型权重固定的前提下，通过专家引导的策略迭代来持续改进模型在专业领域（如罕见病诊断）的任务表现。
AI.method: PIHF将广义策略迭代的评估-改进循环与预训练语言模型结合。具体做法是：(1)使用预训练语言模型作为执行基底；(2)将持久性改进存储在版本化的自然语言策略和工具集中；(3)语言模型批评者与临床专家共同审查推理轨迹和工具使用路径，定位反复出现的失败模式并生成候选修订；(4)专家可重新解读证据，拥有修订的采纳与回滚权限；(5)通过Recall@1和Recall@5验证修订后的执行结果。
AI.result: 在累积消融实验和超罕见病基准上，PIHF派生的策略在不同执行器上均提升了Recall@1表现，包括一个专有执行器和三个开源执行器（激活参数3亿至490亿）。GPT-5.4提升32.7个百分点，Qwen3.6-35B提升31.1个百分点，两者相差1.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，使用预训练语言模型作为固定权重执行基底，结合专家引导的策略发展，在罕见病诊断中是可行的。这为无需微调模型权重即可持续改进专业领域任务表现提供了新路径。

title: Second-Moment Memory in Coordinatewise Adam
comment: 10 pages
summary: Adam retains a moving average of past squared gradients in its denominator, but the optimization cost of this memory is not well understood. We show that second-moment memory can itself suppress progress toward the optimum even under finite-variance stochastic gradients. For a simple two-point oracle, the expected positive normalized update is $O(M_2^{-1/2})$ after an initialization transient, where $M_2=(1-β_2)^{-1}$ is the second-moment memory length. We convert this directional bound, under the stated memory and stepsize scaling, into an average-stationarity lower bound of the same order on a smooth convex problem with normalized gap, smoothness, and variance. Long second-moment memory can slow optimization even when the gradient noise has finite variance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Adam优化器中二阶矩记忆（second-moment memory）对优化收敛速度的影响，证明即使在有限方差随机梯度下，较长的二阶矩记忆也会抑制优化进程，并给出了相应的下界。
AI.motivation: Adam优化器通过分母中的滑动平均（moving average）来记忆过去平方梯度，但这种记忆所带来的优化代价此前未被充分理解。作者希望理论阐明二阶矩记忆如何影响优化进度，并质疑长记忆是否总是有益的。
AI.method: 作者首先在简单的两点oracle设置下，证明期望归一化正向更新量在初始化瞬态后为O(M_2^{-1/2})，其中M_2=(1-β_2)^{-1}为二阶矩记忆长度。随后将该方向性界，在给定的记忆和步长缩放下，转化为光滑凸问题上同阶的平均驻点（average-stationarity）下界，并考虑了归一化间隔、光滑度和方差。
AI.result: 在光滑凸问题中，Adam的收敛速度受限于O(M_2^{-1/2})量级的平均驻点下界，即较长的二阶矩记忆（较大的β_2）即使在梯度噪声有限方差的情况下，也会显著减缓优化速度。
AI.conclusion: Adam的二阶矩记忆长度过大会阻碍优化收敛，即使在噪声方差有限的情况下也是如此。这提示在实际使用中需要谨慎设置β_2参数，过长的记忆窗口并非总是有利。

title: Argumentation for Common Ground: Finding Zones of Possible Agreement between Individuals in Conflict
summary: How can common ground between societies in conflict be identified when citizens' acceptability of peace agreements is shaped by contested narratives? Such acceptability is mediated not only by the clauses that agreements include or exclude, but crucially by citizens' subjective reasoning concerning agreements' clauses. In this paper, we leverage computational argumentation to introduce a novel approach to identifying mutually acceptable agreements among individuals in conflict, i.e. a Zone of Possible Agreement (ZOPA). First, we introduce a quantitative bipolar argumentation framework tailored to represent each side's reasoning about peace agreements. We then show how merging these frameworks can enable negotiators to identify peace agreements that are mutually acceptable. To evaluate our approach under conditions of real-world relevance, we focus on the Palestinian-Israeli conflict, where long-standing policy, practitioner and public interest underscores the demand for methods capable of analysing polarised public reasoning. We show how our framework identifies a ZOPA through theoretical analysis and preliminary experiments using survey data from both existing work and retrieved by a large language model. The results illustrate how argumentation can empower negotiators and conflict-resolution teams in mapping feasible ZOPAs grounded in citizens' reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于计算论证的方法，用于在冲突社会中识别公民可接受的和平协议（即"可能达成协议区"ZOPA）。作者引入定量双极论证框架表示每一方关于和平协议的推理，并通过合并这些框架帮助谈判者识别双方都能接受的协议。方法在以巴冲突中以理论分析和基于调查数据（含大语言模型生成的数据）的初步实验进行验证。
AI.motivation: 冲突社会中公民对和平协议的接受度受争议性叙事影响。协议是否可接受不仅取决于条款内容，还取决于公民对条款的主观推理。现有方法缺乏系统分析这种主体推理的手段，因此需要新方法来识别双方都能接受的协议。
AI.method: 1）引入定量双极论证框架表示每一方关于和平协议的推理；2）展示如何通过合并这些框架识别相互可接受的协议；3）以巴勒斯坦-以色列冲突为案例，结合理论分析和使用已有及大语言模型检索的调查数据的初步实验进行评估。
AI.result: 该框架能够识别ZOPA，初步实验结果表明基于论证的方法可以帮助谈判者和冲突解决团队基于公民推理绘制可行的ZOPA。
AI.conclusion: 计算论证方法能够有效分析冲突中的极化公众推理，为谈判者提供基于公民实际推理的可行协议空间映射工具，有望增强冲突解决实践。

title: Proteus: Incremental Memory Activation for Long-Context Sequence Modeling
summary: The quadratic cost of attention-based sequence models for long contexts has motivated a growing line of research on memory-based models that can compress context into a compact state. However, most existing memory models expose a static memory throughout the entire sequence. Because early tokens face no compression pressure, they occupy too many degrees of freedom and "pollute" the memory state, leaving little capacity for later context and increasing interference between what is stored and what arrives next. We study a new paradigm of incremental memory activation, where the effective capacity of memory is progressively expanded as the context grows. Imposing an early bottleneck forces the model to compress history more effectively, while unlocking fresh capacity over time reduces interference and improves retention of later context. We instantiate this paradigm in Proteus, a straightforward mechanism that can be incorporated into a broad class of neural memory architectures at no additional cost. We apply Proteus to state-of-the-art models, including SWLA, Comba, Titans, and Hope-Attention, and observe consistent improvements on standard language modeling and reasoning, as well as on long-context retrieval and understanding, with gains that grow at longer context lengths. Overall, our results show that static memory is suboptimal and that scheduling effective capacity is a simple and broadly applicable tool for sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"增量记忆激活"（incremental memory activation）范式，通过逐步扩展记忆容量来替代传统的静态记忆机制，并实例化为Proteus机制，可无缝集成到各类神经记忆架构中，在多个SOTA模型上取得一致性改进。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆模型在整个序列中使用静态记忆容量，早期token因为没有压缩压力而占用过多自由度，导致记忆状态被"污染"，留给后续上下文的容量不足，且新旧内容间干扰增大。
AI.method: 提出增量记忆激活范式：早期施加瓶颈迫使模型更有效地压缩历史信息，随上下文增长逐步解锁新容量以减少干扰。将其实例化为Proteus机制，该机制不增加额外计算成本，可应用于广泛的神经记忆架构。
AI.result: 在SWLA、Comba、Titans、Hope-Attention等SOTA模型上应用Proteus，在标准语言建模、推理、长上下文检索和理解任务上均观察到一致性改进，且增益随上下文长度增长而增大。
AI.conclusion: 静态记忆是次优的，通过调度有效记忆容量是一种简单且广泛适用的序列建模工具。

title: A Responsible Artificial Intelligence Framework for Groundwater Modeling
summary: The rapid development and widespread application of artificial intelligence (AI) have sparked intense discussions on how to deploy responsible AI systems in a manner aligned with human values and ethical standards. Compared to fields like healthcare, energy, or finance, the application of AI in groundwater is relatively limited, and research on responsible AI is even more scarce. Taking the middle reaches of the Heihe River Basin as the study area, this paper proposes six Responsible AI principles: transparency, technical robustness, privacy governance, fairness, accountability, and sustainability. LSTM and Transformer time-series models are developed using multi-source hydrometeorological data, and validated via post-hoc interpretability, Monte Carlo simulation, and scenario analysis. The results show that Transformer outperforms LSTM in accuracy, robustness, and interpretability, demonstrating the operability and practical value of Responsible AI principles in groundwater prediction to support sustainable water management under climate change and human activities.

AI.tldr: 本文以黑河流域中游为研究区，提出六项负责任AI原则（透明度、技术稳健性、隐私治理、公平性、问责制和可持续性），并开发LSTM和Transformer时间序列模型用于地下水预测，通过事后可解释性、蒙特卡洛模拟和情景分析进行验证，结果表明Transformer在准确性、稳健性和可解释性方面均优于LSTM。
AI.motivation: AI在医疗、能源、金融等领域已有较多应用，但在地下水研究领域的应用相对有限，负责任AI的研究更是匮乏。作者希望将负责任AI框架引入地下水预测领域，以支持气候变化和人类活动下的可持续水资源管理。
AI.method: 基于多源水文气象数据构建LSTM与Transformer时间序列预测模型；采用事后可解释性分析、蒙特卡洛模拟和情景分析对模型进行验证；以黑河流域中游为研究区开展实证研究。
AI.result: Transformer模型在预测精度、稳健性和可解释性方面均优于LSTM模型，证明了负责任AI原则在地下水预测中的可操作性和实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 负责任AI原则可以在地下水预测领域落地实施，为气候变化和人类活动影响下的可持续水资源管理提供技术支撑，填补了该领域负责任AI研究的空白。

title: Geometry of Forgetting: Representation Flux in Continual Learning
summary: Catastrophic forgetting remains a fundamental obstacle to continual learning, where neural networks lose previously acquired knowledge while learning new tasks. Existing methods primarily mitigate forgetting through parameter regularization or experience replay, while the representation-space dynamics associated with forgetting remain less understood. We investigate latent representation evolution during sequential learning and introduce representation flux, a geometric measure of sample-level representation displacement across training. We show that representation flux is strongly associated with catastrophic forgetting across multiple benchmarks, with temporal analyses indicating that elevated flux can precede subsequent performance degradation. Representation displacement is also associated with confidence degradation, while complementary geometric properties provide additional information about sample-level forgetting. Motivated by these observations, we propose FlowLess-R, a representation-space regularization method that constrains replay representations relative to stored references while allowing continued learning. FlowLess-R is architecture-agnostic and integrates into replay-based methods through a representation-matching term. Experiments on SplitMNIST, SplitFashionMNIST, SplitCIFAR10, and SplitTinyImageNet show improved final average accuracy and reduced forgetting with ER, DER++, and ER-ACE. Our results identify representation flux as an informative geometric marker of forgetting and show that stabilizing latent representations provides a simple strategy for mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"表征流"(representation flux)这一几何度量来量化样本表征在序列学习中的位移，并发现它与灾难性遗忘高度相关；据此提出FlowLess-R方法，通过约束回放样本的表征相对参考点来稳定潜在表征空间，在多个基准上提升ER、DER++和ER-ACE等回放方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法主要通过参数正则化或经验回放缓解遗忘，但表征空间动力学与遗忘之间的关系仍未被充分理解。作者希望从表征几何视角揭示遗忘的机制，并据此设计更有效的缓解策略。
AI.method: 1) 引入表征流(representation flux)，即样本级表征在训练过程中的几何位移度量；2) 通过时间分析发现高表征流可先于性能下降出现；3) 提出FlowLess-R，一种与架构无关的正则化方法，通过表征匹配项约束回放表征相对存储参考点，同时允许模型继续学习。
AI.result: 在SplitMNIST、SplitFashionMNIST、SplitCIFAR10和SplitTinyImageNet四个基准上，FlowLess-R在ER、DER++和ER-ACE三种回放方法上均提升了最终平均准确率并减少了遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 表征流是遗忘的有效几何标记，稳定潜在表征空间是一种简单而有效的缓解灾难性遗忘的策略。该工作加深了人们对持续学习中表征动力学与遗忘关系的理解。

title: THESIS-MoE: Trainable Hierarchical Extraction and SteerIng of Sycophancy in Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Sycophancy, the tendency of a language model to change its answer to match a user's stated belief, is a common alignment failure. Existing activation steering methods typically apply a single contrastive direction uniformly throughout the model, which is an unconditional intervention that alters activations even when no sycophantic behavior is present, trading knowledge retention for behavioral correction. In Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, prior work further suggests that behavior is encoded within expert computations rather than routing decisions alone, making precise behavioral steering particularly challenging. In this work, we introduce a shared contrastive signal, built from matched prompts with and without a stated belief, that identifies where sycophancy lives across the MoE hierarchy and drives interventions that act only where the behavior is present. We formulate localization as a causal search over a granularity ladder of MoE blocks, experts, attention blocks, and heads, and compare unconditional subtraction against two conditional alternatives: an analytic projection-based subtraction and a learned per-token gate that steers the model away from sycophancy while keeping its weights frozen. We evaluate on three MoE models measuring sycophancy alongside general knowledge and reasoning benchmarks. Our conditional interventions removed up to 90\% of the belief-induced sycophancy. Our results demonstrate that sycophancy resides in identifiable computational subcircuits and can be selectively steered while maintaining a favorable removal-retention trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文针对MoE（混合专家）模型中的谄媚行为（sycophancy）对齐失败问题，提出了一种基于共享对比信号的因果定位与条件干预方法。通过在MoE层级（模块、专家、注意力块、头）上精细化定位谄媚子电路，并比较无条件减法与两种条件干预（投影减法、学习式逐token门控）的效果，在三个MoE模型上实现了最多90%的信念诱导谄媚行为的消除，同时保持知识保留与行为纠正之间的良好权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的激活引导方法通常在整个模型中统一施加单一对比方向，属于无条件干预——即使没有谄媚行为发生时也会改变激活，导致知识保留与行为纠正之间的权衡受损。此外，先前研究表明在MoE模型中，行为编码在专家计算中而非仅路由决策中，使得精确行为引导更具挑战性。因此需要一种仅在行为出现时才干预的条件式定位与引导方法。
AI.method: (1) 构建由有无陈述信念的匹配提示组成的共享对比信号，用于识别谄媚行为在MoE层级中的位置；(2) 将定位形式化为基于因果搜索的粒度阶梯（MoE模块、专家、注意力块、注意力头）；(3) 比较三种干预方法：无条件减法、基于投影分析的条件减法、以及学习得到的逐token门控（保持权重冻结）。
AI.result: 在三个MoE模型上评估，条件干预方法消除了高达90%的信念诱导谄媚行为，同时维持了良好的行为移除-知识保留权衡，表明谄媚行为确实驻留在可识别的计算子电路中。
AI.conclusion: 谄媚行为在MoE模型中驻留在可识别、可定位的计算子电路中，通过条件化、细粒度的干预可以在保持模型知识与推理能力的同时有效消除谄媚行为，为MoE模型的对齐提供了更精确的行为引导路径。

title: TransfHAR: Self-Supervised Wrist Representations for On-Demand Activity Recognition
summary: Fine-grained wrist activity recognition can support applications such as procedural step guidance and context-aware assistance, yet acquiring labeled data for every new task, user, and activity granularity remains a bottleneck. We present TransfHAR, a self-supervised wrist IMU framework for on-demand, fine-grained activity recognition by learning transferable motion priors from global, unlabeled activities. We show that self-supervised pretraining on coarse wrist IMU activities (e.g., sitting, walking, exercise) learns motion structure rich enough to transfer to fine-grained manipulative, gestural, and procedural activities (e.g., snapping, stirring, waving) that are absent from pretraining. We implement TransfHAR as a real-time smartwatch application that lets users define and expand their own activity set for personalized recognition from only a few demonstrations. Across three offline cross-dataset evaluations, TransfHAR matches or exceeds fully supervised baselines that use complete label sets with equal or additional sensor channels, by 6.2 balanced-accuracy points on average. In an in-lab study with 10 participants each performing seven novel wrist activities, TransfHAR reaches 86.7% balanced accuracy across participants with five examples per class and 90.4% when updated from a single one-minute recording per class. These results indicate that broad self-supervised wrist pretraining provides an effective foundation for on-demand fine-grained activity recognition.

AI.tldr: TransfHAR是一个基于自监督预训练的腕部IMU框架，通过从粗粒度、无标注的日常活动中学习可迁移的运动先验，实现按需的细粒度活动识别，无需大量标注数据即可支持个性化活动识别。
AI.motivation: 细粒度腕部活动识别虽可支持程序步骤引导和情境感知辅助等应用，但为每个新任务、新用户和新活动粒度获取标注数据仍是瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用自监督预训练范式，在粗粒度腕部IMU活动（如坐、走、运动）上进行预训练以学习运动结构；将迁移学习应用于训练中未出现的细粒度操作性、手势性和程序性活动；实现为实时智能手表应用，支持用户仅用少量示范自定义和扩展活动集。
AI.result: 在三项离线跨数据集评估中，TransfHAR在平衡准确率上平均超越使用完整标签集、同等或更多传感器通道的完全监督基线6.2个百分点；在10名参与者、每人执行7种新腕部活动的实验室研究中，每类仅5个示例时达到86.7%的跨参与者平衡准确率，每类经单次一分钟录音更新后达到90.4%。
AI.conclusion: 广泛的腕部自监督预训练为按需的细粒度活动识别提供了有效基础，解决了标注数据稀缺的问题。

title: Large Models for Small Devices: Recent Advances and Empirical Analysis of Edge AI Deployment
comment: Parts of this work were presented at the IEEE Consumer Communications & Networking Conference (CCNC), Las Vegas, NV, USA, January 2026
summary: Running large AI models on resource-constrained edge devices requires model compression to reduce model size and computation. What compresses well, however, need not deploy well. We survey dozens of recent works that report compression results on real hardware and extract practical deployment guidelines from them. Following these guidelines, we deploy compact language and image models on GPU, CPU, and Raspberry Pi platforms across question answering and image segmentation. No single technique wins across tasks. For question answering, Qwen3.5 0.8B reaches 93.85 SQuAD F1 and 92 EM under Q5_K_M GGUF quantization, while structured pruning at the same precision costs 16 F1 at a 1% ratio. For segmentation, the ranking reverses: default quantization leaves parameters and MACs unchanged, whereas pruning cuts model size by nearly 80% at near-constant mIoU. Pruning can even inflate the deployed artifact by 21-49% by breaking k-quant super-block alignment; combined with longer, less format-compliant outputs, this raises Raspberry Pi latency up to 3.4x. Compression can also manufacture the appearance of competence rather than destroy it visibly: one LoRA-recovered variant stays fully parseable and holds 71% strict BoolQ accuracy while sending 97 of 100 predictions to a single class, at 52.6% balanced accuracy. We explain these effects through neural-flow graph analysis and prefill-decode-level latency decomposition, and condense them into task-specific deployment research directions. The right technique depends on the task, the model, and the hardware. Our experiment code and artifacts are open-sourced at https://github.com/Arnavvvkumar/deployment

AI.tldr: 本文调查了数十篇在真实硬件上报告压缩结果的工作，提取部署指南后在GPU、CPU和树莓派上部署了轻量语言和图像模型（问答和图像分割任务）。核心发现：没有单一压缩技术通吃所有任务——问答任务中Q5_K_M GGUF量化表现最佳（SQuAD F1达93.85），而分割任务中剪枝更有效（模型缩减近80%且mIoU几乎不变）；但剪枝可能因破坏k-quant超块对齐导致部署产物膨胀21-49%，在树莓派上延迟最高增加3.4倍。压缩还可能制造"能力假象"（LoRA恢复变体保持可解析输出但预测严重偏斜）。论文通过神经流图分析和prefill-decode级延迟分解解释这些效应，并提出任务特定的部署研究方向。
AI.motivation: 资源受限的边缘设备上运行大模型需要压缩技术来减小模型大小和计算量，但"压缩效果好"与"部署效果好"并不等同。现有工作缺乏系统性实证，作者希望通过调查和实验揭示压缩技术在实际硬件部署中的真实表现，避免研究社区被压缩指标误导。
AI.method: 1) 调查数十篇报告真实硬件压缩结果的工作并提取实践部署指南；2) 在GPU、CPU、树莓派平台上部署紧凑语言模型和图像模型，覆盖问答和图像分割任务；3) 对比量化与结构化剪枝等多种压缩技术；4) 通过神经流图分析和prefill-decode级延迟分解解释压缩对部署的影响机制。
AI.result: 1) 问答任务中Qwen3.5 0.8B在Q5_K_M GGUF量化下达到93.85 SQuAD F1和92 EM，同为1%比例的结构化剪枝损失16 F1；2) 分割任务中排名反转：默认量化不改动参数和MACs，而剪枝在近乎恒定的mIoU下削减模型近80%；3) 剪枝可能使部署产物膨胀21-49%（破坏k-quant超块对齐），加上更长的非格式合规输出，树莓派延迟最高增至3.4倍；4) 压缩可制造"能力假象"：LoRA恢复变体保持71%严格BoolQ准确率但97/100预测集中到单一类别，实际平衡准确率仅52.6%。
AI.conclusion: 压缩技术的选择高度依赖任务、模型和硬件的组合，不存在通用最优方法。针对问答、分割等任务需要定制化的部署研究方向和基准，不能仅以模型大小或FLOPs等静态指标判断部署可行性。实验代码和工件已开源。

title: Feasible and Novel Synthetic Population Generation with Tabular and Sequential Travel Attributes
comment: 11 figures, 6 tables
summary: Synthetic populations are critical inputs for activity-based travel demand models, yet generating realistic populations from limited survey data remains challenging. Small samples miss valid attribute combinations, known as sampling zeros, and generative models may also produce infeasible structural zeros. Moreover, realistic synthetic populations must capture both static socio-demographic attributes and sequential travel behaviour, such as trip chains. This paper proposes a regularized two-stage generative framework to address these challenges, where regularization refers to additional loss terms that guide the generator toward broader valid coverage and fewer infeasible samples. In Stage 1, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty is augmented with three regularization terms, IGP, LDR, and CLAP, to improve feasibility, diversity, and novelty in tabular population synthesis. In Stage 2, Transformer and LSTM-Attention models generate sequential travel attributes, including departure time, trip purpose, and travel mode, conditioned on the synthesized tabular profiles. We also introduce novelty and count-aware metrics to evaluate whether valid unseen combinations are recovered and generated in realistic proportions. Results show that regularized models outperform the vanilla WGAN-GP across feasibility, diversity, and novelty. Regularization increases feasibility by 2.1 to 3.7 percentage points and novelty by 6.6 to 10.0 percentage points, improving sampling-zero recovery without sacrificing feasibility. The F1 score improves by 6.3 to 8.6 percentage points. For sequential attributes, LSTM-Attention best matches the trip-length distribution, while Transformer achieves higher overall sequential F1, 90.6\% versus 89.1\%. Cross-stage validation confirms strong consistency between generated mobility status and generated trip chains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个正则化的两阶段生成框架来合成现实的人口数据：第一阶段用带三种正则化项（IGP、LDR、CLAP）的WGAN-GP生成表格化社会人口属性，第二阶段用Transformer或LSTM-Attention生成时序出行属性（出发时间、出行目的、出行方式）。实验表明正则化模型在可行性、多样性和新颖性上均优于基线，并引入新颖性和计数感知指标来评估有效未见组合的恢复情况。
AI.motivation: 有限调查数据生成现实合成人口面临两个关键挑战：小样本导致采样零点（有效属性组合缺失）和生成模型可能产生不可行的结构零点；同时合成人口需同时捕捉静态社会人口属性与序列化出行行为（如出行链）。现有方法难以同时解决这些问题。
AI.method: 两阶段正则化生成框架。阶段1：WGAN-GP加入三种正则化项（IGP、LDR、CLAP）提升表格数据合成的可行性、多样性和新颖性。阶段2：Transformer和LSTM-Attention模型基于合成表格档案条件生成时序出行属性（出发时间、出行目的、出行方式）。此外引入新颖性和计数感知评估指标。
AI.result: 正则化模型在可行性、多样性和新颖性上优于vanilla WGAN-GP。可行性提高2.1-3.7个百分点，新颖性提高6.6-10.0个百分点，F1分数提高6.3-8.6个百分点。时序属性方面，LSTM-Attention最佳匹配出行长度分布，Transformer取得更高序列F1（90.6% vs 89.1%）。跨阶段验证确认生成的移动状态与出行链间有强一致性。
AI.conclusion: 正则化能有效提升合成人口的可行性和采样零点恢复能力而不牺牲可行性；Transformer和LSTM-Attention各有优势（Transformer在F1上更优，LSTM-Attention在分布匹配上更优），为基于活动出行需求模型的合成人口生成提供了更可靠的方案。

title: Adaptive Mixing of Policies from Searching and Policies from Learning
comment: 23 pages, 16 figures
summary: Background: Distillation of training targets generated thru search/planning has proven useful in reinforcement learning, but search can take exceedingly long. Objectives: Rather than perform search to the same depth every time (typically at a fixed period of steps), reduce the search depth proportionally to the quality of the policy network priors. Methods: We describe Flexer, an architecture that, for each step, mixes the policy from a neural network and the policy from Monte Carlo tree search. The mixing factor favors the MCTS policy as the policy imitation error of the network and the environment models' variance increases. Results: Flexer outperforms a version of AlphaZero (and DQN and ADP) for some experiments on three toy symbolic problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Flexer架构，通过根据策略网络先验质量动态调整蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)深度，实现更高效的搜索蒸馏训练。
AI.motivation: 搜索/规划生成的训练目标进行知识蒸馏已证明在强化学习中有效，但搜索可能耗时过长。传统方法每次固定搜索深度（通常在固定步数间隔），效率低下。
AI.method: 提出Flexer架构，每一步混合神经网络策略与MCTS策略。混合因子根据网络模仿误差和环境模型方差动态调整，优先采用MCTS策略。
AI.result: Flexer在三个玩具符号问题的实验中优于AlphaZero（以及DQN和ADP）的某些版本。
AI.conclusion: 根据策略网络先验质量按比例降低搜索深度是可行且有效的，能够在保持性能的同时减少搜索成本。

title: Deploying Frontier Agentic Technology in MOOSEnger, a Multiphysics-Capable AI Assistant
summary:
The Multiphysics Object-Oriented Simulation Environment (MOOSE) is an open-source finite-element framework for building multiphysics simulation applications. Using a multiphysics environment effectively demands specialized expertise, creating a barrier for many domain scientists and engineers. MOOSEnger, developed at Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is a domain-specific, tool-enabled AI agent built for the MOOSE Framework. This work extends MOOSEnger with a harness focused on locally-hosted models. The harness gives the agent a full pipeline: it retrieves contextual knowledge from the MOOSE repository, validates and diagnoses the resulting input through interaction with the simulation executable environment, and extracts and stores lessons in a persistent memory.
  The resulting framework is demonstrated on an engineering problem from the National Reactor Innovation Center Virtual Test Bed (VTB), illustrating its potential to support realistic multiphysics simulation workflows. Additionally, the agent performance is evaluated on different categories including diffusion, Navier--Stokes, phase field, plasticity, porous media flow, solid mechanics, transient heat transfer, and reactor mesh generation. Each category consists of 25 prompts/cases. We compare MOOSEnger-Gemma4 against MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2, alongside baseline Gemma4 and GPT-5.2 without agentic capabilities. MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2 shows a slight edge, achieving a 90\% success rate versus 76.5\% for MOOSEnger-Gemma4. The baseline models perform far worse, at just 5\% (GPT-5.2) and 0\% (Gemma4), underscoring the impact of the agentic harness.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MOOSEnger，一个基于MOOSE有限元框架的领域特定AI代理，并扩展了其面向本地托管模型的智能体框架。该框架包含知识检索、仿真验证诊断和持久记忆三个模块。在VTB工程问题和8类仿真任务（每类25个案例）上评估，MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2达到90%成功率，MOOSEnger-Gemma4为76.5%，而基线模型仅5%和0%，凸显了智能体框架的显著价值。
AI.motivation: 多物理场仿真环境需要专业领域知识，对领域科学家和工程师构成使用门槛。现有的AI代理缺乏针对MOOSE框架的本地化、工具化支持，难以在仿真工作流中提供有效的端到端辅助。
AI.method: 扩展MOOSEnger智能体，增加面向本地托管模型的harness框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)从MOOSE仓库检索上下文知识；(2)通过与仿真可执行环境交互来验证和诊断输入；(3)在持久记忆中提取和存储经验教训。
AI.result: 在VTB工程问题和8类仿真任务共200个案例上评估。MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2成功率90%，MOOSEnger-Gemma4为76.5%，远高于基线GPT-5.2（5%）和Gemma4（0%）。
AI.conclusion: 智能体harness框架是提升多物理场仿真AI辅助能力的核心要素，本地托管模型配合检索-验证-记忆的完整流水线可以显著增强模型在专业仿真环境中的实用性，为领域科学家降低使用门槛提供了可行方案。

title: HyMem: Hierarchical Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents via Information Isolation
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents often perform poorly on complex, long-horizon tasks because their context becomes increasingly cluttered over time. As interactions accumulate, detailed execution traces and intermediate outputs dominate the context, making it difficult for the model to retain and use high-level planning information. Most existing methods address this issue through compression or retrieval applied to a single, flat context, which does not clearly separate different types of context information and often leads to degraded reasoning. To address this challenge, we propose HyMem, a hierarchical framework that explicitly separates the agent's context into distinct functional layers. HyMem organizes context by function to separate high-level planning from execution and complex analysis. Its isolated reasoning module handles complex subtasks without adding intermediate reasoning traces to the persistent planning context, while its memory management module preserves task progress across context refreshes through structured summaries. These components reduce redundant context accumulation, retain task-critical information, and support coherent long-horizon reasoning within a limited context window. Experiments on GAIA and Browsecomp-plus show that, with DeepSeek-V4, HyMem achieves average Pass@1 scores of 66.7% and 61.3%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.1 and 4.7 percentage points, respectively. Further analysis indicates that HyMem effectively controls the growth of the reasoning context, allowing the model to maintain focus and accuracy across complex, long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: HyMem是一个分层上下文管理框架，通过将智能体的上下文按功能分离为高层规划、执行和复杂分析等不同层级，解决LLM智能体在长时程任务中因上下文杂乱而推理性能下降的问题。在GAIA和Browsecomp-plus基准上，配合DeepSeek-V4分别达到66.7%和61.3%的Pass@1准确率，超出最强基线6.1和4.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在复杂长时程任务中表现不佳，因为随着交互积累，详细执行轨迹和中间输出占据上下文，使模型难以保留和利用高层规划信息。现有方法主要采用压缩或检索处理单一扁平上下文，未能清晰区分不同类型的上下文信息，导致推理性能下降。
AI.method: HyMem提出分层框架，将智能体上下文按功能显式分离为不同层级：(1) 隔离推理模块处理复杂子任务，避免中间推理轨迹污染持久规划上下文；(2) 记忆管理模块通过结构化摘要保留任务进度，支持上下文刷新后任务信息的延续。两个模块共同减少冗余上下文积累，在有限上下文窗口内维持连贯的长时程推理。
AI.result: 在GAIA和Browsecomp-plus基准上，HyMem配合DeepSeek-V4分别取得66.7%和61.3%的平均Pass@1分数，较最强基线分别提升6.1和4.7个百分点。进一步分析表明HyMem能有效控制推理上下文的增长，帮助模型在复杂长时程任务中保持焦点和准确性。
AI.conclusion: 分层上下文管理是解决LLM智能体长时程任务推理退化的有效途径。通过功能化分离上下文层级并配合结构化记忆管理，可以在有限上下文窗口内同时保留高层规划信息和任务进度，实现更稳定、更准确的长时程推理。

title: Layers Matter: Why Continual Learning Regularization Should Be Layer-Adaptive
summary: Continual learning regularizers like EWC fight forgetting by penalizing changes from previous-task parameters with per-parameter importance, typically diagonal Fisher values. Per-parameter looks more flexible than per-layer, but each layer's diagonal Fisher is a weak summary of its actual curvature, missing the top-eigenvalue information that controls forgetting. Adversarial bit-flip attacks and Hessian-spectrum studies show that this missing per-layer sensitivity spans orders of magnitude in neural networks. Under a block-diagonal Hessian assumption, the layer-level analogue of EWC's existing diagonal assumption, we prove three things. Forgetting decomposes as a sum of per-layer terms weighted by each layer's top Hessian eigenvalue. Diagonal-Fisher weights cannot recover this eigenvalue. For instance, two layers with identical Fisher averages can have top eigenvalues differing by a factor as large as the layer width. For the same level of forgetting, uniform regularization loses new-task performance by an amount scaling with the layer condition number. Our theoretical analysis leads to a simple recipe: protect early layers strongly, let deeper layers move. We apply this recipe to EWC and SLCA and show clear improvements in average performance and forgetting metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文指出EWC等持续学习正则化方法使用逐参数对角Fisher重要性权重存在根本缺陷——对角Fisher无法捕捉决定遗忘的层级Hessian最大特征值信息。作者在块对角Hessian假设下证明遗忘可分解为按顶层特征值加权的逐层项，但对角Fisher权重无法恢复该特征值。据此提出简单策略：强保护浅层、允许深层移动，并应用于EWC和SLCA，在平均性能和遗忘指标上均获明显提升。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习正则化方法（如EWC）使用逐参数对角Fisher作为重要性权重。虽然逐参数看似比逐层更灵活，但每层的对角Fisher只是该层实际曲率的弱摘要，遗漏了控制遗忘的top-eigenvalue信息。对抗性位翻转攻击和Hessian谱研究已表明这种被遗漏的逐层敏感性在神经网络中跨越多个数量级，因此需要从理论上厘清这一缺陷并给出更优的正则化策略。
AI.method: 在块对角Hessian假设下（这相当于EWC现有对角假设的层级版本），作者从数学上证明了三个结论：1）遗忘可分解为逐层项的加权和，权重为每层Hessian的top特征值；2）对角Fisher权重无法恢复此特征值，例如两个Fisher平均值相同的层，其top特征值可相差高达层宽倍；3）在同等遗忘水平下，均匀正则化损失的新任务性能与层条件数成正比。基于这些分析，提出"强保护浅层、让深层自由移动"的简单策略，并将其应用于EWC和SLCA。
AI.result: 将"强保护浅层"的配方应用于EWC和SLCA两种方法后，在平均性能和遗忘指标上均取得了明显改善，验证了理论分析的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 持续学习正则化应关注层级Hessian的top特征值而非对角Fisher，合理分配各层正则化强度（浅层严格约束、深层放松）能显著优于均匀或对角Fisher加权的正则化方案。

title: PLeDO: Pain Level Detection for Osteoarthritis from EMR Data
comment: Published in Intelligent Data Analysis, 2026
summary: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a progressive chronic joint disease resulting in a breakdown of articular cartilage and bone when damaged joint tissues are not able to normally repair themselves. The aim of this pilot research study is to understand the pain severity for OA from patients' primary care Electronic Medical Records (EMR), both from the structured medical data and the unstructured chart note data using information extraction, natural language processing and machine learning techniques. We propose SPaDe, a Synonym-based Pain level Detection tool to categorize patients into having mild or moderate-to-severe pain to understand diagnosis and treatment methods based on only the pain related expressions in the unstructured chart note. Expressions are subjective, objective, and influenced by cultural background and demography which poses a difficult challenge. Therefore, we improve the model by incorporating the medication information from the structured EMR data and pain scale related information from the chart note to propose an integrated pain level detection tool for OA called PLeDO. With the help of human labeled gold standard data, we demonstrate that both SPaDe and PLeDO can detect mild and moderate-to-severe pain from the EMR data to analyze and potentially improve the quality of care in primary care setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于电子病历（EMR）的骨关节炎（OA）疼痛程度检测方法。作者首先提出SPaDe工具，仅利用非结构化病历笔记中的疼痛相关表达进行疼痛分类；随后提出PLeDO工具，整合了结构化EMR中的用药信息和病历笔记中的疼痛量表信息，以提升分类性能。研究通过人工标注的金标准数据验证了两种工具在轻度与中重度疼痛分类上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 骨关节炎是一种常见的进行性慢性关节疾病，疼痛严重程度评估对于理解诊断和治疗方法至关重要。然而，疼痛表达具有主观性、客观性差异，且受文化背景和人口统计学因素影响，从EMR中准确提取疼痛信息存在挑战。现有研究缺乏结合结构和非结构EMR数据进行疼痛级别检测的综合方法。
AI.method: 本文提出了两种工具：(1) SPaDe，基于同义词的疼痛级别检测工具，仅利用非结构化病历笔记中的疼痛相关表达进行轻度/中重度疼痛分类；(2) PLeDO，集成工具，在SPaDe基础上融入结构化EMR中的用药信息和病历笔记中的疼痛量表信息。方法涉及信息抽取、自然语言处理（NLP）和机器学习技术。
AI.result: 通过人工标注的金标准数据验证，SPaDe和PLeDO均能有效从EMR数据中检测出轻度与中重度疼痛，其中PLeDO通过整合多种信息来源提升了检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，结合结构化医疗数据与非结构化病历笔记的NLP和机器学习方法可以有效检测OA患者的疼痛程度，有望在初级医疗环境中分析和改善护理质量。

title: Information Geometry of Message Passing
summary: We show that the natural-gradient stationary condition of variational inference has an edge-local form on a Forney-style factor graph. We start from the Bethe free energy and constrain a selected edge marginal to an exponential family. At a stationary point, the natural parameter of that edge equals the sum of two projected messages, one from each incident factor. Each projected message is the natural-gradient projection of the exact belief-propagation log-message at the current receiving marginal, or equivalently, the gradient of its expectation in the so-called mean coordinates. We call the resulting scheme natural-gradient message passing (NGMP). The rule is local; each edge may carry its own exponential family, and the message a factor sends depends on the marginal that receives it. Compared with variational message passing, NGMP keeps the part of the exact message that the receiving family can represent instead of averaging the factor under the neighboring beliefs. The two coincide when the uncertainty on the edges entering a non-conjugate factor vanishes, and NGMP is more accurate when that uncertainty persists, for example, along a partially observed latent chain or when parameters are filtered through successive data batches. Experiments on Poisson smoothing, heteroskedastic regression, and hourly ETTh forecasting confirm this and show that the gain appears mainly in uncertainty calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了自然梯度消息传递（NGMP）算法。该算法证明变分推断的自然梯度驻点条件在 Forney 风格因子图上具有边局部形式：在 Bethe 自由能中约束某条边的边缘分布为指数族时，驻点处该边的自然参数等于来自两个相邻因子的投影消息之和。每个投影消息是精确置信传播对数消息在当前接收边缘分布上的自然梯度投影。
AI.motivation: 变分消息传递（VMP）在非共轭因子情况下会丢失精确消息中接收族无法表示的部分信息（平均化处理），导致不确定性校准不准确。作者希望设计一种保留精确消息可表示部分的局部消息传递规则，以获得更准确的变分推断结果。
AI.method: 从 Bethe 自由能出发，约束选定边边缘分布为指数族。利用自然梯度驻点条件的边局部形式，每条边的自然参数等于来自两个相邻因子的投影消息之和。每个投影消息是精确 BP 消息在当前接收边缘分布下的自然梯度投影。每条边可携带自己的指数族，因子发送的消息依赖于接收它的边缘分布。
AI.result: 在泊松平滑、异方差回归和每小时 ETTh 时序预测实验中，NGMP 相比 VMP 更准确，主要提升体现在不确定性校准上。当进入非共轭因子的边的不确定性趋于零时，NGMP 与 VMP 重合；不确定性持续存在时（如部分观测潜链或参数经过连续数据批次过滤），NGMP 表现更优。
AI.conclusion: NGMP 是一种局部、灵活的消息传递方案，每条边可携带自己的指数族，保留了精确消息中接收族能表示的部分而不是在相邻信念下平均因子。相比 VMP，NGMP 在不确定性校准上具有显著优势，特别适用于非共轭因子且边缘不确定性持续存在的情景。

title: Toward AI-Friendly Cartography: Understanding How Color Design Influences Foundation Model Spatial Reasoning on Sequential Choropleth Maps
comment: 42 pages, 12 figures, 13 tables
summary: Foundation models (FMs) increasingly support multimodal and geospatial reasoning, yet it remains unclear whether cartographic principles designed for human perception are equally effective for machines. Focusing on sequential choropleth maps, we examine how hue palette, color ordering, and lightness contrast influence FM spatial reasoning. We construct a controlled benchmark of 5,760 maps and 28,800 questions spanning Attribute Identify, Spatial Recognition, Compare, Rank, and Pattern Delineate, and evaluate 21 open-source and proprietary multimodal FMs. Results show that hue choice has limited and inconsistent effects, whereas disrupting sequential color ordering substantially reduces performance, especially for comparison and ranking. Reduced lightness contrast also consistently impairs reasoning, while increasing contrast beyond sufficient separability provides only marginal gains. LoRA fine-tuning improves overall accuracy but preserves these relative sensitivities. Additional factorial experiments further indicate that errors arise from color-and-legend decoding, spatial reasoning, and the integration of thematic attributes with spatial structure. These findings show that conventional sequential ordering and sufficient contrast remain important for machine map understanding and provide empirical guidance for AI-friendly cartographic design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基础模型（FMs）在地理空间推理中，顺序等值线图的制图设计原则（色调、颜色顺序、明度对比度）是否同样适用于机器感知。通过构建包含5,760张地图和28,800个问题的受控基准测试，评估了21个多模态FM，发现色调选择影响有限，而打乱顺序颜色和降低明度对比度会显著损害推理能力。
AI.motivation: 基础模型日益支持多模态和地理空间推理，但尚不清楚为人类感知设计的制图原则是否对机器同样有效。理解这一点有助于指导AI友好的制图设计。
AI.method: 构建受控基准测试（5,760张顺序等值线图和28,800个问题），覆盖属性识别、空间识别、比较、排序和模式勾画五种推理任务；评估21个开源和专有多模态FM；使用LoRA微调；进行额外的因子实验分析错误来源。
AI.result: 色调选择对FM性能影响有限且不一致；打乱顺序颜色会显著降低性能（尤其在比较和排序任务中）；降低明度对比度一致地损害推理，而超过足够可分离性的对比度提升仅带来边际收益；LoRA微调提高整体准确率但保持相对敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 传统的顺序排列和足够的对比度对机器地图理解仍然重要，研究为AI友好的制图设计提供了实证指导。

title: ReliaGate: Reliability Routing for Low-Stakes Wearable Stress Prediction
comment: Accepted at WellComp 2026, held with UbiComp/ISWC 2026. 7 pages, 4 tables, and 1 figure. To appear in UbiComp Companion '26. ACM DOI: 10.1145/3798063.3841770
summary: We study when a wearable stress system should surface a prediction rather than change it. In low-stakes reflection and summary settings, aggregate accuracy is insufficient because withholding can reduce error while leaving some people with little or no information. We formulate fixed-label reliability routing: after a locked classifier emits a protocol-defined stress/non-stress label, a post-hoc gate surfaces that unchanged label or withholds it as unavailable. ReliaGate assembles established confidence, signal-quality/trust, agreement, train-standardized atypicality, and train-fitted geometry cues into a post-hoc correctness score. We evaluate four wearable datasets using subject-disjoint folds, validation-selected routing, paired held-out-subject intervals, and pooled and per-subject analyses. WESAD point estimates favored ReliaGate, UBFC-Phys primary coverage/risk intervals favored ReliaGate, and E4 checks were mixed. ReliaGate provides an operational framework for studying surfaced-label error, output availability, and accepted-output distribution across subjects, without revising labels or providing clinical or finite-sample risk guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可穿戴压力系统何时应呈现预测结果而非保留结果。作者提出固定标签可靠性路由框架：分类器输出标签后，后置门控模块（ReliaGate）决定呈现或保留该标签。ReliaGate综合置信度、信号质量/信任度、一致性、训练标准化异常度及训练拟合几何特征等线索，构建后置正确性评分。在四个可穿戴数据集上采用受试者不重叠划分、验证集选择路由、配对留出受试者区间及合并/逐受试者分析进行评估。
AI.motivation: 在低风险反思与汇总场景中，仅追求聚合准确率是不够的，因为保留（不呈现）预测结果虽然能降低错误率，却可能导致部分用户获得极少甚至没有信息。需要一种机制来决定何时应呈现预测、何时应保留。
AI.method: 提出ReliaGate框架：在已锁定的分类器输出压力/非压力标签后，由后置门控模块选择呈现原始标签或标记为不可用。该门控通过整合置信度、信号质量/信任度、分类器间一致性、训练标准化异常度和训练拟合几何线索，计算后置正确性评分来决定路由。
AI.result: 在四个可穿戴数据集上评估：WESAD点估计支持ReliaGate，UBFC-Phys主要覆盖率/风险区间支持ReliaGate，E4结果混合。
AI.conclusion: ReliaGate为研究跨受试者表面的标签错误、输出可用性及已接受输出分布提供了操作性框架，但不提供临床或有限样本风险保证，也不修改已有标签。

title: Beat the Counter First: A Baseline for Temporal-Graph Anomaly Detectors
summary: Progress in streaming, edge-level graph anomaly detection (GAD) has been marked by increasingly elaborate architectures, from count-min-sketch chi square tests to memory-augmented attention networks. Yet the empirical gains attributable to this added complexity have not been systematically evaluated. We propose SimpleCount, a reference with no parameter fitting that selects one scalar feature per dataset from a fixed pool of counts, recencies, first-occurrence indicators, and count-derived transforms. We compare SimpleCount with two temporal-graph detector models and an IsoForest control fitted to the complete feature vector across five public datasets and one synthetic dataset. SimpleCount matches or exceeds SLADE on three of six datasets and exceeds IsoForest on all six. We report paired statistical tests and five-seed SLADE evaluations. SLADE requires 23 to 133x more wall-clock time than SimpleCount. On Synth-Triangle and an additional Synth-Quad probe, pre-event structural scores recover the planted signal at AUC up to 0.955, while all evaluated detector models remain near random. The benefit of complexity is dataset-dependent, and every claimed gain should be reported against a strong one-feature reference together with its compute cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SimpleCount，一个无需参数拟合的轻量级流式图异常检测基线方法，仅从固定的计数、新近度等简单特征池中为每个数据集选择一个标量特征。在六个数据集上与SLADE和IsoForest对比，SimpleCount在六个数据集中三个匹配或超越SLADE，且全部优于IsoForest，计算速度比SLADE快23到133倍。
AI.motivation: 流式边缘级图异常检测领域的方法架构日益复杂（从count-min-sketch卡方检验到记忆增强注意力网络），但这些复杂性带来的实际增益从未被系统评估。作者旨在通过一个极简参考基线来检验复杂架构的真实价值。
AI.method: 提出SimpleCount参考方法：无参数拟合，从固定特征池（计数、新近度、首次出现指示符及计数衍生变换）中为每个数据集选择一个标量特征。与两个时序图检测器模型及一个使用完整特征向量的IsoForest控制组进行比较，同时进行配对统计检验和五种子SLADE评估。
AI.result: SimpleCount在六个数据集中三个匹配或超越SLADE，且全部六个数据集上优于IsoForest。SLADE耗时是SimpleCount的23至133倍。在Synth-Triangle和Synth-Quad合成探针上，事件前结构得分能恢复植入信号（AUC高达0.955），而所有评估的检测模型仍接近随机。
AI.conclusion: 复杂性的收益因数据集而异，任何声称的增益都应相对于一个强单特征参考基线及其计算成本进行报告。该工作呼吁社区以标准化的简单基线来验证复杂方法的真实价值。

title: Intent-Driven Situation Tracking for User-Centric Multi-Turn Agents
summary: User-centric multi-turn agents must act on an evolving task situation shaped by changing user intents, accumulated tool-grounded facts, missing information, and execution constraints. Existing context-management methods improve the use of past interaction history, but rarely maintain an explicit situation state that separates grounded facts from task-state judgments. As a result, agents often need to infer fine-grained attributes, task dependencies, and constraint satisfaction implicitly from dialogue traces. We propose Intent-Driven Situation States (IDSS), a training-free framework that maintains an explicit situation state alongside the dialogue. IDSS parses tool returns into provenance-aware entities and attributes, tracks user intents, required variables, constraints, and execution status, and propagates new facts to task constraints to update action executability. This allows agents to avoid infeasible actions, advance dependent goals, and reuse relevant information without repeatedly searching raw history. Experiments on three interactive benchmarks across eight LLMs show that IDSS improves task completion, preference elicitation, and interaction efficiency, with clear gains on tasks involving multi-entity coordination, evolving user constraints, and constraint-aware replanning. Ablations and error analyses show that these improvements come from the interaction between fact persistence, intent-centered state tracking, and constraint modeling. These results suggest that explicit situation tracking offers an effective alternative to history-centric context management for reliable user-centric multi-turn agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IDSS（Intent-Driven Situation States），一个无需训练的框架，通过维护显式的"情境状态"来管理多轮对话中的工具调用与用户意图，将工具返回解析为带来源的实体和属性，跟踪用户意图、所需变量、约束和执行状态，并将新事实传播到任务约束以更新动作可执行性。实验表明该方法在三个交互基准、八个LLM上优于基于历史上下文的传统方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的上下文管理方法侧重于更好地利用过往交互历史，但很少维护一个显式的情境状态来区分已确认的事实与任务状态判断。这导致智能体往往需要从对话痕迹中隐式推断细粒度属性、任务依赖和约束满足情况，效率低且容易出错。
AI.method: IDSS定义一个显式的情境状态来补充对话本身。它包含：(1) 将工具返回解析为具有来源信息的实体和属性；(2) 跟踪用户意图、所需变量、约束和每个目标的执行状态；(3) 将新事实传播到受影响的约束以更新动作的可执行性。通过这种结构化状态维护，智能体可以避免执行不可行的动作、推进依赖目标、复用相关信息，而无需反复搜索原始历史。
AI.result: 在三个交互基准、八个LLM上的实验表明，IDSS在任务完成率、偏好澄清和交互效率方面均有提升，特别是在涉及多实体协调、用户约束动态变化和约束感知重规划的任务上效果显著。消融实验和错误分析证实，提升来源于事实持久化、以意图为中心的状态跟踪和约束建模之间的协同作用。
AI.conclusion: 显式情境状态追踪是历史中心式上下文管理的一个有效替代方案，能够为以用户为中心的多轮智能体提供更可靠的行为支持，尤其适用于约束密集和需要动态重规划的场景。

title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration
summary: When a language model refuses to answer a prompt, it is unclear whether the correct answer is erased from its internal representations, or merely suppressed at the output layer. We investigate this mechanism using a controlled withhold setting, which yields perfectly matched answering and refusal trajectories for bidirectional activation patching. We uncover a causal asymmetry in intervention locality under matched causal interventions, which we term broken symmetry. Even when a model generates a clean refusal, the correct answer remains linearly recoverable from its hidden states. Furthermore, releasing this withheld answer is a highly local operation, requiring only a single-position patch. Conversely, the reverse operation is not equally local: reimposing suppression requires broader interventions across multiple positions, and assembling a coherent refusal sequence is more difficult still. We further demonstrate that while an average answer-to-refusal displacement vector marks the geometric difference between these states, it fails to act as a reliable, reversible linear control toggle between behaviours. Taken together, our findings show that refusal does not function as a simple symmetric switch. For safety and auditing, this implies that probe recoverability can overestimate true behavioural control, and locating refusal-relevant directions does not reliably grant the ability to steer a model from answering to coherent refusal.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控的" withhold"设置，研究语言模型拒绝回答问题时，正确答案是被从内部表征中删除还是仅在输出层被抑制。研究发现因果对称性破缺：即使模型生成干净的拒绝，其隐藏状态中仍可线性恢复正确答案；释放被抑制的答案是高度局部操作（单个位置修补即可），但重新施加抑制则需要在多个位置进行更广泛的干预。
AI.motivation: 当语言模型拒绝回答问题时，不清楚正确答案是被从内部表征中擦除，还是仅仅在输出层被抑制。理解这一机制对于模型安全审计和可控性至关重要。
AI.method: 采用受控的withhold设置，使用双向激活修补（bidirectional activation patching）获得完全匹配的"回答"与"拒绝"轨迹；比较正向操作（释放答案）与反向操作（重新施加拒绝）所需的干预范围；检验"平均位移向量"作为可逆转线性控制开关的有效性。
AI.result: 发现"broken symmetry"现象：即使模型输出干净的拒绝，正确答案仍可从隐藏状态线性恢复；释放被抑制的答案只需单位置修补（高度局部），而重新施加抑制需要跨多位置的更广泛干预；平均位移向量不能作为可靠的可逆转线性控制开关。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝机制并非简单的对称开关。对安全审计而言，探针可恢复性可能高估真实的行为控制能力；定位与拒绝相关的方向并不能可靠地赋予模型从"回答"转向"连贯拒绝"的操控能力。

title: Fiber Fingerprints of Hidden Learning-State Dynamics
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Ancillary files include figure-reproducibility code and frozen plot-level data
summary: A learning system can occupy execution states that are indistinguishable under every declared present-behavior readout yet respond differently to future training. We formalize this through fiber fingerprints: controlled future-learning response laws restricted to present-behavior equivalence classes. Prefix-compatible finite probes induce a predictive quotient functor, a Nerode-type minimal recursively sufficient representation, and a canonical set-level predictive fiber without assuming smoothness, reversibility, finite rank, or a manifold. Under an explicit finite-dimensional Hilbert realization, response decomposes into visible, visible-mode-reuse, and irreducible-new sectors; a history-reachability bridge retains only distinctions generated by natural training histories. Conditional mechanism results then identify a graph-Hodge chronology decomposition, a regular switching class with root-mean-square scale $\sqrt{p}η^{3/2}$ and finite-scale corrections, and an exact Adam moment section whose immediate adaptive field is constant while common future gradients can reveal hidden moment differences. Frozen Transformer--LoRA--AdamW studies with Qwen2.5-7B and Mistral-7B-v0.3 support a local action backbone, longer-horizon first-return non-closure, and fresh visible-relative completion with output-range reuse and a low-rank irreducible sector. Stronger claims remain bounded by preregistered negative or mixed results: re-anchored transport is unresolved above its measurement floor; the strict finite-grid Hodge--$3/2$ conjunction is unmet despite prospective contraction; Qwen accessibility is not established in the frozen raw moment chart; and Mistral revelation is future-context dependent rather than bank invariant. Within these support-, scale-, metric-, and context-resolved boundaries, present behavior is not a sufficient statistic for declared future learning.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了在声明的当前行为读出一致（等价类）下，学习系统可以占据不可区分的执行状态，却对未来训练产生不同响应。作者通过"纤维指纹"（fiber fingerprints）形式化这一现象，构建了预测商函子、Nerode型最小递归充分表示和集合级预测纤维，无需光滑性、可逆性、有限秩或流形假设。在有限维希尔伯特实现中响应分解为可见、可见模式复用和不可约新三个扇区。实验（Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B-v0.3上的冻结Transformer-LoRA-AdamW）支持局部动作骨干、长周期首返非闭合等结论，但强主张被预注册负/混合结果约束。核心结论：当前行为并非未来学习的充分统计量。
AI.motivation: 传统观点常假设"行为等价"意味着系统状态可互换，但作者指出，那些在所有声明读出一致的状态下，学习系统对未来训练数据的响应可能根本不同。这挑战了以行为为充分统计量的范式，需要一个更精细的框架来刻画"隐藏的未来学习能力差异"。
AI.method: 数学上：提出"纤维指纹"（受控未来学习响应律，限制在当前行为等价类上）；构造前缀兼容有限探针诱导的预测商函子、Nerode型最小表示及集合级预测纤维（无需光滑性等假设）。在有限维希尔伯特实现下导出响应三扇区分解（可见/可见复用/不可约新），引入历史可达性桥、图-Hodge时间分解、规则切换类（均方根尺度√p·η^{3/2}）、精确Adam矩截面。实验上：冻结Transformer-LoRA-AdamW，对Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B-v0.3做受控训练探测，并做预注册的边界检验。
AI.result: 实验支持：局部动作骨干、长程首返非闭合、新鲜可见相对补全（含输出范围复用与低秩不可约扇区）。负/混合结果：重锚定传输在测量下限以上未解；严格有限网格Hodge-3/2合取未达成（虽有预期收缩）；Qwen在冻结原始矩图中的可达性未确立；Mistral的可揭示性依赖未来上下文而非储存不变量。
AI.conclusion: 在支持、尺度、度量和上下文已解析的边界内，当前（声明的）行为不能作为未来学习的充分统计量；论文为"行为等价但学习异质"现象提供了严格的分类学框架与实证边界图。

title: Pricing the Risk of Runtime Compression: Anytime-Valid Admission and a Served-Output Law for Compressed Serving State
comment: 29 pages (20 pages main text plus appendices), 8 figures, 10 tables. Companion paper: "What to Protect When You Quantize a Mixture of Experts", submitted concurrently. Lean 4 development (228 exported theorems, no sorry) and all artifacts released
summary: Runtime compression of serving state trades quality for capacity with no priced guarantee: systems adapt precision on load signals with no soundness statement, and certified approaches budget request-level risk by a union bound over a pre-declared event count. We show the union budget exhausts on every long request in a production serving stack (100% of requests), and replace it with an anytime-valid, physically accounted ledger whose bound holds at every one of 352,333 admission calls on live traffic and which, in a pre-registered held-out confirmatory round, halves the exact-fallback rate at matched risk (0.30 -> 0.14) -- coverage is bought at a price the account states. We then price the remaining distance from the certified witness to what a user experiences: a machine-checked design law (TV <= tanh(a_q w_thr)) turns the served-TV target into a threshold knob, and a three-layer audit of its instantiation -- an operator-norm query envelope measured 1.5x from tight, a measured-ellipsoid replacement for the Cauchy-Schwarz ball that buys nothing (0.89x, held-out sound), and the gate's operating point (~700x) -- localizes the entire 1064x gap to the operating point, a price the law now states rather than an unknown. A priced bound is worth nothing on a request one has not seen, so the third link is the quantifier: exchangeable extrapolation across 80 serving histories replaces binary conformal prediction's vacuous certificates with order-statistic bounds that discriminate (0.41 against 0.51 calibration risk). All probabilistic kernels are Lean 4-checked (228 exported theorems, no sorry); which object deserves this machinery at all is settled empirically in a companion paper that adjudicates -- and rejects -- the natural alternative of certifying routing. What ships is an account: risk you can spend, a gap you can read off a law, and a bound that survives the request you have not seen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种运行时压缩服务的概率保证框架，用"随时有效"（anytime-valid）的物理核算账本取代传统的联合界（union bound）方法。后者在真实生产环境中因每个请求都会耗尽预算而失效（352,333次准入调用中100%请求受影响）。新方法在预注册的确认实验中，在风险匹配下将精确回退率减半（0.30→0.14）。作者进一步通过机器验证的设计法则（TV ≤ tanh(a_q w_thr)）定位了1064倍的保证差距来源，并用Lean 4形式化验证了228个导出定理。
AI.motivation: 现有运行时压缩系统在服务质量与容量之间权衡时缺乏有保障的定价机制：自适应方法没有可靠性声明，认证方法通过预声明事件数量的联合界来预算请求级风险，但这种方式在实际生产堆栈中会被长请求耗尽，导致所有请求（100%）都触发预算耗尽。
AI.method: 1) 用随时有效的物理核算账本替代联合界预算，保证在每个准入调用点都成立；2) 通过机器检查的设计法则TV ≤ tanh(a_q w_thr)将服务TV目标转化为阈值旋钮；3) 三层审计定位保证差距（算子范数查询包络1.5x、测度椭球替代Cauchy-Schwarz球0.89x、门控工作点~700x）；4) 用可交换外推跨越80个服务历史，替代二元共形预测的空泛证书；5) 所有概率核用Lean 4形式化验证。
AI.result: 在352,333次实时准入调用中，新账本在每个调用点成立；预注册确认实验中，匹配风险下精确回退率从0.30降至0.14。三层审计将1064倍完整差距全部定位到工作点。可交换外推产生的序统计界可区分校准风险（0.41对比0.51）。Lean 4验证了228个导出定理且无sorry。
AI.conclusion: 交付的是一种"账目"：可花费的风险、可从业法则读出的差距、以及对未见过请求仍然成立的界限。作者同时指出认证路由这一自然替代方案在配套论文中被实证否决，确立了该机制在哪些对象上值得应用。

title: Operator-Theoretic Generalization Bounds for Multitask Deep Learning
summary: We develop operator-theoretic generalization bounds for deep multi-output function classes by representing network layers as Koopman composition operators on vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. In vector-valued Sobolev RKHSs, we derive Rademacher complexity bounds for invertible and width-expanding injective architectures. The estimates separate the output-coupling contribution, represented by the trace of the task matrix, from the layerwise operator norms, Sobolev symbol ratios, determinant factors, and restriction constants generated by the linear maps. We then analyze a distinct one-dimensional Brownian/Cameron--Martin regime. Using the exact anchored derivative-norm characterization of the vector-valued Brownian RKHS, we obtain layerwise bounds for domain-preserving scalar linear maps and anchored diffeomorphic activations; the corresponding factors scale as $|W_l|^{1/2}$ and $\|σ_l'\|_\infty^{1/2}$, respectively, and do not involve Sobolev smoothness exponents. Because the Sobolev and Brownian results concern different hypothesis spaces, neither is asserted to dominate the other uniformly. We additionally formulate shared operator learning across tasks, prove a finite-rank representer theorem, derive the exact finite-dimensional problem for squared loss, and establish a target-transfer bound when the learned operator is obtained independently of the target sample. Synthetic and MNIST studies examine stabilized Sobolev-inspired and Brownian-inspired complexity proxies; these empirical proxies are not evaluations of the proved bounds for rank-deficient architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将网络层表示为向量值可再生核希尔伯特空间上的Koopman复合算子，为深度多输出函数类建立了算子理论泛化界。在向量值Sobolev RKHS中推导了可逆和宽度扩展注入架构的Rademacher复杂度界；在布朗/Cameron-Martin框架下获得了基于锚定导数范数的逐层界。还提出了跨任务共享算子学习、有限秩表示定理及应用实验。
AI.motivation: 深度多输出网络的泛化理论分析仍具挑战性，现有复杂度界往往难以分离各结构因素（如输出耦合、逐层算子范数、Sobolev符号比等）的贡献，且对架构灵活性（如可逆性、宽度扩展）缺乏系统刻画。作者希望通过算子理论视角获得更精细且可解释的泛化界。
AI.method: 1) 将网络层表示为向量值RKHS上的Koopman复合算子；2) 在向量值Sobolev RKHS中推导Rademacher复杂度界，分离输出耦合（任务矩阵迹）、逐层算子范数、Sobolev符号比、行列式因子和限制常数；3) 在向量值布朗RKHS中利用精确的锚定导数范数刻画，对保域标量线性映射和锚定微分同胚激活获得逐层界（因子分别为|W_l|^{1/2}和||σ_l'||_\infty^{1/2}）；4) 提出共享算子学习框架、有限秩表示定理、精确有限维问题及目标迁移界；5) 在合成数据和MNIST上验证稳定化的Sobolev/Brownian复杂度代理。
AI.result: 得到两个不同假设空间下的独立复杂度界框架：Sobolev框架包含行列式因子和Sobolev平滑指数依赖，Brownian框架仅含|W_l|^{1/2}和||σ_l'||_\infty^{1/2}且不依赖Sobolev指数；二者不互相统摄。共享算子学习获得有限秩表示定理和精确平方损失问题，独立样本的目标迁移界成立；合成数据和MNIST实验验证了两种复杂度代理的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 本文从算子理论角度为深度多输出网络提供了结构化的泛化界，明确区分了不同架构和假设空间下的复杂度来源。Sobolev与Brownian两种框架各有适用场景，互为补充。实验代理验证了理论界在实际中的可行性，但对秩亏损架构的严格界仍需未来工作。

title: RLCascadeRouter: Quality-Estimator-Free Cascade Routing via Reinforcement Learning
summary: The growing ecosystem of large language models (LLMs) offers huge potential to optimize performance-cost trade-offs. However, their heterogeneous capabilities and inference costs make efficiently routing queries a significant challenge. Existing paradigms are inflexible: one-shot routers commit before observing responses, whereas conventional cascades stop adaptively but follow a fixed model order. Cascade routing removes both restrictions by reconsidering whether to stop or invoke another model after each response. Current methods use a predict-then-optimize pipeline estimating response quality and future model utility. However, prediction loss for quality or utility is not equivalent to routing-decision loss. A lower prediction error does not necessarily yield a better action; a small boundary-crossing error can reverse a ``stop'' or model-selection decision. Therefore, we propose RLCascadeRouter, a quality-estimator-free framework that formulates cascade routing as a Markov decision process with actions comprising ``stop'' and model selection. It uses trajectory returns and advantages to directly optimize the performance-cost objective. Its Cascade Policy Network models candidate complementarity for model selection and remaining-action value for stopping, eliminating independent post-hoc response-quality estimators. Evaluated across ten LLMRouterBench benchmarks with thirteen LLMs, RLCascadeRouter outperforms strong baselines and achieves superior performance-cost trade-offs. It incorporates unseen models without retraining, and ablation studies validate both policy components.

AI.tldr: 提出RLCascadeRouter，一种无需质量估计器的级联路由框架，将级联路由建模为马尔可夫决策过程，直接优化性能-成本目标，在十三个LLM和十个基准上取得优异性能-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由范式存在缺陷：一次性路由器在观察响应前就做决策，而传统级联虽然自适应停止但遵循固定模型顺序。更重要的是，当前的预测-优化管线中存在预测损失与路由决策损失不对等的问题——较小的预测误差不一定带来更好的路由动作，微小的边界跨越误差可能逆转停止或模型选择决策。
AI.method: 将级联路由建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），动作空间包含"停止"和模型选择。使用轨迹回报和优势函数直接优化性能-成本目标，无需质量估计器。设计Cascade Policy Network，同时建模候选模型互补性（用于模型选择）和剩余动作价值（用于停止决策）。
AI.result: 在十个LLMRouterBench基准和十三个LLM上评估，RLCascadeRouter优于强基线，取得更优的性能-成本权衡。能无需重训练即纳入未见过的模型，消融研究验证了策略网络两个组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除预测-优化管线和独立的后验质量估计器，直接以强化学习优化路由决策目标，实现了更灵活且更优的级联路由性能，同时具备对未知模型的泛化能力。

title: Toward Optimal Second-Order Path-Length Guarantee for Adversarial Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: We study second-order path-length regret in adversarial $K$-armed bandits against oblivious loss sequences. Bubeck et al. [2019] designed an algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K+\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,1}})$ regret, where $Q_{\infty,1}$ is the first-order path length, and left open whether $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\text{poly}(K)\sqrt{1+Q_{\infty,2}})$ regret is achievable under bandit feedback, where $Q_{\infty,2}$ is the second-order path length. Somewhat surprisingly, we resolve this question positively by showing that with a more involved analysis, the exact same algorithm of Bubeck et al. [2019] achieves $\mathcal{O}\left(K\log(KT)+\sqrt{K\log(KT)\bigl(1+Q_{\infty,2}\bigr)}\right)$ expected regret when $Q_{\infty,2}$ is known, where $T$ is the horizon. This matches the $Ω(\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,2}})$ lower bound up to logarithmic factors and additive terms. We further remove the knowledge of $Q_{\infty,2}$ using an adaptive restart scheme whose path-length estimator has uniformly bounded increments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了对抗性K臂老虎机中二阶路径长度遗憾问题。作者证明了Bubeck等人(2019)的相同算法，通过更精细的分析，可以实现O(K log(KT) + sqrt(K log(KT)(1+Q∞,2)))的期望遗憾，解决了他们留下的开放问题，并匹配了Ω(√(KQ∞,2))的下界（至多相差对数因子和附加项）。此外，作者还通过自适应重启方案去除了对Q∞,2的已知性要求。
AI.motivation: Bubeck等人(2019)设计了在对抗性K臂老虎机中关于一阶路径长度遗憾的算法，并留下了一个开放问题：在bandit反馈下，是否可以实现关于二阶路径长度Q∞,2的poly(K)√(1+Q∞,2)遗憾。本文旨在解决这一开放问题。
AI.method: 作者对Bubeck等人(2019)的相同算法进行了更精细的分析，证明其可以直接实现二阶路径长度遗憾界。同时，针对Q∞,2未知的情况，提出了一种自适应重启方案，该方案的路径长度估计器具有一致有界的增量。
AI.result: 当Q∞,2已知时，算法达到O(K log(KT) + √(K log(KT)(1+Q∞,2)))的期望遗憾，匹配Ω(√(KQ∞,2))下界（至多差对数因子）。当Q∞,2未知时，通过自适应重启方案同样可以去除对其的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 本文正面解决了Bubeck等人(2019)留下的开放问题，令人惊讶地证明了原始算法就足以实现二阶路径长度遗憾界，无需重新设计算法，只需更深入的分析。

title: The Authority Resolution Framework: A Five-Domain Ontology for Governing Who and What Decides, at Scale
comment: 27 Pages, 2 Tables, 1 Script, 1 Query
summary:
As AI systems become increasingly capable of autonomous action, determining whether an agent is technically capable of performing an action is insufficient: the system must also determine whether the action is authorised in its context.
  This paper introduces the Authority Resolution Framework (ARF), a five-domain ontology for representing and resolving authority across organisational roles and informal influence, business concepts, codified processes, machine-readable permissions and executable systems, and external real-world context. ARF defines the Authority Relation (AR) as a cross-domain primitive binding an actor, action, object, bounded context, justification chain, and a calibration measure termed the DNA-Coefficient, which captures divergence between documented authority structures and authority as practiced.
  The framework provides a machine-interpretable representation of authority provenance and scope, with JSON-LD representations and knowledge-graph query patterns for authority resolution. ARF is designed to support AI agents in determining the provenance, scope and contextual validity of authority before executing consequential actions. The framework positions authority resolution as a knowledge-representation and reasoning problem at the intersection of ontology engineering, semantic AI, agentic AI and AI governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出权威解析框架(ARF)，一个五域本体用于表示和解析人工智能系统中的权威关系。ARF定义了权威关系(AR)作为跨域原语，包含行为者、行为、对象、受限上下文、论证链和DNA系数(衡量文档化权威与实际实践之间的偏差)，支持AI代理在执行关键行动前判断权威的来源、范围和上下文有效性。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统自主行动能力增强，仅判断代理技术上能否执行某个动作已不够，系统还必须判断该动作在其上下文中是否被授权。这需要将"权威"作为一个知识表示和推理问题来正式解决。
AI.method: 提出ARF框架，涵盖五个领域：组织角色与非正式影响力、商业概念、编码化流程、机器可读权限与可执行系统、外部现实世界上下文。ARF定义权威关系(AR)为跨域原语，包含六个要素，并引入DNA系数量化文档化权威与实际实践的偏差。框架提供JSON-LD表示和知识图谱查询模式。
AI.result: ARF提供了机器可解释的权威溯源和范围表示，基于JSON-LD和知识图谱查询模式实现权威解析，能够支持AI代理在行动前验证权威的合法性。
AI.conclusion: 权威解析应被视为一个知识表示和推理问题，位于本体工程、语义AI、智能体AI和AI治理的交叉领域。ARF为这一挑战提供了结构化解决方案。

title: Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast for Molecule-Text Alignment
summary: This paper studies the problem of molecule-text alignment, which aims to project molecules and their textual descriptions into a joint latent space for downstream tasks including molecule search and molecular property prediction. Previous approaches typically combine graph structure mining with contrastive learning to enhance joint representation learning. However, they typically neglect fine-grained semantic relationships between substructures and texts, leading to suboptimal performance on downstream tasks. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast (RISEN) for molecule-text alignment. The core idea of RISEN is to construct a latent twin molecule for each substructure with cross-modal retrieval for semantic enhancement. In particular, for each substructure query, we retrieve relevant textual descriptions and sample several molecules that share similar descriptions of substructures. Then, we aggregate their representations via attention pooling for a twin latent representation, which would be further fused with the original substructure for representation enrichment. In addition, we measure the similarity across substructures and texts, which would further guide cross-modal contrastive learning with soft thresholding. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets validate the superiority of the proposed RISEN in comparison with existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RISEN方法，通过构建潜在孪生分子进行跨模态检索来增强子结构语义，并采用相似度感知的软阈值对比学习，在分子-文本对齐任务上取得SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 现有分子-文本对齐方法虽结合图结构挖掘与对比学习，但忽略了子结构与文本之间的细粒度语义关系，导致下游任务（分子搜索、分子性质预测）性能次优。
AI.method: RISEN核心思路：1) 对每个子结构查询，跨模态检索相关文本描述并采样共享相似子结构描述的分子；2) 通过注意力池化聚合这些分子的表征形成孪生潜在表征；3) 将孪生表征与原子结构表征融合实现表示增强；4) 计算子结构与文本间的相似度，指导软阈值对比学习。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RISEN相比现有基线方法具有优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨模态检索构建孪生分子并结合相似度感知对比学习，能够有效提升分子-文本对齐效果，验证了细粒度语义建模的重要性。

title: Breaking the Compression Barrier: Cross-Architecture Compression Boundary Learning via Reverse Regrowth
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code available at https://github.com/EnumaCaliber/BRIDGE
summary: Model compression is critical for deploying networks on resource-constrained edge devices. While pruning-based methods can significantly reduce model size, they often suffer from abrupt performance collapse beyond a sparsity thresh-old, making it difficult to identify the feasible compression limit of the model. To address this challenge, we propose a boundary-Learning reverse regrowth framework, BRIDGE, that reformulates compression as a constructive boundary-search problem. Unlike forward pruning, our method first drives the model to an extremely sparse state to expose the collapse region, and then selectively regenerates the critical structure to restore performance. The proposed framework employs a hierarchical regeneration strategy, including coarse-grained layer selection and fine-grained regeneration parameter selection, to accurately identify which parameters require recovery. Experiments show that our method can recover models from the brink of collapse on both CNNs and Transformer architectures, demonstrating its architecture in-dependence. BRIDGE achieves a performance improvement of up to 1.49% in unstructured pruning and up to 4.77% in structured pruning. These results demonstrate that reverse regeneration can effectively extend the compression limit while maintaining stable performance. The source code is available at https://github.com/EnumaCaliber/BRIDGE.

AI.tldr: 提出了BRIDGE框架，一种基于边界学习的反向再生长模型压缩方法。与传统前向剪枝不同，该方法先将模型压缩到极度稀疏状态以暴露崩塌区域，再选择性再生关键结构以恢复性能，从而扩展模型的压缩极限。
AI.motivation: 传统剪枝方法在超过稀疏度阈值后会遭遇性能骤降，难以确定模型的可行压缩极限。现有前向剪枝方法无法有效定位和恢复这些关键结构。
AI.method: 将压缩重构为构造性边界搜索问题。采用反向再生长策略：首先将模型驱动到极度稀疏状态暴露崩塌区域，然后通过分层再生长策略（粗粒度层选择+细粒度再生长参数选择）精确识别需要恢复的参数。
AI.result: 在CNN和Transformer上均能从崩塌边缘恢复模型性能，非结构化剪枝性能提升最高1.49%，结构化剪枝提升最高4.77%，验证了架构无关性。
AI.conclusion: 反向再生长策略能有效扩展压缩极限并保持性能稳定，为模型压缩提供了新的研究思路。

title: RAGas: Retrieval-Augmented Gas Optimization for Smart Contracts with Continuous Knowledge Integration
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures
summary: Ethereum is now integral to mission-critical sectors, including finance, healthcare, and supply chain management. Execution fees, commonly referred to as Gas, scale with the computational complexity of their functions. Smart contracts on Ethereum incur execution fees, known as Gas, which increase with computational complexity. Thus, optimizing Gas-intensive code while preserving functional equivalence significantly lowers deployment costs. No existing system continuously exploits evolving Gas usage patterns. We systematically analyze syntactic and semantic constructs that drive excessive Gas use. This yields six high-level categories covering twelve fine-grained antipatterns underpinning a curated knowledge base. We operationalize these insights with RAGas, a three-stage retrieval-augmented generation framework that uses a large language model to pinpoint and automatically fix Gas inefficiencies. Experiments on deployed contracts demonstrate that RAGas reduces Gas usage by up to 11% and achieves high precision and recall in detecting code snippets exhibiting Gas wastage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAGas，一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的三阶段框架，利用大语言模型自动检测并修复以太坊智能合约中的Gas低效问题。基于对语法和语义构造的系统分析，作者建立了涵盖六类十二种细粒度反模式的 curated 知识库，实验表明RAGas可将Gas消耗降低最多11%，且在检测高Gas浪费代码片段方面达到高精度和高召回率。
AI.motivation: 以太坊已深度应用于金融、医疗、供应链等关键领域，而Gas费用随计算复杂度增长，直接影响部署成本。现有系统未能持续利用不断演化的Gas使用模式来优化智能合约，存在技术空白。
AI.method: 1) 系统分析导致过度Gas消耗的语法和语义构造，归纳出六大类十二种细粒度反模式，构建curated知识库；2) 提出RAGas，一个三阶段检索增强生成框架，利用大语言模型精确定位并自动修复Gas效率问题。
AI.result: 在已部署合约上的实验表明，RAGas能将Gas使用量降低最多11%，同时在检测高Gas浪费代码片段方面实现了高精度和高召回率。
AI.conclusion: RAGas证明了结合检索增强生成与反模式知识库的方法能有效优化智能合约Gas消耗，在保持功能等价性的前提下显著降低成本，为该领域提供了新的自动化优化路径。

title: RagGAD: Rationale-Aware Conditional Gaussian Mixture Normalizing Flow for Unsupervised Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph anomaly detection aims to identify nodes that deviate from normal behavioral patterns within graphs. However, existing methods largely rely on the homophily assumption, which makes it difficult to distinguish spurious affinities and to capture the diverse behaviors of normal nodes,limiting their robustness in complex real-world scenarios. To address this problem, we propose RagGAD, an unsupervised graph anomaly detection framework based on rationale-aware conditional Gaussian mixture normalizing flow. RagGAD introduces an adaptive rationale disentangler to disentangle stable rationales from spurious correlations within node interrelationships, and further decomposes stable rationales into robust and fragile components. The learned rationales capture underlying interaction patterns that characterize normal behaviors under varying conditions, while anomalies emerge as deviations associated with unstable or spurious correlations. To model the intricate distributions of normal and abnormal nodes, RagGAD integrates rationale-non-rationale Gaussian mixture modeling with a robust-fragile rationale mixture learning strategy. By mitigating spurious homophilic correlations and embracing the heterogeneity of normal patterns, RagGAD identifies anomalies as low-density regions within a structure-aware distribution space. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that RagGAD outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: RagGAD是一个基于理性感知的条件高斯混合归一化流的无监督图异常检测框架，通过自适应理性解耦器将节点间关系中的稳定理性与虚假相关性分离，并进一步将稳定理性分解为鲁棒和脆弱组件，通过理性-非理性高斯混合建模识别异常。
AI.motivation: 现有图异常检测方法过度依赖同质性假设，难以区分虚假亲和度并捕捉正常节点的多样化行为，在复杂现实场景中鲁棒性有限。
AI.method: RagGAD采用自适应理性解耦器分离稳定理性与虚假相关性，将理性分解为鲁棒和脆弱组件；结合理性-非理性高斯混合建模与鲁棒-脆弱理性混合学习策略，在结构感知分布空间中识别低密度区域的异常节点。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RagGAD优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过缓解虚假同质相关性并接纳正常模式的异质性，RagGAD有效提升了图异常检测在复杂场景下的鲁棒性和性能。

title: CoupVisor: Strategy Optimization by Round and Challenge Decision Support
comment: 15 Pages and 9 pages of appendix
summary: This paper presents CoupVisor, a decision-support system for the hidden-information card game Coup. It addresses two questions: what a player should do on each turn, and when a player should challenge an opponent's claim. The system is built around a single description of game events, which is shared across manual play, replay of recorded games, simulation, belief tracking, advisor recommendations, and learning-based policies. CoupVisor estimates the chance that a claim is truthful by combining how likely each role is with how many cards the claimant still holds, which corrects a case where the very first claim of a game was flagged as suspicious despite no evidence. We compare a rule-following advisor and several learned and heuristic players across many simulated games and different opponent styles. Our main finding is that the choice of reward, whether it rewards short-term gains or ultimately winning the game, decides which learning approach performs best, and that a win-oriented reward produces a policy that outperforms all baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍CoupVisor，一个面向隐藏信息卡牌游戏Coup的决策支持系统，回答玩家每回合应做什么以及何时质疑对手声明两个问题。系统基于统一的游戏事件描述，涵盖手动游戏、回放、模拟、信念追踪、顾问建议和学习策略等功能。通过结合角色概率与持有牌数来估计声明真实性，纠正了首回合声明被误判为可疑的问题。实验发现奖励函数的选择（短期收益vs最终获胜）决定了学习方法的表现，以获胜为导向的奖励策略优于所有基线。
AI.motivation: 隐藏信息卡牌游戏（如Coup）中的决策支持具有挑战性，玩家需要在不完全信息下决定行动和质疑时机。现有方法缺乏统一的决策支持框架，且简单概率评估在游戏初期会产生误导性判断。
AI.method: CoupVisor构建了单一的游戏事件描述，统一支持手动游戏、重放、模拟、信念追踪、顾问推荐和学习策略。声明真实性评估结合角色可能性分布与声明者剩余卡牌数量；比较了规则型顾问与多种学习和启发式玩家在各对手风格下的表现。
AI.result: 主要发现是奖励函数的选择（奖励短期收益或最终赢得游戏）决定何种学习方法表现最佳，以获胜为导向的奖励策略在性能上超越所有基线。
AI.conclusion: CoupVisor证明了统一事件描述架构在隐藏信息卡牌游戏决策支持中的有效性，并揭示了奖励设计对学习方法性能的关键影响。

title: Group ICA 2.0: Closing the Gap Between Subjects and Group Latent Decomposition with Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA)
summary: Group Independent Component Analysis (gICA) is widely used to decompose high-dimensional functional MRI data into interpretable brain networks. However, conventional gICA primarily identifies components shared across subjects. This group-level assumption can limit the recovery of networks present only in individuals or subject subsets, reducing sensitivity to intersubject heterogeneity in clinical neuroimaging datasets. We introduce Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA), an algorithm in the Group ICA 2.0 framework that jointly estimates template-linked, cohort-only, and subject-only brain networks within a unified model. CoLiG-ICA combines ICA-based spatial decomposition, copula-based dependence modeling, and deep learning optimization to preserve the consistency and interpretability of template-constrained ICA while enabling free components beyond the reference networks. By linking subject decompositions to shared templates and jointly estimating cohort-only and subject-only sources, CoLiG-ICA represents individual variability not captured by conventional group priors.
