AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和七个搜索增强问答基准上均优于评估的基线方法。使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct时，WebShop分数提升6.0%-12.6%；使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct时，SearchQA平均分数提升1.9%-18.3%。
AI.conclusion: 转换级别的规则信用分配方法在稀疏成功锚点的长程任务中展现了有效性，提供了一种无需学习评估器或成功轨迹的步骤级监督方案。

title: Quantifying the Gap Between Laboratory Battery Test Patterns and Field Duty Profiles
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to ECCE Europe 2026
summary: Laboratory battery tests provide the main empirical basis for battery performance and degradation studies, but their operating patterns do not directly represent field duty profiles. This paper quantifies the gap by comparing six accessible evidence sources covering controlled cycling, drive-cycle testing, dynamic cycling, NMC811 laboratory ageing, a real electric-vehicle charging trace, and fleet-scale electric-vehicle state-of-health (SOH) data. The analysis combines usage frequency, usage intensity, usage C-rate, and a duty-structure index (DSI) based on normalized current dispersion and ramping. The representative single-segment DSI ranges from 0.630 for the field source trace and 0.699 for NASA to 2.936 for Oxford and 2.855 for Imperial, while usage C-rate ranges from 0.14-0.40 for Imperial, NASA, Stanford, and Hyundai to 2.00 for Oxford. Long-term ageing also differs: the 80 percent retention region occurs near 351 NASA cycles, 6292 Oxford checkpoints, and 1019 Stanford cycles. In chemistry-aligned NMC/NCM evidence, Imperial retains 0.813 under standard cycling and 0.865 under drive-cycle ageing, while the field source has median SOH 0.889 with visible dispersion. Field operation further shows a median use intensity of 137.2 km/day and 56.9 percent of charges ending at or above 95 percent SOC. These results show that battery performance metrics are conditional on the duty pattern that generated them; application-oriented studies should report explicit duty-profile descriptors together with chemistry, capacity, and ageing metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比六种证据来源（受控循环、驾驶循环测试、动态循环、NMC811实验室老化、真实电动汽车充电轨迹和车队规模SOH数据），量化了实验室电池测试与实际现场工况之间的差距，提出了基于电流离散度和爬坡速率的工况结构指数（DSI）等量化指标。
AI.motivation: 实验室电池测试虽为电池性能和退化研究的主要实证基础，但其运行模式不能直接代表实际现场工况剖面，导致性能指标可能误导应用导向的研究结论。
AI.method: 对比六种证据来源，结合使用频率、使用强度、使用C-rate和基于归一化电流离散度与爬坡的工况结构指数（DSI）进行分析，并对化学匹配的NMC/NCM证据进行老化和SOH对比。
AI.result: 代表性单段DSI范围从现场源的0.630和NASA的0.699到Oxford的2.936和Imperial的2.855；使用C-rate范围从Imperial、NASA、Stanford、Hyundai的0.14-0.40到Oxford的2.00。长期老化差异显著：80%容量保持区域出现在NASA约351循环、Oxford 6292检查点、Stanford 1019循环处。现场运行显示中位使用强度137.2 km/天，56.9%充电结束于95% SOC以上。
AI.conclusion: 电池性能指标取决于产生该指标的工况模式；面向应用的研究应在报告化学体系、容量和老化指标的同时，明确报告工况剖面的描述符。

title: Trajectory-Level Automatic Curriculum Learning for Legged Locomotion on Unstructured Terrain
summary: Training locomotion policies for complex unstructured terrain requires a curriculum to avoid early exploration failures. However, since unstructured terrain lacks explicit difficulty ordering for curriculum design, existing methods resort to heuristic curricula over parameterized terrains. This abstraction limits generalization, as policies can overadapt to near-fixed perceptual patterns. To address this, we propose \textbf{\ourname{}}, an \textbf{T}rajectory-level \textbf{A}utomatic \textbf{C}urriculum \textbf{L}earning framework that generates training tasks directly from unstructured terrain maps. At each curriculum update, the evaluator learns a difficulty function for the current policy that maps a given trajectory task to a difficulty score. The sampler then proposes new trajectories guided by the learned evaluator as the curriculum for the next policy update. This forms a closed loop in which the curriculum is iteratively matched to the evolving policy. Quantitative and qualitative experiments show that \ourname{} continuously provides effective curricula on unstructured terrain, improving trajectory success rate by \(56.3\%\) over direct training without curriculum. Compared with handcrafted curriculum learning, our method improves success rate by \(18.5\%\) on the hardest terrain tasks and by up to \(39.74\%\) when evaluating traversal from diverse approach directions on the same obstacle type.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TACL框架，一种面向非结构化地形的轨迹级自动课程学习方法，通过学习难度函数生成训练轨迹任务，形成与策略演化匹配的闭环课程，显著提升轨迹成功率和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在非结构化地形上采用基于参数化地形的启发式课程，缺乏显式难度排序，且策略容易过适应近固定的感知模式，泛化能力受限。
AI.method: TACL框架包含两个核心组件：评估器（学习当前策略的难度函数，将轨迹任务映射为难度分数）和采样器（根据评估器提出新轨迹作为下一轮策略更新的课程），二者形成闭环，使课程随策略演化迭代匹配。
AI.result: 相比无课程直接训练，轨迹成功率提升56.3%；相比手工设计课程，在最难地形任务上成功率提升18.5%，在相同障碍类型不同接近方向的穿越评估中提升高达39.74%。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级自动课程学习为非结构化地形训练提供了有效且可泛化的课程方案，能够持续提供与策略演化匹配的训练任务，显著优于直接训练和手工课程方法。

title: Beyond Peak Backlog: Conditional Energy and Temporal Geometry in Capacity-Constrained Delayed Bandit Optimization
comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables
summary: What is the right delay complexity when a learner can track only $C$ pending feedback items and discarded feedback is permanently lost? Existing one-point bandit convex optimization guarantees in this model pay $\sqrt{Tσ_{\max}}$, where $σ_{\max}$ is the peak backlog, although unlimited tracking admits the sharper $\sqrt{d_{\mathrm{tot}}}$ dependence on total delay. We introduce a scheduler-side conditional-energy interface that separates rate adaptation from the one-point perturbation filtration and handles the dependent importance weights created by randomized admission. Under the same semi-clairvoyant oracle and pathwise hard-capacity contract, this yields an untuned learner whose delay term scales as $O(\sqrt{E_C d_{\mathrm{tot}}})$, with only an explicit restart factor $E_C$; a public constant-factor peak bound removes this factor while $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$ remains unknown. Under strong convexity, the same interface yields the temporal cost $H_A(d)=\sum_t σ_t/(A+t)$. Two delay vectors with identical delay multisets, $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$, $σ_{\max}$, and capacity can nevertheless have polynomially different minimax regret, showing that timing matters under curvature even when aggregate delay summaries agree. Finally, a continuous hard family converts tracking capacity into a zeroth-order query budget and gives a complementary capacity-starvation lower endpoint. The upper bounds require $C\ge \ln T+1$ and do not constitute a complete capacity minimax characterization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究学习者只能跟踪C个待反馈项时（被丢弃的反馈永久丢失）的延迟复杂度问题。通过引入调度器侧条件能量接口，将速率适应与单点扰动过滤分离，处理随机准入产生的依赖重要性权重，在相同半预见预言机和路径硬容量契约下，实现延迟项为O(√(E_C·d_tot))的自适应学习器。在强凸条件下给出时间成本H_A(d)=Σσ_t/(A+t)，并证明两个延迟向量即使有相同延迟多重集、总延迟、峰值积压和容量，其极小极大遗憾也可能多项式不同。最后通过连续困难族将跟踪容量转化为零阶查询预算，给出容量匮乏的下界。
AI.motivation: 现有单点带状凸优化在这类模型中的保证为√(T·σ_max)（依赖于峰值积压），而无限制跟踪可实现更优的√d_tot依赖（总延迟）。论文旨在弥合这一差距，找到更紧的延迟复杂度上界，并理解延迟时序（而非仅聚合摘要）对遗憾的影响。
AI.method: 1) 提出调度器侧条件能量接口，将速率适应从单点扰动过滤中分离，处理随机准入产生的依赖重要性权重；2) 在相同半预见预言机和路径硬容量契约下推导O(√(E_C·d_tot))延迟项，含显式重启因子E_C；3) 强凸情形下推导时间成本H_A(d)=Σσ_t/(A+t)；4) 构造连续困难族将跟踪容量转化为零阶查询预算。
AI.result: 延迟项尺度为O(√(E_C·d_tot))，公开常数因子峰值界可去除重启因子E_C而d_tot仍未知。强凸下得到时间成本H_A(d)。证明存在延迟向量对，即使d_tot、σ_max、容量和延迟多重集均相同，极小极大遗憾仍可多项式不同。同时给出容量匮乏下界，上界要求C≥lnT+1。
AI.conclusion: 延迟的时序信息而非聚合摘要对学习性能至关重要，尤其在有曲率（强凸）条件下。本文提供了更紧的延迟复杂度上界，但尚未构成完全的容量极小极大特征刻画。

title: Baseline-Relative Counterfactual Refinement for Bit-Aware Visual Token Communication
summary: Generative visual-token communication reduces transmission load by sending only selected discrete tokens and reconstructing missing content at the receiver. However, existing token-selection criteria based on local uncertainty, importance, or diversity do not directly determine whether changing the current selection improves the final reconstruction under the same packet budget. To address this problem, we propose Gated Counterfactual Refinement for Communication (GCR-C), a rollout-style correction layer over Local-MDL. GCR-C constructs a compact diversified candidate set, evaluates each candidate through matched full-budget Local-MDL continuation, and replaces the baseline action only when a positive baseline-relative reconstruction gain is obtained. Experiments on CIFAR-10, STL-10, a coded 5G-LDPC link, and a limited high-resolution Kodak transfer show that GCR-C consistently improves reconstruction quality at active low- and medium-rate operating points without increasing the realized packet rate, while remaining effective across changes in dataset, channel condition, resolution, token grid, and tokenizer. The results also reveal a clear quality--computation tradeoff due to the additional encoder-side counterfactual evaluation.

AI.tldr: GCR-C是一种基于门控反事实精炼的生成式视觉令牌通信优化方法，通过构建紧凑的多样化候选集并对每个候选进行全预算Local-MDL延续评估，仅在确认能带来重建增益时才替换基线动作，从而在不增加传输速率的情况下提升重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有令牌选择标准（基于局部不确定性、重要性或多样性）无法直接判断改变当前选择是否能在相同数据包预算下改善最终重建效果，缺乏对最终重建质量的直接优化。
AI.method: 提出GCR-C（Gated Counterfactual Refinement for Communication），这是一种在Local-MDL之上构建的rollout式修正层。具体包括：构建紧凑的多样化候选集；对每个候选通过匹配全预算的Local-MDL延续进行评估；仅当获得正向的基线相对重建增益时才替换基线动作。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、STL-10、编码5G-LDPC链路和受限高分辨率Kodak传输实验中，GCR-C在低中速率工作点一致地提升了重建质量，且不增加实际数据包速率；在不同数据集、信道条件、分辨率、令牌网格和分词器下均保持有效性。同时揭示了因编码端反事实评估带来的质量-计算权衡。
AI.conclusion: GCR-C通过反事实评估机制有效解决了令牌选择与最终重建质量之间的直接优化问题，在广泛条件下稳健提升重建性能，但代价是增加编码端计算开销。

title: A Privacy Study of Sparse Collaborative Inference
summary: Collaborative inference (CI) splits a model between an edge device and a server, whereby the client computes an intermediate activation, transmits it, and the server completes the computation. This raises two concerns, the communication cost of the transmission and the risk that it reveals private information about the input. Recent work reduces this cost by sparsifying activations and entropy-coding the result. Sparsity has also been argued to improve privacy, on the intuition that transmitting fewer values reveals less about the input. We test this claim by decomposing the sparse activation into the retained values and the set of positions they occupy, and by reconstructing inputs from each component in isolation. We find that sparsification reduces the leakage far less than it reduces the transmission cost, and that the remaining risk shifts to the positions, which prior analyses treat as side information for decoding. Across natural-image and face datasets, the positions alone constitute a serious privacy risk, enabling high-fidelity reconstructions and re-identification of individuals. The leakage from the positions persists even when both the transmission cost and the task utility are low. We conclude that the positions of sparse activations should be treated as sensitive transmitted data and audited carefully in the context of collaborative inference. Code is available at https://github.com/an7123/Privacy-Study-Sparse-CI.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了协作推理（CI）中稀疏化激活值的隐私泄漏问题。作者将稀疏激活分解为保留值和位置信息两部分，分别从各组件重建输入。结果发现，稀疏化减少通信成本的效果远好于减少隐私泄漏的效果，而剩余风险主要集中在位置信息上——即使通信成本和任务效用都较低时，位置信息单独就足以实现高质量重建和个人识别。因此位置信息应被视为敏感数据传输并加以审计。
AI.motivation: 协作推理中客户端需向服务器传输中间激活值，存在通信成本和隐私泄漏的双重顾虑。近期的稀疏化方法虽被直觉认为同时降低两者，但缺乏对稀疏化如何具体影响隐私泄漏的系统性验证。
AI.method: 将稀疏激活分解为保留值和位置集合两个独立组件，分别从每个组件单独重建输入图像，在自然图像和人脸数据集上评估重建保真度和个体重识别能力，并与通信成本、任务效用进行对比分析。
AI.result: 稀疏化对隐私泄漏的降低程度远小于其减少通信成本的程度；位置信息单独构成严重的隐私风险，能够实现高保真度重建和个体再识别；即使通信成本和任务效用均较低时，位置泄漏仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏激活的位置信息应被视为敏感的传输数据，在协作推理场景中需进行认真审计，不能仅凭直觉认为稀疏化等同于隐私保护。

title: Beyond Asking: A Pipeline for Personalized Game Generation that Reads Players from Behavior
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Includes technical appendix
summary: Personalized game generation requires inferring a player's abilities and behavioral style from how they play. Large language models have made this inference more attainable than ever: an LLM can read a raw gameplay transcript and produce a fluent, plausible profile of the player. Plausible, however, is not verified, and verification is precisely what the field lacks: latent traits are unobservable; questionnaires provide noisy proxies and become circular when self-reports are used to validate behavior-based inference; and behavior itself is ambiguous without context -- a player who never collects an item may not want it, or may never have had the chance. We address both problems. First, we construct a synthetic player population whose traits are ground truth by construction: each trait is an explicit bot parameter, accepted only after controlled manipulation produces consistent, trait-specific behavioral change. Unlike prior parameter-recovery work that inverts a known decision model, our benchmark evaluates policy-agnostic inference from behavioral transcripts alone. Second, we introduce an opportunity-aware decision-moment representation that disentangles preference from the chance to express it; ablating it selectively degrades opportunity-dependent traits. On this benchmark, few-shot LLM inference outperforms embedding- and rule-based baselines on most traits, though feature-based supervised regressors remain stronger overall. Finally, we close the loop: inferred profiles drive difficulty adaptation, evaluated against ground-truth references and mismatched-profile controls, and an exploratory human study examines whether these findings transfer to real players.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个合成玩家基准数据集（每个特质由显式bot参数定义并经过操控验证），引入机会感知的决策时刻表示来区分玩家偏好与表达机会，在此基础上评估LLM从行为转录中进行玩家推断的能力，并闭环应用于难度自适应，辅以探索性人类研究验证其向真实玩家的迁移性。
AI.motivation: 个性化游戏生成需要从玩家行为推断其能力与行为风格，LLM虽能生成流畅合理的玩家画像，但"合理"不等于"经过验证"。潜在特质不可观察、问卷存在噪声且自我报告验证行为推论会陷入循环、行为本身无上下文则模棱两可——这些根本性缺陷导致该领域缺乏可靠的验证基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建合成玩家群体：每个特质是显式bot参数，通过受控操控产生一致的、特质特定的行为变化后才被接受为ground truth，实现策略无关的推断评估（区别于反转已知决策模型的参数恢复工作）；2) 引入机会感知的决策时刻表示，将偏好与表达机会解耦，并通过消融实验验证其对机会依赖特质的贡献；3) 评估few-shot LLM推断与嵌入/规则基线及特征监督回归器的对比；4) 闭环：用推断画像驱动难度自适应，与ground truth参考和错配画像对照评估；5) 探索性人类研究检验迁移性。
AI.result: 在基准上，few-shot LLM推断在多数特质上优于嵌入和规则基线，但基于特征的监督回归器整体上仍然更强。消融机会感知表示会选择性降低机会依赖特质的推断性能。闭环实验中，推断画像可驱动难度自适应并得到验证，探索性人类研究初步考察了向真实玩家的迁移。
AI.conclusion: 本文为个体化游戏生成中的玩家行为推断提供了一个具备ground truth的验证框架，证明LLM可行但仍有提升空间，机会感知表示是有价值的设计原则，且推断出的画像在实际应用（难度自适应）中具有实用性，但需要进一步验证其向真实玩家的泛化。

title: Optimizing Multi-Market Participation of Battery and Electrolyser Systems Based on Field Performance
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Power and Energy Society General Meeting (PESGM)
summary: The increasing share of renewable energy in power systems creates a need for fast-response and flexible resources to maintain system stability. With the expansion of electricity markets and ancillary service products, opportunities arise to stack revenues across multiple services. Long-term Power-to-X (PTX) electrolysers and short-term battery energy storage systems (BESS) are prevalent flexible resources, yet most studies neglect real hardware behavior, such as ramp limits, efficiency, and setpoint-tracking accuracy. This work presents experimental and modeling results for a 55 kW/79 kWh BESS and an electrolyser comprising three 2.4 kW units. Key characteristics are identified through measurements and embedded into a price-driven optimization framework for participation in the Danish electricity and ancillary service markets, utilizing real market data from 2022 to 2025. The optimized daily profits for multi-market participation are 1,749.27 DKK and 289.46 DKK for the BESS and electrolyser, respectively. With the demonstrated business cases for BESS and PTX systems, this work highlights the importance of incorporating experimental performance when evaluating participation across multiple markets and years.

AI.tldr: 本文对55 kW/79 kWh电池储能系统(BESS)和由三个2.4 kW单元组成的电解槽进行了实验与建模研究，将实测的关键特性（爬坡限制、效率、设定值跟踪精度）嵌入价格驱动优化框架，利用2022-2025年丹麦真实市场数据评估多市场参与收益，结果显示BESS和电解槽的日优化利润分别为1,749.27丹麦克朗和289.46丹麦克朗，强调了实验性能纳入多市场多年评估的重要性。
AI.motivation: 可再生能源占比提升需要快速响应的灵活资源维持系统稳定；电力市场与辅助服务产品扩展带来跨服务叠加收益的机会。然而多数研究忽略了实际硬件行为（如爬坡限制、效率、设定值跟踪精度），导致评估结果与实际表现存在偏差。
AI.method: 对55 kW/79 kWh BESS和由三个2.4 kW单元组成的电解槽进行实验测量，识别关键硬件特性参数，并将这些参数嵌入价格驱动的优化框架中，模拟参与丹麦电力市场及辅助服务市场的多市场交易，使用2022-2025年的真实市场数据进行分析。
AI.result: 多市场参与下，BESS的优化日利润为1,749.27丹麦克朗，电解槽为289.46丹麦克朗。结果表明两类系统均具备可行的商业案例，同时验证了实验性能数据在多年多市场评估中的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究展示了BESS和PTX电解槽在多市场参与中的可行商业模式，并强调了将实验测量的硬件性能特征纳入优化模型的重要性，为未来灵活资源参与电力辅助服务市场的准确评估提供了方法参考。

title: Competing at Every Price Point with Agentic Evolution over a Menu of LLMs
summary: Consider a firm that surveys its competition for a particular agentic task and seeks to offer superior accuracy at every competitor price point. A firm that Pareto-dominated its competitors would leave no rational customer a reason to buy elsewhere. This paper shows a path to this kind of capability via agentic evolution over a menu of LLMs, from training pools of at most 100 examples. Given a priced menu of nine LLM endpoints; brief documentation of the task, objective, and API; a simple seed agent; and an operator-chosen per-problem cost target - usually set at an incumbent's own price - RoboPhD, an evolutionary meta-agent, evolves complete agent programs that attack the public frontiers of two semantically dissimilar tasks point by point: DS-1000 (execution-checked code generation) and PaperFindingBench (LLM-judged scientific document retrieval). Our officially scored submissions hold every Pareto-frontier slot but one on the two tasks' leaderboards, including Pareto domination of both the top-scoring and the lowest-cost competing points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoboPhD，一个进化元智能体，通过基于最多100个样例的训练池，对LLM菜单进行智能体进化，为特定智能体任务生成完整的智能体程序，从而在多个价格点上实现帕累托主导竞争对手的能力。
AI.motivation: 企业希望为特定智能体任务提供在每个竞争对手价格点上都更优的准确性，即帕累托主导竞争对手。如果能够完全主导，理性的客户将没有理由选择其他供应商。然而，在有限训练数据和固定价格菜单下实现这种能力是具有挑战性的。
AI.method: RoboPhD是一个进化元智能体：它从LLM端点价格菜单中选择模型，在给定的任务文档和目标下，通过进化过程（基于最多100个样例的训练池）不断迭代生成和优化完整的智能体程序。操作员只需设定每个问题的成本目标（通常设定为竞争对手的价格），RoboPhD便会针对性地攻击前沿。
AI.result: 在DS-1000（执行验证的代码生成）和PaperFindingBench（LLM判断的科学文档检索）两个语义不同任务的公开排行榜上，RoboPhD的官方评分提交占据了除一个槽位外的所有帕累托前沿位置，包括对最高分和最低成本竞争点的帕累托主导。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作证明，即使仅使用极少量的训练数据，通过进化式智能体编程也可以实现在多价格点上的帕累托主导能力，为企业在竞争性LLM市场中提供了一种实用的能力构建路径。

title: The Trade-off Between Covariate Dependence and Latent Structure in Representation Learning
summary: Disentangled representation learning seeks latent representations whose indicidual dimensions each align with a distinct covariate. Unsupervised approaches typically target latent dimension independence, yet this gives no guarantee that the resulting dimensions align with semantically meaningful covariates. Supervised approaches structure the latent space using observed covariates, but under correlated covariates they cannot simultaneously control one-to-one latent-covariate alignment and latent independence. We introduce a unified, supervised framework that couples latent dimension-covariate dependence with constraints on the latent structure. Within this framework, we show an inherent trade-off, where enforcing latent independence or exclusive one-to-one latent-covariate dependence comes at a provable cost in latent-covariate alignment. We prove that the resulting disentanglement regimes are ordered by the strength of that alignment. Each regime admits a closed-form transformation of the latent space. We apply these transformations post-hoc to realign the representations of pretrained models such as CLIP, DINOv2, and ViT, and we fold them into the inference of informed factor analysis (iFA), a probabilistic model with covariate-informed factors. On simulated and real multi-omics data, we show that both post-hoc alignment and iFA enable controllability of structured latent representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的监督学习框架，将潜在维度-协变量依赖与潜在结构约束耦合，揭示了强制潜在独立性与一对一潜在-协变量依赖之间存在内在权衡，并证明不同解纠缠机制按对齐强度排序，每个机制都有闭式变换，可应用于预训练模型的后处理对齐及概率模型（iFA）推理。
AI.motivation: 无监督解纠缠方法虽追求潜在维度独立性，但无法保证维度与语义协变量对齐；有监督方法利用观测协变量结构化潜在空间，但在协变量相关时无法同时控制一对一潜在-协变量对齐和潜在独立性。作者希望解决这一矛盾，统一两类方法。
AI.method: 提出统一的有监督框架，将潜在维度-协变量依赖与潜在结构约束耦合。在此框架下证明内在权衡：强制潜在独立性或专属一对一潜在-协变量依赖会以潜在-协变量对齐为代价。推导出不同解纠缠机制按对齐强度排序，每种机制均有闭式变换。这些变换可用于预训练模型（CLIP、DINOv2、ViT）的后处理对齐，并融入信息因子分析（iFA），一种带协变量信息因子的概率模型。
AI.result: 在模拟数据和真实多组学数据上，后处理对齐和iFA均实现了结构化潜在表示的可控性。
AI.conclusion: 作者通过理论证明和实验验证，展示了在潜在表示解纠缠中，潜在独立性与潜在-协变量对齐之间存在本质权衡，并提供了实用的闭式变换方案来在不重新训练的情况下对齐预训练模型的潜在空间。

title: BaT: Towards Self-Evolving Medical Research Agent with Stage Rubrics
summary: Long-horizon agents are beginning to automate complete workflows that produce code, reports, and research artifacts. Medical imaging workflows are multi-stage and data-sensitive, while expert trajectories remain scarce and difficult to share. Structured benchmarks can localize failures through stage-level rubrics, but standard post-training discards these diagnostics before the next training round. We present Benchmark-as-Teacher (BaT), a recursive self-improvement system for agent post-training. BaT contains two linked components: the asynchronous Stage Bank data pipeline and BiCuRL (Bilevel Curriculum Reinforcement Learning), its self-improving post-training method. Stage Bank synthesizes content-isolated training states outside the policy-update loop. BiCuRL uses a fixed held-out evaluation to select the next stage curriculum, verifies rollouts with task rubrics, updates the policy with GRPO, and returns the candidate checkpoint to evaluation. On AutoMedBench-Lite, BaT-4B and BaT-9B more than double the Overall scores of their Qwen Instruct baselines. BaT-9B Agent reaches 79.6 Overall, exceeding Claude Opus 4.6 with Claude Code at 77.5.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Benchmark-as-Teacher (BaT)，一个用于智能体后训练的递归自改进系统。它包含异步Stage Bank数据管道和BiCuRL（双层面课程强化学习）方法，通过阶段级评分实现失败定位和课程选择。在AutoMedBench-Lite上，BaT-4B和BaT-9B相比Qwen Instruct基线将Overall分数翻倍以上，BaT-9B Agent达到79.6分，超越Claude Opus 4.6与Claude Code的77.5分。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体正在自动化产生代码、报告和研究工件的完整工作流，但医疗影像工作流是多阶段且数据敏感的，专家轨迹稀缺且难以共享。现有结构化基准可通过阶段级评分定位失败，但标准后训练在下一轮训练前丢弃了这些诊断信息，造成资源浪费，阻碍了渐进式改进。
AI.method: BaT包含两个关联组件：(1) 异步Stage Bank数据管道，在策略更新循环之外合成内容隔离的训练状态；(2) BiCuRL（Bilevel Curriculum Reinforcement Learning）自改进后训练方法，使用固定保留评估集选择下一阶段课程，用任务评分验证rollouts，通过GRPO更新策略，并将候选检查点返回评估。整个过程形成递归自改进闭环。
AI.result: 在AutoMedBench-Lite上，BaT-4B和BaT-9B的Overall分数相比Qwen Instruct基线翻倍以上。BaT-9B Agent达到79.6 Overall，超过了Claude Opus 4.6配合Claude Code的77.5分。
AI.conclusion: BaT通过将基准诊断信息重新注入训练循环，实现了智能体后训练的递归自改进，有效解决多阶段医疗影像工作流中专家轨迹稀缺的难题，并展现出超越商业闭源模型配合编码工具的潜力。

title: SAUL: Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning
comment: 9 pages
summary: Machine unlearning in Large Language Models (LLMs) faces a critical trade-off between erasing target knowledge and preserving general utility. We propose SAUL (Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning), which formulates unlearning as a constrained minimization problem following the principle of "forget enough, but no more than necessary." At its core, SAUL formulates forgetting as an explicit constraint with a prescribed satisfaction criterion, whereas prior unlearning methods typically specify the desired level of forgetting implicitly through optimization objectives. An augmented Lagrangian controller adaptively adjusts forget-side pressure according to constraint violation and can eventually deactivate the forget-side update as the prescribed criterion remains satisfied. Sharpness-aware updates on both retain and forget objectives, together with a dual-optimizer design that maintains role-separated states, further stabilize the resulting unlearning dynamics. We evaluate SAUL on the TOFU, WMDP, and MUSE benchmarks, demonstrating favorable forgetting-utility trade-offs over representative sharpness- and perturbation-based baselines under benchmark-specific forgetting criteria. Beyond the complete SAUL framework, we further show on TOFU that applying the augmented-Lagrangian controller as a drop-in modifier to representative baselines improves their post-forgetting utility, demonstrating the practical value of explicit forgetting control.

AI.tldr: 提出SAUL框架，将大模型机器遗忘建模为带显式约束的最小化问题，通过增广拉格朗日控制器自适应调节遗忘压力，结合sharpness-aware更新和双优化器设计，在TOFU、WMDP、MUSE基准上取得更优的遗忘-效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 大模型机器遗忘面临"遗忘目标知识"与"保持通用能力"之间的关键权衡，现有方法通常通过优化目标隐式设定遗忘程度，缺乏显式可控的遗忘准则，难以精确平衡两者。
AI.method: 将遗忘建模为带预设满足准则的显式约束的约束最小化问题；使用增广拉格朗日控制器根据约束违反程度自适应调节遗忘侧压力，准则满足后可停用遗忘更新；对保留和遗忘目标均采用sharpness-aware更新，并通过双优化器设计维持角色分离的状态以稳定动力学。
AI.result: 在TOFU、WMDP和MUSE基准上，SAUL相比代表性sharpness和扰动基线在各自基准的遗忘准则下展现出更优的遗忘-效用权衡；此外，将增广拉格朗日控制器作为即插即用模块应用于代表性基线，可提升其遗忘后效用。
AI.conclusion: 显式的遗忘约束控制具有实用价值，SAUL证明了"遗忘到恰到好处，不多不少"这一原则在LLM机器遗忘中的有效性与广泛适用性。

title: Process-Constituted Intelligence: A Shared Criterion for Humans and Machines
summary: Intelligence is constituted by \textit{process} (iterative activity through which output emerges), not in the output itself. Generative AI (GenAI) is trained on \textit{traces} (textual and visual residues of human cognitive processes), reproducing samples from a distribution of those traces. Its outputs resemble reasoning, problem-solving, and creativity, yet the activity that produces such outputs in humans remains largely absent. Current GenAI is, therefore, weakly equivalent to the cognition it imitates, matching outputs while process stays absent or opaque. The cognitive sciences have long distinguished between weak and strong equivalence. Here, we define \textit{strong} equivalence across seven process features, assessable against human and machine cognition. Our process-based account addresses a symmetric risk: GenAI tools that outsource a person's generative processes may leave critical capacities unbuilt. We specify design principles for GenAI that instantiate more process and preserve rather than erode human judgment and creativity, and outline process audits that make strong equivalence testable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出智能应被定义为"过程"而非"输出"，认为当前生成式AI仅是在人类认知过程的痕迹分布上采样，与人类认知仅构成弱等价。作者定义了跨七个过程特征的强等价标准，提出可测试强等价的过程审计方法，并给出让GenAI保留而非侵蚀人类判断与创造力的设计原则。
AI.motivation: 现有GenAI输出看似具备推理、问题解决和创造力，但其产生这些输出的内在过程缺失或不透明。认知科学早已区分强弱等价，作者希望建立以过程为基础的强等价框架，以回应对称性风险：当GenAI外包了人的生成过程，可能使人类关键能力得不到建构而退化。
AI.method: 提出以过程为中心的智能定义，识别七个可评估的过程特征以界定人类与机器认知的强等价；据此提出使GenAI实例化更多过程的设计原则，并设计可测试强等价的过程审计方法。
AI.result: 给出了一套可操作的过程特征指标、GenAI设计原则及过程审计框架，使"强等价"从概念上可检验，同时指出GenAI可能侵蚀人类判断与创造力的风险路径。
AI.conclusion: 智能的本质在于迭代过程而非输出；当前GenAI仅与人类认知弱等价。通过过程框架和审计，可以引导GenAI设计走向保留并建构人类智能的方向，避免能力的被动流失。

title: Efficient Coreset Selection via K-Nearest Neighbor Graphs
summary: Coreset selection reduces the cost of model training by replacing a large training set with a small representative subset. Existing gradient-approximation coreset methods such as CRAIG and cluster-based variants can preserve model accuracy. Still, their selection stages often rely on dense pairwise distances or large item-cluster bound matrices, leading to high time and memory costs on large datasets. This paper proposes KNNG-CS, a lightweight coreset selection method based on a $K$-nearest neighbor graph. KNNG-CS exploits local neighborhood structures to estimate the importance of each data item and greedily selects representative nodes without maintaining a quadratic distance matrix. The method requires only linear storage in the number of edges. Experiments on four real-world datasets show that KNNG-CS achieves accuracy comparable to representative gradient-approximation coreset methods, while reducing selection time by $2.3\times$-$41.2\times$ and peak memory to $0.3\%$-$7.5\%$ of the baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KNNG-CS，一种基于K近邻图的轻量级核心集选择方法，利用局部邻域结构估计数据重要性并贪心选择代表节点，无需维护二次距离矩阵，仅需线性存储。在四个真实数据集上，该方法在保持与现有梯度近似核心集方法相当精度的同时，选择时间降低2.3-41.2倍，峰值内存仅为基线的0.3%-7.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度近似核心集方法（如CRAIG及基于聚类的变体）虽能保持模型精度，但其选择阶段依赖稠密的成对距离或大型item-cluster边界矩阵，在大型数据集上导致高昂的时间和内存成本，亟需更轻量的解决方案。
AI.method: KNNG-CS基于K近邻图构建，利用局部邻域结构来估计每个数据项的重要性，并通过贪心策略选择代表性节点，避免维护二次距离矩阵，存储复杂度与边数成线性关系。
AI.result: 在四个真实数据集上的实验表明，KNNG-CS在精度上与代表性梯度近似核心集方法相当，同时选择时间降低2.3倍至41.2倍，峰值内存降至基线的0.3%至7.5%。
AI.conclusion: KNNG-CS显著降低核心集选择的计算和存储开销，为大规模数据集上的高效模型训练提供了可行方案，同时保持了良好的模型精度。

title: AeroCopilotBench: A Two-Tier Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents as Aviation Copilots in an Interactive Virtual Cockpit Environment
comment: 38 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents may assist flight crews with complex decisions and task execution, but existing aviation evaluations centered on static knowledge do not support systematic testing of procedural execution and safety compliance in interactive environments. This paper presents the AeroCopilot Operational Environment (ACOE), a reproducible interactive virtual-cockpit test environment, and AeroCopilotBench, a two-tier aviation agent evaluation benchmark. Tier-1 evaluates aviation knowledge using 1,200 multiple-choice questions, while Tier-2 comprises 73 emergency and abnormal tasks derived from the manufacturers' Pilot's Operating Handbooks (POHs) and instantiated in ACOE. ACOE converts natural-language procedures into executable state transitions, final-state goal conditions, and hard safety constraints, enabling models to interpret cockpit state, diagnose faults, and operate aircraft systems through standardized tool interfaces. We establish a safety-gated evaluation framework in which a trajectory succeeds only when all task goals are achieved without violating any hard safety constraint, while safe goal progress and trajectory safety are measured separately. Across 12 models, the highest Tier-2 success rate is 72.6%, while static knowledge performance does not consistently translate into procedural execution. Analysis of 451 failed episodes from 3 representative models identifies recurring failures in procedural completeness, use of state feedback, and long-horizon execution management. These findings motivate state-aware agent orchestration, joint assessment of task completion and trajectory safety, and repeated regression testing. ACOE and AeroCopilotBench provide a reproducible foundation for testing knowledge application, interactive execution, and operational safety in aviation agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AeroCopilot Operational Environment (ACOE)，一个可复现的交互式虚拟驾驶舱测试环境，以及AeroCopilotBench，一个用于评估航空LLM智能体的双重基准。基准包含1200道知识选择题（Tier-1）和73个来自飞行员操作手册的紧急/异常任务（Tier-2），并引入安全门控评估框架，要求任务完成且不违反硬安全约束。
AI.motivation: 现有航空评估集中于静态知识，无法支持在交互环境中对程序执行和合规性进行系统测试，因此需要可复现的交互式虚拟驾驶舱环境来全面评估航空智能体的决策和执行能力。
AI.method: 构建ACOE交互式虚拟驾驶舱环境，将自然语言程序转换为可执行状态转换、最终状态目标条件和硬安全约束；设计两级基准（Tier-1知识测试+Tier-2任务执行）；采用安全门控评估框架，分别测量安全目标进展与轨迹安全性。
AI.result: 在12个模型中，最高Tier-2成功率为72.6%，静态知识表现不能一致转化为程序执行能力。对3个代表性模型的451个失败片段分析发现程序完整性、状态反馈利用和长时程执行管理方面的反复失败。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现需要状态感知的智能体编排、任务完成与轨迹安全的联合评估以及重复回归测试。ACOE和AeroCopilotBench为航空智能体的知识应用、交互执行和操作安全测试提供了可复现的基础设施。

title: Foresight-England: Development of a National-Scale Generative AI Model of Electronic Health Records for Medical Event Prediction across the COVID-19 Pandemic
comment: Methodology and evaluation framework for Foresight-England. As detailed in the Project Status section, NHS England has paused access to data for the Foresight-E project, meaning quantitative results are not currently available. On behalf of the CVD-COVID-UK/COVID-IMPACT Consortium
summary: Foresight-England (Foresight-E) is the first national-scale generative foundation model of electronic health records (EHRs), developed as a research pilot strictly for COVID-19 research. We evaluated its ability to model the direct and indirect effects of the pandemic. Trained from scratch entirely within the NHS England Secure Data Environment, Foresight-E is a 243-million-parameter transformer decoder. It was trained and evaluated on de-identified, longitudinal EHRs of approximately 61 million individuals, integrating primary/secondary care, death registrations, and COVID-19 data. Training and validation used a 90% subset (54.9 million) spanning November 2018 to December 2022; the remaining 10% (6.1 million) was held out for evaluation. Foresight-E models patient timelines autoregressively, predicting the next medical event given their prior history. At inference, it operates zero-shot, predicting any concept in its ~40,000-code vocabulary without task-specific training. Our tokenisation scheme retains the clinical granularity of ICD-10, OPCS-4, and SNOMED CT codes, jointly representing absolute and relative timing. We designed an evaluation framework for 30-day COVID-19 hospitalisation and mortality, including subgroup analyses by demographic factors and vaccination status. To assess generalisation to unseen future data and the pandemic's indirect effects, we tested the model on medical events from 2023 (beyond its training period), benchmarking against logistic regression and XGBoost. As detailed in the Project Status section, NHS England has paused access to data for the Foresight-E project, meaning quantitative results are currently unavailable. Instead, we share our strategy for tokenisation, architecture, training, inference, and evaluation as a methodological template and case study in the challenges of building population-scale EHR foundation models.

AI.tldr: Foresight-England是首个国家级电子健康记录（EHR）生成式基础模型，由NHS England安全数据环境内从零训练，243M参数的Transformer解码器，覆盖约6100万人的纵向EHR数据。由于NHS暂停了数据访问，论文不提供定量结果，而是作为方法论模板和构建人口规模EHR基础模型的案例研究。
AI.motivation: 此前缺乏国家级规模的EHR生成式基础模型，且难以在大规模真实人口数据上评估疫情直接与间接影响。作者旨在构建首个全国性EHR基础模型，并系统性地评估其在COVID-19疫情背景下的建模能力，同时探索模型对训练期外未来数据的泛化能力。
AI.method: Foresight-E是一个243M参数的Transformer解码器，从零在NHS England安全数据环境内训练，数据来自约6100万人去标识化的纵向EHR（整合初级/次级医疗、死亡登记和COVID数据）。采用自回归方式建模患者时间线，基于既往病史预测下一个医疗事件。分词方案保留ICD-10、OPCS-4和SNOMED CT的临床粒度，并联合表示绝对和相对时间。推理时零样本预测4万代码词汇，无需任务特定训练。评估框架涵盖30天COVID住院和死亡，含人口统计因素和疫苗接种状态的亚组分析，并测试2023年（训练期外）的泛化能力，与逻辑回归和XGBoost对比。
AI.result: 由于NHS England暂停了Foresight-E项目的数据访问，定量结果目前不可用。论文转而提供tokenisation、架构、训练、推理和评估的策略作为方法论模板，以及构建人口规模EHR基础模型所面临挑战的案例研究。
AI.conclusion: Foresight-E展示了建设国家规模EHR基础模型的技术可行性方案，但研究也揭示了此类项目在数据治理、访问权限和监管环境方面面临的重大现实挑战——即便技术上可行，制度性障碍仍可能使项目无法产生定量结果，凸显了人口级AI健康研究的治理复杂性。

title: DriveCache: Action-Aware Caching for Driving World Model Inference
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables
summary: Driving video generation models support autonomous-driving development by predicting controllable future scenes for simulation, planning evaluation, and offline data generation. Diffusion-based driving generators repeatedly evaluate large backbones across denoising steps, which limits generation throughput. Existing diffusion acceleration methods reduce this cost, but general-purpose designs omit driving signals available before generation, such as ego speed and planned trajectories. Experiments across driving motions show that cache tolerance varies with ego translation and rotation, denoising progress, and consecutive reuse length. We propose DriveCache, a training-free, action-aware controller that uses planned motion to allocate reuse across scenes and dynamic programming to place it across denoising steps under a calibrated response budget. A causal drift check refreshes features and replans the remaining schedule when generation departs from calibration. Across three generator configurations, DriveCache improves the overall fidelity-efficiency trade-off over evaluated cache methods. Our code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: DriveCache是一个无训练的、动作感知的缓存控制器，利用驾驶规划信息（如车辆速度和计划轨迹）来优化扩散视频生成模型的去噪缓存策略，在保真度和效率之间取得更好的平衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散式驾驶视频生成模型因反复评估大型主干网络导致生成吞吐量受限。现有的扩散加速方法（如通用缓存）未利用生成前即可获得的驾驶信号（如自车速度和计划轨迹），错失了进一步优化的机会。
AI.method: DriveCache提出一种无训练的动作感知控制器：(1)利用计划运动在场景间分配特征缓存复用；(2)通过动态规划在去噪步骤间分配缓存预算；(3)采用因果漂移检查，当生成偏离校准时刷新特征并重新规划剩余调度。
AI.result: 在三种生成器配置下，DriveCache相比现有缓存方法在整体保真度-效率权衡上取得了更优的表现。实验还发现缓存容忍度随自车平移、旋转、去噪进度和连续复用长度而变化。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用自动驾驶场景中独有的规划信号，DriveCache在保持生成质量的同时显著提升扩散模型生成吞吐量，为自动驾驶数据生成和仿真提供了更高效的解决方案。

title: SCALE: State-Calibrated Latent Embeddings for JEPA Planning in the Right Geometry
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures
summary: Joint-embedding predictive world models plan by scoring predicted terminal embeddings against a goal embedding using a cost defined on the representation itself. Two prominent strategies for obtaining non-collapsed representations are to inherit a pretrained feature space, as in DINO-WM, and to learn an embedding end to end with anti-collapse regularization, as in LeWorldModel (LeWM) with SIGReg. These strategies show complementary strengths across tasks. Although task-relevant state is decodable from the full embeddings of both models, DINO-WM's leading principal components usually retain substantially more state information than LeWM's. Because Euclidean planning costs are dominated by high-variance directions, this difference affects how strongly state can influence candidate selection. We propose SCALE (State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings) to give the end-to-end LeWM representation the favorable geometric property observed in DINO-WM. SCALE induces this property by correlating sampled pairwise latent distances with distances in a standardized task-relevant state space, without replacing LeWM's learned encoder. Across five tasks, three planning solvers, and five compute budgets, SCALE improves every task--solver average over LeWM. A latent-to-state regression control matches or exceeds SCALE's full-embedding decodability yet leaves latent--state distance alignment essentially unchanged and yields less consistent planning gains. SCALE adds a single lightweight training-time regularizer and no planning-time overhead. These results show that planning depends not only on whether task-relevant information is present, but also on whether it shapes the geometry consumed by the planner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCALE（State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings）方法，通过将成对潜在距离与标准化任务相关状态空间中的距离相关联，为端到端学习的世界模型表示（LeWM）赋予类似DINO-WM的有利几何性质，从而提升基于联合嵌入预测世界模型的规划性能。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入预测世界模型使用表示空间中的成本函数来规划，但两种主流的非塌缩表示策略（DINO-WM继承预训练特征空间，LeWM端到端学习加反塌缩正则化）在不同任务上表现出互补优势。关键发现是DINO-WM的主成分保留了更多状态信息，而LeWM的表示中高方差方向主导了欧几里得规划成本，导致状态信息对候选选择的影响较弱。这揭示了规划不仅取决于任务相关信息是否存在，还取决于它如何塑造规划器所使用的几何结构。
AI.method: SCALE通过一个轻量级的训练时正则化器，将采样的成对潜在距离与标准化任务相关状态空间中的距离进行关联（相关性约束），从而在保持LeWM学习编码器不变的前提下，诱导其表示获得DINO-WM式的有利几何性质（即主成分保留更多状态信息）。该方法不增加任何规划时开销。
AI.result: 在5个任务、3种规划求解器和5种计算预算的设置下，SCALE在每个任务-求解器组合上的平均性能均优于LeWM。作为对照，潜在到状态的回归方法在完整嵌入的可解码性上达到或超过SCALE，但几乎不改变潜在与状态的距离对齐，且规划改进不够一致。
AI.conclusion: 规划性能不仅取决于表示中是否存在任务相关信息，还取决于这些信息是否塑造了规划器实际消费的几何结构。SCALE证明可以通过简单的训练时正则化器调整端到端学习表示的几何性质来提升规划表现，且无需增加规划时计算成本。

title: What Does Context Compression Cost an Agent? Interaction Costs Unrevealed by Task-Completion Metrics
summary:
Task completion is the standard metric for evaluating context compression, yet it is incomplete: compression can increase an agent's interaction cost by forcing it to reacquire dropped state while leaving completion statistically unchanged.
  We introduce a controlled runtime measurement protocol for reacquisition cost in a bounded-horizon tool-using agent. The agent acts in a deterministic planning environment under a fixed 24-turn horizon. We vary compression severity, compare a dropping operator with a fact-preserving operator, restore dropped state through controlled oracle interventions, and decompose tool calls into retrieval and execution. We evaluate three models across two task regimes.
  Retrieval calls increase in all six model-regime comparisons and account for almost all added interaction; five of six remain significant after Holm correction. At the prespecified 5x comparison point, completion changes are not significant in any cell. DeepSeek shows a significant completion drop only at 10x compression. GPT-5.5 is the clearest case: completion changes from 80% to 85% (p = 1.0) while retrieval increases from 21.0 to 63.9 calls (p = .002).
  Retention interventions further separate state quantity, state type, and content validity. Random selection is comparable to an offline hindsight oracle, while replacing retained D-state with semantically irrelevant content increases retrieval by 57% (p < .001) without a significant completion change. In a second environment, ALFWorld, sliding compression produces no retrieval surge, showing that the reacquisition signature is environment-dependent rather than intrinsic to shortening context.
  Overall, compression can impose hidden interaction costs when execution-relevant state becomes absent and must be reacquired, while completion alone may not expose those costs.

AI.tldr: 本文指出任务完成率作为上下文压缩的评价指标不完整，因为压缩可能增加智能体的交互成本（重新获取被丢弃的状态）。作者提出了一个受控运行时测量协议，在固定24轮视界的工具使用智能体环境中量化"重新获取成本"。研究发现压缩导致检索调用显著增加（6个模型-任务比较中全部增加），而完成率变化却不显著。GPT-5.5是最典型案例：完成率从80%升到85%（p=1.0），但检索调用从21.0增至63.9（p=.002）。进一步实验表明，重获取信号依赖于环境（ALFWorld中无此现象），压缩会隐藏交互成本而完成率无法暴露。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文压缩评估仅依赖任务完成率这一指标，该指标不完整——压缩可能通过迫使智能体重新获取被丢弃的状态来增加交互成本，即使完成率统计上不变。作者希望揭示这种被掩盖的成本，并提出可量化的测量方法。
AI.method: 1) 设计受控运行时测量协议，在确定性规划环境下使用有界24轮视界的工具使用智能体；2) 系统性地变化压缩严重程度，比较"丢弃操作符"与"保留事实操作符"；3) 通过受控oracle干预恢复被丢弃的状态；4) 将工具调用分解为检索和执执行两部分；5) 在三种模型、两种任务机制下评估；6) 通过保留干预进一步分离状态数量、状态类型和内容有效性。
AI.result: 1) 所有6个模型-任务比较中检索调用均增加，几乎占据所有新增交互成本，其中5/6在Holm校正后仍显著；2) 在预设5倍压缩点，完成率变化均不显著；3) DeepSeek仅在10倍压缩时显示显著完成率下降；4) GPT-5.5：完成率80%→85%（p=1.0）但检索21.0→63.9（p=.002）；5) 随机选择与离线 hindsight oracle相当；6) 用语义无关内容替换D状态使检索增加57%（p<.001）而无完成率变化；7) ALFWorld环境中压缩未产生检索激增，表明重获取信号依赖环境而非压缩本身。
AI.conclusion: 压缩在执行相关状态缺失时需要重新获取时，可能施加隐藏的交互成本，而仅靠完成率指标无法暴露这些成本。评估压缩方法时应同时考虑交互效率（如检索调用次数），而非仅关注任务完成率。

title: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
summary:
This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science. We open-source three pieces of software that we expect to accelerate research in the field towards meaningful real-world impact. We aim to steer further development based on feedback from, and in collaboration with, the community. Given the early stage of development, our $α$-release targets researchers and early-adopting practitioners. Over the past years, a variety of datasets and tasks for relational learning have emerged, but the community has not converged on a reliable, reproducible way to compare different methods on these tasks. Our $α$-release, RelArena-$α$, provides a unified framework for running and comparing baselines on RelBench v1 by standardizing data loading, evaluation protocols, tuning regimes, and support for systems with custom tuning, inspired by established tabular benchmarks such as TabArena. We plan to work with the research community to further develop RelArena-$α$ into a catalyst for progress in the relational learning community. We release the initial version of TabPFN-Rel, a purpose-built relational harness for TabPFN-3. Currently ranked first among models on RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel makes key improvements upon RDBLearn. Beyond its ranking, TabPFN-Rel serves as a strong baseline, adding to the growing evidence that flattening a relational database into a single table remains competitive with specialized relational architectures on real-world tasks.
  To facilitate adoption of relational learning methods in research and industry, we release an initial $α$-version of our Relational Predictive Interface, RPI, an open-source, model-agnostic interface that enables early adopters to easily define problems on new databases and apply any model implemented in RelArena-$α$, including TabPFN-Rel, to these problems.

AI.tldr: Prior Labs发布了三款开源软件：RelArena-α（统一的基准测试框架，标准化了数据加载、评估协议和调优机制）、TabPFN-Rel（专为关系学习设计的TabPFN-3工具包，目前在RelArena-α上排名第一）以及RPI（模型无关的关系预测接口），旨在加速关系学习领域的研究并向实际应用推进。
AI.motivation: 关系学习领域虽然涌现了大量数据集和任务，但社区尚未就不同方法的可靠、可复现比较方式达成共识，缺乏统一的基准测试框架。同时，需要推动关系学习方法在研究和工业界的实际采纳。
AI.method: 发布RelArena-α作为统一框架，标准化数据加载、评估协议、调优机制及系统支持；开发TabPFN-Rel作为TabPFN-3的关系学习工具包（在RDBLearn基础上改进）；构建RPI作为模型无关的开源接口，使早期采用者能轻松在新数据库上定义问题并应用模型。
AI.result: TabPFN-Rel目前在RelArena-α上排名第一，并作为强基线证明将关系数据库扁平化为单表的做法在真实任务中仍能与专门的关系架构竞争。
AI.conclusion: Prior Labs致力于开放科学，通过与社区合作持续迭代RelArena-α，期望将其发展为关系学习社区进步的催化剂，推动该领域走向有意义的实际影响。

title: AstronOS: A Unified Execution Model and Runtime for Long-Horizon Agentic Systems
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Zhenhang Nie and Gui Zheng contributed equally; Gui Zheng and Bin Zhang are corresponding authors
summary: Agentic systems often organize execution and state around a single conversation, model invocation, or agent instance, even when real work spans many calls and stages. We introduce a unified execution model that maintains a work item's persistent identity and versioned authoritative state across calls. Each step receives input scoped to a specific state version and new material; a result advances state only after validation and recording. We implement selected paths of this model in AstronOS using Cases, Tasks, and Scenario Packs across central and local execution. We compare five complete strategies for carrying an established software-version update plan into a fresh model session: rereading original materials, replaying full history, deterministic text summary, deterministic JSON, and the AstronOS runtime-mediated handoff. Ten controlled tasks are run under all five strategies with three repetitions, yielding 150 included executions. On the single-stage reference family, strategies perform similarly. In the primary three-stage A-C batch, AstronOS passes the frozen scorer in 14 of 15 executions, compared with 0 of 15 for rereading and 2 of 15 for full-history replay; later non-interleaved summary and JSON batches each pass 0 of 15. AstronOS has lower attempt-accounted model-token cost per passing execution, while requiring more execution-window time per attempt. These results associate the complete AstronOS condition with higher end-to-end pass rates across fresh sessions in this benchmark, at a measurable time cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统一执行模型，通过维护工作项的持久身份和版本化权威状态，使智能体系统能够在多次调用和多个阶段中保持连贯执行。该模型在AstronOS系统中实现，通过Cases、Tasks和Scenario Packs支持中心与本地执行。实验对比五种跨新会话传递软件版本更新计划的策略，结果表明AstronOS在端到端通过率上显著优于其他策略（三阶段批次中14/15通过 vs 0/15和2/15），但代价是更长的执行窗口时间。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统通常围绕单一对话、模型调用或智能体实例组织执行和状态，但实际工作往往跨越多次调用和多个阶段。这种设计导致跨会话、跨阶段的持续工作缺乏状态一致性和可追溯性，无法有效支持长期、多步骤任务的执行。
AI.method: 提出统一执行模型，为工作项维护持久身份和版本化权威状态。每个步骤接收限定于特定状态版本的输入和新材料，结果仅在验证和记录后才推进状态。在AstronOS中通过Cases、Tasks和Scenario Packs实现该模型的部分路径，并对比五种策略：重新阅读原始材料、重放完整历史、确定性文本摘要、确定性JSON、以及AstronOS运行时中介交接。
AI.result: 10个受控任务在5种策略下各执行3次，共150次有效执行。单阶段参考族中各策略表现相近；主要三阶段A-C批次中，AstronOS在15次执行中14次通过冻结评分器，而重读策略0/15、全历史重放2/15、非交错摘要和JSON批次均为0/15。AstronOS每次通过执行的平均模型token成本更低，但每次尝试需更长的执行窗口时间。
AI.conclusion: 完整AstronOS条件与该基准中跨新会话的更高端到端通过率相关联，但以可测量的时间成本为代价。这揭示了运行时中介的状态交接方案在跨会话任务延续中的优势与权衡。

title: Transfer Learning of Keystroke Dynamics for Cross-Device User Authentication
summary: Keystroke dynamics (typing patterns) can be used as a behavioural biometric modality for user authentication, with applications such as fraud prevention. While the modality has been shown to work well for single device authentication, its application to cross-device scenarios is more challenging. Dynamics learned on one device (eg., phone) may not be directly applicable to authentication on a secondary device with a different form factor (eg., tablet) due to changes in typing patterns that can lead to distribution drifts. To address this, we propose a cross-device user authentication system based on inductive transfer learning, where keystroke dynamics learned on one device are adapted to a secondary device. The adapted data is then combined with necessarily limited training data for the secondary device, which is used to robustly train a binary classifier. Furthermore, an extended set of keystroke features is used to better capture discriminative dynamics. Experiments on the BBMAS dataset show that proposed system achieves an equal error rate of 14.2% for the cross-device scenario, surpassing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于归纳迁移学习的跨设备用户认证系统，利用在一个设备上学习的击键动力学特征来适应另一个不同形态因子的设备，结合有限的辅助设备训练数据训练二分类器，并在BBMAS数据集上实现了14.2%的等错误率，超越了现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 击键动力学作为一种行为生物特征在单一设备认证上表现良好，但跨设备场景中由于设备形态因子不同导致击键模式变化，引发数据分布漂移，使得在一个设备上学习的动力学特征难以直接应用于另一个设备，现有方法未能有效解决此问题。
AI.method: 采用归纳迁移学习框架：将源设备（如手机）上学习的击键动力学特征适应到目标设备（如平板），迁移后的数据与目标设备上有限的训练数据相结合，训练一个鲁棒的二元分类器；同时使用扩展的击键特征集以更好地捕获判别性动力学特征。
AI.result: 在BBMAS数据集上的跨设备实验结果表明，所提系统实现了14.2%的等错误率（EER），性能超越了现有最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过归纳迁移学习方法有效解决了跨设备击键认证中的分布漂移问题，证明该方法能够将源设备学到的知识成功迁移到目标设备，实现鲁棒的跨设备用户认证。

title: Think Inside the Chunk: RegulaRAG for Regulation-Compliant Scenario Generation using LLMs: A Case Study of UN Regulation No. 152
summary: Generating regulation-compliant test scenarios is essential for validating safety-critical automotive systems, yet Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to ground outputs in long, hierarchical standards. We present RegulaRAG, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline that couples SmartChunking, reference-aware enrichment of paragraphs and tables via graph traversal, with Smart Retrieve & Rerank over these enriched units. To test our system, we evaluate on a manually curated dataset covering all scenarios in UN Regulation No. 152 (AEBS). Our study comprises: (i) a three-step progressive search that identifies near-optimal retrieval parameters without exhaustive grid search; (ii) head-to-head comparisons against five baseline RAG systems; and (iii) a robustness stress test that scales the source corpus with distractor content. Outputs are evaluated using a customized penalized scoring metric. Across all experiments, RegulaRAG achieves the highest average Meta-Score (82.99), outperforming the next-best system by 43% (NoRAG: 57.94), while operating at 14k-25k tokens per query versus up to 500k for graphcentric baselines. It maintains strong performance, remaining stable even as the number of regulatory sources grows, whereas competing RAG systems degrade sharply in both quality and robustness.

AI.tldr: RegulaRAG是一个面向汽车安全法规合规测试场景生成的检索增强生成（RAG）流水线，通过智能分块、引用来感知的图遍历增强以及智能检索重排序，在UN R152（AEBS）法规数据集上以82.99的Meta-Score超越五种基线系统43%，并在扩展法规语料时保持稳定性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在生成符合法规的测试场景时，难以将输出锚定在长且具有层级结构的行业标准中，导致生成内容与法规要求脱节。
AI.method: 提出RegulaRAG流水线，包含：(i) SmartChunking智能分块；(ii) 通过图遍历对段落和表格进行引用来感知的增强（reference-aware enrichment）；(iii) Smart Retrieve & Rerank对增强单元进行检索重排序；(iv) 三步渐进式搜索确定近似最优检索参数；(v) 使用定制化惩罚评分指标评估输出。
AI.result: RegulaRAG在全部实验中取得最高平均Meta-Score（82.99），比次优系统（NoRAG: 57.94）高出43%；每次查询仅消耗14k-25k tokens（对比图中心基线的500k tokens）；在法规来源数量增长时性能保持稳定，而竞品RAG系统的质量和鲁棒性显著下降。
AI.conclusion: RegulaRAG通过结构化分块与图增强相结合的策略，在效率（token消耗低一个数量级）和效果（评分显著领先）上均优于现有RAG方案，且具备良好的可扩展性与鲁棒性，为法规密集型场景下的测试生成提供了可靠的解决方案。

title: Task-Anchored Representation Shaping for Pre-Trained Model-Based Continual Learning
comment: 7pages, 4figures, 5tables
summary: Pre-trained models (PTMs) provide a strong foundation for continual learning by offering stable representations that facilitate lightweight adaptation to new tasks. However, adapting well to each task does not ensure reliable inference over all learned tasks. Since task boundaries are often artificial and semantically entangled, an input from an unknown task can remain ambiguous even with strong PTM features, making cross-task prediction a key bottleneck. We propose Task-Anchored Inference Latent Shaping (TAILS), a lightweight post-PTM module that can be integrated into diverse continual learners and optimized through a decoupled step. TAILS uses fixed task anchors as persistent references to accumulated knowledge. It interprets each sample's feature representation relative to these references, then composes relevant evidence across tasks into latent recall. Rather than selecting a task-specific path or adjusting classifier outputs, TAILS uses latent recall to directly correct the feature representation before prediction. It therefore resolves cross-task ambiguity at the representation level, while leaving the original PTM, method-specific modules, and classifier unchanged. Extensive experiments across multiple PTM-based continual learning paradigms show that TAILS can improve classification and task-inference performance with modest parameter overhead and negligible inference cost.

AI.tldr: TAILS是一个轻量级的后PTM模块，通过固定任务锚点作为持久参考，将样本特征与跨任务证据组合成潜在召回，直接在表示层面纠正特征以解决跨任务预测的模糊性问题，可集成到多种持续学习器中，以微小参数开销和推理成本提升分类与任务推断性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练模型为持续学习提供稳定表示，但适应每个任务并不能保证对所有已学习任务的可靠推断。由于任务边界通常是人为且语义纠缠的，即使有强大的PTM特征，来自未知任务的输入仍可能保持模糊，跨任务预测成为关键瓶颈。
AI.method: TAILS使用固定任务锚点作为累积知识的持久参考，将每个样本的特征表示相对于这些锚点进行解释，然后跨任务组合相关证据形成潜在召回（latent recall）。它不是选择特定任务路径或调整分类器输出，而是用潜在召回直接在预测前纠正特征表示，从而在表示层面解决跨任务模糊性，同时保持原始PTM、方法特定模块和分类器不变。该模块可通过解耦步骤优化。
AI.result: 在多种基于PTM的持续学习范式上的广泛实验表明，TAILS能以适度的参数开销和可忽略的推理成本提升分类和任务推断性能。
AI.conclusion: TAILS通过在表示层面而非输出层面解决跨任务歧义，为PTM-based持续学习提供了一种通用且轻量化的改进方案，可与多种现有持续学习方法无缝集成。

title: A Policy Algebra for Trust-Preserving Agentic AI Execution
comment: 7 figures, 10 tables, and 5 algorithms
summary: Large language model-based agentic frameworks primarily optimize capability: whether an agent can reason, retrieve information, call tools, delegate work, and complete a goal. Enterprise execution requires a stronger property. A successful result is not reliable if it was produced through unauthorized data access, widened delegated authority, unapproved side effects, unrecoverable budget consumption, or incomplete evidence. This paper defines reliable capability as a path property: an agent is reliably capable only when it completes a task through action events that remain admissible under identity, profile, tool, data, memory, budget, artifact, approval, and audit constraints. We propose a policy algebra that defines the reliability envelope within which agent capability may be exercised. Security profiles and runtime obligations compose through joins, intersections, budget narrowing, approval inheritance, and evidence accumulation; the resulting composition is both trust-preserving and the least restrictive state satisfying all governing inputs. The algebra also propagates restrictions across multi-agent calls and introduces cost-aware artifact materialization, which redirects open-ended execution toward a recoverable outcome as budget exposure grows. The evaluation is interpreted as a reliability-capability trade-off rather than a capability benchmark: the policy-algebra runtime intervenes on 94.8% of policy-violating events while retaining an 86.9% task-completion rate, eliminates the observed profile-monotonicity and zero-artifact-exhaustion violations, and increases audit completeness to 98.6%. The method provides researchers and practitioners with formal correctness conditions, executable decision semantics, and trace evidence for building agents that are not only capable, but reliably capable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于大型语言模型智能体的策略代数（policy algebra），定义了智能体能力可被行使的"可靠性包络"（reliability envelope），通过身份、档案、工具、数据、记忆、预算、工件、审批和审计等约束来确保智能体不仅具备能力，而且可靠地具备能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的智能体框架主要优化能力（能否推理、检索、调用工具、委派工作、完成目标），但企业执行需要更强的属性：可靠性。即使任务成功完成，如果是通过未授权数据访问、扩大委派权限、未经批准的副作用、不可恢复的预算消耗或不完整的证据实现的，该结果也是不可靠的。因此需要形式化的可靠性保证。
AI.method: 提出一种策略代数（policy algebra），定义智能体能力可行使的可靠性包络。安全配置文件和运行时义务通过连接（joins）、交集（intersections）、预算收窄（budget narrowing）、审批继承（approval inheritance）和证据积累（evidence accumulation）进行组合，组合结果是保信任的且是满足所有治理输入的最不严格状态。代数还在多智能体调用间传播限制，并引入成本感知的工件物化（cost-aware artifact materialization），在预算暴露增长时将开放式的执行重定向到可恢复的结果。
AI.result: 策略代数运行时对94.8%的违反策略事件进行干预，同时保持86.9%的任务完成率；消除了观察到的配置单调性（profile-monotonicity）和零工件耗尽（zero-artifact-exhaustion）违规；将审计完整性提高到98.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为研究人员和实践者提供了形式化的正确性条件、可执行的决策语义和痕迹证据，用于构建不仅具备能力而且可靠具备能力的智能体。评估被解释为可靠性-能力权衡而非单纯的能力基准。

title: OceanDepths: A Global Dataset of Paired Subsurface and Surface Ocean Observations
summary: Despite comprising over 70\% of its surface, the world's oceans are critically underobserved compared to the land surface or the atmosphere.Understanding the global ocean requires jointly observing its surface and subsurface structure, yet no standardized, high-resolution dataset couples satellite surface fields to co-located \emph{in situ} depth profiles in an AI-ready format.Existing resources either consist of model-reconstructed gridded products rather than observations, cover only a single variable or basin, or operate at resolutions too coarse for mesoscale dynamics.We introduce \textsc{OceanDepths}, the first open, global, regridded AI-ready dataset that pairs satellite-derived sea surface temperature (SST), sea surface salinity (SSS), and sea surface height (SSH) L4 products with co-located EN4 subsurface temperature and salinity profiles, complemented by matched GLORYS12 ocean reanalysis data to support comparisons or multi-stage learning.The dataset spans 2000--2024 at \SI{0.1}{\degree}$\times$\SI{0.1}{\degree} spatial resolution and at weekly temporal resolution, covering the entire globe's sea surface and with over 9.5 million paired profiles interpolated to 50 standardized depth levels.We provide a configurable system to split the globe in equally sized spatial patches.The 4D multivariate structure, high resolution, long temporal extent, and extreme sparsity of subsurface observations (${\sim}$0.01\% per depth level) make \textsc{OceanDepths}a challenging testbed for novel AI methods.We demonstrate subsurface state reconstruction as an example task with simple baseline models, but also envision \textsc{OceanDepths}to support the development of observation-based forecast methods and other related tasks.\added{Available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ESA-philab/OceanDepths.}

AI.tldr: OceanDepths 是首个开源、全球范围、AI就绪的海洋数据集，将卫星观测的海表温度、盐度和海面高度数据与 EN4 潜标温盐剖面数据配对，覆盖2000-2024年、0.1°空间分辨率和周时间分辨率，包含超过950万个标准化深度层的配对剖面，为海洋次表层状态重建等AI任务提供了具有挑战性的测试平台。
AI.motivation: 全球海洋占据地球表面70%以上，但观测严重不足。现有资源要么是模型重建的网格产品而非观测数据，要么只覆盖单一变量或海域，要么分辨率过低无法捕捉中尺度动力学。缺乏一个将卫星海表场与同位置实地深度剖面耦合的标准化、高分辨率、AI就绪数据集。
AI.method: 1) 将卫星衍生的海表温度(SST)、海表盐度(SSS)和海表高度(SSH) L4产品与EN4次表层温度/盐度剖面配对；2) 补充GLORYS12海洋再分析数据以支持比较或多阶段学习；3) 以0.1°×0.1°空间分辨率和周时间分辨率覆盖2000-2024年全球；4) 将超过950万个剖面插值到50个标准化深度层；5) 提供可配置系统将全球划分为等大小的空间图块。
AI.result: 数据集覆盖全球海面，包含超过950万个配对剖面并插值到50个标准化深度层，具有4D多元结构、高分辨率、长时间跨度和极稀疏的次表层观测（每深度层约0.01%）。以次表层状态重建作为示例任务验证了简单基线模型的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OceanDepths 填补了海洋观测数据在AI就绪格式上的空白，为次表层状态重建、基于观测的预报方法开发及其他相关任务提供了具有挑战性的测试平台，数据集已公开发布。

title: Reasoning-supported Robustness Validation of Automotive E/E Components
comment: Published in: 2017 IEEE 11th International Conference on Semantic Computing (ICSC)
summary: This paper presents an ontology-supported approach to tackle the complexity of the Robustness Validation (RV) process of automotive electrical/electronic (E/E) components. The approach uses formalized knowledge from the RV process and stress, operating, and load profiles, so-called Mission Profiles (MPs). In contrast to the error-prone industrially established manual procedure, we show how component characteristics are formalized in OWL in order to form the foundation of an efficient automated analysis selection and decision support during the RV process. The proposed approach is based on the idea of mapping MPs to an OWL representation so to allow to perform semantic queries against MP data to improve their integration into the RV process. The resulting ontology-supported application framework has been applied to an industrial use-case from automotive power electronics. We present experimental results showing that the RV process can be significantly improved in terms of reduced design time and increased exhaustiveness by automating the analyses selection step and the provisioning of all the relevant data to be used.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于本体（OWL）的汽车电子/电气（E/E）组件鲁棒性验证（RV）方法，通过将任务剖面（MPs）形式化为OWL表示，实现自动化分析选择和决策支持，显著缩短设计时间并提高验证全面性。
AI.motivation: 传统的汽车E/E组件RV过程依赖人工操作，容易出错且效率低下。开发过程中，RV过程的复杂性以及任务剖面（MPs）数据的整合困难，导致设计时间长、验证不全面，亟需一种更高效的自动化方法。
AI.method: 该方法的核心理念是将MPs映射到OWL本体表示，利用本体形式化RV过程的知识以及应力、运行和负载剖面。通过语义查询对MP数据进行分析，实现自动化分析选择和决策支持。整个框架在汽车电力电子的工业用例中进行验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该本体支持的应用框架能够显著改进RV过程，具体表现为：通过自动化分析选择步骤以及提供所有相关数据，减少了设计时间并提高了验证的全面性（exhaustiveness）。
AI.conclusion: 基于本体的方法相比传统的工业手动RV流程，能够有效克服人工操作的错误倾向，通过将MP数据形式化为OWL表示，实现语义查询驱动的自动化分析选择和决策支持，从而提升汽车E/E组件RV过程的效率和完整性。

title: Coverage-Maximizing Multinomial Subset Routing under Operational Constraints
summary:
We introduce Multinomial Subset Routing (MSR), a new online routing framework over $K$ experts in which the learner keeps a multinomial routing policy instead of a deterministic subset of experts. At each round, the learner samples $M$ experts i.i.d. from the multinomial policy, and the resulting set of distinct sampled experts forms the routed subset.
  The reward depends only on the best-performing expert(s) in the routed subset. This reward structure arises naturally in routing across specialized models but is not captured by standard combinatorial bandits or subset-selection methods, which optimize deterministic subsets and typically assume additive rewards. We require the selection to satisfy several long-term, two-sided operational constraints under bandit feedback, observing only the winner's reward each round. We propose OMD-Approachability, combining online mirror descent with Blackwell's Approachability, and prove it achieves $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ regret in both reward and constraint violation. We ground the framework in practical application domains and validate it empirically on a real-world crowdsourcing dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的在线路由框架——多项子集路由（MSR），其中学习器维护一个多项路由策略而非确定性专家子集。每轮从多项分布中采样M个专家，回报仅取决于路由子集中表现最佳的专家。结合在线镜像下降与Blackwell可逼近性，提出OMD-Approachability算法，在满足长期双边操作约束和仅观测胜者回报的bandit反馈下，实现了O(1/√T)的遗憾与约束违反界。
AI.motivation: 现有组合bandit或子集选择方法优化确定性子集且通常假设可加性回报，无法捕捉"回报仅取决于路由子集中最佳专家"这一在专业化模型路由中自然出现的回报结构，因此需要新的路由框架。
AI.method: 提出OMD-Approachability算法，将在线镜像下降（Online Mirror Descent）与Blackwell可逼近性（Blackwell's Approachability）相结合，以处理多项路由策略下的带约束在线学习问题。
AI.result: 理论上证明OMD-Approachability在奖励遗憾和约束违反两方面均达到O(1/√T)的界；在真实众包数据集上的实验验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MSR框架为跨专业模型路由提供了更具表达力的建模方式，OMD-Approachability在理论上和实证中均展现了良好的性能，为带长期操作约束的在线路由问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: ParaTempo: Efficient Parallel Reasoning via Temporal Confidence
comment: Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/ScottZhang812/ParaTempo
summary: Parallel reasoning improves the accuracy and robustness of large reasoning models by exploring multiple solution paths, but its computational cost grows with reasoning depth and branch count. Existing methods for managing these parallel paths typically rely on final-answer consensus, local token confidence, or isolated intermediate probes. However, these signals are often delayed, weakly tied to actual reasoning progress, or too noisy for dynamic, branch-level control. To address these limitations, we introduce ParaTempo, a training-free asynchronous parallel reasoning framework. ParaTempo is driven by temporal confidence, a branch-local measure of answer-space convergence. Each branch is periodically probed for a tentative answer probability distribution, and temporal confidence quantifies how sharply the recent intermediate probes concentrate on a dominant answer. Once sufficient evidence has accumulated, ParaTempo drives its entire control process from this single signal: low-confidence branches are pruned, branches that persistently commit to their dominant answer are retired early, freed computation is reallocated by forking new branches, and generation stops globally once the confidence-weighted vote concentrates. Without requiring synchronization among reasoning trajectories, ParaTempo adaptively allocates computation based on branch-level convergence. Experiments on challenging mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks show that ParaTempo reduces average latency by 21.8-32.2% and total token usage by 18.1-30.3% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Moreover, temporal confidence exhibits stronger temporal stability and predictive power for future branch convergence than token-level and instantaneous signals.

AI.tldr: ParaTempo是一个无需训练的异步并行推理框架，通过"时间置信度"（temporal confidence）这一分支级信号来动态管理并行推理路径，在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著降低延迟和token开销。
AI.motivation: 并行推理虽能提升准确率和鲁棒性，但计算成本随推理深度和分支数增长。现有路径管理方法依赖最终答案共识、局部token置信度或孤立的中间探针，这些信号存在延迟、与推理进度关联弱、噪声大等问题，难以实现动态的分支级控制。
AI.method: ParaTempo提出时间置信度作为核心控制信号：定期对每个分支探测暂定答案的概率分布，量化近期中间探针在主导答案上的集中程度。基于该单一信号驱动整个控制流程——剪枝低置信度分支、提前退役持续锁定主导答案的分支、通过分叉新分支重新分配计算资源、在置信度加权投票集中时全局停止。所有推理轨迹无需同步。
AI.result: 在数学和科学推理基准上，ParaTempo将平均延迟降低21.8%-32.2%，总token使用量减少18.1%-30.3%，同时保持竞争性准确率。时间置信度在时间稳定性和对未来分支收敛的预测能力上优于token级和瞬时信号。
AI.conclusion: 时间置信度是一种比现有信号更可靠、更具预测力的分支级收敛指标，基于该信号的异步并行推理框架能够在保持准确率的同时大幅降低计算成本，为大规模推理模型的高效并行推理提供了新的方案。

title: FETERS: Few-Shot Early Time-Series Classification via Effective Ratio Selection
summary: Early time-series classification (ETSC) aims to make accurate predictions from partially observed time series as early as possible. Although various stopping mechanisms and feature learning strategies have been developed for ETSC, most existing methods assume access to sufficient labeled training data, which may be unrealistic in applications with limited annotation. Under limited supervision, learning an additional sample-level stopping module and extracting effective classification features can both become challenging. In this paper, we propose FETERS, a few-shot ETSC framework that selects a dataset-level stopping ratio through class-wise leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation on the support set and uses a penalty-based reward function to manage the accuracy-earliness trade-off, thereby avoiding the need to train an additional stopping module. FETERS further combines Rocket-based features with frozen Chronos representations for classification. Extensive experiments on 69 public datasets spanning 14 domains show that FETERS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in the 5-shot setting, with the highest average harmonic mean (HM) and the best HM on 38 datasets, while outperforming the current SOTA method on 44 datasets. FETERS also remains competitive in the full-shot setting, demonstrating its effectiveness in managing the accuracy-earliness trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出了FETERS，一个少样本早期时间序列分类框架，通过数据集级别的停止比例选择和惩罚奖励函数来管理准确率-及时性权衡，在69个公共数据集上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有早期时间序列分类方法大多假设有充足的标注训练数据，但在实际应用中标注可能有限。在少样本场景下，训练样本级停止模块和提取有效分类特征都变得困难。
AI.method: 1) 通过支持集上的类间留一法（LOO）评估选择数据集级别的停止比例，避免训练额外的停止模块；2) 使用基于惩罚的奖励函数管理准确率-及时性权衡；3) 结合Rocket特征和冻结的Chronos表示进行分类。
AI.result: 在14个领域的69个公共数据集上，5-shot设置下达到SOTA性能，平均谐波均值最高，在38个数据集上取得最佳HM，在44个数据集上超越当前SOTA方法；在全量设置下也保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FETERS有效解决了少样本早期时间序列分类中的准确率-及时性权衡问题，避免了训练额外停止模块的需求，验证了其在有限标注条件下的有效性。

title: SoftModel: A Neural Model That Grows Its Own Topology -- Governed Structural Growth for Continual In-Service Learning
comment: 99 pages, 16 figures, 12 tables
summary: Today, a neural system is almost always used in two phases -- trained, then deployed -- and in that regime it freezes twice: training ends, and the topology itself was never a degree of freedom. We take the opposite premise as an axiom -- total plasticity: no part of a model, including its structure, is ever frozen -- and derive the governance a lifelong learner then requires. The design's target regime is continual, in-service learning: a long-lived model on a non-stationary stream, whose stability comes from governance rather than immobility and whose capacity follows demand. The result is a growable soft model: an algebra of structural operators (width, hierarchy, composition, input interface, grown cycles, attention heads), each exact at application, budgeted, and audited, with adoption decided solely by a held-out reality gate that treats parametric and structural change uniformly. A complete from-scratch system realizes the whole account; its factory surface is operated end-to-end by a production LLM. Two conclusions follow from the axiom by construction: stability under lifelong change becomes an audit property of the lifecycle, and structure that follows demand removes the silent cap a fixed topology places on later capability where the capacity floor binds. A third is measured: in the worlds where this was measured, the marginal value of new capacity was unobservable before adoption, so workable growth governance took its ex-post form. The same governance extends to evaluative signals, and the core method is evaluated on standard continual-learning benchmarks, where governed growth preserves the ability to keep learning along long task sequences. A pre-registered experimental program adjudicates the mechanism and value claims on the tested problems and reports its failures at full prominence; the map -- positive and negative -- is the contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"完全可塑性"原则：模型的任何部分（包括其结构）都永不冻结。在此基础上设计了一个可生长的软模型（growable soft model），通过结构性算子（宽度、层级、组合、输入接口、循环、注意力头）库，配合仅由留出验证门（reality gate）统一决定参数与结构变更的治理机制，实现终身持续学习。系统由生产级LLM全流程操作，稳定性成为生命周期审计属性，结构随需求增长消解了固定拓扑对能力的隐性上限。
AI.motivation: 传统神经系统的范式是先训练后部署，模型会两次"冻结"：训练终止、拓扑结构本身从未成为自由度。作者质疑这一前提，主张以"完全可塑性"为公理，探究终身学习者所需的治理机制——在非平稳数据流上长期服役的模型，其稳定性应来自治理而非静止，容量应跟随需求而非被固定结构锁死。
AI.method: 设计一个可生长的软模型：构建代数化的结构算子库（宽度、层级、组合、输入接口、生长循环、注意力头），每个算子在应用时精确、有预算、被审计；所有参数与结构变更统一交由保留的"现实门"（reality gate）裁决采用与否。整个系统从零完整实现，其工厂表面由生产级LLM端到端运营。治理同时延伸至评估信号本身；采用了预注册（pre-registered）实验程序。
AI.result: 两个结论由公理构造性地得出：终身变化下的稳定性成为生命周期的审计属性；随需求生长的结构消除固定拓扑在容量下限约束时对后续能力的隐性封顶。第三个结论是实测得到的：在测量的场景中，新容量的边际价值在采纳前不可观测，因此可行的增长治理采取事后（ex-post）形式。该核心方法在标准持续学习基准上评估，治理式增长保持了沿长任务序列持续学习的能力；预注册实验以最大显著性报告失败，正反面结果共同构成贡献。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献不是单一方法的胜利，而是一张"正负完整的地图"：通过预注册实验程序判定了机制与价值主张在测试问题上的真实表现，并全面披露失败。作者强调这张正反面地图本身才是贡献所在，为终身学习治理提供了原则性的、可审计的、结构可生长的设计蓝图。

title: The Value of a Prompt: An LLM-Relative Kolmogorov-Complexity Approach
summary:
In a world where valuable artifacts are increasingly created, completed, or processed by LLMs, the central economic question is not only what the LLM can produce, but what \emph{value} remains in the inputs (i.e., the prompts) we provide to it. Given a prompt, hint, critique, problem statement, or partial solution that helps an LLM produce an artifact $z$---a proof, program, design, or scientific hypothesis---how should we measure the value of that input?
  Intuitively, an input is valuable when it makes the target artifact easier for the model to generate: either by increasing its sampling probability, or by reducing the thinking time needed to find it. We propose a computational Levin--Kolmogorov complexity approach to this problem, by appropriately replacing the universal Turing machine in the classical definitions by the LLM itself. Concretely, we introduce an LLM-relative notion of \emph{probabilistic Levin--Kolmogorov complexity} $pKt$---treating the model's thinking as the random tape of the program, and charging logarithmically for it in Levin's manner---and define prompt value as algorithmic mutual information with respect to $pKt$. This captures the intuition above: a prompt having $b$ bits of value for an artifact $z$ makes $z$ $2^b$ times ``easier to obtain'', by multiplying the success probability by $2^b$, by dividing the required computation by $2^b$, or by any corresponding tradeoff between probability and computation.
  In contrast to the classical notion of algorithmic mutual information, ours is efficiently estimable. We additionally show that, under a natural reproduction experiment, a prompt value of \(b\) bits means that reproducing \(z\) without the prompt has median token cost \(2^b\) times that of reproducing it with the prompt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LLM相对的主观概率Levin-Kolmogorov复杂度（pKt）的新框架，用于量化提示词（prompt）对LLM生成目标产物（如证明、程序、设计或科学假设）的价值。提示词的价值被定义为相对于pKt的算法互信息，其直觉是：一个具有b比特价值的提示词使目标产物变得2^b倍更容易获得。与经典的算法互信息不同，该指标可以高效估计。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地参与产生有价值的产物，核心经济问题不仅是LLM能产生什么，还包括我们提供给它的输入（提示词）中保留了什么价值。需要一种方法来衡量提示词、线索、批评、问题陈述或部分解对LLM生成目标产物的价值贡献。
AI.method: 提出LLM相对的概率Levin-Kolmogorov复杂度pKt，将经典定义中的通用图灵机替换为LLM本身，将模型的思考过程视为程序的随机带，并按照Levin的方式对其计算成本取对数。提示词价值定义为相对于pKt的算法互信息，同时支持概率与计算之间的权衡。
AI.result: 与经典算法互信息不同，该指标可以被高效估计。此外，在自然繁殖实验（reproduction experiment）下，具有b比特价值的提示词意味着在没有提示词的情况下重现目标产物的中位token成本是有提示词时的2^b倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为LLM时代输入价值的量化提供了理论基础，将信息论与计算复杂度框架扩展到LLM语境中，为提示词的经济价值评估提供了可计算的度量标准。

title: TRACE-CASH: Trial-History-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Configuration Exploration in Time-Series CASH
summary: Combined algorithm selection and hyperparameter optimization (CASH) searches a conditional space in which the selected model determines which hyperparameters are active. In time-series forecasting, temporal choices, chronological validation, and costly evaluations further complicate this search. Controlled comparisons of heterogeneous search methods under a shared time-series CASH (TS-CASH) evaluation protocol remain limited. Within this setting, we study TRACECASH, a task-local hybrid sequential optimizer combining grouped actor-critic candidate generation with fixed rules for model coverage, validation-guided exploitation, and exploration after stalled progress. A model actor proposes an initial forecasting model; three model-conditioned actors generate temporal, architectural, and training actions; and a modelspecific decoder constructs the configuration ultimately evaluated. We compare TRACE-CASH with six alternatives spanning random, Bayesian, evolutionary, multi-objective, and language-model-assisted search across 41 dataset-frequency task variants. TRACE-CASH has the lowest mean rank on both MASE and WQL. Descriptively, it also has the lowest window-averaged test-MASE rank in the predefined full and late windows. These results support the complete TRACECASH procedure as competitive among the evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究时间序列预测中的组合算法选择与超参数优化（TS-CASH）问题，提出TRACE-CASH——一种结合分组actor-critic候选生成与固定规则的混合顺序优化器，并在41个数据集-频率任务变体上与六种基线方法对比，TRACE-CASH在MASE和WQL指标上均取得最低平均排名。
AI.motivation: 在时间序列预测中，CASH问题搜索的是条件空间（所选模型决定哪些超参数活跃），且时间性选择、时序验证和昂贵评估使得搜索更加复杂。已有研究缺乏在统一时间序列CASH评估协议下的异构搜索方法受控比较，因此需要系统研究这一问题。
AI.method: TRACE-CASH是一种任务局部混合顺序优化器，包含三个核心组件：(1) 模型actor提出初始预测模型；(2) 三个模型条件actor分别生成时间、架构和训练动作；(3) 模型特定解码器构建最终配置。同时结合固定规则保证模型覆盖、验证引导的利用和停滞后的探索。
AI.result: 在41个数据集-频率任务变体上，TRACE-CASH与六种替代方法（随机、贝叶斯、进化、多目标和语言模型辅助搜索）进行对比，在MASE和WQL两个指标上均取得最低平均排名，并在预定义的完整窗口和后期窗口上具有最低的窗口平均测试MASE排名。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持TRACE-CASH作为一个完整的流程在所评估的方法中具有竞争力，表明结合actor-critic候选生成与固定规则的混合优化策略在时间序列CASH问题上有效。

title: Time to Reason: Scalable Neurosymbolic Learning for LTLf via Fuzzy Semantics
summary: Neurosymbolic (NeSy) Artificial Intelligence aims to integrate Deep Learning (DL) architectures with symbolic reasoning. While initial NeSy approaches have targeted mainly symbolic reasoning in propositional and first-order logics, recent works have started to address the construction of neurosymbolic frameworks for Temporal Logics, and in particular for LTLf. These approaches have established temporal NeSy as a promising research direction, laying the foundations for learning under temporal constraints. Nonetheless, they leave many questions unanswered. From a theoretical perspective, several differentiable semantics for interpreting LTLf have been proposed but have not yet been formally and systematically defined within a unified framework. Moreover, existing approaches commonly rely on automata to represent temporal knowledge, resulting in limited scalability. Motivated by this research gap, this paper provides the following contributions: (i) formally defining different fuzzy semantics for LTLf, and systematically analysing theoretical properties regarding equivalences and dualities of temporal operators; (ii) showing how these semantics can be directly integrated within a novel NeSy framework, called DiffLTLf, enabling flexible and scalable learning without relying on the usage of automata; and (iii) introducing a novel evaluation protocol of increased complexity of learning tasks w.r.t. existing benchmarks. Our results show that the choice of fuzzy semantics has a significant impact on predictive performance. Moreover, DiffLTLf achieves performance on par with, and sometimes superior to, state-of-the-art probabilistic approaches while substantially improving scalability. Taken together, these results establish direct fuzzy interpretations as a competitive and scalable alternative to existing temporal NeSy frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DiffLTLf，一个无需自动机、直接将LTLf的模糊语义集成到神经符号框架中的可扩展学习方法，并在理论上系统定义了多种模糊语义及其性质，实证表明其性能与最优概率方法相当甚至更优，且大幅提升可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有的时序神经符号框架虽将LTLf与深度学习结合，但存在两大问题：(1) 多种可微语义缺乏统一的形式化定义与理论分析；(2) 现有方法普遍依赖自动机表示时序知识，导致可扩展性受限。因此需要一种统一的理论框架和可扩展的免自动机方法。
AI.method: (i) 在统一框架下形式化定义LTLf的多种模糊语义，系统分析时序算子的等价性与对偶性等理论性质；(ii) 提出DiffLTLf神经符号框架，将模糊语义直接集成到深度学习中进行灵活可扩展的学习，无需依赖自动机；(iii) 设计比现有基准更复杂的评估协议与学习任务。
AI.result: 实验表明：模糊语义的选择对预测性能有显著影响；DiffLTLf在性能上与最先进的概率方法相当甚至更优，同时在可扩展性上大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 直接模糊解释（direct fuzzy interpretations）被证明是现有时序神经符号框架的一种有竞争力且可扩展的替代方案，为时序约束下的神经符号学习奠定了更坚实、更可扩展的基础。

title: Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models
summary: Automated machine learning (AutoML) systems search for pipelines within a space of preprocessing operators, learners, and hyper-parameters specified in advance: they can select and tune known components, but cannot produce structure outside that space. We present LACE, an AutoML framework that instead searches over complete executable pipeline programs: an evolutionary loop maintains a population of scikit-learn-compatible Python classes, and a large language model acts as the variation operator. To our knowledge, LACE is the first to formulate general tabular pipeline AutoML this way, evaluated on standardized OpenML tasks under a leakage-controlled protocol that withholds dataset identity from the generator. Because every candidate is ordinary Python, the returned pipeline and the search that produced it can be inspected and edited directly, rather than only through a framework's model objects. On 68 OpenML classification tasks, LACE with GPT-5.4-mini significantly outperforms auto-sklearn, H2O, and a fixed XGBoost baseline, with no detectable difference against AutoGluon, the strongest search-based system evaluated, while covering the full benchmark. Newer tabular foundation models are more accurate on the subset of tasks they support, but apply a fixed pretrained predictor rather than returning an editable task-specific program. LACE's contribution is therefore not raw accuracy but a search space defined by code: complete coverage, pipelines practitioners can reuse directly, and a component set extended by editing the prompt rather than the framework.

AI.tldr: LACE 是一个新型 AutoML 框架，通过大型语言模型作为变异算子，在演化循环中搜索完整的可执行 Python 程序（scikit-learn 兼容类），而非预定义的流水线空间。在 68 个 OpenML 分类任务上，LACE 显著优于 auto-sklearn、H2O 和 XGBoost 基线，与 AutoGluon 相当，且返回的流水线可直接检查和编辑。
AI.motivation: 传统 AutoML 系统只能在预先指定的预处理算子、学习器和超参数空间内搜索，无法产生该空间之外的新结构。作者希望突破这一限制，让 AutoML 能够搜索完整的可执行程序，从而覆盖更广泛的流水线结构并生成可复用、可编辑的代码。
AI.method: LACE 采用演化循环：维护一个 scikit-learn 兼容的 Python 类种群，使用大规模语言模型（GPT-5.4-mini）作为变异算子生成新的候选。搜索过程在泄漏控制的协议下进行，向生成器隐瞒数据集身份。每个候选都是普通 Python 代码，因此可直接检查和编辑。
AI.result: 在 68 个 OpenML 分类任务上，LACE 显著优于 auto-sklearn、H2O 和固定 XGBoost 基线，与 AutoGluon（评估中最强的基于搜索的系统）无显著差异，并覆盖了整个基准。较新的表格基础模型虽在支持的任务子集上更准确，但使用固定的预训练预测器而非返回可编辑的任务特定程序。
AI.conclusion: LACE 的贡献不在于原始准确率，而在于以代码定义的搜索空间：提供完整的基准覆盖、可直接复用的流水线，以及通过编辑提示词而非修改框架来扩展组件集的能力。

title: HaReCAP: Habitual-action Grounding for Recursive Large Language Model Agents
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures
summary: Long-horizon embodied tasks require LLM agents to iteratively decompose high-level goals, revise plans in response to environmental feedback, and ground leaf-level subgoals into valid executable actions. Recursive context-management methods such as ReCAP improve planning stability through multi-level task decomposition and parent-node refinement, but still repeatedly invoke the LLM at leaf nodes to ground atomic subtasks into exact valid actions. We refer to this final grounding step as last-mile grounding redundancy, which accumulates into substantial LLM-call and token overhead during long-horizon execution. To mitigate this issue, we propose HaReCAP (Habitual-action Grounded ReCAP), a low-intrusion leaf grounding extension for ReCAP. HaReCAP extracts frequent leaf decisions from successful trajectories and compiles them offline into auditable and abstainable one-step leaf-reflex rules. At runtime, it skips the leaf LLM call only when a rule can uniquely determine a legal action in the current valid-action set; otherwise, it falls back to the original ReCAP. This design avoids repeatedly carrying the full recursive context into the LLM for routine leaf action grounding, while preserving the original recursive control flow. We evaluate HaReCAP on Robotouille and ALFWorld with Qwen3.5-27B as the main model. On tasks solved by both ReCAP and HaReCAP, HaReCAP reduces token consumption by 14.67%, 17.93%, and 20.08% on Robotouille synchronous, Robotouille asynchronous, and ALFWorld, respectively. The results show that HaReCAP can serve as a low-intrusion extension to ReCAP-style recursive context-management frameworks, reducing last-mile grounding redundancy across environments and models on commonly successful trajectories.

AI.tldr: HaReCAP是ReCAP的低侵入性扩展，通过离线编译可审计、可弃权的"一步叶反射规则"，在运行时跳过常规叶节点LLM调用，减少长时程具身任务中"最后一英里落地冗余"，在Robotouille和ALFWorld上分别降低14.67%-20.08%的token消耗。
AI.motivation: 长时程具身任务中，LLM代理需要在叶节点反复调用LLM将原子子目标落地为有效动作，这种"最后一英里落地冗余"在长期执行中累积为大量LLM调用和token开销，即使ReCAP等递归上下文管理方法已优化了规划稳定性，仍无法避免这一开销。
