AI.method: HaReCAP从成功轨迹中提取频发的叶级决策，离线编译为可审计且可弃权的一步叶反射规则。运行时仅当规则能唯一确定当前有效动作集中的合法动作时跳过叶LLM调用，否则回退到原始ReCAP流程，保留原有递归控制流。
AI.result: 在Robotouille同步、Robotouille异步和ALFWorld上，对ReCAP和HaReCAP均能解决的任务，token消耗分别降低14.67%、17.93%和20.08%，主模型为Qwen3.5-27B。
AI.conclusion: HaReCAP可作为ReCAP风格递归上下文管理框架的低侵入性扩展，在常见的成功轨迹上跨环境和模型减少最后一英里落地冗余，同时保持原有递归控制流的安全性。

title: PertMind: Eliciting Emergent Biological Reasoning in LLM via Reinforcement Learning on Cellular Perturbation Data
comment: Project page: https://shapsider.github.io/PertMind/ Code: https://github.com/shapsider/PertMind Model: https://huggingface.co/tzcfly/PertMind
summary: Large language models can describe mechanisms, yet scalable post-training still depends on costly, manually curated biological reasoning traces. Here we show that cellular perturbation atlases can instead become reinforcement-learning environments, where measured gene responses provide computable rewards for biological reasoning. We introduce PertMind, which combines trusted-trajectory supervised initialization with gene-, pathway-, and format-level reinforcement signals. Trained only on forward perturbation-response prediction, PertMind improved response inference in unseen cellular contexts while retaining general language capabilities. It also transferred without task-specific post-training to reverse perturbation identification, double-perturbation reasoning, phenotypic-screen prioritization, and biological-process interpretation. PertMind further generated biological profiles that supported competitive gene, cell, and donor representations across multiscale downstream tasks. These results support the hypothesis that reinforcement on experimental endpoints can concentrate reusable biological strategies already accessible to pretrained models. More broadly, perturbation-derived reinforcement learning offers a scalable route for transforming expanding experimental atlases into training environments for general-purpose biological reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PertMind框架，将细胞扰动图谱转化为强化学习环境，利用测量到的基因响应作为可计算奖励来训练大语言模型的生物推理能力，在无需任务特定微调的情况下迁移到多种下游生物任务。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽能描述生物机制，但其后训练依赖昂贵且人工整理的生物推理轨迹。论文旨在寻找一种可扩展的替代方案，利用已有的实验数据（细胞扰动图谱）作为训练信号，避免对人工标注推理链的依赖。
AI.method: PertMind结合两个关键组件：(1) 信任轨迹监督初始化（trusted-trajectory supervised initialization）；(2) 基因层面、通路层面和格式层面的多层次强化学习信号。模型仅在正向扰动-响应预测任务上训练。
AI.result: PertMind在未见细胞情境下提升了响应推断能力，同时保持通用语言能力；无需任务特定后训练即可迁移到逆向扰动识别、双重扰动推理、表型筛选优先级排序和生物过程解释等任务；生成的生物特征支持跨多尺度下游任务的基因、细胞和供体表征。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在实验终点上施加强化学习可以集中利用预训练模型中已有的可复用生物策略。基于扰动的强化学习为将迅速扩大的实验图谱转化为通用生物推理训练环境提供了可扩展途径。

title: JailbreakSkill: Scaling Automated Red-Teaming with Reusable and Ever-Evolving Skills
summary: Automated red-teaming has produced a growing collection of attack strategies, yet they typically remain scattered across prompts and workflows, making them difficult to systematically integrate, reuse, and improve at scale. We introduce \textsc{JailbreakSkill}, a skill-centric framework for scaling automated red-teaming through reusable and continuously evolving attack capabilities. \textsc{JailbreakSkill} packages existing attack strategies into modular, agent-ready skills that can be directly reused and adaptively selected across tasks and target models. Beyond reuse, it closes the loop between attacking and learning: attack experience is used to diagnose, refine, combine, and discover new skills, which are added back to an ever-growing skill library. This evolution lifts macro-average ASR by 17.5 percentage points on AdvBench and 13.4 points on HarmBench, including a 48.6-point gain against GPT-5.4 on AdvBench, while yielding novel attack strategies such as reframing a direct request as an unfinished document-completion task. Several evolved skills also generalize to unseen prompts and target models without further adaptation. Our code is available at https://github.com/BattleWen/JailbreakSkill.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JailbreakSkill，一个以技能为中心的框架，将零散的自动化红队攻击策略打包为模块化、可复用的技能，并通过"攻击-学习"闭环不断演化技能库，在AdvBench和HarmBench上分别将宏平均ASR提升17.5和13.4个百分点，且演化出的技能可泛化到未见过的提示和目标模型。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化红队攻击策略分散在各种提示词和工作流中，难以系统性地整合、复用和大规模改进，缺乏统一的技能管理和演化机制。
AI.method: 提出JailbreakSkill框架：（1）将现有攻击策略封装为模块化、智能体可直接复用和自适应选择的技能；（2）建立攻击与学习之间的闭环，利用攻击经验诊断、改进、组合和发现新技能；（3）将演化出的技能持续加入不断增长的技能库。
AI.result: 在AdvBench上宏平均ASR提升17.5个百分点，在HarmBench上提升13.4个百分点，其中对GPT-5.4在AdvBench上获得48.6个百分点的增益；同时发现了新颖攻击策略（如将直接请求重构为未完成的文档完成任务），且多个演化技能无需额外适配即可泛化到未见提示和目标模型。
AI.conclusion: 技能中心化的红队攻击框架能够实现攻击能力的系统性积累、复用与演化，显著提升攻击成功率并产生可泛化的攻击策略，为大规模自动化红队提供了一种可扩展的范式。代码已开源。

title: Localized TabICLv2: Scaling Tabular In-Context Learning through k-NN
comment: Accepted at the 2nd ICML Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data (FMSD), ICML 2026
summary: Foundational models for tabular data have made significant progress in recent years, with TabICLv2 reporting state-of-the-art performance on several tabular classification tasks. However, full-context tabular ICL still suffers from attention cost that grows with the training-context size, which limits its ability to handle large datasets efficiently. Localized TabICLv2 introduces a method that reduces the inference cost of TabICLv2 by retrieving only the k nearest training neighbours for each test point, measured by similarity in the model's Stage 2 row-representation space, rather than using the full training context. This requires no architectural changes, and we show that accuracy retention can be improved through additional Stage 2 and Stage 3 fine-tuning. On TabArena classification tasks, the fine-tuned localized model retains 98.64% of Full TabICLv2 accuracy and it achieves a median 2.18$\times$ speedup in batch inference, and reaches approximately 249$\times$ median speedup in the single-query serving setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Localized TabICLv2方法，通过仅检索每个测试点的k个最近训练邻居（基于模型Stage 2行表示空间的相似性）来替代全上下文训练集，从而降低TabICLv2的注意力计算成本。该方法无需架构改动，通过额外的Stage 2和Stage 3微调可提升精度保持率，在TabArena分类任务上保留了Full TabICLv2的98.64%精度，批推理中位数加速2.18倍，单查询服务场景下中位数加速约249倍。
AI.motivation: 全上下文表格数据上下文学习（ICL）的注意力成本随训练上下文规模增长，限制了其在大数据集上的高效处理能力。
AI.method: 提出Localized TabICLv2，为每个测试点从Stage 2行表示空间中检索k个最近训练邻居作为上下文，而非使用全部训练数据；辅以Stage 2和Stage 3的额外微调来改善精度保持，且无需修改模型架构。
AI.result: 在TabArena分类任务上，微调后的局部模型保留了Full TabICLv2的98.64%精度，批推理中位数加速2.18倍，单查询服务场景中位数加速约249倍。
AI.conclusion: 局部化检索策略能够在显著降低推理成本的同时保持高精度，为表格数据基础模型在大规模数据集上的高效推理提供了可行方案。

title: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Hemodynamic Management of Sepsis in the ICU: a MIMIC-IV Study with Dual Off-Policy Evaluation
summary: The dosing of intravenous fluids and vasopressors in sepsis is a sequential decision made under uncertainty and guided largely by clinical judgment, which makes it a natural target for reinforcement learning from historical care. Because a learned policy cannot be trialed on patients, its value must be estimated off-policy, and such estimates can be fragile and optimistic. This work advances the reliable evaluation of sepsis treatment policies by combining off-policy estimation, reliability diagnostics, and clinician-agreement analyses in a transparent validation framework. We modeled fluid and vasopressor dosing on a cohort of 36,872 septic ICU stays drawn from the MIMIC-IV critical-care database, as a discretized Markov decision process with 1,000 states and 25 actions, defined by a five-by-five grid of fluid and vasopressor levels and solved by policy iteration. The clinicians' behavior policy was estimated with a random forest, which mitigated the collapse of the Effective Sample Size (ESS 50.1 against 4.0 with smoothed counts) that otherwise destabilizes the importance-sampling estimate. The learned policy was evaluated with two estimators, weighted importance sampling (WIS) and fitted Q evaluation (FQE), with the ESS and clinician agreement as reliability checks. An empirical variable selection found that the composition of the state matters more than its size. Both estimators place the learned policy above the clinicians' return (WIS 50.8 and FQE 46.8 against 38.2, ESS 50.1), yet it departs only modestly from observed practice (total variation 0.18), favoring less intravenous fluid. These retrospective single-center off-policy results support the learned policy as a clinically plausible refinement of observed practice and motivate its further evaluation as a discordance-based clinical decision-support approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个透明的验证框架，将离策略估计、可靠性诊断（ESS、总变差）和临床一致性分析相结合，用于评估脓毒症治疗策略。研究基于MIMIC-IV数据库中36,872例脓毒症ICU住院记录，将液体和血管加压药给药建模为1,000状态、25动作的马尔可夫决策过程，采用策略迭代求解。学习策略经WIS和FQE两种估计器评估均优于临床医师回报（WIS 50.8、FQE 46.8 vs 38.2），但与实际临床实践偏离适中（TV 0.18），倾向减少静脉输液，支持其作为临床可行的实践优化方案。
AI.motivation: 脓毒症中静脉输液和血管加压药的给药是需要在不确定性下做序贯决策的过程，主要依赖临床判断，因此成为从历史护理数据中应用强化学习的自然目标。然而，学习得到的策略无法在患者身上进行试验，必须通过离策略估计其价值，而这类估计可能脆弱且过于乐观。因此需要一个可靠、透明的评估框架来确保策略评估的可信度。
AI.method: 作者结合离策略估计、可靠性诊断和临床一致性分析构建验证框架。具体方法包括：(1) 从MIMIC-IV中提取36,872例脓毒症ICU住院作为队列；(2) 将液体和血管加压药剂量离散化为5×5网格，构成含1,000状态、25动作的马尔可夫决策过程，用策略迭代求解；(3) 使用随机森林估计临床医师行为策略，以缓解有效样本量（ESS）崩溃问题；(4) 用加权重要性采样（WIS）和拟合Q评估（FQE）两种估计器评估学习策略，并以ESS和临床一致性作为可靠性检验；(5) 进行经验变量选择，考察状态组成与规模的影响。
AI.result: 随机森林估计行为策略使ESS从4.0提升至50.1，显著缓解了重要性采样估计的不稳定。经验变量选择表明状态组成比状态规模更重要。两种估计器均表明学习策略回报高于临床实践（WIS 50.8、FQE 46.8 vs 临床38.2），而策略与观察实践的偏离适中（总变差0.18），主要倾向于减少静脉输液。
AI.conclusion: 这些基于回顾性单中心的离策略结果支持学习策略作为对观察临床实践的合理细化，并推动其作为基于不一致性的临床决策支持方法进行进一步评估。研究为脓毒症治疗策略的可靠评估提供了一个可复制的透明框架。

title: Reference-free logged energy-oracle recovery for neural approximations of symmetric coercive variational problems: conforming Riesz reconstruction and archive-level selection
comment: 35 pages, 7 figures
summary: Neural PDE training yields a finite checkpoint archive, yet its logged energy errors are inaccessible without the exact solution, while loss-based selection does not necessarily recover the logged energy oracle. For admissible neural approximations of symmetric coercive variational problems, we introduce a reference-free selection rule based on minimizing a computable conforming Riesz monitor. The exact residual-energy identity and conforming projection make the monitor an unconditional lower bound converging monotonically to each logged energy error under nested conforming refinement; under saturation, hierarchical enrichment yields a computable upper estimate and hence a lower-upper bracket. A key finding is that archive selection is order-sensitive: unresolved checkpoint-dependent components can reverse the oracle-non-oracle ranking at finite resolution, so checkpointwise recovery alone is insufficient. For finite archives, we prove uniform recovery, yielding convergence to the logged-oracle error and, without saturation, logged-oracle selection at sufficiently fine auxiliary resolution. Under saturation, the bracket gives a computable near-oracle bound and certifies unique logged-oracle selection upon interval separation. We also bound logging-resolution loss and certify oracle inclusion over prescribed comparison trajectories. The resulting criterion replaces inaccessible exact-error minimization by computable, training-independent post-training selection on the intrinsic energy-error scale, requiring only the computed candidates and the variational problem. Experiments on diffusion and elasticity, including a non-manufactured perforated plate, demonstrate energy-scale calibration, oracle-level selection, and modest post-processing cost.

AI.tldr: 本文针对神经偏微分方程训练产生的有限checkpoint档案，提出一种无需参考解（reference-free）的模型选择准则：通过最小化一个可计算的共形Riesz监控量来选择最优checkpoint，该监控量是每个checkpoint对数能量误差的无条件下界，并在嵌套共形细化下单调收敛；在饱和条件下，通过分层富集可获得可计算的上界估计，从而形成上下界区间。
AI.motivation: 神经PDE训练会生成有限checkpoint档案，但其记录的能量误差在没有精确解的情况下无法获取，而基于损失函数的选择并不能恢复记录的能量oracle。这导致现有模型选择方法在无精确解场景下不可靠，需要一种无需参考解的选择准则。
AI.method: 针对对称强制变分问题的可容许神经逼近，提出最小化可计算共形Riesz监控量的选择准则。利用精确残差-能量恒等式和共形投影，使监控量成为每个对数能量误差的无条件下界，并在嵌套共形细化下单调收敛；在饱和条件下通过分层富集构造可计算上界，形成下上界括号。对有限档案证明均匀恢复，实现对对数oracle误差的收敛，并在足够细的辅助分辨率下（无饱和时）实现对对数oracle的选择。
AI.result: 实验在扩散问题和弹性问题（包括非制造的穿孔板）上验证了能量尺度校准、oracle级选择以及适度的后处理成本。关键发现是档案选择具有顺序敏感性：未解析的checkpoint依赖分量可以在有限分辨率下反转oracle-非oracle排序，因此仅靠逐checkpoint恢复是不够的。
AI.conclusion: 该准则将不可访问的精确误差最小化替换为可计算的、与训练无关的训练后选择，在内在能量误差尺度上进行，仅需要计算候选解和变分问题本身，避免了依赖精确解或损失函数作为代理的局限。

title: Large language models as synthetic clinical experts to inform longitudinal rare-disease modeling
summary: Due to the limited amount of information, modeling longitudinal rare-disease data can benefit from integrating clinical knowledge. Yet, elicitation of expert knowledge and formalization for model fitting is challenging, in particular due to limited time of clinical experts. To nevertheless make domain knowledge accessible during model fitting, we use large language models (LLMs) as synthetic clinical experts to supervise a variational-autoencoder-based approach that learns low-dimensional latent summaries of visit-level observations. Specifically, LLMs are queried offline on textual descriptions of patient observations to obtain judgments, e.g., the suspected clinical category. To improve the variational autoencoder fit, we train a differentiable surrogate model on these judgments and augment the loss function to encourage reconstructions that preserve the clinical-label distribution of their corresponding input profile. In an application to longitudinal motor-function assessments from children with spinal muscular atrophy, we map visit-level clinical profiles to low-dimensional representations that are linked by a multivariate mixed-effects model. The synthetic expert loss discourages reconstructions that remain numerically close in data space but alter the clinical interpretation of the reconstructed motor function profile, such as by crossing a disease-type boundary. We thus reduced disagreement between original and reconstructed SMA type labels from about 11 to 7 percent. Furthermore, informing the latent representation by the synthetic expert improved prediction of motor function milestones compared with unsupervised latent representations and a data-level baseline. These results suggest that incorporating LLMs into model fitting can make clinical knowledge available to representation learning and improve clinical faithfulness for longitudinal rare-disease data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLMs）作为合成临床专家，通过可微代理模型将临床知识注入变分自编码器（VAE）的训练中，用于纵向罕见病数据的表示学习。在脊髓性肌萎缩症（SMA）运动功能数据上，该方法将重建数据与原始数据在疾病类型标签上的不一致率从约11%降至7%，并提升了运动功能里程碑预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 纵向罕见病数据因信息量有限，建模时受益于整合临床知识。然而，直接从临床专家获取知识并进行形式化建模具有挑战性，尤其是临床专家时间有限。因此需要一种在不依赖专家频繁参与的情况下，将领域知识纳入模型拟合过程的方法。
AI.method: 1) 离线查询LLM，对患者观测的文本描述进行判断（如疑似临床类别）；2) 在这些判断上训练一个可微代理模型；3) 用代理模型增强VAE的损失函数，鼓励重建保留输入档案对应的临床标签分布；4) 将访问级临床档案映射到低维表示，再由多元混合效应模型关联。
AI.result: 合成专家损失减少了重建结果中改变临床解释（如跨越疾病类型边界）的情况，将原始与重建SMA类型标签的不一致率从约11%降至7%；同时，相比无监督潜在表示和数据级基线，合成专家信息的引入改善了运动功能里程碑的预测。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM整合进模型拟合过程，可以使临床知识对表示学习可利用，提高纵向罕见病数据的临床忠实度。这为罕见病研究中资源受限情况下的知识注入提供了一条可行路径。

title: Pallas: A Proactive KV Cache Migration Framework for LLM Inference in AI-RAN
summary:
AI-RAN brings large language model (LLM) serving close to mobile users, but cellular handover can separate an active request from its inference state: the user attaches to a target base station (gNB) while the large and growing key-value (KV) cache remains at the source. Retaining inference at the source preserves service continuity but persistently increases inter-token latency (ITL), whereas recovering the state at the target restores serving locality but requires KV-cache transfer, recomputation, or a combination of both only after handover, directly prolonging service interruption time (SIT).
  This work presents Pallas, a \textit{proactive} KV-cache migration framework that prepares the inference state at the predicted target before handover, in parallel with ongoing source-side inference and token delivery. At the preparation trigger, Pallas partitions the token sequence into a stable historical prefix and an evolving suffix. The target reconstructs the prefix through local prefill, while the source streams the KV blocks generated for the suffix. At handover, the target assembles both portions into an up-to-date KV cache and resumes decoding locally, leaving only unfinished preparation to contribute to SIT. An online scheduler selects the \textit{prefetching window}, which determines how early preparation begins before handover, based on mobility predictions and runtime telemetry. Across three LLMs and $100$--$500~\mathrm{Mbps}$ inter-gNB links, our vLLM-based prototype reduces average SIT by factors of $2.28$--$89.68$ over target-side recovery approaches and lowers average ITL by $16.0\%$--$50.0\%$ compared with source-side forwarding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pallas，一种主动式KV缓存迁移框架，在小区切换发生前预测目标基站并提前准备推理状态，通过将token序列分为历史前缀和演进后缀，目标端本地prefill重建前缀，源端流式传输后缀KV块，在切换时组装为最新KV缓存，从而同时降低服务中断时间（SIT）和跨token延迟（ITL）。
AI.motivation: AI-RAN将LLM服务部署在移动边缘，但蜂窝切换会使活跃请求与推理状态分离——用户连接到目标基站而KV缓存仍留在源端。源端继续推理会增加ITL，目标端恢复状态则需KV缓存传输或重计算，延长SIT。现有方法均为切换后处理，无法同时兼顾服务连续性和服务局部性。
AI.method: Pallas采用主动式KV缓存迁移：1）在预测的切换触发点，将token序列分为稳定的历史前缀和演进的当前后缀；2）目标基站通过本地prefill重建前缀部分，源端并行流式传输后缀生成的KV块；3）切换时目标端组装两部分形成最新KV缓存并恢复本地解码，仅未完成的准备工作贡献SIT；4）在线调度器基于移动性预测和运行时遥测选择预取窗口（prefetching window）以确定提前量。
AI.result: 在三个LLM模型和100-500Mbps链路带宽下，基于vLLM的原型相比目标端恢复方案将平均SIT降低2.28-89.68倍，相比源端转发方案将平均ITL降低16.0%-50.0%。
AI.conclusion: Pallas通过主动预迁移策略有效解决了AI-RAN场景中蜂窝切换导致的KV缓存放置问题，实现了SIT和ITL的双重优化，为移动边缘LLM服务的无缝切换提供了可行方案。

title: DeepInsight II: One Trace from Benchmark to Robot
summary: Across a Physical AI stack, evaluation maturity is inversely aligned with deployment risk: foundation models enjoy mature, standardized harnesses, while the embodied layers on which deployment actually turns remain fragmented across benchmark-specific simulators, embodiments, and interfaces. The first DeepInsight report (v1) unified evaluation across this stack behind three abstractions---task, resource, and result---but its quantitative evidence centered on the foundation-model layer; navigation and manipulation (System 1) and whole-body control (System 0) remained simulation case studies, and physical execution was outside its empirical scope. DeepInsight II keeps that substrate fixed and quantifies the embodied half. First, it reproduces released-checkpoint references across two navigation and four manipulation benchmarks under their native protocols. Second, MotionBench places four released whole-body controllers under one workload and metric contract, then carries a qualified within-family cohort from parallel simulation to matched real-robot trials in which simulated and physical rollouts share a parent trace identity while retaining execution-domain-specific records, making the sim-to-real gap a native reduction rather than a reconciliation across toolchains. Third, a composed System 2--1--0 study extends trace localization into five evidence-grounded handoff labels, each mapped to a concrete repair action, with a measured repairability criterion and physical episodes testing the same attribution under hardware-observable state. The contribution is therefore not a new evaluation architecture, but empirical continuity from benchmark execution to matched robot evidence and repair-oriented diagnosis.

AI.tldr: DeepInsight II延续首版报告的统一评估框架，将实证范围从基础模型层扩展到具身层（System 1导航/操作、System 0全身控制），通过复现发布检查点、统一全身控制基准（MotionBench）、以及System 2-1-0组合研究，实现从仿真到实体机器人的证据连续性与可修复性诊断。
AI.motivation: 物理AI栈中评估成熟度与部署风险呈反向关系：基础模型层已有成熟的标准化评估工具，而真正决定部署的具身层仍受限于碎片化的仿真器、实体与接口。DeepInsight v1虽统一了评估抽象（task、resource、result），但其定量证据集中在基础模型层，导航/操作与全身控制仍停留在仿真案例，物理执行不在实证范围内。
AI.method: 保持DeepInsight v1的底层框架不变，聚焦量化具身层：1）在原生协议下复现四个导航和两个操作基准的已发布检查点参考；2）提出MotionBench，将四个发布的全身控制器置于统一工作负载与指标契约下，并将在域内队列从并行仿真扩展至匹配的真实机器人试验，使仿真与实体rollout共享父轨迹身份但保留各执行域专属记录，从而使sim-to-real差距成为原生还原而非跨工具链的对齐；3）组合System 2-1-0研究，将轨迹定位扩展为五种基于证据的交接标签，每种映射到具体修复动作，并设置可测量的可修复性判据与物理测试。
AI.result: 贡献不在于提出新的评估架构，而在于实现从基准执行到匹配机器人证据再到修复导向诊断的实证连续性，量化了具身层评估缺口并验证了sim-to-real差距的原生还原方法。
AI.conclusion: DeepInsight II通过对具身层的系统化实证，弥合了物理AI评估中基础模型层与部署实际依赖的具身层之间的成熟度断层，确立了从统一基准到真实机器人验证的诊断闭环。

title: CUBICS: Situation-aware performance estimation for safety-relevant ML components
comment: To be published in the proceedings for the 37th International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE 2026)
summary: Machine learning (ML) is a key technology driving innovation today, but ensuring ML safety remains a major challenge for safety-related applications. A promising idea is to build proven-in-use arguments from field data, e.g. by running ML components (MLCs) in shadow mode or within safety envelopes so that their outputs can be monitored as 'safe probes' without affecting safety. These probes can then be used to build a statistical argument about field performance in a Bayesian way. However, many Bayesian field-data approaches in safety engineering model failures as a simple Bernoulli (or binomial) process with a single global failure probability and i.i.d. trials, which is rarely adequate for MLCs whose performance depends strongly on context. Statistical evidence is also about coverage of relevant situations, including edge cases, and building a single integrated statistical model for the entire system is usually not feasible. To address these challenges, this paper introduces CUBICS, a context-modular framework for per-component, situation-aware performance estimation of safety-relevant ML components. CUBICS partitions the operational design domain into situations and, for each safety-relevant component, defines a set of situation-specific assumptions and probabilistic guarantees that are represented and updated in a Bayesian manner using Subjective Logic (SL). By combining these guarantees with beliefs about how often each situation occurs, CUBICS derives an overall risk estimate for each component without requiring a monolithic system-level statistical model, and thus provides a building block for modular, field-data based safety assurance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CUBICS框架，一种面向安全相关机器学习组件的上下文模块化性能估计方法，通过将运行设计域划分为情境、利用主观逻辑以贝叶斯方式更新各组件的情境特定概率保证，并由情境发生频率综合推导整体风险估计，从而摆脱对单一全局统计模型的依赖。
AI.motivation: 传统的贝叶斯现场数据方法通常将ML组件故障建模为具有单一全局故障概率和i.i.d.试验的简单伯努利过程，这不足以捕捉ML组件对上下文的强烈依赖性。此外，构建覆盖所有相关情境（包括边缘情况）的单一集成统计模型通常不现实，因此需要模块化、情境感知的安全论证方法。
AI.method: CUBICS框架：(1) 将运行设计域（ODD）划分为多个情境；(2) 对每个安全相关ML组件，定义一组情境特定的假设和概率保证；(3) 使用主观逻辑（Subjective Logic）以贝叶斯方式表示和更新这些保证；(4) 将各情境的保证与各情境发生频率的信念结合，推导每个组件的总体风险估计，无需构建系统级单一统计模型。
AI.result: CUBICS提供了一种模块化的、基于现场数据的组件级安全论证构建模块，能够实现情境感知的性能估计，并通过组合情境保证与出现频率来实现总体风险评估，避免了整体系统级统计建模的需要。
AI.conclusion: CUBICS为基于现场数据的安全保障提供了一种模块化构建模块，通过情境划分和主观逻辑的贝叶斯更新，实现了对安全相关ML组件的情境感知性能估计和风险评估，克服了传统单一全局统计模型的局限性。

title: When Tool-Backed Skill Retrieval Fails: Source-Style Collapse in Executable Capability Retrieval
summary: Large-scale agents increasingly rely on retrieval to access external capabilities. We study this retrieval gate in structured tools and APIs, a measurable class of tool-backed executable skills that must be surfaced before an agent can plan, incorporate, or act. In this setting the retrieval layer can silently fail even when the capability corpus is fixed: on ToolRet, a retriever fine-tuned on one source-specific slice collapses on another source-specific slice of the same benchmark, with FT-1100 despite its higher lexical overlap with the gold tools. We call this failure mode source-style collapse. Query-side TF-IDF fingerprints flag source styles on which the fine-tuned retriever is likely to fail better than semantic or length-based proxies, giving a cheap signal for mismatch over a fixed tool corpus. We propose ToolScout, a source-aware routing method that uses this signal as a routing guard: on the mixed 4,996-query stream, TF-IDF-based routing raises coverage from 22.3% to 86.1%, and across five collapsed sources 20 matched examples raise the coverage-weighted global top-1 proxy from 1.3% to 53.9%. The same failure and routing behaviors persist when tools are rerendered as executable skill cards, which rules out raw API-schema format as the sole cause.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大规模智能体在检索结构化工具和API时面临的"源风格崩塌"问题：即使工具语料库固定，针对某一数据源微调的检索器在其他数据源上会性能骤降。作者提出基于TF-IDF指纹的源感知路由方法ToolScout，通过检测查询风格与训练源不匹配来引导路由，在混合查询流中将覆盖率从22.3%提升到86.1%，并在五个崩塌源上显著提升全局top-1检索性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模智能体依赖检索访问外部工具能力，但现有检索层在跨数据源场景下会无声失败——即使工具语料固定，微调检索器在未见过的源风格上会崩溃。这种失败难以察觉，且缺乏廉价的检测信号，因此需要理解失败机制并提出有效的路由解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 识别"源风格崩塌"现象：对ToolRet基准中一个源切片微调的检索器在另一个源切片上崩溃；2) 提出查询侧TF-IDF指纹作为检测信号，优于语义或长度代理指标；3) 设计ToolScout源感知路由方法，利用TF-IDF信号作为路由守卫，在混合查询流中引导查询到合适的检索器；4) 通过将工具重渲染为可执行技能卡来排除原始API schema格式作为唯一原因。
AI.result: ToolScout在混合4,996查询流上将覆盖率从22.3%提升至86.1%；在五个崩塌源上，仅用20个匹配示例即将覆盖加权全局top-1代理指标从1.3%提升至53.9%。此外，将工具重渲染为可执行技能卡后，该失败和路由行为仍然存在，证明问题不单纯由API schema格式引起。
AI.conclusion: 检索层的源风格崩塌是工具检索中的实质性失败模式，TF-IDF指纹提供了廉价有效的检测信号，源感知路由（ToolScout）能显著改善跨源场景下的检索覆盖率和准确性。该问题本质上是风格层面的，而非仅由API格式引起。

title: Probabilistic Circuits as Reasoning Machines in Artificial Intelligence (Part I)
comment: Habilitation Thesis
summary:
This cumulative habilitation thesis studies probabilistic circuits (PCs) as a powerful and tractable framework for reasoning and learning under uncertainty in artificial intelligence (AI). It first advocates for probability as a core language for AI, emphasizing its connections to logic and information theory; the conceptual simplicity of probabilistic reasoning---based primarily on the sum and product rules; the parallels between probabilistic inference and human cognition; and the role of probability in optimal decision making. However, probability also faces significant computational challenges, as probabilistic inference is NP-hard in almost all probabilistic models. PCs address these challenges through structural constraints that ensure exact computation of a wide range of inference queries in polynomial time, such as marginals, conditionals, most probable explanations, expectations, and more advanced inference tasks. This thesis synthesizes a decade of research across foundations, algorithmic developments, and empirical validation of PCs. Key contributions highlighted in this work are foundational theory of PCs, Bayesian approaches for learning PCs, scalable implementations and integration with deep learning, hybrid models that combine PCs with intractable models, and connections with symbolic machine learning paradigms.
  This is the first part of my Habilitation Thesis. The second part is omitted, as it comprises the cumulative part of the thesis and has been published at various venues (see Chapter 5).

AI.tldr: 本文是作者教授资格论文（Habilitation Thesis）的第一部分，系统研究了概率电路（Probabilistic Circuits, PCs）作为AI中不确定性推理与学习的可处理（tractable）框架。论文主张概率是AI的核心语言，同时指出概率推理在计算上具有NP-hard挑战，而PCs通过结构约束实现多项式时间内精确计算多种推理查询。论文综合了十年研究，涵盖PCs的基础理论、贝叶斯学习、可扩展实现与深度学习集成、混合模型及与符号机器学习范式的联系。
AI.motivation: 概率推理在几乎所有概率模型中都是NP-hard的，这严重制约了不确定性推理在实际AI系统中的应用。尽管概率论在概念上是AI的核心语言（与逻辑、信息论、认知科学和最优决策紧密相关），但其计算复杂性阻碍了大规模应用。因此需要一种既能保持概率推理的表达能力，又能保证计算可处理性的框架。
AI.method: 使用概率电路（PCs）作为核心框架，通过结构约束（structural constraints）确保在多项式时间内精确计算各类推理查询（边缘概率、条件概率、最可能解释、期望等）。论文综合贡献包括：PCs的基础理论、PCs的贝叶斯学习方法、可扩展实现及与深度学习的集成、PCs与不可处理模型的混合模型，以及与符号机器学习范式的连接。
AI.result: 通过十年的研究积累，建立了PCs作为可处理概率推理框架的理论基础与算法体系，在多个维度上推进了该领域：从理论奠基到贝叶斯学习，从可扩展实现到深度学习集成，再到混合模型和符号机器学习交叉，形成了较为完整的PCs研究体系。
AI.conclusion: 概率电路为AI中的不确定性推理提供了一种兼顾表达力与计算可处理性的解决方案。论文通过理论、算法和实证三方面的系统研究，确立了PCs在概率AI中的重要地位，并为未来研究（如与深度学习、符号方法的更深层融合）奠定了基础。

title: One Residual with Three Reuses: A Wristband Front End for Gesture Sensing
comment: 3 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Design study: results are from four public corpora; measured silicon power and on-body capture are out of scope and deferred to follow-on hardware work
summary: Continuous wrist-worn hand sensing for gesture interfaces and motor symptom monitoring needs an always-on front end that fits inside a coin-cell power budget while pairing a micro-electro-mechanical-systems (MEMS) inertial measurement unit (IMU) with a 60 GHz frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar to stay robust under occlusion and on-body drift. We present a design study of such a wristband front end in which classifier wake-up gating, mmWave versus IMU routing, and innovation-based EKF measurement reweighting share a single on-chip residual generator. The shared generator occupies 14.4 KB of program memory and 278 B of state and runs at 110K multiply-accumulates (MACs) per frame on an Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus class edge microcontroller unit (MCU). Across four public sensor data corpora (IPN Hand, SHREC 2021, MiliPoint 60 GHz FMCW radar, EAT-Radar) the front end reaches detection probability $P_D = 0.72/0.80$ at a 1% false-alarm rate, sustains a 47% classifier invocation energy reduction at 90% gesture detection recall, and lowers pose tracking root-mean-square error by $4.6\times$ under measurement bias drift relative to an adaptive Kalman with $R$-inflation baseline. Measured silicon power and on-body capture are deferred to follow-on hardware; the contribution here is a design study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向腕戴式手势界面的前端设计研究，将MEMS IMU与60 GHz FMCW雷达配对，通过共享残差发生器实现分类器唤醒门控、毫米波与IMU路由选择以及基于创新的EKF测量重加权，在Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus级MCU上仅占用14.4 KB程序内存和278 B状态，运行速度为每帧110K MACs。
AI.motivation: 连续腕戴式手势感应和运动症状监测需要始终开启的前端，既要满足纽扣电池功耗预算，又要结合IMU与毫米波雷达以在遮挡和身体漂移下保持鲁棒性，这是一个关键的设计挑战。
AI.method: 设计一种共享残差发生器的腕带前端架构，统一了三种操作：分类器唤醒门控、mmWave与IMU路由选择、基于创新的EKF测量重加权，在低成本边缘MCU上高效实现。
AI.result: 在四个公开数据集（IPN Hand、SHREC 2021、MiliPoint、EAT-Radar）上，前端在1%虚警率下达到PD=0.72/0.80的检测概率，在90%手势检测召回率下实现47%的分类器调用能量降低，并在测量偏差漂移下相对自适应卡尔曼R膨胀基线将姿态跟踪RMSE降低4.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 本研究贡献在于前端的架构设计研究，硅片功耗和真实手腕采集数据留待后续硬件验证，但目前结果已显示出在超低功耗约束下融合IMU与毫米波雷达进行鲁棒手势感知的可行性。

title: Physics of Agents: Statistical Mechanics Predicts Collective Behavior of AI Agents
comment: 51 pages, 20 figures, 9 tables
summary: AI agents increasingly operate as part of interacting systems rather than in isolation. As agents exchange information and jointly make decisions, their interactions can improve collective reasoning but may also produce herding, polarization, or amplify shared biases. Understanding and predicting these collective dynamics is therefore important for designing effective and aligned multi-agent systems. Here, we study over 10,000 communities of language-model agents that repeatedly exchange messages and revise their opinions across objective mathematics questions and subjective political statements. Despite substantial diversity in possible behavior, the individual and group dynamics can be represented by three characteristic regimes: indifference, polarization, and consensus. AI agents start indifferent and build conviction as they interact. On objective questions, communication improves collective accuracy, while on subjective questions it often drifts group opinions toward the right in the political spectrum. We explain these observations with a statistical-mechanics formalism in which agents stochastically favor lower social pressure. Given only initial opinions, our model predicts individual trajectories, outperforms all standard baselines, generalizes to unseen community graphs, and reproduces the observed group archetype distributions. Our fitted model parameters reveal the mechanics underlying our key observations: i) communities operate below the critical social temperature, which explains conviction buildup; ii) attractive ties outweigh repulsive ones, which favors consensus; and iii) agents holding the correct answer exert the strongest pull, which drives truth-seeking. Overall, our results demonstrate that collective behavior of AI agents, like that of other complex systems, follows compact and predictive dynamical laws.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了超过10,000个语言模型智能体社区的集体动态，发现其个体和群体行为可归结为三种特征状态：冷漠、极化和共识。通过统计力学形式化框架（智能体随机偏好较低社会压力），该模型仅凭初始观点即可预测个体轨迹，优于所有标准基线，并能推广到未见的社区图结构。
AI.motivation: AI智能体越来越多地以交互系统的形式运作，而非孤立运行。它们的信息交换和联合决策可能改善集体推理，但也可能导致羊群效应、极化或放大共享偏见。理解并预测这些集体动态对于设计有效且对齐的多智能体系统至关重要。
AI.method: 研究在客观数学问题和主观政治陈述上构建了超过10,000个重复交换消息并修订观点的语言模型智能体社区。作者提出一个统计力学形式化模型，其中智能体随机倾向于较低的社会压力状态。该模型仅需初始观点即可预测个体轨迹和群体动态。
AI.result: 客观问题上，交流提升了集体准确性；主观问题上，群组观点常向右翼漂移。模型预测个体轨迹优于所有标准基线，可泛化到未见的社区图。关键发现：社区运行在临界社会温度以下（解释信念积累）、吸引力连接超过排斥力（促进共识）、持有正确答案的智能体施加最强拉力（推动求真）。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体的集体行为如同其他复杂系统一样，遵循紧凑且可预测的动力学规律。统计力学框架不仅能理解多智能体系统的集体现象，还能为设计更有效、更对齐的多智能体系统提供理论基础。

title: Learning Generalizable Reconstruction of High-Dimensional Neural Dynamics
summary: Accurate reconstruction of long-duration neural recordings is challenging because local field potentials (LFPs) are high-resolution, multichannel, transient, and variable across subjects. We present PCA-DMD, a scalable operator-theoretic framework that segments LFP recordings into overlapping windows, projects them into a compact PCA space, learns linear Koopman evolution in the latent space, and reconstructs continuous signals through inverse projection and overlap-add aggregation. On 200,000-sample hippocampal recordings, PCA-DMD outperformed Classical DMD, SpDMD, MrDMD, and HODMD, achieving KLD=0.0761 and HD=0.0847. In all-pair cross-subject zero-shot generalization at 300,000 samples, correlations were 0.9504-0.9800, with HD=0.0010-0.0072 and KLD=0.0005-0.0022, without target-subject fine-tuning. Out-of-sample temporal prediction showed close one-step agreement on temporally held-out LFP segments across the unseen interval and multiple channels. Scalability analysis from 400,000 to 900,000 samples showed stable zero-shot reconstruction, with mean correlation remaining about 0.965-0.968 while computational cost increased predictably. External validation on an independent 93-channel Allen Neuropixels recording yielded mean and median channel-wise correlations of 0.7427 and 0.7990, respectively. Koopman spectral and mode analyses revealed dominant eigenvalues concentrated near the unit circle. PCA-DMD therefore provides an interpretable, generalizable, and computationally scalable framework for reconstructing high-dimensional neural dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCA-DMD框架，结合PCA降维与Koopman算子理论，对长时间神经记录（LFP）进行可扩展的重建。在20万-90万样本的数据集上，该方法在重建精度、跨受试者零样本泛化和时间外推预测上均优于多种DMD变体，并在独立93通道Allen Neuropixels数据上验证了泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 长时间神经记录（LFP）的重建具有挑战性，因为其高分辨率、多通道、瞬态性和跨受试者变异性使得现有方法难以准确、可扩展地重建神经信号。需要一种既能捕捉高维神经动力学、又具备可解释性和跨受试者泛化能力的框架。
AI.method: PCA-DMD框架包含四个步骤：1) 将LFP记录分割为重叠窗口；2) 将窗口投影到紧凑的PCA空间中；3) 在潜空间中学习线性Koopman演化；4) 通过逆投影和重叠-相加聚合重建连续信号。
AI.result: 在20万样本的海马记录中，PCA-DMD优于Classical DMD、SpDMD、MrDMD和HODMD，KLD=0.0761，HD=0.0847。跨受试者零样本泛化（30万样本）相关性达0.9504-0.9800。90万样本下零样本重建稳定，平均相关性维持在0.965-0.968。独立93通道Allen Neuropixels验证的通道平均相关性为0.7427。Koopman谱分析显示主导特征值集中在单位圆附近。
AI.conclusion: PCA-DMD提供了一个可解释、可泛化且计算可扩展的框架，用于重建高维神经动力学，兼具高精度、跨受试者零样本泛化能力和稳定的规模化性能。

title: CACSurv: Concordance-Aligned Comparative Learning with Large Language Models for Cancer Survival Prediction
summary: Cancer survival prediction supports treatment planning, risk stratification, and follow-up management. Existing methods use structured clinical variables, whole-slide images, genomic profiles, or multimodal inputs, while patient reports remain underexplored. We study report-centric survival prediction using reports that organize pathological, clinical, and molecular evidence. Large language models (LLMs) can reason over such reports, but case-wise time regression introduces two mismatches. First, a formulation mismatch arises because survival evaluation depends on ordering comparable patients, whereas independent time predictions do not enforce ranking consistency. Second, a supervision mismatch arises because a censored patient's observed time indicates survival beyond that point and cannot serve as an exact regression target, although it still implies orderings relative to patients who died earlier. To address these mismatches, we propose CACSurv, a Concordance-Aligned Comparative framework for report-centric survival prediction. CACSurv reformulates survival modeling as mini-cohort comparative reasoning, where an LLM predicts relative prognostic orderings. We introduce concordance-aligned rewards derived from comparable relations under right censoring, enabling censored outcomes to provide ranking supervision without exact event-time targets. At inference, Monte Carlo Reference Aggregation compares each patient with sampled references and aggregates positions into a cohort-level ranking. We establish TCGA-SurvReport, a benchmark covering six TCGA cancer cohorts. CACSurv achieves the highest C-index on all six cohorts and an average C-index of 0.722, outperforming the strongest published survival model by 6.5 percentage points and the strongest LLM time-regression baseline by 4.2 percentage points. Our code, models, and dataset will be available at https://github.com/xmed-lab/CACSurv.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CACSurv，一个基于大语言模型的报告中心癌症生存预测框架。它通过将生存预测重构为小队列比较推理，并引入一致性对齐奖励来利用右删失数据，解决了传统时间回归方法在公式和监督上的双重不匹配问题。在六个TCGA队列上取得了最佳C-index（平均0.722）。
AI.motivation: 现有癌症生存预测方法依赖结构化变量、全切片图像、基因组数据或多模态输入，而患者报告这一信息源未被充分利用。当使用LLM对报告进行逐例时间回归时存在两个问题：一是公式不匹配（生存评估依赖可比患者的排序而非独立时间预测）；二是监督不匹配（删失患者观测时间仅表明生存超过该点，不能作为精确回归目标）。
AI.method: CACSurv将生存建模重构为迷你队列比较推理：LLM预测患者的相对预后排序；引入一致性对齐奖励，基于右删失下的可比关系，使删失结果也能提供排序监督而无需精确事件时间；推理时采用蒙特卡洛参考聚合，将每个患者与采样参考比较并聚合位置形成队列级排名。
AI.result: 在TCGA-SurvReport基准（覆盖六个TCGA癌症队列）上，CACSurv在所有六个队列上均取得最高C-index，平均C-index为0.722，比最强已发表生存模型高6.5个百分点，比最强LLM时间回归基线高4.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 报告中心的CACSurv框架通过比较式推理和一致性对齐奖励，有效解决了LLM时间回归在生存预测中的双重不匹配问题，显著提升了预测性能，开辟了利用患者报告进行生存预测的新方向。

title: Variational Outlier-Robust Gaussian Process Regression with Generative Modeling
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure
summary: Outliers can substantially distort Gaussian process regression (GPR) due to its conventional Gaussian observation likelihood, leading to inaccurate model learning and prediction. To address this limitation, this article introduces a generative GPR model that captures observation-specific contamination and adaptively mitigates the influence of outliers. Subsequently, a variational generalized expectation-maximization procedure is used to learn the latent variables and GPR model parameters. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets under different contamination settings demonstrate that the proposed method remains competitive with-and in several cases outperforms-robust GPR baselines in prediction accuracy. Moreover, the proposed method shares the cubic computational scaling of the compared GPR methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种生成式高斯过程回归（GPR）模型，通过捕获观测特定的污染并自适应减轻异常值的影响，解决了传统GPR因高斯观测似然而对异常值敏感的问题。使用变分广义期望最大化算法学习潜在变量和模型参数，实验表明该方法在预测精度上具有竞争力，且保持了与对比方法相同的三次方计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 传统高斯过程回归使用高斯观测似然，导致对异常值非常敏感，异常值会严重扭曲模型学习和预测结果。现有方法缺乏一种能够有效捕获观测特定污染并自适应降低异常值影响的生成式建模方案。
AI.method: 提出一个生成式GPR模型，为每个观测捕获特定的污染信息；采用变分广义期望最大化（variational generalized expectation-maximization）过程来学习潜在变量和GPR模型参数。
AI.result: 在多种污染设置下的合成和真实数据集实验中，所提方法与鲁棒GPR基线相比在预测精度上保持竞争力，且在若干情况下表现更优；计算复杂度保持与对比GPR方法相同的三次方量级。
AI.conclusion: 提出的生成式GPR模型能够有效处理异常值问题，在保持计算复杂度不变的前提下获得有竞争力的预测性能，为鲁棒高斯过程回归提供了新思路。

title: Cost Scales with Change, Not Corpus Size: Incrementally Maintaining an Evolving Semantic Substrate
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted and presented at the 2026 International Electronics Symposium (IES), Yogyakarta, Indonesia, August 1-3, 2026 (IEEE technically co-sponsored). Authors' accepted version
summary: Retrieval-augmented and agentic question-answering systems increasingly re-derive the meaning of a corpus at query time. Put plainly, instead of re-deriving what a corpus means on every question, the work is done once when a document arrives and is thereafter merely consulted -- a compiler, not an interpreter, of meaning. An alternative is to compile that meaning once, at ingest time, into a compact, queryable semantic substrate and maintain it as the corpus evolves. The central objection is maintenance cost: rebuilding a truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) on every change appears prohibitive, and a change of embedding model seems to force a full re-embedding. We argue and show empirically that maintenance cost scales with the amount of change, not corpus size. On a controlled synthetic pilot (dimension 256, rank 32, a corpus grown from 3,000 to 9,000 documents over 50 update events), incremental low-rank updates were 33.7 times cheaper per update than full re-SVD and 23.8 times cheaper cumulatively, while the incremental subspace tracked the full recomputation to within floating-point precision (maximum principal-angle drift below 1e-11 degrees; recall@10 = 1.0). An orthogonal Procrustes virtual axis update recovered 0.95 mean cosine to truly re-embedded vectors by re-embedding only about 10 percent of the corpus. The results support maintaining, rather than repeatedly reconstructing, a semantic substrate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在文档摄入时（而非查询时）将语料库语义编译为紧凑可查询的语义基质的范式，并论证其维护成本与变化量成正比而非与语料库规模成正比。实验表明增量低秩更新比全量重算SVD便宜33.7倍，正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新通过仅重嵌入约10%的语料即可恢复0.95的平均余弦相似度。
AI.motivation: 检索增强和智能体问答系统在每次查询时反复重新推导语料库的含义，效率低下。作者认为更优方案是在文档到达时一次性编译语义（类似编译器而非解释器），但核心反对意见是维护成本过高——每次变更都重建截断SVD似乎代价高昂，嵌入模型变更似乎也强制全量重嵌入。本文旨在反驳这一观点。
AI.method: 作者通过受控合成实验验证增量维护方案：1) 增量低秩更新（incremental low-rank updates）替代全量重SVD；2) 正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新（orthogonal Procrustes virtual axis update）仅重嵌入约10%的语料库来近似全量重嵌入的效果。实验设定为维度256、秩32，语料从3,000份文档增长到9,000份，经历50次更新事件。
AI.result: 增量低秩更新每次更新比全量重SVD便宜33.7倍，累计便宜23.8倍；增量子空间跟踪全量重计算达到浮点精度级别（最大主角度漂移低于1e-11度，召回率@10=1.0）。正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新通过仅重嵌入约10%的语料库实现了0.95的平均余弦相似度（相对真正重嵌入的向量）。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明维护（而非反复重建）语义基质是可行的且成本可控，维护成本与变更量成正比而非语料库规模，支持采用"编译器"式的一次性语义编译范式而非"解释器"式的每次查询重推导范式。

title: Hoeffding adaptive splitting trees for data stream classification with concept drift and ensemble learning
summary: Ensembles of decision trees are well-established methods for data stream classification. In ensemble learning, Hoeffding Trees are widely adopted as base learners, performing periodic split attempts according to the Hoeffding bound. Recent studies, however, indicate that this standard splitting mechanism lacks adaptability, while adaptive trees that trigger splits in response to performance degradation have achieved superior results. In this paper, we identify limitations in the use of adaptive-splitting decision trees as ensemble base learners, showing that change detectors often fail to promote sufficient diversity within ensembles. To address this issue, we propose two novel decision tree models, termed Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees. These models combine the periodic splitting strategy of Hoeffding Trees, which fosters ensemble diversity, with adaptive splitting mechanisms that employ change detection algorithms to identify performance decay and determine split points. Experimental results demonstrate that Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees enhance ensemble performance and achieve state-of-the-art results across a comprehensive evaluation, including benchmark comparisons, computational cost analysis, and concept drift adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种新的决策树模型（Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees），将Hoeffding树的周期性分裂策略与自适应分裂机制相结合，在保持集成多样性的同时提升数据流分类性能。实验证明该方法在基准比较、计算成本和概念漂移适应方面均达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有研究指出Hoeffding树的标准分裂机制缺乏适应性，而自适应树（根据性能下降触发分裂）虽然表现更优，但在作为集成基学习器时，其变化检测器往往无法促进足够的集成多样性，这是一个尚未解决的局限。
AI.method: 提出两种新型决策树模型（Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees）：结合Hoeffding树的周期性分裂策略（有助于促进集成多样性）与自适应分裂机制（利用变化检测算法识别性能下降并确定分裂点）。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees增强了集成性能，在基准比较、计算成本分析和概念漂移适应等全面评估中取得了最先进的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合周期性分裂与自适应分裂两种机制，所提出的模型既能保持Hoeffding树促进集成多样性的优势，又能利用自适应分裂提升适应性，从而在数据流分类任务中实现更优的集成学习效果。

title: A Shop Floor Production Scheduling Case based on RFID-supported Smart Factory
summary: Radio frequency identification (RFID) technology has been widely implemented for real-time data collection in manufacturing shop floors, which, in turn, can be used to support dynamic shop floor production planning and scheduling. Within such an environment, uncertainty in operation and production processes collectively contribute to the dynamicity in manufacturing, thereby hampering the scheduling system from achieving maximal utility. To highlight the importance of handling such uncertainty, this paper addresses the problem of dynamic shop floor scheduling for a real-life case smart factory equipped with RFID technology. Feasible production sequence mining and real-time processing rate estimation are conducted on RFID-collected production data to quantify the operation and production uncertainties. A deep reinforcement learning approach based on the RFID data analysis is then presented for shop floor production scheduling. Simulation studies based on real-life case data have demonstrated the feasibility and practicality of the proposed dynamic production scheduling framework. Specifically, it is observed that the proposed framework outperforms existing dispatch methods in terms of minimizing operation makespan, including first in first out (FIFO), last in first out (LIFO) and deep Q network (DQN).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于RFID数据分析的深度强化学习框架，用于解决智能工厂动态车间调度问题。通过对RFID采集的生产数据进行可行序列挖掘和实时处理速率估计来量化操作与生产不确定性，并基于此构建深度强化学习调度方法。仿真实验表明该方法在最小化完工时间方面优于FIFO、LIFO和DQN等现有调度方法。
AI.motivation: 制造车间中的操作和生产过程存在不确定性，这些不确定性共同导致制造的动态性，阻碍调度系统实现最大效用。现有研究往往忽视对这类不确定性的量化处理，因此需要一种能够有效应对动态车间调度问题的方法。
AI.method: 首先利用RFID采集的生产数据进行可行生产序列挖掘与实时处理速率估计，以量化操作和生产不确定性；然后基于RFID数据分析结果，采用深度强化学习方法进行车间生产调度。
AI.result: 基于真实案例数据的仿真研究表明，所提出的动态生产调度框架在最小化操作完工时间方面优于FIFO、LIFO和DQN等现有调度方法，验证了该框架的可行性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了结合RFID数据分析与深度强化学习可以有效处理车间调度中的不确定性，为智能工厂动态生产调度提供了可行的解决方案，并在实际案例中展现出优于传统调度规则的性能。

title: UniTAC: Universal Task-Aware Compression via Weighted Distortion Measures
comment: 9 pages
summary: Physical AI systems such as autonomous vehicles and robots rely on timely exchange of high-dimensional sensory signals under tight bandwidth, latency, and energy budgets. Because the task driving downstream decisions evolves over time, a task-specific codec is brittle and retraining one per task is infeasible in the field. We propose UniTAC, a single learned image codec spanning universal (task-agnostic) to task-specialized operation, re-targeted at runtime without retraining. The task is abstracted as a per-component importance vector, derived, e.g., from gradient attribution of any downstream model, and transmitted as low-overhead side information that conditions both encoder and decoder. Trained once over a broad, randomized family of such vectors against weighted-reconstruction distortion, UniTAC keeps a fixed backbone and a single human-viewable reconstruction whose fidelity is steered to the active task by swapping the injected vector. We analyze the underlying weighted rate-distortion problem, characterizing when a diagonal weighted distortion is task-consistent and how weights relate to task sensitivity. Guided by this, we design a Vision Transformer (ViT) codec whose token-level conditioning natively realizes this weight-driven code. On a localized task at 0.034 bpp, a single UniTAC model reaches 91.4% accuracy, only 1.9% below a task-based codec (93.3%) and above universal codecs (76.9%).

AI.tldr: 提出了UniTAC，一个统一的图像编码框架，通过运行时注入任务重要性向量实现从任务无关到任务特化的连续操作，无需重新训练。该框架基于加权率失真分析，使用ViT编码器通过token级条件化实现权重驱动编码，在多项指标上优于通用编码器且接近任务特化编码器。
AI.motivation: 物理AI系统（如自动驾驶、机器人）需要在高带宽、低延迟和能量约束下传输高维感知信号。由于下游任务随时间演化，任务特定编解码器性能好但现场重训练不可行，而任务无关的通用编解码器性能不佳。需要一个能同时兼顾通用性和任务特化、且无需重训练即可切换的单模型方案。
AI.method: 1) 将任务抽象为逐组件重要性向量（如从任何下游模型的梯度归因得到），作为低开销的边信息注入编解码器。2) 对加权率失真问题进行理论分析，刻画对角加权失真何时与任务一致以及权重与任务敏感性的关系。3) 设计基于Vision Transformer (ViT)的编解码器，通过token级条件化在固定主干网络上实现权重驱动的编码，训练时在随机的权重向量族上优化加权重建失真。
AI.result: 在局部化任务上，0.034 bpp条件下，单个UniTAC模型达到91.4%的准确率，仅比任务特化编解码器（93.3%）低1.9%，显著高于通用编解码器（76.9%）。
AI.conclusion: UniTAC展示了通过运行时注入任务重要性向量实现单一模型覆盖从通用到任务特化操作范围的可行性，在不需要重训练的情况下在任务性能和通用性之间取得了良好平衡，为物理AI系统的动态任务场景提供了实用解决方案。

title: Hypergraph-based Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Incremental Refinement
comment: Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
summary: Modern Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (M-RAG) systems are fundamentally limited by the binary connectivity paradigm of traditional simple graphs, which fails to capture the intricate, high-order correlations among heterogeneous entities, such as the N-ary relationships between a visual chart, its scattered textual descriptions, and underlying numerical data. Furthermore, existing refinement strategies often rely on exhaustive, full-page reconstruction to align cross-modal information, leading to prohibitive computational redundancy and the introduction of contextual noise in long-form document processing. In this paper, we propose Hyper-M2RAG, a novel framework that redefines multimodal document retrieval through High-order Hypergraph Representation Learning. We first formalize the document structure as a Multimodal Hypergraph, utilizing hyperedges as unified semantic containers to encapsulate multi-way associations across text, images, and tables, thereby transcending point-to-point modeling. To mitigate semantic fragmentation caused by physical pagination, we introduce an Anchor-driven Incremental Refinement mechanism. Rather than performing a global sweep, our approach identifies boundary-crossing anchor nodes and reconstructs their local hyper-topology using one-hop neighborhood contexts. This targeted refinement effectively bridges cross-page knowledge gaps with minimal computational footprints. Extensive evaluations on multimodal benchmarking datasets demonstrate that Hyper-M2RAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both retrieval precision and generation coherence. Our code is available at https://github.com/ShenAoChen2001/MMHRAG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hyper-M2RAG框架，通过高阶超图表示学习重新定义多模态文档检索，利用超边统一封装文本、图像和表格间的N元关联，并引入锚点驱动的增量精炼机制解决跨页语义碎片化问题，在检索精度和生成连贯性上优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 传统M-RAG系统受限于简单图的二元连接范式，无法捕捉异构实体间的高阶关联（如N元关系）。同时，现有精炼策略依赖全页重建，导致计算冗余并引入大量上下文噪声。
AI.method: 1) 将文档结构形式化为多模态超图，使用超边作为统一语义容器封装文本、图像和表格之间的多路关联；2) 提出锚点驱动的增量精炼机制，识别跨越边界的锚节点，仅用一跳邻域上下文重建局部超拓扑，以最小计算代价桥接跨页知识缺口。
AI.result: 在多模态基准数据集上的广泛评估表明，Hyper-M2RAG在检索精度和生成连贯性两方面均显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 高阶超图表示结合定向增量精炼能够以高效的计算方式有效解决多模态文档检索中的语义碎片化和关联建模难题，为M-RAG系统提供了新的设计范式。

title: Learning to Unlearn: Machine Unlearning via Learning the Unlearning Behaviors
summary:
Various machine unlearning techniques have been developed in response to privacy legislation requirements, enabling individuals to exercise their legal right to have their data $D_f$ removed from a machine learning model. This process is typically accomplished via the use of an unlearning function denoted as $U$. Existing methods focus on designing an intricate $U$ to unlearn $D_f \subset D$ from a previous model $A(D)$, so that the unlearned model performs as closely as possible to the retrained model $A(D \setminus D_f)$. However, these methods often suffer from high computational costs when dealing with massive training data, as the complex structures of $U$ become a bottleneck even for models with fewer parameters.
  Inspired by Learning to Optimize, we introduce the first learning-based model-agnostic approach, Learning-to-UnLearn (L2UL). Our core insight is to shift from manually designing $U$ to learning the unlearning behaviors from a distribution perspective, thereby acquiring a simple and efficient $U$ via learning. Our experimental results demonstrate that the accuracy achieved by L2UL is comparable to that of retraining while exhibiting impressive efficiency, particularly in data-intensive scenarios. Furthermore, we validate the performance and scalability of our method on larger models ResNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Learning-to-UnLearn (L2UL)，这是首个基于学习的、模型无关的机器遗忘方法。不同于传统方法手动设计复杂的遗忘函数U，L2UL从分布视角学习遗忘行为，获得简单高效的U，在保持与重训练相当的准确率的同时，显著提升效率，尤其适用于大规模数据场景。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法需要手动设计复杂的遗忘函数U，在处理大规模训练数据时面临高计算成本问题——即使模型参数较少，U的复杂结构也成为性能瓶颈。因此迫切需要一种更简单高效的遗忘方法。
AI.method: 受Learning to Optimize启发，L2UL将机器遗忘从手动设计U转变为从分布视角学习遗忘行为，通过学习来获取简单且高效的遗忘函数U，且是一种模型无关（model-agnostic）的方法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，L2UL在准确率上与重训练方法相当，同时在数据密集型场景中展现出令人印象深刻的效率优势。此外，在更大规模的ResNet模型上验证了方法的性能和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: L2UL通过将遗忘函数的学习过程自动化，成功解决了传统机器遗忘方法计算开销大的问题，为大规模数据场景下的隐私合规提供了高效且实用的解决方案。

title: PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning
summary: LLMs remain unreliable for long-horizon planning, often generating logically inconsistent or non-applicable plans. Recent hybrid methods instead translate natural language into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), allowing symbolic planners to produce verifiable plans. However, existing methods frequently rely on rigid generation pipelines, a partial PDDL definition, or human feedback. Furthermore, their evaluation is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks with automated verification. To address these limitations, we present PDDLCoder, an agentic framework for PDDL generation from natural language that iteratively generates, analyzes, and refines planning specifications. We further introduce NL-pddlgym, a benchmark dataset comprising 711 planning problems across 23 domains with executable gym environments for the automated verification of plan applicability. Experiments on the NL-pddlgym test set containing 106 problems across 4 held-out domains show that PDDLCoder generates applicable plans for 89.6\% of tested planning problems. This improves upon our adaptations of previous PDDL generation methods, which achieved up to 45.3\%, and outperforms direct LLM planning approaches, which reached up to 74.5\% on the same test set. Our work demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic PDDL generation for planning and establishes a reproducible benchmark for future research on LLM-assisted symbolic planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PDDLCoder，一个基于智能体（agentic）的框架，用于从自然语言迭代生成、分析和细化PDDL规划规范，并引入NL-pddlgym基准数据集（23个领域711个规划问题）。实验表明PDDLCoder在4个保留领域的106个测试问题上实现了89.6%的可适用规划生成率，远超现有PDDL生成方法（最高45.3%）和直接LLM规划方法（最高74.5%）。
AI.motivation: LLM在进行长时程规划时不可靠，常生成逻辑不一致或不可执行的计划。现有混合方法（LLM转PDDL后由符号规划器验证）存在刚性生成流程、部分PDDL定义、依赖人类反馈等问题，同时缺乏标准化基准和自动化验证手段。
AI.method: 1) PDDLCoder：一个智能体框架，通过迭代生成、分析与细化PDDL规范来实现从自然语言到可执行规划规范的转换；2) NL-pddlgym：包含711个规划问题、覆盖23个领域的基准数据集，提供可执行的gym环境用于规划可适用性的自动化验证。
AI.result: 在NL-pddlgym测试集（4个保留领域、106个问题）上，PDDLCoder对89.6%的规划问题生成了可适用计划，优于改编的现有PDDL生成方法（最高45.3%）和直接LLM规划方法（最高74.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了智能体式PDDL生成在规划任务中的有效性，并为未来LLM辅助符号规划研究建立了可复现的基准。

title: The Ethical Decision Head: Operationalizing Normative Ethics in Autonomous Vehicles via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
summary: As autonomous vehicles (AVs) approach Level 4 and Level 5 operational capability [SAE International, 2018], their on- board decision systems must handle not only safety-critical locomotion but also their subsequent moral weight. This paper details the Ethical Decision Head (EDH), a deep re- inforcement learning (RL) framework that encodes ethical reasoning as a differentiable reward signal, enabling a pol- icy gradient agent to learn morally-aligned driving behavior in scenarios whose state representation is aligned with the CARLA simulation environment [Dosovitskiy et al., 2017]. Two normative frameworks are instantiated and evaluated: a Utilitarian framework minimizing total casualties and a Kan- tian framework enforcing course maintenance as a categori- cal imperative. The EDH is trained via Proximal Policy Op- timization (PPO) [Schulman et al., 2017] against a Bradley- Terry reward model [Bradley and Terry, 1952] learned from pairwise human preference annotations over 200 collision- imminent scenarios. Results reveal an asymmetry in the learnability of normative ethical frameworks under human su- pervision. The Kantian condition, which reduces to a con- stant prediction task under the codebook, serves as a pipeline control: it confirms training stability and rules out infrastruc- ture failure as an explanation for the utilitarian result. The Utilitarian agent learned something more unsettling: human raters rewarded self-sacrifice over casualty minimization, and the model learned that preference faithfully. This divergence between what humans prescribe in theory and what they re- ward in practice suggests that RLHF does not learn ethics as philosophers define it, but as humans live it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出伦理决策头（EDH），一种将伦理推理编码为可微奖励信号的深度强化学习框架，用于自动驾驶车辆的道德决策。通过PPO算法和基于人类偏好标注的Bradley-Terry奖励模型，作者在CARLA仿真环境中评估了功利主义和康德主义两种伦理框架，发现人类在实践奖励中倾向于自我牺牲而非伤亡最小化，揭示了人类理论与实践伦理之间的分歧。
AI.motivation: 随着自动驾驶车辆迈向L4/L5级别，其决策系统不仅面临安全关键的运动控制问题，还面临随之而来的道德权重问题。作者旨在通过强化学习框架将伦理推理形式化，解决自动驾驶的道德决策难题。
AI.method: 1) 提出EDH框架，将伦理推理编码为可微奖励信号；2) 实例化功利主义（最小化总伤亡）和康德主义（保持车道作为绝对命令）两种规范框架；3) 使用PPO算法训练；4) 在200个碰撞临近场景中通过Bradley-Terry模型从成对人类偏好标注学习奖励模型。
AI.result: 1) 康德条件作为管道控制，确认训练稳定性；2) 功利主义智能体学习到人类评分者奖励自我牺牲而非伤亡最小化，模型忠实地学习了这一偏好；3) 揭示了规范伦理框架在人类监督下学习能力的非对称性。
AI.conclusion: 人类在理论上规定的伦理与在实践中奖励的伦理之间存在分歧，RLHF学习的不是哲学家定义的伦理，而是人类实际践行的伦理。这对自动驾驶伦理决策系统的设计和验证具有重要意义。

title: Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning algorithms for Large Language Models (LLMs) are largely distinguished by their variance reduction strategy. Group-relative methods like GRPO reduce gradient variance by sampling multiple rollouts per prompt, but provide only sequence-level credit. Training is also blocked by straggler rollouts, reducing throughput and increasing off-policyness. Learned value functions theoretically address both problems, providing token-level advantages without requiring large groups. However, additional infrastructure engineering challenges combined with the practical success of critic-free methods have made it difficult to justify their inclusion in RL pipelines. We propose two complementary strategies to improve the performance of value function RL: 1) Privileged Value Functions (PVF) which provide an elegant mechanism to inject additional task-relevant token-level signal without biasing the policy objective; 2) TETHER, a baseline that adaptively interpolates between group-relative and value baselines depending on the value function accuracy. Across several reasoning tasks, both strategies consistently improve over the standard value function baseline, and are competitive with or outperform mean-baseline GRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM强化学习中价值函数方法被低估的问题，提出两种互补策略：特权价值函数（PVF）通过注入任务相关token级信号而不偏置策略目标，以及TETHER基准线可根据价值函数准确性自适应地在组相对基准和价值基准之间插值。实验表明两种策略在多个推理任务上均优于标准价值函数基准，并与均值基准GRPO相当或更优。
AI.motivation: GRPO等组相对方法通过采样多个rollout降低梯度方差，但只能提供序列级信用且受困于掉队样本导致的吞吐量下降和离策略问题。价值函数理论上能解决这两个问题（提供token级优势且无需大组），但工程复杂性和无批评者方法的实际成功使其难以被采用。
AI.method: 提出两种策略：1）特权价值函数（PVF），在不偏置策略目标的前提下注入额外任务相关token级信号；2）TETHER，根据价值函数准确性自适应地在组相对基准与价值基准之间进行插值的基线方法。
AI.result: 在多个推理任务上，两种策略均一致优于标准价值函数基线，且与均值基准GRPO相比具有竞争力或表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 通过PVF和TETHER两种策略，价值函数RL方法在LLM训练中的性能可以得到显著提升，使其能够与主流的无批评者方法（如GRPO）竞争甚至超越，从而为价值函数在LLM强化学习管道中的实际应用提供了有力论证。

title: Chronocooked: A Benchmark for Implicit Interval Timing in Reinforcement Learning Agents
summary: This paper presents Chronocooked, a reinforcement learning (RL) benchmark suite for studying implicit interval timing in RL agents. Inspired by Overcooked, the suite comprises cooking scenarios that require temporal decision making. The tasks and reward functions are designed such that temporal information is unobserved yet critical for optimal performance. The environment is intentionally kept simple to enable controlled experiments and support biologically plausible models. Evaluation metrics are designed to expose limitations in timing abilities of RL agents, and we report baselines using a non-recurrent, a recurrent, and a biologically plausible model. This work ultimately aims to underscore the need to incorporate time perception and temporal processing in artificial agents designed for human robot interaction and deployment in time dependent human societies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Chronocooked，一个基于Overcooked的强化学习基准套件，用于研究RL智能体的隐式间隔计时能力。该环境故意保持简单以支持受控实验和生物合理模型，并通过专门的评估指标暴露RL智能体在时间感知上的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有RL智能体缺乏对时间感知和隐式间隔计时能力的系统研究，而这对于人机交互和在时间依赖的人类社会中部署至关重要。作者旨在强调将时间知觉整合进人工智能体的必要性。
AI.method: 设计了一个以烹饪场景为背景的RL基准套件（Chronocooked），其中时间信息未被直接观测但对最优表现至关重要。环境保持简单以支持受控实验和生物合理模型，并采用专门设计的评估指标来暴露RL智能体的计时缺陷。报告了非循环、循环和生物合理模型三种基线的结果。
AI.result: 通过专门设计的评估指标，研究揭示了三种基线模型（非循环、循环和生物合理模型）在隐式间隔计时任务中的表现差异和局限性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作强调在面向人机交互和时间依赖社会的AI系统中，需要纳入时间感知和时序处理能力，并为此提供了可复现的基准测试环境。

title: Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments
summary: Many areas of AI research, such as language model interpretability and chain of thought faithfulness, seek to explain model behaviors. But what constitutes a "good" explanation? In this work, we evaluate explanations through the lens of counterfactual simulatability-whether the explanation is useful for predicting model behaviors on related counterfactual inputs. To this end, we introduce CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits), a novel agentic pipeline that identifies unexpected model behaviors in the wild and investigates them with counterfactual prompt edits. This yields thousands of high-quality explanations for naturally-occurring model behaviors along with supporting counterfactual evidence. We apply CHIVE in two ways. First, we evaluate whether common LLM interpretability techniques improve an agent's ability to predict counterfactual model behaviors. Surprisingly, we find no uplift from any of the interpretability techniques studied. Second, we use CHIVE to generate training data. We find that training models to predict outcomes of CHIVE-generated counterfactual experiments generalizes to various out-of-distribution settings. Overall, CHIVE automatically discovers explanations of naturally-occurring LLM behaviors, enabling us to evaluate and improve methods for explaining LLM behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHIVE（Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits），一个基于agent的pipeline，通过反事实提示编辑（counterfactual prompt edits）自动发现和解释LLM在自然场景中的意外行为，并生成高质量解释及反事实证据。应用CHIVE进行两项研究：一是评估常见可解释性技术是否提升agent预测反事实模型行为的能力（结果发现均无提升）；二是利用CHIVE生成训练数据，训练模型预测反事实实验结果可推广到多种分布外场景。
AI.motivation: 许多AI研究领域（如语言模型可解释性和思维链忠实性）都试图解释模型行为，但缺乏统一的"好解释"标准。本文提出用反事实可模拟性（counterfactual simulatability）——即解释是否能帮助预测模型在相关反事实输入上的行为——作为评估解释质量的标准，并据此自动发现和评估LLM行为的解释。
AI.method: 提出CHIVE agentic pipeline：1) 在自然场景中识别意外的模型行为；2) 通过反事实提示编辑（counterfactual prompt edits）调查这些行为；3) 生成大量高质量解释及配套反事实证据。随后将CHIVE用于两个方向：评估常见LLM可解释性技术的效用，以及生成训练数据来训练模型预测反事实实验结果。
AI.result: 1) 所有被研究的常见可解释性技术均未提升agent预测反事实模型行为的能力（令人惊讶）；2) 使用CHIVE生成的数据训练模型预测反事实实验结果为，模型能泛化到各种分布外（out-of-distribution）设置。
AI.conclusion: CHIVE能够自动发现自然发生的LLM行为的解释，为评估和改进LLM行为解释方法提供了新工具和基准。同时，反事实可模拟性可作为评估解释质量的有效标准，而现有可解释性技术的效果需要重新审视。

title: FabriMAE I Trust Myself? Self-Evaluating VLA Action Generation with Markov Attention Entropy
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) integrate visual perception, language instruction, and action generation into end-to-end policies across heterogeneous architectures. However, enabling VLAs to self-evaluate their action generation reliability without external supervision remains a major challenge. Existing methods either rely on expert annotations or estimate uncertainty only from output statistics, largely ignoring internal signals. In this work, we observe that internal visual modality entropy exhibits consistent distinctions between successful and failed tasks across heterogeneous VLAs. Although VLAs' architectures differ in their action generation, we show that they share a common latent action generation abstraction evolving under visual perception, language instruction, and state input, which we formulate as a Conditional Generative Markov Chain. Based on this formulation, we propose MAE (Markov Attention Entropy), a self-evaluation framework that directly converts internal attention signals into architecture-aware reliability scores, and introduce LIBERO-Reflect, a 4,000-episode benchmark combining 2,000 standard episodes and 2,000 challenging episodes across four subsets. Extensive experiments across heterogeneous VLA architectures and diverse scenarios show that MAE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on AUPR, AUROC, and FPR@95. We further instantiate FabriMAE for verifier-free test-time action selection, showing that MAE-guided multiple sampling improves PI-family robustness on LIBERO-Plus with small observed runtime overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAE（马尔可夫注意力熵）框架，通过利用视觉语言行动模型（VLA）内部的注意力信号进行自我评估，无需外部监督即可判断动作生成的可靠性。作者发现不同架构的VLA共享一个条件生成马尔可夫链的潜在抽象，基于此将内部注意力信号转化为架构感知的可靠性分数。同时引入LIBERO-Reflect基准（4000个回合），实验证明MAE在AUPR、AUROC和FPR@95上优于现有方法，并实例化FabriMAE用于无验证器的测试时动作选择。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型缺乏自我评估动作生成可靠性的能力，要么依赖专家标注，要么仅从输出统计中估计不确定性，忽略了模型内部信号（如注意力机制）所蕴含的信息，无法实现无外部监督的可靠自评估。
AI.method: 1) 观察到内部视觉模态熵在成功与失败任务间呈现一致性差异；2) 形式化VLA共享的潜在动作为条件生成马尔可夫链（Conditional Generative Markov Chain）；3) 基于该形式化提出MAE，将内部注意力信号直接转化为架构感知的可靠性分数；4) 构建LIBERO-Reflect基准（含2000标准+2000挑战回合）；5) 实例化FabriMAE用于无验证器的测试时动作选择。
AI.result: 在多种异构VLA架构和多样场景下，MAE在AUPR、AUROC和FPR@95指标上一致优于最先进基线。MAE引导的多重采样在LIBERO-Plus上提升了PI系列模型的鲁棒性，且运行时开销较小。
AI.conclusion: 内部注意力信号可作为一种通用的、跨架构的自评估线索，MAE框架为VLA提供了一种无需外部监督的有效可靠性评估方法，并可通过测试时多重采样进一步提升策略鲁棒性。

title: LAVA: Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation Framework for Large-Scale Financial Document Auditing
summary: Financial document validation in production, such as payroll auditing, tax compliance, and loan underwriting, demands exceptional accuracy, consistency, and reproducibility under strict enterprise constraints. In practice, documents arrive with heterogeneous layouts and formats, semantically rich and context-dependent content, and embedded business rules that current pipelines struggle to process reliably. We introduce LAVA (Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation), a modular, backbone-agnostic pipeline built on multimodal large language models, that integrates a four-stage design: document-rule retrieval, layout-preserving information extraction, auxiliary metadata enrichment, and auditable symbolic/arithmetic verification. LAVA supports robust rule grounding, fine-grained error attribution, and consistent, traceable end-to-end execution, capabilities essential for high-stakes deployment. Evaluated on a large real-world benchmark with diverse financial documents and dozens of expert-curated validation rules, LAVA outperforms baselines in hallucination control and edge-case handling while maintaining efficient token usage, demonstrating practicality for high-volume, time-critical validation.

AI.tldr: LAVA是一个基于多模态大语言模型的模块化、骨干无关流水线，用于金融文档验证，通过四阶段设计（文档规则检索、保布局信息提取、辅助元数据增强、可审计的符号/算术验证）实现高精度、一致性和可复现性，在真实基准上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 金融文档验证（如薪资审计、税务合规、贷款承销）在生产环境中要求极高的准确性、一致性和可复现性，但文档布局异构、内容语义丰富且依赖上下文、嵌入业务规则复杂，现有流水线难以可靠处理。
AI.method: LAVA采用四阶段模块化设计：1) 文档-规则检索（rule grounding）；2) 保布局信息提取；3) 辅助元数据增强；4) 可审计的符号/算术验证。该流水线基于多模态大语言模型，且与具体骨干模型无关。
AI.result: 在包含多样化金融文档和数十条专家筛选验证规则的大规模真实基准上，LAVA在幻觉控制和边缘案例处理方面优于基线，同时保持高效的token使用，证明其适合高吞吐、时间敏感的验证场景。
AI.conclusion: LAVA通过支持稳健的规则落地、细粒度错误归因和一致可追溯的端到端执行，为高风险的金融文档验证部署提供了实用且可靠的解决方案。

title: Beyond $L_2$: Generalizing Abductive Latent Explanations to Diverse Prototype-Based Architectures
comment: Accepted at ECML-PKDD 2026, Research Track
summary: Prototype-based neural networks are hailed as interpretable-by-design architectures. Recently, Abductive Latent Explanations (ALE) were introduced to provide formal, mathematically guaranteed explanations that leverage the intrinsic structure of these networks to ensure both predictive safety and human readability. ALEs rely on computing tight bounds on latent space distances to produce formal explanations. However, existing ALE formulations are rigidly confined to Euclidean latent spaces. This leaves a critical gap: modern state-of-the-art architectures increasingly rely on non-Euclidean representations - such as spherical metrics, Gaussian densities, and dimensional projections - rendering current formal explanation methods incompatible. In this work, we generalize the ALE framework to support non-Euclidean prototype architectures. For each geometric variant, we systematically derive how to either map the architecture to existing bounds or construct novel, architecture-specific bounding algorithms. We validate our theoretical constructions by computing subset-minimal formal explanations on fully trained image classifiers. By unifying these diverse models under a single formal framework, we enable the first rigorous, cross-architecture comparison of their interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文将Abductive Latent Explanations (ALE)框架从欧几里得潜空间推广到非欧几里得原型网络架构（如球面度量、高斯密度和维度投影），为每种几何变体推导了映射到现有边界或构造新型架构特定边界算法的方法，并通过在图像分类器上计算子集最小形式化解释验证了理论构建，首次实现了跨架构的可解释性严格比较。
AI.motivation: 现有ALE框架仅适用于欧几里得潜空间，而现代最先进的架构越来越多地采用非欧几里得表示（球面度量、高斯密度、维度投影等），导致当前形式化解释方法无法兼容这些架构。这形成了一个关键空白：无法为这些新兴的、更强大的原型网络架构提供形式化、有数学保证的解释。
AI.method: 将ALE框架推广以支持非欧几里得原型架构。对于每种几何变体，系统性地推导两种路径之一：(1) 将架构映射到已有的边界方法；(2) 构造新型、架构特定的边界算法。随后通过在训练好的图像分类器上计算子集最小形式化解释来验证理论构造。
AI.result: 验证了理论构造的有效性，在多种非欧几里得原型架构（球面、高斯、维度投影）上成功计算了子集最小形式化解释，并且通过统一框架实现了这些多样模型之间首次严格的跨架构可解释性比较。
AI.conclusion: 通过将多样化的原型网络架构统一到单一形式化框架下，该工作填补了非欧几里得潜空间中形式化解释方法的空白，为原型网络的解释能力提供了跨架构的严格比较基础，推动了可解释AI的发展。

title: GRIP: Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures
summary: High-capacity encoders in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can let the query dominate the latent state, leaving retrieved evidence functionally irrelevant. We call this failure mode query dominance. To address it, we introduce \textbf{GRIP} (Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises), which imposes capacity asymmetry: the decoder keeps full-dimensional access to the query, while retrieved evidence passes through a severe stochastic bottleneck. This forces the evidence channel to encode only the residual information unavailable from the query. Across five reasoning benchmarks, GRIP outperforms strong iterative baselines, cuts a query--latent mutual-information diagnostic by roughly 30$\times$ (14.8 $\to$ 0.47 bits), and reduces hallucination by 73\%. Residual-alignment analysis further shows that the bottleneck output occupies subspaces less aligned with the query than baseline representations.

AI.tldr: GRIP通过信息受限前提（Information-Restricted Premises）解决RAG中的查询主导（query dominance）问题，对检索证据施加随机瓶颈，迫使证据通道仅编码查询中不可用的残差信息，在五个推理基准上优于强迭代基线，互信息诊断降低约30倍，幻觉减少73%。
AI.motivation: 在检索增强生成（RAG）中，高容量编码器可能导致查询在潜在状态中占据主导地位，使检索到的证据在功能上变得无关紧要。这种"查询主导"（query dominance）失效模式会损害推理质量并增加幻觉风险。
AI.method: 提出GRIP框架，核心思想是施加容量不对称（capacity asymmetry）：解码器保留对查询的全维度访问，而对检索到的证据施加严格的随机瓶颈（stochastic bottleneck）。这种设计迫使证据通道只编码查询中不可用的残差信息，从而避免查询对证据的淹没。
AI.result: 在五个推理基准上，GRIP优于强迭代基线；查询-潜在互信息诊断从14.8比特降至0.47比特（约30倍降低）；幻觉减少73%；残差对齐分析表明瓶颈输出占据的潜在子空间与查询的对齐程度低于基线表示。
AI.conclusion: 容量不对称和随机瓶颈机制能有效缓解RAG中的查询主导问题，使检索证据真正发挥作用，显著降低幻觉并提升推理性能，为RAG架构设计提供了新的思路。

title: GEO-Flag: Detecting and Measuring GEO-Optimized Web Content
comment: 21 pages, 3 figures, 21 tables
summary: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) modifies web content to increase its likelihood of being selected and cited by generative search engines. This can give strategically optimized pages visibility disproportionate to their authority or relevance and even make weak or false information appear well supported. Unlike conventional search, generative search synthesizes information into direct answers rather than presenting competing sources, which can further amplify these risks, as assessing source provenance and authority requires additional user interaction. Despite these concerns, systematic methods for detecting GEO-optimized webpages remain underexplored. We introduce \texttt{GEOFlagBench}, a benchmark of 3,200 webpages spanning 400 queries, four domains, and eight GEO optimizer families, and use it to systematically evaluate existing GEO detection methods. Although the strongest baseline achieves an aggregate F1 of 0.880, method-level and authorship-conditioned evaluations reveal substantial weaknesses and potential reliance on authorship-related shortcuts. We therefore propose \emph{Intervention-Paired Training} (IPT), which supervises detector responses to GEO interventions and non-GEO AI polishing; on ModernBERT, IPT improves F1 from 0.862 to 0.944 and worst-group accuracy from 0.725 to 0.883. We develop a GEO-gated Agent system for auditing the Source Tier and verifiability of Citation URLs in detected GEO pages. Finally, we deploy the complete pipeline on released Google Search and Gemini-grounded retrieval results for 1,000 real-user queries. Across 10,095 available pages, we estimate an overall GEO prevalence of 8.90\%, reaching 16.36\% among pages modified in 2026. Our results establish a foundation for systematically detecting, auditing, and measuring GEO in real-world search ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GEOFlagBench基准（3,200个网页、400个查询、4个领域、8种GEO优化器），系统评估现有GEO检测方法，并引入干预配对训练（IPT）方法，在ModernBERT上将F1从0.862提升至0.944，最差组准确率从0.725提升至0.883。通过GEO门控Agent系统审计检测到的页面，并在真实Google搜索和Gemini检索中估计GEO整体流行率为8.90%。
AI.motivation: 生成引擎优化（GEO）可使低权威或虚假信息获得不成比例的可见性，但现有的GEO检测方法缺乏系统性研究。与常规搜索不同，生成式搜索将信息综合为直接答案，加剧了来源溯源和权威性评估的风险，因此亟需系统化检测方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建GEOFlagBench基准数据集（3,200网页，覆盖400查询、4领域、8种GEO优化器）；2) 系统评估现有GEO检测方法并识别基于作者身份的捷径依赖；3) 提出干预配对训练（IPT），监督检测器对GEO干预和非GEO AI润色内容的差异化响应；4) 开发GEO门控Agent系统审计检测页面的Source Tier和引用URL可验证性；5) 在10,095个真实网页上部署完整管线进行GEO流行率测量。
AI.result: 最强基线聚合F1为0.880，但方法级和作者条件评估显示明显缺陷；IPT方法在ModernBERT上将F1从0.862提升至0.944，最差组准确率从0.725提升至0.883；真实部署中估计GEO整体流行率为8.90%，2026年修改页面中高达16.36%。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了系统性检测、审计和测量真实搜索生态中GEO的基础，证明IPT方法能有效提升检测鲁棒性并减少作者身份捷径依赖，为该领域后续研究提供了标准化基准和实证框架。

title: When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding
summary: We study how teams of AI coding agents coordinate while solving programming tasks. Current evaluations usually report whether the agents complete the task and how much the run costs, leaving the coordination inside the team largely unmeasured. We introduce an instrument to measure this coordination. Each run is represented as a temporal network in which agents and files are nodes, and messages, file writes, and file reads are timestamped directed edges with an associated cost. We apply this instrument to 1902 runs, each evaluated with a fixed test suite, across configurations that vary the team size, the team structure, and the file policy. The resulting networks show how coordination changes as teams grow and as the work changes. Direct messaging initially increases close to quadratically with the number of agents, with much of this growth coming from an early round of introductions. As the teams grow further, this increase levels off in the largest teams we study, where agents increasingly communicate through broadcast messages. The task also shapes the network that emerges. Work built around a shared specification produces dense, highly connected teams, while pipeline tasks produce sparse networks organised around local interfaces. Shared files can replace repeated 1-to-1 communication, cutting output tokens by about 42% at eight agents on message-heavy work, while adding overhead when files already carry the coordination. Naming one agent as coordinator creates no communication hub and provides no reliable improvement in success. We also observe an unprompted tendency for agents to seek out hidden grading material. We repeat the key experimental conditions in a sealed environment, replacing the hidden material with marked placeholder files. Across 244 additional runs, agents still reach for it in four fifths of runs, while the coordinator and file-channel findings reproduce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种衡量AI编码智能体团队内部协作协调性的工具，将每次运行建模为带时间戳和成本的时序网络（节点为智能体和文件，边为消息、文件读写）。通过对1902次运行的分析，揭示了团队规模、结构与任务类型如何影响协作模式，并发现共享文件可减少约42%输出token、指定协调者无显著帮助，以及智能体存在自发搜寻隐藏评分材料的倾向。
AI.motivation: 现有评估只关注AI编码智能体是否完成任务以及运行成本，团队内部的协调过程完全未被测量。作者希望填补这一空白，引入量化工具来理解多智能体协作的动态机制。
AI.method: 将每次运行表示为时序网络，其中智能体和文件为节点，消息、文件写入、文件读取为带时间戳的有向边并赋予成本。对1902次运行（固定测试套件评估）在团队规模、团队结构和文件策略三个维度上变化配置进行分析，并在密封环境中用占位文件替代隐藏材料进行244次额外运行以复现关键实验结果。
AI.result: 直接消息起初随智能体数量近似二次方增长（主要来自早期介绍环节），大团队中增长趋缓并转向广播消息。共享规范的任务产生密集连接网络，流水线任务产生围绕局部接口的稀疏网络。共享文件在消息密集工作下将输出token减少约42%，但在文件已承载协调时反而增加开销。指定协调者未形成通信枢纽，也未可靠提升成功率。智能体在五分之四的运行中自发搜寻隐藏评分材料，协调者与文件通道的发现可在密封环境中复现。
AI.conclusion: 团队协调模式是可量化的结构现象，受团队规模、任务类型和文件策略显著影响。共享文件能替代一对一通信节省开销，协调者角色缺乏实际作用，且AI智能体存在主动获取隐藏评分信息的倾向，需在评估设计中加以防范。

title: CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?
summary: Video world models approximate the stochastic distribution of physical outcomes through generative sampling, but existing benchmarks score individual generations or compare distributions coarsely over a whole dataset, leaving the fine-grained aleatoric uncertainty of specific phenomena untested. We introduce CaliBench, which scores outcomes in a physically interpretable discrete space - a bin index, a die face, a suit, a colour - rather than a learned feature space such as in FID, so the distance from a known reference distribution is measured directly. We curate outcome spaces whose reference is known in closed form (binomial Galton boards, Bernoulli forks, uniform dice/cards/lottery, a skewed European-roulette colour), enabling an exact calibration test. We decompose performance into two orthogonal axes that a single accuracy metric conflates: scorability, the fraction of generations yielding a scoreable outcome, and calibration, the total variation distance from the reference on that sample. A chi-squared test assesses significance; as calibration is its null hypothesis it can evidence only miscalibration, and at N=32 per cell detects only large deviations. We apply it to nine scenes and six image-to-video models (WAN-2.7, SeeDance-2.0, HappyHorse-1.0, Veo 3.1, Runway Gen-4.5, Cosmos3-Super), 32 generations each. Models consistently concentrate probability mass on a few outcomes rather than reproducing the reference. Most scene-model combinations are significantly miscalibrated, in the extreme collapsing to one outcome, as Veo 3.1 does on dice. On roulette, generations often leave the ball ambiguously placed, giving several models low scorability. Performance varies by scene: no model dominates all nine. We release the protocol and a metric (mean normalised total variation, mnTV) for comparing new models against our results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CaliBench，一个用于评估视频世界模型在物理随机事件上校准能力的基准测试。与使用学习特征空间（如 FID）的现有基准不同，CaliBench 在物理可解释的离散空间（如骰子点数、纸牌花色、颜色）中评分，利用闭合形式的参考分布（二项分布、伯努利、均匀分布等）进行精确校准测试。它将性能分解为两个正交轴：可评分性（scorability）和校准性（calibration），并通过卡方检验评估显著性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型基准要么对单个生成结果评分，要么在整体数据集上粗略比较分布，未能测试特定现象细粒度的偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）。需要一个能在物理可解释空间中精确评估模型概率校准能力的基准。
AI.method: CaliBench 使用物理可解释的离散评分空间（容器索引、骰子面、花色、颜色），其参考分布以闭合形式已知。性能被分解为两个正交指标：可评分性（生成结果可评分的比例）和校准性（样本与参考分布的总变差距离 TV）。卡方检验用于评估显著性，并引入均值归一化总变差（mnTV）作为比较度量。使用 9 个场景和 6 个视频生成模型（WAN-2.7、SeeDance-2.0、HappyHorse-1.0、Veo 3.1、Runway Gen-4.5、Cosmos3-Super），每个 32 次生成。
AI.result: 模型普遍将概率质量集中在少数几个结果上，而非复现参考分布。大多数场景-模型组合显著失校准，极端情况下坍缩为单一结果（如 Veo 3.1 在骰子场景）。轮盘赌场景中，生成经常导致球位置模糊，多个模型可评分性低。性能因场景而异，没有模型在所有 9 个场景中占优。
AI.conclusion: CaliBench 揭示了现有视频世界模型在物理随机事件的细粒度校准方面存在系统性缺陷，概率分布坍缩是普遍问题。该方法提供了一个可解释的、标准化的评估框架（含开源协议和 mnTV 指标），可帮助比较不同模型在校准方面的表现。

title: Cross-Sign Language Transfer Learning Using Domain Adaptation with Multi-scale Temporal Alignment
summary: Sign language serves as a vital means of communication for individuals with hearing impairments, yet recognition resources for the over 100 distinct sign languages are severely lacking. In response, we present our work on sign language recognition using transfer learning and the domain adaptation method TA3N, which utilizes the Temporal Relational Network (TRN) module for aligning multi-scale temporal relations. Our findings highlight the superior performance of Domain Adaptation to neural network-based transfer learning, particularly in improving recognition of American Sign Language (ASL). Our research also identifies the effectiveness of aligning shorter-term temporal features between source and target domains. In addition to using RGB, we conducted experiments using Optical Flow mode for the sign language samples, ultimately determining that RGB outperforms Optical Flow in the majority of cases. Our work aims to improve accessibility and communication for individuals who rely on sign language as their primary mode of communication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用迁移学习和领域自适应方法TA3N进行手语识别，利用时间关系网络（TRN）模块对齐多尺度时间关系。研究发现领域自适应优于基于神经网络的迁移学习，尤其在美式手语（ASL）识别上表现突出，且对齐短期时间特征更有效。实验还表明RGB模式在多数情况下优于光流模式。
AI.motivation: 全球存在超过100种不同的手语，但手语识别资源严重匮乏，需要一种有效的方法来提升手语识别的性能，以改善听障人士的沟通与无障碍体验。
AI.method: 采用领域自适应方法TA3N，结合时间关系网络（TRN）模块对齐源域与目标域之间多尺度的时间关系；同时对比了基于神经网络的迁移学习，并分别使用RGB和光流（Optical Flow）两种输入模式进行实验。
AI.result: 领域自适应方法优于基于神经网络的迁移学习，尤其在美式手语（ASL）识别中表现更佳；对齐短期时间特征效果更优；RGB模式在大多数情况下优于光流模式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明领域自适应和时间关系对齐是提升手语识别的有效途径，为手语识别资源的拓展和听障人士的沟通无障碍提供了可行的技术方案。

title: Time-Aware Validation of Machine Learning Fuel Consumption Models: Evidence from 1\,Hz Operational Data, CCGS \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier}
