summary: Ship fuel consumption (SFC) prediction supports vessel operation optimisation, emissions estimation, and decision support systems (DSS) for sustainable maritime transportation. Numerous data-driven fuel models have been developed over the past two decades, but a critical and often overlooked limitation lies in their validation practices: most studies evaluate performance using random train--test splits, which, applied to high-frequency records, admit temporal leakage and yield optimistic results that do not reflect deployment conditions. This paper examines that gap using time-aware evaluation, specifically Time Series Cross-Validation (TSCV) and Blocked TSCV (BTSCV). Using the Canadian Coast Guard Ship (CCGS) \textit{Sir Wilfrid Laurier} as a case study, six regression models and a physics baseline are tuned under three time-aware schemes and three feature configurations, then evaluated on a common chronological hold-out set drawn from approximately 3.88 million steady-state 1\,Hz records.

AI.tldr: 本文指出船舶燃油消耗（SFC）预测模型研究中普遍存在的时间泄漏问题——多数研究使用随机训练-测试划分，在高频数据上导致过于乐观的结果。作者采用时间感知评估（TSCV和BTSCV），以加拿大海岸警卫队Sir Wilfrid Laurier号船为案例，对六个回归模型和物理基线在三种时间感知方案和三种特征配置下进行调优，并在约388万条稳态1Hz记录的公共时序留出集上评估。
AI.motivation: 过去二十多年虽然开发了大量数据驱动的燃油模型，但其验证实践存在关键缺陷：随机训练-测试划分在高频时序数据上会造成时间泄漏，导致性能评估结果过于乐观，不能反映真实部署条件，需要更严谨的时间感知验证方法。
AI.method: 采用时间感知评估框架，包括时间序列交叉验证（TSCV）和分块TSCV（BTSCV）。以CCGS Sir Wilfrid Laurier船为案例，构建六个回归模型和一个物理基线模型，在三种时间感知调优方案和三种特征配置下进行超参数调优，最后在一个共同的按时间顺序划分的hold-out测试集上评估。
AI.result: 研究基于约388万条稳态1Hz记录进行实验，比较了不同时间感知评估方案和特征配置下各模型的性能表现（具体数值结果未在摘要中给出）。
AI.conclusion: 随机训练-测试划分会因时间泄漏而高估模型性能，时间感知评估（TSCV/BTSCV）是更可靠、更贴近实际部署条件的验证方式，为船舶燃油模型开发提供了更严谨的评估范式。

title: Quipu: A Governed Bitemporal Knowledge Graph Store
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Subtitle: "Start strict: rethinking knowledge-graph defaults for agent-written knowledge". Source and the benchmark/census/ artifacts behind every reported number are archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21878428 (concept DOI, resolves to newest release). Development repository: github.com/scbrown/quipu
summary: Agents now write knowledge graphs, but knowledge-graph stores still carry defaults set when humans curated them: accept writes now and clean later, keep one time axis or none, treat every writer's facts as equally trustworthy, and leave governance to dashboards and middleware. These four defaults are individually convenient and jointly untenable under agent workloads. We present Quipu, an embeddable store that inverts all four: no fact enters except through a gate whose predicates evaluate the pending post-state; data, trust labels, verdicts, and the rules themselves are bitemporal; named graphs are the unit of authority and trust, composed under a lattice whose one invariant is that composition never widens; and the governance specification $Σ$, the trace, and signed verdicts are facts in the store they govern, making the audit $T \models Σ$ a query. We evaluate with Census, a deterministic multi-writer lifecycle whose single seeded run scores every research question against planted ground truth: the gated store ends with 0 of 6 planted defects versus 6 of 6 ungated; all 7 composition probes uphold the lattice contract; 50 of 50 satisfied verdicts re-derive faithfully as of their instant while all 50 would be misreported under a latest-only rule set; and the SARC reference checker agrees with the in-store audit verdict-for-verdict, differing only on coverage semantics. A recorded trace from a governed writer surfaces a live enforcement gap the audit names with its remediation. On DEMM-Bench, an external decision-evidence sufficiency benchmark, a content-only reading of the exported records answers all 512 property-level governance questions correctly with zero overclaim under all eight degradation conditions, while container-presence baselines overclaim on up to 87.5% of them -- and the run surfaced, and led us to close, a gap in what a denial's verdict attests.

AI.tldr: Quipu是一个可嵌入的知识图谱存储系统，反转了传统知识图谱存储的四个默认设置：通过门控谓词过滤事实写入、实现完全双时态数据、以命名图为信任和权威单位并在格下组合、将治理规范本身作为存储内的事实从而支持可查询审计。实验证明其在确定性基准和外部基准上均显著优于未门控基线。
AI.motivation: 传统知识图谱存储的四个默认设计（延迟清洗、单一时间轴、信任均等、治理外置）在人类策展场景下尚可接受，但在智能体（agent）工作负载下不可持续——智能体写入的事实需要即时验证、多时间维度、差异化信任和可执行的治理。
AI.method: Quipu反转全部四个默认：(1) 所有事实必须通过门控谓词对pending post-state求值后才能进入；(2) 数据、信任标签、裁决和规则本身都采用双时态存储；(3) 命名图作为权威和信任单元，在格(lattice)下组合且保证组合不扩张；(4) 治理规范Σ、追踪记录和签名裁决都作为所治理存储中的事实，使审计T⊨Σ成为一次查询。
AI.result: 在Census确定性基准中：门控存储留下0/6个缺陷（未门控为6/6）；7个组合探针全部满足格契约；50/50的满意裁决可按其时间点忠实重推导（latest-only规则下全部50个会被误报）；SARC参考检查器与存储内审计逐裁决一致。在DEMM-Bench上，内容级读取在8种退化条件下512个属性级治理问题全部答对且零过度声明，而容器存在性基线最多在87.5%问题上过度声明。
AI.conclusion: Quipu证明将治理内嵌为存储自身的可查询事实是可行的，能够检测并修复实时执行差距（如拒绝裁决的证明范围缺口），为智能体时代的AI代理知识图谱治理提供了新范式。

title: Data-Efficient and Interpretable Classification of Circulating Tumor Cell Phenotypes in Microfluidic Devices via Deep Learning
summary:
Accurate classification of circulating tumor cell (CTC) phenotypes can provide valuable information for assessing metastatic potential. Label free microfluidic devices provide a hydrodynamic obstacle course that transforms subtle biophysical characteristics of CTCs, including size and deformability, into distinct kinematic trajectories. However, the highly nonlinear fluid structure interactions governing these trajectories make the inverse problem of inferring cellular phenotype from trajectory data analytically intractable. While deep neural networks (DNNs) have emerged as a powerful approach for addressing this inverse problem, their effectiveness is constrained by the limited availability of trajectory data and the lack of physical interpretability.
  To address these challenges, we propose an interpretable and data efficient DNN framework for trajectory based CTC classification. To mitigate the scarcity of data, we develop Subsequence (SubSeq), a targeted augmentation strategy that randomly extracts informative local trajectory segments during training to promote learning from localized patterns. We further apply Gradient Weighted Class Activation Mapping to identify the trajectory features and physical regions of the microfluidic device that drive model predictions. Experimental results demonstrate that SubSeq improves classification accuracy over the evaluated baseline and augmentation methods. Furthermore, interpretability analysis suggests that localized trajectory segments contain substantial biophysical information relevant to accurate classification. This provides justification for SubSeq and also highlights the redundancy of full-length trajectories. More broadly, the proposed framework views microfluidic geometries as physical encoders of cellular mechanical properties, providing mechanistic insights that may inform the future design of diagnostic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可解释且数据高效的深度神经网络框架，用于基于轨迹的循环肿瘤细胞（CTC）表型分类。通过子序列（SubSeq）数据增强策略缓解轨迹数据稀缺问题，并使用梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM）提供物理可解释性，实验表明该方法在分类准确率和可解释性上均优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: CTC表型准确分类对评估转移潜力至关重要。无标记微流控装置将细胞生物物理特征转化为运动轨迹，但高度非线性的流固耦合作用使得从轨迹反推细胞表型的逆问题在解析上难以处理。虽然深度神经网络可以解决该逆问题，但受限于轨迹数据稀缺和缺乏物理可解释性。
AI.method: 1) 提出SubSeq定向增强策略：训练过程中随机提取信息丰富的局部轨迹片段，促进模型从局部模式中学习，缓解数据稀缺问题。2) 应用梯度加权类激活映射（Grad-CAM）识别驱动模型预测的轨迹特征和微流控装置中的物理区域，提供可解释性分析。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：SubSeq在分类准确率上优于基线和其他增强方法；可解释性分析显示局部轨迹片段包含大量与准确分类相关的生物物理信息，验证了SubSeq方法的合理性，同时也凸显了全长轨迹的冗余性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将微流控几何结构视为细胞机械特性的物理编码器，为CTC分类提供了机制层面的洞见，可为未来诊断设备的设计提供指导。研究不仅解决了数据稀缺和可解释性问题，还揭示了局部轨迹片段在分类中的关键价值。

title: What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models
summary: Regulatory compliance monitoring in deployed language models is increasingly implemented as a legal and audit control, checking model outputs against written rules spanning data protection, healthcare, financial regulation, and platform policy. Such monitoring is meaningful only if a detector's verdict depends on the stated rule rather than on surface features of the scenario. We show this condition fails across the current class of compliance detectors, a failure we call rule blindness. Deleting, permuting, or substituting the governing rule leaves detection accuracy unchanged for every guard and activation probe we test, including a policy-conditioned guard that correctly cites the governing clause yet barely changes its verdict when that clause is swapped for its permissive counterpart. A purpose-built benchmark crossing two rules with two scenarios, so that neither alone predicts the label, confirms the failure under a design no prior benchmark rules out, and shows that step by step reasoning, not any fast detector we test, is what escapes it. Auditing at scale requires a retraining-free detector, so we introduce the Internal Compliance Score (ICS): a training-free activation readout calibrated from ten labelled pairs and scored by a single projection. We hold ICS to the same scrutiny as the guards it audits: a pre-registered criterion for beating trivial baselines is not met, and a bag-of-words model matches its pooled generalisation exactly. It remains useful because it is inexpensive, letting us audit four deployed guard models, an 8B zero-shot judge, and thirteen benchmarks, and it raises the mechanically verified pass rate when used to rank candidate responses, though an adaptive white-box attack removes this gain. We release the counterfactual protocol and crossed-rule benchmark so rule blindness can be tested in future probe and guard claims.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了当前合规性检测器（包括守卫模型和激活探针）存在"规则盲区"（rule blindness）问题：检测结果依赖于场景表面特征而非实际规则文本。作者提出了跨越两条规则与两个场景去交叉的基准来验证该问题，并引入了一种免训练的激活读取方法（Internal Compliance Score, ICS），尽管它在严格评估中未能超越简单基线，但因成本低廉仍可用于大规模审计。文章还发布了反事实协议和交叉规则基准供未来研究使用。
AI.motivation: 监管合规监控在已部署的语言模型中日益重要，但一个检测器只有在判定依据是明确规则而非场景表面特征时才有意义。现有检测器在这一条件下失效，即"规则盲区"问题——删除、置换或替换规则文本不影响检测结果，这严重危及合规审计的可靠性。
AI.method: 1) 构造跨越两条规则和两个场景的交叉基准，确保单一特征无法预测标签，以验证规则盲区。2) 引入训练免费的激活读取器ICS（Internal Compliance Score），用十个标注样本校准，通过单一投影评分。3) 采用预注册标准对ICS进行严格评估，并与词袋基线对比。4) 对四个部署守卫模型、8B零样本裁判及十三个基准进行大规模审计。
AI.result: 发现所有受测守卫和激活探针均存在规则盲区，包括能正确引用规则条款的策略条件守卫。ICS未达到击败平凡基线的预注册标准，其池化泛化性能与词袋模型完全一致。尽管ICS在排序候选响应时能提高机械验证的通过率，但自适应白盒攻击可消除此收益。
AI.conclusion: 当前合规检测器普遍存在规则盲区，逐步推理（step-by-step reasoning）是唯一能摆脱该问题的方法。ICS虽不优于简单基线，但因其低成本特性在大规模审计中仍有实用价值，同时需警惕其对自适应攻击的脆弱性。作者公开了反事实协议和交叉规则基准，以促进未来检测器声明的可验证性。

title: An Analytical-Prior Framework for Data-Efficient Prediction of Sound-Reduction Frequencies in Rectangular Side-Branch Helmholtz Resonators
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 1 table
summary: High-fidelity finite-element simulations can provide accurate numerical predictions for side-branch resonators, but large simulation datasets are expensive to generate and purely data-driven surrogates may become unreliable when simulation-labelled data are scarce. This study develops an analytical-prior learning framework that reuses a low-cost analytical model to improve data efficiency under limited high-fidelity simulation budgets. Two complementary routes are considered. When the analytical model remains available at inference, it is retained as an explicit baseline and the simulation data are used to learn only the analytical-to-simulation discrepancy. When a self-contained predictor is required, the analytical mapping is first distilled from abundant low-cost evaluations into a learned prior and then calibrated with the limited simulation data. The framework is evaluated on rectangular side-branch Helmholtz resonators using 86 simulation-labelled geometries and 8,998 non-overlapping analytical-only geometries. The analytical model achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.333 Hz. Direct support vector regression (SVR) achieved 3.375 Hz, while residual SVR reduced the MAE to 0.426 Hz. A direct multilayer perceptron (MLP) achieved 1.109 Hz, whereas analytical-prior pretraining reduced the error to 0.556 Hz with frozen-prior residual adaptation and 0.371 Hz with full-model fine-tuning. Across training budgets of 20 to 70 simulation-labelled cases, both analytical correction and analytical-prior pretraining consistently improved data efficiency relative to direct learning. These results show that analytical prior information can substantially improve high-fidelity prediction when simulation data are scarce, with explicit correction and prior distillation serving complementary deployment needs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"解析先验学习"框架，通过复用低成本解析模型来提升高保真有限元仿真代理模型在仿真数据稀缺时的预测精度。框架包含两条路径：显式残差校正（在推理时保留解析模型）和解析先验蒸馏（先蒸馏解析知识再微调）。在86个仿真标注几何体上，该方法将SVR误差从3.375 Hz降至0.426 Hz，将MLP误差从1.109 Hz降至0.371 Hz，显著提升数据效率。
AI.motivation: 高保真有限元仿真虽然准确但生成大量数据成本昂贵，而纯数据驱动的代理模型在仿真标注数据稀缺时可能不可靠。作者希望利用低成本的解析模型来弥补数据不足的问题，提高代理模型在有限仿真预算下的数据效率和预测精度。
AI.method: 提出解析先验学习框架，包含两条互补路线：(1) 显式校正路线：推理时保留解析模型作为基线，仅用仿真数据学习解析模型与仿真之间的残差（residual learning）；(2) 先验蒸馏路线：先从大量低成本解析模型中蒸馏出学习先验，再用有限仿真数据校准/微调。两种方法分别与SVR和MLP结合验证。
AI.result: 在矩形侧支亥姆霍兹谐振器上，86个仿真标注和8,998个解析数据。解析模型MAE为1.333 Hz，直接SVR为3.375 Hz，残差SVR降至0.426 Hz；直接MLP为1.109 Hz，解析先验预训练后冻结先验残差适配为0.556 Hz，全模型微调为0.371 Hz。在20-70个训练样本预算下，两种路线均一致提升数据效率。
AI.conclusion: 解析先验信息能在仿真数据稀缺时显著提升高保真预测精度。显式校正和先验蒸馏两条路线互补，分别适用于不同部署需求（能否在推理时访问解析模型），为仿真替代模型的数据效率问题提供了有效解决方案。

title: Q-based Variational Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: The development of safe and beneficial AI requires that systems can learn and act in accordance with human preferences. However, explicitly specifying these preferences by hand is often infeasible. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) addresses this challenge by inferring preferences, represented as reward functions, from expert behaviour. We introduce Q-based Variational IRL (QVIRL), a novel Bayesian IRL method that recovers a posterior distribution over rewards from expert demonstrations via primarily learning a variational distribution over optimal Q-values. Unlike previous approaches, QVIRL combines scalability with uncertainty quantification, important for safety-critical applications as well as active learning. We demonstrate QVIRL's strong performance in apprenticeship learning across various tasks, including gridworlds, Lunar Lander, the Highway Environment, and two ATARI games both with static expert data and with active learning. It is the first method for Bayesian IRL that demonstrates training from raw pixel observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QVIRL（基于Q值的变分逆强化学习），一种新颖的贝叶斯逆强化学习方法，通过学习最优Q值上的变分分布来恢复奖励的后验分布，兼顾可扩展性与不确定性量化，并在多种任务中展现了强大的学徒学习性能。
AI.motivation: 开发安全有益的AI需要系统能够学习并遵循人类偏好，但手工明确指定这些偏好往往不可行。逆强化学习（IRL）通过从专家行为中推断奖励函数来解决这一挑战，但现有方法难以同时满足可扩展性和不确定性量化两个需求，这对安全关键应用和主动学习至关重要。
AI.method: QVIRL是一种贝叶斯IRL方法，核心思路是主要通过学习最优Q值上的变分分布来恢复奖励的后验分布，而非直接对奖励建模。这种方法既保持了贝叶斯框架下的不确定性量化能力，又通过基于Q值的学习实现了良好的可扩展性。
AI.result: QVIRL在多种任务中展现了强大的学徒学习性能，包括网格世界、Lunar Lander、高速公路环境和两个ATARI游戏，在静态专家数据和主动学习两种场景下均有出色表现。此外，它是首个能从原始像素观测进行训练的贝叶斯IRL方法。
AI.conclusion: QVIRL成功将贝叶斯IRL的可扩展性与不确定性量化相结合，为安全关键应用和主动学习提供了有力支持，并首次实现了贝叶斯IRL在原始像素观测上的训练，推动了该领域的发展。
